data.v: कुलीनार्यजनोपेतं तुष्टपुष्टमनुद्धतम् । कृतमानोपकारं च यशस्वि च मनस्वि च ॥
data.md: They are high-born, respectable, evercontented, well-fed and submissive. They have been duly honoured and rewarded by ourselves. They are all endued with fame and intelligence.

data.v: सचिवैश्चापरैर्मुख्यैर्बहुभिर्मुख्यकर्मभिः । लोकपालोपमैस्तात पालितं नरसत्तमैः ॥
data.md: They again, O sire, are defended by our best warriors and other's of pious practices, all of whom are foremost men and resemble the Lokapalas themselves.

data.v: बहुभिः पार्थिवैर्गुप्तमस्मत्प्रियचिकीर्षुभिः । अस्मानभिसृतैः कामात्सबलैः सपदानुगैः ॥
data.md: Numerous kings solicitous of our welfare, who have, out of their own accord, joined us with all their forces and followers, also defend them.

data.v: महोदधिमिवापूर्णमापगाभिः समन्ततः । अपक्षैः पक्षिसंकाशै रथैरश्वैश्च संवृतम् ॥
data.md: Truly our army is like the vast ocean swelling with the waters of various stream flowing into it from all sides. It teems with chariot and steeds, which though devoid of wings are still capable of moving through the air like the winged rangers of the sky.

data.v: योधाक्षय्यजलं भीमं वाहनोर्मितरङ्गिणम् । क्षेपण्यसिगदाशक्तिशरप्रासझषाकुलम् ॥
data.md: (Ocean-like as our arrmy is), numerous warriors constitute its waters; and the various vehicles constitute its dreadful and surging waves. Innumerable maces, swords, darts, shafts and javelins constitute the oars plied on it.

data.v: ध्वजभूषणसंबाधं रत्नपट्टेन संचितम् । वाहनैरपि धावद्भिर्वायुवेगविकम्पितम् ॥
data.md: Teeming with standards and ornaments, the combatants form the lotuses on it. The swiftmoving steeds and elephants and chargers constitute the tempest that lashes in into fury.

data.v: द्रोणगम्भीरपातालं कृतवर्ममहाह्रदम् । जलसंधमहाग्राहं कर्णचन्द्रोदयोद्धतम् ॥
data.md: Drona forms its fathomless cave, Kritavarman its minghty lake and Jalasandha its dreadful alligator and Karna, the rising of the moon that makes it swell with pride and energy.

data.v: गते सैन्यार्णवं भित्त्वा तरसा पाण्डवर्षभे । संजयैकरथेनैव युयुधाने च मामकम् ॥
data.md: O Sanjaya, on a single car that foremost of the Pandavas viz., Arjuna has gone piercing through my ocean-like host and Yuyudhana also has followed him;

data.v: तत्र शेषं न पश्यामि प्रविष्टे सव्यसाचिनि । सात्वते च रथोदारे मम सैन्यस्य संजय ॥
data.md: And O Sanjaya, when Savyasachin has thus penetrated into my host and also that excellent car-warrior Satyaki of the Satvata race has done so, I do not think that any one of my troops will be able to escape with his life.

data.v: तौ तत्र समतिक्रान्तौ दृष्ट्वाभीतौ तरस्विनौ । सिन्धुराजं च संप्रेक्ष्य गाण्डीवस्येषुगोचरे ॥
data.md: Beholding those two heroes dash with speed through the vanguards of my troops and seeing the ruler of the Sindhus come within range of arrows shot from the Gandiva bow.

data.v: किं तदा कुरवः कृत्यं विदधुः कालचोदिताः । दारुणैकायने काले कथं वा प्रतिपेदिरे ॥
data.md: What course of action did the Kurus, goaded on to destruction by Fate then adopt? What became of them at that hour when the battle raged with fury?

data.v: ग्रस्तान्हि कौरवान्मन्ये मृत्युना तात संगतान् । विक्रमो हि रणे तेषां न तथा दृश्यतेऽद्य वै ॥
data.md: O son, I consider the assembled Kaurava host already within the jaws of Death. Their prowess in battle is no longer seen to be what it once was.

data.v: अक्षतौ संयुगे तत्र प्रविष्टौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ । न च वारयिता कश्चित्तयोरस्तीह संजय ॥
data.md: Krishna and the son of Pandu have both entered into our troops, receiving not even the slightest wound. O Sanjaya, there is none also who can resist them.

data.v: भृताश्च बहवो योधाः परीक्ष्यैव महारथाः । वेतनेन यथायोग्यं प्रियवादेन चापरे ॥
data.md: Many mighty car-warriors and combatants have been admitted into our army after due examination. They all have been gratified by us with due remunerations and agreeable speeches.

data.v: अकारणभृतस्तात मम सैन्ये न विद्यते । कर्मणा ह्यनुरूपेण लभ्यते भक्तवेतनम् ॥
data.md: There is none among my troops who has been maltreated. Every one receives his pay and ration, according to his abilities.

data.v: न च योधोऽभवत्कश्चिन्मम सैन्ये तु संजय । अल्पदानभृतस्तात न कुप्यभृतको नरः ॥
data.md: O Sanjaya, there is none who is not a good warrior, none who receives remuneration less then what he deserves or none who receives no pay.

data.v: पूजिता हि यथाशक्त्या दानमानासनैर्मया । तथा पुत्रैश्च मे तात ज्ञातिभिश्च सबान्धवैः ॥
data.md: The soldiers are honoured by me to the best of my resources, with gifts, honors and seats. My sons, relatives and my kinsmen, O son, all treat them in the same respectful manner as I do.

data.v: ते च प्राप्यैव संग्रामे निर्जिताः सव्यसाचिना । शैनेयेन परामृष्टाः किमन्यद्भागधेयतः ॥
data.md: Even such troops, encountering Savayasachin in battle, are being vanquished by him; they are also being crushed by the grand son of Sini; what can it be but Destiny?

data.v: रक्ष्यते यश्च संग्रामे ये च संजय रक्षिणः । एकः साधारणः पन्था रक्ष्यस्य सह रक्षिभिः ॥
data.md: Those who are protecting and those who are protected, are following the same road, the dcfender and the defended!

data.v: अर्जुनं समरे दृष्ट्वा सैन्धवस्याग्रतः स्थितम् । पुत्रो मम भृशं मूढः किं कार्यं प्रत्यपद्यत ॥
data.md: Beholding Arjuna stand before the ruler of the Sindhus in hostile attitude, what measure did my highly foolish son adopt?

data.v: सात्यकिं च रणे दृष्ट्वा प्रविशन्तमभीतवत् । किं नु दुर्योधनः कृत्यं प्राप्तकालममन्यत ॥
data.md: Beholding also Satyaki dash through his troops like one fearless, what measures also did Duryodhana consider to be suitable to the situation?

data.v: सर्वशस्त्रातिगौ सेनां प्रविष्टौ रथसत्तमौ । दृष्ट्वा कां वै धृतिं युद्धे प्रत्यपद्यन्त मामकाः ॥
data.md: Beholding those two foremost of carwarriors, both beyond the reach of all weapons, thus penetrate into my host, what resolution did my troops then form

data.v: दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं तु दाशार्हमर्जुनार्थे व्यवस्थितम् । शिनीनामृषभं चैव मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥
data.md: Meseems, beholding Krishna of the Dasarha race and that foremost of the Sinis, both exerting for the sake of Arjuna, my sons are giving way to grief.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा सेनां व्यतिक्रान्तां सात्वतेनार्जुनेन च । पलायमानांश्च कुरून्मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥
data.md: Beholding him of the Satvata race and Arjuna pass through my divisions and beholding the Kurus fly in all directions, Meseems, my sons are giving way to grief.

data.v: विद्रुतान्रथिनो दृष्ट्वा निरुत्साहान्द्विषज्जये । पलायने कृतोत्साहान्मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥
data.md: Meseems my sons are giving way to grief, beholding the car-warriors routed and hopeless of conquering their foes and exert themselves in flying away.

data.v: शून्यान्कृतान्रथोपस्थान्सात्वतेनार्जुनेन च । हतांश्च योधान्संदृश्य मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥
data.md: Beholding him of the Satvata race and Arjuna pass through my divisions and beholding the Kurus fly in all directions, Meseems, my sons are giving way to grief.

data.v: व्यश्वनागरथान्दृष्ट्वा तत्र वीरान्सहस्रशः । धावमानान्रणे व्यग्रान्मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥
data.md: Meseems my sons are lamenting, beholding the steeds, the chariots, the elephants and thousands of heroic soldiers flying away in haste from the field of battle.

data.v: विवीरांश्च कृतानश्वान्विरथांश्च कृतान्नरान् । तत्र सात्यकिपार्थाभ्यां मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥
data.md: Meseems my sons are lamenting seeing steeds deprived of riders and warriors deprived of chariots, by Arjuna and Satyaki.

data.v: पत्तिसंघान्रणे दृष्ट्वा धावमानांश्च सर्वशः । निराशा विजये सर्वे मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥
data.md: Meseems my sons are lamenting, hopeless of their victory, by seeing the divisions of infantry fly with haste in all direction.

data.v: द्रोणस्य समतिक्रान्तावनीकमपराजितौ । क्षणेन दृष्ट्वा तौ वीरौ मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥
data.md: Meseems my sons are lamenting beholding those two invincible heroes pass in a moment through the division of Drona.

data.v: संमूढोऽस्मि भृशं तात श्रुत्वा कृष्णधनंजयौ । प्रविष्टौ मामकं सैन्यं सात्वतेन सहाच्युतौ ॥
data.md: O son, I am indeed overwhelmed with a stupor upon hearing that Krishna and Arjuna of unfading glory together with Satyaki of the Satvata race, have entered into my divisions.

data.v: तस्मिन्प्रविष्टे पृतनां शिनीनां प्रवरे रथे । भोजानीकं व्यतिक्रान्ते कथमासन्हि कौरवाः ॥
data.md: When that foremost of car-warriors among the Sinis had plunged into my host and when he had passed through the Bhoja division, what, O Sanjaya, did the Kurus do?

data.v: तथा द्रोणेन समरे निगृहीतेषु पाण्डुषु । कथं युद्धमभूत्तत्र तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥
data.md: O Sanjaya, relate to me also how the battle raged there where Drona began to crush the Pandava host in battle.

data.v: द्रोणो हि बलवाञ्शूरः कृतास्त्रो दृढविक्रमः । पाञ्चालास्तं महेष्वासं प्रत्ययुध्यन्कथं रणे ॥
data.md: Drona was a warrior of superior skill; he was endued with strength, accomplished in the use of weapons and indomitable in battle. How was it then possible for the Panchalas to pierce that hero in battle?

data.v: बद्धवैरास्तथा द्रोणे धर्मराजजयैषिणः । भारद्वाजस्तथा तेषु कृतवैरो महारथः ॥
data.md: Solicitious of Dhanajaya's victory, the Panchalas were Drona's implacable foes, so also that mighty car-warrior the son of Bharadvaja was an inveterate enemy of theirs.

data.v: अर्जुनश्चापि यच्चक्रे सिन्धुराजवधं प्रति । तन्मे सर्वं समाचक्ष्व कुशलो ह्यसि संजय ॥
data.md: O Sanjaya, skilful as you are in narration, tell me all that in detail which Arjuna did for bringing about the slaughter of the Sindhu king.

data.v: आत्मापराधात्संभूतं व्यसनं भरतर्षभ । प्राप्य प्राकृतवद्वीर न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said O foremost of the Bharatas, it behoves you not to lament like an ordinary person, when you are overtaken, O hero, by a calamity which owes its origin to your own misconduct.

data.v: तव निर्गुणतां ज्ञात्वा पक्षपातं सुतेषु च । द्वैधीभावं तथा धर्मे पाण्डवेषु च मत्सरम् । आर्तप्रलापांश्च बहून्मनुजाधिपसत्तम ॥
data.md: Knowing your worthlessness, your partiality for your sons, your duplicity in virtue, your animosity against the sons of Pandu and ascertaining your crooked intentions against them and listening to many of your incoherent and delirious bewailings, 0 foremost of kings.

data.v: सर्वलोकस्य तत्त्वज्ञः सर्वलोकगुरुः प्रभुः । वासुदेवस्ततो युद्धं कुरूणामकरोन्महत् ॥
data.md: That puissant lord of all the worlds, that one conversant with the truth of everything in the worlds, namely, the son of Vasudeva, caused the drums of war to be sounded among the Kurus.

data.v: आत्मापराधात्सुमहान्प्राप्तस्ते विपुलः क्षयः । न हि ते सुकृतं किंचिदादौ मध्ये च भारत । दृश्यते पृष्ठतश्चैव त्वन्मूलो हि पराजयः ॥
data.md: As these incidents developed themselves, no good action was performed by you either in the beginning, in the middle or in the end, O Bharata. The defeat that can be anticipated now, is entirely owing to your fault.

data.v: तस्मादद्य स्थिरो भूत्वा ज्ञात्वा लोकस्य निर्णयम् । शृणु युद्धं यथा वृत्तं घोरं देवासुरोपमम् ॥
data.md: Therefore, knowing as you do, the fate of this world, quietly and attentively hear how the battle that resembled that between the gods and the Asuras, took place.

data.v: प्रविष्टे तव सैन्यं तु शैनेये सत्यविक्रमे । भीमसेनमुखाः पार्थाः प्रतीयुर्वाहिनीं तव ॥
data.md: When Sini's grandson of invincible prowess had entered into your troops, the troops of the Parthas headed by Bhimasena, fell upon your troops.

data.v: आगच्छतस्तान्सहसा क्रुद्धरूपान्सहानुगान् । दधारैको रणे पाण्डून्कृतवर्मा महारथः ॥
data.md: Then the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman, single-headed, received in that battle, the enraged Pandava troops who had been rushing to the battle with their followers.

data.v: यथोद्वृत्तं धारयते वेला वै सलिलार्णवम् । पाण्डुसैन्यं तथा संख्ये हार्दिक्यः समवारयत् ॥
data.md: Just as the banks resist the surging waves of the sea, so did the son of Hridika resist the Pandava troops in battle.

data.v: तत्राद्भुतममन्यन्त हार्दिक्यस्य पराक्रमम् । यदेनं सहिताः पार्था नातिचक्रमुराहवे ॥
data.md: Then we beheld the wonderful prowess of Hridika's son inasmuch as the united divisions of the Parthas were unable to bear him down in battle.

data.v: ततो भीमस्त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा कृतवर्माणमायसैः । शङ्खं दध्मौ महाबाहुर्हर्षयन्सर्वपाण्डवान् ॥
data.md: Thereupon the mighty-armed Bhima piercing Kritavarman with three swift-coursing arrows, blew his conch-shell, imparting thereby delight unto the Pandava troops.

data.v: सहदेवस्तु विंशत्या धर्मराजश्च पञ्चभिः । शतेन नकुलश्चापि हार्दिक्यं समविध्यत ॥
data.md: Then Sahadeva pierced Hridika's son with twenty, Yudhishthira the virtuous with five and Nakula with a hundred shafts.

data.v: द्रौपदेयास्त्रिसप्तत्या सप्तभिश्च घटोत्कचः । धृष्टद्युम्नस्त्रिभिश्चापि कृतवर्माणमार्दयत् । विराटो द्रुपदश्चैव याज्ञसेनिश्च पञ्चभिः ॥
data.md: The son of Draupadi pierced him with three and seventy, Ghatotkacha with seven and Dhristadyumna pierced Kritavarman with three arrows.

data.v: शिखण्डी चापि हार्दिक्यं विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः । पुनर्विव्याध विंशत्या सायकानां हसन्निव ॥
कृतवर्मा ततो राजन्सर्वतस्तान्महारथान् । एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा भीमं विव्याध सप्तभिः । धनुर्ध्वजं च संयत्तो रथाद्भूमावपातयत् ॥
data.md: He then once more smilingly pierced him with twenty shafts. Thereupon, Oking, Kritavarman piercing each of these mighty carwarriors separately with five shafts, pierced Bhima with another seven shafts. Then he felled from the latter's car his standard and cutoff his bow.

data.v: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं त्वरमाणो महारथः । आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः सप्तत्या निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Then that mighty car-warrior making haste and burning with rage, pierced Bhima whose bow had been severed, on the breast, with seventy sharp arrows.

data.v: स गाढविद्धो बलवान्हार्दिक्यस्य शरोत्तमैः । चचाल रथमध्यस्थः क्षितिकम्पे यथाचलः ॥
data.md: That hero (Bhima) endued with prowess, thus deeply pierced by the excellent shafts of Hridika's son, began to tremble in the terrace of his car, like a mountain shaking during an earthquake.

data.v: भीमसेनं तथा दृष्ट्वा धर्मराजपुरोगमाः । विसृजन्तः शरान्घोरान्कृतवर्माणमार्दयन् ॥
data.md: Beholding Bhima thus involved in a dangerous situation, O king, the Pandava warriors headed by Yudhishthira, began to afflict Kritavarman by shooting numerous arrows.

data.v: तं तथा कोष्ठकीकृत्य रथवंशेन मारिष । विव्यधुः सायकैर्हृष्टा रक्षार्थं मारुतेर्मृधे ॥
data.md: Then impaling Kritavarman within a circle of chariots, the Pandava warriors, O sire, filled with delight, began to wound him with their arrows, out of a desire for rescuing the son of Maruta.

data.v: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां भीमसेनो महाबलः । शक्तिं जग्राह समरे हेमदण्डामयस्मयीम् । चिक्षेप च रथात्तूर्णं कृतवर्मरथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Thereafter the highly puissant Bhimasena regaining his senses, grasped, in that battle, a dreadful lance of golden staff and iron head.

data.v: सा भीमभुजनिर्मुक्ता निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभा । कृतवर्माणमभितः प्रजज्वाल सुदारुणा ॥
तामापतन्तीं सहसा युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभाम् । द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां हार्दिक्यो निचकर्त द्विधा तदा ॥
सा छिन्ना पतिता भूमौ शक्तिः कनकभूषणा । द्योतयन्ती दिशो राजन्महोल्केव दिवश्च्युता । शक्तिं विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा भीमश्चुक्रोध वै भृशम् ॥
data.md: And, O king, it there began to illumine the points of the compass like a mighty meteor dropping from the heavens. Thereat Bhima beholding his lance baffled, became excited to the highest pitch of fury.

data.v: ततोऽन्यद्धनुरादाय वेगवत्सुमहास्वनम् । भीमसेनो रणे क्रुद्धो हार्दिक्यं समवारयत् ॥
data.md: Thereafter, taking up another bow of great toughness and emitting loud twang, the enraged Bhimasena in that battle began to resist the son of Hridika.

data.v: अथैनं पञ्चभिर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे । भीमो भीमबलो राजंस्तव दुर्मन्त्रितेन ह ॥
data.md: Then, Oking, Bhima of awful prowess, pierced Kritavarman, on the centre of his breast, with five arrows. All this is the result of your wicked policy.

data.v: भोजस्तु क्षतसर्वाङ्गो भीमसेनेन मारिष । रक्ताशोक इवोत्फुल्लो व्यभ्राजत रणाजिरे ॥
data.md: Then, O sire, the ruler of the Bhojas wounded on all parts of his body, appeared on the field of battle like a red Ashoka tree covered with blossoms.

data.v: ततः क्रुद्धस्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्भीमसेनं हसन्निव । अभिहत्य दृढं युद्धे तान्सर्वान्प्रत्यविध्यत ॥
data.md: Thereafter Kritavarman inflamed with rage, smilingly striking Bhimasena with three arrows, began, in return, to pierce the other warriors (with his arrows).

data.v: त्रिभिस्त्रिभिर्महेष्वासो यतमानान्महारथान् । तेऽपि तं प्रत्यविध्यन्त सप्तभिः सप्तभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: That mighty bowman then pierced those car-warriors exerting their best in battle, each with three shafts. They then also pierced him in return, each with seven shafts.

data.v: शिखण्डिनस्ततः क्रुद्धः क्षुरप्रेण महारथः । धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे प्रहसन्निव भारत ॥
data.md: Then that mighty car-warrior of the Satvata race, inflamed with rage, smilingly cut-off the bow of Sikhandin with a razor-headed arrow.

data.v: शिखण्डी तु ततः क्रुद्धश्छिन्ने धनुषि सत्वरम् । असिं जग्राह समरे शतचन्द्रं च भास्वरम् ॥
data.md: Thereupon on the severance of his bow, Sikhandin burning with rage and hastening as much as possible, took up a sword and a buckler decked with hundreds of moons.

data.v: भ्रामयित्वा महाचर्म चामीकरविभूषितम् । तमसिं प्रेषयामास कृतवर्मरथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Whirling that mighty sword decked with gold, Sikhandin hurled it at the chariot of Kritavarman.

data.v: स तस्य सशरं चापं छित्त्वा संख्ये महानसिः । अभ्यगाद्धरणीं राजंश्च्युतं ज्योतिरिवाम्बरात् ॥
data.md: O king, then that mighty sword, cutting off his bow with arrows placed on its string, dropped, O king, on the ground like a luminous body falling down from the skies.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु त्वरमाणा महारथाः । विव्यधुः सायकैर्गाढं कृतवर्माणमाहवे ॥
data.md: Meanwhile many mighty car-warriors, making haste began to pierce Kritavarman deeply and quickly with their arrows.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय त्यक्त्वा तच्च महद्धनुः । विशीर्णं भरतश्रेष्ठ हार्दिक्यः परवीरहा ॥
data.md: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, taking up a fresh bow and leaving the one cut-off, that slayer of hostile heroes, namely Hridika's son.

data.v: विव्याध पाण्डवान्युद्धे त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः । शिखण्डिनं च विव्याध त्रिभिः पञ्चभिरेव च ॥
data.md: Pierced the Pandavas in battle, each with three straight-flying arrows. He then pierced Sikhandin at first with three and then with five arrows.

data.v: धनुरन्यत्समादाय शिखण्डी तु महायशाः । अवारयत्कूर्मनखैराशुगैर्हृदिकात्मजम् ॥
data.md: Then the highly renowned Sikhandin also, taking up another bow, covered the son of Hridika with swift-flying arrows. Furnished with heads resembling the mouth of tortoises.

data.v: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे राजन्हृदिकस्यात्मसंभवः । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन याज्ञसेनिं महारथम् ॥
data.md: Then, O king, the son of Hridika, excited with wrath, in that battle, quickly rushed upon that mighty car-warrior that son of Yajnasena.

data.v: भीष्मस्य समरे राजन्मृत्योर्हेतुं महात्मनः । विदर्शयन्बलं शूरः शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम् ॥
data.md: Who had been, Oking, the cause of death of the illustrious Bhima. Then the heroic Kritavarman displaying his prowess fell upon Sikhandin like a tiger falling upon an elephant.

data.v: तौ दिशागजसंकाशौ ज्वलिताविव पावकौ । समासेदतुरन्योन्यं शरसंघैररिंदमौ ॥
data.md: Then those to subduers of foes, resembling two elephants guarding the points of the compass and looking like two blazing fires, attacked each other with their showers of arrows.

data.v: विधुन्वानौ धनुःश्रेष्ठे संदधानौ च सायकान् । विसृजन्तौ च शतशो गभस्तीनिव भास्करौ ॥
data.md: They stretched their two excellent bows and placed many arrows on their bow-strings. Like two suns shooting numerous rays, they also shot myriad arrows.

data.v: तापयन्तौ शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरन्योन्यं तौ महारथौ । युगान्तप्रतिमौ वीरौ रेजतुर्भास्कराविव ॥
data.md: Those two mighty car-warriors afflicting one another with their sharp-arrows, appeared beautiful like two suns that rise at the end of a Yuga.

data.v: कृतवर्मा तु रभसं याज्ञसेनिं महारथम् । विद्ध्वेषूणां त्रिसप्तत्या पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥
data.md: In that battle then, Kritavarman pierced that mighty car-warrior the son of Yajanasena at first with seventy three and then again with seven arrowS.

data.v: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् । विसृजन्सशरं चापं मूर्छयाभिपरिप्लुतः ॥
data.md: Thus deeply pierced and extremely pained, the latter squatted down on the terrace of his car; and he lost hold of his arrows and bow and was overwhelmed with a swoon.

data.v: तं विषण्णं रथे दृष्ट्वा तावका भरतर्षभ । हार्दिक्यं पूजयामासुर्वासांस्यादुधुवुश्च ह ॥
data.md: Then your troops, O foremost of men, beholding Sikhandin cheerless in battle, began to applaud Hridika's son and they waived their garments in the air.

data.v: शिखण्डिनं तथा ज्ञात्वा हार्दिक्यशरपीडितम् । अपोवाह रणाद्यन्ता त्वरमाणो महारथम् ॥
data.md: Then knowing Sikhandin to be afflicted sore with the arrows of the son of Hridika, his driver, in all haste, carried that mighty carwarrior away from the field of battle.

data.v: सादितं तु रथोपस्थे दृष्ट्वा पार्थाः शिखण्डिनम् । परिवव्रू रथैस्तूर्णं कृतवर्माणमाहवे ॥
data.md: Beholding Sikhandin overthrown on the terrace of his car, the Parthas in that battle quickly surrounded Kritavarman with their chariots.

data.v: तत्राद्भुतं परं चक्रे कृतवर्मा महारथः । यदेकः समरे पार्थान्वारयामास सानुगान् ॥
data.md: Then the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman filled his enemies with wonder, in asmuch as the alone succeeded in resisting the sons of Pritha and their followers in battle.

data.v: पार्थाञ्जित्वाजयच्चेदीन्पाञ्चालान्सृञ्जयानपि । केकयांश्च महावीर्यान्कृतवर्मा महारथः ॥
data.md: Conquering the Parthas, the mighty carwarrior Kritavarman vanquished the Chedis, the Panchaias, the Srinjayas and the valourous Kekayas.

data.v: ते वध्यमानाः समरे हार्दिक्येन स्म पाण्डवाः । इतश्चेतश्च धावन्तो नैव चक्रुर्धृतिं रणे ॥
data.md: Thus slaughtered by Hridika's son in battle, the Pandavas began to run hither and thither and they could not then fight steadily.

data.v: जित्वा पाण्डुसुतान्युद्धे भीमसेनपुरोगमान् । हार्दिक्यः समरेऽतिष्ठद्विधूम इव पावकः ॥
data.md: Conquering the son of Pandu viz., Bhimasena in battle, Hridika's son then remained on the field, like a blazing fire free from even a single curl of smoke.

data.v: ते द्राव्यमाणाः समरे हार्दिक्येन महारथाः । विमुखाः समपद्यन्त शरवृष्टिभिरर्दिताः ॥
data.md: Those mighty car-warriors routed by the son of Hridika, were compelled to turn their faces leack, afflicted as they were with incessant showers of arrows.

data.v: शृणुष्वैकमना राजन्यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि । द्राव्यमाणे बले तस्मिन्हार्दिक्येन महात्मना ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Hear, O king, with undivided attention, the reply to the questions you have asked me. When the Pandava troops had been routed by the illustrious son of Hridika.

data.v: लज्जयावनते चापि प्रहृष्टैश्चैव तावकैः । द्वीपो य आसीत्पाण्डूनामगाधे गाधमिच्छताम् ॥
data.md: When then Parthas had been shamefully humiliated and when your troops were filled with delight, it was Satyaki that became the protector of the Pandavas solicitous of protection, for the king was then in the fathomless depth of distress.

data.v: श्रुत्वा तु निनदं भीमं तावकानां महाहवे । शैनेयस्त्वरितो राजन्कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात् ॥
data.md: That hero viz., the grandson of Sini, hearing that fierce uproar of your army in that dreadful battle, quickly, O monarch, turned back and advanced against Kritavarman.

data.v: कृतवर्मा तु हार्दिक्यः शैनेयं निशितैः शरैः । अवाकिरत्सुसंक्रुद्धस्ततोऽक्रुध्यत सात्यकिः ॥
data.md: Then Hridika's son Kritavarman inflamed with wrath, covered the grandson of Sini with clouds of whetted arrows. Thereupon Satyaki also became excited with rage.

data.v: ततः सुनिशितं भल्लं शैनेयः कृतवर्मणे । प्रेषयामास समरे शरांश्च चतुरोऽपरान् ॥
data.md: arrows Thereafter the grandson of Sini quickly sped at Kritavarman a whetted bhalla and four other shafts in that battle.

data.v: ते तस्य जघ्निरे वाहान्भल्लेनास्याच्छिनद्धनुः । पृष्ठरक्षं तथा सूतमविध्यन्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: These slew the steeds of Kritavarman and his bow was cut-off by the bhalla. Thereafter Satyaki pierced his charioteer and the supporter of his rear, with numerous sharp arrows.

data.v: ततस्तं विरथं कृत्वा सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः । सेनामस्यार्दयामास शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥
data.md: Thereafter depriving Kritavarman of the use of his chariot, Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled, began to afflict his divisions with arrows of depressed knots.

data.v: साभज्यताथ पृतना शैनेयशरपीडिता । ततः प्रायाद्वै त्वरितः सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः ॥
data.md: Afflicted with the arrows shot by the grandson of Sini, the army then began to break away. Then Satyaki of unbaffled prowess proceeded with great velocity.

data.v: शृणु राजन्यदकरोत्तव सैन्येषु वीर्यवान् । अतीत्य स महाराज द्रोणानीकमहार्णवम् ॥
data.md: Hear, O king, what feats were achieved by that hero endued with great propwess, at the cost of your troops. O mighty monarch, passing through the ocean-like host of Drona.

data.v: पराजित्य च संहृष्टः कृतवर्माणमाहवे । यन्तारमब्रवीच्छूरः शनैर्याहीत्यसंभ्रमम् ॥
data.md: And vanquishing Kritavarman in battle, that hero Satyaki filled with joy, addressed his charioteer saying “Proceed slowly without fear.”

data.v: दृष्ट्वा तु तव तत्सैन्यं रथाश्वद्विपसंकुलम् । पदातिजनसंपूर्णमब्रवीत्सारथिं पुनः ॥
data.md: Then holding that army of yours teeming with car-warriors, horses, elephants and footsoldiers, he again addressed his charioteer sayingयदेतन्मेधसंकाशं द्रोणानीकस्य सव्यतः।

data.v: यदेतन्मेघसंकाशं द्रोणानीकस्य सव्यतः । सुमहत्कुञ्जरानीकं यस्य रुक्मरथो मुखम् ॥
data.md: 'Yonder is the mighty division of elephants which you see on the left of Drona's host and which appears like a dark mass of clouds and which is headed by Rukmaratha;

data.v: एते हि बहवः सूत दुर्निवार्याश्च संयुगे । दुर्योधनसमादिष्टा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः । राजपुत्रा महेष्वासाः सर्वे विक्रान्तयोधिनः ॥
data.md: O charioteer, they number many and are irresistible in battle. They have been deputed by Duryodhana to oppose me and are ready to cast off their lives any moment,

data.v: त्रिगर्तानां रथोदाराः सुवर्णविकृतध्वजाः । मामेवाभिमुखा वीरा योत्स्यमाना व्यवस्थिताः ॥
अत्र मां प्रापय क्षिप्रमश्वांश्चोदय सारथे । त्रिगर्तैः सह योत्स्यामि भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः ॥
ततः प्रायाच्छनैः सूतः सात्वतस्य मते स्थितः । रथेनादित्यवर्णेन भास्वरेण पताकिना ॥
तमूहुः सारथेर्वश्या वल्गमाना हयोत्तमाः । वायुवेगसमाः संख्ये कुन्देन्दुरजतप्रभाः ॥
आपतन्तं रथं तं तु शङ्खवर्णैर्हयोत्तमैः । परिवव्रुस्ततः शूरा गजानीकेन सर्वतः । किरन्तो विविधांस्तीक्ष्णान्सायकाँल्लघुवेधिनः ॥
data.md: The brave Kaurava warriors surrounded him with their elephant division, shooting sharp arrows of various kinds, all capable of penetrating through everything.

data.v: सात्वतोऽपि शितैर्बाणैर्गजानीकमयोधयत् । पर्वतानिव वर्षेण तपान्ते जलदो महान् ॥
data.md: Satyaki of the Satvata race then fought on with that elephant division, discharging many whetted shafts; and he covered it with his arrows like clouds at the end of summer covering the mountain-breast with torrents of rain.

data.v: वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शैर्वध्यमानाः शरैर्गजाः । प्राद्रवन्रणमुत्सृज्य शिनिवीर्यसमीरितैः ॥
data.md: Wounded with arrows resembling in touch the thunderbolt of Indra shot by the heroic grandson of Sini, those elephants began to fly away leaving the field of battle.

data.v: शीर्णदन्ता विरुधिरा भिन्नमस्तकपिण्डकाः । विशीर्णकर्णास्यकरा विनियन्तृपताकिनः ॥
data.md: With their tusks broken, bodies drenched with blood, heads and frontal globes rent open and ears, faces and trunks cut-off and themselves deprived of their drivers and standards.

data.v: संभिन्नवर्मघण्टाश्च संनिकृत्तमहाध्वजाः । हतारोहा दिशो राजन्भेजिरे भ्रष्टकम्बलाः ॥
data.md: With their skin lacerated their bells broken and their mighty standards cut-off and blankets thrown off, those elephants, O king, having none to ride them, began to fly away in all directions.

data.v: रुवन्तो विविधान्रावाञ्जलदोपमनिस्वनाः । नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च सात्वतेन विदारिताः ॥
data.md: They uttered various yells and roars that resembled the rumble of rain clouds. With Narachas, with Vatsadants, with Vallas, with Anja-likas.

data.v: तस्मिन्द्रुते गजानीके जलसंधो महारथः । यत्तः संप्रापयन्नागं रजताश्वरथं प्रति ॥
रुक्मवर्णकरः शूरस्तपनीयाङ्गदः शुचिः । कुण्डली मुकुटी शङ्खी रक्तचन्दनरूषितः ॥
शिरसा धारयन्दीप्तां तपनीयमयीं स्रजम् । उरसा धारयन्निष्कं कण्ठसूत्रं च भास्वरम् ॥
चापं च रुक्मविकृतं विधुन्वन्गजमूर्धनि । अशोभत महाराज सविद्युदिव तोयदः ॥
तमापतन्तं सहसा मागधस्य गजोत्तमम् । सात्यकिर्वारयामास वेलेवोद्वृत्तमर्णवम् ॥
नागं निवारितं दृष्ट्वा शैनेयस्य शरोत्तमैः । अक्रुध्यत रणे राजञ्जलसंधो महाबलः ॥
ततः क्रुद्धो महेष्वासो मार्गणैर्भारसाधनैः । अविध्यत शिनेः पौत्रं जलसंधो महोरसि ॥
ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च । अस्यतो वृष्णिवीरस्य निचकर्त शरासनम् ॥
सात्यकिं छिन्नधन्वानं प्रहसन्निव भारत । अविध्यन्मागधो वीरः पञ्चभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: He cut-off the bow of that Vrishni hero (Satyaki). Then O Bharata, the heroic ruler of the Magadhas pierced with five sharp arrows, Satyaki whose bow had been burst open. Then that highly powerful Satyaki being thus pierced with numerous arrows by Jalasandha.

data.v: स विद्धो बहुभिर्बाणैर्जलसंधेन वीर्यवान् । नाकम्पत महाबाहुस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
अचिन्तयन्वै स शरान्नात्यर्थं संभ्रमाद्बली । धनुरन्यत्समादाय तिष्ठ तिष्ठेत्युवाच ह ॥
एतावदुक्त्वा शैनेयो जलसंधं महोरसि । विव्याध षष्ट्या सुभृशं शराणां प्रहसन्निव ॥
क्षुरप्रेण च पीतेन मुष्टिदेशे महद्धनुः । जलसंधस्य चिच्छेद विव्याध च त्रिभिः शरैः ॥
जलसंधस्तु तत्त्यक्त्वा सशरं वै शरासनम् । तोमरं व्यसृजत्तूर्णं सात्यकिं प्रति मारिष ॥
स निर्भिद्य भुजं सव्यं माधवस्य महारणे । अभ्यगाद्धरणीं घोरः श्वसन्निव महोरगः ॥
निर्भिन्ने तु भुजे सव्ये सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः । त्रिंशद्भिर्विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्जलसंधमताडयत् ॥
प्रगृह्य तु ततः खड्गं जलसंधो महाबलः । आर्षभं चर्म च महच्छतचन्द्रमलंकृतम् । तत आविध्य तं खड्गं सात्वतायोत्ससर्ज ह ॥
data.md: And a shield made of bull's hide and decked with a hundred moons. Then whirling that sword in the air, he let it go towards the grandson of Sini.

data.v: शैनेयस्य धनुश्छित्त्वा स खड्गो न्यपतन्महीम् । अलातचक्रवच्चैव व्यरोचत महीं गतः ॥
data.md: Cutting off the bow of Sini's grandson, that sword then fell on the ground; and lying on the surface of the earth, it then appeared beautiful like a circle of fire.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय सर्वकायावदारणम् । शालस्कन्धप्रतीकाशमिन्द्राशनिसमस्वनम् । विस्फार्य विव्यधे क्रुद्धो जलसंधं शरेण ह ॥
data.md: Then taking up another bow capable of piercing all kinds of things, large as a Sala offshoot and emitting twang resembling the rumble of Indra's thunder.

data.v: ततः साभरणौ बाहू क्षुराभ्यां माधवोत्तमः । साङ्गदौ जलसंधस्य चिच्छेद प्रहसन्निव ॥
तौ बाहू परिघप्रख्यौ पेततुर्गजसत्तमात् । वसुंधराधराद्भ्रष्टौ पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ ॥
ततः सुदंष्ट्रं सुहनु चारुकुण्डलमुन्नसम् । क्षुरेणास्य तृतीयेन शिरश्चिच्छेद सात्यकिः ॥
data.md: Like a couple of five-hooded snakes dropping down from a mountain. Then with another razor-headed arrow Satyaki lopped off his adversary head graced with beautiful teeth and with a pair of charming ear-rings. The headless and armless trunk of dreadful aspect.

data.v: तत्पातितशिरोबाहुकबन्धं भीमदर्शनम् । द्विरदं जलसंधस्य रुधिरेणाभ्यषिञ्चत ॥
जलसंधं निहत्याजौ त्वरमाणस्तु सात्वतः । नैषादिं पातयामास गजस्कन्धाद्विशां पते ॥
रुधिरेणावसिक्ताङ्गो जलसंधस्य कुञ्जरः । विलम्बमानमवहत्संश्लिष्टं परमासनम् ॥
शरार्दितः सात्वतेन मर्दमानः स्ववाहिनीम् । घोरमार्तस्वरं कृत्वा विदुद्राव महागजः ॥
हाहाकारो महानासीत्तव सैन्यस्य मारिष । जलसंधं हतं दृष्ट्वा वृष्णीनामृषभेण ह ॥
विमुखाश्चाभ्यधावन्त तव योधाः समन्ततः । पलायने कृतोत्साहा निरुत्साहा द्विषज्जये ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन्द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः । अभ्ययाज्जवनैरश्वैर्युयुधानं महारथम् ॥
तमुदीर्णं तथा दृष्ट्वा शैनेयं कुरुपुंगवाः । द्रोणेनैव सह क्रुद्धाः सात्यकिं पर्यवारयन् ॥
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरूणां सात्वतस्य च । द्रोणस्य च रणे राजन्घोरं देवासुरोपमम् ॥
data.md: Rushed at him in rage, accompanied by Drona himself. Then, O king, there ensued a fight between the Kurus headed by Drona on one side and Yuyudhana on the other, that resembled the dreadful battle that was fought in days gone by, between the Gods and the Asuras.

data.v: ते किरन्तः शरव्रातान्सर्वे यत्ताः प्रहारिणः । त्वरमाणा महाराज युयुधानमयोधयन् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then, O mighty monarch, all those warriors accomplished in smiting down the foe and united together, began to fight with Yuyudhana quickly discharging numerous arrows.

data.v: तं द्रोणः सप्तसप्तत्या जघान निशितैः शरैः । दुर्मर्षणो द्वादशभिर्दुःसहो दशभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: Then Drona pierced Satyaki with seven and seventy shafts of great sharpness; Durmursana pierced him with twelve and Dussaha with ten shafts.

data.v: विकर्णश्चापि निशितैस्त्रिंशद्भिः कङ्कपत्रिभिः । विव्याध सव्ये पार्श्वे तु स्तनाभ्यामन्तरे तथा ॥
data.md: Vikarna pierced Satyaki with thirty whetted shafts furnished with wings of Kanka feather, on his lift side and on the centre of his chest.

data.v: दुर्मुखो दशभिर्बाणैस्तथा दुःशासनोऽष्टभिः । चित्रसेनश्च शैनेयं द्वाभ्यां विव्याध मारिष ॥
data.md: o sire, Durmukha then pierced Sini's grandson with ten shafts, Dushasana pierced him with eight and Chitrasena with a couple of arrows.

data.v: दुर्योधनश्च महता शरवर्षेण माधवम् । अपीडयद्रणे राजञ्शूराश्चान्ये महारथाः ॥
data.md: Then with a mighty shower of arrows Duryodhana, O king, afflicted that mighty carwarrior the descendant of Madhu's race. O king, other heroic warriors followed his example.

data.v: सर्वतः प्रतिविद्धस्तु तव पुत्रैर्महारथैः । तान्प्रत्यविध्यच्छैनेयः पृथक्पृथगजिह्मगैः ॥
data.md: Thus opposed on all sides by your sons, all mighty car-warriors, he of the Vrishni race began to pierce them all in return with distinct groups of straight-going shafts.

data.v: भारद्वाजं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्दुःसहं नवभिस्तथा । विकर्णं पञ्चविंशत्या चित्रसेनं च सप्तभिः ॥
data.md: Satyaki pierced the son of Bharadvaja with three arrows, Dussaha with nine, Vikarna with twenty-five, Chitrasena with seven.

data.v: दुर्मर्षणं द्वादशभिश्चतुर्भिश्च विविंशतिम् । सत्यव्रतं च नवभिर्विजयं दशभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: Durmarsena with twelve, Vivinsati with eight, Satyavrata with nine and Vijaya with ten shafts.

data.v: ततो रुक्माङ्गदं चापं विधुन्वानो महारथः । अभ्ययात्सात्यकिस्तूर्णं पुत्रं तव महारथम् ॥
data.md: Then that mighty car-warrior Satyaki, having pierced Rukmangada, stretching his bow quickly assailed your son Duryodhana who also was a mighty car-warrior.

data.v: राजानं सर्वलोकस्य सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम् । शरैरभ्याहनद्गाढं ततो युद्धमभूत्तयोः ॥
data.md: Then with his arrows Satyaki deeply pierced the king of all creatures who is regarded as he best car-warrior in all the worlds. Thereupon a battle commenced between them.

data.v: विमुञ्चन्तौ शरांस्तीक्ष्णान्संदधानौ च सायकान् । अदृश्यं समरेऽन्योन्यं चक्रतुस्तौ महारथौ ॥
data.md: Then those two mighty car-warriors discharging sharp arrows and placing other arrows on the bow-string, rendered each other invisible in battle.

data.v: सात्यकिः कुरुराजेन निर्विद्धो बह्वशोभत । अस्रवद्रुधिरं भूरि स्वरसं चन्दनो यथा ॥
data.md: Satyaki then pierced sore by the king of the Kurus, appeared highly beautiful. He shed blood copiously like a sandal tree discharging its sap.

data.v: सात्वतेन च बाणौघैर्निर्विद्धस्तनयस्तव । शातकुम्भमयापीडो बभौ यूप इवोच्छ्रितः ॥
data.md: r'ierced with myriads of shafts by him of the Satvata race, your son appeared beautiful like a golden stake set up at a sacrifice.

data.v: माधवस्तु रणे राजन्कुरुराजस्य धन्विनः । धनुश्चिच्छेद सहसा क्षुरप्रेण हसन्निव । अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं शरैर्बहुभिराचिनोत् ॥
data.md: Thereafter, Oking, that descendant of Madhu's race, with a razor-headed shaft, cutoff in battle the bow of the Kuru king that best wielder of the bow, smiling all the while.

data.v: निर्भिन्नश्च शरैस्तेन द्विषता क्षिप्रकारिणा । नामृष्यत रणे राजा शत्रोर्विजयलक्षणम् ॥
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम् । विव्याध सात्यकिं तूर्णं सायकानां शतेन ह ॥
सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता पुत्रेण तव धन्विना । अमर्षवशमापन्नस्तव पुत्रमपीडयत् ॥
पीडितं नृपतिं दृष्ट्वा तव पुत्रा महारथाः । सात्वतं शरवर्षेण छादयामासुरञ्जसा ॥
स छाद्यमानो बहुभिस्तव पुत्रैर्महारथैः । एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥
दुर्योधनं च त्वरितो विव्याधाष्टभिराशुगैः । प्रहसंश्चास्य चिच्छेद कार्मुकं रिपुभीषणम् ॥
नागं मणिमयं चैव शरैर्ध्वजमपातयत् । हत्वा तु चतुरो वाहांश्चतुर्भिर्निशितैः शरैः । सारथिं पातयामास क्षुरप्रेण महायशाः ॥
data.md: Then slaying with four sharp arrows the four horses of Duryodhana, that illusirious warrior felled the charioteer of the latter with a razor-headed arrow.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चैव कुरुराजं महारथम् । अवाकिरच्छरैर्हृष्टो बहुभिर्मर्मभेदिभिः ॥
data.md: After this, filled with delight he began to cover the king of the Kurus, that mighty carwarrior, with numerous arrows, all capable of penetrating to the very vitals.

data.v: स वध्यमानः समरे शैनेयस्य शरोत्तमैः । प्राद्रवत्सहसा राजन्पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव । आप्लुतश्च ततो यानं चित्रसेनस्य धन्विनः ॥
data.md: Thus pierced by the excellent shafts of the grandson of Sini, Oking, your son Duryodhana suddenly fled away from the field of battle.

data.v: हाहाभूतं जगच्चासीद्दृष्ट्वा राजानमाहवे । ग्रस्यमानं सात्यकिना खे सोममिव राहुणा ॥
तं तु शब्दं महच्छ्रुत्वा कृतवर्मा महारथः । अभ्ययात्सहसा तत्र यत्रास्ते माधवः प्रभुः ॥
विधुन्वानो धनुःश्रेष्ठं चोदयंश्चैव वाजिनः । भर्त्सयन्सारथिं चोग्रं याहि याहीति सत्वरः ॥
तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम् । युयुधानो महाराज यन्तारमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
कृतवर्मा रथेनैष द्रुतमापतते शरी । प्रत्युद्याहि रथेनैनं प्रवरं सर्वधन्विनाम् ॥
ततः प्रजविताश्वेन विधिवत्कल्पितेन च । आससाद रणे भोजं प्रतिमानं धनुष्मताम् ॥
ततः परमसंक्रुद्धौ ज्वलन्ताविव पावकौ । समेयातां नरव्याघ्रौ व्याघ्राविव तरस्विनौ ॥
कृतवर्मा तु शैनेयं षड्विंशत्या समार्पयत् । निशितैः सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्यन्तारं चास्य सप्तभिः ॥
चतुरश्च हयोदारांश्चतुर्भिः परमेषुभिः । अविध्यत्साधुदान्तान्वै सैन्धवान्सात्वतस्य ह ॥
रुक्मध्वजो रुक्मपृष्ठं महद्विस्फार्य कार्मुकम् । रुक्माङ्गदी रुक्मवर्मा रुक्मपुङ्खानवाकिरत् ॥
ततोऽशीतिं शिनेः पौत्रः सायकान्कृतवर्मणे । प्राहिणोत्त्वरया युक्तो द्रष्टुकामो धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: Decked with golden Angadas and clad in a golden mail, covered Satyaki with arrow of golden wings. Thereafter the grandson of Sini quickly sped numerous shafts at Kritavarman, as he was longing to have a sight of Dhananjaya. Pierced deeply by his powerful adversary, that scorcher of foes.

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुतापनः । समकम्पत दुर्धर्षः क्षितिकम्पे यथाचलः ॥
त्रिषष्ट्या चतुरोऽस्याश्वान्सप्तभिः सारथिं शरैः । विव्याध निशितैस्तूर्णं सात्यकिः कृतवर्मणः ॥
data.md: Began to tremble like a mountain during an earth-quake. Then Stayaki of prowess incapable of being baffled quickly pierced his four steeds with sixty-three and his charioteer with seven sharp arrows. Then Satyaki placed on his bow string a shaft furnished with golden wings.

data.v: सुवर्णपुङ्खं विशिखं समाधाय स सात्यकिः । व्यसृजत्तं महाज्वालं संक्रुद्धमिव पन्नगम् ॥
सोऽविशत्कृतवर्माणं यमदण्डोपमः शरः । जाम्बूनदविचित्रं च वर्म निर्भिद्य भानुमत् । अभ्यगाद्धरणीमुग्रो रुधिरेण समुक्षितः ॥
data.md: Then that fierce arrow, penetrating through the effulgent and gold-decked armour of Kritavarman, fell down on the ground, steeped completely in blood.

data.v: संजातरुधिरश्चाजौ सात्वतेषुभिरर्दितः । प्रचलन्धनुरुत्सृज्य न्यपतत्स्यन्दनोत्तमे ॥
data.md: Covered all over with blood and afflicted with the arrows of the of the Satvata hero, Kritavarman, throwing aside his bow and arrow, feil upon his niche on the chariot.

data.v: स सिंहदंष्ट्रो जानुभ्यामापन्नोऽमितविक्रमः । शरार्दितः सात्यकिना रथोपस्थे नरर्षभः ॥
data.md: That one of infinite prowess and of teeth resembling those of the lion, that foremost of men, then fell on his knees on the terrace of his car, being afflicted by arrows of Satyaki.

data.v: सहस्रबाहोः सदृशमक्षोभ्यमिव सागरम् । निवार्य कृतवर्माणं सात्यकिः प्रययौ ततः ॥
data.md: Thereafter Satyaki having successfully checked Kritavarman who reseinbled the thousand-armed Arjuna or the unagitable ocean itself, quickly advanced onwards.

data.v: खड्गशक्तिधनुःकीर्णां गजाश्वरथसंकुलाम् । प्रवर्तितोग्ररुधिरां शतशः क्षत्रियर्षभैः ॥
data.md: Then passing through the division of Kritavarman, bristling with swords, lances and javelins and teeming with elephants, steeds and cars and shedding blood copiously, before the very eyes of all the troops that foremost of the descendants of Sini moved forwards like the slayer of Vritra passing through the Asura host.

data.v: प्रेक्षतां सर्वसैन्यानां मध्येन शिनिपुंगवः । अभ्यगाद्वाहिनीं भित्त्वा वृत्रहेवासुरीं चमूम् ॥
data.md: Then passing through the division of Kritavarman, bristling with swords, lances and javelins and teeming with elephants, steeds and cars and shedding blood copiously, before the very eyes of all the troops that foremost of the descendants of Sini moved forwards like the slayer of Vritra passing through the Asura host.

data.v: समाश्वास्य च हार्दिक्यो गृह्य चान्यन्महद्धनुः । तस्थौ तत्रैव बलवान्वारयन्युधि पाण्डवान् ॥
data.md: Meanwhile the son of Hridika regaining his composure and grasping another mighty bow, stood on the field of battle checking the mighty Pandava hosts.

data.v: काल्यमानेषु सैन्येषु शैनेयेन ततस्ततः । भारद्वाजः शरव्रातैर्महद्भिः समवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said When the troops on those parts of the field through which Sini's grandson had passed were compelled by him to tremble, the son of Bharadvaja covered him with a mighty shower of arrows.

data.v: स संप्रहारस्तुमुलो द्रोणसात्वतयोरभूत् । पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां बलिवासवयोरिव ॥
data.md: Then a fierce fight commenced between Drona and him of the Satvata race, before the very eyes of all the troops-fight that resembled that between Bali and Vasava fought in the day's of yore.

data.v: ततो द्रोणः शिनेः पौत्रं चित्रैः सर्वायसैः शरैः । त्रिभिराशीविषाकारैर्ललाटे समविध्यत ॥
data.md: Then Drona pierced Sini's grandson on the forehead with three beautiful shafts wholly made or iron and looking like so many snakes of virulent poison.

data.v: तैर्ललाटार्पितैर्बाणैर्युयुधानस्त्वजिह्मगैः । व्यरोचत महाराज त्रिशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः ॥
data.md: O mighty monarch, with those straightgoing shafts struck the forehead, Yuyudhana appeared beautiful like a mountain with three peaks. on

data.v: ततोऽस्य बाणानपरानिन्द्राशनिसमस्वनान् । भारद्वाजोऽन्तरप्रेक्षी प्रेषयामास संयुगे ॥
data.md: Then Bharadvaja's son, ever on the watch for an opportunity for defeating his focs, once more sped at Satyaki shafts whose whizz resembled the rumble of Indra's thunder.

data.v: तान्द्रोणचापनिर्मुक्तान्दाशार्हः पततः शरान् । द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां सुपुङ्खाभ्यां चिच्छेद परमास्त्रवित् ॥
data.md: Then he of the Dasarha race conversant with many excellent weapons, cut-off those shafts shot from Drona's bow and coming towards hiin, each with a couple of arrows equipped with excellent wings.

data.v: तामस्य लघुतां द्रोणः समवेक्ष्य विशां पते । प्रहस्य सहसाविध्यद्विंशत्या शिनिपुंगवम् ॥
data.md: Then, O ruler of men, Drona beholding his light-handedness, smiled and then pierced that foremost of Sini's descendant with thirty sharp arrows.

data.v: पुनः पञ्चाशतेषूणां शतेन च समार्पयत् । लघुतां युयुधानस्य लाघवेन विशेषयन् ॥
data.md: Then once more he pierced him with fifty and hundred shafts successively, thus surpassing with his own lightness of hands the lightness displayed by Yuyudhana.

data.v: समुत्पतन्ति वल्मीकाद्यथा क्रुद्धा महोरगाः । तथा द्रोणरथाद्राजन्नुत्पतन्ति तनुच्छिदः ॥
data.md: Just as, O king, mighty snakes excited to fury, plunge off from the ant-hills, so from the car of Drona numerous shafts were seen to fly.

data.v: तथैव युयुधानेन सृष्टाः शतसहस्रशः । अवाकिरन्द्रोणरथं शरा रुधिरभोजनाः ॥
data.md: Similarly hundreds and thousands of shafts all capable of drinking blood, covered the car of Drona being discharged by Yuyudhana.

data.v: लाघवाद्द्विजमुख्यस्य सात्वतस्य च मारिष । विशेषं नाध्यगच्छाम समावास्तां नरर्षभौ ॥
data.md: O sire, we were then not able to detect which of the two, that foremost of the Brahmanas or he of the Satvata race, excelled the other in lightness of hands; but both of those best of men appeared to be equal.

data.v: सात्यकिस्तु ततो द्रोणं नवभिर्नतपर्वभिः । आजघान भृशं क्रुद्धो ध्वजं च निशितैः शरैः । सारथिं च शतेनैव भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.md: Then excited to the highest pitch of fury, Satyaki struck Drona in battle with mine shafts of depressed knots. He also struck with sharp shafts, the standard.

data.v: लाघवं युयुधानस्य दृष्ट्वा द्रोणो महारथः । सप्तत्या सात्यकिं विद्ध्वा तुरगांश्च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः । ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध माधवस्य रथे स्थितम् ॥
data.md: Piercing the charioteer of him of Madhu's race with seventy arrows and the horses with three arrows each, cut-off his standard with a single arrows.

data.v: अथापरेण भल्लेन हेमपुङ्खेन पत्रिणा । धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे माधवस्य महात्मनः ॥
data.md: Then with another broad-headed shaft equipped with golden wings, he curt off bow of that illustrious descendant of Madhu's race.

data.v: सात्यकिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो धनुस्त्यक्त्वा महारथः । गदां जग्राह महतीं भारद्वाजाय चाक्षिपत् ॥
data.md: Thereat that mighty car-warrior Satyaki highly excited with rage, laid aside his bow and taking up a mighty mace, hurled it at the son of Bharadvaja.

data.v: तामापतन्तीं सहसा पट्टबद्धामयस्मयीम् । न्यवारयच्छरैर्द्रोणो बहुभिर्बहुरूपिभिः ॥
data.md: Then Drona with numerous shafts of various appearance, baffled that mace made of iron and covered with silken cloth, as it coursed vehemently towards him.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः । विव्याध बहुभिर्वीरं भारद्वाजं शिलाशितैः ॥
data.md: Thereafter Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled taking up another bow, pierced the heroic son of Bharadvaja with numerous shafts whetted on stone.

data.v: स विद्ध्वा समरे द्रोणं सिंहनादममुञ्चत । तं वै न ममृषे द्रोणः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ॥
data.md: Thus wounding Drona in battle he sent up his war-cry. But Drona that foremost of all wielders of weapons did not brook that war-cry of his.

data.v: ततः शक्तिं गृहीत्वा तु रुक्मदण्डामयस्मयीम् । तरसा प्रेषयामास माधवस्य रथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Then taking up a lance of golden staff and iron-head, Drona hurled it vchemently at the car of that descendant of Madhu's race (Satyaki).

data.v: अनासाद्य तु शैनेयं सा शक्तिः कालसंनिभा । भित्त्वा रथं जगामोग्रा धरणीं दारुणस्वना ॥
data.md: That lance resembling the Destroyer himself, without reaching the grandson of Sini, penetrated through his chariot and then fell on the ground, looking fierce and emitting a loud noise.

data.v: ततो द्रोणं शिनेः पौत्रो राजन्विव्याध पत्रिणा । दक्षिणं भुजमासाद्य पीडयन्भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Thereafter ( king, Sini's grandson pierced Drona on his right arin with many winged shafts. Thus, O foremost of the Bharatas, Drona was greatly afflicted,

data.v: द्रोणोऽपि समरे राजन्माधवस्य महद्धनुः । अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद रथशक्त्या च सारथिम् ॥
data.md: In that battle Drona also, O king, with a crescent-shaped arrow cut-off the mighty bow of that descendant of Madhava; and he smote the latter's driver with a lance.

data.v: मुमोह सारथिस्तस्य रथशक्त्या समाहतः । स रथोपस्थमासाद्य मुहूर्तं संन्यषीदत ॥
data.md: Satyaki's charioteer was then overwhelmed with a swoon in consequent of his being struck with that dart. For a while, he lay senseless on his niche on the car.

data.v: चकार सात्यकी राजंस्तत्र कर्मातिमानुषम् । अयोधयच्च यद्द्रोणं रश्मीञ्जग्राह च स्वयम् ॥
data.md: Then, o king, Satyaki achieved a superhuman feat, in as much as he fought on with Drona and held the reins of his horse like his driver simultaneously.

data.v: ततः शरशतेनैव युयुधानो महारथः । अविध्यद्ब्राह्मणं संख्ये हृष्टरूपो विशां पते ॥
data.md: Then, O ruler of men, with a cheerful appearance, the mighty car-warrior Yuyudhana, pierced in that that battle that Brahmana with a set of hundred arrows.

data.v: तस्य द्रोणः शरान्पञ्च प्रेषयामास भारत । ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा पपुः शोणितमाहवे ॥
data.md: At him then Drona sped, O Bharata, five shafts and those dreadful shaft penetrating through his armour drank his life-blood.

data.v: निर्विद्धस्तु शरैर्घोरैरक्रुध्यत्सात्यकिर्भृशम् । सायकान्व्यसृजच्चापि वीरो रुक्मरथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Pierced deeply with those fierce arrows Satyaki became exited to the highest pitch of Wrath; and then that hero began to shoot numerous arrows at him of the golden car.

data.v: ततो द्रोणस्य यन्तारं निपात्यैकेषुणा भुवि । अश्वान्व्यद्रावयद्बाणैर्हतसूतान्महात्मनः ॥
data.md: He then felled Drona's driver by striking him with a single arrow; then with other arrows, he compelled his horses to run away from the field.

data.v: स रथः प्रद्रुतः संख्ये मण्डलानि सहस्रशः । चकार राजतो राजन्भ्राजमान इवांशुमान् ॥
data.md: That resplendent chariot, Oking, dragged over all parts of the field, began to describe various circles like the Sun in motion.

data.v: अभिद्रवत गृह्णीत हयान्द्रोणस्य धावत । इति स्म चुक्रुशुः सर्वे राजपुत्राः सराजकाः ॥
data.md: 'Rush,' 'seize the running steeds of Drona,' these were the words that were then uttered loudly by the kings and princes of the Kaurava host.

data.v: ते सात्यकिमपास्याशु राजन्युधि महारथाः । यतो द्रोणस्ततः सर्वे सहसा समुपाद्रवन् ॥
data.md: O king, then all those mighty car-warriors, leaving Satyaki in battle, proceeded to the spot where Drona was carried away by his horses.

data.v: तान्दृष्ट्वा प्रद्रुतान्सर्वान्सात्वतेन शरार्दितान् । प्रभग्नं पुनरेवासीत्तव सैन्यं समाकुलम् ॥
data.md: Then once more seeing all those heroes routed and afflicted by the scion of the Satvata race, your troops once more began to give way, being overwhelmed with fear.

data.v: व्यूहस्यैव पुनर्द्वारं गत्वा द्रोणो व्यवस्थितः । वातायमानैस्तैरश्वैर्हृतो वृष्णिशरार्दितैः ॥
data.md: Drona, once more proceeding to the gate of the array of his troops, stationed himself there, borne away, as he was, by those steeds of the fleetness of the wind, that had been afflicted by the shafts of the Vrishni hero.

data.v: पाण्डुपाञ्चालसंभग्नं व्यूहमालोक्य वीर्यवान् । शैनेये नाकरोद्यत्नं व्यूहस्यैवाभिरक्षणे ॥
data.md: Then that highly puissant Drona, seeing his array shattered by the Pandavas and the Panchalas, did not try to check the grandson of Sini, but began to re-arrange his broken array.

data.v: निवार्य पाण्डुपाञ्चालान्द्रोणाग्निः प्रदहन्निव । तस्थौ क्रोधाग्निसंदीप्तः कालसूर्य इवोदितः ॥
data.md: Resisting the Pandavas and the Panchalas, the Drona-fire then, burning in rage, stationed himself there, consuming everything like the Sun that rises at the end of a Yuga.

data.v: द्रोणं स जित्वा पुरुषप्रवीर;स्तथैव हार्दिक्यमुखांस्त्वदीयान् । प्रहस्य सूतं वचनं बभाषे; शिनिप्रवीरः कुरुपुंगवाग्र्य ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Having defeated in battle Drona and other warriors of your army headed by Hridika's son, that foremost of men, that best scion of the Sini race, addressing smilingly his charioteer, said, O best of the Kurus, these wordsनिमित्तमात्रं वयमद्य सूत दग्धारयः केशवफाल्गुनाभ्याम्

data.v: निमित्तमात्रं वयमत्र सूत; दग्धारयः केशवफल्गुनाभ्याम् । हतान्निहन्मेह नरर्षभेण; वयं सुरेशात्मसमुद्भवेन ॥
तमेवमुक्त्वा शिनिपुंगवस्तदा; महामृधे सोऽग्र्यधनुर्धरोऽरिहा । किरन्समन्तात्सहसा शरान्बली; समापतच्छ्येन इवामिषं यथा ॥
data.md: Saying these words to his driver, that best of the Sinis, that illustrious bowman, that slayer of hostile heroes, that highly puissant warrior, shooting vehemently his arrows in all directions pounced upon the Kaurava host like a hawk swooping down upon a piece of meat.

data.v: तं यान्तमश्वैः शशिशङ्खवर्णै;र्विगाह्य सैन्यं पुरुषप्रवीरम् । नाशक्नुवन्वारयितुं समन्ता;दादित्यरश्मिप्रतिमं नराग्र्यम् ॥
data.md: The warriors of the Kaurava army, although they assailed him from all sides, were unable to resist that best of car-warriors resembling the thousand-rayed sun himself, that foremost of men, who having penetrated through the Kaurava array, was advancing, borne by his excellent steeds that were white like the moon or he conch-shell.

data.v: असह्यविक्रान्तमदीनसत्त्वं; सर्वे गणा भारत दुर्विषह्यम् । सहस्रनेत्रप्रतिमप्रभावं; दिवीव सूर्यं जलदव्यपाये ॥
data.md: O Bharata, none amongst your warriors was then able to resist Yuyudhana of prowess incapable of being withstood, of unmitigating energy, of heroism equal to that of the thousand-eyed deity, looking like the autumnal sun in the firmament.

data.v: अमर्षपूर्णस्त्वतिचित्रयोधी; शरासनी काञ्चनवर्मधारी । सुदर्शनः सात्यकिमापतन्तं; न्यवारयद्राजवरः प्रसह्य ॥
data.md: Thereupon that foremost of kings, named Sudarsana, versed in all modes of warfare, clad in golden armour, armed with the bow and the arrows and inspired with wrath, proceeded against the dashing Satyaki and strove to check his career.

data.v: तयोरभूद्भरत संप्रहारः; सुदारुणस्तं समभिप्रशंसन् । योधास्त्वदीयाश्च हि सोमकाश्च; वृत्रेन्द्रयोर्युद्धमिवामरौघाः ॥
data.md: The encounter that then commenced between them was extremely awful. Both your warriors and the Somakas applauded it highly; and the immortals compared it to the one that took place in days gone by between Vritra and Indra.

data.v: शरैः सुतीक्ष्णैः शतशोऽभ्यविध्य;त्सुदर्शनः सात्वतमुख्यमाजौ । अनागतानेव तु तान्पृषत्कां;श्चिच्छेद बाणैः शिनिपुंगवोऽपि ॥
data.md: Sudarsana striving hard sped at that foremost descendant of the Satvata race, hundreds of sharp arrows, but O king, that illustrious scion of the Sini race, cut down all those arrows, before they could ever reach him.

data.v: तथैव शक्रप्रतिमोऽपि सात्यकिः; सुदर्शने यान्क्षिपति स्म सायकान् । द्विधा त्रिधा तानकरोत्सुदर्शनः; शरोत्तमैः स्यन्दनवर्यमास्थितः ॥
data.md: So also did, Sudarsana, riding on his own chariot of excellent make, severed, by means of his own arrows, in two or three parts, all the arrows sped at him by Satyaki who resembled Indra himself.

data.v: संप्रेक्ष्य बाणान्निहतांस्तदानीं; सुदर्शनः सात्यकिबाणवेगैः । क्रोधाद्दिधक्षन्निव तिग्मतेजाः; शरानमुञ्चत्तपनीयचित्रान् ॥
data.md: Then beholding his own arrows repulsed by the force of those shot by Satyaki, Sudarsana of fierce energy in order to burn down his adversary, angrily shot some beautiful shafts equipped with wings of gold.

data.v: पुनः स बाणैस्त्रिभिरग्निकल्पै;राकर्णपूर्णैर्निशितैः सुपुङ्खैः । विव्याध देहावरणं विभिद्य; ते सात्यकेराविविशुः शरीरम् ॥
data.md: Then he pierced his adversary with three beautiful arrows resembling fire itself and furnished with golden wings, discharged from the bowstring drawn back to the very ear. These arrows penetrating through Satyaki's armour mangled his body.

data.v: तथैव तस्यावनिपालपुत्रः; संधाय बाणैरपरैर्ज्वलद्भिः । आजघ्निवांस्तान्रजतप्रकाशां;श्चतुर्भिरश्वांश्चतुरः प्रसह्य ॥
data.md: Once more that prince Sudarsana, fixing on his bowstring another four resplendent shafts, struck therewith the four steeds of Satyaki that were of argentine huc.

data.v: तथा तु तेनाभिहतस्तरस्वी; नप्ता शिनेरिन्द्रसमानवीर्यः । सुदर्शनस्येषुगणैः सुतीक्ष्णै;र्हयान्निहत्याशु ननाद नादम् ॥
data.md: Thus afflicted by him, Sini's grandson, possessed of great agility and endowed with might equal to that of Indra himself, quickly slew with his own arrows the steeds of Sudarsana and sent up (then) a loud war-cry.

data.v: अथास्य सूतस्य शिरो निकृत्य; भल्लेन वज्राशनिसंनिभेन । सुदर्शनस्यापि शिनिप्रवीरः; क्षुरेण चिच्छेद शिरः प्रसह्य ॥
सकुण्डलं पूर्णशशिप्रकाशं; भ्राजिष्णु वक्त्रं निचकर्त देहात् । यथा पुरा वज्रधरः प्रसह्य; बलस्य संख्येऽतिबलस्य राजन् ॥
data.md: Then lopping off with a bhalla charged with the vehemence of Indra's thunder-bolt, the head of Sudarsana's charioteer, that best of the Sinis, with a razor-headed arrow resembling the fire that appears at the end of a Yuga, cutoff from Sudarsana's trunk his head graced with ear-rings, resembling the full moon and decked with an exceedingly charming face, like the wiclder of the thunder-bolt, 0 king, forcibly cutting off in day's gone by, the head of the Asura bala in battle.

data.v: निहत्य तं पार्थिवपुत्रपौत्रं; रणे यदूनामृषभस्तरस्वी । मुदा समेतः परया महात्मा; रराज राजन्सुरराजकल्पः ॥
data.md: Thus having slain that grandson of a prince, that illustrious Scion of the Yadu race became inspired with joy and shone resplendent, O king, like the chief of the celestials himself.

data.v: ततो ययावर्जुनमेव येन; निवार्य सैन्यं तव मार्गणौघैः । सदश्वयुक्तेन रथेन निर्या;ल्लोकान्विसिस्मापयिषुर्नृवीरः ॥
data.md: Then that best hero among men viz., Yuyudhana proceeded along the track by which Arjuna had gone before him, resisting as he advanced, by means of his myriad shafts, all your warriors and riding on that excellent chariot of his, O king, to which were yoked those best steeds and filling every body with wonder.

data.v: तत्तस्य विस्मापयनीयमग्र्य;मपूजयन्योधवराः समेताः । यद्वर्तमानानिषुगोचरेऽरी;न्ददाह बाणैर्हुतभुग्यथैव ॥
data.md: Then all the excellent warriors assembled on the field of battle, applauded that wonderful feat achieved by Satyaki, inasmuch as he consumed all opponents that came within the range of his arrows, like a blazing conflagration burning everything that falls in its way.

data.v: ततः स सात्यकिर्धीमान्महात्मा वृष्णिपुंगवः । सुदर्शनं निहत्याजौ यन्तारमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Thereafter that illustrious scion of the Vrishni race, the high-souled and intelligent Satyaki, having slain Sudarsana in battle, addressing charioteer thus spoke.

data.v: रथाश्वनागकलिलं शरशक्त्यूर्मिमालिनम् । खड्गमत्स्यं गदाग्राहं शूरायुधमहास्वनम् ॥
प्राणापहारिणं रौद्रं वादित्रोत्क्रुष्टनादितम् । योधानामसुखस्पर्शं दुर्धर्षमजयैषिणाम् ॥
तीर्णाः स्म दुस्तरं तात द्रोणानीकमहार्णवम् । जलसंधबलेनाजौ पुरुषादैरिवावृतम् ॥
अतोऽन्यं पृतनाशेषं मन्ये कुनदिकामिव । तर्तव्यामल्पसलिलां चोदयाश्वानसंभ्रमम् ॥
हस्तप्राप्तमहं मन्ये सांप्रतं सव्यसाचिनम् । निर्जित्य दुर्धरं द्रोणं सपदानुगमाहवे ॥
data.md: I think I am now within a hand's distance from Savyasachin. Having vanquished in are battle, the indomitable Drona together with his followers.

data.v: हार्दिक्यं योधवर्यं च प्राप्तं मन्ये धनंजयम् । न हि मे जायते त्रासो दृष्ट्वा सैन्यान्यनेकशः । वह्नेरिव प्रदीप्तस्य ग्रीष्मे शुष्कं तृणोलपम् ॥
data.md: As also that best of all warriors namely, the son of Hridika, I think I have already reached Dhananjaya. Though I see these numerous divisions of troops before me, fear does not assail my heart.

data.v: पश्य पाण्डवमुख्येन यातां भूमिं किरीटिना । पत्त्यश्वरथनागौघैः पतितैर्विषमीकृताम् ॥
अभ्याशस्थमहं मन्ये श्वेताश्वं कृष्णसारथिम् । स एष श्रूयते शब्दो गाण्डीवस्यामितौजसः ॥
data.md: I think myself to be very near to that one of white steeds whose charioteer in Krishna, inasmuch as I hear the twang of the bow Gandiva wielded by that one of infinite prowess.

data.v: यादृशानि निमित्तानि मम प्रादुर्भवन्ति वै । अनस्तंगत आदित्ये हन्ता सैन्धवमर्जुनः ॥
data.md: From the omens that are revealing themselves to me, I can judge that Arjuna will slay the ruler of the Sindhus before the sun today goes below the horizon.

data.v: शनैर्विश्रम्भयन्नश्वान्याहि यत्तोऽरिवाहिनीम् । यत्रैते सतनुत्राणाः सुयोधनपुरोगमाः ॥
data.md: Without exhausting their strength, drive the steeds slowly to the spot where the hostile ranks are staying, that is, to the spot where yonder warriors headed by Duryodhana, their hands cased in leathern fences

data.v: दंशिताः क्रूरकर्माणः काम्बोजा युद्धदुर्मदाः । शरबाणासनधरा यवनाश्च प्रहारिणः ॥
data.md: And yonder Kambojas of dreadful deeds, cased in mail and difficult of defeat in battle and these Yavanas armed with bows and arrows and accomplished in smiting.

data.v: शकाः किराता दरदा बर्बरास्ताम्रलिप्तकाः । अन्ये च बहवो म्लेच्छा विविधायुधपाणयः । मामेवाभिमुखाः सर्वे तिष्ठन्ति समरार्थिनः ॥
data.md: And yonder Sakas and Kiratas and Daradas and Barbaras and Tamraliptakas and numerous other Mlechchas armed with diverse weapons are staying.

data.v: एतान्सरथनागाश्वान्निहत्याजौ सपत्तिनः । इदं दुर्गं महाघोरं तीर्णमेवोपधारय ॥
data.md: Consider me, O charioteer as already passed through this dreadful strong-hold, having slain in battle all these warriors and cars, elephants, horses and foot-soldiers that are among them.

data.v: न संभ्रमो मे वार्ष्णेय विद्यते सत्यविक्रम । यद्यपि स्यात्सुसंक्रुद्धो जामदग्न्योऽग्रतः स्थितः ॥
data.md: The Charioteer said O scion of the Vrishni race, fear I have none, O you of prowess incapable of being withstood! If you had before you the enraged son of Yamadagni.

data.v: द्रोणो वा रथिनां श्रेष्ठः कृपो मद्रेश्वरोऽपि वा । तथापि संभ्रमो न स्यात्त्वामाश्रित्य महाभुज ॥
data.md: Or Drona that foremost of car-warriors or Kripa or the ruler of the Madras himself, even then fear would not enter my heart, O you of mighty arms, as long as I am under the shadow of your protection.

data.v: त्वया सुबहवो युद्धे निर्जिताः शत्रुसूदन । न च मे संभ्रमः कश्चिद्भूतपूर्वः कदाचन । किमु चैतत्समासाद्य वीर संयुगगोष्पदम् ॥
आयुष्मन्कतरेण त्वा प्रापयामि धनंजयम् । केषां क्रुद्धोऽसि वार्ष्णेय केषां मृत्युरुपस्थितः । केषां संयमनीमद्य गन्तुमुत्सहते मनः ॥
data.md: On whom have you been angry, O you of the Vrishni race? Who are they for whom death is waiting? Who are they that are destined to repair to the mansion of death today?

data.v: के त्वां युधि पराक्रान्तं कालान्तकयमोपमम् । दृष्ट्वा विक्रमसंपन्नं विद्रविष्यन्ति संयुगे । केषां वैवस्वतो राजा स्मरतेऽद्य महाभुज ॥
data.md: Who are they that will fly away from the field of battle beholding you endowed with such prowess, resembling the Destroyer himself as he appears at the end of the Yuga and putting forth that prowess of yours? O you of mighty arms who are they whoin king Vaivasvat, has remembered today?

data.v: मुण्डानेतान्हनिष्यामि दानवानिव वासवः । प्रतिज्ञां पारयिष्यामि काम्बोजानेव मा वह । अद्यैषां कदनं कृत्वा क्षिप्रं यास्यामि पाण्डवम् ॥
data.md: Satyaki said I will slay these warriors with sharpened shafts like Vasava slaying the Danavas. Slaying the Kambojas, I will fulfill my vow. Carry me thither.

data.v: अद्य द्रक्ष्यन्ति मे वीर्यं कौरवाः ससुयोधनाः । मुण्डानीके हते सूत सर्वसैन्येषु चासकृत् ॥
अद्य कौरवसैन्यस्य दीर्यमाणस्य संयुगे । श्रुत्वा विरावं बहुधा संतप्स्यति सुयोधनः ॥
अद्य पाण्डवमुख्यस्य श्वेताश्वस्य महात्मनः । आचार्यककृतं मार्गं दर्शयिष्यामि संयुगे ॥
अद्य मद्बाणनिहतान्योधमुख्यान्सहस्रशः । दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनो राजा पश्चात्तापं गमिष्यति ॥
अद्य मे क्षिप्रहस्तस्य क्षिपतः सायकोत्तमान् । अलातचक्रप्रतिमं धनुर्द्रक्ष्यन्ति कौरवाः ॥
मत्सायकचिताङ्गानां रुधिरं स्रवतां बहु । सैनिकानां वधं दृष्ट्वा संतप्स्यति सुयोधनः ॥
अद्य मे क्रुद्धरूपस्य निघ्नतश्च वरान्वरान् । द्विरर्जुनमिमं लोकं मंस्यते स सुयोधनः ॥
अद्य राजसहस्राणि निहतानि मया रणे । दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनो राजा संतप्स्यति महामृधे ॥
अद्य स्नेहं च भक्तिं च पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु । हत्वा राजसहस्राणि दर्शयिष्यामि राजसु ॥
एवमुक्तस्तदा सूतः शिक्षितान्साधुवाहिनः । शशाङ्कसंनिकाशान्वै वाजिनोऽचूचुदद्भृशम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya continued Thus spoken to, the charioteer quickly drove those well-trained steeds resembling the moon in huc and carrying the warrior Satyaki well.

data.v: ते पिबन्त इवाकाशं युयुधानं हयोत्तमाः । प्रापयन्यवनाञ्शीघ्रं मनःपवनरंहसः ॥
data.md: Those excellent steeds, possessed of the fleetness of the wind or the mind, dashed forward scanning to devour the very skies and bore Yuyudhana to the spot where those Vas were,

data.v: सात्यकिं ते समासाद्य पृतनास्वनिवर्तिनम् । बहवो लघुहस्ताश्च शरवर्षैरवाकिरन् ॥
data.md: Then thosc Yavanas endued with great lightness of hunds obtaining in their midst the unretreating Satyaki, began to cover him with mighty showers of arrows.

data.v: तेषामिषूनथास्त्राणि वेगवन्नतपर्वभिः । अच्छिनत्सात्यकी राजन्नैनं ते प्राप्नुवञ्शराः ॥
data.md: Then Satyaki who was moving with great celerity, cul-off their arrows and weapons with his shafts of depressed knots. Indeed the arrows discharged by them could not then reach him.

data.v: रुक्मपुङ्खैः सुनिशितैर्गार्ध्रपत्रैरजिह्मगैः । उच्चकर्त शिरांस्युग्रो यवनानां भुजानपि ॥
data.md: The fierce Satyaki then began to lop off the heads and arms of the Yavanas, with sharp arrows cquipt with golden wings or wings made of vultering feathers, all-flying straight.

data.v: शैक्यायसानि वर्माणि कांस्यानि च समन्ततः । भित्त्वा देहांस्तथा तेषां शरा जग्मुर्महीतलम् ॥
data.md: Those arrows, penetrating through the iron or brass armours of the Yavanas as also their bodies, then fell down on the earth.

data.v: ते हन्यमाना वीरेण म्लेच्छाः सात्यकिना रणे । शतशो न्यपतंस्तत्र व्यसवो वसुधातले ॥
data.md: Thus slaughtered by the heroic Satyaki in that haitle, the Mlechchas began to fall by inundreds on the ground deprived of their lives.

data.v: सुपूर्णायतमुक्तैस्तानव्यवच्छिन्नपिण्डितैः । पञ्च षट्सप्त चाष्टौ च बिभेद यवनाञ्शरैः ॥
data.md: With his arrows disc!larged from his bow drawn to the fullest exicnt and flying in a continuous line, that brave warrior began to slay, five, six, seven or eight Yavanas at a time.

data.v: काम्बोजानां सहस्रैस्तु शकानां च विशां पते । शबराणां किरातानां बर्बराणां तथैव च ॥
data.md: With the dead bodies of hundreds and thousands of Kambojas, Sakas, Souviras, Trgartas andri ruler of men.

data.v: अगम्यरूपां पृथिवीं मांसशोणितकर्दमाम् । कृतवांस्तत्र शैनेयः क्षपयंस्तावकं बलम् ॥
data.md: The carth became impassable; and it was slippery with the flesh and blond that then constitutcoins mire. The grandson of Sini then cabut carnage amous pour troops.

data.v: दस्यूनां सशिरस्त्राणैः शिरोभिर्लूनमूर्धजैः । तत्र तत्र मही कीर्णा विबर्हैरण्डजैरिव ॥
data.md: The ground was then strewn over with the head-gears of those robbers and the shaved heads that looked like unfledged birds in consequence of their long beards.

data.v: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गैस्तैस्तदायोधनं बभौ । कबन्धैः संवृतं सर्वं ताम्राभ्रैः खमिवावृतम् ॥
data.md: The field of battle overspread with headless trunks bathed in blood, appeared charming like the firmament overspread with coppery clouds.

data.v: वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शैः सुपर्वभिरजिह्मगैः । ते साश्वयाना निहताः समावव्रुर्वसुंधराम् ॥
data.md: Slain with the shafts of the heroic Satyaki, shafts whose touch resembled the thunderbolt's stroke and whose knots were wellpressed and which were flying in straight lines, the Yavanas covered the field of battle over.

data.v: अल्पावशिष्टाः संभग्नाः कृच्छ्रप्राणा विचेतसः । जिताः संख्ये महाराज युयुधानेन दंशिताः ॥
data.md: The handful remnant of those mail-covered soldiers, defeated, O king, by the Satvata hero, became cheerless; and finding their lives on the points of being snatched away from them, they broke.

data.v: पार्ष्णिभिश्च कशाभिश्च ताडयन्तस्तुरंगमान् । जवमुत्तममास्थाय सर्वतः प्राद्रवन्भयात् ॥
data.md: And fled away, urging, their steeds to the top of their speed, with their whips, goads & c out of great fear that then overwhelmed them.

data.v: काम्बोजसैन्यं विद्राव्य दुर्जयं युधि भारत । यवनानां च तत्सैन्यं शकानां च महद्बलम् ॥
data.md: Routing in battle the invisible Kamboja troops and 0 Bharata, the troops of the Yavanas and the mighty host of the Sakas.

data.v: स ततः पुरुषव्याघ्रः सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः । प्रहृष्टस्तावकाञ्जित्वा सूतं याहीत्यचोदयत् ॥
data.md: That foremost of men, viz... Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled, penetrated into the heart of your troops, vanquishing them and urging his charioteer saying, "Proceed."

data.v: तं यान्तं पृष्ठगोप्तारमर्जुनस्य विशां पते । चारणाः प्रेक्ष्य संहृष्टास्त्वदीयाश्चाप्यपूजयन् ॥
data.md: Then, O ruler of men, beholding him proceeding as the rear-guard of Arjuna, the Charanas were filled with delight. Even your troops then began to applaud him.

data.v: जित्वा यवनकाम्बोजान्युयुधानस्ततोऽर्जुनम् । जगाम तव सैन्यस्य मध्येन रथिनां वरः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Having defeated the Yavanas and the Kambojas that foremost of car-warriors Yuyudhana advanced after Arjuna right through the centre of your troops.

data.v: शरदंष्ट्रो नरव्याघ्रो विचित्रकवचच्छविः । मृगान्व्याघ्र इवाजिघ्रंस्तव सैन्यमभीषयत् ॥
data.md: Then like a huntsman slaying dcer, that foremost of men, viz., Satyaki, graced with beautiful teeth, cased in exceilent armour and owning a beautiful standard, slew the Kaurava troops and struck terror into their hearts.

data.v: स रथेन चरन्मार्गान्धनुरभ्रामयद्भृशम् । रुक्मपृष्ठं महावेगं रुक्मचन्द्रकसंकुलम् ॥
data.md: Advancing on his chariot, he began to shake his bow with force, bow the back of which was decked with gold, the toughness of which as great and which was beautified with golden moons.

data.v: रुक्माङ्गदशिरस्त्राणो रुक्मवर्मसमावृतः । रुक्मध्वजवरः शूरो मेरुशृङ्ग इवाबभौ ॥
data.md: His arms adorned with golden Angadas, his turban decked with gold, his body covered with a golden armour, his standard and bow variegated with gold, that hero appeared resplendent like the crest of the Merumountain.

data.v: सधनुर्मण्डलः संख्ये तेजोभास्वररश्मिवान् । शरदीवोदितः सूर्यो नृसूर्यो विरराज ह ॥
data.md: Himself emitting great effulgence and wielding that bow drawn to a circle in his hands, he appeared like another autumnal sum.

data.v: वृषभस्कन्धविक्रान्तो वृषभाक्षो नरर्षभः । तावकानां बभौ मध्ये गवां मध्ये यथा वृषः ॥
data.md: That foremost of men graced with shoulders, tread and eyes, resembling those of the moon, appeared in the centre of your army, like a bull in the midst of a cowpen.

data.v: मत्तद्विरदसंकाशं मत्तद्विरदगामिनम् । प्रभिन्नमिव मातङ्गं यूथमध्ये व्यवस्थितम् । व्याघ्रा इव जिघांसन्तस्त्वदीयाभ्यद्रवन्रणे ॥
data.md: Him looking like and possessing the graceful tread of, an infuriate elephant and appearing like an elephant leader with open temples, standing in their midst.

data.v: द्रोणानीकमतिक्रान्तं भोजानीकं च दुस्तरम् । जलसंधार्णवं तीर्त्वा काम्बोजानां च वाहिनीम् ॥
हार्दिक्यमकरान्मुक्तं तीर्णं वै सैन्यसागरम् । परिवव्रुः सुसंक्रुद्धास्त्वदीयाः सात्यकिं रथाः ॥
दुर्योधनश्चित्रसेनो दुःशासनविविंशती । शकुनिर्दुःसहश्चैव युवा दुर्मर्षणः क्रथः ॥
अन्ये च बहवः शूराः शस्त्रवन्तो दुरासदाः । पृष्ठतः सात्यकिं यान्तमन्वधावन्नमर्षिताः ॥
अथ शब्दो महानासीत्तव सैन्यस्य मारिष । मारुतोद्धूतवेगस्य सागरस्येव पर्वणि ॥
data.md: Afflicted as they were with the shafts of that descendent of Madhu's race, was tremendous like that of the Ocean in a Parvadayi. Then hearing the cry and that tremendous din, Drona, addressing his charioteer, said

data.v: तानभिद्रवतः सर्वान्समीक्ष्य शिनिपुंगवः । शनैर्याहीति यन्तारमब्रवीत्प्रहसन्निव ॥
इदमेति समुद्धूतं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य यद्बलम् । मामेवाभिमुखं तूर्णं गजाश्वरथपत्तिमत् ॥
नादयन्वै दिशः सर्वा रथघोषेण सारथे । पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च कम्पयन्सागरानपि ॥
एतद्बलार्णवं तात वारयिष्ये महारणे । पौर्णमास्यामिवोद्धूतं वेलेव सलिलाशयम् ॥
पश्य मे सूत विक्रान्तमिन्द्रस्येव महामृधे । एष सैन्यानि शत्रूणां विधमामि शितैः शरैः ॥
निहतानाहवे पश्य पदात्यश्वरथद्विपान् । मच्छरैरग्निसंकाशैर्विदेहासून्सहस्रशः ॥
इत्येवं ब्रुवतस्तस्य सात्यकेरमितौजसः । समीपं सैनिकास्ते तु शीघ्रमीयुर्युयुत्सवः । जह्याद्रवस्व तिष्ठेति पश्य पश्येति वादिनः ॥
data.md: You warriors quickly approached him desirous of battling with him, saying, 'Slay'. 'Rush,' “Wait" 'Look look'.

data.v: तानेवं ब्रुवतो वीरान्सात्यकिर्निशितैः शरैः । जघान त्रिशतानश्वान्कुञ्जरांश्च चतुःशतान् ॥
data.md: Satyaki then fell to slaughter those heroes even when they were thus speaking, with his sharp arrows. He slew three hundred steeds and four hundred elephants.

data.v: स संप्रहारस्तुमुलस्तस्य तेषां च धन्विनाम् । देवासुररणप्रख्यः प्रावर्तत जनक्षयः ॥
data.md: That battle between Satyaki on the one hand and your warriors of the others, became awful like that between the gods and the Asuras fought in the days of yore. The carnage that attended it, was fierce in the extreme.

data.v: मेघजालनिभं सैन्यं तव पुत्रस्य मारिष । प्रत्यगृह्णाच्छिनेः पौत्रः शरैराशीविषोपमैः ॥
data.md: O sire, the grandson of Sini received the assault of your son's divisions resembling thick masses of clouds, with his shafts resembling snakes of virulent poison.

data.v: प्रच्छाद्यमानः समरे शरजालैः स वीर्यवान् । असंभ्रमं महाराज तावकानवधीद्बहून् ॥
data.md: That valorous hero then covered over with net-work of arrows, O king, began to slay your troops by hundreds, nothing daunted.

data.v: आश्चर्यं तत्र राजेन्द्र सुमहद्दृष्टवानहम् । न मोघः सायकः कश्चित्सात्यकेरभवत्प्रभो ॥
data.md: 0 king, I then beheld an extremcly wonderful sight there, inasmuch as, O lord, I saw not one shaft of Satyaki fail in striking its aim.

data.v: रथनागाश्वकलिलः पदात्यूर्मिसमाकुलः । शैनेयवेलामासाद्य स्थितः सैन्यमहार्णवः ॥
data.md: That ocean constituted by the troops of Duryodhana, teening with cars, elephants and steeds and surging with waves constituted by cars, as soon as it came in contact with the bank formed by Sinis grandson.

data.v: संभ्रान्तनरनागाश्वमावर्तत मुहुर्मुहुः । तत्सैन्यमिषुभिस्तेन वध्यमानं समन्ततः । बभ्राम तत्र तत्रैव गावः शीतार्दिता इव ॥
data.md: That host consisting of terrified warriors, clephants and horses, carnaged on all sides by the arrows of Satyaki, began to turn round repeatedly.

data.v: पदातिनं रथं नागं सादिनं तुरगं तथा । अविद्धं तत्र नाद्राक्षं युयुधानस्य सायकैः ॥
न तादृक्कदनं राजन्कृतवांस्तत्र फल्गुनः । यादृक्क्षयमनीकानामकरोत्सात्यकिर्नृप । अत्यर्जुनं शिनेः पौत्रो युध्यते भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: As was done by Satyaki in your ranks. O foremost of men, Sini's grandson then fought, surpassing even Arjuna himself.

data.v: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सात्वतस्य त्रिभिः शरैः । विव्याध सूतं निशितैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् ॥
सात्यकिं च त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध सोऽष्टभिः । दुःशासनः षोडशभिर्विव्याध शिनिपुंगवम् ॥
शकुनिः पञ्चविंशत्या चित्रसेनश्च पञ्चभिः । दुःसहः पञ्चदशभिर्विव्याधोरसि सात्यकिम् ॥
उत्स्मयन्वृष्णिशार्दूलस्तथा बाणैः समाहतः । तानविध्यन्महाराज सर्वानेव त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः ॥
गाढविद्धानरीन्कृत्वा मार्गणैः सोऽतितेजनैः । शैनेयः श्येनवत्संख्ये व्यचरल्लघुविक्रमः ॥
सौबलस्य धनुश्छित्त्वा हस्तावापं निकृत्य च । दुर्योधनं त्रिभिर्बाणैरभ्यविध्यत्स्तनान्तरे ॥
चित्रसेनं शतेनैव दशभिर्दुःसहं तथा । दुःशासनं च विंशत्या विव्याध शिनिपुंगवः ॥
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय स्यालस्तव विशां पते । अष्टभिः सात्यकिं विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः ॥
दुःशासनश्च दशभिर्दुःसहश्च त्रिभिः शरैः । दुर्मुखश्च द्वादशभी राजन्विव्याध सात्यकिम् ॥
data.md: Pierced Satyaki first with eight and then with another five arrows. Then o king, Dushasana pierced Satyaki with ten, Dussaha with three and Durmukha with twelve shafts. O Bharata, then Duryodhana, pierced that scion of Madhu's race with seventy-three arrows.

data.v: दुर्योधनस्त्रिसप्तत्या विद्ध्वा भारत माधवम् । ततोऽस्य निशितैर्बाणैस्त्रिभिर्विव्याध सारथिम् ॥
तान्सर्वान्सहिताञ्शूरान्यतमानान्महारथान् । पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिर्बाणैः पुनर्विव्याध सात्यकिः ॥
ततः स रथिनां श्रेष्ठस्तव पुत्रस्य सारथिम् । आजघानाशु भल्लेन स हतो न्यपतद्भुवि ॥
data.md: Were pierced each with five arrows by Satyaki. Then that foremost of warriors struck the driver of your son with a broad-headed shaft. The latter then fell down on the ground slain. When his charioteer had been laid low, O master, that car-warrior, your son.

data.v: पातिते सारथौ तस्मिंस्तव पुत्ररथः प्रभो । वातायमानैस्तैरश्वैरपानीयत संगरात् ॥
ततस्तव सुता राजन्सैनिकाश्च विशां पते । राज्ञो रथमभिप्रेक्ष्य विद्रुताः शतशोऽभवन् ॥
विद्रुतं तत्र तत्सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा भारत सात्यकिः । अवाकिरच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णै रुक्मपुङ्खैः शिलाशितैः ॥
विद्राव्य सर्वसैन्यानि तावकानि समन्ततः । प्रययौ सात्यकी राजञ्श्वेताश्वस्य रथं प्रति ॥
तं शरानाददानं च रक्षमाणं च सारथिम् । आत्मानं मोचयन्तं च तावकाः समपूजयन् ॥
data.md: Satyaki flew towards the chariot of Arjuna owning cream-colored steeds. Even your troops then applauded him as they beheld him proceed shooting arrows and protecting himself and his charioteer.

data.v: संप्रमृद्य महत्सैन्यं यान्तं शैनेयमर्जुनम् । निर्ह्रीका मम ते पुत्राः किमकुर्वत संजय ॥
data.md: Dhritarastra said What, O Sanjaya, did my shameless sons do when they beheld the grandson of Sini proceed towards Arjuna, crushing as he advanced my troops?

data.v: कथं चैषां तथा युद्धे धृतिरासीन्मुमूर्षताम् । शैनेयचरितं दृष्ट्वा सदृशं सव्यसाचिनः ॥
data.md: How indeed did those dying wretches set their heart on fight, when Sini's grandson who is equal to Savyasachin himself appeared before them?

data.v: किं नु वक्ष्यन्ति ते क्षात्रं सैन्यमध्ये पराजिताः । कथं च सात्यकिर्युद्धे व्यतिक्रान्तो महायशाः ॥
data.md: What indeed, did the Kshatriyas defeated in battle do? How indeed did the illustrious Satyaki penetrate through their ranks?

data.v: कथं च मम पुत्राणां जीवतां तत्र संजय । शैनेयोऽभिययौ युद्धे तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वतः ॥
data.md: O Sanjaya, tell me also, how could the grandson of Sini proceed to battle when all my sons were alive and fighting?

data.v: अत्यद्भुतमिदं तात त्वत्सकाशाच्छृणोम्यहम् । एकस्य बहुभिर्युद्धं शत्रुभिर्वै महारथैः ॥
data.md: What I have heard from you, O son, appears to be exceedingly wonderful viz., the battle between the one and the many the latter counting many mighty car-warrior among them.

data.v: विपरीतमहं मन्ये मन्दभाग्यान्सुतान्प्रति । यत्रावध्यन्त समरे सात्वतेन महात्मना ॥
data.md: O Suta, I think Destiny is adverse to the interests of my sons, in as much as they are now being slaughtered by that mighty carwarrior of the Satvata race.

data.v: एकस्य हि न पर्याप्तं मत्सैन्यं तस्य संजय । क्रुद्धस्य युयुधानस्य सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु पाण्डवाः ॥
data.md: Even all my troops united together were not competent enough to withstand the enraged Yuyudhana; not to speak of the sons of Pandu.

data.v: निर्जित्य समरे द्रोणं कृतिनं युद्धदुर्मदम् । यथा पशुगणान्सिंहस्तद्वद्धन्ता सुतान्मम ॥
data.md: Like a lion slaying other inferior beasts Satyaki is slaughtering my sons, having first vanquished in battle Drona that warrior accomplished in weapons and versed in all modes of warfare.

data.v: कृतवर्मादिभिः शूरैर्यत्तैर्बहुभिराहवे । युयुधानो न शकितो हन्तुं यः पुरुषर्षभः ॥
data.md: Countless heroes headed by Kirtavaiman himself, fighting heedfully, were not able to slay Satyaki in battle; so it is certain that the latter will vanquish my sons single-headed.

data.v: नैतदीदृशकं युद्धं कृतवांस्तत्र फल्गुनः । यादृशं कृतवान्युद्धं शिनेर्नप्ता महायशाः ॥
data.md: Even Phalguna himself did not fight in the manner in which the illustrious grandson of Sini has fought.

data.v: तव दुर्मन्त्रिते राजन्दुर्योधनकृतेन च । शृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा यत्ते वक्ष्यामि भारत ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said All this has been brought about by your wicked policy and by the vile deeds of Duryodhana o king. O Bharata, now hear attentively what I am going to say to you.

data.v: ते पुनः संन्यवर्तन्त कृत्वा संशप्तकान्मिथः । परां युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा पुत्रस्य तव शासनात् ॥
data.md: At the command of your son, all those warriors then taking tremendous vows to fight

data.v: त्रीणि सादिसहस्राणि दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः । शकाः काम्बोजबाह्लीका यवनाः पारदास्तथा ॥
data.md: Three thousand bowmen, commanded by Duryodhana himself and supported by a numerous body of Sakas, Kambojas, Valhikas, Yavanas, Paradas.

data.v: कुणिन्दास्तङ्गणाम्बष्ठाः पैशाचाश्च समन्दराः । अभ्यद्रवन्त शैनेयं शलभाः पावकं यथा ॥
युक्ताश्च पार्वतीयानां रथाः पाषाणयोधिनाम् । शूराः पञ्चशता राजञ्शैनेयं समुपाद्रवन् ॥
ततो रथसहस्रेण महारथशतेन च । द्विरदानां सहस्रेण द्विसाहस्रैश्च वाजिभिः ॥
शरवर्षाणि मुञ्चन्तो विविधानि महारथाः । अभ्यद्रवन्त शैनेयमसंख्येयाश्च पत्तयः ॥
तांश्च संचोदयन्सर्वान्घ्नतैनमिति भारत । दुःशासनो महाराज सात्यकिं पर्यवारयत् ॥
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम शैनेयचरितं महत् । यदेको बहुभिः सार्धमसंभ्रान्तमयुध्यत ॥
अवधीच्च रथानीकं द्विरदानां च तद्बलम् । सादिनश्चैव तान्सर्वान्दस्यूनपि च सर्वशः ॥
तत्र चक्रैर्विमथितैर्भग्नैश्च परमायुधैः । अक्षैश्च बहुधा भग्नैरीषादण्डकबन्धुरैः ॥
कूबरैर्मथितैश्चापि ध्वजैश्चापि निपातितैः । वर्मभिश्चामरैश्चैव व्यवकीर्णा वसुंधरा ॥
स्रग्भिराभरणैर्वस्त्रैरनुकर्षैश्च मारिष । संछन्ना वसुधा तत्र द्यौर्ग्रहैरिव भारत ॥
गिरिरूपधराश्चापि पतिताः कुञ्जरोत्तमाः । अञ्जनस्य कुले जाता वामनस्य च भारत । सुप्रतीककुले जाता महापद्मकुले तथा ॥
ऐरावणकुले चैव तथान्येषु कुलेषु च । जाता दन्तिवरा राजञ्शेरते बहवो हताः ॥
