data.md: Vrikodara then cut-off with many shafts all those arrows of Karna that ornaments of battle, arrows that resembled the bolt of heaven, before they could reach him.

data.v: पुनश्च शरवर्षेण छादयामास भारत । कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे भीमसेनं महारथम् ॥
data.md: But once more, O Bharata, that subduer of foes viz., Vikartana's son Karna, covered Bhimasena with a shower of arrows.

data.v: तत्र भारत भीमं तु दृष्टवन्तः स्म सायकैः । समाचिततनुं संख्ये श्वाविधं शललैरिव ॥
data.md: O Bharata, we then beheld Bhimasena thus pierced all over with arrows, resemble a porcupine with its quills erect.

data.v: हेमपुङ्खाञ्शिलाधौतान्कर्णचापच्युताञ्शरान् । दधार समरे वीरः स्वरश्मीनिव भास्करः ॥
data.md: Then that hero Vikodara held all those shafts, furnished with golden wings, whetted on stone and shot from the bow of Karna, like the sun holding his own myriad rays.

data.v: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गो भीमसेनो व्यरोचत । तपनीयनिभैः पुष्पैः पलाश इव कानने ॥
तत्तु भीमो महाराज कर्णस्य चरितं रणे । नामृष्यत महेष्वासः क्रोधादुद्वृत्य चक्षुषी ॥
data.md: But the mighty armed Bhima with his eyes roiling in rage, did not for long, bear that conduct of Karna in battle patiently.

data.v: स कर्णं पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समार्पयत् । महीधरमिव श्वेतं गूढपादैर्विषोल्बणैः ॥
data.md: Thereafter he pierced Karna in battle with twenty five Narachas; pierced therewith Karna appeared beautiful like a white mountain with his sides covered over with snakes of virulent poison.

data.v: तं विव्याध पुनर्भीमः षड्भिरष्टाभिरेव च । मर्मस्वमरविक्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं महारणे ॥
data.md: Then once more that one of prowess resembling that of the immortals, pierced that reckless son of a Suta in his vital limbs with two sets of arrows numbering six and eight respectively.

data.v: ततः कर्णस्य संक्रुद्धो भीमसेनः प्रतापवान् । चिच्छेद कार्मुकं तूर्णं सर्वोपकरणानि च ॥
data.md: Again the valiant Bhimasena with another arrow smilingly cut-off the bow of Karna with great quickness.

data.v: जघान चतुरश्चाश्वान्सूतं च त्वरितः शरैः । नाराचैरर्करश्म्याभैः कर्णं विव्याध चोरसि ॥
data.md: Quickly did he then slay with his arrows Karna's four steeds and charioteer. He then pierced Karna on the breast with Narachas of the effulgence of solar rays.

data.v: ते जग्मुर्धरणीं सर्वे कर्णं निर्भिद्य मारिष । यथा हि जलदं भित्त्वा राजन्सूर्यस्य रश्मयः ॥
data.md: Those winged shafts piercing Karna through, fell down on the earth like the rays of the sun penetrating through masses of rain clouds.

data.v: स वैकल्यं महत्प्राप्य छिन्नधन्वा शरार्दितः । तथा पुरुषमानी स प्रत्यपायाद्रथान्तरम् ॥
data.md: Wounded with those arrows and with his bow cut open, Karna was afflicted with great pain; although proud of his manliness, he then proceeded to another part of the field.

data.v: यस्मिञ्जयाशा सततं पुत्राणां मम संजय । तं दृष्ट्वा विमुखं संख्ये किं नु दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत् । कर्णो वा समरे तात किमकार्षीदतः परम् ॥
भीमसेनं रणे दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् । रथमन्यं समास्थाय विधिवत्कल्पितं पुनः । अभ्ययात्पाण्डवं कर्णो वातोद्धूत इवार्णवः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Riding on another duly furnished car, Karna then rushed at Pandu's son, like the ocean lashed into fury by the tempest.

data.v: क्रुद्धमाधिरथिं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रास्तव विशां पते । भीमसेनममन्यन्त वैवस्वतमुखे हुतम् ॥
data.md: Then, 0 ruler of men, beholding Adhiratha's son excited with rage, your sons considered Bhimasena to be a libation poured on fire.

data.v: चापशब्दं महत्कृत्वा तलशब्दं च भैरवम् । अभ्यवर्तत राधेयो भीमसेनरथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Then dreadfully slapping his palms and producing whizzes with his arrows, the sons of Radha began to shower arrows on the car of Bhimasena.

data.v: पुनरेव ततो राजन्महानासीत्सुदारुणः । विमर्दः सूतपुत्रस्य भीमस्य च विशां पते ॥
data.md: Once more, O king, the encounter between the heroic son of Vikartana and the high-souled Bhima, raged furiously.

data.v: संरब्धौ हि महाबाहू परस्परवधैषिणौ । अन्योन्यमीक्षां चक्राते दहन्ताविव लोचनैः ॥
data.md: Filled with wrath and desirous of slaying one another, O mighty-armed one, they began to look at each other as if to burn each other down with their giances.

data.v: क्रोधरक्तेक्षणौ क्रुद्धौ निःश्वसन्तौ महारथौ । युद्धेऽन्योन्यं समासाद्य ततक्षतुररिंदमौ ॥
data.md: Their eyes became fierce and red in rage and the breathed like two snakes. Those two slayers of enemies, those two heroes, then began to mangle each other with their arrows.

data.v: व्याघ्राविव सुसंरब्धौ श्येनाविव च शीघ्रगौ । शरभाविव संक्रुद्धौ युयुधाते परस्परम् ॥
data.md: They fought on with one another like two furious tigers or two swift-flying hawks or two enraged Sarabhas,

data.v: ततो भीमः स्मरन्क्लेशानक्षद्यूते वनेऽपि च । विराटनगरे चैव प्राप्तं दुःखमरिंदमः ॥
data.md: Then that subduer of foes, viz., Bhima remembering the hardships undergone by him at the game of dice, during his exile in the woods and residence in the city of Virata;

data.v: राष्ट्राणां स्फीतरत्नानां हरणं च तवात्मजैः । सततं च परिक्लेशान्सपुत्रेण त्वया कृतान् ॥
data.md: And recollecting the despoliation of the kingdom swelling with prosperity and gems by your sons and various other injuries inflicted upon the Pandavas, by yourself and the son of Suta;

data.v: दग्धुमैच्छश्च यत्कुन्तीं सपुत्रां त्वमनागसम् । कृष्णायाश्च परिक्लेशं सभामध्ये दुरात्मभिः ॥
data.md: And bearing in mind the fact that you had conspired to burn the innocent Kunti with her sons and remembering the woes of Krishna in the midst of the assembly at the hands of those wretches;

data.v: पतिमन्यं परीप्सस्व न सन्ति पतयस्तव । नरकं पतिताः पार्थाः सर्वे षण्ढतिलोपमाः ॥
data.md: To this effect="Take you another husband, for, all your husbands are dead; the sons of Pritha have merged into hell and are like sesamum seed without kernel."

data.v: समक्षं तव कौरव्य यदूचुः कुरवस्तदा । दासीभोगेन कृष्णां च भोक्तुकामाः सुतास्तव ॥
data.md: Remembering also those words, O descendant of the Kuru race, that were uttered by the Kauravas in your presence and the fact that your son had been desirous of enjoying Krishna as a slave.

data.v: यच्चापि तान्प्रव्रजतः कृष्णाजिननिवासिनः । परुषाण्युक्तवान्कर्णः सभायां संनिधौ तव ॥
data.md: Recollecting also those words, harsh and cruel, uttered by Karna, when the sons of Pandu were about to go to the forest, clad in deerskins;

data.v: तृणीकृत्य च यत्पार्थांस्तव पुत्रो ववल्ग ह । विषमस्थान्समस्थो हि संरम्भाद्गतचेतसः ॥
data.md: And keeping alive in his remmory the brag your vindictive and foolish son, then in prosperity, indulged in holding the woe stricken sons of Pritha in the light of mere

data.v: बाल्यात्प्रभृति चारिघ्नस्तानि दुःखानि चिन्तयन् । निरविद्यत धर्मात्मा जीवितेन वृकोदरः ॥
data.md: Indeed the virtuous-souled Bhima that slayer of opponents recollecting all these hardships and those he had undergone since his childhood, became disregardful of his very life.

data.v: ततो विस्फार्य सुमहद्धेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम् । चापं भरतशार्दूलस्त्यक्तात्मा कर्णमभ्ययात् ॥
data.md: Them, o foremost of the Bharatas, stretching his invincible and gold-decked bow, Bhima rushed at Krishna, reckless of his very life.

data.v: स सायकमयैर्जालैर्भीमः कर्णरथं प्रति । भानुमद्भिः शिलाधौतैर्भानोः प्रच्छादयत्प्रभाम् ॥
data.md: Then with a net-work woven with arrows whetted on stone, lustrous like the rays of the sun spread around the car of Karna, Bhima intercepted the rays of the sun.

data.v: ततः प्रहस्याधिरथिस्तूर्णमस्यञ्शिताञ्शरान् । व्यधमद्भीमसेनस्य शरजालानि पत्रिभिः ॥
data.md: Thereupon Adhiratha's son, smiling (in contempt) tore away Bhima's net-work of arrows, by means of his own winged shafts whetted on stone.

data.v: महारथो महाबाहुर्महावेगैर्महाबलः । विव्याधाधिरथिर्भीमं नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Then the mighty car-warrior of mighty arms and great strength, viz., that son of Adhiratha, pierced with nine whetted and mighty shafts that mighty warrior Bhima.

data.v: स तोत्त्रैरिव मातङ्गो वार्यमाणः पतत्रिभिः । अभ्यधावदसंभ्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं वृकोदरः ॥
data.md: Assailed with those winged shaft, like an elephant assailed with the hook, Vrikodara then dauntlessly rushed against Suta's son.

data.v: तमापतन्तं वेगेन रभसं पाण्डवर्षभम् । कर्णः प्रत्युद्ययौ योद्धुं मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम् ॥
data.md: Then as that foremost of the Pandavas was rushing with fury at him, Karna, excited with wrath, rushed at him like an infuriate elephant rushing at another.

data.v: ततः प्रध्माप्य जलजं भेरीशतनिनादितम् । अक्षुभ्यत बलं हर्षादुद्धूत इव सागरः ॥
data.md: Then blowing his conch whose blast resembled the sound of a hundred Bheris, he agitated the hostile array that resembled the surging sea.

data.v: तदुद्धूतं बलं दृष्ट्व रथनागाश्वपत्तिमत् । भीमः कर्णं समासाद्य छादयामास सायकैः ॥
data.md: Beholding his army teeming with elephants, horses, cars and infantry then agitated, Bhima approaching Karna began to cover him with arrows.

data.v: अश्वानृश्यसवर्णांस्तु हंसवर्णैर्हयोत्तमैः । व्यामिश्रयद्रणे कर्णः पाण्डवं छादयञ्शरैः ॥
data.md: Karna thereupon caused his own horses of the hue of swans to the mingled with those of Bhimasena of the hue of bears and covered in his turn the son of Pandu, with his shafts.

data.v: ऋश्यवर्णान्हयान्कर्कैर्मिश्रान्मारुतरंहसः । निरीक्ष्य तव पुत्राणां हाहाकृतमभूद्बलम् ॥
data.md: Beholding those steeds of the hue of bears and fleet as the wind, mingled with those of Karna of the hue of swans, cries Oh and Alas, rose among the army of your son.

data.v: ते हया बह्वशोभन्त मिश्रिता वातरंहसः । सितासिता महाराज यथा व्योम्नि बलाहकाः ॥
data.md: Those horses, fleet as the winds, thus mingled together looked exceedingly beautiful like white and black clouds, O king, mingled together in the firmament.

data.v: संरब्धौ क्रोधताम्राक्षौ प्रेक्ष्य कर्णवृकोदरौ । संत्रस्ताः समकम्पन्त त्वदीयानां महारथाः ॥
data.md: Beholding Karna and Vrikodara burning with rage with, their eyes coppery therewith, your mighty car-warriors began tremble with fear.

data.v: यमराष्ट्रोपमं घोरमासीदायोधनं तयोः । दुर्दर्शं भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रेतराजपुरं यथा ॥
data.md: The field of battle where they fought, soon became dreadful like the abode of Yama; and O foremost of the Bharatas, it became as repulsive to the sight as the domain of the king of departed spirits.

data.v: समाजमिव तच्चित्रं प्रेक्षमाणा महारथाः । नालक्षयञ्जयं व्यक्तमेकैकस्य निवारणे ॥
data.md: Your warriors, who were then looking upon that battle as upon a sport in an arena could not find any of them get any advantage over other.

data.v: तयोः प्रैक्षन्त संमर्दं संनिकृष्टमहास्त्रयोः । तव दुर्मन्त्रिते राजन्सपुत्रस्य विशां पते ॥
data.md: They only then saw the clash and the mingling of the mighty weapons shot by those warriors, as the consequence brought about by the wicked policy of you and your sons, O ruler of men.

data.v: छादयन्तौ हि शत्रुघ्नावन्योन्यं सायकैः शितैः । शरजालावृतं व्योम चक्राते शरवृष्टिभिः ॥
data.md: Those two heroes of wonderful prowess, those two slayers of their foes, then-covering each other with their arrows covered next the welkin with the net-work of their arrows.

data.v: तावन्योन्यं जिघांसन्तौ शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्महारथौ । प्रेक्षणीयतरावास्तां वृष्टिमन्ताविवाम्बुदौ ॥
data.md: Desirous of slaying each other, those two mighty car-warriors shooting sharp arrows at each other became worthy of being looked at like two clouds surcharged with rain.

data.v: सुवर्णविकृतान्बाणान्प्रमुञ्चन्तावरिंदमौ । भास्वरं व्योम चक्राते वह्न्युल्काभिरिव प्रभो ॥
data.md: O Lord, those two subduers of foes shooting arrows decked with gold, 'illumined the welkin like meteors illumining the skies.

data.v: ताभ्यां मुक्ता व्यकाशन्त कङ्कबर्हिणवाससः । पङ्क्त्यः शरदि मत्तानां सारसानामिवाम्बरे ॥
data.md: O king, the arrows, furnished with vulterince wings and discharged by Bhima, appeared beautiful like rows of maddened swans ranging through the welkin.

data.v: संसक्तं सूतपुत्रेण दृष्ट्वा भीममरिंदमम् । अतिभारममन्येतां भीमे कृष्णधनंजयौ ॥
data.md: Then beholding Bhima that subduer of foes engaged with the son of Suta, Krishna and Dhananjaya considered a heavy burden to be placed on the former.

data.v: तत्राधिरथिभीमाभ्यां शरैर्मुक्तैर्दृढाहताः । इषुपातमतिक्रम्य पेतुरश्वनरद्विपाः ॥
data.md: As Karna and Bhima, desirous of baffling each other shot numerous arrows, many elephants, horses and men, wounded therewith, fell down dead;

data.v: पतद्भिः पतितैश्चान्यैर्गतासुभिरनेकशः । कृतो महान्महाराज पुत्राणां ते जनक्षयः ॥
data.md: And in consequence of those falling and fallen creatures, deprived of life and shouting by thousands, great was the damage that then spread in the ranks of your army.

data.v: मनुष्याश्वगजानां च शरीरैर्गतजीवितैः । क्षणेन भूमिः संजज्ञे संवृता भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: O foremost of the Bharatas, the field became soon covered over with the corpses and carcarsses of slain men, horses and elephants.

data.v: अत्यद्भुतमहं मन्ये भीमसेनस्य विक्रमम् । यत्कर्णं योधयामास समरे लघुविक्रमम् ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said Indeed I consider Bhima's prowess to be very wonderful, inasmuch as he fought with Karna of great agility.

data.v: त्रिदशानपि चोद्युक्तान्सर्वशस्त्रधरान्युधि । वारयेद्यो रणे कर्णः सयक्षासुरमानवान् ॥
data.md: Indeed that Karna who is competent enough of resisting the celestials together with the Yakshas, Asuras and men all armed with numerous kinds of weapon.

data.v: स कथं पाण्डवं युद्धे भ्राजमानमिव श्रिया । नातरत्संयुगे तात तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥
data.md: How is it that Karna could not vanquish in battle that son of Pritha, of great effulgence? O Sanjaya tell me all you know about it in detail.

data.v: कथं च युद्धं भूयोऽभूत्तयोः प्राणदुरोदरे । अत्र मन्ये समायत्तो जयो वाजय एव वा ॥
data.md: Tell me how the battle them raged-battle in which each staked his very life. Messems each of them was capable of conquering or each mighty have suffered defeat, (at the hand of the other).

data.v: कर्णं प्राप्य रणे सूत मम पुत्रः सुयोधनः । जेतुमुत्सहते पार्थान्सगोविन्दान्ससात्वतान् ॥
data.md: Obtaining Suta's son Karna to help him, my son Duryodhana is confident of securing victory over the Pandavas with Govinda and the Satwatas.

data.v: श्रुत्वा तु निर्जितं कर्णमसकृद्भीमकर्मणा । भीमसेनेन समरे मोह आविशतीव माम् ॥
data.md: However, hearing of the repeated defeats of Karna by Bhimasena of dreadful deeds, a swoon seems to overtake me. pervert son

data.v: विनष्टान्कौरवान्मन्ये मम पुत्रस्य दुर्नयैः । न हि कर्णो महेष्वासान्पार्थाञ्जेष्यति संजय ॥
data.md: I regard the Kauravas as already slain, in consequence of the evil policy of my son. O Sanjaya, Karna will never be able to vanquish the sons of Pritha, those illustrious bowmen.

data.v: कृतवान्यानि युद्धानि कर्णः पाण्डुसुतैः सह । सर्वत्र पाण्डवाः कर्णमजयन्त रणाजिरे ॥
data.md: In all the battles that Karna has fought with the sons of Pandu, the latter have worsted him on the field of battle.

data.v: अजय्याः पाण्डवास्तात देवैरपि सवासवैः । न च तद्बुध्यते मन्दः पुत्रो दुर्योधनो मम ॥
data.md: The Pandavas are incapable of being vanquished even by the celestials led by Vasava himself. But my Duryodhana will not take cognisance of this fact.

data.v: धनं धनेश्वरस्येव हृत्वा पार्थस्य मे सुतः । मधुप्रेप्सुरिवाबुद्धिः प्रपातं नावबुध्यते ॥
data.md: Having robbed Yudhishthira the son of Pritha's who is like the Lord of wealth, of his wealth, my foolish son sees not the impending fall, like a searcher of honey (on the mountains).

data.v: निकृत्या निकृतिप्रज्ञो राज्यं हृत्वा महात्मनाम् । जितानित्येव मन्वानः पाण्डवानवमन्यते ॥
data.md: Having robbed by means of his deceit, the kingdom of those high-souled ones, my son conversant with deceit, thinks it to be irrecoverably his own; and so always insults the Pandavas.

data.v: पुत्रस्नेहाभिभूतेन मया चाप्यकृतात्मना । धर्मे स्थिता महात्मानो निकृताः पाण्डुनन्दनाः ॥
data.md: Those high-souled son of Pandu, who ever treaded the paths of rectitude, were also insulted by myself who am over-fondly attached to my sons and am of selfish temperament.

data.v: शमकामः सदा पार्थो दीर्घप्रेक्षी युधिष्ठिरः । अशक्त इति मन्वानैः पुत्रैर्मम निराकृतः ॥
data.md: The foresighted Yudhishthira that son of Pritha, was ever desirous of peace. But my sons turned him out, taking him to be incapable (of launching on war).

data.v: तानि दुःखान्यनेकानि विप्रकारांश्च सर्वशः । हृदि कृत्वा महाबाहुर्भीमोऽयुध्यत सूतजम् ॥
data.md: Bearing in mind all those hardships and all other insults offered to the Pandavas, the mighty-armed Bhima fought with Suta's son.

data.v: तस्मान्मे संजय ब्रूहि कर्णभीमौ यथा रणे । अयुध्येतां युधि श्रेष्ठौ परस्परवधैषिणौ ॥
data.md: O Sanjaya, relate to me, how Bhima and Karna, those two foremost of warriors fought with each other, desirous of taking each other's life.

data.v: शृणु राजन्यथा वृत्तः संग्रामः कर्णभीमयोः । परस्परवधप्रेप्स्वोर्वने कुञ्जरयोरिव ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Hear, O king, how the battle between Karna and Bhima raged like that between two elephants desirous of slaughtering each other in the forest.

data.v: राजन्वैकर्तनो भीमं क्रुद्धः क्रुद्धमरिंदमम् । पराक्रान्तं पराक्रम्य विव्याध त्रिंशता शरैः ॥
data.md: O king, the enraged son of Vikartana then pierced with thirty arrows that chastiser of foes viz., Bhimasena who excited with rage, had been putting forth his prowess.

data.v: महावेगैः प्रसन्नाग्रैः शातकुम्भपरिष्कृतैः । आहनद्भरतश्रेष्ठ भीमं वैकर्तनः शरैः ॥
data.md: O foremost of the Bharatas, Vikartana's son then wounded Bhima with many shafts of keen points and great impetuosity and decked with gold.

data.v: तस्यास्यतो धनुर्भीमश्चकर्त निशितैस्त्रिभिः । रथनीडाच्च यन्तारं भल्लेनापातयत्क्षितौ ॥
data.md: But when Karna was engaged in wounding him, Bhima cut-off his bow with three sharp shafts and then with a Bhalla felled his charioteer from the niche on the car.

data.v: स काङ्क्षन्भीमसेनस्य वधं वैकर्तनो वृषः । शक्तिं कनकवैडूर्यचित्रदण्डां परामृशत् ॥
data.md: Thereupon Vikartana's son longing to compass the slaughter of Bhimasena, took a lance with a staff variegated with gold and lapises.

data.v: प्रगृह्य च महाशक्तिं कालशक्तिमिवापराम् । समुत्क्षिप्य च राधेयः संधाय च महाबलः । चिक्षेप भीमसेनाय जीवितान्तकरीमिव ॥
data.md: Taking up that fierce lance that resembled a second dart of Death and tilting it and aiming it, the powerful son of Radha.

data.v: शक्तिं विसृज्य राधेयः पुरंदर इवाशनिम् । ननाद सुमहानादं बलवान्सूतनन्दनः । तं च नादं ततः श्रुत्वा पुत्रास्ते हृषिताभवन् ॥
data.md: That puissant descendant of a charioteer's race, uttered a loud roar; and then your sons hearing that loud shout uttered by Karna, became filled with delight.

data.v: तां कर्णभुजनिर्मुक्तामर्कवैश्वानरप्रभाम् । शक्तिं वियति चिच्छेद भीमः सप्तभिराशुगैः ॥
data.md: But as that lance of the radiance of fire or the sun was coursing through the skies, Bhima cut it off with seven swift-arrows.

data.v: छित्त्वा शक्तिं ततो भीमो निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभाम् । मार्गमाण इव प्राणान्सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष ॥
data.md: Cutting off that lance resembling a snake just freed from its slough, Bhima, O sire, as if looking out for the opportunity of wrenching the life-breaths out of Suta's son.

data.v: प्राहिणोन्नव संरब्धः शरान्बर्हिणवाससः । स्वर्णपुङ्खाञ्शिलाधौतान्यमदण्डोपमान्मृधे ॥
data.md: Wrathfully pierced the latter with many arrows furnished with wings of peacock's feathers or of gold and whetted on stone and resembling darts of Death.

data.v: कर्णोऽप्यन्यद्धनुर्गृह्य हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम् । विकृष्य च महातेजा व्यसृजत्सायकान्नव ॥
data.md: Karna also then taking up another terrible bow of golden staff, began to stretch it; and then that highly energetic one began to discharge arrows at Bhima.

data.v: तान्पाण्डुपुत्रश्चिच्छेद नवभिर्नतपर्वभिः । वसुषेणेन निर्मुक्तान्नव राजन्महाशरान् । छित्त्वा भीमो महाराज नादं सिंह इवानदत् ॥
data.md: But the son of Pandu cut-off those shafts, with nine shafts of depressed knots shot by himself. Having cut-off, O foremost of men, those arrows shot by Karna.

data.v: तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ बलिनौ वाशितान्तरे । शार्दूलाविव चान्योन्यमत्यर्थं च ह्यगर्जताम् ॥
अन्योन्यं प्रजिहीर्षन्तावन्योन्यस्यान्तरैषिणौ । अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तौ गोष्ठेष्विव महर्षभौ ॥
महागजाविवासाद्य विषाणाग्रैः परस्परम् । शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥
data.md: Then like two huge elephants goring each other with the ends of their tusks, those two heroes began to pierce each other with arrows shot from bows drawn to the fullest stretch.

data.v: निर्दहन्तौ महाराज शरवृष्ट्या परस्परम् । अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तौ कोपाद्विवृतलोचनौ ॥
प्रहसन्तौ तथान्योन्यं भर्त्सयन्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः । शङ्खशब्दं च कुर्वाणौ युयुधाते परस्परम् ॥
तस्य भीमः पुनश्चापं मुष्टौ चिच्छेद मारिष । शङ्खवर्णांश्च तानश्वान्बाणैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥
तथा कृच्छ्रगतं दृष्ट्वा कर्णं दुर्योधनो नृपः । वेपमान इव क्रोधाद्व्यादिदेशाथ दुर्जयम् ॥
गच्छ दुर्जय राधेयं पुरा ग्रसति पाण्डवः । जहि तूबरकं क्षिप्रं कर्णस्य बलमादधत् ॥
एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा तव पुत्रस्तवात्मजम् । अभ्यद्रवद्भीमसेनं व्यासक्तं विकिरञ्शरान् ॥
स भीमं नवभिर्बाणैरश्वानष्टभिरर्दयत् । षड्भिः सूतं त्रिभिः केतुं पुनस्तं चापि सप्तभिः ॥
भीमसेनोऽपि संक्रुद्धः साश्वयन्तारमाशुगैः । दुर्जयं भिन्नमर्माणमनयद्यमसादनम् ॥
स्वलंकृतं क्षितौ क्षुण्णं चेष्टमानं यथोरगम् । रुदन्नार्तस्तव सुतं कर्णश्चक्रे प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
स तु तं विरथं कृत्वा स्मयन्नत्यन्तवैरिणम् । समाचिनोद्बाणगणैः शतघ्नीमिव शङ्कुभिः ॥
तथाप्यतिरथः कर्णो भिद्यमानः स्म सायकैः । न जहौ समरे भीमं क्रुद्धरूपं परंतपः ॥
data.md: Although thus mangled with those arrows, that slayer of foes, the Atiratha Karna, did not avoid the enraged Bhima in battle.

data.v: स तथा विरथः कर्णः पुनर्भीमेन निर्जितः । रथमन्यं समास्थाय सद्यो विव्याध पाण्डवम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said. Thus though deprived of his car and completely vanquished by Bhima, Karna mounting on another car began speedily to pierce the son of Pandu.

data.v: महागजाविवासाद्य विषाणाग्रैः परस्परम् । शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥
data.md: Then like two huge elephants goring each other with the ends of their tusks, those two heroes began to pierce each other with arrows shot from bows drawn to the fullest stretch.

data.v: अथ कर्णः शरव्रातैर्भीमं बलवदर्दयत् । ननाद बलवन्नादं पुनर्विव्याध चोरसि ॥
data.md: Thereupon Karna covered Bhima with mriyads of shafts and then uttered a loud warcry and once more pierced the latter on his breast.

data.v: तं भीमो दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यदजिह्मगैः । पुनर्विव्याध विंशत्या शराणां नतपर्वणाम् ॥
data.md: In return, Bhima pierced him with ten straight-flying arrows and next with twenty arrows of depressed knots.

data.v: कर्णस्तु नवभिर्भीमं विद्ध्वा राजन्स्तनान्तरे । ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध सायकेन शितेन ह ॥
data.md: Karna again, O king, piercing Bhima on the centre of his chest with nine arrows, struck his enemy's standard with one sharp arrow.

data.v: सायकानां ततः पार्थस्त्रिषष्ट्या प्रत्यविध्यत । तोत्त्रैरिव महानागं कशाभिरिव वाजिनम् ॥
data.md: Then with a group of sixty-three arrows Pritha's son, pierced Karna in return like a driver goring his elephant with so many hooks or a horseman lacerating his animal with so many whips.

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज पाण्डवेन यशस्विना । सृक्विणी लेलिहन्वीरः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ॥
data.md: Thus deeply pierced, O king, by the highsouled son of Pandu, the heroic Karna began to lick the corners of his mouth and his eyes became red in rage.

data.v: ततः शरं महाराज सर्वकायावदारणम् । प्राहिणोद्भीमसेनाय बलायेन्द्र इवाशनिम् ॥
data.md: Therefore, O mighty monarch with a view to bring about the slaughter of Bhima, Karna sped at him an arrow capable of penetrating through all bodies, like Indra hurling the thunder.

data.v: स निर्भिद्य रणे पार्थं सूतपुत्रधनुश्च्युतः । अगच्छद्दारयन्भूमिं चित्रपुङ्खः शिलीमुखः ॥
data.md: That shaft or variegated wing shot from the bow of Suta's son pierced through the son of Pritha and then penetrating the earth went inside it.

data.v: सर्वशैक्यां चतुष्किष्कुं गुर्वीं रुक्माङ्गदां गदाम् । प्राहिणोत्सूतपुत्राय षडस्रामविचारयन् ॥
तया जघानाधिरथेः सदश्वान्साधुवाहिनः । गदया भारतः क्रुद्धो वज्रेणेन्द्र इवासुरान् ॥
ततो भीमो महाबाहुः क्षुराभ्यां भरतर्षभ । ध्वजमाधिरथेश्छित्त्वा सूतमभ्यहनत्तदा ॥
हताश्वसूतमुत्सृज्य रथं स पतितध्वजम् । विस्फारयन्धनुः कर्णस्तस्थौ भारत दुर्मनाः ॥
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम राधेयस्य पराक्रमम् । विरथो रथिनां श्रेष्ठो वारयामास यद्रिपुम् ॥
विरथं तं रथश्रेष्ठं दृष्ट्वाधिरथिमाहवे । दुर्योधनस्ततो राजन्नभ्यभाषत दुर्मुखम् ॥
एष दुर्मुख राधेयो भीमेन विरथीकृतः । तं रथेन नरश्रेष्ठं संपादय महारथम् ॥
दुर्योधनवचः श्रुत्वा ततो भारत दुर्मुखः । त्वरमाणोऽभ्ययात्कर्णं भीमं चावारयच्छरैः ॥
दुर्मुखं प्रेक्ष्य संग्रामे सूतपुत्रपदानुगम् । वायुपुत्रः प्रहृष्टोऽभूत्सृक्किणी परिलेलिहन् ॥
ततः कर्णं महाराज वारयित्वा शिलीमुखैः । दुर्मुखाय रथं शीघ्रं प्रेषयामास पाण्डवः ॥
तस्मिन्क्षणे महाराज नवभिर्नतपर्वभिः । सुपुङ्खैर्दुर्मुखं भीमः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥
ततस्तमेवाधिरथिः स्यन्दनं दुर्मुखे हते । आस्थितः प्रबभौ राजन्दीप्यमान इवांशुमान् ॥
शयानं भिन्नमर्माणं दुर्मुखं शोणितोक्षितम् । दृष्ट्वा कर्णोऽश्रुपूर्णाक्षो मुहूर्तं नाभ्यवर्तत ॥
तं गतासुमतिक्रम्य कृत्वा कर्णः प्रदक्षिणम् । दीर्घमुष्णं श्वसन्वीरो न किंचित्प्रत्यपद्यत ॥
तस्मिंस्तु विवरे राजन्नाराचान्गार्ध्रवाससः । प्राहिणोत्सूतपुत्राय भीमसेनश्चतुर्दश ॥
data.md: The heroic Karna breathed hot and heavily and was embarrassed as to what he should do. At this opportunity O king, Bhimasena struck Suta's son with fourteen Narachas furnished with vulterine feathers. Those Narachas of great impetuosity and furnished with golden wings, pierced through Karna's armour;

data.v: ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा स्वर्णपुङ्खा महौजसः । हेमचित्रा महाराज द्योतयन्तो दिशो दश ॥
अपिबन्सूतपुत्रस्य शोणितं रक्तभोजनाः । क्रुद्धा इव मनुष्येन्द्र भुजगाः कालचोदिताः ॥
प्रसर्पमाणा मेदिन्यां ते व्यरोचन्त मार्गणाः । अर्धप्रविष्टाः संरब्धा बिलानीव महोरगाः ॥
तं प्रत्यविध्यद्राधेयो जाम्बूनदविभूषितैः । चतुर्दशभिरत्युग्रैर्नाराचैरविचारयन् ॥
data.md: With only half their bodies inserted into their holes. Then the son of Radha, without a moment's reflection, pierced Bhimasena in return with fourteen fierce Narachas decked with gold. Those winged shafts piercing the left arm of Bhimasena.

data.v: ते भीमसेनस्य भुजं सव्यं निर्भिद्य पत्रिणः । प्राविशन्मेदिनीं भीमाः क्रौञ्चं पत्ररथा इव ॥
ते व्यरोचन्त नाराचाः प्रविशन्तो वसुंधराम् । गच्छत्यस्तं दिनकरे दीप्यमाना इवांशवः ॥
स निर्भिन्नो रणे भीमो नाराचैर्मर्मभेदिभिः । सुस्राव रुधिरं भूरि पर्वतः सलिलं यथा ॥
स भीमस्त्रिभिरायस्तः सूतपुत्रं पतत्रिभिः । सुपर्णवेगैर्विव्याध सारथिं चास्य सप्तभिः ॥
स विह्वलो महाराज कर्णो भीमबलार्दितः । प्राद्रवज्जवनैरश्वै रणं हित्वा महायशाः ॥
भीमसेनस्तु विस्फार्य चापं हेमपरिष्कृतम् । आहवेऽतिरथोऽतिष्ठज्ज्वलन्निव हुताशनः ॥
data.md: Of illustrious renown fled from the field of battle, being borne away by his fleet steeds. Then Bhimasena, that Atiratha remained the master of the field, with his bow of golden staff stretched and looking like a burning fire.

data.v: दैवमेव परं मन्ये धिक्पौरुषमनर्थकम् । यत्राधिरथिरायस्तो नातरत्पाण्डवं रणे ॥
data.md: Dhritarastra said I consider Destiny to be supreme. Fie on the useless exertions of man, inasmuch the son of Adhiratha striving vigorously, was not able to conquer Pandus's son in battle.

data.v: कर्णः पार्थान्सगोविन्दाञ्जेतुमुत्सहते रणे । न च कर्णसमं योधं लोके पश्यामि कंचन । इति दुर्योधनस्याहमश्रौषं जल्पतो मुहुः ॥
data.md: Karna is capable of conquering the Parthas together with Govinds himself; no where in the worlds do I find a warrior who is a match for Karna.

data.v: कर्णो हि बलवाञ्शूरो दृढधन्वा जितक्लमः । इति मामब्रवीत्सूत मन्दो दुर्योधनः पुरा ॥
वसुषेणसहायं मां नालं देवापि संयुगे । किमु पाण्डुसुता राजन्गतसत्त्वा विचेतसः ॥
तत्र तं निर्जितं दृष्ट्वा भुजंगमिव निर्विषम् । युद्धात्कर्णमपक्रान्तं किं स्विद्दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत् ॥
अहो दुर्मुखमेवैकं युद्धानामविशारदम् । प्रावेशयद्धुतवहं पतंगमिव मोहितः ॥
अश्वत्थामा मद्रराजः कृपः कर्णश्च संगताः । न शक्ताः प्रमुखे स्थातुं नूनं भीमस्य संजय ॥
तेऽपि चास्य महाघोरं बलं नागायुतोपमम् । जानन्तो व्यवसायं च क्रूरं मारुततेजसः ॥
किमर्थं क्रूरकर्माणं यमकालान्तकोपमम् । बलसंरम्भवीर्यज्ञाः कोपयिष्यन्ति संयुगे ॥
कर्णस्त्वेको महाबाहुः स्वबाहुबलमाश्रितः । भीमसेनमनादृत्य रणेऽयुध्यत सूतजः ॥
योऽजयत्समरे कर्णं पुरंदर इवासुरम् । न स पाण्डुसुतो जेतुं शक्यः केनचिदाहवे ॥
द्रोणं यः संप्रमथ्यैकः प्रविष्टो मम वाहिनीम् । भीमो धनंजयान्वेषी कस्तमर्छेज्जिजीविषुः ॥
को हि संजय भीमस्य स्थातुमुत्सहतेऽग्रतः । उद्यताशनिवज्रस्य महेन्द्रस्येव दानवः ॥
प्रेतराजपुरं प्राप्य निवर्तेतापि मानवः । न भीमसेनं संप्राप्य निवर्तेत कदाचन ॥
पतंगा इव वह्निं ते प्राविशन्नल्पचेतसः । ये भीमसेनं संक्रुद्धमभ्यधावन्विमोहिताः ॥
यत्तत्सभायां भीमेन मम पुत्रवधाश्रयम् । शप्तं संरम्भिणोग्रेण कुरूणां शृण्वतां तदा ॥
तन्नूनमभिसंचिन्त्य दृष्ट्वा कर्णं च निर्जितम् । दुःशासनः सह भ्रात्रा भयाद्भीमादुपारमत् ॥
यश्च संजय दुर्बुद्धिरब्रवीत्समितौ मुहुः । कर्णो दुःशासनोऽहं च जेष्यामो युधि पाण्डवान् ॥
data.md: Dushasana and his brothers ceased to meet Bhima in battle out of fear. That pervert son of mine, O Sanjaya, who repeatedly said in the assembly these words-Karna and Dushasana and I myself will vanquish the Pandavas in battle-surely beholding Karna vanquished and deprived of his car by Bhima.

data.v: स नूनं विरथं दृष्ट्वा कर्णं भीमेन निर्जितम् । प्रत्याख्यानाच्च कृष्णस्य भृशं तप्यति संजय ॥
दृष्ट्वा भ्रातॄन्हतान्युद्धे भीमसेनेन दंशितान् । आत्मापराधात्सुमहन्नूनं तप्यति पुत्रकः ॥
को हि जीवितमन्विच्छन्प्रतीपं पाण्डवं व्रजेत् । भीमं भीमायुधं क्रुद्धं साक्षात्कालमिव स्थितम् ॥
वडवामुखमध्यस्थो मुच्येतापि हि मानवः । न भीममुखसंप्राप्तो मुच्येतेति मतिर्मम ॥
न पाण्डवा न पाञ्चाला न च केशवसात्यकी । जानन्ति युधि संरब्धा जीवितं परिरक्षितुम् ॥
यत्संशोचसि कौरव्य वर्तमाने जनक्षये । त्वमस्य जगतो मूलं विनाशस्य न संशयः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said O descendant of the Kuru dynasty, why are you now lamenting for the present carnage? Surely you are the root of this destruction of the worlds.

data.v: स्वयं वैरं महत्कृत्वा पुत्राणां वचने स्थितः । उच्यमानो न गृह्णीषे मर्त्यः पथ्यमिवौषधम् ॥
data.md: Accepting the counsels of your sons, it was you who provoked all those fierce hostilities. Though advised on the contrary, you did not pay any heed to those advices, like a dying man refusing to take proper medicines,

data.v: स्वयं पीत्वा महाराज कालकूटं सुदुर्जरम् । तस्येदानीं फलं कृत्स्नमवाप्नुहि नरोत्तम ॥
data.md: O best of men, Oking, having drunk the fiercest and most indigestible poison, you should now feel the consequences.

data.v: यत्तु कुत्सयसे योधान्युध्यमानान्यथाबलम् । अत्र ते वर्णयिष्यामि यथा युद्धमवर्तत ॥
data.md: The warriors of your army are fighting to the best of their prowess, yet you speak depreciatingly of them. Hear now, as I go on describing how this battle raged.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा कर्णं तु पुत्रास्ते भीमसेनपराजितम् । नामृष्यन्त महेष्वासाः सोदर्याः पञ्च मारिष ॥
data.md: Beholding Karna defeated by Bhimasena, the following five and mighty bowmen all brothers.

data.v: दुर्मर्षणो दुःसहश्च दुर्मदो दुर्धरो जयः । पाण्डवं चित्रसंनाहास्तं प्रतीपमुपाद्रवन् ॥
data.md: Namely, Durmarsena, Dussaha, Durmada, Durdhara and Jaya, all clad in beautiful armours, rushed against the son of Pandu with hostile intentions.

data.v: ते समन्तान्महाबाहुं परिवार्य वृकोदरम् । दिशः शरैः समावृण्वञ्शलभानामिव व्रजैः ॥
data.md: Surrounding the mighty-armed Vrikodara on all sides, they began to cover the quarters with their arrows resembling flights of locusts.

data.v: आगच्छतस्तान्सहसा कुमारान्देवरूपिणः । प्रतिजग्राह समरे भीमसेनो हसन्निव ॥
data.md: Then Bhimasena smilingly received those princes of godly presence as they advanced furiously against him.

data.v: तव दृष्ट्वा तु तनयान्भीमसेनसमीपगान् । अभ्यवर्तत राधेयो भीमसेनं महाबलम् ॥
data.md: Then beholding your sons before the enraged Bhimasena, Radha's son rushed against the mighty-armed Bhima.

data.v: विसृजन्विशिखान्राजन्स्वर्णपुङ्खाञ्शिलाशितान् । तं तु भीमोऽभ्ययात्तूर्णं वार्यमाणः सुतैस्तव ॥
data.md: Although opposed by your sons, yet Bhima then quickly rushed against Karna shooting sharp arrows, furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone.

data.v: कुरवस्तु ततः कर्णं परिवार्य समन्ततः । अवाकिरन्भीमसेनं शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥
data.md: Thereupon the Kurus surrounding Karna, on all sides, began to shower upon Bhimasena, numerous arrows of depressed knots.

data.v: तान्बाणैः पञ्चविंशत्या साश्वान्राजन्नरर्षभान् । ससूतान्भीमधनुषो भीमो निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥
data.md: Then that fierce bowman Bhima, with twenty-five arrows dispatched to the abode of Yama, those foremost of men, with their steeds and charioteers.

data.v: प्रापतन्स्यन्दनेभ्यस्ते सार्धं सूतैर्गतासवः । चित्रपुष्पधरा भग्ना वातेनेव महाद्रुमाः ॥
data.md: They then fell down dead from their cars, after their charioteers, like so many mighty trees decked with flowers, overthrown by a hurricane.

data.v: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम भीमसेनस्य विक्रमम् । संवार्याधिरथिं बाणैर्यज्जघान तवात्मजान् ॥
data.md: Then we beheld the wonderful prowess of Bhimasena, inasmuch as he succeeded in slaying your sons and withstanding Karna with his arrows simultaneously.

data.v: स वार्यमाणो भीमेन शितैर्बाणैः समन्ततः । सूतपुत्रो महाराज भीमसेनमवैक्षत ॥
data.md: Opposed on all sides by sharp arrows shot by Bhimasena, that son of Suta, O mighty : monarch, began to eye Bhima.

data.v: तं भीमसेनः संरम्भात्क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः । विस्फार्य सुमहच्चापं मुहुः कर्णमवैक्षत ॥
data.md: Bhimasena also, with his eyes red in anger and stretching his bow, began to look to Karna.

data.v: तवात्मजांस्तु पतितान्दृष्ट्वा कर्णः प्रतापवान् । क्रोधेन महताविष्टो निर्विण्णोऽभूत्स जीवितात् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Beholding your sons fallen on the field, the puissant Karna, overwhelmed with rage, became regardless of his very life.

data.v: आगस्कृतमिवात्मानं मेने चाधिरथिस्तदा । भीमसेनं ततः क्रुद्धः समाद्रवत संभ्रमात् ॥
स भीमं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा राधेयः प्रहसन्निव । पुनर्विव्याध सप्तत्या स्वर्णपुङ्खैः शिलाशितैः ॥
data.md: Thereupon the son of Radha smilingly piercing Bhima with five shafts, once more pierced him with seventy shafts furnished with golden wings whetted on stone.

data.v: अवहासं तु तं पार्थो नामृष्यत वृकोदरः । ततो विव्याध राधेयं शतेन नतपर्वणाम् ॥
पुनश्च विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः । धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष ॥
data.md: Once more, O sire, piercing him on his vital parts with five sharp arrows, Bhima severed the bow of Suta's son with a broad-headed shaft.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय कर्णो भारत दुर्मनाः । इषुभिश्छादयामास भीमसेनं समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Thereupon, O Bharata, highly dejected, Karna took up another bow and covered Bhima with arrows on all directions.

data.v: तस्य भीमो हयान्हत्वा विनिहत्य च सारथिम् । प्रजहास महाहासं कृते प्रतिकृतं पुनः ॥
data.md: Slaying Karna's horses and his charioteer also, Bhima then laughed a tremendous laugh, having thus counter-balanced the feats of the former.

data.v: इषुभिः कार्मुकं चास्य चकर्त पुरुषर्षभः । तत्पपात महाराज स्वर्णपृष्ठं महास्वनम् ॥
data.md: Then that foremost of men, cut-off the bow of Karna with his arrows; and O mighty monarch, that bow of golden staff, fell down, producing a great sound.

data.v: अवारोहद्रथात्तस्मादथ कर्णो महारथः । गदां गृहीत्वा समरे भीमसेनाय चाक्षिपत् ॥
data.md: Thereupon the mighty car-warrior Karna descended from his chariot and taking up a mace hurled it at Bhimasena with great fury.

data.v: तामापतन्तीं सहसा गदां दृष्ट्वा वृकोदरः । शरैरवारयद्राजन्सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.md: Beholding that mace towards himself with great impetuosity, Vrikodara repulsed it with his arrows before the eyes of all the troops.

data.v: ततो बाणसहस्राणि प्रेषयामास पाण्डवः । सूतपुत्रवधाकाङ्क्षी त्वरमाणः पराक्रमी ॥
data.md: Then the puissant son of Pandu quickly shot thousands of arrows, desirous of accomplishing the death of Suta's son.

data.v: तानिषूनिषुभिः कर्णो वारयित्वा महामृधे । कवचं भीमसेनस्य पातयामास सायकैः ॥
data.md: Checking those arrows with his own, in that battle, Karna cut down Bhima's arīnour with numerous arrows. course

data.v: अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समार्पयत् । पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
data.md: Then he pierced Bhima with twenty five small shafts before the eyes of all; and that seemed highly wonderful.

data.v: ततो भीमो महाराज नवभिर्नतपर्वणाम् । रणेऽप्रेषयत क्रुद्धः सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष ॥
data.md: Thereupon, O sire, Bhima excited to the highest pitch of fury, sped at the son of Suta nine shafts of depressed knots.

data.v: ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा तथा बाहुं च दक्षिणम् । अभ्यगुर्धरणीं तीक्ष्णा वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः ॥
data.md: Those sharp arrows penetrating through Karna's armour and piercing his right arm, sank into the earth, like so many fierce snakes entering their holes on ant hills.

data.v: राधेयं तु रणे दृष्ट्वा पदातिनमवस्थितम् । भीमसेनेन संरब्धं राजा दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत् । त्वरध्वं सर्वतो यत्ता राधेयस्य रथं प्रति ॥
ततस्तव सुता राजञ्श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्वचो द्रुतम् । अभ्ययुः पाण्डवं युद्धे विसृजन्तः शिताञ्शरान् ॥
चित्रोपचित्रश्चित्राक्षश्चारुचित्रः शरासनः । चित्रायुधश्चित्रवर्मा समरे चित्रयोधिनः ॥
आगच्छतस्तान्सहसा भीमो राजन्महारथः । साश्वसूतध्वजान्यत्तान्पातयामास संयुगे । ते हता न्यपतन्भूमौ वातनुन्ना इव द्रुमाः ॥
दृष्ट्वा विनिहतान्पुत्रांस्तव राजन्महारथान् । अश्रुपूर्णमुखः कर्णः कश्मलं समपद्यत ॥
data.md: Beholding your sons all mighty carwarriors slain, o king, Karna with a tearful countenance, began to think of those words of Khatva.

data.v: रथमन्यं समास्थाय विधिवत्कल्पितं पुनः । अभ्ययात्पाण्डवं युद्धे त्वरमाणः पराक्रमी ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Riding on another duly furnished car, Karna then rushed at Pandu's son, like the ocean lashed into fury by the tempest.

data.v: तावन्योन्यं शरैर्विद्ध्वा स्वर्णपुङ्खैः शिलाशितैः । व्यभ्राजेतां महाराज पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ॥
data.md: Piercing each other with arrows furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone, those two heroes appeared beautiful like two clouds fringed with the rays of the sun.

data.v: षट्त्रिंशद्भिस्ततो भल्लैर्निशितैस्तिग्मतेजनैः । व्यधमत्कवचं क्रुद्धः सूतपुत्रस्य पाण्डवः ॥
data.md: Then Pandu's son, excited with rage cut-off the armour of Suta's son with thirty-six Vallas of great sharpness and energy.

data.v: रक्तचन्दनदिग्धाङ्गौ शरैः कृतमहाव्रणौ । शोणिताक्तौ व्यराजेतां कालसूर्याविवोदितौ ॥
data.md: Those two combatants then, smeared with red sandal-paste, covered with many wounds caused by each other's shaft and steeped in blood, appeared charming like the sun or the moon in full splendour.

data.v: तौ शोणितोक्षितैर्गात्रैः शरैश्छिन्नतनुच्छदौ । विवर्माणौ व्यराजेतां निर्मुक्ताविव पन्नगौ ॥
data.md: Then Karna and Bhima, with their bodies steeped in blood and armour shattered with arrows appeared beautiful like snakes freed from their sloughs.

स छिन्नधन्वा विरथः स्वधर्ममनुपालयन् । स्वरथं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा युद्धायैव व्यवस्थितः ॥
तद्विहत्यास्य राधेयस्तत एनं समभ्ययात् । संरब्धः पाण्डवं संख्ये युद्धाय समुपस्थितम् ॥
तौ समेतौ महारङ्गे स्पर्धमानौ महाबलौ । जीमूताविव घर्मान्ते गर्जमानौ नभस्तले ॥
तयोरासीत्संप्रहारः क्रुद्धयोर्नरसिंहयोः । अमृष्यमाणयोः संख्ये देवदानवयोरिव ॥

data.md: Then deprived as he was of his weapons, beholding the huge mountain-like elephant slain by Arjuna lying on the field, he entered into their midst for impeding the progress of the car of Karna.

data.md: Over and over again, Beardless eunuch, ignorant fool, glutton, without any skill in the use of weapons, do you never again venture to fight (with any one)? You are but a boy, a laggard in battle!

data.md: O son of Pandu where there are various kinds of food and drink and edibles, that is really the place fit for you and not the field of battle, O wicked-souled one!

data.md: Becoming a hermit, O Bhima, do you began eating fruits, O wicked-minded wretch. O son of Kunti, betake to the forest, for you are incapable of fighting.

data.md: Devouring esculent roots, fruits fruits and flowers, it is proper that you should engage yourself in the observance of vows and rites, in the woods. O Bhima, you know not how to fight!

data.md: Vast is the difference, O Vrikodara, between fighting and the occupation of a hermit. So, do you repair to the forest O master; you are not capable of fighting and have an inclination for dwelling in the wood.

data.md: Followed his brother Savyasachin the son of Pandu in battle. Then Dhananjaya with his eyes red in rage and with great celerity sped at Karna a Naracha like the Destroyer urging death forward. Then like. Garuda ranging through the welkin in quest of a mighty snake.

data.md: Furnished with wings made of the feathers of the peacock and the Kanka, Arjuna began to agitate that army of yours. O foremost of the Bharatas, Partha, the son of Pakasasani (Indra) then began to carnage that host of yours, consisting of horses elephants and men.

data.v: अहन्यहनि मे दीप्तं यशः पतति संजय । हता मे बहवो योधा मन्ये कालस्य पर्ययम् ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said Day by day, O Sanjaya, by blazing fame is dwindling away. Numerous warriors of my side are being slain. I consider all this to be due to the adverse influence of Fate.

data.md: Inflamed with wrath, Dhananjaya has entered into my host which is protected by Drona's son and Karna and which is therefore incapable of being penetrated into by the very celestials.

data.md: He that had single-handed and unsupported entered into and agitated my army, even as an infuriate elephant enters and crushes a group of lotuses.

data.v: अद्य संयमनीं याता मया त्वं निहतो रणे । यथा रामानुजेनाजौ रावणिर्लक्ष्मणेन वै ॥
data.md: Slain by me in battle, you shall today go to the domains of the Samyamni, like the son of Ravana slain by the younger brother of Rama (Lakshmana.)

data.v: अद्य कृष्णश्च पार्थश्च धर्मराजश्च माधव । हते त्वयि निरुत्साहा रणं त्यक्ष्यन्त्यसंशयम् ॥
data.md: Today Krishna, Partha and the virtuous king Yudhishthira, O Madhava, will abandon fighting and became despondent, consequence of your slaughter.

data.v: अद्य तेऽपचितिं कृत्वा शितैर्माधव सायकैः । तत्स्त्रियो नन्दयिष्यामि ये त्वया निहता रणे ॥
data.md: O Madhava, today, slaying you with my sharp arrows, I shall afford delight to the wives of those who have been slain by you. in

data.v: चक्षुर्विषयसंप्राप्तो न त्वं माधव मोक्ष्यसे । सिंहस्य विषयं प्राप्तो यथा क्षुद्रमृगस्तथा ॥
data.md: Just as a small deer coming within the range of a lion's sight cannot escape, SO O descendant of Madhu's race, you shall not escape me alive, having come within the range of my sight."

data.v: युयुधानस्तु तं राजन्प्रत्युवाच हसन्निव । कौरवेय न संत्रासो विद्यते मम संयुगे ॥
data.md: Thereupon, O king, Yuyudhana smilingly replied to him saying,"O illustrious descendant of the Kuru race, I have no fear in fight.

data.v: स मां निहन्यात्संग्रामे यो मां कुर्यान्निरायुधम् । समास्तु शाश्वतीर्हन्याद्यो मां हन्याद्धि संयुगे ॥
किं मृषोक्तेन बहुना कर्मणा तु समाचर । शारदस्येव मेघस्य गर्जितं निष्फलं हि ते ॥
श्रुत्वैतद्गर्जितं वीर हास्यं हि मम जायते । चिरकालेप्सितं लोके युद्धमद्यास्तु कौरव ॥
त्वरते मे मतिस्तात त्वयि युद्धाभिकाङ्क्षिणि । नाहत्वा संनिवर्तिष्ये त्वामद्य पुरुषाधम ॥
अन्योन्यं तौ तदा वाग्भिस्तक्षन्तौ नरपुंगवौ । जिघांसू परमक्रुद्धावभिजघ्नतुराहवे ॥
समेतौ तौ नरव्याघ्रौ शुष्मिणौ स्पर्धिनौ रणे । द्विरदाविव संक्रुद्धौ वाशितार्थे मदोत्कटौ ॥
भूरिश्रवाः सात्यकिश्च ववर्षतुररिंदमौ । शरवर्षाणि भीमानि मेघाविव परस्परम् ॥
सौमदत्तिस्तु शैनेयं प्रच्छाद्येषुभिराशुगैः । जिघांसुर्भरतश्रेष्ठ विव्याध निशितैः शरैः ॥
दशभिः सात्यकिं विद्ध्वा सौमदत्तिरथापरान् । मुमोच निशितान्बाणाञ्जिघांसुः शिनिपुंगवम् ॥
तानस्य विशिखांस्तीक्ष्णानन्तरिक्षे विशां पते । अप्राप्तानस्त्रमायाभिरग्रसत्सात्यकिः प्रभो ॥
data.md: Out of a desire for slaying that illustrious scion of the Sini race, sped other sharp shafts at him. Then, O ruler of men, Satyaki with the illusion of his weapons devoured up all those up all those arrows, O lord, when they were ranging through the skies and before they had even reached him (Satyaki). Then those two heroes began to pour upon one another their showers of weapons.

data.v: तौ पृथक्शरवर्षाभ्यामवर्षेतां परस्परम् । उत्तमाभिजनौ वीरौ कुरुवृष्णियशस्करौ ॥
तौ नखैरिव शार्दूलौ दन्तैरिव महाद्विपौ । रथशक्तिभिरन्योन्यं विशिखैश्चाप्यकृन्तताम् ॥
निर्भिदन्तौ हि गात्राणि विक्षरन्तौ च शोणितम् । व्यष्टम्भयेतामन्योन्यं प्राणद्यूताभिदेविनौ ॥
एवमुत्तमकर्माणौ कुरुवृष्णियशस्करौ । परस्परमयुध्येतां वारणाविव यूथपौ ॥
तावदीर्घेण कालेन ब्रह्मलोकपुरस्कृतौ । जिगीषन्तौ परं स्थानमन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥
सात्यकिः सौमदत्तिश्च शरवृष्ट्या परस्परम् । हृष्टवद्धार्तराष्ट्राणां पश्यतामभ्यवर्षताम् ॥
संप्रैक्षन्त जनास्तत्र युध्यमानौ युधां पती । यूथपौ वाशिताहेतोः प्रयुद्धाविव कुञ्जरौ ॥
अन्योन्यस्य हयान्हत्वा धनुषी विनिकृत्य च । विरथावसियुद्धाय समेयातां महारणे ॥
आर्षभे चर्मणी चित्रे प्रगृह्य विपुले शुभे । विकोशौ चाप्यसी कृत्वा समरे तौ विचेरतुः ॥
चरन्तौ विविधान्मार्गान्मण्डलानि च भागशः । मुहुराजघ्नतुः क्रुद्धावन्योन्यमरिमर्दनौ ॥
सखड्गौ चित्रवर्माणौ सनिष्काङ्गदभूषणौ । रणे रणोत्कटौ राजन्नन्योन्यं पर्यकर्षताम् ॥
मुहूर्तमिव राजेन्द्र परिकृष्य परस्परम् । पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां वीरावाश्वसतां पुनः ॥
data.md: Then, O foremost of men, striking each other, they took respite only for a moment before the presence of all the troop.

data.v: असिभ्यां चर्मणी शुभ्रे विपुले च शरावरे । निकृत्य पुरुषव्याघ्रौ बाहुयुद्धं प्रचक्रतुः ॥
data.md: Having, with their respective swords cut-off the variegated buckler of each other decked with hundred moons, those foremost of men engaged in a wrestling encounter, O ruler of men.

data.v: व्यूढोरस्कौ दीर्घभुजौ नियुद्धकुशलावुभौ । बाहुभिः समसज्जेतामायसैः परिघैरिव ॥
data.md: Possessed of expanded chests, long arms and both versed in wrestling, they fought on with each other with their arms that resembling iron-piked bludgeons.

data.v: तयोरासन्भुजाघाता निग्रहप्रग्रहौ तथा । शिक्षाबलसमुद्भूताः सर्वयोधप्रहर्षणाः ॥
data.md: They struck and seized each other with their arms and each seized the others neck with his arms. The skill that hey had acquired by practice, afforded great delight to other warriors who then were turned into mere spectators.

data.v: तयोर्नृवरयो राजन्समरे युध्यमानयोः । भीमोऽभवन्महाशब्दो वज्रपर्वतयोरिव ॥
data.md: The, O king, as those two foremost of men fought on with each other, the sound that then arose, was the like that caused by the striking of thunder against a mountain.

data.v: द्विपाविव विषाणाग्रैः शृङ्गैरिव महर्षभौ । युयुधाते महात्मानौ कुरुसात्वतपुंगवौ ॥
क्षीणायुधे सात्वते युध्यमाने; ततोऽब्रवीदर्जुनं वासुदेवः । पश्यस्वैनं विरथं युध्यमानं; रणे केतुं सर्वधनुर्धराणाम् ॥
data.md: When during that encounter, the lock of Satwata's weapons was exhausted, Vasudeva's son addressing Arjuna said-" Behold this carless hero, viz., Satyaki, this foremost of all wielder of bow, engaged in fight.

data.v: प्रविष्टो भारतीं सेनां तव पाण्डव पृष्ठतः । योधितश्च महावीर्यैः सर्वैर्भारत भारतैः ॥
data.md: O son of Pandu, he has followed you having penetrated into the Bharata host. O Bharata, he has fought with many mighty warriors of the Bharata host.

data.v: परिश्रान्तो युधां श्रेष्ठः संप्राप्तो भूरिदक्षिणम् । युद्धकाङ्क्षिणमायान्तं नैतत्सममिवार्जुन ॥
data.md: Bhurisravas who has made great sacrificial presents, rushing upon that foremost of warriors viz., Satyaki exhausted with fatigue, has no encountered him. This is indeed very unfair."

data.v: ततो भूरिश्रवाः क्रुद्धः सात्यकिं युद्धदुर्मदम् । उद्यम्य न्यहनद्राजन्मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम् ॥
data.md: Then the indomitable Bhurisravas inflamed with rage, uplifting his sword struck Satyaki like a mad elephant striking another in the same state.

data.v: रथस्थयोर्द्वयोर्युद्धे क्रुद्धयोर्योधमुख्ययोः । केशवार्जुनयो राजन्समरे प्रेक्षमाणयोः ॥
data.md: Those two foremost of car-warriors, both riding in their cars and both rushing with rage fought on with each other, Arjuna and Krishna being their witness.

data.v: अथ कृष्णो महाबाहुरर्जुनं प्रत्यभाषत । पश्य वृष्ण्यन्धकव्याघ्रं सौमदत्तिवशं गतम् ॥
data.md: Thereupon the mighty-armed Krishna addressing Arjuna, said. “Behold the foremost of the Vrishni and Andhaka races, viz., Satyaki succumb to the son of Somadatta.

data.v: परिश्रान्तं गतं भूमौ कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् । तवान्तेवासिनं शूरं पालयार्जुन सात्यकिम् ॥
data.md: Having achieved many difficult feats he now laid low on the field in consequence of his great exhaustion. O Arjuna protect the heroic Satyaki, your (renowned) pupil.

data.v: न वशं यज्ञशीलस्य गच्छेदेष वरारिहन् । त्वत्कृते पुरुषव्याघ्र तदाशु क्रियतां विभो ॥
data.md: O foremost of men, O Arjuna, do you soon take that measure by which Satyaki many not succumb to Bhurisravas the performer of numerous sacrifices, O lord.”

data.v: अथाब्रवीद्धृष्टमना वासुदेवं धनंजयः । पश्य वृष्णिप्रवीरेण क्रीडन्तं कुरुपुंगवम् । महाद्विपेनेव वने मत्तेन हरियूथपम् ॥
data.md: Then Dhananjaya, with cheerful heart addressing Vasudeva's son said-"Behold that foremost among the Kurus and that best hero among the Vrishni's, sport with each other.

data.v: हाहाकारो महानासीत्सैन्यानां भरतर्षभ । यदुद्यम्य महाबाहुः सात्यकिं न्यहनद्भुवि ॥
data.md: Loud cried of Oh and Alas arose among the troops, foremost of the Bharatas, as the mighty-armed (Bhurisravas) striking vigorously had brought Satyaki down on the earth.

data.v: स सिंह इव मातङ्गं विकर्षन्भूरिदक्षिणः । व्यरोचत कुरुश्रेष्ठः सात्वतप्रवरं युधि ॥
data.md: Then like a lion dragging an elephant, that foremost of the Kuru race, namely Bhurisravas, that destroyer of darkness, looked beautiful in that battle as he dragged that foremost one of the Satwatas.

data.v: अथ कोशाद्विनिष्कृष्य खड्गं भूरिश्रवा रणे । मूर्धजेषु निजग्राह पदा चोरस्यताडयत् ॥
data.md: Then drawing his sword out of the scabbard and holding Satyaki by the hair, Bhurisravas struck the former on the breast with his legs.

data.v: तथा तु परिकृष्यन्तं दृष्ट्वा सात्वतमाहवे । वासुदेवस्ततो राजन्भूयोऽर्जुनमभाषत ॥
data.md: Beholding the Satvata hero thus dragged by Bhurisravas, Vasudeva once more addressing Arjuna said-

data.v: पश्य वृष्ण्यन्धकव्याघ्रं सौमदत्तिवशं गतम् । तव शिष्यं महाबाहो धनुष्यनवरं त्वया ॥
data.md: Behold O mighty-armed one, that foremost hero among the Vrishnis and Andhakas, that disciple of yours who is not inferior to you in bowmanship, succumb to the son of Somadatta.

data.v: असत्यो विक्रमः पार्थ यत्र भूरिश्रवा रणे । विशेषयति वार्ष्णेयं सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम् ॥
data.md: Behold, O son of Partha, the weak Bhurisravas obtain advantage over the Vrishni hero Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled.

data.v: एवमुक्तो महाबाहुर्वासुदेवेन पाण्डवः । मनसा पूजयामास भूरिश्रवसमाहवे ॥
data.md: The mighty-armed son of Pandu thus spoken to by Vasudeva (Krishna), worshipped Bhurisravas in his minds.

data.v: विकर्षन्सात्वतश्रेष्ठं क्रीडमान इवाहवे । संहर्षयति मां भूयः कुरूणां कीर्तिवर्धनः ॥
data.md: (He then said to himself). 'Dragging this foremost of the Satvata race as if in sport, the enhancer of the glory of the (Bhurisravas) is filling me with delight.

data.v: प्रवरं वृष्णिवीराणां यन्न हन्याद्धि सात्यकिम् । महाद्विपमिवारण्ये मृगेन्द्र इव कर्षति ॥
data.md: Without slaying that foremost of the Vrishni heroes viz., Satyaki he is only dragging the former like the king of the beasts dragging a mighty elephant in the woods.'

data.v: एवं तु मनसा राजन्पार्थः संपूज्य कौरवम् । वासुदेवं महाबाहुरर्जुनः प्रत्यभाषत ॥
data.md: Having thus mentally applauded that foremost of the Kauravas, Pritha's son, O king, the mighty Arjuna thus replied to Vasudeva

data.v: सैन्धवासक्तदृष्टित्वान्नैनं पश्यामि माधव । एष त्वसुकरं कर्म यादवार्थे करोम्यहम् ॥
data.md: “O Madhava, my eyes being fixed on the ruler of the Sindhus, I cannot see Bhurisravas; but for the sake of that descendant of Yadu's, race, I shall perform a very difficult feat.”

data.v: इत्युक्त्वा वचनं कुर्वन्वासुदेवस्य पाण्डवः । सखड्गं यज्ञशीलस्य पत्रिणा बाहुमच्छिनत् ॥
स बाहुरपतद्भूमौ सखड्गः सशुभाङ्गदः । आदधज्जीवलोकस्य दुःखमुत्तममुत्तमः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then that arm with the sword in grasp and decked with beautiful Angadas, fell down on the earth, thereby inflicting great grief on the living creation.

data.v: प्रहरिष्यन्हृतो बाहुरदृश्येन किरीटिना । वेगेनाभ्यपतद्भूमौ पञ्चास्य इव पन्नगः ॥
data.md: In the act of striking, that arm was lopped off by the diadem-decked Arjuna, who himself remained invisible to Bhruisravas; thus cut-off, it fell down vehemently on the earth, like a five-hooded snake.

data.v: स मोघं कृतमात्मानं दृष्ट्वा पार्थेन कौरवः । उत्सृज्य सात्यकिं क्रोधाद्गर्हयामास पाण्डवम् ॥
data.md: Then that descendant of the Kuru race, beholding himself incapacitated by Pritha's son, began, out of rage, to reprove the son of Pandu, having abandoned Satyaki.

data.v: नृशंसं बत कौन्तेय कर्मेदं कृतवानसि । अपश्यतो विषक्तस्य यन्मे बाहुमचिच्छिदः ॥
data.md: Bhurisravas said Alas, O son of Kunti, you have committed a cruel and heartless deed, in as much as, not being engaged with me and covertly, you have cut-off my arm.

data.v: किं नु वक्ष्यसि राजानं धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् । किं कुर्वाणो मया संख्ये हतो भूरिश्रवा इति ॥
data.md: Shall you have not to say to king Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma-'Bhurisravas when engaged with another was slain by me in battle?"

data.v: इदमिन्द्रेण ते साक्षादुपदिष्टं महात्मना । अस्त्रं रुद्रेण वा पार्थ द्रोणेनाथ कृपेण वा ॥
data.md: Was it for this that you learnt the use of weapons from the illustrious Indra or Rudra or Drona or Kripa. O son of Pritha!

data.v: ननु नाम स्वधर्मज्ञस्त्वं लोकेऽभ्यधिकः परैः । अयुध्यमानस्य कथं रणे प्रहृतवानसि ॥
data.md: It is said that you are batter acquainted with the rules about the use of weapons then many others. Why then have you lopped off the arm of one who was not fighting with you?

data.v: न प्रमत्ताय भीताय विरथाय प्रयाचते । व्यसने वर्तमानाय प्रहरन्ति मनस्विनः ॥
data.md: The righteous never strike him who is careless or who is frightened or who is made carless or who implores mercy or who is involved in a calamity.

data.v: इदं तु नीचाचरितमसत्पुरुषसेवितम् । कथमाचरितं पार्थ त्वया कर्म सुदुष्करम् ॥
data.md: Why then, O son of Pritha, have you perpetrated this vile and difficult deed, that is only worthy of a mean fellow and is practised only by wicked people.

data.v: आर्येण सुकरं ह्याहुरार्यकर्म धनंजय । अनार्यकर्म त्वार्येण सुदुष्करतरं भुवि ॥
data.md: O Dhananjaya, respectable people look upon respectable deeds to be very easy of being accomplished. But a disrespectable deed is difficult of being perpetrated by a respectable person.

data.v: येषु येषु नरः पार्थ यत्र यत्र च वर्तते । आशु तच्छीलतामेति तदिदं त्वयि दृश्यते ॥
data.md: Men quickly imbibe the behaviours of those among whom they live, O Bharata, the truth of this proposition is verified in you.

data.v: कथं हि राजवंश्यस्त्वं कौरवेयो विशेषतः । क्षत्रधर्मादपक्रान्तः सुवृत्तश्चरितव्रतः ॥
data.md: Of royal extraction and specially descendant as you are of the Kuru race, how could you transgress the duties of the Kshatriya race, although you were well-behaved and observant of vows.

data.v: इदं तु यदतिक्षुद्रं वार्ष्णेयार्थे कृतं त्वया । वासुदेवमतं नूनं नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते ॥
data.md: This vile act that you have today perpetrated for the sake of the Vrishni hero, is surely the result of Vasudeva's instigations. And it cannut possibly be reconciled to your nature.

data.v: को हि नाम प्रमत्ताय परेण सह युध्यते । ईदृशं व्यसनं दद्याद्यो न कृष्णसखो भवेत् ॥
data.md: What man, except he that calls himself a friended of Krishna would inflict such an injury on another who is engaged deeply in fighting with his adversary?

data.v: व्रात्याः संश्लिष्टकर्माणः प्रकृत्यैव विगर्हिताः । वृष्ण्यन्धकाः कथं पार्थ प्रमाणं भवता कृताः ॥
data.md: The Vrishnis and the Andhakas are vile Kshatriyas, ever engaged in perpetrating low deeds and are by nature wedded to shameful conduct. Why, O Partha, have you chosen them to be your model?” Being thus spoken to Partha then replied to Bhurisravas sayingएवमुक्तो रणे पार्थो भूरिश्रवसमब्रवीत्।

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्यूपकेतुर्महायशाः । युयुधानं परित्यज्य रणे प्रायमुपाविशत् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to (by Arjuna), the illustrious and mighty-armed Bhurisravas bearing the device of a sacrificial stake on his banner, let Yuyudhana go and desired to enter upon the performance of Praya-Yoga.

data.v: शरानास्तीर्य सव्येन पाणिना पुण्यलक्षणः । यियासुर्ब्रह्मलोकाय प्राणान्प्राणेष्वथाजुहोत् ॥
data.md: Distinguished by many pious deeds, he then spread with his left hand a bed of arrows and out of a desire for going to the regions of Brahman, he committed his vital breaths to the care of the gods presiding over them.

data.v: सूर्ये चक्षुः समाधाय प्रसन्नं सलिले मनः । ध्यायन्महोपनिषदं योगयुक्तोऽभवन्मुनिः ॥
data.md: Steadying his eyes on the sun, setting his mind on the purified water and meditating the Mantras contained in the Upanishads, Bhurisravas betaking himself to yoga, became reticent.

data.v: ततः स सर्वसेनायां जनः कृष्णधनंजयौ । गर्हयामास तं चापि शशंस पुरुषर्षभम् ॥
data.md: Then all the men in the army began to rebuke Krishna and Dhananjaya and applaud that foremost of men viz., Bhurisravas.

data.v: निन्द्यमानौ तथा कृष्णौ नोचतुः किंचिदप्रियम् । प्रशस्यमानश्च तथा नाहृष्यद्यूपकेतनः ॥
data.md: Though thus reproached by the general voice, the two Krishnas uttered not a single word, nor did the stake-bannered Bhurisravas feel any joy in consequence of those encomiums.

data.v: तांस्तथा वादिनो राजन्पुत्रांस्तव धनंजयः । अमृष्यमाणो मनसा तेषां तस्य च भाषितम् ॥
data.md: Then Dhananjaya otherwise called Phalguna, that son of Pandu unable to tolerate your sons speaking in that strain as also to put up with their words and the words of Bhurisravas, O Bharata, in sorrows and not at all angry, spoke these words, as if for remaining them all.

data.v: असंक्रुद्धमना वाचा स्मारयन्निव भारत । उवाच पाण्डुतनयः साक्षेपमिव फल्गुनः ॥
data.md: Then Dhananjaya otherwise called Phalguna, that son of Pandu unable to tolerate your sons speaking in that strain as also to put up with their words and the words of Bhurisravas, O Bharata, in sorrows and not at all angry, spoke these words, as if for remaining them all.

data.v: मम सर्वेऽपि राजानो जानन्त्येतन्महाव्रतम् । न शक्यो मामको हन्तुं यो मे स्याद्बाणगोचरे ॥
data.md: All kings know of this my great vow, that no one shall slay any body of our party so long as the latter is with in the range of my arrows.

data.v: यूपकेतो समीक्ष्य त्वं न मां गर्हितुमर्हसि । न हि धर्ममविज्ञाय युक्तं गर्हयितुं परम् ॥
data.md: Knowing this, O stake-bannered, one it befits you not to reproach me; without yourself knowing the rules of morality, you should not censure others.

data.v: आत्तशस्त्रस्य हि रणे वृष्णिवीरं जिघांसतः । यदहं बाहुमच्छैत्सं न स धर्मो विगर्हितः ॥
data.md: That I have lopped off your arm while you, armed to the teeth, were on the point of slaying the unarmed Satyaki, is not at all against the rules of fair combat.

data.v: न्यस्तशस्त्रस्य बालस्य विरथस्य विवर्मणः । अभिमन्योर्वधं तात धार्मिकः को न पूजयेत् ॥
data.md: But what righteous man is there who will not condemn the slaughter of the body Abhimanyu specially when he was deprived of his weapons, his car and his armour?

data.v: एवमुक्तस्तु पार्थेन शिरसा भूमिमस्पृशत् । पाणिना चैव सव्येन प्राहिणोदस्य दक्षिणम् ॥
data.md: Thus addressed by Pritha's son, Bhurisravas touched the ground with his head and offered with his left arm the right one that had been severed.

data.v: एतत्पार्थस्य तु वचस्ततः श्रुत्वा महाद्युतिः । यूपकेतुर्महाराज तूष्णीमासीदवाङ्मुखः ॥
data.md: Then the stake-bannered Bhurisravas of great effulgence O king having heard those words of Partha, become silent with his face turned towards the earth.

data.v: या प्रीतिर्धर्मराजे मे भीमे च वदतां वरे । नकुले सहदेवे च सा मे त्वयि शलाग्रज ॥
data.md: Arjuna said O eldest brother of Shalya, the love I bear for you is equal even to that I bear for king Yudhishthira the virtuous or Bhima that foremost of all mighty persons or Nakula or Sahadeva.

data.v: मया तु समनुज्ञातः कृष्णेन च महात्मना । गच्छ पुण्यकृताँल्लोकाञ्शिबिरौशीनरो यथा ॥
data.md: With my permission as also with that of the high-souled Krishna do you go to the regions of the righteous where Sivi the son of Usinara is.

data.v: तत उत्थाय शैनेयो विमुक्तः सौमदत्तिना । खड्गमादाय चिच्छित्सुः शिरस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Liberated from the grasp of Somadatta's son, the grandson of Sini rose and with a view to cut-off the head of that illustrious hero, drew his sword.

data.v: निहतं पाण्डुपुत्रेण प्रमत्तं भूरिदक्षिणम् । इयेष सात्यकिर्हन्तुं शलाग्रजमकल्मषम् ॥
data.md: Satyaki then desired to slay the sinless Bhurisravas, the eldest brother of Saila that giver of profuse presents at sacrifices, who was staying with his senses drawn back from the battle and who had already been slain by Arjuna the son of Pandu;

data.v: निकृत्तभुजमासीनं छिन्नहस्तमिव द्विपम् । क्रोशतां सर्वसैन्यानां निन्द्यमानः सुदुर्मनाः ॥
data.md: Who was sitting with his arm lopped off, like an elephant with his trunk cut-off. Then all the warriors reproached him loudly for his intention. But destitute of reason.

data.v: वार्यमाणः स कृष्णेन पार्थेन च महात्मना । भीमेन चक्ररक्षाभ्यामश्वत्थाम्ना कृपेण च ॥
data.md: And although forbidden by the high-souled Partha and Krishna and Bhima and the two wheel protectors of of Arjuna's car and Ashvattharnan and Kripa.

data.v: कर्णेन वृषसेनेन सैन्धवेन तथैव च । विक्रोशतां च सैन्यानामवधीत्तं यतव्रतम् ॥
data.md: And Karna and Vrishasena and the king of the Sindhus and while the soldiers were still uttering loud shouts of denunciation, Satyaki flew Bhurisravas while engaged in the observance of the vow.

data.v: प्रायोपविष्टाय रणे पार्थेन छिन्नबाहवे । सात्यकिः कौरवेन्द्राय खड्गेनापाहरच्छिरः ॥
data.md: Indeed with his sword Satyaki lopped off the head of the Kuru warrior who had been deprived of his arm by Partha and who was then engaged in the Praya for liberating his soul from the body.

data.v: नाभ्यनन्दन्त तत्सैन्याः सात्यकिं तेन कर्मणा । अर्जुनेन हतं पूर्वं यज्जघान कुरूद्वहम् ॥
data.md: The soldiers then did not praise Satyaki for that act of his, viz., the slaughter of the perpetuator of the Kuru race, who already been slain by Pritha's son.

data.v: सहस्राक्षसमं तत्र सिद्धचारणमानवाः । भूरिश्रवसमालोक्य युद्धे प्रायगतं हतम् ॥
अपूजयन्त तं देवा विस्मितास्तस्य कर्मभिः । पक्षवादांश्च बहुशः प्रावदंस्तस्य सैनिकाः ॥
data.md: Then the Siddhas, the Charanas and the men present, as also the celestials, seeing the Indra-like Bhurisravas slain in battle when sitting in the observance of the vow Praya, began to praise him, struck with wonder at the feats achieved by him. Your troops also argued

data.v: न वार्ष्णेयस्यापराधो भवितव्यं हि तत्तथा । तस्मान्मन्युर्न वः कार्यः क्रोधो दुःखकरो नृणाम् ॥
data.md: In this matter no blame should be attributed to the Vrishni hero. What has been ordained must happen. Therefore we should not cherish wrath; since again wrath is the cause of a man's grief.

data.v: हन्तव्यश्चैष वीरेण नात्र कार्या विचारणा । विहितो ह्यस्य धात्रैव मृत्युः सात्यकिराहवे ॥
data.md: It was doomed that Bhurisravas would be slain by the heroic Satyaki. We need not judge of its propriety or otherwise. Satyaki has been made the instrument of Bhurisrava's death by the Creator himself.

data.v: न हन्तव्यो न हन्तव्य इति यन्मां प्रभाषथ । धर्मवादैरधर्मिष्ठा धर्मकञ्चुकमास्थिताः ॥
data.md: Satyaki said You, sinful Kauravas, vested in outward garments of virtue, you are telling me in words of virtue, that Bhurisravas should not have been slain.

data.v: यदा बालः सुभद्रायाः सुतः शस्त्रविनाकृतः । युष्माभिर्निहतो युद्धे तदा धर्मः क्व वो गतः ॥
data.md: Where did this righteousness of yours fly when you ruthlessly slew in battle that child viz., Subhadra's son when he was deprived to the use of his weapons;

data.v: मया त्वेतत्प्रतिज्ञातं क्षेपे कस्मिंश्चिदेव हि । यो मां निष्पिष्य संग्रामे जीवन्हन्यात्पदा रुषा । स मे वध्यो भवेच्छत्रुर्यद्यपि स्यान्मुनिव्रतः ॥
data.md: In a certain fit of haughtiness I had vowed that he who would throw me down in battle alive and strike me in wrath with his knees.

data.v: चेष्टमानं प्रतीघाते सभुजं मां सचक्षुषः । मन्यध्वं मृतमित्येवमेतद्वो बुद्धिलाघवम् । युक्तो ह्यस्य प्रतीघातः कृतो मे कुरुपुंगवाः ॥
data.md: Yet you had taken me as already slain. It is indeed a great foolishness on your part. You foremost of the Kurus, the slaughter of Bhurisravas achieved by me, in indeed very proper.

data.v: यत्तु पार्थेन मत्स्नेहात्स्वां प्रतिज्ञां च रक्षता । सखड्गोऽस्य हृतो बाहुरेतेनैवास्मि वञ्चितः ॥
data.md: Partha by lopping off the arm of this one, with sword in grasp, had fulfiled his vow of protecting his own partisans and has thereby robbed me of my glory!

data.v: भवितव्यं च यद्भावि दैवं चेष्टयतीव च । सोऽयं हतो विमर्देऽस्मिन्किमत्राधर्मचेष्टितम् ॥
data.md: What is ordained must come to pass. It is the hand of fate that works. Bhurisravas has been slain in the course of this battle. What sin have I perpetrated?

data.v: अपि चायं पुरा गीतः श्लोको वाल्मीकिना भुवि । पीडाकरममित्राणां यत्स्यात्कर्तव्यमेव तत् ॥
एवमुक्ते महाराज सर्वे कौरवपाण्डवाः । न स्म किंचिदभाषन्त मनसा समपूजयन् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said After Satyaki had said these words, none amongst the Pandavas and the Kauravas, o king, said anything; on the other hand they praised Bhurisravas in their mind.

data.v: मन्त्रैर्हि पूतस्य महाध्वरेषु; यशस्विनो भूरिसहस्रदस्य । मुनेरिवारण्यगतस्य तस्य; न तत्र कश्चिद्वधमभ्यनन्दत् ॥
data.md: Nobody present there countenanced the slaughter of Somadatta's illustrious son, who resembled an hermit of the woods and who had given away thousands of golden coins.

data.v: सुनीलकेशं वरदस्य तस्य; शूरस्य पारावतलोहिताक्षम् । अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य शिरो निकृत्तं; न्यस्तं हविर्धानमिवोत्तरेण ॥
data.md: The head of that brave hero graced with beautiful blue locks and eyes red like those of pegions looked like the head of a horse cut-off in a horse sacrifice and placed on the sacrificial altar.

data.v: स तेजसा शस्त्रहतेन पूतो; महाहवे देहवरं विसृज्य । आक्रामदूर्ध्वं वरदो वरार्हो; व्यावृत्य धर्मेण परेण रोदसी ॥
data.md: Purified through his prowess and death by the edge of weapons and in consequence of the boon accorded to him, Bhurisravas worthy of every boon went to the regions on high, shuffling off his mortal coil and filling the heavens with his illustrious fame.

data.v: अजितो द्रोणराधेयविकर्णकृतवर्मभिः । तीर्णः सैन्यार्णवं वीरः प्रतिश्रुत्य युधिष्ठिरे ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said Having promised to Yudhishthira to do so, the heroic Satyaki crossed the ocean of my troops, unvanquished cven by Drona, Radha's son, Vikarna and Kritavarman.

data.v: स कथं कौरवेयेण समरेष्वनिवारितः । निगृह्य भूरिश्रवसा बलाद्भुवि निपातितः ॥
data.md: How was it then that Satyaki checked and humiliated by the scion of the Kurus namely Bhurisravas, was brought down on the ground with force.

data.v: शृणु राजन्निहोत्पत्तिं शैनेयस्य यथा पुरा । यथा च भूरिश्रवसो यत्र ते संशयो नृप ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Hear, O monarch, how the grandson of Sini came to being in days gone by as also how Bhurisravas was descended. O ruler of men, this will explain all your doubts.

data.v: अत्रेः पुत्रोऽभवत्सोमः सोमस्य तु बुधः स्मृतः । बुधस्यासीन्महेन्द्राभः पुत्र एकः पुरूरवाः ॥
data.md: Atri had Soma for his son and Soma's son was called Buddha. Buddha's son was Pururava whose effulgence was like that of the great Indra.

data.v: पुरूरवस आयुस्तु आयुषो नहुषः स्मृतः । नहुषस्य ययातिस्तु राजर्षिर्देवसंमितः ॥
data.md: Pururava had a son called Ayush; and Ayush's son was Nahusha. Nahusha had Yayati for his son who was a royal sage equal to a celestial.

data.v: ययातेर्देवयान्यां तु यदुर्ज्येष्ठोऽभवत्सुतः । यदोरभूदन्ववाये देवमीढ इति श्रुतः ॥
data.md: By his wife Deveyani Yayati had Yadu for his eldest son. In the dynasty of Yadu was born a son called by the name of Devamida.

data.v: यादवस्तस्य च सुतः शूरस्त्रैलोक्यसंमतः । शूरस्य शौरिर्नृवरो वसुदेवो महायशाः ॥
data.md: Devamnida of Yadu's race had Sura for his son, who was highly esteemed in all the three worlds. Sura had for his son that foremost of men namely the illustrious Vasudeva.

data.v: धनुष्यनवरः शूरः कार्तवीर्यसमो युधि । तद्वीर्यश्चापि तत्रैव कुले शिनिरभून्नृपः ॥
data.md: Foremost of all wielders of bows, Sura was equal to Kartikeya in battle. O king, in his race and equal to him in energy was born Sini, O monarch.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवकस्य महात्मनः । दुहितुः स्वयंवरे राजन्सर्वक्षत्रसमागमे ॥
data.md: At this time, O monarch the Sayamvara of the daughter of the illustrious Devaka took place in which numerous Kshatriyas were present.

data.v: तत्र वै देवकीं देवीं वसुदेवार्थमाप्तवान् । निर्जित्य पार्थिवान्सर्वान्रथमारोपयच्छिनिः ॥
data.md: In that Sayamvara, Sini having vanquished the kings, placed the princess Devaki on his car, with a view to marry her to Vasudeva.

data.v: तां दृष्ट्वा देवकीं शौरे रथस्थां पुरुषर्षभः । नामृष्यत महातेजाः सोमदत्तः शिनेर्नृप ॥
data.md: O foremost of men, O king, then beholding the princess Devaki on the car of Sini of Sura's line, the highly puissant Somadatta could not broke it.

data.v: तयोर्युद्धमभूद्राजन्दिनार्धं चित्रमद्भुतम् । बाहुयुद्धं सुबलिनोः शक्रप्रह्रादयोरिव ॥
data.md: Thereupon, O king, a battle was fought between then, that occupied half a day and was beautiful to look at. O foremost of men, a wrestling encounter then took place between those heroes endued with great heroism.
