data.v: प्रातिपीयस्तु संक्रुद्धः शक्तिं भीमस्य वक्षसि । निचखान महाबाहुः पुरंदर इवाशनिम् ॥
data.md: Like Purandara hurling the thunder bolt, the mighty arrmed son of Partha. (i.e., Valhika), smitten with ire, struck Bhima on the chest with an arrow.

data.v: स तयाभिहतो भीमश्चकम्पे च मुमोह च । प्राप्य चेतश्च बलवान्गदामस्मै ससर्ज ह ॥
data.md: Thus struck (by Valhika) Bhima trembled and (then) fell into a swoon. Then that powerful one, recovering his senses, hurled a mace at him.

data.v: सा पाण्डवेन प्रहिता बाह्लीकस्य शिरोऽहरत् । स पपात हतः पृथ्व्यां वज्राहत इवाद्रिराट् ॥
data.md: That (mace) hurled by the Pandava (Bhimasena) smashed the head of Valhika. He (then) fell down dead on the earth like a tree struck by lightning.

data.v: तस्मिन्विनिहते वीरे बाह्लीके पुरुषर्षभे । पुत्रास्तेऽभ्यर्दयन्भीमं दश दाशरथेः समाः ॥
data.md: That foremost of men, the heroic Valhika being (thus) slain, your ten sons, viz., Nagadatta, Dhridaratha, Viravahu, Ayobhuja, Dridha, Suhasta, Viraja, Pramatha and Ugrayayin; (each of whom) resembled the son of Dasharatha (i.e. Rama) began to torment Bhima.

data.v: नाराचैर्दशभिर्भीमस्तान्निहत्य तवात्मजान् । कर्णस्य दयितं पुत्रं वृषसेनमवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Having destroyed those (ten) sons of your with ten arrows Bhima covered Vrishasena, the beloved son of Karna (with downpours of shafts).

data.v: ततो वृषरथो नाम भ्राता कर्णस्य विश्रुतः । जघान भीमं नाराचैस्तमप्यभ्यवधीद्बली ॥
data.md: Then the renowned brother of Karna, Vrikaratha by name, pierced Bhima with arrows. (But) that hero (i.e., Bhima) soon slew him.

data.v: ततः सप्त रथान्वीरः स्यालानां तव भारत । निहत्य भीमो नाराचैः शतचन्द्रमपोथयत् ॥
data.md: Then the heroic Bhima, having killed seven car-warriors among your brothers-in-law, with arrows, buried Satachandra into the earth (by main force), O Bharata.

data.v: अमर्षयन्तो निहतं शतचन्द्रं महारथम् । शकुनेर्भ्रातरो वीरा गजाक्षः शरभो विभुः । अभिद्रुत्य शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भीमसेनमताडयन् ॥
data.md: Unable to put up with the destruction of that great car-warrior Satachandra, the brothers of Shakuni viz., the heroic Gavaksha, Sarava, Vibhu (and two others).

data.v: स तुद्यमानो नाराचैर्वृष्टिवेगैरिवर्षभः । जघान पञ्चभिर्बाणैः पञ्चैवातिबलो रथान् । तान्दृष्ट्वा निहतान्वीरान्विचेलुर्नृपसत्तमाः ॥
data.md: Destroyed those five kings endued with great prowess, with five arrows. Those foremost of kings (who were present in that battle) seeing the destruction of those five heroes began to waver.

data.v: ततो युधिष्ठिरः क्रुद्धस्तवानीकमशातयत् । मिषतः कुम्भयोनेश्च पुत्राणां च तवानघ ॥
data.md: Then Yudhishthira began angrily to crush borm (Drona) and in that of your sons, O sinless one.

data.v: अम्बष्ठान्मालवाञ्शूरांस्त्रिगर्तान्सशिबीनपि । प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय गणान्युद्धे युधिष्ठिरः ॥
data.md: (And) in that battle Yudhishthira sent to the region of Death, the Ambhastas, the Malavas, the heroic Trigartas and the Sivis.

data.v: अभीषाहाञ्शूरसेनान्बाह्लीकान्सवसातिकान् । निकृत्य पृथिवीं राजा चक्रे शोणितकर्दमाम् ॥
data.md: Chopping off the Abhishahas, the Surasenas, the Valhikas and the Vashatikas, he made the earth muddy with (their) flesh and blood.

data.v: यौधेयारट्टराजन्यमद्रकाणां गणान्युधि । प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय शूरान्बाणैर्युधिष्ठिरः ॥
data.md: (And), O king, in a moment he sent to the region of Yama, with a number of darts, the heroic Youdheyas, the Malavas and hosts of the Madrakas in battle.

data.v: हताहरत गृह्णीत विध्यत व्यवकृन्तत । इत्यासीत्तुमुलः शब्दो युधिष्ठिररथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Then a tumultuous uproar (such as) “Slay, seize, capture, pierce and cut to pieces”-arose in the direction of Yudhishthira's car.

data.v: सैन्यानि द्रावयन्तं तं द्रोणो दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरम् । चोदितस्तव पुत्रेण सायकैरभ्यवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Seeing Yudhishthira afflict your troops Drona, urged on by your son surrounded him (i.e. Yudhishthira) with arrows.

data.v: द्रोणस्तु परमक्रुद्धो वायव्यास्त्रेण पार्थिवम् । विव्याध सोऽस्य तद्दिव्यमस्त्रमस्त्रेण जघ्निवान् ॥
data.md: Drona also, exceedingly enraged, discharged at that Pandava the weapon presided over by Vayu. over by Vayu. But he (i.e., Yudhishthira) destroyed that celestial weapon with (another) weapon.

data.v: तस्मिन्विनिहते चास्त्रे भारद्वाजो युधिष्ठिरे । वारुणं याम्यमाग्नेयं त्वाष्ट्रं सावित्रमेव च । चिक्षेप परमक्रुद्धो जिघांसुः पाण्डुनन्दनम् ॥
क्षिप्तानि क्षिप्यमाणानि तानि चास्त्राणि धर्मजः । जघानास्त्रैर्महाबाहुः कुम्भयोनेरवित्रसन् ॥
सत्यां चिकीर्षमाणस्तु प्रतिज्ञां कुम्भसंभवः । प्रादुश्चक्रेऽस्त्रमैन्द्रं वै प्राजापत्यं च भारत । जिघांसुर्धर्मतनयं तव पुत्रहिते रतः ॥
data.md: Devoted to the welfare of your son, called into existence the weapons presided over by Varuna or Prajapati, in order to slay the son of Dharma, O Bharata.

data.v: पतिः कुरूणां गजसिंहगामी; विशालवक्षाः पृथुलोहिताक्षः । प्रादुश्चकारास्त्रमहीनतेजा; माहेन्द्रमन्यत्स जघान तेऽस्त्रे ॥
data.md: (Then) the lord of the Kurus (i.e. Yudhishthira) walking like a lion or elephant endued with a broad chest and large red eyes and possessed of an energy not less (then that of Drona) called into existence the Mahendra weapon, by means of which he baffled the weapon of Drona.

data.v: विहन्यमानेष्वस्त्रेषु द्रोणः क्रोधसमन्वितः । युधिष्ठिरवधप्रेप्सुर्ब्राह्ममस्त्रमुदैरयत् ॥
data.md: All those weapons of his being baffled, Drona was filled with ire; and desirous of slaying Yudhishthira, he called into existence the weapon presided over by Brahma.

data.v: ततो नाज्ञासिषं किंचिद्घोरेण तमसावृते । सर्वभूतानि च परं त्रासं जग्मुर्महीपते ॥
data.md: Being enveloped in a dismal darkness, we could not, then, discern anything. And, O lord of the earth, all the creatures experienced a terrible horror.

data.v: ब्रह्मास्त्रमुद्यतं दृष्ट्वा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः । ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव राजेन्द्र तदस्त्रं प्रत्यवारयत् ॥
data.md: Seeing that the Brahma weapon was uplifted, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, baffled that weapon by means of Brahma weapon, O king of kings.

data.v: ततः सैनिकमुख्यास्ते प्रशशंसुर्नरर्षभौ । द्रोणपार्थौ महेष्वासौ सर्वयुद्धविशारदौ ॥
data.md: Then the principal warriors (of the two armies) praised those two most exalted of men, those two great bowmen, viz., Drona and the son of Pritha, who were conversant with all the (arts of) warfare.

data.v: ततः प्रमुच्य कौन्तेयं द्रोणो द्रुपदवाहिनीम् । व्यधमद्रोषताम्राक्षो वायव्यास्त्रेण भारत ॥
data.md: Leaving the son of Kunti, Drona, then, whose eyes became as red as copper in rage, began to destroy, by means of weapons, the army of Drupada.

data.v: ते हन्यमाना द्रोणेन पाञ्चालाः प्राद्रवन्भयात् । पश्यतो भीमसेनस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः ॥
data.md: The Panchalas, (thus) destroyed by Drona fled away in terror in the very presence of Bhimasena and in that of the high-souled Pritha.

data.v: ततः किरीटी भीमश्च सहसा संन्यवर्तताम् । महद्भ्यां रथवंशाभ्यां परिगृह्य बलं तव ॥
data.md: Then Kiriti and Bhima, rallying their own ariny, all on a sudden attacked, with a great car-force, your army.

data.v: बीभत्सुर्दक्षिणं पार्श्वमुत्तरं तु वृकोदरः । भारद्वाजं शरौघाभ्यां महद्भ्यामभ्यवर्षताम् ॥
data.md: Vibhatsu attacking the right and Vrikodara the left flank (of your army), discharged at the son of Bharadvaja mighty downpours of shafts.

data.v: तौ तदा सृञ्जयाश्चैव पाञ्चालाश्च महौजसः । अन्वगच्छन्महाराज मत्स्याश्च सह सात्वतैः ॥
data.md: The Kakeyas, the Srinjayas and the highly energetic Panchalas, O great king, together with the Matsyas and the Sattvata followed suit.

data.v: ततः सा भारती सेना वध्यमाना किरीटिना । द्रोणेन वार्यमाणास्ते स्वयं तव सुतेन च । नाशक्यन्त महाराज योधा वारयितुं तदा ॥
data.md: Although, O great king, Drona himself and your son tried to rally them, yet they were not capable of reducing the warriors to order.

data.v: उदीर्यमाणं तद्दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवानां महद्बलम् । अविषह्यं च मन्वानः कर्णं दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Duryodhana, on beholding the vast army of the Pandavas-inflated with wrath and thinking it to be irresistible thus spoke to Karna.

data.v: अयं स कालः संप्राप्तो मित्राणां मित्रवत्सल । त्रायस्व समरे कर्ण सर्वान्योधान्महाबल ॥
data.md: The time is now, O you that are devoted to your friends (to seek your assistance). O Karna, save in battle all my soldiers and car warriors.

data.v: पाञ्चालैर्मत्स्यकैकेयैः पाण्डवैश्च महारथैः । वृतान्समन्तात्संक्रुद्धैर्निःश्वसद्भिरिवोरगैः ॥
data.md: Who are not completely hemmed in by the wrathful Panchalas and the Keykeas and the Matsyas and by the mighty car-warriors of the Pandavas who are all listening like (angry) snakes.

data.v: एते नदन्ति संहृष्टाः पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः । शक्रोपमाश्च बहवः पाञ्चालानां रथव्रजाः ॥
data.md: These Pandavas, filled with ecstasy and desirous of victory and these numerous carwarriors of the Panchalas equal to Shakra in prowess, are (all) roaring.

data.v: परित्रातुमिह प्राप्तो यदि पार्थं पुरंदरः । तमप्याशु पराजित्य ततो हन्तास्मि पाण्डवम् ॥
data.md: Karna said Even if Purandara himself comes here in person in order to deliver the son of Pritha, I will soon vanquish him and then slay the son of Pandu (i.e. Arjuna).

data.v: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि समाश्वसिहि भारत । हन्तास्मि पाण्डुतनयान्पाञ्चालांश्च समागतान् ॥
data.md: I swear this truly. Reassure your-self O Bharata. I will destroy the sons of Pandu together with all the assembled Panchalas.

data.v: जयं ते प्रतिजानामि वासवस्येव पावकिः । प्रियं तव मया कार्यमिति जीवामि पार्थिव ॥
data.md: I will secure to you victory as the son of Pavaka (i.e., Kartikeya) did to Vasava himself. In this battle which is now going on, I will do good offices to you.

data.v: सर्वेषामेव पार्थानां फल्गुनो बलवत्तरः । तस्यामोघां विमोक्ष्यामि शक्तिं शक्रविनिर्मिताम् ॥
data.md: Among all the sons of Pritha. Phalguna is the most powerful. I will hurl at him the unfailing dart made by Shakra.

data.v: तस्मिन्हते महेष्वासे भ्रातरस्तस्य मानद । तव वश्या भविष्यन्ति वनं यास्यन्ति वा पुनः ॥
data.md: When the mighty-bowman will be slain, his brothers, O bestower of honours, will either come under your away or depart to the forest again.

data.v: मयि जीवति कौरव्य विषादं मा कृथाः क्वचित् । अहं जेष्यामि समरे सहितान्सर्वपाण्डवान् ॥
data.md: O lord of the Kauravas, since I am alive you need not give way to sorrow. I will, in battle, destroy all the Pandavas joined together.

data.v: पाञ्चालान्केकयांश्चैव वृष्णींश्चापि समागतान् । बाणौघैः शकलीकृत्य तव दास्यामि मेदिनीम् ॥
data.md: The Panchalas, the Keykayas and the assembled Vrishnis. (And) cutting (them) off into pieces with arrows I will give the earth to you.

data.v: एवं ब्रुवाणं कर्णं तु कृपः शारद्वतोऽब्रवीत् । स्मयन्निव महाबाहुः सूतपुत्रमिदं वचः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said When Karna was saying all this the mightyarmed Kripa, the son of Saradvata smilingly said these words to the charioteer's son.

data.v: शोभनं शोभनं कर्ण सनाथः कुरुपुंगवः । त्वया नाथेन राधेय वचसा यदि सिध्यति ॥
data.md: "Very well very well, O Karna. If words alone were to lead to success, then 0 son of Radha, with yourself as his supporter, this most exalted of the Kuru could be considered as sufficiently backed.

data.v: बहुशः कत्थसे कर्ण कौरव्यस्य समीपतः । न तु ते विक्रमः कश्चिद्दृश्यते बलमेव वा ॥
data.md: Frequently in the presence of the Kaurava (king) you boast (of your prowess). But neither your prowess nor the result of it has ever been witnessed.

data.v: समागमः पाण्डुसुतैर्दृष्टस्ते बहुशो युधि । सर्वत्र निर्जितश्चासि पाण्डवैः सूतनन्दन ॥
data.md: You have been, on several occasions, seen to engage in battle with the sons of Pandu. But, charioteer's son, you have, on all those occasions, been defeated by the Pandavas.

data.v: ह्रियमाणे तदा कर्ण गन्धर्वैर्धृतराष्ट्रजे । तदायुध्यन्त सैन्यानि त्वमेकस्तु पलायथाः ॥
data.md: On the son of Dhritarashtra being taken prisoner by the Gandharvas, you yourself were the first to take to your heels although all the troops were fighting (to rescue the Kuru king).

data.v: विराटनगरे चापि समेताः सर्वकौरवाः । पार्थेन निर्जिता युद्धे त्वं च कर्ण सहानुजः ॥
data.md: Again, in the city of Virata, all the assembled Kauravas as well as you, O Karna, together with your younger brother were (all) defeated by Part. a in battle.

data.v: एकस्याप्यसमर्थस्त्वं फल्गुनस्य रणाजिरे । कथमुत्सहसे जेतुं सकृष्णान्सर्वपाण्डवान् ॥
data.md: You are, in battle, incapable of fighting with Phalguna alone. How can you, (therefore) hope to conquer all the Pandavas together with Krishna?

data.v: अब्रुवन्कर्ण युध्यस्व बहु कत्थसि सूतज । अनुक्त्वा विक्रमेद्यस्तु तद्वै सत्पुरुषव्रतम् ॥
data.md: O Karna, O charioteer's son, you boast too much (of your prowess). Be engaged in fight. It is the duty of good (i.e. really brave) men to display their prowess without uttering (a single boastful word).

data.v: गर्जित्वा सूतपुत्र त्वं शारदाभ्रमिवाजलम् । निष्फलो दृश्यसे कर्ण तच्च राजा न बुध्यते ॥
data.md: By roaring like the rainless autumnal clouds, O charioteer's son, O Karna, you show that you have no worth. But the king does not understand this.

data.v: तावद्गर्जसि राधेय यावत्पार्थं न पश्यसि । पुरा पार्थं हि ते दृष्ट्वा दुर्लभं गर्जितं भवेत् ॥
data.md: Continue, O son Radha, to roar so long as you do not behold Partha; (for) you will cease roaring when you will see Partha near.

data.v: त्वमनासाद्य तान्बाणान्फल्गुनस्य विगर्जसि । पार्थसायकविद्धस्य दुर्लभं गर्जितं भवेत् ॥
data.md: Continue to roar so long as you are out of the reach of Phalguna's arrows: (for) you will cease roaring when you will see Partha near.

data.v: बाहुभिः क्षत्रियाः शूरा वाग्भिः शूरा द्विजातयः । धनुषा फल्गुनः शूरः कर्णः शूरो मनोरथैः ॥
data.md: It is by means of (the prowess of) their arms that the Kshyatras are heroes. The twice-born ones display their heroism by words. It is by means of this bow that Phalguna is a hero. But Karna is a hero by the wishes (he cherishes in his heart).

data.v: एवं परुषितस्तेन तदा शारद्वतेन सः । कर्णः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः कृपं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ॥
शूरा गर्जन्ति सततं प्रावृषीव बलाहकाः । फलं चाशु प्रयच्छन्ति बीजमुप्तमृताविव ॥
दोषमत्र न पश्यामि शूराणां रणमूर्धनि । तत्तद्विकत्थमानानां भारं चोद्वहतां मृधे ॥
यं भारं पुरुषो वोढुं मनसा हि व्यवस्यति । दैवमस्य ध्रुवं तत्र साहाय्यायोपपद्यते ॥
व्यवसायद्वितीयोऽहं मनसा भारमुद्वहन् । गर्जामि यद्यहं विप्र तव किं तत्र नश्यति ॥
data.md: That is (if wishing in my mind) to slay in battle the son of Pandu together with Krishna and Sattvata, I roar thus, what harm is there in it to you, O Brahmana?

data.v: वृथा शूरा न गर्जन्ति सजला इव तोयदाः । सामर्थ्यमात्मनो ज्ञात्वा ततो गर्जन्ति पण्डिताः ॥
data.md: Heroes do not roar in vain like the autumnal clouds. The wise, conscious of their ownstrength, indulge in roars.

data.v: सोऽहमद्य रणे यत्तः सहितौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ । उत्सहे तरसा जेतुं ततो गर्जामि गौतम ॥
data.md: I am, too, resolved in my mind to conquer in battle today the Pandavas and Krishna joined together, by exerting my best. O son of Goutama, it is on this account, that I indulge in roars.

data.v: पश्य त्वं गर्जितस्यास्य फलं मे विप्र सानुगः । हत्वा पाण्डुसुतानाजौ सहकृष्णान्ससात्वतान् । दुर्योधनाय दास्यामि पृथिवीं हतकण्टकाम् ॥
data.md: O Brahmana, witness the result of these roars of mine. Having slain in battle the sons of Pandu together with Krishna. Sattvata and (all their) followers I will deliver the (entire) earth with its thorns weeded out, to Duryodhana.

data.v: मनोरथप्रलापो मे न ग्राह्यस्तव सूतज । यदा क्षिपसि वै कृष्णौ धर्मराजं च पाण्डवम् ॥
data.md: Kripa said Your intentions being like the ravings (of a mad man) cannot be acceptable to me, inasmuch as you always tale to me, inasmuch as you always speak depreciatingly of Krishna, Arjuna and Dharmaraj, the son of Pandu.

data.v: ध्रुवस्तत्र जयः कर्ण यत्र युद्धविशारदौ । देवगन्धर्वयक्षाणां मनुष्योरगरक्षसाम् । दंशितानामपि रणे अजेयौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ ॥
ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यवाग्दान्तो गुरुदैवतपूजकः । नित्यं धर्मरतश्चैव कृतास्त्रश्च विशेषतः । धृतिमांश्च कृतज्ञश्च धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥
भ्रातरश्चास्य बलिनः सर्वास्त्रेषु कृतश्रमाः । गुरुवृत्तिरताः प्राज्ञा धर्मनित्या यशस्विनः ॥
data.md: His brother (also) are powerful, well-skilled in all the weapons, devoted to the ministrations of their elders, wise, renowned and (they) always practice righteousness.

data.v: संबन्धिनश्चेन्द्रवीर्याः स्वनुरक्ताः प्रहारिणः । धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च दौर्मुखिर्जनमेजयः ॥
data.md: His relations and kinsmen too are powerful as Indra himself, are devotedly attached (to him) and (efficient) smiters. Dhristadyumna, Sikhandi and Janamejaya, the son of Durmuksha. armoirs are

data.v: चन्द्रसेनो भद्रसेनः कीर्तिधर्मा ध्रुवो धरः । वसुचन्द्रो दामचन्द्रः सिंहचन्द्रः सुवेधनः ॥
data.md: And Chandrasena, Bhadrasena, Kirtivarma, Dhruva, Dhara, Vasuchandra, Damachandra, Singha-Chandra, sutejana.

data.v: द्रुपदस्य तथा पुत्रा द्रुपदश्च महास्त्रवित् । येषामर्थाय संयत्तो मत्स्यराजः सहानुगः ॥
data.md: And the sons of Drupada and Drupada himself skilled in great weapons and the king of Matsya together with his younger brothers are exerting their utmost on their behalf.

data.v: शतानीकः सुदशनः श्रुतानीकः श्रुतध्वजः । बलानीको जयानीको जयाश्वो रथवाहनः ॥
data.md: And Gajaneeka, Srutaneeka, Veerabhadra, Sudrasana, Srutadhvaja, Valaneeka, Jayaneeka, Jarapreya and Vijaya, Labdhalaksha, Jayasva, Rathavahana, Chandradaya, Kamaratha, the auspicious brothers of Virata,

data.v: चन्द्रोदयः कामरथो विराटभ्रातरः शुभाः । यमौ च द्रौपदेयाश्च राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः । येषामर्थाय युध्यन्ते न तेषां विद्यते क्षयः ॥
data.md: And the twins, the (five) sons of Draupadi and the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha are fighting for their sake. They (therefore) cannot meet with destruction.

data.v: कामं खलु जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानवम् । सयक्षराक्षसगणं सभूतभुजगद्विपम् । निःशेषमस्त्रवीर्येण कुर्यातां भीमफल्गुनौ ॥
data.md: These and innumerable numbers of other kinsmen and relations) are on the side of the son of Pandu. Indeed, Bhima and Phalguna, by ineans of the prowess of their weapons, can easily destroy the whole universe together with all the celestials, the Asuras, the human beings and the Rakshasas, (other) created beings, the serpents and the elephants.

data.v: युधिष्ठिरश्च पृथिवीं निर्दहेद्घोरचक्षुषा । अप्रमेयबलः शौरिर्येषामर्थे च दंशितः । कथं तान्संयुगे कर्ण जेतुमुत्सहसे परान् ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira, also by means of his angry looks, can consume the (whole). O Karna, how can you hope to vanquish these enemies in battle, for whose sake Souri of unrivaled prowess has armed himself? It is indeed a great impudence on your part, OCharioteer's son, as you always dare confronting Souri in battle.

data.v: महानपनयस्त्वेष तव नित्यं हि सूतज । यस्त्वमुत्सहसे योद्धुं समरे शौरिणा सह ॥
एवमुक्तस्तु राधेयः प्रहसन्भरतर्षभ । अब्रवीच्च तदा कर्णो गुरुं शारद्वतं कृपम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to (by Kripa), Karna the son of Radha then replied smilingly to the preceptor Kripa, the son of Saradvat.

data.v: सत्यमुक्तं त्वया ब्रह्मन्पाण्डवान्प्रति यद्वचः । एते चान्ये च बहवो गुणाः पाण्डुसुतेषु वै ॥
data.md: “O Brahmana, the words that you have (just) spoken about the Pandavas are true. Indeed the sons of Pandu are gifted with these and many other noble qualities.

data.v: अजय्याश्च रणे पार्था देवैरपि सवासवैः । सदैत्ययक्षगन्धर्वपिशाचोरगराक्षसैः । तथापि पार्थाञ्जेष्यामि शक्त्या वासवदत्तया ॥
data.md: The sons of Pritha are unconquerable in battle by the celestials together with Vasava (at their head), by the Yakshas, the Daityas and the Gandharvas (all) united together and by the Pishachas, the Urages and the Rakshasas.

data.v: ममाप्यमोघा दत्तेयं शक्तिः शक्रेण वै द्विज । एतया निहनिष्यामि सव्यसाचिनमाहवे ॥
हते तु पाण्डवे कृष्णो भ्रातरश्चास्य सोदराः । अनर्जुना न शक्ष्यन्ति महीं भोक्तुं कथंचन ॥
तेषु नष्टेषु सर्वेषु पृथिवीयं ससागरा । अयत्नात्कौरवेयस्य वशे स्थास्यति गौतम ॥
सुनीतैरिह सर्वार्थाः सिध्यन्ते नात्र संशयः । एतमर्थमहं ज्ञात्वा ततो गर्जामि गौतम ॥
त्वं तु वृद्धश्च विप्रश्च अशक्तश्चापि संयुगे । कृतस्नेहश्च पार्थेषु मोहान्मामवमन्यसे ॥
यद्येवं वक्ष्यसे भूयो मामप्रियमिह द्विज । ततस्ते खड्गमुद्यम्य जिह्वां छेत्स्यामि दुर्मते ॥
यच्चापि पाण्डवान्विप्र स्तोतुमिच्छसि संयुगे । भीषयन्सर्वसैन्यानि कौरवेयाणि दुर्मते । अत्रापि शृणु मे वाक्यं यथावद्गदतो द्विज ॥
data.md: In order to strike terror into the hearts of) all the troops and the Kauravas, O evil-minded one, O son of Goutama, hear what I say on this point.

data.v: दुर्योधनश्च द्रोणश्च शकुनिर्दुर्मुखो जयः । दुःशासनो वृषसेनो मद्रराजस्त्वमेव च । सोमदत्तश्च भूरिश्च तथा द्रौणिर्विविंशतिः ॥
data.md: Where Duryodhana, Drona, Shakuni, Durmukha, Jaya, Dusasana, Vrishasena, the king Madra and yourself.

data.v: तिष्ठेयुर्दंशिता यत्र सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः । जयेदेतान्रणे को नु शक्रतुल्यबलोऽप्यरिः ॥
शूराश्च हि कृतास्त्राश्च बलिनः स्वर्गलिप्सवः । धर्मज्ञा युद्धकुशला हन्युर्युद्धे सुरानपि ॥
एते स्थास्यन्ति संग्रामे पाण्डवानां वधार्थिनः । जयमाकाङ्क्षमाणा हि कौरवेयस्य दंशिताः ॥
दैवायत्तमहं मन्ये जयं सुबलिनामपि । यत्र भीष्मो महाबाहुः शेते शरशताचितः ॥
विकर्णश्चित्रसेनश्च बाह्लीकोऽथ जयद्रथः । भूरिश्रवा जयश्चैव जलसंधः सुदक्षिणः ॥
शलश्च रथिनां श्रेष्ठो भगदत्तश्च वीर्यवान् । एते चान्ये च राजानो देवैरपि सुदुर्जयाः ॥
निहताः समरे शूराः पाण्डवैर्बलवत्तराः । किमन्यद्दैवसंयोगान्मन्यसे पुरुषाधम ॥
यांश्च तान्स्तौषि सततं दुर्योधनरिपून्द्विज । तेषामपि हताः शूराः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
क्षीयन्ते सर्वसैन्यानि कुरूणां पाण्डवैः सह । प्रभावं नात्र पश्यामि पाण्डवानां कथंचन ॥
यांस्तान्बलवतो नित्यं मन्यसे त्वं द्विजाधम । यतिष्येऽहं यथाशक्ति योद्धुं तैः सह संयुगे । दुर्योधनहितार्थाय जयो दैवे प्रतिष्ठितः ॥
data.md: I will confront in battle putting forth my utmost prowess for the welfare of Duryodhana. As regards success, it is dependent on fate.

data.v: तथा परुषितं दृष्ट्वा सूतपुत्रेण मातुलम् । खड्गमुद्यम्य वेगेन द्रौणिरभ्यपतद्द्रुतम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Seeing his maternal uncle thus insulted by the charioteer's son, the son of Drona brandishing his scimitar ran furiously towards him.

data.v: कर्ण पश्य सुदुर्बुद्धे तिष्ठेदानीं नराधम । एष तेऽद्य शिरः कायादुद्धरामि सुदुर्मते ॥
data.md: Look, O Karna of wicked understanding, O vilest of men stay here now. I will presently cut-off your head from your body.

data.v: तमुत्पतन्तं वेगेन राजा दुर्योधनः स्वयम् । न्यवारयन्महाराज कृपश्च द्विपदां वरः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said The highly-energetic king Duryodhana himself and that best of men, Kripa, prevented him (i.e., Ashvatthama) who was rushing furiously (at Karna).

data.v: शूरोऽयं समरश्लाघी दुर्मतिश्च द्विजाधमः । आसादयतु मद्वीर्यं मुञ्चेमं कुरुसत्तम ॥
data.md: Karna said Let this basest of Brahmanas, who (thinks that he) is a hero, boasts of his prowess in battle and is of wicked understanding, taste of my prowess. Do leave him, O best of the Kurus.

data.v: तवैतत्क्षम्यतेऽस्माभिः सूतात्मज सुदुर्मते । दर्पमुत्सिक्तमेतत्ते फल्गुनो नाशयिष्यति ॥
data.md: Ashvatthama said 0 charioteer's of wicked understanding, we forgive you of this (fault). Phalguna will destroy this swelling pride of yours.

data.v: अश्वत्थामन्प्रसीदस्व क्षन्तुमर्हसि मानद । कोपः खलु न कर्तव्यः सूतपुत्रे कथंचन ॥
data.md: Duryodhana said O Ashvatthama, O bestower of honours, be gratified; do forgive (him). O siniess one, you should not be angry with the charioteer's son.

data.v: त्वयि कर्णे कृपे द्रोणे मद्रराजेऽथ सौबले । महत्कार्यं समायत्तं प्रसीद द्विजसत्तम ॥
data.md: To you and Karna and Kripa and Drona and the king of Madra and to the son of Subala, a heavy task is entrusted. O best of the twiceborn ones, be gratified.

data.v: एते ह्यभिमुखाः सर्वे राधेयेन युयुत्सवः । आयान्ति पाण्डवा ब्रह्मन्नाह्वयन्तः समन्ततः ॥
data.md: O Brahmana, all the Pandavas, desiring to fight with and shouting to the son of Radha (to give battle) are coming (against him) from all sides.

data.v: कर्णोऽपि रथिनां श्रेष्ठश्चापमुद्यम्य वीर्यवान् । कौरवाग्र्यैः परिवृतः शक्रो देवगणैरिव । पर्यतिष्ठत तेजस्वी स्वबाहुबलमाश्रितः ॥
data.md: The puissant and energetic Karna too taking up his bow and surrounding by the foremost of the Kauravas, like Shakra by the celestials, awaited (their charge) relying on the strength of his own arms. The battle, that then took place between Karna (on one side) and the Pandavas (on the other).

data.v: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कर्णस्य सह पाण्डवैः । संरब्धस्य महाराज सिंहनादविनादितम् ॥
ततस्ते पाण्डवा राजन्पाञ्चालाश्च यशस्विनः । दृष्ट्वा कर्णं महाबाहुमुच्चैः शब्दमथानदन् ॥
अयं कर्णः कुतः कर्णस्तिष्ठ कर्ण महारणे । युध्यस्व सहितोऽस्माभिर्दुरात्मन्पुरुषाधम ॥
अन्ये तु दृष्ट्वा राधेयं क्रोधरक्तेक्षणाब्रुवन् । हन्यतामयमुत्सिक्तः सूतपुत्रोऽल्पचेतनः ॥
सर्वैः पार्थिवशार्दूलैर्नानेनार्थोऽस्ति जीवता । अत्यन्तवैरी पार्थानां सततं पापपूरुषः ॥
एष मूलं ह्यनर्थानां दुर्योधनमते स्थितः । हतैनमिति जल्पन्तः क्षत्रियाः समुपाद्रवन् ॥
महता शरवर्षेण छादयन्तो महारथाः । वधार्थं सूतपुत्रस्य पाण्डवेयेन चोदिताः ॥
तांस्तु सर्वांस्तथा दृष्ट्वा धावमानान्महारथान् । न विव्यथे सूतपुत्रो न च त्रासमगच्छत ॥
दृष्ट्वा नगरकल्पं तमुद्धूतं सैन्यसागरम् । पिप्रीषुस्तव पुत्राणां संग्रामेष्वपराजितः ॥
सायकौघेन बलवान्क्षिप्रकारी महाबलः । वारयामास तत्सैन्यं समन्ताद्भरतर्षभ ॥
ततस्तु शरवर्षेण पार्थिवास्तमवारयन् । धनूंषि ते विधुन्वानाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः । अयोधयन्त राधेयं शक्रं दैत्यगणा इव ॥
data.md: Shaking hundreds and thousands of bows, they battled with the son of Radha as the Daityas (fought with) Shakra in days of yore.

data.v: शरवर्षं तु तत्कर्णः पार्थिवैः समुदीरितम् । शरवर्षेण महता समन्ताद्व्यकिरत्प्रभो ॥
data.md: That downpour, of shafts discharged by the kings on all sides, was destroyed by the puissant Karna with a heavy shower of arrows.

data.v: तद्युद्धमभवत्तेषां कृतप्रतिकृतैषिणाम् । यथा देवासुरे युद्धे शक्रस्य सह दानवैः ॥
data.md: Then a marvellous battle, in which each party was desirous of warding off the blows of the other and which resembled the fight between Shakra and the Danavas in the war between the gods and the Asuras, took place between them. arrows

data.v: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम सूतपुत्रस्य लाघवम् । यदेनं समरे यत्ता नाप्नुवन्त परे युधि ॥
data.md: There we beheld of wonderful lighthandness of the charioteer's son : for, all the hostile forces, exerting their utmost, could not subdue him in that battle.

data.v: निवार्य च शरौघांस्तान्पार्थिवानां महारथः । युगेष्वीषासु छत्रेषु ध्वजेषु च हयेषु च । आत्मनामाङ्कितान्बाणान्राधेयः प्राहिणोच्छितान् ॥
data.md: That mighty car-warrior, the son of Radha, checking those downpours of discharged by the (hostile) kings, shot at their yokes, umbrellas, cars and steeds, dreadful arrows, marked with his own name. Then, afflicted by Karna and not knowing what to do, those (hostile) kings.

data.v: ततस्ते व्याकुलीभूता राजानः कर्णपीडिताः । बभ्रमुस्तत्र तत्रैव गावः शीतार्दिता इव ॥
हयानां वध्यमानानां गजानां रथिनां तथा । तत्र तत्राभ्यवेक्षामः संघान्कर्णेन पातितान् ॥
शिरोभिः पतितै राजन्बाहुभिश्च समन्ततः । आस्तीर्णा वसुधा सर्वा शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम् ॥
हतैश्च हन्यमानैश्च निष्टनद्भिश्च सर्वशः । बभूवायोधनं रौद्रं वैवस्वतपुरोपमम् ॥
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य विक्रमम् । अश्वत्थामानमासाद्य तदा वाक्यमुवाच ह ॥
युध्यतेऽसौ रणे कर्णो दंशितः सर्वपार्थिवैः । पश्यैतां द्रवतीं सेनां कर्णसायकपीडिताम् । कार्त्तिकेयेन विध्वस्तामासुरीं पृतनामिव ॥
data.md: Behold, the (enemy's) army, oppressed with the arrows of Karna, is, like the Asura force afflicted by Kartikeya, running away in all the directions).

data.v: दृष्ट्वैतां निर्जितां सेनां रणे कर्णेन धीमता । अभियात्येष बीभत्सुः सूतपुत्रजिघांसया ॥
data.md: Witnessing the defeat of his army by the intelligent Karna, Vibhatsu, in order to slay the charioteer's son, is advancing (against him).

data.v: तद्यथा पश्यमानानां सूतपुत्रं महारथम् । न हन्यात्पाण्डवः संख्ये तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् ॥
data.md: Adopt such measures that the son of Pandu may not kill that mighty car-warrior, i.e., the charioteer's son in battle in our very sight."

data.v: ततो द्रौणिः कृपः शल्यो हार्दिक्यश्च महारथः । प्रत्युद्ययुस्तदा पार्थं सूतपुत्रपरीप्सया ॥
data.md: (Hearing these words of the king), the son of Drona and Kripa and Shalya and that mighty car-warrior, the son of Hridika, advanced against Partha in order to protect the charioteer's son.

data.v: आयान्तं दृश्य कौन्तेयं वृत्रं देवचमूमिव । प्रत्युद्ययौ तदा कर्णो यथा शक्रः प्रतापवान् ॥
संरब्धं फल्गुनं दृष्ट्वा कालान्तकयमोपमम् । कर्णो वैकर्तनः सूत प्रत्यपद्यत्किमुत्तरम् ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said Seeing the wrathful Phalguna looking like Yama, the destroyer of time, what measures, O charioteer, did Karna, the son of Vikartana, adopt?

data.v: स ह्यस्पर्धत पार्थेन नित्यमेव महारथः । आशंसते च बीभत्सुं युद्धे जेतुं सुदारुणे ॥
data.md: That mighty car-warrior (i.e. Karna) always challenged Partha and hoped that he has powerful enough to vanquish Vibhatsu.

data.v: स तु तं सहसा प्राप्तं नित्यमत्यन्तवैरिणम् । कर्णो वैकर्तनः सूत किमुत्तरमपद्यत ॥
data.md: Thus meeting all on a sudden his inveterate enemy, what measures, O charioteer, did Karna, the son of Vikartana adopt?

data.v: आयान्तं पाण्डवं दृष्ट्वा गजः प्रतिगजं यथा । असंभ्रान्ततरः कर्णः प्रत्युदीयाद्धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Seeing the son of Pandu (advance against) his rival elephant, Karna dauntlessly fell upon Dhananjaya.

data.v: तमापतन्तं वेगेन वैकर्तनमजिह्मगैः । वारयामास तेजस्वी पाण्डवः शत्रुतापनः ॥
तं कर्णः शरजालेन छादयामास मारिष । विव्याध च सुसंक्रुद्धः शरैस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः ॥
data.md: (And) the son of Pandu covered Karna with a dense shower of arrows. Then Karna greatly excited with rage pierced him with three darts,

data.v: तस्य तल्लाघवं पार्थो नामृष्यत महाबलः । तस्मै बाणाञ्शिलाधौतान्प्रसन्नाग्रानजिह्मगान् ॥
प्राहिणोत्सूतपुत्राय त्रिंशतं शत्रुतापनः । विव्याध चैनं संरब्धो बाणेनैकेन वीर्यवान् ॥
सव्ये भुजाग्रे बलवान्नाराचेन हसन्निव । तस्य विद्धस्य वेगेन कराच्चापं पपात ह ॥
पुनरादाय तच्चापं निमेषार्धान्महाबलः । छादयामास बाणौघैः फल्गुनं कृतहस्तवत् ॥
data.md: Taking up that bow within half the time of the twinking of an eye, that highly powerful one, with great nibleness of hand, covered Phalguna with downpours of arrows.

data.v: शरवृष्टिं तु तां मुक्तां सूतपुत्रेण भारत । व्यधमच्छरवर्षेण स्मयन्निव धनंजयः ॥
data.md: The arrowy shower, sent forth by the charioteer's son, was baffled by Dhananjaya with discharges of arrows, as if with a smile, O Bharata.

data.v: तौ परस्परमासाद्य शरवर्षेण पार्थिव । छादयेतां महेष्वासौ कृतप्रतिकृतैषिणौ ॥
data.md: Those two mighty wielders of bow desiring to baffle each other and coming up to catch each other enveloped each other with a (perfect) deluge of arrows.

data.v: तदद्भुतमभूद्युद्धं कर्णपाण्डवयोर्मृधे । क्रुद्धयोर्वाशिताहेतोर्वन्ययोर्गजयोरिव ॥
data.md: Then a marvellous encounter took place between Karna and the of Pandu resembling that between two wild elephants for the sake of a she-elephant in the time of her passion.

data.v: ततः पार्थो महेष्वासो दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य विक्रमम् । मुष्टिदेशे धनुस्तस्य चिच्छेद त्वरयान्वितः ॥
data.md: Then that mighty bowman Partha, witnessing the prowess of Karna, speedily cutoff that part of his bow at which it is grasped.

data.v: अश्वांश्च चतुरो भल्लैरनयद्यमसादनम् । सारथेश्च शिरः कायादहरच्छत्रुतापनः ॥
data.md: (And) that scorcher of (his) foes (i.e. Dhananjaya) sent his horses to the abode of Yama with broad headed shafts and severed the head of his charioteer from the body. son

data.v: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं हताश्वं हतसारथिम् । विव्याध सायकैः पार्थश्चतुर्भिः पाण्डुनन्दनः ॥
data.md: Then Partha, the son of Pandu pierced that one (i.e., Karna) deprived on his steeds and driver and whose bow was cut-off with four arrows.

data.v: हताश्वात्तु रथात्तूर्णमवप्लुत्य नरर्षभः । आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं कृपस्य शरपीडितः ॥
data.md: Afflicted with arrows of Kripa that foremost of men jumped down from the car of which the steeds were slain, quickly got up to another car.

data.v: राधेयं निर्जितं दृष्ट्वा तावका भरतर्षभ । धनंजयशरैर्नुन्नाः प्राद्रवन्त दिशो दश ॥
data.md: 0 best of the Bharatas, witnessing the defeat of the son of Radha, your Partisans, (already) mangled by the shafts of Dhananjaya ran away in ten directions.

data.v: द्रवतस्तान्समालोक्य राजा दुर्योधनो नृप । निवर्तयामास तदा वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह ॥
data.md: Beholding that they were running away King Duryodhana himself rallied them and spoke these words.

data.v: अलं द्रुतेन वः शूरास्तिष्ठध्वं क्षत्रियर्षभाः । एष पार्थवधायाहं स्वयं गच्छामि संयुगे । अहं पार्थान्हनिष्यामि सपाञ्चालान्ससोमकान् ॥
data.md: Heroes, do not take to flight! O best of the Kshatriyas, stay! I am myself going against Partha in order to slay him in battle.

data.v: अद्य मे युध्यमानस्य सह गाण्डीवधन्वना । द्रक्ष्यन्ति विक्रमं पार्थाः कालस्येव युगक्षये ॥
अद्य मद्बाणजालानि विमुक्तानि सहस्रशः । द्रक्ष्यन्ति समरे योधाः शलभानामिवायतीः ॥
अद्य बाणमयं वर्षं सृजतो मम धन्विनः । जीमूतस्येव घर्मान्ते द्रक्ष्यन्ति युधि सैनिकाः ॥
जेष्याम्यद्य रणे पार्थं सायकैर्नतपर्वभिः । तिष्ठध्वं समरे शूरा भयं त्यजत फल्गुनात् ॥
न हि मद्वीर्यमासाद्य फल्गुनः प्रसहिष्यति । यथा वेलां समासाद्य सागरो मकरालयः ॥
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ राजा सैन्येन महता वृतः । फल्गुनं प्रति दुर्धर्षः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ॥
तं प्रयान्तं महाबाहुं दृष्ट्वा शारद्वतस्तदा । अश्वत्थामानमासाद्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ॥
एष राजा महाबाहुरमर्षी क्रोधमूर्छितः । पतंगवृत्तिमास्थाय फल्गुनं योद्धुमिच्छति ॥
यावन्नः पश्यमानानां प्राणान्पार्थेन संगतः । न जह्यात्पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तावद्वारय कौरवम् ॥
data.md: Resorting to the practices of the insects, (which heedless of danger rush into fire) is desiring to fight with Arjuna (heedless of his life). Prevent the Kaurava king (from doing this) before he sacrifices his life in our very sight by encountering Partha in battle. So long as he does not present himself within the range। of Kirit's shafts.

data.v: यावत्फल्गुनबाणानां गोचरं नाधिगच्छति । कौरवः पार्थिवो वीरस्तावद्वारय तं द्रुतम् ॥
यावत्पार्थशरैर्घोरैर्निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभैः । न भस्मीक्रियते राजा तावद्युद्धान्निवार्यताम् ॥
data.md: The heroic Kaurava king can only remain alive in battle. Prevent the king (from taking this rash step) before he is burnt to ashes by the dreadful arrows of Partha looking like snakes that have just cast off their sloughs. It looks very improper, O giver of hunours, that when we are here.

data.v: अयुक्तमिव पश्यामि तिष्ठत्स्वस्मासु मानद । स्वयं युद्धाय यद्राजा पार्थं यात्यसहायवान् ॥
दुर्लभं जीवितं मन्ये कौरव्यस्य किरीटिना । युध्यमानस्य पार्थेन शार्दूलेनेव हस्तिनः ॥
data.md: The king will go in person to fight in battle like one having no support. I think it will be (as) greatly difficult for Kaurava king to escape with life while fighting with Kiriti in battle, as it is in the case of an elephant (fighting with) a tiger. Thus addressed by his maternal uncle, the son of Drona, who was the foremost of those that could wield weapons.

data.v: मातुलेनैवमुक्तस्तु द्रौणिः शस्त्रभृतां वरः । दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यं त्वरितं समभाषत ॥
मयि जीवति गान्धारे न युद्धं गन्तुमर्हसि । मामनादृत्य कौरव्य तव नित्यं हितैषिणम् ॥
न हि ते संभ्रमः कार्यः पार्थस्य विजयं प्रति । अहमावारयिष्यामि पार्थं तिष्ठ सुयोधन ॥
data.md: Disregarding me who am always devoted to your welfare. O Kaurava king, you need at all be anxious for vanquishing Partha. I will myself check Partha. Stay (here), 0 Suyodhona.

data.v: आचार्यः पाण्डुपुत्रान्वै पुत्रवत्परिरक्षति । त्वमप्युपेक्षां कुरुषे तेषु नित्यं द्विजोत्तम ॥
data.md: Duryodhana said The protector protects the sons of Pandu as if they were his own children. You also never manage in right earnest with my enemies.

data.v: मम वा मन्दभाग्यत्वान्मन्दस्ते विक्रमो युधि । धर्मराजप्रियार्थं वा द्रौपद्या वा न विद्म तत् ॥
data.md: It is either owing to my ill luck or owing to your desire to do good to the Dharmaraj ihat your prowess diminishes in battle, though I do not know what is the true cause.

data.v: धिगस्तु मम लुब्धस्य यत्कृते सर्वबान्धवाः । सुखार्हाः परमं दुःखं प्राप्नुवन्त्यपराजिताः ॥
data.md: Fie on my avaricious self on whose account all the friends, solicitous of my welfare, are, being vanquished (in battle), now experiencing great misery.

data.v: को हि शस्त्रभृतां मुख्यो महेश्वरसमो युधि । शत्रून्न क्षपयेच्छक्तो यो न स्याद्गौतमीसुतः ॥
data.md: What person is there, O son of Goutama's daughter, who though capable yet would not destroy my enemies, besides you that are the foremost of those that wield weapons and are equal to Maheshvara himself in battle.

data.v: अश्वत्थामन्प्रसीदस्व नाशयैतान्ममाहितान् । तवास्त्रगोचरे शक्ताः स्थातुं देवापि नानघ ॥
data.md: O Ashvatthama, be gratified. Destroy my enemies. Neither the celestials nor thc Danavas are capable of staying within the range of your weapons.

data.v: पाञ्चालान्सोमकांश्चैव जहि द्रौणे सहानुगान् । वयं शेषान्हनिष्यामस्त्वयैव परिरक्षिताः ॥
data.md: O Drona's son, destroy the Panchalas as well as the Somakas together with all their followers. Protected by you we shall slay the rest.

data.v: एते हि सोमका विप्र पाञ्चालाश्च यशस्विनः । मम सैन्येषु संरब्धा विचरन्ति दवाग्निवत् ॥
data.md: Look, O Brahmana, the Somakas and the renowned Panchalas are ranging furiously amidst my troops like a forest fire.

data.v: तान्वारय महाबाहो केकयांश्च नरोत्तम । पुरा कुर्वन्ति निःशेषं रक्ष्यमाणाः किरीटिना ॥
data.md: O mighty-armed and most excellent of men, check the career of these and also of the Kaikayas, before, they, backed up as they are by Kiriti, destroy (all our forces).

data.v: आदौ वा यदि वा पश्चात्तवेदं कर्म मारिष । त्वमुत्पन्नो महाबाहो पाञ्चालानां वधं प्रति ॥
करिष्यसि जगत्सर्वमपाञ्चालं किलाच्युत । एवं सिद्धाब्रुवन्वाचो भविष्यति च तत्तथा ॥
न तेऽस्त्रगोचरे शक्ताः स्थातुं देवाः सवासवाः । किमु पार्थाः सपाञ्चालाः सत्यमेतद्वचो मम ॥
data.md: Not to speak of the sons of Pritha together with the Panchalas, even the very celestials together with their allies cannot stand within the range of your weapon. I speak this truly.

data.v: दुर्योधनेनैवमुक्तो द्रौणिराहवदुर्मदः । प्रत्युवाच महाबाहो यथा वदसि कौरव ॥
प्रिया हि पाण्डवा नित्यं मम चापि पितुश्च मे । तथैवावां प्रियौ तेषां न तु युद्धे कुरूद्वह । शक्तितस्तात युध्यामस्त्यक्त्वा प्राणानभीतवत् ॥
data.md: The sons of Pandu are always dear to me as well as to my father. Similarly, we too also dear to them. But this is otherwise in battle.

data.v: अहं कर्णश्च शल्यश्च कृपो हार्दिक्य एव च । निमेषात्पाण्डवीं सेनां क्षपयेम नृपोत्तम ॥
ते चापि कौरवीं सेनां निमेषार्धात्कुरूद्वह । क्षपयेयुर्महाबाहो न स्याम यदि संयुगे ॥
data.md: Can destroy the army of the Pandavas, O most excellent of kings, in the twinkling of an eye. And O best of the Kurus, O mighty armed one, they too can destroy the army of the Kauravas within the twinkling of an eye, if we are not present in battle. We are fighting with Pandavas putting forth our utmost prowess and they too are battling with us to the best of their might.

data.v: युध्यतां पाण्डवाञ्शक्त्या तेषां चास्मान्युयुत्सताम् । तेजस्तु तेज आसाद्य प्रशमं याति भारत ॥
अशक्या तरसा जेतुं पाण्डवानामनीकिनी । जीवत्सु पाण्डुपुत्रेषु तद्धि सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते ॥
आत्मार्थं युध्यमानास्ते समर्थाः पाण्डुनन्दनाः । किमर्थं तव सैन्यानि न हनिष्यन्ति भारत ॥
त्वं हि लुब्धतमो राजन्निकृतिज्ञश्च कौरव । सर्वातिशङ्की मानी च ततोऽस्मानतिशङ्कसे ॥
अहं तु यत्नमास्थाय त्वदर्थे त्यक्तजीवितः । एष गच्छामि संग्रामं त्वत्कृते कुरुनन्दन ॥
योत्स्येऽहं शत्रुभिः सार्धं जेष्यामि च वरान्वरान् । पाञ्चालैः सह योत्स्यामि सोमकैः केकयैस्तथा । पाण्डवेयैश्च संग्रामे त्वत्प्रियार्थमरिंदम ॥
data.md: In order to do what is agreeable to you, O chastiser of foes, I will fight with the Panchalas, the Somakas as well as with the Kaikeyas and the Pandavas, in battle.

data.v: अद्य मद्बाणनिर्दग्धाः पाञ्चालाः सोमकास्तथा । सिंहेनेवार्दिता गावो विद्रविष्यन्ति सर्वतः ॥
data.md: Today the Chedis, the Panchalas and the Somakas, scorched with my darts, like cows afflicted by a lion, will fly on all sides.

data.v: अद्य धर्मसुतो राजा दृष्ट्वा मम पराक्रमम् । अश्वत्थाममयं लोकं मंस्यते सह सोमकैः ॥
data.md: Witnessing my prowess today, king (Yudhishthira), the son of Dharma, together with the Somakas, will deem the whole world full of Ashvatthamas.

data.v: आगमिष्यति निर्वेदं धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः । दृष्ट्वा विनिहतान्संख्ये पाञ्चालान्सोमकैः सह ॥
data.md: Beholding the destruction of the Panchalas as well well as of the Somakas in battle, Yudhishthira, the lord of Dharma, will experience a great pain.

data.v: ये मां युद्धेऽभियोत्स्यन्ति तान्हनिष्यामि भारत । न हि ते वीर मुच्येरन्मद्बाह्वन्तरमागताः ॥
data.md: O Bharata, I will destroy all those that will confront me in battle. O hero, afflicted with the prowess of my arms no one shall escape.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुः पुत्रं दुर्योधनं तव । अभ्यवर्तत युद्धाय द्रावयन्सर्वधन्विनः । चिकीर्षुस्तव पुत्राणां प्रियं प्राणभृतां वरः ॥
data.md: Having thus addressed your Duryodhana, that one, possessed of mighty arms (i.e., Ashvatthama), distressing all bow men, proceeded to battle.

data.v: ततोऽब्रवीत्सकैकेयान्पाञ्चालान्गौतमीसुतः । प्रहरध्वमितः सर्वे मम गात्रे महारथाः । स्थिरीभूताश्च युध्यध्वं दर्शयन्तोऽस्त्रलाघवम् ॥
data.md: All of you, O mighty car-warriors, strike me in the body and displaying your dexterity in handling weapons engage in battle with calmness.

data.v: एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे शस्त्रवृष्टिमपातयन् । द्रौणिं प्रति महाराज जलं जलधरा इव ॥
data.md: Thus addressed (by Ashvatthama), all of them, O great monarch, began to discharge showers of weapons upon the son of Drona as clouds pour down showers of rain.

data.v: तान्निहत्य शरान्द्रौणिर्दश वीरानपोथयत् । प्रमुखे पाण्डुपुत्राणां धृष्टद्युम्नस्य चाभिभो ॥
data.md: having destroyed those (showers of weapons), the son of Drona, even in the very presence of the sons of Drona, even in the very presence of the sons of Pandu and in that of Dhristadyumna, slew ten (warriors) among them in battle,olord.

data.v: ते हन्यमानाः समरे पाञ्चालाः सृञ्जयास्तथा । परित्यज्य रणे द्रौणिं व्यद्रवन्त दिशो दश ॥
data.md: Sore oppressed in battle, the Panchalas and the Somakas, abandoning the son of Drona, took to flight in ten directions.

data.v: तान्दृष्ट्वा द्रवतः शूरान्पाञ्चालान्सहसोमकान् । धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज द्रौणिमभ्यद्रवद्युधि ॥
data.md: Witnessing the flight of those heroes that is, the Panchalas and the Somakas, Dhristadyumna, O great king, rushed against the son of Drona in that battle.

data.v: ततः काञ्चनचित्राणां सजलाम्बुदनादिनाम् । वृतः शतेन शूराणां रथानामनिवर्तिनाम् ॥
data.md: Then surrounded by one hundred heroic and unretreating car-warriors riding on cars adorned with gold and the rattle of which resembled the roar of clouds full of rain.

data.v: पुत्रः पाञ्चालराजस्य धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः । द्रौणिमित्यब्रवीद्वाक्यं दृष्ट्वा योधान्निपातितान् ॥
data.md: That great car-warrior, Dhristadyumna, the son of the king of Panchala, beholding the carnage of his warriors, said these words to the son of Drona.

data.v: आचार्यपुत्र दुर्बुद्धे किमन्यैर्निहतैस्तव । समागच्छ मया सार्धं यदि शूरोऽसि संयुगे । अहं त्वां निहनिष्यामि तिष्ठेदानीं ममाग्रतः ॥
data.md: O son of the preceptor, O you that are possessed of wicked understanding, why are you slaughtering the common soldiers? If you are (really) a hero, then fight with me in battle.

data.v: ततस्तमाचार्यसुतं धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान् । मर्मभिद्भिः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्जघान भरतर्षभ ॥
ते तु पङ्क्तीकृता द्रौणिं शरा विविशुराशुगाः । रुक्मपुङ्खाः प्रसन्नाग्राः सर्वकायावदारणाः । मध्वर्थिन इवोद्दामा भ्रमराः पुष्पितं द्रुमम् ॥
सोऽतिविद्धो भृशं क्रुद्धः पदाक्रान्त इवोरगः । मानी द्रौणिरसंभ्रान्तो बाणपाणिरभाषत ॥
data.md: The proud and dauntless son of Drona, (thus) deeply pierced (with Dhristdyumna's arrows) became as enraged as a serpent crushed by foot and (then), arrow in hand, thus said

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्न स्थिरो भूत्वा मुहूर्तं प्रतिपालय । यावत्त्वां निशितैर्बाणैः प्रेषयामि यमक्षयम् ॥
data.md: O Dhristadyumna, wait a moment quietly before I send "you to the abode of Yama with sharpened darts."

data.v: द्रौणिरेवमथाभाष्य पार्षतं परवीरहा । छादयामास बाणौघैः समन्ताल्लघुहस्तवत् ॥
data.md: having thus addressed the son of Prishata, the son of Drona, the slayer of hostile heroes, like one endued with great nimbleness of hand, covered him completely with deluges of arrows.

data.v: स छाद्यमानः समरे द्रौणिना युद्धदुर्मदः । द्रौणिं पाञ्चालतनयो वाग्भिरातर्जयत्तदा ॥
data.md: Thus covered (with arrows) in that battle by the son of Drona, the son of the Panchala king, invincible in battle, thundered forth these words to the son of Drona.

data.v: न जानीषे प्रतिज्ञां मे विप्रोत्पत्तिं तथैव च । द्रोणं हत्वा किल मया हन्तव्यस्त्वं सुदुर्मते । ततस्त्वाहं न हन्म्यद्य द्रोणे जीवति संयुगे ॥
data.md: O Brahmana, you are neither aware of my promise nor of my of my origin. Of wicked understanding as you are, I will slay you after killing Drona.

data.v: इमां तु रजनीं प्राप्तामप्रभातां सुदुर्मते । निहत्य पितरं तेऽद्य ततस्त्वामपि संयुगे । नेष्यामि मृत्युलोकायेत्येवं मे मनसि स्थितम् ॥
data.md: I will (first) slay your father and then send yourself too, in battle, to the abode of the departed spirits, I chariot this (thought) in my mind.

data.v: यस्ते पार्थेषु विद्वेषो या भक्तिः कौरवेषु च । तां दर्शय स्थिरो भूत्वा न मे जीवन्विमोक्ष्यसे ॥
data.md: Now assuming a quiet attitude show all your hatred towards the sons of Pritha and your devotion towards the Kauravas. You will not escape alive (from me).

data.v: यो हि ब्राह्मण्यमुत्सृज्य क्षत्रधर्मरतो द्विजः । स वध्यः सर्वलोकस्य यथा त्वं पुरुषाधम ॥
data.md: That twice-born one, who giving up the practices of the Brahmana, gives himself up to the practices of the Kshaytrias, deserves to be slain by all the Kshaytrias like you, O vilest of men."

data.v: इत्युक्तः परुषं वाक्यं पार्षतेन द्विजोत्तमः । क्रोधमाहारयत्तीव्रं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: That foremost of the twice-born ones (i.e. Ashvatthama), thus addressed in harsh words by the son of Prishata, became terrible excited with wrath and said (to Dhristadyumna) “Wait, wait."

data.v: निर्दहन्निव चक्षुर्भ्यां पार्षतं सोऽभ्यवैक्षत । छादयामास च शरैर्निःश्वसन्पन्नगो यथा ॥
data.md: (And) as if to burn the son of Prishata with his eyes, he gazed at him. Heaving sighs like a snake he covered (Dhristadyumna with arrows) in that battle.

data.v: स छाद्यमानः समरे द्रौणिना राजसत्तम । सर्वपाञ्चालसेनाभिः संवृतो रथसत्तमः ॥
data.md: Though) that foremost of car-warriors, the son of Prishata, who was surrounded by all the Panchala troops, was (thus) struck with arrows by the son of Drona in that battle,

data.v: नाकम्पत महाबाहुः स्वधैर्यं समुपाश्रितः । सायकांश्चैव विविधानश्वत्थाम्नि मुमोच ह ॥
data.md: (Yet) that mighty-armed one did not tremble; (but) resorting to his own prowess discharged at Ashvatthama numerous arrows.

data.v: तौ पुनः संन्यवर्तेतां प्राणद्यूतपरे रणे । निवारयन्तौ बाणौघैः परस्परममर्षिणौ । उत्सृजन्तौ महेष्वासौ शरवृष्टीः समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Those two (warriors), who resisted each other, baffled the arrowy showers of each other and could not tolerate each other, were engaged in the game of battle in which the wager was life itself.

data.v: द्रौणिपार्षतयोर्युद्धं घोररूपं भयानकम् । दृष्ट्वा संपूजयामासुः सिद्धचारणवातिकाः ॥
data.md: Those two mighty wielders of bow poured down showers of arrows on a sides. Beholding the fight between the son of Drona and that of one Prishata which was awe-inspiring and dreadful to look at, the Siddhas, the Charanas and the (other) sky-ranging creatures highly extolled them. Filling the firmament and (all) the directions with a downpour of arrows.

data.v: शरौघैः पूरयन्तौ तावाकाशं प्रदिशस्तथा । अलक्ष्यौ समयुध्येतां महत्कृत्वा शरैस्तमः ॥
नृत्यमानाविव रणे मण्डलीकृतकार्मुकौ । परस्परवधे यत्तौ परस्परजयैषिणौ ॥
अयुध्येतां महाबाहू चित्रं लघु च सुष्ठु च । संपूज्यमानौ समरे योधमुख्यैः सहस्रशः ॥
तौ प्रयुद्धौ रणे दृष्ट्वा वने वन्यौ गजाविव । उभयोः सेनयोर्हर्षस्तुमुलः समपद्यत ॥
सिंहनादरवाश्चासन्दध्मुः शङ्खांश्च मारिष । वादित्राण्यभ्यवाद्यन्त शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
तस्मिंस्तु तुमुले युद्धे भीरूणां भयवर्धने । मुहूर्तमिव तद्युद्धं समरूपं तदाभवत् ॥
ततो द्रौणिर्महाराज पार्षतस्य महात्मनः । ध्वजं धनुस्तथा छत्रमुभौ च पार्ष्णिसारथी । सूतमश्वांश्च चतुरो निहत्याभ्यद्रवद्रणे ॥
data.md: The encounter (between the sons of Drona and Prishata) seemed to go on equally for a moment only. Then O mighty monarch, the son of Drona, cutting off the bow, the standard, the umbrellas, the two Parshni drivers, the charioteer and the four steeds of the highsouled son of Prishata in battle, rushed against him.

data.v: पाञ्चालांश्चैव तान्सर्वान्बाणैः संनतपर्वभिः । व्यद्रावयदमेयात्मा शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: And that one, of immeasurable soul, began ! to afflict all those Panchalas in hundreds and thousands with his straight coursing arrows. Then the arıny of the Pandavas, beholding that brilliant exploit, resembling that of Vasava, achieved by the son of Drona in battle, became greatly dejected, the most exalted of the Bharatas.

data.v: ततः प्रविव्यथे सेना पाण्डवी भरतर्षभ । दृष्ट्वा द्रौणेर्महत्कर्म वासवस्येव संयुगे ॥
data.md: And that one, of immeasurable soul, began ! to afflict all those Panchalas in hundreds and thousands with his straight coursing arrows. Then the arıny of the Pandavas, beholding that brilliant exploit, resembling that of Vasava, achieved by the son of Drona in battle, became greatly dejected, the most exalted of the Bharatas.

data.v: शतेन च शतं हत्वा पाञ्चालानां महारथः । त्रिभिश्च निशितैर्बाणैर्हत्वा त्रीन्वै महारथान् ॥
data.md: Destroying one hundred mighty carwarriors of the Panchalas with a hundred arrows and slaying three foremost of (their) men with three sharpened arrows.

data.v: द्रौणिर्द्रुपदपुत्रस्य फल्गुनस्य च पश्यतः । नाशयामास पाञ्चालान्भूयिष्ठं ये व्यवस्थिताः ॥
data.md: In the very presence of Phalguna and of the son of Drupada, the son of Drona slaughtered all those Panchalas who had confronted him.

data.v: ते वध्यमानाः पाञ्चालाः समरे सह सृञ्जयैः । अगच्छन्द्रौणिमुत्सृज्य विप्रकीर्णरथध्वजाः ॥
data.md: Thus slaughtered in battle, the Panchalas together with the Srinjayas fled from the son of Drona, on their cars with their standards cut down.

data.v: स जित्वा समरे शत्रून्द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः । ननाद सुमहानादं तपान्ते जलदो यथा ॥
data.md: Having defeated his enemies in battle, that mighty car-warrior, the son of Drona, began to send forth thundering roars like those of the clouds at the end of summer.

data.v: स निहत्य बहूञ्शूरानश्वत्थामा व्यरोचत । युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि भस्म कृत्वेव पावकः ॥
data.md: Having destroyed numerous heroes, Ashvatthama shone like the fire at the end of a Yuga after having consumed all the creatures.

data.v: संपूज्यमानो युधि कौरवेयै;र्विजित्य संख्येऽरिगणान्सहस्रशः । व्यरोचत द्रोणसुतः प्रतापवा;न्यथा सुरेन्द्रोऽरिगणान्निहत्य ॥
data.md: Highly adored by the Kauravas after having vanquished thousands of enemies in battle, the puissant son of Drona shone like the lord of the celestials himself after the destruction of his foes.

data.v: ततो युधिष्ठिरश्चैव भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः । द्रोणपुत्रं महाराज समन्तात्पर्यवारयन् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then, O great monarch, king Yudhishthira and Bhimasena the son of Pandu hemmed in the son of Drona on all sides.

data.v: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा भारद्वाजेन संवृतः । अभ्ययात्पाण्डवान्संख्ये ततो युद्धमवर्तत । घोररूपं महाराज भीरूणां भयवर्धनम् ॥
data.md: King Duryodhana, then, accompanied by the son of Bharadvaja, advanced against the Pandavas in battle. Then commenced a fight.

data.v: अम्बष्ठान्मालवान्वङ्गाञ्शिबींस्त्रैगर्तकानपि । प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय गणान्क्रुद्धो युधिष्ठिरः ॥
data.md: (And) in that battle Yudhishthira sent to the region of Death, the Ambhastas, the Malavas, the heroic Trigartas and the Sivis.

data.v: अभीषाहाञ्शूरसेनान्क्षत्रियान्युद्धदुर्मदान् । निकृत्य पृथिवीं चक्रे भीमः शोणितकर्दमाम् ॥
data.md: Chopping off the Abhishahas, the Surasenas, the Valhikas and the Vashatikas, he made the earth muddy with (their) flesh and blood.

data.v: यौधेयारट्टराजन्यान्मद्रकांश्च गणान्युधि । प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय किरीटी निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: (And), O king, in a moment he sent to the region of Yama, with a number of darts, the heroic Youdheyas, the Malavas and hosts of the Madrakas in battle.

data.v: प्रगाढमञ्जोगतिभिर्नाराचैरभिपीडिताः । निपेतुर्द्विरदा भूमौ द्विशृङ्गा इव पर्वताः ॥
निकृत्तैर्हस्तिहस्तैश्च लुठमानैस्ततस्ततः । रराज वसुधा कीर्णा विसर्पद्भिरिवोरगैः ॥
क्षिप्तैः कनकचित्रैश्च नृपच्छत्रैः क्षितिर्बभौ । द्यौरिवादित्यचन्द्राद्यैर्ग्रहैः कीर्णा युगक्षये ॥
हत प्रहरताभीता विध्यत व्यवकृन्तत । इत्यासीत्तुमुलः शब्दः शोणाश्वस्य रथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Then a tumultuous uproar (such as) “Slay, seize, capture, pierce and cut to pieces”-arose in the direction of Yudhishthira's car.

data.v: द्रोणस्तु परमक्रुद्धो वायव्यास्त्रेण संयुगे । व्यधमत्तान्यथा वायुर्मेघानिव दुरत्ययः ॥
ते हन्यमाना द्रोणेन पाञ्चालाः प्राद्रवन्भयात् । पश्यतो भीमसेनस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः ॥
data.md: The Panchalas, (thus) destroyed by Drona fled away in terror in the very presence of Bhimasena and in that of the high-souled Pritha.

data.v: ततः किरीटी भीमश्च सहसा संन्यवर्तताम् । महता रथवंशेन परिगृह्य बलं तव ॥
data.md: Then Kiriti and Bhima, rallying their own ariny, all on a sudden attacked, with a great car-force, your army.

data.v: बीभत्सुर्दक्षिणं पार्श्वमुत्तरं तु वृकोदरः । भारद्वाजं शरौघाभ्यां महद्भ्यामभ्यवर्षताम् ॥
data.md: Vibhatsu attacking the right and Vrikodara the left flank (of your army), discharged at the son of Bharadvaja mighty downpours of shafts.

data.v: तौ तदा सृञ्जयाश्चैव पाञ्चालाश्च महारथाः । अन्वगच्छन्महाराज मत्स्याश्च सह सोमकैः ॥
data.md: The Kakeyas, the Srinjayas and the highly energetic Panchalas, O great king, together with the Matsyas and the Sattvata followed suit.

data.v: तथैव तव पुत्रस्य रथोदाराः प्रहारिणः । महत्या सेनया सार्धं जग्मुर्द्रोणरथं प्रति ॥
ततः सा भारती सेना वध्यमाना किरीटिना । तमसा निद्रया चैव पुनरेव व्यदीर्यत ॥
data.md: Then the Bharata army, butchered by Kiriti and (overpowered) with sleep and darkness, dispersed again.

data.v: द्रोणेन वार्यमाणास्ते स्वयं तव सुतेन च । न शक्यन्ते महाराज योधा वारयितुं तदा ॥
data.md: Although, O great king, Drona himself and your son tried to rally them, yet they were not capable of reducing the warriors to order.

data.v: सा पाण्डुपुत्रस्य शरैर्दार्यमाणा महाचमूः । तमसा संवृते लोके व्यद्रवत्सर्वतोमुखी ॥
उत्सृज्य शतशो वाहांस्तत्र केचिन्नराधिपाः । प्राद्रवन्त महाराज भयाविष्टाः समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Took to flight in all directions when the world was enveloped in darkness. Hundreds of kings, leaving their conveyances, fled away, O great monarch, in terror, on all side.

data.v: सोमदत्तं तु संप्रेक्ष्य विधुन्वानं महद्धनुः । सात्यकिः प्राह यन्तारं सोमदत्ताय मां वह ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Seeing Somadatta angrily shake his great bow, Satyaki said to his charioteer “Bear me towards Somadatta.

data.v: न ह्यहत्वा रणे शत्रुं बाह्लीकं कौरवाधमम् । निवर्तिष्ये रणात्सूत सत्यमेतद्वचो मम ॥
data.md: O charioteer, I will not return from battle today without killing my enemy-the vilest of the Kurus, the son of Valhika. These my words are true.

data.v: ततः संप्रेषयद्यन्ता सैन्धवांस्तान्महाजवान् । तुरङ्गमाञ्शङ्खवर्णान्सर्वशब्दातिगान्रणे ॥
data.md: Thereupon, (his) charioteer drove to the battle those horses oi' Sindhu breed endowed with great fleetness, having the colour of the conch and capable of bearing all the weapons.

data.v: तेऽवहन्युयुधानं तु मनोमारुतरंहसः । यथेन्द्रं हरयो राजन्पुरा दैत्यवधोद्यतम् ॥
data.md: Those (steeds), fleet as the mind or the wind, carried Yuyudhana (to the field of battle) as the horses of Indra, O king, had, in days of yore, born him who was preparing to slay the Asuras.

data.v: तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य सात्वतं रभसं रणे । सोमदत्तो महाबाहुरसंभ्रान्तोऽभ्यवर्तत ॥
data.md: Beholding Sattyata quickly proceed against him to battle, Somadatta, O mighty monarch, confronted him undauntedly.

data.v: विमुञ्चञ्शरवर्षाणि पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान् । छादयामास शैनेयं जलदो भास्करं यथा ॥
data.md: Discharging a shower of arrows as the clouds (pour down) torrents of rain, he (i.e., Somadatta) covered the grandson of Sini like the clouds (covering the sun)

data.v: असंभ्रान्तश्च समरे सात्यकिः कुरुपुंगवम् । छादयामास बाणौघैः समन्ताद्भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: 0 best of the Bharatas, the dauntless Satyaki also completely covered that most exalted the Kurus with arrowy showers in that battle.

data.v: सोमदत्तस्तु तं षष्ट्या विव्याधोरसि माधवम् । सात्यकिश्चापि तं राजन्नविध्यत्सायकैः शितैः ॥
data.md: Somadatta also pierced the descendant of Madhu in the chest with sixty arrows. Satyaki, too, O king, pierced him with keen darts.

data.v: तावन्योन्यं शरैः कृत्तौ व्यराजेतां नरर्षभौ । सुपुष्पौ पुष्पसमये पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ॥
data.md: Pierced by each other with each other's arrows, they looked like two blossoming Kinsuka trees in the following season.

data.v: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गौ कुरुवृष्णियशस्करौ । परस्परमवेक्षेतां दहन्ताविव लोचनैः ॥
data.md: With their bodies covered all over with blood, those two renowned descendants of Kuru and Vrishni eyed at each other as it (desirous of) consuming each other with their glances.

data.v: रथमण्डलमार्गेषु चरन्तावरिमर्दनौ । घोररूपौ हि तावास्तां वृष्टिमन्ताविवाम्बुदौ ॥
data.md: Those two dreadful-looking grinder of foes ranging on their cars coursing in circles, looked like two clouds pouring (torrents of) rain.

data.v: शरसंभिन्नगात्रौ तौ सर्वतः शकलीकृतौ । श्वाविधाविव राजेन्द्र व्यदृश्येतां शरक्षतौ ॥
data.md: With their bodies pierced, mangled and wounded with shafts, they looked, O king of kings, like two hedge hogs.

data.v: सुवर्णपुङ्खैरिषुभिराचितौ तौ व्यरोचताम् । खद्योतैरावृतौ राजन्प्रावृषीव वनस्पती ॥
data.md: Pierced with shafts endued with golden wings, those two (heroes), O monarch, looked as (beautiful) two lords of the forest covered with glow-worms during the rainy season.

data.v: संप्रदीपितसर्वाङ्गौ सायकैस्तौ महारथौ । अदृश्येतां रणे क्रुद्धावुल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरौ ॥
data.md: Their bodies looking resplendent with arrows (they were pierced with) those two great car-warriors appeared in that battle, like two furious elephants with their bodies covered all over with (blazing) meteors.

data.v: ततो युधि महाराज सोमदत्तो महारथः । अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद माधवस्य महद्धनुः ॥
data.md: Then, O great monarch, in that encounter, the mighty car-warrior Somadatta cut-off with cresent-shaped arrows the great bow of the descendant of Madhu.

data.v: अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकानां समार्पयत् । त्वरमाणस्त्वराकाले पुनश्च दशभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: (He) then pierced him with twenty five darts and at that time when speed was (urgently) necessary, he again speedily pierced him with ten (more) arrows.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय सात्यकिर्वेगवत्तरम् । पञ्चभिः सायकैस्तूर्णं सोमदत्तमविध्यत ॥
data.md: Thereupon Satyaki, taking up a very strong bow, speedily pierced Somadatta with five arrows.

data.v: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन ध्वजं चिच्छेद काञ्चनम् । बाह्लीकस्य रणे राजन्सात्यकिः प्रहसन्निव ॥
data.md: Then again, Oking, Satyaki, as if with a smile in that battle, cut down with another broad-headed shafts the golden standard of the son of Balhika.

data.v: सोमदत्तस्त्वसंभ्रान्तो दृष्ट्वा केतुं निपातितम् । शैनेयं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकानां समाचिनोत् ॥
data.md: Seeing his standard cut down Somadatta fearlessly pierced the grandson of Sini with twenty-five arrows.

data.v: सात्वतोऽपि रणे क्रुद्धः सोमदत्तस्य धन्विनः । धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे क्षुरप्रेण शितेन ह ॥
data.md: Filled with wrath, Satyaki also, in that engagement, cut-off with a keen and razorfaced shaft, the bow of the (great) bowman Somadatta.

data.v: अथैनं रुक्मपुङ्खानां शतेन नतपर्वणाम् । आचिनोद्बहुधा राजन्भग्नदंष्ट्रमिव द्विपम् ॥
data.md: He then, O great king, pierced him (i.e. Somadatta), who then looked like a snake with its fangs broken, with one hundred straightcoursing arrows furnished with golden wings.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय सोमदत्तो महारथः । सात्यकिं छादयामास शरवृष्ट्या महाबलः ॥
data.md: Thereupon the greatly puissant Somadatta, the great car-warrior, taking up another bow, covered Satyaki with downpours of shafts.

data.v: सोमदत्तं तु संक्रुद्धो रणे विव्याध सात्यकिः । सात्यकिं चेषुजालेन सोमदत्तो अपीडयत् ॥
data.md: Satyaki also, getting greatly excited with wrath, pierced Somadatta in that battle. Somadatta, on his part, afflicted Satyaki with showers of arrows.

data.v: दशभिः सात्वतस्यार्थे भीमोऽहन्बाह्लिकात्मजम् । सोमदत्तोऽप्यसंभ्रान्तः शैनेयमवधीच्छरैः ॥
data.md: Bhima also, for the sake of Sattvata, struck the son of Valhika with ten arrows. And the dauntless Somadatta also pierced Bhima with sharpened arrows.

data.v: ततस्तु सात्वतस्यार्थे भैमसेनिर्नवं दृढम् । मुमोच परिघं घोरं सोमदत्तस्य वक्षसि ॥
data.md: Bhimasena, also for the purpose of (helping) Satyaki, hurled a new and formidable Parigha at the head of Somadatta.

data.v: तमापतन्तं वेगेन परिघं घोरदर्शनम् । द्विधा चिच्छेद समरे प्रहसन्निव कौरवः ॥
data.md: (But the descendant of Kuru), as if with a smile, cut-off into two parts, in that engagement, that dreadful-looking Parigha so it was advancing against him.

data.v: स पपात द्विधा छिन्न आयसः परिघो महान् । महीधरस्येव महच्छिखरं वज्रदारितम् ॥
data.md: Thus severed into two parts, that great Parigha of iron, fell down (on the ground) like the great peak of a mountain riven by thunder.

data.v: ततस्तु सात्यकी राजन्सोमदत्तस्य संयुगे । धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन हस्तावापं च पञ्चभिः ॥
data.md: Then, in the engagement, o king, Satyaki cut-off the bow of Somadatta with one broadheaded arrows and with another five the leathern case that sheathed his fingers.

data.v: चतुर्भिस्तु शरैस्तूर्णं चतुरस्तुरगोत्तमान् । समीपं प्रेषयामास प्रेतराजस्य भारत ॥
data.md: Then with four darts he speedily sent before the lord of the departed spirit the four excellent horses (of Somadatta).

data.v: सारथेश्च शिरः कायाद्भल्लेन नतपर्वणा । जहार रथशार्दूलः प्रहसञ्शिनिपुंगवः ॥
data.md: And, O Bharata, that foremost of carwarriors, as if with a smile, cut-off, with a broad-headed and straight-coursing arrow, the head of his charioteer from the trunk.

data.v: ततः शरं महाघोरं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् । मुमोच सात्वतो राजन्स्वर्णपुङ्खं शिलाशितम् ॥
data.md: He then discharged (at Somadatta himself) a highly dreadful arrow, blazing like the fire, furnished with golden wings, bathed in oil and sharpened on stone.

data.v: स विमुक्तो बलवता शैनेयेन शरोत्तमः । घोरस्तस्योरसि विभो निपपाताशु भारत ॥
data.md: Shot with great force by the grandson of Sini that excellent and formidable shaft, darted like a falcon, at the chest of Somadatta.

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता सात्वतेन महारथः । सोमदत्तो महाबाहुर्निपपात ममार च ॥
data.md: The great car-warrior Somadatta, deeply pierced by the puissant Satvata, fell down (from his car) and died, O great king.

data.v: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं तत्र सोमदत्तं महारथाः । महता शरवर्षेण युयुधानमुपाद्रवन् ॥
data.md: Seeing Somadatta slain there, your soldiers proceeded against Yuyudhana with a large number of cars. arrowS

data.v: छाद्यमानं शरैर्दृष्ट्वा युयुधानं युधिष्ठिरः । महत्या सेनया सार्धं द्रोणानीकमुपाद्रवत् ॥
data.md: The Pandavas also, O mighty monarch, accompanied by all the Prabhadrakas and by a large army, made a rush upon Drona's division.

data.v: ततो युधिष्ठिरः क्रुद्धस्तावकानां महाबलम् । शरैर्विद्रावयामास भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.md: Then, Yudhishthira, filled with rage, began to crush the troops of the son of Bharadvaja with in the the very presence of Bharadvaja's son.

data.v: सैन्यानि द्रावयन्तं तु द्रोणो दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरम् । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ॥
data.md: Seeing Yudhishthira afflict your troops Drona, urged on by your son surrounded him (i.e. Yudhishthira) with arrows.

data.v: ततः सुनिशितैर्बाणैः पार्थं विव्याध सप्तभिः । सोऽतिविद्धो महाबाहुः सृक्किणी परिसंलिहन् । युधिष्ठिरस्य चिच्छेद ध्वजं कार्मुकमेव च ॥
data.md: That mighty bowman, being (thus) deeply pierced, for a moment licked the corners of his mouth and (then) cut-off the standard and also the bow of Yudhishthira.

data.v: स छिन्नधन्वा त्वरितस्त्वराकाले नृपोत्तमः । अन्यदादत्त वेगेन कार्मुकं समरे दृढम् ॥
data.md: Deprived of his bows, that excellent king took up another tough and strong bow, with great speed when speed was highly necessary.

data.v: ततः शरसहस्रेण द्रोणं विव्याध पार्थिवः । साश्वसूतध्वजरथं तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
data.md: Then with a thousand shafts, the son of Pandu pierced Drona together with his horses, charioteer, standard and car and this (feat on the part of Yudhishthira) seemed marvellous.

data.v: ततो मुहूर्तं व्यथितः शरघातप्रपीडितः । निषसाद रथोपस्थे द्रोणो भरतसत्तम ॥
data.md: In consequence of the strokes of those darts, Drona, the foremost of the Brahmanas, being (greatly) pained, sank unconsciously for a moment on the terrace of his car.

data.v: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां मुहूर्ताद्द्विजसत्तमः । क्रोधेन महताविष्टो वायव्यास्त्रमवासृजत् ॥
data.md: Then regaining his consciousness, heaving sighs like a snake and excited with a terrible wrath, he brought into existence the weapon presided over by Vayu.

data.v: असंभ्रान्तस्ततः पार्थो धनुराकृष्य वीर्यवान् । तदस्त्रमस्त्रेण रणे स्तम्भयामास भारत ॥
data.md: But the dauntless and puissant son of Pritha, in that fight taking up his bow, checked the career of that weapon with one of his own.

data.v: ततोऽब्रवीद्वासुदेवः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् । युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो यत्त्वा वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु ॥
उपारमस्व युद्धाय द्रोणाद्भरतसत्तम । गृध्यते हि सदा द्रोणो ग्रहणे तव संयुगे ॥
नानुरूपमहं मन्ये युद्धमस्य त्वया सह । योऽस्य सृष्टो विनाशाय स एनं श्वो हनिष्यति ॥
परिवर्ज्य गुरुं याहि यत्र राजा सुयोधनः । भीमश्च रथशार्दूलो युध्यते कौरवैः सह ॥
data.md: Where Dhananjaya and that most valiant of men, Bhima, with myself only to help them are fighting with (all) the Kauravas.

data.v: वासुदेववचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः । मुहूर्तं चिन्तयित्वा तु ततो दारुणमाहवम् ॥
data.md: Hearing these words of Vasudeva, the virtuous king Yudhishthira reflected for a moment and then proceeded towards the spot where the battle was raging hot and furious and where, Bhima, the slayer of his foes, taking up his station, was destroying your warriors like the (grim) Destroyer with gaping mouth.

data.v: प्रायाद्द्रुतममित्रघ्नो यत्र भीमो व्यवस्थितः । विनिघ्नंस्तावकान्योधान्व्यादितास्य इवान्तकः ॥
data.md: Hearing these words of Vasudeva, the virtuous king Yudhishthira reflected for a moment and then proceeded towards the spot where the battle was raging hot and furious and where, Bhima, the slayer of his foes, taking up his station, was destroying your warriors like the (grim) Destroyer with gaping mouth.

data.v: रथघोषेण महता नादयन्वसुधातलम् । पर्जन्य इव घर्मान्ते नादयन्वै दिशो दश ॥
data.md: Ringing the surface of the earth with the thundering rattle of his car like the roar of the clouds at the end of summer, that king of kings, Yudhishthira.

data.v: भीमस्य निघ्नतः शत्रून्पार्ष्णिं जग्राह पाण्डवः । द्रोणोऽपि पाण्डुपाञ्चालान्व्यधमद्रजनीमुखे ॥
data.md: The son of Pandu, took up his station at the flank of Bhima who was destroying the foes. Drona also began, at that nigiit, to destroy his enemies, the Panchalas.

data.v: वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे घोररूपे भयावहे । तमसा संवृते लोके रजसा च महीपते । नापश्यन्त रणे योधाः परस्परमवस्थिताः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said That terrible and awe-inspiring battle having taken place when the world was enveloped with darkness and dust, o lord of the earth.

data.v: अनुमानेन संज्ञाभिर्युद्धं तद्ववृते महत् । नरनागाश्वमथनं परमं लोमहर्षणम् ॥
द्रोणकर्णकृपा वीरा भीमपार्षतसात्यकाः । अन्योन्यं क्षोभयामासुः सैन्यानि नृपसत्तम ॥
वध्यमानानि सैन्यानि समन्तात्तैर्महारथैः । तमसा रजसा चैव समन्ताद्विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥
ते सर्वतो विद्रवन्तो योधा वित्रस्तचेतसः । अहन्यन्त महाराज धावमानाश्च संयुगे ॥
महारथसहस्राणि जघ्नुरन्योन्यमाहवे । अन्धे तमसि मूढानि पुत्रस्य तव मन्त्रिते ॥
ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि सेनागोपाश्च भारत । व्यमुह्यन्त रणे तत्र तमसा संवृते सति ॥
data.md: (And) in that blinding darkness, (the soldiers) lost their senses. (All this is no doubt due to the evil counsels of your son. And that (dismal) darkness prevailing all around, all the creatures, may the very foremost of the combatants themselves, O Bharata, were seized with terror and their senses forsook them, o Bharata in that battle.

data.v: तेषां संलोड्यमानानां पाण्डवैर्निहतौजसाम् । अन्धे तमसि मग्नानामासीत्का वो मतिस्तदा ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said When drowned in that blinding darkness you were agitated by the Pandavas and were deprived of your energy, what became the state of your minds?

data.v: कथं प्रकाशस्तेषां वा मम सैन्येषु वा पुनः । बभूव लोके तमसा तथा संजय संवृते ॥
data.md: When the world was thus enveloped with darkness, how, O Sanjaya, their and my armies were disclosed to view again!

data.v: ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि हतशिष्टानि यानि वै । सेनागोप्तॄनथादिश्य पुनर्व्यूहमकल्पयत् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then all the survivors of the slaughtered army (of the Kurus) were, in obedience to the order of their commanders, again drawn up in battle array.

data.v: द्रोणः पुरस्ताज्जघने तु शल्य;स्तथा द्रौणिः पार्श्वतः सौबलश्च । स्वयं तु सर्वाणि बलानि राज;न्राजाभ्ययाद्गोपयन्वै निशायाम् ॥
data.md: And Drona (took his station) at the van, Shalya at the rear and the sons of Drona and Subala (respectively placed themselves) at the right and left flanks (of that array). And king (Duryodhana) himself, O monarch, was, during that night, engaged in protecting all the troops.

data.v: उवाच सर्वांश्च पदातिसंघा;न्दुर्योधनः पार्थिव सान्त्वपूर्वम् । उत्सृज्य सर्वे परमायुधानि; गृह्णीत हस्तैर्ज्वलितान्प्रदीपान् ॥
data.md: (And) consoling all the foot-soldiers and also the lords of the earth, Duryodhana said to them "leaving aside your great weapons, take in hand blazing lamps.”

data.v: ते चोदिताः पार्थिवसत्तमेन; ततः प्रहृष्टा जगृहुः प्रदीपान् । सा भूय एव ध्वजिनी विभक्ता; व्यरोचताग्निप्रभया निशायाम् ॥
महाधनैराभरणैश्च दिव्यैः; शस्त्रैः प्रदीप्तैरभिसंपतद्भिः । क्षणेन सर्वे विहिताः प्रदीपा; व्यदीपयंश्च ध्वजिनीं तदाशु ॥
सर्वास्तु सेना व्यतिसेव्यमानाः; पदातिभिः पावकतैलहस्तैः । प्रकाश्यमाना ददृशुर्निशायां; यथान्तरिक्षे जलदास्तडिद्भिः ॥
data.md: Nay, all the troops thus disclosed to view by the foot-soldiers carrying oilified lamps in their hands, looked as brilliant as the clouds in the firmament during the night with flashes of lightning (plying amidst them).

data.v: प्रकाशितायां तु तथा ध्वजिन्यां; द्रोणोऽग्निकल्पः प्रतपन्समन्तात् । रराज राजेन्द्र सुवर्णवर्मा; मध्यं गतः सूर्य इवांशुमाली ॥
data.md: When the army was thus lighted up, Drona, like the fire, scorching everything around, looked resplendent, O king of kings, with his golden armour on, like the mid-day sun of blazing rays.

data.v: जाम्बूनदेष्वाभरणेषु चैव; निष्केषु शुद्धेषु शरावरेषु । पीतेषु शस्त्रेषु च पावकस्य; प्रतिप्रभास्तत्र ततो बभूवुः ॥
data.md: The lustre of the lamps (falling upon the golden Ornaments) the bright cuirasses and bow and the will-tempered weapons, was reflected from them.

data.v: गदाश्च शैक्याः परिघाश्च शुभ्रा; रथेषु शक्त्यश्च विवर्तमानाः । प्रतिप्रभा रश्मिभिराजमीढ; पुनः पुनः संजनयन्ति दीप्ताः ॥
data.md: The rays (of these lamps) falling upon maces entwined with strings, bright Parighas, cars and darts as they whirled along, created innumerable lamps.

data.v: छत्राणि बालव्यजनानुषङ्गा; दीप्ता महोल्काश्च तथैव राजन् । व्याघूर्णमानाश्च सुवर्णमाला; व्यायच्छतां तत्र तदा विरेजुः ॥
data.md: O king, umbrellas and yak-tails and scimitars and flaming brands and necklaces of gold as they were being whirled looked exceedingly brilliant.

data.v: शस्त्रप्रभाभिश्च विराजमानं; दीपप्रभाभिश्च तदा बलं तत् । प्रकाशितं चाभरणप्रभाभि;र्भृशं प्रकाशं नृपते बभूव ॥
data.md: And, O king, that army illuminated by the lustre of the weapons, by the splendour of those lamps and by the brilliancy of the ornaments, looked highly resplendent.

data.v: पीतानि शस्त्राण्यसृगुक्षितानि; वीरावधूतानि तनुद्रुहाणि । दीप्तां प्रभां प्राजनयन्त तत्र; तपात्यये विद्युदिवान्तरिक्षे ॥
data.md: Well-tempered and beautiful weapons dyed with blood and wielded by the warriors shed a blazing lustre like flashes of lightning in the firmament at the end of the hot season.

data.v: प्रकम्पितानामभिघातवेगै;रभिघ्नतां चापततां जवेन । वक्त्राण्यशोभन्त तदा नराणां; वाय्वीरितानीव महाम्बुजानि ॥
data.md: The faces, of the combatants who were trembling by the impetuosity of their speed and rushing furiously against their enemies striking them down, shone at that time like great lotuses shaken by the wind.

data.v: महावने दाव इव प्रदीप्ते; यथा प्रभा भास्करस्यापि नश्येत् । तथा तवासीद्ध्वजिनी प्रदीप्ता; महाभये भारत भीमरूपा ॥
data.md: On that dreadful night that army blazed up (by the light of those lamps) looked as terrible as the splendour of the sun during the progress of the conflagration of a great forest teeming with trees.

data.v: तत्संप्रदीप्तं बलमस्मदीयं; निशाम्य पार्थास्त्वरितास्तथैव । सर्वेषु सैन्येषु पदातिसंघा;नचोदयंस्तेऽथ चक्रुः प्रदीपान् ॥
data.md: Seeing our army (thus) lighted up, the sons of Pritha urging all their foot-soldiers through their entire army, acted in the same way (as we did).

data.v: गजे गजे सप्त कृताः प्रदीपा; रथे रथे चैव दश प्रदीपाः । द्वावश्वपृष्ठे परिपार्श्वतोऽन्ये; ध्वजेषु चान्ये जघनेषु चान्ये ॥
data.md: (And they) placed seven lamps on each elephant, ten on each car, two on the back of every horse and many on the flank and rear and the standards.

data.v: सेनासु सर्वासु च पार्श्वतोऽन्ये; पश्चात्पुरस्ताच्च समन्ततश्च । मध्ये तथान्ये ज्वलिताग्निहस्ताः; सेनाद्वयेऽपि स्म नरा विचेरुः ॥
data.md: (Innumerable) blazing lamps were placed on the flanks and the rear and the van of and within and all around the entire army. Thus were the two hosts lighted up.

data.v: सर्वेषु सैन्येषु पदातिसंघा; व्यामिश्रिता हस्तिरथाश्ववृन्दैः । मध्ये तथान्ये ज्वलिताग्निहस्ता; व्यदीपयन्पाण्डुसुतस्य सेनाम् ॥
data.md: (Innumerable) blazing lamps were placed on the flanks and the rear and the van of and within and all around the entire army. Thus were the two hosts lighted up.

data.v: तेन प्रदीप्तेन तथा प्रदीप्तं; बलं तदासीद्बलवद्बलेन । भाः कुर्वता भानुमता ग्रहेण; दिवाकरेणाग्निरिवाभितप्तः ॥
तयोः प्रभाः पृथिवीमन्तरिक्षं; सर्वा व्यतिक्रम्य दिशश्च वृद्धाः । तेन प्रकाशेन भृशं प्रकाशं; बभूव तेषां तव चैव सैन्यम् ॥
तेन प्रकाशेन दिवंगमेन; संबोधिता देवगणाश्च राजन् । गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसंघाः; समागमन्नप्सरसश्च सर्वाः ॥
तद्देवगन्धर्वसमाकुलं च; यक्षासुरेन्द्राप्सरसां गणैश्च । हतैश्च वीरैर्दिवमारुहद्भि;रायोधनं दिव्यकल्पं बभूव ॥
रथाश्वनागाकुलदीपदीप्तं; संरब्धयोधाहतविद्रुताश्वम् । महद्बलं व्यूढरथाश्वनागं; सुरासुरव्यूहसमं बभूव ॥
तच्छक्तिसंघाकुलचण्डवातं; महारथाभ्रं रथवाजिघोषम् । शस्त्रौघवर्षं रुधिराम्बुधारं; निशि प्रवृत्तं नरदेवयुद्धम् ॥
तस्मिन्महाग्निप्रतिमो महात्मा; संतापयन्पाण्डवान्विप्रमुख्यः । गभस्तिभिर्मध्यगतो यथार्को; वर्षात्यये तद्वदभून्नरेन्द्र ॥
data.md: In that encounter that foremost of the Brahmanas, he magnanimous (Drona) endued with the energy of a great fire began to afflict the Pandavas like the noon day sun, (scorching everything) at the end of the rainy season.

data.v: प्रकाशिते तथा लोके रजसा च तमोवृते । समाजग्मुरथो वीराः परस्परवधैषिणः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said The field of battle, which had been before buried in darkness and dust, being thus lighted up (by the lustre of those lamps, heroic combatants, desirous of slay-ingone another, encountered one another (in battle).

data.v: ते समेत्य रणे राजञ्शस्त्रप्रासासिधारिणः । परस्परमुदैक्षन्त परस्परकृतागसः ॥
data.md: Taking up their lances, swords and (other) weapons and encountering one another, they looked wrathfully at one another in battle, o king.

data.v: प्रदीपानां सहस्रैश्च दीप्यमानैः समन्ततः । विरराज तदा भूमिर्द्यौर्ग्रहैरिव भारत ॥
data.md: With thousands of lamps shedding their lustre all around and placed upon golden steeds adorned with gems and fed with fragrant oil.

data.v: उल्काशतैः प्रज्वलितै रणभूमिर्व्यराजत । दह्यमानेव लोकानामभावे वै वसुंधरा ॥
data.md: The field of battle, lighted up by hundreds of blazing brands, looked resplendent. Indeed, the earth seemed to be on fire like what happens at the time of universal destruction.

data.v: प्रादीप्यन्त दिशः सर्वाः प्रदीपैस्तैः समन्ततः । वर्षाप्रदोषे खद्योतैर्वृता वृक्षा इवाबभुः ॥
data.md: All the points illuminated by the light of) those lamps all around, looked (beautiful) like trees teeming with glow-worms on an evening of the rainy season.

data.v: असज्जन्त ततो वीरा वीरेष्वेव पृथक्पृथक् । नागा नागैः समाजग्मुस्तुरगाः सह वाजिभिः ॥
data.md: The, O monarch, brave warriors engaged with brave warriors. Elephants encountered elephants, horsemen (encountered) horsemen.

data.v: रथा रथवरैरेव समाजग्मुर्मुदान्विताः । तस्मिन्रात्रिमुखे घोरे पुत्रस्य तव शासनात् ॥
data.md: and car-warriors joyfully engaged with one another, during the dreadful night at the command of your son.

data.v: ततोऽर्जुनो महाराज कौरवाणामनीकिनीम् । व्यधमत्त्वरया युक्तः क्षपयन्सर्वपार्थिवान् ॥
data.md: Terrific, (indeed) was the clash of the two armies, (each) consisting of four (kinds of) forces. Then, 0 great king, Arjuna, vanquishing all the kings (on your son's side), began quickly to destroy the army of the Kauravas.

data.v: तस्मिन्प्रविष्टे संरब्धे मम पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम् । अमृष्यमाणे दुर्धर्षे किं व आसीन्मनस्तदा ॥
data.md: Dhritarastra said What, (O Sanjaya) became the state of your minds when, filled with rage, the invincible one (i.e. Arjuna) entered into my son's army?

data.v: किममन्यन्त सैन्यानि प्रविष्टे शत्रुतापने । दुर्योधनश्च किं कृत्यं प्राप्तकालममन्यत ॥
data.md: What did (my) forces do then when that sorcher of foes penetrated into them? (And) what course, (best) suited to that occasion, did Duryodhana think to adopt?

data.v: के चैनं समरे वीरं प्रत्युद्ययुररिंदमम् । केऽरक्षन्दक्षिणं चक्रं के च द्रोणस्य सव्यतः ॥
data.md: What chastisers of foes opposed (the career of) that hero? Who were they that protected Drona when Shetavahana entered into our army)?

data.v: के पृष्ठतोऽस्य ह्यभवन्वीरा वीरस्य युध्यतः । के पुरस्तादगच्छन्त निघ्नतः शात्रवान्रणे ॥
यत्प्राविशन्महेष्वासः पाञ्चालानपराजितः । नृत्यन्निव नरव्याघ्रो रथमार्गेषु वीर्यवान् ॥
data.md: Indeed, when that invincible, puissant and mighty bowman, endued with the valour of a tiger, penetrated into the midst of the Panchalas, dancing as it were along the track of his car and destroying his enemies in battle, who were they that came to his front? How did Drona who consumed large troops of cars of the Panchalas.

data.v: ददाह च शरैर्द्रोणः पाञ्चालानां रथव्रजान् । धूमकेतुरिव क्रुद्धः स कथं मृत्युमीयिवान् ॥
अव्यग्रानेव हि परान्कथयस्यपराजितान् । हतांश्चैव विषण्णांश्च विप्रकीर्णांश्च शंससि । रथिनो विरथांश्चैव कृतान्युद्धेषु मामकान् ॥
data.md: Cheerful and impetuous in battle. But, O Sanjaya, you do not speak so of my warriors. You speak of them as slain, pale and routed and of my car-warriors as (always) made carless in the battle?

data.v: द्रोणस्य मतमाज्ञाय योद्धुकामस्य तां निशाम् । दुर्योधनो महाराज वश्यान्भ्रातॄनभाषत ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Aware of the intentions of Drona as desirous of fighting during that night, Duryodhana, O mighty monarch, addressed his obedient brothers.

data.v: विकर्णं चित्रसेनं च महाबाहुं च कौरवम् । दुर्धर्षं दीर्घबाहुं च ये च तेषां पदानुगाः ॥
data.md: (Namely) Vikarna, Chitrasena, Suparsa, Durdharsha and Dirghabahu and all their followers sayingद्रोणं यत्ताः परक्रान्ताः सर्वे रक्षन्तु पृष्ठतः।

data.v: द्रोणं यत्ताः पराक्रान्ताः सर्वे रक्षत पृष्ठतः । हार्दिक्यो दक्षिणं चक्रं शल्यश्चैवोत्तरं तथा ॥
data.md: O powerful (heroes), all of your carefully protect Drona from the rear. Let the son of Hridika (protect) his right car-wheel and Shalya the left.

data.v: त्रिगर्तानां च ये शूरा हतशिष्टा महारथाः । तांश्चैव सर्वान्पुत्रस्ते समचोदयदग्रतः ॥
data.md: Then your son commanded all the survivors of the heroic Trigarta warriors to place themselves in the van (saying).

data.v: आचार्यो हि सुसंयत्तो भृशं यत्ताश्च पाण्डवाः । तं रक्षत सुसंयत्ता निघ्नन्तं शात्रवान्रणे ॥
data.md: The preceptor is of benevolent disposition and the Pandavas are trying their utmost (to slay him). United together you will protect him while he will be engaged in destroying his enemies in battle.

data.v: द्रोणो हि बलवान्युद्धे क्षिप्रहस्तः पराक्रमी । निर्जयेत्त्रिदशान्युद्धे किमु पार्थान्ससोमकान् ॥
data.md: Drona is powerful in battle, is endued with nimbleness of hand and is puissant. Not to speak of Pandavas united with the Somakas, he is competent to vanquish even the very gods in battle.

data.v: ते यूयं सहिताः सर्वे भृशं यत्ता महारथाः । द्रोणं रक्षत पाञ्चाल्याद्धृष्टद्युम्नान्महारथात् ॥
data.md: United together and exerting your very best in (this) dreadful engagement, all of you protect Drona from that invincible and mighty car-warrior Dhristadyumna.

data.v: पाण्डवेयेषु सैन्येषु योधं पश्याम्यहं न तम् । यो जयेत रणे द्रोणं धृष्टद्युम्नादृते नृपाः ॥
data.md: I do not find any one among the warriors of the Pandavas except Dhristadyumna, that is capable of defeating Drona in battle.

data.v: तस्य सर्वात्मना मन्ये भारद्वाजस्य रक्षणम् । स गुप्तः सोमकान्हन्यात्सृञ्जयांश्च सराजकान् ॥
data.md: I therefore think we should apply our whole heart and soul to protection of the son of Bharadvaja. (If) protected (by us) he will gradually destroy the Somakas as well as the Srinjayas.

data.v: सृञ्जयेष्वथ सर्वेषु निहतेषु चमूमुखे । धृष्टद्युम्नं रणे द्रौणिर्नाशयिष्यत्यसंशयम् ॥
data.md: When all the Srinjayas, (placed) in the van of the (Pandava) army will be destroyed, the son of Drona will undoubtedly slay Dhristadyumna in battle.

data.v: तथार्जुनं रणे कर्णो विजेष्यति महारथः । भीमसेनमहं चापि युद्धे जेष्यामि दंशितः ॥
data.md: Similarly the great car-warrior Karna will vanquish Arjuna in battle. (And) I will myself destroy Bhimasena and others clad in mail in battle.

data.v: सोऽयं मम जयो व्यक्तं दीर्घकालं भविष्यति । तस्माद्रक्षत संग्रामे द्रोणमेव महारथाः ॥
