इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठ पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव । व्यादिदेश ततः सैन्यं तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे ॥
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं रात्रौ तद्भरतर्षभ । उभयोः सेनयोर्घोरं विजयं प्रति काङ्क्षिणोः ॥
अर्जुनः कौरवं सैन्यमर्जुनं चापि कौरवाः । नानाशस्त्रसमावापैरन्योन्यं पर्यपीडयन् ॥
द्रौणिः पाञ्चालराजानं भारद्वाजश्च सृञ्जयान् । छादयामासतुः संख्ये शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥
पाण्डुपाञ्चालसेनानां कौरवाणां च मारिष । आसीन्निष्टानको घोरो निघ्नतामितरेतरम् ॥
नैवास्माभिर्न पूर्वैर्नो दृष्टं पूर्वं तथाविधम् । युद्धं यादृशमेवासीत्तां रात्रिं सुमहाभयम् ॥
data.md: Fell to destroying one another there arose a dreadful uproar. Neither ourselves nor those who preceded us, had (previously) witnessed such a furious and dreadful battle as took place during that night.

data.v: वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे रात्रियुद्धे विशां पते । सर्वभूतक्षयकरे धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥
अब्रवीत्पाण्डवांश्चैव पाञ्चालांश्च ससोमकान् । अभ्यद्रवत गच्छध्वं द्रोणमेव जिघांसया ॥
राज्ञस्ते वचनाद्राजन्पाञ्चालाः सोमकास्तथा । द्रोणमेवाभ्यवर्तन्त नदन्तो भैरवान्रवान् ॥
data.md: In obedience to the commands of the king, the Panchalas as well as the Srinjayas O monarch, sending forth thundering roars, rushed against Drona alone.

data.v: तान्वयं प्रतिगर्जन्तः प्रत्युद्यातास्त्वमर्षिताः । यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं यथासत्त्वं च संयुगे ॥
data.md: We two, on our part, roaring in return and filled with wrath, rushed against them, in battle, to the full measure of our prowess, enthusiasm and courage.

data.v: कृतवर्मा च हार्दिक्यो युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत् । द्रोणं प्रति जिघांसन्तं मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम् ॥
data.md: Kritavarman, the son of Hridika, rushed against Yudhishthira as he was advancing against Drona like a mad elephant against its infuriate rival.

data.v: शैनेयं शरवर्षाणि विकिरन्तं समन्ततः । अभ्ययात्कौरवो राजन्भूरिः संग्राममूर्धनि ॥
data.md: (Similarly), O king, Bhuri, the crusher (of his foes) in battle who belonged to the Kuru party rushed against the grandson of Sini (as he came forward) scattering showers of arrows on all sides.

data.v: सहदेवमथायान्तं द्रोणप्रेप्सुं महारथम् । कर्णो वैकर्तनो राजन्वारयामास पाण्डवम् ॥
data.md: Again, O king, Karna, the son of Vikartana, checked that mighty car-warriors Sahadeva, the son of Pandu, as he, actuated with the desire of taking Drona, was advancing (against him).

data.v: भीमसेनमथायान्तं व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम् । स्वयं दुर्योधनो युद्धे प्रतीपं मृत्युमाव्रजत् ॥
data.md: Duryodhana himself rushed against Bhimasena, the foremost of car-warriors, in that engagement, who was advancing on his car (against Drona) like the grim Destroyer.

data.v: नकुलं च युधां श्रेष्ठं सर्वयुद्धविशारदम् । शकुनिः सौबलो राजन्वारयामास सत्वरः ॥
data.md: Shakuni, the son of Subala, O king, quickly opposed Nakula, the best of warriors and skilled in every (sort of) battle.

data.v: शिखण्डिनमथायान्तं रथेन रथिनां वरम् । कृपो शारद्वतो राजन्वारयामास संयुगे ॥
data.md: Similarly, in that encounter, Kripa, the son of Saradvata, opposed Shikhandi, the foremost of car-warriors, (who was) advancing on his car, Oking.

data.v: प्रतिविन्ध्यमथायान्तं मयूरसदृशैर्हयैः । दुःशासनो महाराज यत्तो यत्तमवारयत् ॥
data.md: In like manner, . great monarch, Dushasana, with utmost exertions, checked Prativindhya, who was resolutely advancing (on his car drawn by) heroes, (beautiful) as peacocks.

data.v: भैमसेनिमथायान्तं मायाशतविशारदम् । अश्वत्थामा पितुर्मानं कुर्वाणः प्रत्यषेधयत् ॥
data.md: Similarly, O mighty monarch, Ashvatthama checked the career of the son of Bhimasena, viz., the Rakshasa (Ghatotkacha) skilled in a hundred sorts of illusions.

data.v: द्रुपदं वृषसेनस्तु ससैन्यं सपदानुगम् । वारयामास समरे द्रोणप्रेप्सुं महारथम् ॥
data.md: In that engagement Vrishasena resisted the highly puissant Drupada, (who) accompanied by his troops and retainers, (advanced forward) with the desire of slaying Drona.

data.v: विराटं द्रुतमायान्तं द्रोणस्य निधनं प्रति । मद्रराजः सुसंक्रुद्धो वारयामास भारत ॥
data.md: 0 Bharata, O great monarch, the king of Madra, inflamed with rage, opposed Virata who was advancing quickly for slaying Drona.

data.v: शतानीकमथायान्तं नाकुलिं रभसं रणे । चित्रसेनो रुरोधाशु शरैर्द्रोणवधेप्सया ॥
data.md: Similarly, in that encounter, Chitrasena, with showers of arrows, checked the impetuous Sataneeka the son of Nakula, as he was advancing for the purpose of taking the life of Drona.

data.v: अर्जुनं च युधां श्रेष्ठं प्राद्रवन्तं महारथम् । अलम्बुसो महाराज राक्षसेन्द्रो न्यवारयत् ॥
data.md: O great king, Alambusha, the lord of the Rakshasas, resisted the rapid career of the mighty car-warrior Arjuna, the foremost of warriors.

data.v: तथा द्रोणं महेष्वासं निघ्नन्तं शात्रवान्रणे । धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ पाञ्चाल्यो हृष्टरूपमवारयत् ॥
data.md: Then Dhristadyumna, the son of the Panchala king, gladly resisted the mighty bowman Drona (who was) destroying his enemies.

data.v: तथान्यान्पाण्डुपुत्राणां समायातान्महारथान् । तावका रथिनो राजन्वारयामासुरोजसा ॥
data.md: Similarly, o king, your car-warriors energetically opposed other great car-warriors of the sons of Pandu, who were advancing (Against Drona).

data.v: गजारोहा गजैस्तूर्णं संनिपत्य महामृधे । योधयन्तः स्म दृश्यन्ते शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: Hundreds and thousands of warriors, mounted on elephants, speedily encountering riders on elephants in that great engagement, began to fight with and crush one another.

data.v: निशीथे तुरगा राजन्नाद्रवन्तः परस्परम् । समदृश्यन्त वेगेन पक्षवन्त इवाद्रयः ॥
data.md: O king, at dead of night, horses, rushing furiously against one another, looked like mountains endued with wings.

data.v: सादिनः सादिभिः सार्धं प्रासशक्त्यृष्टिपाणयः । समागच्छन्महाराज विनदन्तः पृथक्पृथक् ॥
data.md: O mighty monarch, taking up lances, darts and swords in their hands and sending forth loud shouts, horsemen closed with horsemen.

data.v: नरास्तु बहवस्तत्र समाजग्मुः परस्परम् । गदाभिर्मुसलैश्चैव नानाशस्त्रैश्च संघशः ॥
data.md: There (on the field of battle) large numbers of men destroyed one another in heaps, by means of maces, short clubs and several other weapons.

data.v: कृतवर्मा तु हार्दिक्यो धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् । वारयामास संक्रुद्धो वेलेवोद्वृत्तमर्णवम् ॥
data.md: Kritavarma, the son of Hridika, inflamed with rage, resisted Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, as the place between the high and the low tide-marks (resists) the ocean.

data.v: युधिष्ठिरस्तु हार्दिक्यं विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः । पुनर्विव्याध विंशत्या तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira, also piercing the son of Hridika with five darts and again piercing him with twenty (more), said-"wait, wait."

data.v: कृतवर्मा तु संक्रुद्धो धर्मपुत्रस्य मारिष । धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन तं च विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥
data.md: O worshipful sire, Kritavarma too, fired with rage, cut-off the bow of the Dharmaraja with a broad-headed dart and then pierced him with seven (arrows).

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः । हार्दिक्यं दशभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत् ॥
data.md: Then that mighty car-warrior, that is, the son of Dharma, taking up another bow, struck the son of Hridika on the arms and the chest with ten arrows.

data.v: माधवस्तु रणे विद्धो धर्मपुत्रेण मारिष । प्राकम्पत च रोषेण सप्तभिश्चार्दयच्छरैः ॥
data.md: Pierced in (that) battle by the son of Dharma, O worshipful sire, the descendant of Madhu (i.e. Kritavarma) trembled in ire and (then) afflicted (Yudhishthira) with seven arrows.

data.v: तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा हस्तावापं निकृत्य च । प्राहिणोन्निशितान्बाणान्पञ्च राजञ्शिलाशितान् ॥
data.md: The son of Pritha (however), cutting off his bow and armlet, shot at him, O king, five keen and broad-headed shafts sharpened on stone.

data.v: ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा हेमचित्रं महाधनम् । प्राविशन्धरणीमुग्रा वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः ॥
data.md: Penetrating through his precious armour ornamented with gold, those fierce shafts entered into the earth like snakes (entering into) ant-hill.

data.v: अक्ष्णोर्निमेषमात्रेण सोऽन्यदादाय कार्मुकम् । विव्याध पाण्डवं षष्ट्या सूतं च नवभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: Taking up another bow in the twinkling of an eye, he pierced the son of Pandu with six and again with ten arrows.

data.v: तस्य शक्तिममेयात्मा पाण्डवो भुजगोपमाम् । चिक्षेप भरतश्रेष्ठ रथे न्यस्य महद्धनुः ॥
data.md: Then that Pandava, of immeasurable soul, placing his mighty bow on the car, hurled at him (i.e. Kritavarman) a dart (fierce) as a snake.

data.v: सा हेमचित्रा महती पाण्डवेन प्रवेरिता । निर्भिद्य दक्षिणं बाहुं प्राविशद्धरणीतलम् ॥
data.md: Hurled by the son of Pandu that formidable (dart) ornamented with gold, penetrating through the right arm (of Kritavarma) entered into the bottom of the earth.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु गृह्य पार्थः पुनर्धनुः । हार्दिक्यं छादयामास शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥
data.md: In the meantime, the son of Pritha, taking up his mighty bow covered the son of Hridika with straight shafts.

data.v: ततस्तु समरे शूरो वृष्णीनां प्रवरो रथी । व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे निमेषार्धाद्युधिष्ठिरम् ॥
data.md: Then there (on the field of battle) that hero, that foremost car-warrior among the Vrishnis, within half the time of the twinkling of an eye, deprived Yudhishthira of his horse, driver and car.

data.v: ततस्तु पाण्डवो ज्येष्ठः खड्गचर्म समाददे । तदस्य निशितैर्बाणैर्व्यधमन्माधवो रणे ॥
data.md: Then the eldest son of Pandu took up a sword and shield. But the descendant of Madhu cut-off those two with sharpened and broad headed shafts in that battle.

data.v: तोमरं तु ततो गृह्य स्वर्णदण्डं दुरासदम् । प्रेषयत्समरे तूर्णं हार्दिक्यस्य युधिष्ठिरः ॥
data.md: Thereupon, taking up a formidable lance furnished with a golden handle, (Yudhishthira) hurled it, quickly in that engagement, against the high-souled son of Hridika.

data.v: तमापतन्तं सहसा धर्मराजभुजच्युतम् । द्विधा चिच्छेद हार्दिक्यः कृतहस्तः स्मयन्निव ॥
data.md: (But) the light-handed son of Hridika, as if with a smile, cut-off into two parts, that (formidable lance), as it, hurled by the hand of Yudhishthira careered impetuously along.

data.v: ततः शरशतेनाजौ धर्मपुत्रमवाकिरत् । कवचं चास्य संक्रुद्धः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरदारयत् ॥
data.md: Then, in that encounter, he covered the son of Dharma with hundreds of shafts; (and then), inflamed with ire he cut-off the armour of (Yudhishthira) with showers of arrows.

data.v: हार्दिक्यशरसंछिन्नं कवचं तन्महात्मनः । व्यशीर्यत रणे राजंस्ताराजालमिवाम्बरात् ॥
data.md: Cut off into a hundred fragments with the arrows of the son of Hridika, (the armour of Yudhishthira) ornamented with gold, fell down, scattered in that battle, O monarch (from its body) like a cluster of stars (dropping from) the sky.

data.v: स छिन्नधन्वा विरथः शीर्णवर्मा शरार्दितः । अपायासीद्रणात्तूर्णं धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥
data.md: With his coat of mail cut-off, deprived of his car and afflicted with the arrows of Krigavarma, Yudhishthira the son of Dharma, quickly withdrew from (the field of) battle.

data.v: कृतवर्मा तु निर्जित्य धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् । पुनर्द्रोणस्य जुगुपे चक्रमेव महाबलः ॥
data.md: Having defeated Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, the mighty car-warrior Kritavarma again engaged himself in protecting the carwheels of Drona.

data.v: भूरिस्तु समरे राजञ्शैनेयं रथिनां वरम् । आपतन्तमपासेधत्प्रपानादिव कुञ्जरम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Bhuri also, 0 monarch, in (that) engagement, checked the grandson of Sini who rushing along like elephant (descending) from a gradually sloping ground.

data.v: अथैनं सात्यकिः क्रुद्धः पञ्चभिर्निशितैः शरैः । विव्याध हृदये तूर्णं प्रास्रवत्तस्य शोणितम् ॥
data.md: Inflamed with wrath, Satyaki, then, pierced him in the heart with five sharpened arrows. (Thus struck) his blood began to flow.

data.v: तथैव कौरवो युद्धे शैनेयं युद्धदुर्मदम् । दशभिर्विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैरविध्यत भुजान्तरे ॥
data.md: Similarly, the descendant of Kuru (i.e. Bhurij, in (that) engagement, quickly pierced the grandson of Sini invincible in battle, in the chest, with ten darts.

data.v: तावन्योन्यं महाराज ततक्षाते शरैर्भृशम् । क्रोधसंरक्तनयनौ क्रोधाद्विस्फार्य कार्मुके ॥
data.md: (And), O great king, their eyes blood-shot in rage and drawing their bows powerfully, those two (heroes) began to mangle each other.

data.v: तयोरासीन्महाराज शस्त्रवृष्टिः सुदारुणा । क्रुद्धयोः सायकमुचोर्यमान्तकनिकाशयोः ॥
data.md: Inflamed with wrath and looking like Death (itself) or the sun, those two (warriors commenced (to shower upon each other) terrible downpours of shafts, 0 mighty monarch.

data.v: तावन्योन्यं शरै राजन्प्रच्छाद्य समरे स्थितौ । मुहूर्तं चैव तद्युद्धं समरूपमिवाभवत् ॥
data.md: The battle, O great king, between those two (heroes), who, covering each other (with arrows) stood (face to face) in (that) encounter, went on equally for a moment only.

data.v: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज शैनेयः प्रहसन्निव । धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे कौरव्यस्य महात्मनः ॥
data.md: Then, O mighty monarch, the grandson of Sini, fired with rage, cut-off, as it were, with a smile, the bow of that high-souled descendant of Kuru, in (that) engagement.

data.v: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः । विव्याध हृदये तूर्णं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Then he quickly pierced that (warrior) whose bow was cut-off, in the chest, with nine sharpened arrows and said (to him) “wait, wait."

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुतापनः । धनुरन्यत्समादाय सात्वतं प्रत्यविध्यत ॥
data.md: That scorcher of foes, (thus) deeply pierced by his powerful antagonist, took up another bow and pierced Satvata in return.

data.v: स विद्ध्वा सात्वतं बाणैस्त्रिभिरेव विशां पते । धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन सुतीक्ष्णेन हसन्निव ॥
data.md: O lord of the earth, having pierced Satvata with three arrows, he cut-off his bow, as it were, with a smile, by means of a very keen and broad-headed shaft.

data.v: छिन्नधन्वा महाराज सात्यकिः क्रोधमूर्छितः । प्रजहार महावेगां शक्तिं तस्य महोरसि ॥
data.md: Ogreat king, his bow being (thus) cut-off, Satyaki, insensible with wrath, hurled an impetuous dart at the broad chest of that (Kuru hero).

data.v: स तु शक्त्या विभिन्नाङ्गो निपपात रथोत्तमात् । लोहिताङ्ग इवाकाशाद्दीप्तरश्मिर्यदृच्छया ॥
data.md: His body being riven by that dart, he fell down from his excellent car like the blazing Mars (dropping down) from the firmament.

data.v: तं तु दृष्ट्वा हतं शूरमश्वत्थामा महारथः । अभ्यधावत वेगेन शैनेयं प्रति संयुगे । अभ्यवर्षच्छरौघेण मेरुं वृष्ट्या यथाम्बुदः ॥
data.md: The mighty car-warrior Ashvatthama witnessing the slaughter of that hero, rushed impetuously, O descendant of Bharata, against the grandson of Shini.

data.v: तमापतन्तं संरब्धं शैनेयस्य रथं प्रति । घटोत्कचोऽब्रवीद्राजन्नादं मुक्त्वा महारथः ॥
data.md: (Thereupon), the mighty car-warrior Ghatotkacha, sending forth a loud shout, said to him (i.e., Ashvatthama) who was rushing furiously towards the car of the grandson of Shini.

data.v: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ न मे जीवन्द्रोणपुत्र गमिष्यसि । एष त्वाद्य हनिष्यामि महिषं स्कन्दराडिव । युद्धश्रद्धामहं तेऽद्य विनेष्यामि रणाजिरे ॥
data.md: “Wait, wait. O son of Drona, you shall not escape alive. I will presently destroy you as the six-faced (Kartikeya) slew the (Asura) Mahisha in days of yore).

data.v: इत्युक्त्वा रोषताम्राक्षो राक्षसः परवीरहा । द्रौणिमभ्यद्रवत्क्रुद्धो गजेन्द्रमिव केसरी ॥
रथाक्षमात्रैरिषुभिरभ्यवर्षद्घटोत्कचः । रथिनामृषभं द्रौणिं धाराभिरिव तोयदः ॥
शरवृष्टिं तु तां प्राप्तां शरैराशीविषोपमैः । शातयामास समरे तरसा द्रौणिरुत्स्मयन् ॥
data.md: The son of Drona, the foremost of carwarriors as the clouds (pour down) showers of rain. The son of Drona, however, in that engagement, quickly baffled that arrowy down pour by means of shafts resembling poisonous snakes. Then with a hundred keen darts, capable of piercing the vital parts and coursing rapidly.

data.v: ततः शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मर्मभेदिभिराशुगैः । समाचिनोद्राक्षसेन्द्रं घटोत्कचमरिंदम ॥
स शरैराचितस्तेन राक्षसो रणमूर्धनि । व्यकाशत महाराज श्वाविच्छललितो यथा ॥
ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टो भैमसेनिः प्रतापवान् । शरैरवचकर्तोग्रैर्द्रौणिं वज्राशनिस्वनैः ॥
क्षुरप्रैरर्धचन्द्रैश्च नाराचैः सशिलीमुखैः । वराहकर्णैर्नालीकैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चापि विकर्णिभिः ॥
तां शस्त्रवृष्टिमतुलां वज्राशनिसमस्वनाम् । पतन्तीमुपरि क्रुद्धो द्रौणिरव्यथितेन्द्रियः ॥
सुदुःसहां शरैर्घोरैर्दिव्यास्त्रप्रतिमन्त्रितैः । व्यधमत्स महातेजा महाभ्राणीव मारुतः ॥
ततोऽन्तरिक्षे बाणानां संग्रामोऽन्य इवाभवत् । घोररूपो महाराज योधानां हर्षवर्धनः ॥
ततोऽस्त्रसंघर्षकृतैर्विस्फुलिङ्गैः समन्ततः । बभौ निशामुखे व्योम खद्योतैरिव संवृतम् ॥
स मार्गणगणैर्द्रौणिर्दिशः प्रच्छाद्य सर्वतः । प्रियार्थं तव पुत्राणां राक्षसं समवाकिरत् ॥
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं द्रौणिराक्षसयोर्मृधे । विगाढे रजनीमध्ये शक्रप्रह्रादयोरिव ॥
data.md: Then the battle between those two roaring heroes, viz., Karna and that Rakshasa, commenced resembling O foremost of kings that between Shakra and Pralhada in days gone by.

data.v: ततो घटोत्कचो बाणैर्दशभिर्द्रौणिमाहवे । जघानोरसि संक्रुद्धः कालज्वलनसंनिभैः ॥
स तैरभ्यायतैर्विद्धो राक्षसेन महाबलः । चचाल समरे द्रौणिर्वातनुन्न इव द्रुमः । स मोहमनुसंप्राप्तो ध्वजयष्टिं समाश्रितः ॥
ततो हाहाकृतं सैन्यं तव सर्वं जनाधिप । हतं स्म मेनिरे सर्वे तावकास्तं विशां पते ॥
data.md: Thereupon all your forces, O lord of men, set up a loud wail. (And) all your partisans, O lord of the earth, thought him to be dead.

data.v: तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथावस्थमश्वत्थामानमाहवे । पाञ्चालाः सृञ्जयाश्चैव सिंहनादं प्रचक्रिरे ॥
data.md: Seeing Ashvatthama in that state, the Panchalas as well as the Srinjayas, in that encounter, sent forth roars like lions.

data.v: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञामश्वत्थामा महाबलः । धनुः प्रपीड्य वामेन करेणामित्रकर्शनः ॥
data.md: Regaining his consciousness, that grinder of foes, the mighty car-warriors Ashvatthama, drawing powerfully his bow with the left hand.

data.v: मुमोचाकर्णपूर्णेन धनुषा शरमुत्तमम् । यमदण्डोपमं घोरमुद्दिश्याशु घटोत्कचम् ॥
data.md: Shot quickly from his bow, the string of which was) stretched up to the very ear, an excellent arrow, formidable as the rod of Yama, which was aimed at Ghatotkacha.

data.v: स भित्त्वा हृदयं तस्य राक्षसस्य शरोत्तमः । विवेश वसुधामुग्रः सुपुङ्खः पृथिवीपते ॥
data.md: O Lord of earth, that great arrow furnished with beautiful wings, riving the heart of that Rakshasa, penetrated into the earth.

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् । राक्षसेन्द्रः सुबलवान्द्रौणिना रणमानिना ॥
data.md: O great monarch, the puissant lord of the Rakshasas, pierced home by the son of Drona, proud of (his feats in) battle, sat down on the terrace of his car.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा विमूढं हैडिम्बं सारथिस्तं रणाजिरात् । द्रौणेः सकाशात्संभ्रान्तस्त्वपनिन्ये त्वरान्वितः ॥
data.md: Seeing that the son of Hidimva had lost his consciousness, his charioteer, struck with fear, hastily removed him from the field of battle and from the presence of the son of Drona.

data.v: तथा तु समरे विद्ध्वा राक्षसेन्द्रं घटोत्कचम् । ननाद सुमहानादं द्रोणपुत्रो महाबलः ॥
data.md: Having, in that engagement, thus pierced Ghatotkacha, the lord of the Rakshasas, that great car-warrior, the son of Drona sent forth a highly dreadful roar.

data.v: पूजितस्तव पुत्रैश्च सर्वयोधैश्च भारत । वपुषा प्रतिजज्वाल मध्याह्न इव भास्करः ॥
data.md: O Bharata, adored by your sons and all the warriors, his body shone brilliantly like the noon-day sun.

data.v: भीमसेनं तु युध्यन्तं भारद्वाजरथं प्रति । स्वयं दुर्योधनो राजा प्रत्यविध्यच्छितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: King Duryodhana himself pierced with keen arrows Bhimasena who was fighting his way, through your army, towards the car of the son of Bharadvaja.

data.v: तं भीमसेनो नवभिः शरैर्विव्याध मारिष । दुर्योधनोऽपि विंशत्या शराणां प्रत्यविध्यत ॥
data.md: O Bharata, Bhimasena pierced him in return with nine darts. Duryodhana also pierced him with twenty arrows.

data.v: तौ सायकैरवच्छन्नावदृश्येतां रणाजिरे । मेघजालसमाच्छन्नौ नभसीवेन्दुभास्करौ ॥
data.md: Those two (horses), shrouded with arrows on the field of battle, looked like the sun and the moon covered with masses of clouds in the firmament.

data.v: अथ दुर्योधनो राजा भीमं विव्याध पत्रिभिः । पञ्चभिर्भरतश्रेष्ठ तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Then king Duryodhana pierced Bhima, O foremost of the descendants of Bharata, with five arrows and said (to him) “Wait, wait.”

data.v: तस्य भीमो धनुश्छित्त्वा ध्वजं च नवभिः शरैः । विव्याध कौरवश्रेष्ठं नवत्या नतपर्वणाम् ॥
data.md: But Bhima, cutting off his bow and his standard with sharpened arrows, pierced the lord of the Kauravas with nine straight darts.

data.v: ततो दुर्योधनः क्रुद्धो भीमसेनस्य मारिष । चिक्षेप स शरान्राजन्पश्यतां सर्वधन्विनाम् ॥
तान्निहत्य शरान्भीमो दुर्योधनधनुश्च्युतान् । कौरवं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समार्पयत् ॥
दुर्योधनस्तु संक्रुद्धो भीमसेनस्य मारिष । क्षुरप्रेण धनुश्छित्त्वा दशभिः प्रत्यविध्यत ॥
data.md: Oppressed him with five and twenty short arrows. Duryodhana also, O worshipfui sire, inflamed with ire, cut-off his bow with razorshaped dart and then pierced him in return with ten (darts). Thereupon, the highly-powerful Bhimasena, taking up another bow.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय भीमसेनो महाबलः । विव्याध नृपतिं तूर्णं सप्तभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥
तदप्यस्य धनुः क्षिप्रं चिच्छेद लघुहस्तवत् । द्वितीयं च तृतीयं च चतुर्थं पञ्चमं तथा ॥
आत्तमात्तं महाराज भीमस्य धनुराच्छिनत् । तव पुत्रो महाराज जितकाशी मदोत्कटः ॥
data.md: Similarly, O mighty monarch, he cut-off the second, the third, the fourth and the fifty bows taken up by Bhima. And O great king, your son, desirous of success and swelling with pride, cut-off another bow as soon as it was taken up by Bhima. His bows being thus again and again cut-off (by Duryodhana) he i.e. Bhima.

data.v: स तदा छिद्यमानेषु कार्मुकेषु पुनः पुनः । शक्तिं चिक्षेप समरे सर्वपारशवीं शुभाम् ॥
अप्राप्तामेव तां शक्तिं त्रिधा चिच्छेद कौरवः । पश्यतः सर्वलोकस्य भीमस्य च महात्मनः ॥
ततो भीमो महाराज गदां गुर्वीं महाप्रभाम् । चिक्षेपाविध्य वेगेन दुर्योधनरथं प्रति ॥
ततः सा सहसा वाहांस्तव पुत्रस्य संयुगे । सारथिं च गदा गुर्वी ममर्द भरतर्षभ ॥
पुत्रस्तु तव राजेन्द्र रथाद्धेमपरिष्कृतात् । आप्लुतः सहसा यानं नन्दकस्य महात्मनः ॥
ततो भीमो हतं मत्वा तव पुत्रं महारथम् । सिंहनादं महच्चक्रे तर्जयन्निव कौरवान् ॥
तावकाः सैनिकाश्चापि मेनिरे निहतं नृपम् । ततो विचुक्रुशुः सर्वे हा हेति च समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Roared furiously like a lion challenging the Kauravas. Your partisans and soldiers also thought that the king was slain.

data.v: तेषां तु निनदं श्रुत्वा त्रस्तानां सर्वयोधिनाम् । भीमसेनस्य नादं च श्रुत्वा राजन्महात्मनः ॥
data.md: And all of them set up a loud wail all around. Hearing the lamentation of all the coinbatants struck with terror.

data.v: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा हतं मत्वा सुयोधनम् । अभ्यवर्तत वेगेन यत्र पार्थो वृकोदरः ॥
data.md: And hearing also the yells of the highsouled Bhima, O monarch, king Yudhishthira, also, considered Suyodhana to have been slain.

data.v: पाञ्चालाः केकया मत्स्याः सृञ्जयाश्च विशां पते । सर्वोद्योगेनाभिजग्मुर्द्रोणमेव युयुत्सया ॥
data.md: And hastened with all speed to the place where Vrikodara, the son of Pritha was. Then, the Panchalas, the Srinjayas, the Matsyas as well as the Keykeyas.

data.v: तत्रासीत्सुमहद्युद्धं द्रोणस्याथ परैः सह । घोरे तमसि मग्नानां निघ्नतामितरेतरम् ॥
data.md: Desirous of slaying Drona, rushed with all their mighty (against him). There also took place a highly dreadful encounter between Drona and his enemies. And the combatants, (of both sides) buried in pitchy darkness, began to slaughter one another.

data.v: सहदेवमथायान्तं द्रोणप्रेप्सुं विशां पते । कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे वारयामास भारत ॥
data.md: Again, O king, Karna, the son of Vikartana, checked that mighty car-warriors Sahadeva, the son of Pandu, as he, actuated with the desire of taking Drona, was advancing (against him).

data.v: सहदेवस्तु राधेयं विद्ध्वा नवभिराशुगैः । पुनर्विव्याध दशभिर्निशितैर्नतपर्वभिः ॥
data.md: Shahadeva, also piercing the son of Radha with nine arrows, pierced him again in that encounter with nine straight (shafts).

data.v: तं कर्णः प्रतिविव्याध शतेन नतपर्वणाम् । सज्यं चास्य धनुः शीघ्रं चिच्छेद लघुहस्तवत् ॥
data.md: Karna (also) pierced him in return with a hundred straight arrows and then with great light-handedness quickly cut-off his stringed bow.

data.v: ततोऽन्यद्धनुरादाय माद्रीपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । कर्णं विव्याध विंशत्या तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
data.md: Thereupon the puissant son of Madri taking up another bow, pierced Karna with twenty shafts and this appeared wonderful.

data.v: तस्य कर्णो हयान्हत्वा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः । सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन द्रुतं निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥
data.md: (Then) Karna, having destroyed his horses with straight shafts, quickly sent his charioteer, with a broad-headed dart, to the abode of Yama.

data.v: विरथः सहदेवस्तु खड्गं चर्म समाददे । तदप्यस्य शरैः कर्णो व्यधमत्प्रहसन्निव ॥
data.md: Made carless (thus), Shahadeva then took up a scimitar and a shield. But (Karma) cut-off those (things) also with a smile.

data.v: ततो गुर्वीं महाघोरां हेमचित्रां महागदाम् । प्रेषयामास समरे वैकर्तनरथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Thereupon the highly-puissant Shahadeva, in that engagement, hurled a heavy and formidable mace ornamented with gold, at the car of the son of Vikartana.

data.v: तामापतन्तीं सहसा सहदेवप्रवेरिताम् । व्यष्टम्भयच्छरैः कर्णो भूमौ चैनामपातयत् ॥
data.md: Karna, however, cut-off with shafts that mace which, hurled by the Shahadeva, was making for him with great force and caused it to fall on the ground.

data.v: गदां विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा सहदेवस्त्वरान्वितः । शक्तिं चिक्षेप कर्णाय तामप्यस्याच्छिनच्छरैः ॥
data.md: Seeing that his cut-off, Shahadeva, with great haste, hurled a dart at mace was Karna. But that too was cut-off with arrows (by Karna).

data.v: ससंभ्रमस्ततस्तूर्णमवप्लुत्य रथोत्तमात् । सहदेवो महाराज दृष्ट्वा कर्णं व्यवस्थितम् । रथचक्रं ततो गृह्य मुमोचाधिरथिं प्रति ॥
data.md: The son of Madri, then, speedily jumping down from his excellent car and burning with indignation, as it were, at the sight of Karna stationed (before him).

data.v: तमापतन्तं सहसा कालचक्रमिवोद्यतम् । शरैरनेकसाहस्रैरच्छिनत्सूतनन्दनः ॥
तस्मिंस्तु वितथे चक्रे कृते तेन महात्मना । वार्यमाणश्च विशिखैः सहदेवो रणं जहौ ॥
तमभिद्रुत्य राधेयो मुहूर्ताद्भरतर्षभ । अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्वाक्यं सहदेवं विशां पते ॥
मा युध्यस्व रणे वीर विशिष्टै रथिभिः सह । सदृशैर्युध्य माद्रेय वचो मे मा विशङ्किथाः ॥
अथैनं धनुषोऽग्रेण तुदन्भूयोऽब्रवीद्वचः । एषोऽर्जुनो रणे यत्तो युध्यते कुरुभिः सह । तत्र गच्छस्व माद्रेय गृहं वा यदि मन्यसे ॥
data.md: Yonder Arjuna is fighting resolutely with the Kurus. O son of Madri, either go there or return home, which ever you like.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा तु तं कर्णो रथेन रथिनां वरः । प्रायात्पाञ्चालपाण्डूनां सैन्यानि प्रहसन्निव ॥
data.md: Having addressed him thus, Karna, the foremost of car-warriors, advanced smilingly against the troops of the Panchala king.

data.v: वधप्राप्तं तु माद्रेयं नावधीत्समरेऽरिहा । कुन्त्याः स्मृत्वा वचो राजन्सत्यसंधो महारथः ॥
data.md: Remembering the words of Kunti, that mighty car-warrior and slayer of foes in battle, firm in truth, did not, O king, slay the son of Madri though he could do so.

data.v: सहदेवस्ततो राजन्विमनाः शरपीडितः । कर्णवाक्शल्यतप्तश्च जीवितान्निरविद्यत ॥
data.md: With his mind ill at ease, afflicted with darts and smitten with the words of Karna (poignant) as darts, Shahadeva lost all love for life.

data.v: आरुरोह रथं चापि पाञ्चाल्यस्य महात्मनः । जनमेजयस्य समरे त्वरायुक्तो महारथः ॥
data.md: (And) that great car-warrior in that battle, with great haste mounted the car of Janamejaya, the high-souled Panchalas.

data.v: विराटं सहसेनं तु द्रोणार्थे द्रुतमागतम् । मद्रराजः शरौघेण छादयामास धन्विनम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said The king of Madra, with a down-pours of arrow, covered on all sides Virata, who, accompanied by his division, was proceeding quickly for (the slaughter ot) Drona.

data.v: तयोः समभवद्युद्धं समरे दृढधन्विनोः । यादृशं ह्यभवद्राजञ्जम्भवासवयोः पुरा ॥
data.md: (And) between those two strong bowmen ensued a battle, Oking, like that which had taken place between Bali and Vasava in days of yore.

data.v: मद्रराजो महाराज विराटं वाहिनीपतिम् । आजघ्ने त्वरितं तीक्ष्णैः शतेन नतपर्वणाम् ॥
data.md: The king of Madra, O great monarch, displaying great alacrity, quickly wounded Virata, the chief of a great force, with straight arrows.

data.v: प्रतिविव्याध तं राजा नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः । पुनश्चैव त्रिसप्तत्या भूयश्चैव शतेन ह ॥
data.md: King (Virata also) pierced him in returm with nine sharpened arrows, again with seventy-three and once more with a hundred.

data.v: तस्य मद्राधिपो हत्वा चतुरो रथवाजिनः । सूतं ध्वजं च समरे रथोपस्थादपातयत् ॥
data.md: The king of Madra, (also) destroying the four horses of his car, cut down with two shafts, in that engagement, the umbrella and the standard (of Virata).

data.v: हताश्वात्तु रथात्तूर्णमवप्लुत्य महारथः । तस्थौ विस्फारयंश्चापं विमुञ्चंश्च शिताञ्शरान् ॥
data.md: That lord of the earth (i.e., Virata) jumping down from his car, the steeds of which were destroyed, stood, drawing his bow and shooting keen darts.

data.v: शतानीकस्ततो दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं हतवाहनम् । रथेनाभ्यपतत्तूर्णं सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.md: Witnessing the destruction of his brother's steeds, Shatanika quickly came up (there), in the very sight of all the troops.

data.v: शतानीकमथायान्तं मद्रराजो महामृधे । विशिखैर्बहुभिर्विद्ध्वा ततो निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥
data.md: That lord of the earth, that is, the king of Madra, having with numerous shafts pierced Shatanika who was advancing (against him), sent him to the abode of Yama.

data.v: तस्मिंस्तु निहते वीरे विराटो रथसत्तमः । आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं तमेव ध्वजमालिनम् ॥
ततो विस्फार्य नयने क्रोधाद्द्विगुणविक्रमः । मद्रराजरथं तूर्णं छादयामास पत्रिभिः ॥
data.md: The heroic (Shatanika) being slain, Virata, the chief of a great force, (abandoning his steed-less car, ascended to that (of his brother). Then, his eyes rolling (in ire) and his strength doubled with indignation, (he) quickly covered the car of the king of Madra with arrows.

data.v: ततो मद्राधिपः क्रुद्धः शतेन नतपर्वणाम् । आजघानोरसि दृढं विराटं वाहिनीपतिम् ॥
data.md: Therefore the king of Madra, inflamed with wrath, struck Virata, the chief of a large force, furiously in the chest with a hundred straight arrows.

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् । कश्मलं चाविशत्तीव्रं विराटो भरतर्षभ । सारथिस्तमपोवाह समरे शरविक्षतम् ॥
data.md: The mighty car-warrior Virata thus pierced home by the puissant (Shalya) sat down on the terrace of his car and soon fainted away.

data.v: ततः सा महती सेना प्राद्रवन्निशि भारत । वध्यमाना शरशतैः शल्येनाहवशोभिना ॥
तां दृष्ट्वा विद्रुतां सेनां वासुदेवधनंजयौ । प्रायातां तत्र राजेन्द्र यत्र शल्यो व्यवस्थितः ॥
तौ तु प्रत्युद्ययौ राजन्राक्षसेन्द्रो ह्यलम्बुसः । अष्टचक्रसमायुक्तमास्थाय प्रवरं रथम् ॥
तुरंगममुखैर्युक्तं पिशाचैर्घोरदर्शनैः । लोहितार्द्रपताकं तं रक्तमाल्यविभूषितम् । कार्ष्णायसमयं घोरमृक्षचर्मावृतं महत् ॥
data.md: That terrible car was furnished with bloodred banners, adorned with garlands made of black iron and covered with bear skins.

data.v: रौद्रेण चित्रपक्षेण विवृताक्षेण कूजता । ध्वजेनोच्छ्रिततुण्डेन गृध्रराजेन राजता ॥
data.md: And it was furnished with a tall standard on which sat a fierce vulture of spotted wings, having eyes wide open and shrieking incessantly.

data.v: स बभौ राक्षसो राजन्भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः । रुरोधार्जुनमायान्तं प्रभञ्जनमिवाद्रिराट् । किरन्बाणगणान्राजञ्शतशोऽर्जुनमूर्धनि ॥
data.md: That Rakshasa, who, O monarch, looked like a loose heap of antimony, checked the Aadvancing Arjuna as the mountain Meru (resists) a hurricane.

data.v: अतितीव्रमभूद्युद्धं नरराक्षसयोर्मृधे । द्रष्टॄणां प्रीतिजननं सर्वेषां भरतर्षभ ॥
तमर्जुनः शतेनैव पत्रिणामभ्यताडयत् । नवभिश्च शितैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद ध्वजमुच्छ्रितम् ॥
data.md: Arjuna, (then), struck Alamvusa with his arrows and with ten keen darts cut down his standard.

data.v: सारथिं च त्रिभिर्बाणैस्त्रिभिरेव त्रिवेणुकम् । धनुरेकेन चिच्छेद चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् । विरथस्योद्यतं खड्गं शरेणास्य द्विधाच्छिनत् ॥
data.md: (And) with three darts he cut-off his charioteer, with three more his Trivenu, with one his bow and with four his horses.

data.v: अथैनं निशितैर्बाणैश्चतुर्भिर्भरतर्षभ । पार्थोऽर्दयद्राक्षसेन्द्रं स विद्धः प्राद्रवद्भयात् ॥
तं विजित्यार्जुनस्तूर्णं द्रोणान्तिकमुपाययौ । किरञ्शरगणान्राजन्नरवारणवाजिषु ॥
वध्यमाना महाराज पाण्डवेन यशस्विना । सैनिका न्यपतन्नुर्व्यां वातनुन्ना इव द्रुमाः ॥
तेषु तूत्साद्यमानेषु फल्गुनेन महात्मना । संप्राद्रवद्बलं सर्वं पुत्राणां ते विशां पते ॥
data.md: The soldiers fell down like trees levelled (on the ground) by a storm. Thus slaughtered by that renowned Pandava all the soldiers (of your son) ran away like a terror-stricken herd of deer.

data.v: शतानीकं शरैस्तूर्णं निर्दहन्तं चमूं तव । चित्रसेनस्तव सुतो वारयामास भारत ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said O Bharata, your son Chitrasena withstood Satnika, the of Nakula, who consuming your troops with keen arrows. son was

data.v: नाकुलिश्चित्रसेनं तु नाराचेनार्दयद्भृशम् । स च तं प्रतिविव्याध दशभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: The son of Nakula pierced Chitrasena, with five arrows. He (i.e. Citrasena) also pierced him i.e. in return with ten sharpened arrows.

data.v: चित्रसेनो महाराज शतानीकं पुनर्युधि । नवभिर्निशितैर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे ॥
data.md: Once again, in that engagement Chitrasena, ( mighty monarch, pierced Satanika in the chest with nine keen darts.

data.v: नाकुलिस्तस्य विशिखैर्वर्म संनतपर्वभिः । गात्रात्संच्यावयामास तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
data.md: The son of Nakula, (also), with straight arrows cut-off his armour from his body and this feat seemed marvellous.

data.v: सोऽपेतवर्मा पुत्रस्ते विरराज भृशं नृप । उत्सृज्य काले राजेन्द्र निर्मोकमिव पन्नगः ॥
data.md: His armour being cut-off, your son O monarch, O lord of kings, looked as beautiful as a snake with its slough cast off in proper time.

data.v: ततोऽस्य निशितैर्बाणैर्ध्वजं चिच्छेद नाकुलिः । धनुश्चैव महाराज यतमानस्य संयुगे ॥
data.md: The, O great king, the son of Nakula, cutoff, with sharpened arrows, the standard and the bow of that one i.e., Chitrasena who was exerting his utmost in that engagement.

data.v: स छिन्नधन्वा समरे विवर्मा च महारथः । धनुरन्यन्महाराज जग्राहारिविदारणम् ॥
data.md: That mighty car-warrior, deprived of his car and coat of mail and his bow cut-off, took up another very strong bow capable of piercing every foe.

data.v: ततस्तूर्णं चित्रसेनो नाकुलिं नवभिः शरैः । विव्याध समरे क्रुद्धो भरतानां महारथः ॥
data.md: Then Chitrasena, that great car-warrior among the Bharatas, quickly pierced the son of Nakula, in battle, with straight arrows.

data.v: शतानीकोऽथ संक्रुद्धश्चित्रसेनस्य मारिष । जघान चतुरो वाहान्सारथिं च नरोत्तमः ॥
data.md: son The highly powerful Satanika, then inflamed with wrath, destroyed the four horses and also the charioteer of Chitrasena O Bharata.

data.v: अवप्लुत्य रथात्तस्माच्चित्रसेनो महारथः । नाकुलिं पञ्चविंशत्या शराणामार्दयद्बली ॥
data.md: Jumping down from his car, the highlyrenowned Chitrasena, possessed of (great) strength, oppressed the son of Nakula with twenty-five arrows.

data.v: तस्य तत्कुर्वतः कर्म नकुलस्य सुतो रणे । अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद चापं रत्नविभूषितम् ॥
data.md: When he (i.e. Chitrasena) was achieving this feat, the of Nakula, in that engagement, cut-off, with a cresent-shaped arrow, his shaft furnished with gold.

data.v: स छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः । आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं हार्दिक्यस्य महात्मनः ॥
data.md: His bow cut-off and deprived of his car, steeds and charioteer, he (i.e. Chitrasena) quickly mounted on the car of the high-souled son of Hridika.

data.v: द्रुपदं तु सहानीकं द्रोणप्रेप्सुं महारथम् । वृषसेनोऽभ्ययात्तूर्णं किरञ्शरशतैस्तदा ॥
data.md: Then, O great king, Vrishasena, covered that great car-warrior Drupada, who, followed by his army, was advancing against Drona.

data.v: यज्ञसेनस्तु समरे कर्णपुत्रं महारथम् । षष्ट्या शराणां विव्याध बाह्वोरुरसि चानघ ॥
data.md: Yajnasena also, O lord, pierced in that battle, that mighty car-warrior, the son of Karna, in the arm and the chest with six arrows.

data.v: वृषसेनस्तु संक्रुद्धो यज्ञसेनं रथे स्थितम् । बहुभिः सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैराजघान स्तनान्तरे ॥
data.md: Thereupon inflamed with wrath, Vrishasena soon struck Yajnasena, stationed on his car, in the centre of his chest with numerous arrows.

data.v: तावुभौ शरनुन्नाङ्गौ शरकण्टकिनौ रणे । व्यभ्राजेतां महाराज श्वाविधौ शललैरिव ॥
data.md: O great king, those two heroes mangled with shafts and their bodies looking prickly with the darts sticking io them, looked beautiful like a couple of hedgehogs with their quills erect on their bodies, in that encounter.

data.v: रुक्मपुङ्खैरजिह्माग्रैः शरैश्छिन्नतनुच्छदौ । रुधिरौघपरिक्लिन्नौ व्यभ्राजेतां महामृधे ॥
data.md: Covered all over with blood flowing from the wounds caused by straight arrows furnished with golden wings and keen points, those two warriors in that great engagement, looked beautiful.

data.v: तपनीयनिभौ चित्रौ कल्पवृक्षाविवाद्भुतौ । किंशुकाविव चोत्फुल्लौ व्यकाशेतां रणाजिरे ॥
data.md: Like a pair of highly graceful and radiant Kalpa trees or a couple of Kinsuka trees rich with their burden of flowers.

data.v: वृषसेनस्ततो राजन्नवभिर्द्रुपदं शरैः । विद्ध्वा विव्याध सप्तत्या पुनश्चान्यैस्त्रिभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: Vrishasena them, o king, having pierced Drupada with nine arrows, pierced him again with seventy and once more with another three shafts.

data.v: ततः शरसहस्राणि विमुञ्चन्विबभौ तदा । कर्णपुत्रो महाराज वर्षमाण इवाम्बुदः ॥
data.md: Then, discharging thousands of arrows in that battle, the son of Karna, O mighty monarch, looked like cloud pouring torrents of rain.

data.v: ततस्तु द्रुपदानीकं शरैश्छिन्नतनुच्छदम् । संप्राद्रवद्रणे राजन्निशीथे भैरवे सति ॥
data.md: All the warriors (on your side), on that frightful night, rushed against the army of Drupada having their coats of mail cut to pieces with arrows (of the enemy).

data.v: प्रदीपैर्हि परित्यक्तैर्ज्वलद्भिस्तैः समन्ततः । व्यराजत मही राजन्वीताभ्रा द्यौरिव ग्रहैः ॥
data.md: In virtue of the (lustre of the) lamps abandoned (by the combatants) and which were burning all around, the field shone resplendent like the cloud-less firmament studded with planets and stars.

data.v: तथाङ्गदैर्निपतितैर्व्यराजत वसुंधरा । प्रावृट्काले महाराज विद्युद्भिरिव तोयदः ॥
data.md: Similarly, O great king, (strewn all over) with the fallen Angadas of the combatants, the field looked beautiful like a (mass of) clouds (enlivened) with flashes of lightning during the rainy season.

data.v: ततः कर्णसुतत्रस्ताः सोमका विप्रदुद्रुवुः । यथेन्द्रभयवित्रस्ता दानवास्तारकामये ॥
data.md: Then, seized with the fear of the son of Karna, (the Panchalas troops) ran away in all directions as the Danavas agitated with the fear of Indra (had fled away) in the battle between the gods and the Asuras.

data.v: तेनार्द्यमानाः समरे द्रवमाणाश्च सोमकाः । व्यराजन्त महाराज प्रदीपैरवभासिताः ॥
data.md: Crushed in that battle by him (i.e. Vrishasena) the Panchalas together with the Somakas, illuminated by lamps, shone resplendent.

data.v: तांस्तु निर्जित्य समरे कर्णपुत्रो व्यरोचत । मध्यंदिनमनुप्राप्तो घर्मांशुरिव भारत ॥
data.md: Having, O Bharata, defeated them in battle, the son of Karna, looked like the sun of scorching rays when he reaches the meridian.

data.v: तेषु राजसहस्रेषु तावकेषु परेषु च । एक एव ज्वलंस्तस्थौ वृषसेनः प्रतापवान् ॥
data.md: Amongst the thousands of kings belonging to your party and that of your enemy, the puissant Vrishasena alone stood (on the field) like the blazing fire.

data.v: स विजित्य रणे शूरान्सोमकानां महारथान् । जगाम त्वरितस्तत्र यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः ॥
data.md: Having vanquished (innumerable) horses as well as those great car-warriors the Somakas, he (i.e. Vrishasena) hastened to the spot where king Yudhishthira was.

data.v: प्रतिविन्ध्यमथ क्रुद्धं प्रदहन्तं रणे रिपून् । दुःशासनस्तव सुतः प्रत्युद्गच्छन्महारथः ॥
data.md: Your son Dushasana stood against that mighty car-warrior, the advancing Prativindhya, consuming his enemies in battle.

data.v: तयोः समागमो राजंश्चित्ररूपो बभूव ह । व्यपेतजलदे व्योम्नि बुधभार्गवयोरिव ॥
data.md: O king, the clash between looked as marvellous as that between Mercury and Venus in the cloudless sky.

data.v: प्रतिविन्ध्यं तु समरे कुर्वाणं कर्म दुष्करम् । दुःशासनस्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्ललाटे समविध्यत ॥
data.md: In (that) battle, Prativindhya, who was achieving frightful feats, was pierced by Dushasana in the forehead with three arrows.

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता पुत्रेण तव धन्विना । विरराज महाबाहुः सशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः ॥
data.md: Pierced deeply by that powerful bcwman, that is, your son, Prativindhya, O mighty monarch, looked like a mountain furnished with a peak.

data.v: दुःशासनं तु समरे प्रतिविन्ध्यो महारथः । नवभिः सायकैर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥
data.md: The great car-warrior Prativindhya (also), in (that) battle, having pierced Dushasana with nine arrows, pierced him again with seven.

data.v: तत्र भारत पुत्रस्ते कृतवान्कर्म दुष्करम् । प्रतिविन्ध्यहयानुग्रैः पातयामास यच्छरैः ॥
data.md: There, O Bharata, your son performed a difficult feat in as much as he struck down the steeds of Prativindhya with fierce shafts.

data.v: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन ध्वजं च समपातयत् । रथं च शतशो राजन्व्यधमत्तस्य धन्विनः ॥
data.md: (He then), with a broad-headed shaft, O king, struck down the charioteer and the standard and cut-off into minute fragments the car of that bowman.

data.v: पताकाश्च स तूणीरान्रश्मीन्योक्त्राणि चाभिभो । चिच्छेद तिलशः क्रुद्धः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥
data.md: (And), inflamed with rage (he) cut-off into very small fragments, with straight arrows, the flags, the quivers, the strings and the terraces, O lord, (of Prativindhya,s) car.

data.v: विरथः स तु धर्मात्मा धनुष्पाणिरवस्थितः । अयोधयत्तव सुतं किरञ्शरशतान्बहून् ॥
data.md: Made carless, the virtuous-souled (Prativindhya) stood, bow in hand and fought with your son by discharging many hundreds of shafts.

data.v: क्षुरप्रेण धनुस्तस्य चिच्छेद कृतहस्तवत् । अथैनं दशभिर्भल्लैश्छिन्नधन्वानमार्दयत् ॥
data.md: Your son, then) with (great) nimbleness of hand cut-off his bow with a razor-shaped arrow and then smote that one whose bow was cutoff, with ten darts.

data.v: तं दृष्ट्वा विरथं तत्र भ्रातरोऽस्य महारथाः । अन्ववर्तन्त वेगेन महत्या सेनया सह ॥
data.md: Witnessing that (sad) plight that their brother was in, his brothers, who were great car-warriors, followed by a large army, rushed furiously to that place.

data.v: आप्लुतः स ततो यानं सुतसोमस्य भास्वरम् । धनुर्गृह्य महाराज विव्याध तनयं तव ॥
data.md: He then mounted the resplendent car of Sutasoma and O great king, taking up a bow, pierced your son.

data.v: ततस्तु तावकाः सर्वे परिवार्य सुतं तव । अभ्यवर्तन्त संग्रामे महत्या सेनया वृताः ॥
data.md: Thereupon, all your warriors surrounding your son (in order to protect him) and followed by a great force, rushed (against the Pandavas).

data.v: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तव तेषां च भारत । निशीथे दारुणे काले यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम् ॥
data.md: Then, at that frightful hour of midnight, there commenced an encounter swelling (the population of) Yama's domains between your (army) and theirs.

data.v: नकुलं रभसं युद्धे निघ्नन्तं वाहिनीं तव । अभ्ययात्सौबलः क्रुद्धस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said The son of Subala (i.e. Shakuni), excited with wrath, rushed against Nakula who was slaughtering your troops with (great) impetuosity in battle and said (to him) “Wait, wait."

data.v: कृतवैरौ तु तौ वीरावन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणौ । शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥
data.md: Those two heroes, between whom was excited a bitter enmity, desirous of slaying each other, struck each other with arrows discharged (from their bows) drawn to their fullest stretch.

data.v: यथैव सौबलः क्षिप्रं शरवर्षाणि मुञ्चति । तथैव नकुलो राजञ्शिक्षां संदर्शयन्युधि ॥
data.md: In (that) battle, O king, the son of Subala displayed as much dexterity in discharging showers of arrows as Nakula (god).

data.v: तावुभौ समरे शूरौ शरकण्टकिनौ तदा । व्यराजेतां महाराज कण्टकैरिव शाल्मली ॥
data.md: O great king, those two heroes mangled with shafts and their bodies looking prickly with the darts sticking io them, looked beautiful like a couple of hedgehogs with their quills erect on their bodies, in that encounter.

data.v: सुजिह्मं प्रेक्षमाणौ च राजन्विवृतलोचनौ । क्रोधसंरक्तनयनौ निर्दहन्तौ परस्परम् ॥
data.md: O king, looking delightedly at each other with expanded eyes which became red in wrath, they seemed to consume each other (with their fiery glances).

data.v: स्यालस्तु तव संक्रुद्धो माद्रीपुत्रं हसन्निव । कर्णिनैकेन विव्याध हृदये निशितेन ह ॥
data.md: Inflamed with wrath, your brother-in-law, pierced, as it were with a smile, the son of Madri in the chest with keen and barbed dart.

data.v: नकुलस्तु भृशं विद्धः स्यालेन तव धन्विना । निषसाद रथोपस्थे कश्मलं चैनमाविशत् ॥
data.md: Your brother-in-law wielder of bow, wounded Nakula extremely. He fell down on his chariot and filled with very grief.

data.v: अत्यन्तवैरिणं दृप्तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुं तथागतम् । ननाद शकुनी राजंस्तपान्ते जलदो यथा ॥
data.md: Beholding his bitter and haughty foe in that (pitiable) plight, Shakuni roared there like the clouds at the end of summer.

data.v: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां नकुलः पाण्डुनन्दनः । अभ्ययात्सौबलं भूयो व्यात्तानन इवान्तकः ॥
data.md: Then, Nakula, the son of Pandu, recovering his senses once again rushed against the son of Subala like death itself with gaping mouth.

data.v: संक्रुद्धः शकुनिं षष्ट्या विव्याध भरतर्षभ । पुनश्चैव शतेनैव नाराचानां स्तनान्तरे ॥
data.md: He, (then), O best of the Bharatas, wrathfully pierced Shakuni with six (arrows) and again with a hundred long shafts, in the centre of the chest.

data.v: ततोऽस्य सशरं चापं मुष्टिदेशे स चिच्छिदे । ध्वजं च त्वरितं छित्त्वा रथाद्भूमावपातयत् ॥
data.md: (He then cut-off) his bow with the arrow fixed (on the string) into two fragments, at the points at which it is grasped. (Then), quickly cutting off his standard, (he) caused it to fall from his car to the ground.

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् । तं विसंज्ञं निपतितं दृष्ट्वा स्यालं तवानघ । अपोवाह रथेनाशु सारथिर्ध्वजिनीमुखात् ॥
ततः संचुक्रुशुः पार्था ये च तेषां पदानुगाः । निर्जित्य च रणे शत्रून्नकुलः शत्रुतापनः । अब्रवीत्सारथिं क्रुद्धो द्रोणानीकाय मां वह ॥
data.md: On the defeat of his foe in battle, Nakula. the scorcher of foes, said to his charioteer "convey me towards Drona's division."

data.v: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा माद्रीपुत्रस्य धीमतः । प्रायात्तेन रणे राजन्येन द्रोणोऽन्वयुध्यत ॥
data.md: Hearing those words of the son of Madri, his charioteer, conveyed him to the spot where, O king, Drona took his stand.

data.v: शिखण्डिनं तु समरे द्रोणप्रेप्सुं विशां पते । कृपः शारद्वतो यत्तः प्रत्युद्गच्छत्सुवेगितः ॥
data.md: Kripa, the son of Saradvata, rushed with great impetuosity and resoluteness, against the highly-powerful Sikhandi who was advancing in order to slay Drona.

data.v: गौतमं द्रुतमायान्तं द्रोणान्तिकमरिंदमम् । विव्याध नवभिर्भल्लैः शिखण्डी प्रहसन्निव ॥
data.md: Sikhandi, the subduer of foes, pierced as it were with a smile the son of Goutama advancing furiously (again him) towards the vicinity of Drona, with nine arrows.

data.v: तमाचार्यो महाराज विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः । पुनर्विव्याध विंशत्या पुत्राणां प्रियकृत्तव ॥
data.md: The preceptor, devoted to the welfare of your sons, having, O great monarch, pierced him with five shafts, struck him again with twenty (more).

data.v: महद्युद्धं तयोरासीद्घोररूपं विशां पते । यथा देवासुरे युद्धे शम्बरामरराजयोः ॥
data.md: (Then), O lord of the earth, the encounter that ensued between them was as dreadful as that between the (Asura) Samvara and the lord of the immortals in the war between the celestials and the Asuras.

data.v: शरजालावृतं व्योम चक्रतुस्तौ महारथौ । प्रकृत्या घोररूपं तदासीद्घोरतरं पुनः ॥
रात्रिश्च भरतश्रेष्ठ योधानां युद्धशालिनाम् । कालरात्रिनिभा ह्यासीद्घोररूपा भयावहा ॥
शिखण्डी तु महाराज गौतमस्य महद्धनुः । अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद सज्यं सविशिखं तदा ॥
data.md: That awfully-dreadful night striking terror (into very heart) seemed to be the death-night (of all the combatants). Then, O great monarch, Shikandi cut-off the great bow of the son of Goutama with a crescent-shaped (dart) and poured down sharpened arrows (at him). Kripa, then, O monarch, excited with rage, hurled a formidable dart.

data.v: तस्य क्रुद्धः कृपो राजञ्शक्तिं चिक्षेप दारुणाम् । स्वर्णदण्डामकुण्ठाग्रां कर्मारपरिमार्जिताम् ॥
तामापतन्तीं चिच्छेद शिखण्डी बहुभिः शरैः । सापतन्मेदिनीं दीप्ता भासयन्ती महाप्रभा ॥
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय गौतमो रथिनां वरः । प्राच्छादयच्छितैर्बाणैर्महाराज शिखण्डिनम् ॥
स छाद्यमानः समरे गौतमेन यशस्विना । व्यषीदत रथोपस्थे शिखण्डी रथिनां वरः ॥
सीदन्तं चैनमालोक्य कृपः शारद्वतो युधि । आजघ्ने बहुभिर्बाणैर्जिघांसन्निव भारत ॥
विमुखं तं रणे दृष्ट्वा याज्ञसेनिं महारथम् । पाञ्चालाः सोमकाश्चैव परिवव्रुः समन्ततः ॥
तथैव तव पुत्राश्च परिवव्रुर्द्विजोत्तमम् । महत्या सेनया सार्धं ततो युद्धमभूत्पुनः ॥
रथानां च रणे राजन्नन्योन्यमभिधावताम् । बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो मेघानां नदतामिव ॥
द्रवतां सादिनां चैव गजानां च विशां पते । अन्योन्यमभितो राजन्क्रूरमायोधनं बभौ ॥
पत्तीनां द्रवतां चैव पदशब्देन मेदिनी । अकम्पत महाराज भयत्रस्तेव चाङ्गना ॥
रथा रथान्समासाद्य प्रद्रुता वेगवत्तरम् । न्यगृह्णन्बहवो राजञ्शलभान्वायसा इव ॥
तथा गजान्प्रभिन्नांश्च सुप्रभिन्ना महागजाः । तस्मिन्नेव पदे यत्ता निगृह्णन्ति स्म भारत ॥
data.md: And, O king, attacked numerous (other carwarriors), as crows (attack) winged insects. In the same manner, elephants, with the juice trickling down their bodies, resolutely attacked great elephants (of the opposite side) with juice trickling down their bodies, O Bharata. Horsemen approaching horsemen and foot soldiers (approaching) foot soldiers.

data.v: सादी सादिनमासाद्य पदाती च पदातिनम् । समासाद्य रणेऽन्योन्यं संरब्धा नातिचक्रमुः ॥
धावतां द्रवतां चैव पुनरावर्ततामपि । बभूव तत्र सैन्यानां शब्दः सुतुमुलो निशि ॥
data.md: In that battle, angrily encountered one another, without getting the better of one another. Terrific indeed as the sound caused by the rush, retreat and return of the combatants at dead of night. (Innumerable) blazing lamps placed upon cars, elephants and horses.

data.v: दीप्यमानाः प्रदीपाश्च रथवारणवाजिषु । अदृश्यन्त महाराज महोल्का इव खाच्च्युताः ॥
सा निशा भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रदीपैरवभासिता । दिवसप्रतिमा राजन्बभूव रणमूर्धनि ॥
आदित्येन यथा व्याप्तं तमो लोके प्रणश्यति । तथा नष्टं तमो घोरं दीपैर्दीप्तैरलंकृतम् ॥
शस्त्राणां कवचानां च मणीनां च महात्मनाम् । अन्तर्दधुः प्रभाः सर्वा दीपैस्तैरवभासिताः ॥
तस्मिन्कोलाहले युद्धे वर्तमाने निशामुखे । अवधीत्समरे पुत्रं पिता भरतसत्तम ॥
पुत्रश्च पितरं मोहात्सखायं च सखा तथा । संबन्धिनं च संबन्धी स्वस्रीयं चापि मातुलः ॥
data.md: Son (his) father and kinsmen (killed kinsmen, friends (slew) friends and maternal uncles (killed) sister's sons, through ignorance.

data.v: स्वे स्वान्परे परांश्चापि निजघ्नुरितरेतरम् । निर्मर्यादमभूद्युद्धं रात्रौ घोरं भयावहम् ॥
data.md: (And) O Bharata, warrior killed warriors of the same party and enemies killed their own O king, in that awful nocturnal engagement (the combatants) lost all regard for one another. men.

data.v: तस्मिन्सुतुमुले युद्धे वर्तमाने भयावहे । धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज द्रोणमेवाभ्यवर्तत ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then, O mighty monarch, when the battle raged hot and furious Dhristadyumna rushed against Drona.

data.v: संमृजानो धनुः श्रेष्ठं ज्यां विकर्षन्पुनः पुनः । अभ्यवर्तत द्रोणस्य रथं रुक्मविभूषितम् ॥
data.md: Wielding his strong bow and twanging its string often and often, he rushed against Drona's chariot decked with golden trappings.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नं तदायान्तं द्रोणस्यान्तचिकीर्षया । परिवव्रुर्महाराज पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह ॥
data.md: And as Dhristadyumna rushed against Drona, O mighty monarch, the Panchalas together with the Pandavas surrounded him, with a view to put an end to Drona's life.

data.v: तथा परिवृतं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणमाचार्यसत्तमम् । पुत्रास्ते सर्वतो यत्ता ररक्षुर्द्रोणमाहवे ॥
data.md: Then beholding that foremost of preceptors Drona, thus hemmed in on all sides, your sons, exerting their best, protected Drona in that battle.

data.v: बलार्णवौ ततस्तौ तु समेयातां निशामुखे । वातोद्धूतौ क्षुब्धसत्त्वौ भैरवौ सागराविव ॥
data.md: Then those two sea of troops encountering each other at the dead of night resembled two dreadful sees agitated by the tempest with all the creatures within them dreadfully terrified.

data.v: ततो द्रोणं महाराज पाञ्चाल्यः पञ्चभिः शरैः । विव्याध हृदये तूर्णं सिंहनादं ननाद च ॥
data.md: Thereafter, O king, the prince of the Panchalas quickly pierced Drona on the breast with five arrows and then uttered his war-cry.

data.v: तं द्रोणः पञ्चविंशत्या विद्ध्वा भारत संयुगे । चिच्छेदान्येन भल्लेन धनुरस्य महाप्रभम् ॥
data.md: Thereupon, O Bharata, Drona piercing him with twenty-five shafts, cut-off his lustrous bow with another broad-headed shaft.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु निर्विद्धो द्रोणेन भरतर्षभ । उत्ससर्ज धनुस्तूर्णं संदश्य दशनच्छदम् ॥
data.md: Pierced sore by Drona, Dhristadyumna, O foremost of the Bharatas, threw quickly aside the (severed) bow and bit his lips (in anger).

data.v: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान् । आददेऽन्यद्धनुः श्रेष्ठं द्रोणस्यान्तचिकीर्षया ॥
data.md: Then, O mighty monarch, excited to his highest pitch of fury, the puissant Dhristadyumna grasped another strong bow, desirous of accomplishing Drona's destruction.

data.v: विकृष्य च धनुश्चित्रमाकर्णात्परवीरहा । द्रोणस्यान्तकरं घोरं व्यसृजत्सायकं ततः ॥
data.md: That handsome warrior, the slayer of his foes, then drawing back the string of that bow to his cars, let go a dreadful shaft capable of achieving Drona's destruction.

data.v: स विसृष्टो बलवता शरो घोरो महामृधे । भासयामास तत्सैन्यं दिवाकर इवोदितः ॥
data.md: In that terrible battle that shaft, shot by his strong arm, flooded the Kuru troops with its lustre like the risen sun.

data.v: तं दृष्ट्वा तु शरं घोरं देवगन्धर्वमानवाः । स्वस्त्यस्तु समरे राजन्द्रोणायेत्यब्रुवन्वचः ॥
data.md: Beholding that dreadful shaft, o king, the Gods, the Danavas and the Gandharvas said these words viz., “May good betide Drona."

data.v: तं तु सायकमप्राप्तमाचार्यस्य रथं प्रति । कर्णो द्वादशधा राजंश्चिच्छेद कृतहस्तवत् ॥
data.md: Then as that shaft coursed towards the chariot of Drona, Oking Karna like one endued with great lightness of hands, cut it off into twelve fragments.

data.v: स छिन्नो बहुधा राजन्सूतपुत्रेण मारिष । निपपात शरस्तूर्णं निकृत्तः कर्णसायकैः ॥
data.md: () king, that shaft of Dhristadyumna severed into numerous pieces, quickly fell down on the earth like, O sire, a snake without its poisonous fangs.

data.v: छित्त्वा तु समरे बाणं शरैः संनतपर्वभिः । धृष्टद्युम्नं रणे कर्णो विव्याध दशभिः शरैः ॥
पञ्चभिर्द्रोणपुत्रस्तु स्वयं द्रोणश्च सप्तभिः । शल्यश्च नवभिर्बाणैस्त्रिभिर्दुःशासनस्तथा ॥
दुर्योधनश्च विंशत्या शकुनिश्चापि पञ्चभिः । पाञ्चाल्यं त्वरिताविध्यन्सर्व एव महारथाः ॥
स विद्धः सप्तभिर्वीरैर्द्रोणत्राणार्थमाहवे । सर्वानसंभ्रमाद्राजन्प्रत्यविध्यत्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः । द्रोणं द्रौणिं च कर्णं च विव्याध तव चात्मजम् ॥
data.md: Dhristadyumna was then pierced by the seven heroes who strove to protect Drona in battle. He also in his turn, pierced each of them with three shafts.

data.v: ते विद्ध्वा धन्विना तेन धृष्टद्युम्नं पुनर्मृधे । विव्यधुः पञ्चभिस्तूर्णमेकैको रथिनां वरः ॥
data.md: 0 mighty monarch, with the greatest quickness, Dhristadyumna then pierced Drona, Karna, Drona's son and your son, in that terrible battle.

data.v: द्रुमसेनस्तु संक्रुद्धो राजन्विव्याध पत्रिणा । त्रिभिश्चान्यैः शरैस्तूर्णं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Thus pierced by that bowman, your warriors again unitedly pierced Dhristadyumna in that battle, uttering terrible war-cries.

data.v: स तु तं प्रतिविव्याध त्रिभिस्तीक्ष्णैरजिह्मगैः । स्वर्णपुङ्खैः शिलाधौतैः प्राणान्तकरणैर्युधि ॥
data.md: Inflamed with fury, O king, Drumasena then pierced Dhristadyumna with an arrow and then again quickly piercing the latter with sharp shafts he said-"wait, wait."

data.md: Dhristadyumna pierced him in return with three sharp straight-flying arrows, winged with golden feathers, whetted on stone and capable of destroying life.

data.v: तच्छिरो न्यपतद्भूमौ संदष्टौष्ठपुटं रणे । महावातसमुद्धूतं पक्वं तालफलं यथा ॥
data.md: Next with another broad-headed shaft, he lopped off from Drumasena's trunk, his head graced with glimmering ear-rings of gold.

data.md: arrows on That head with its lips bitten, then fell on the field like a ripe palm-fruit thrown down by i a raging tempest.

data.md: Thereafter the heroic Dhristadyumna piercing his opponent warriors with wellshaprened shafts cut-off with broad-headed arrows, the bow of Radha's son versed in various modes of war-fare.

data.md: But Karna did not brook that severance of his bow even as a fierce lion does not brook the chopping off of its tail.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा तु कर्णं संरब्धं ते वीराः षड्रथर्षभाः । पाञ्चाल्यपुत्रं त्वरिताः परिवव्रुर्जिघांसया ॥
data.md: Taking up another bow, with eyes red in rage and breathing fiercely, he poured a shower of the highly puissant Dhristadyumna.

data.v: षण्णां योधप्रवीराणां तावकानां पुरस्कृतम् । मृत्योरास्यमनुप्राप्तं धृष्टद्युम्नममंस्महि ॥
data.md: Then beholding Karna wrought up with rage, the other six heroic foremost car-warriors, quickly surrounded the son the Panchala king with a view to slay him in battle.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दाशार्हो विकिरञ्शरान् । धृष्टद्युम्नं पराक्रान्तं सात्यकिः प्रत्यपद्यत ॥
data.md: 0 lord, the troops then considered Dhristadyumna to be already within the jaws of Death, as he was then confronted by the six foremost car-warriors of your army.

data.v: तमायान्तं महेष्वासं सात्यकिं युद्धदुर्मदम् । राधेयो दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यदजिह्मगैः ॥
data.md: At this juncture, Satyaki that scion of the Dasarha race, advanced to the rescue of the puissant Dhristadyumna, shooting numerous arrows (in all directions).

data.v: तं सात्यकिर्महाराज विव्याध दशभिः शरैः । पश्यतां सर्ववीराणां मा गास्तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Beholding that Satvata warrior indomitable in battle advance, Radha's son pierced him in battle, with ten shafts.

data.v: स सात्यकेस्तु बलिनः कर्णस्य च महात्मनः । आसीत्समागमो घोरो बलिवासवयोरिव ॥
data.md: Him, O mighty monarch, Satyaki pierced in return with ten shafts before the eyes of all the heroes present and said-'Fly not-stay.'

data.v: त्रासयंस्तलघोषेण क्षत्रियान्क्षत्रियर्षभः । राजीवलोचनं कर्णं सात्यकिः प्रत्यविध्यत ॥
data.md: 0 king, that encounter between the powerful Satyaki and the high-souled Karna looked like the encounter between Bali and Vasava.

data.v: कम्पयन्निव घोषेण धनुषो वसुधां बली । सूतपुत्रो महाराज सात्यकिं प्रत्ययोधयत् ॥
data.md: That foremost of the Kshatriyas Satyaki, then pierced the lotus-eyed Karna terrifying the Kshatriya warriors with the clatter of his car.

data.v: विपाठकर्णिनाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैः क्षुरैरपि । कर्णः शरशतैश्चापि शैनेयं प्रत्यविध्यत ॥
data.md: On the other hand, O mighty monarch the puissant son of Suta fought on with Satyaki, causing the earth to tremble with the tremendous twang on his bow.

data.v: तथैव युयुधानोऽपि वृष्णीनां प्रवरो रथः । अभ्यवर्षच्छरैः कर्णं तद्युद्धमभवत्समम् ॥
data.md: Karna then pierced that scion of Sini's race with Vipatkarnis, Narachas, Vatsadantas, Kshuras and hundreds of other kings of arrows.

data.v: तावकाश्च महाराज कर्णपुत्रश्च दंशितः । सात्यकिं विव्यधुस्तूर्णं समन्तान्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: So also Yuyudhana that foremost of the Vrishni warriors, covered Karna with his shower of arrows. The combat was an equal one (in all respects).

data.v: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य तेषां कर्णस्य चाभिभो । अविध्यत्सात्यकिः क्रुद्धो वृषसेनं स्तनान्तरे ॥
data.md: Placing Karna in front of them, your sons then, O ruler of men, began to pierce Satyaki simultaneously with sharp arrows.

data.v: तेन बाणेन निर्विद्धो वृषसेनो विशां पते । न्यपतत्स रथे मूढो धनुरुत्सृज्य वीर्यवान् ॥
data.md: Baffing their as well as Karna's weapons with those of his own, O lord, Satyaki quickly pierced Vrishasena on the centre of his chest.

data.v: ततः कर्णो हतं मत्वा वृषसेनं महारथः । पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तः सात्यकिं प्रत्यपीडयत् ॥
data.md: Pierced with the shaft of Satyaki, the highly effulgent and puissant Vrishasena fell down on his car, losing hold of his bow.

data.v: पीड्यमानस्तु कर्णेन युयुधानो महारथः । विव्याध बहुभिः कर्णं त्वरमाणः पुनः पुनः ॥
data.md: Thereupon Karna taking Vrishasena the mighty car-warrior to be slain, was afflicted with grief on account of his son's death and began to afflict Satyaki.

data.v: स कर्णं दशभिर्विद्ध्वा वृषसेनं च सप्तभिः । सहस्तावापधनुषी तयोश्चिच्छेद सात्वतः ॥
data.md: The mighty car-warrior Yuyudhana then afflicted sore by Karna, forcibly pierced Karna with numerous shafts over and over again.

data.v: तावन्ये धनुषी सज्ये कृत्वा शत्रुभयंकरे । युयुधानमविध्येतां समन्तान्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Piercing Karna with ten and Vrishasena with five shafts, the Satvata hero then cut-off their bow as well as their gloves.

data.v: वर्तमाने तु संग्रामे तस्मिन्वीरवरक्षये । अतीव शुश्रुवे राजन्गाण्डीवस्य महास्वनः ॥
data.md: Thereupon they both having strung another pair of bows dreadful to the foe, began simultaneously to pierce Yuyudhana with sharp arrows.

data.v: श्रुत्वा तु रथनिर्घोषं गाण्डीवस्य च निस्वनम् । सूतपुत्रोऽब्रवीद्राजन्दुर्योधनमिदं वचः ॥
data.md: When that dreadful destruction of heroes was progressing, O king, the terrible twang of the Gandiva bow was heard, arising above the din of battle.

data.v: एष सर्वाञ्शिबीन्हत्वा मुख्यशश्च नरर्षभान् । पौरवांश्च महेष्वासान्गाण्डीवनिनदो महान् ॥
data.md: Having heard the sound of the Gandiva and the clatter of (Arjuna's) car, Oking Suta's son addressing Duryodhana said these wordsपार्थो विजयते तत्र गाण्डीवनिनदो महान्।

data.v: श्रूयते रथघोषश्च वासवस्येव नर्दतः । करोति पाण्डवो व्यक्तं कर्मौपयिकमात्मनः ॥
एषा विदीर्यते राजन्बहुधा भारती चमूः । विप्रकीर्णान्यनीकानि नावतिष्ठन्ति कर्हिचित् ॥
वातेनेव समुद्धूतमभ्रजालं विदीर्यते । सव्यसाचिनमासाद्य भिन्ना नौरिव सागरे ॥
द्रवतां योधमुख्यानां गाण्डीवप्रेषितैः शरैः । विद्धानां शतशो राजञ्श्रूयते निनदो महान् । निशीथे राजशार्दूल स्तनयित्नोरिवाम्बरे ॥
हाहाकाररवांश्चैव सिंहनादांश्च पुष्कलान् । शृणु शब्दान्बहुविधानर्जुनस्य रथं प्रति ॥
अयं मध्ये स्थितोऽस्माकं सात्यकिः सात्वताधमः । इह चेल्लभ्यते लक्ष्यं कृत्स्नाञ्जेष्यामहे परान् ॥
एष पाञ्चालराजस्य पुत्रो द्रोणेन संगतः । सर्वतः संवृतो योधै राजन्पुरुषसत्तमैः ॥
सात्यकिं यदि हन्यामो धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम् । असंशयं महाराज ध्रुवो नो विजयो भवेत् ॥
सौभद्रवदिमौ वीरौ परिवार्य महारथौ । प्रयतामो महाराज निहन्तुं वृष्णिपार्षतौ ॥
सव्यसाची पुरोऽभ्येति द्रोणानीकाय भारत । संसक्तं सात्यकिं ज्ञात्वा बहुभिः कुरुपुंगवैः ॥
तत्र गच्छन्तु बहवः प्रवरा रथसत्तमाः । यावत्पार्थो न जानाति सात्यकिं बहुभिर्वृतम् ॥
ते त्वरध्वं यथा शूराः शराणां मोक्षणे भृशम् । यथा तूर्णं व्रजत्येष परलोकाय माधवः ॥
कर्णस्य मतमाज्ञाय पुत्रस्ते प्राह सौबलम् । यथेन्द्रः समरे राजन्प्राह विष्णुं यशस्विनम् ॥
data.md: Knowing this to be the opinion O, Karna, your son addressed Subala's son even as the highly illustrious Indra addressed Vishnu, on the field of battle.

data.v: वृतः सहस्रैर्दशभिर्गजानामनिवर्तिनाम् । रथैश्च दशसाहस्रैर्वृतो याहि धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: "Supported by a host of ten thousand unretreating elephants and also by detachment of ten thousand car-warriors, do you proceed against Dhananjaya.

data.v: दुःशासनो दुर्विषहः सुबाहुर्दुष्प्रधर्षणः । एते त्वामनुयास्यन्ति पत्तिभिर्बहुभिर्वृताः ॥
data.md: Dushasana Durvishaha, Subahu and Durshpradharshana these supported by numerous of infantry will follow you.

data.v: जहि कृष्णौ महाबाहो धर्मराजं च मातुल । नकुलं सहदेवं च भीमसेनं च भारत ॥
data.md: O my uncle, slay me those fierce bowmen, the two Krishnas the very virtuous king Yudhishthira and Nakula and Sahadeva and Pandu's son Bhimasena.

data.v: देवानामिव देवेन्द्रे जयाशा मे त्वयि स्थिता । जहि मातुल कौन्तेयानसुरानिव पावकिः ॥
data.md: My hopes of victory rest on you as those of the gods rest on their lord Indra. O uncle, slay the sons of Kunti, even as Pabaka's son slew the Asuras."

data.v: एवमुक्तो ययौ पार्थान्पुत्रेण तव सौबलः । महत्या सेनया सार्धं तव पुत्रैस्तथा विभो ॥
data.md: Thus addressed and urged on by your son, he (Subala's son) covered in mail, proceeded against the sons of Pritha, being himself supported by your sons and a large army.

data.v: प्रियार्थं तव पुत्राणां दिधक्षुः पाण्डुनन्दनान् । ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तावकानां परैः सह ॥
data.md: In order to do good to your sons, shrouded the Rakshasa (Ghatotkacha). Then, between the son of Drona and the Rakshas, again took place a battle.

data.v: प्रयाते सौबले राजन्पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् । बलेन महता युक्तः सूतपुत्रस्तु सात्वतम् ॥
data.md: When, O king, Subala's son had going against the (main) army of the Pandavas, the son of Suta supported by a mighty force, quickly rushed upon the Satvata hero in battle, shooting many hundreds of shafts. Your troops then gathering together encompassed Satyaki.

data.v: अभ्ययात्त्वरितं युद्धे किरञ्शरशतान्बहून् । तथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे सात्यकिं पर्यवारयन् ॥
data.md: When, O king, Subala's son had going against the (main) army of the Pandavas, the son of Suta supported by a mighty force, quickly rushed upon the Satvata hero in battle, shooting many hundreds of shafts. Your troops then gathering together encompassed Satyaki.

data.v: महद्युद्धं तदासीत्तु द्रोणस्य निशि भारत । धृष्टद्युम्नेन शूरेण पाञ्चालैश्च महात्मनः ॥
data.md: The son of Bharadvaja also advancing against Dhristadyumna's car commenced at that night, O foremost of Bharatas, a most terrible and wonderful battle with the heroic Dhristadyumna and the Panchalas.

data.v: ततस्ते प्राद्रवन्सर्वे त्वरिता युद्धदुर्मदाः । अमृष्यमाणाः संरब्धा युयुधानरथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then all those royal warriors of your army all indomitable in battle, furiously rushed against Yuyudhana's chariot, unable to brook his feats.

data.v: ते रथैः कल्पितै राजन्हेमरूप्यविभूषितैः । सादिभिश्च गजैश्चैव परिवव्रुः स्म सात्वतम् ॥
data.md: Those warriors then surrounded on all sides the Satvata hero, with duly-equipped chariots decked with gold and gems and with horsemen and elephants.

data.v: अथैनं कोष्ठकीकृत्य सर्वतस्ते महारथाः । सिंहनादांस्तदा चक्रुस्तर्जयन्तः स्म सात्यकिम् ॥
data.md: Having thus impaled the Satvata hero, all those mighty warriors filled the directions of the compass with the echo of their war-cries.

data.v: तेऽभ्यवर्षञ्शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम् । त्वरमाणा महावीर्या माधवस्य वधैषिणः ॥
data.md: Then those mighty heroes, desirous of achieving the slaughter of that scion of Madhu's race, began to pour showers of sharp arrows on Satyaki of infallible prowess.

data.v: तान्दृष्ट्वा पततस्तूर्णं शैनेयः परवीरहा । प्रत्यगृह्णान्महाबाहुः प्रमुञ्चन्विशिखान्बहून् ॥
data.md: Beholding then those heroes make towards himself in fury, that slayer of hostile heroes, that mighty-armed grandson of Shini, received them with a copious discharge of arrows.

data.v: तत्र वीरो महेष्वासः सात्यकिर्युद्धदुर्मदः । निचकर्त शिरांस्युग्रैः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥
data.md: Then that mighty bowman, the heroic Satyaki of indomitable prowess, began to lop off the heads of his foes with fierce shafts of depressed knots.

data.v: हस्तिहस्तान्हयग्रीवान्बाहूनपि च सायुधान् । क्षुरप्रैः पातयामास तावकानां स माधवः ॥
data.md: That scion of Madhu's race then severed with his razor-edged arrows, the trunks of elephants, the necks of horses and the arms of warriors decked with brace-lets.

data.v: पतितैश्चामरैश्चैव श्वेतच्छत्रैश्च भारत । बभूव धरणी पूर्णा नक्षत्रैर्द्यौरिव प्रभो ॥
data.md: The earth then over-strewn with shattered yak-tails and white umbrellas, looked, O king, as beautiful as the star-bespangled firmament,

data.v: तेषां तु युयुधानेन युध्यतां युधि भारत । बभूव तुमुलः शब्दः प्रेतानामिव क्रन्दताम् ॥
data.md: Thus when they were being thus slaughtered by Yuyudhana in battle, O Bharata, a tumultuous uproar was heard there like the yell or bewailing of ghosts.

data.v: तेन शब्देन महता पूरितासीद्वसुंधरा । रात्रिः समभवच्चैव तीव्ररूपा भयावहा ॥
data.md: With that terrible uproar the earth was filled and the night appeared to be more hideous and more frightful.

data.v: दीर्यमाणं बलं दृष्ट्वा युयुधानशराहतम् । श्रुत्वा च विपुलं नादं निशीथे लोमहर्षणम् ॥
data.md: Beholding the army routed and afflicted by the arrows of Yuyudhana and hearing in that nightly darkness that tremendous and horripilating uproar.

data.v: सुतस्तवाब्रवीद्राजन्सारथिं रथिनां वरः । यत्रैष शब्दस्तत्राश्वांश्चोदयेति पुनः पुनः ॥
data.md: Your son that foremost of car-warrior, O king, addressing his charioteer thus repeatedly spoke-"Drive, drive the steeds to the spot whence this tumult is proceeding.”

data.v: तेन संचोद्यमानस्तु ततस्तांस्तुरगोत्तमान् । सूतः संचोदयामास युयुधानरथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Then inspired by him that charioteer proceeded those excellent horses to the car of Yuyudhana. Then that resolute bowman that indefatigable warrior, king Duryodhana versed in various modes of warfare and endued with great lightness of hands, rushed upon Yuyudhana.

data.v: ततो दुर्योधनः क्रुद्धो दृढधन्वा जितक्लमः । शीघ्रहस्तश्चित्रयोधी युयुधानमुपाद्रवत् ॥
data.md: Then inspired by him that charioteer proceeded those excellent horses to the car of Yuyudhana. Then that resolute bowman that indefatigable warrior, king Duryodhana versed in various modes of warfare and endued with great lightness of hands, rushed upon Yuyudhana.

data.v: ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैर्मांसशोणितभोजनैः । दुर्योधनं द्वादशभिर्माधवः प्रत्यविध्यत ॥
data.md: Thereupon the scion of Madhu's race pierced Duryodhana with twelve shafts shot from a full-drawn bow and capable of drinking the blood and mangling the skin.

data.v: दुर्योधनस्तेन तथा पूर्वमेवार्दितः शरैः । शैनेयं दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यदमर्षितः ॥
data.md: Duryodhana then pierced as before with those arrows of Shini's grandsons, angrily pierced the latter with ten shafts in return.

data.v: ततः समभवद्युद्धमाकुलं भरतर्षभ । पाञ्चालानां च सर्वेषां भारतानां च दारुणम् ॥
data.md: Meanwhile the battle that was being fought between the Panchalas and your troops, presented a wonderful and harming aspect.

data.v: शैनेयस्तु रणे क्रुद्धस्तव पुत्रं महारथम् । सायकानामशीत्या तु विव्याधोरसि भारत ॥
data.md: O Bharata, then the grandson of Shini, worked up with rage, pierced your mighty son with a group of eighty shafts on the chest.

data.v: ततोऽस्य वाहान्समरे शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम् । सारथिं च रथात्तूर्णं पातयामास पत्रिणा ॥
data.md: Thereafter that slayer of foes dispatched to the abode of Death the horses of Duryodhana and he also felled quickly the charioteer of the latter.

data.v: हताश्वे तु रथे तिष्ठन्पुत्रस्तव विशां पते । मुमोच निशितान्बाणाञ्शैनेयस्य रथं प्रति ॥
data.md: O ruler of men, remaining in that steedless car, your son began to discharge sharp arrows towards the car of Shini's grandson.

data.v: शरान्पञ्चाशतस्तांस्तु शैनेयः कृतहस्तवत् । चिच्छेद समरे राजन्प्रेषितांस्तनयेन ते ॥
data.md: Then like one endued with great lightness of hands, Shinis' grandson, O king, cut-off the group of fifty arrows shot by your son in that battle.

data.v: अथापरेण भल्लेन मुष्टिदेशे महद्धनुः । चिच्छेद रभसो युद्धे तव पुत्रस्य मारिष ॥
data.md: The descendant of Madhu's race then cutoff the mighty bow of your son near the grasp, with broad-headed arrows shot with great force.

data.v: विरथो विधनुष्कश्च सर्वलोकेश्वरः प्रभुः । आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं भास्वरं कृतवर्मणः ॥
data.md: Deprived of his car and his bow, that lord, that ruler of all men, quickly ascended the resplendent car of Kritavarman.

data.v: दुर्योधने परावृत्ते शैनेयस्तव वाहिनीम् । द्रावयामास विशिखैर्निशामध्ये विशां पते ॥
data.md: When Duryodhana had been compelled to turn his face away from the battle, the grandson of Shini in that night began to crush your troops, O ruler of men.

data.v: शकुनिश्चार्जुनं राजन्परिवार्य समन्ततः । रथैरनेकसाहस्रैर्गजैश्चैव सहस्रशः । तथा हयसहस्रैश्च तुमुलं सर्वतोऽकरोत् ॥
data.md: O king, meanwhile Shakuni surrounding Arjuna on all sides with countless cars and thousands of elephants.

data.v: ते महास्त्राणि दिव्यानि विकिरन्तोऽर्जुनं प्रति । अर्जुनं योधयन्ति स्म क्षत्रियाः कालचोदिताः ॥
तान्यर्जुनः सहस्राणि रथवारणवाजिनाम् । प्रत्यवारयदायस्तः प्रकुर्वन्विपुलं क्षयम् ॥
ततस्तु समरे शूरः शकुनिः सौबलस्तदा । विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैरर्जुनं प्रहसन्निव ॥
पुनश्चैव शतेनास्य संरुरोध महारथम् । तमर्जुनस्तु विंशत्या विव्याध युधि भारत ॥
अथेतरान्महेष्वासांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरविध्यत । संवार्य तान्बाणगणैर्युधि राजन्धनंजयः । अवधीत्तावकान्योधान्वज्रपाणिरिवासुरान् ॥
data.md: O monarch, baffling the countless shafts shot by his foes, Dhananjaya slew the warriors of your army with excellent shafts charged with the force of the thunder.

data.v: भुजैश्छिन्नैर्महाराज शरीरैश्च सहस्रशः । समास्तीर्णा धरा तत्र बभौ पुष्पैरिवाचिता ॥
स विद्ध्वा शकुनिं भूयः पञ्चभिर्नतपर्वभिः । उलूकं त्रिभिराजघ्ने त्रिभिरेव महायसैः ॥
तमुलूकस्तथा विद्ध्वा वासुदेवमताडयत् । ननाद च महानादं पूरयन्वसुधातलम् ॥
अर्जुनस्तु द्रुतं गत्वा शकुनेर्धनुराच्छिनत् । निन्ये च चतुरो वाहान्यमस्य सदनं प्रति ॥
ततो रथादवप्लुत्य सौबलो भरतर्षभ । उलूकस्य रथं तूर्णमारुरोह विशां पते ॥
तावेकरथमारूढौ पितापुत्रौ महारथौ । पार्थं सिषिचतुर्बाणैर्गिरिं मेघाविवोत्थितौ ॥
तौ तु विद्ध्वा महाराज पाण्डवो निशितैः शरैः । विद्रावयंस्तव चमूं शतशो व्यधमच्छरैः ॥
अनिलेन यथाभ्राणि विच्छिन्नानि समन्ततः । विच्छिन्नानि तथा राजन्बलान्यासन्विशां पते ॥
तद्बलं भरतश्रेष्ठ वध्यमानं तथा निशि । प्रदुद्राव दिशः सर्वा वीक्षमाणं भयार्दितम् ॥
उत्सृज्य वाहान्समरे चोदयन्तस्तथापरे । संभ्रान्ताः पर्यधावन्त तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे ॥
विजित्य समरे योधांस्तावकान्भरतर्षभ । दध्मतुर्मुदितौ शङ्खौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ ॥
धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज द्रोणं विद्ध्वा त्रिभिः शरैः । चिच्छेद धनुषस्तूर्णं ज्यां शरेण शितेन ह ॥
तन्निधाय धनुर्नीडे द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः । आददेऽन्यद्धनुः शूरो वेगवत्सारवत्तरम् ॥
धृष्टद्युम्नं ततो द्रोणो विद्ध्वा सप्तभिराशुगैः । सारथिं पञ्चभिर्बाणै राजन्विव्याध संयुगे ॥
तं निवार्य शरैस्तूर्णं धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः । व्यधमत्कौरवीं सेनां शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
वध्यमाने बले तस्मिंस्तव पुत्रस्य मारिष । प्रावर्तत नदी घोरा शोणितौघतरङ्गिणी ॥
उभयोः सेनयोर्मध्ये नराश्वद्विपवाहिनी । यथा वैतरणी राजन्यमराष्ट्रपुरं प्रति ॥
द्रावयित्वा तु तत्सैन्यं धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान् । अत्यराजत तेजस्वी शक्रो देवगणेष्विव ॥
अथ दध्मुर्महाशङ्खान्धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डिनौ । यमौ च युयुधानश्च पाण्डवश्च वृकोदरः ॥
जित्वा रथसहस्राणि तावकानां महारथाः । सिंहनादरवांश्चक्रुः पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः ॥
पश्यतस्तव पुत्रस्य कर्णस्य च मदोत्कटाः । तथा द्रोणस्य शूरस्य द्रौणेश्चैव विशां पते ॥
data.md: The Pandavas ever attended with victory uttered dreadful war-cries, even before the eyes of your son and Karna and the heroic Drona and the son of Drona, O ruler of men.

data.v: विद्रुतं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा वध्यमानं महात्मभिः । क्रोधेन महताविष्टः पुत्रस्तव विशां पते ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Beholding his own army carnaged by highsouled warriors, your son, O ruler of men, was excited to the highest pitch of fury.

data.v: अभ्येत्य सहसा कर्णं द्रोणं च जयतां वरम् । अमर्षवशमापन्नो वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Then quickly approaching Karna and Drona that foremost of victorious heroes and burning with rage, he eloquent in speech, spoke these wordsभवद्भ्यामिह संग्रामः क्रुद्धाभ्यां सम्प्रवर्तितः।

data.v: भवद्भ्यामिह संग्रामो क्रुद्धाभ्यां संप्रवर्तितः । आहवे निहतं दृष्ट्वा सैन्धवं सव्यसाचिना ॥
निहन्यमानां पाण्डूनां बलेन मम वाहिनीम् । भूत्वा तद्विजये शक्तावशक्ताविव पश्यतः ॥
data.md: Though competent to slay the Pandava troops, still you are beholding the slaughter of my troops by them with great in-difference.

data.v: यद्यहं भवतोस्त्याज्यो न वाच्योऽस्मि तदैव हि । आवां पाण्डुसुतान्संख्ये जेष्याव इति मानदौ ॥
data.md: If you now abandon me, you should have told me of it in the beginning. We two shall vanquish the sons of Pandu in battle even these were the words, you said to me, o you givers of honor. Hearing those words of yours, I then allowed these proceedings. Otherwise I would never have provoked these hostilities with the Parthas-hostilities that are so destructive of heroic combatants.

data.v: तदैवाहं वचः श्रुत्वा भवद्भ्यामनुसंमतम् । कृतवान्पाण्डवैः सार्धं वैरं योधविनाशनम् ॥
यदि नाहं परित्याज्यो भवद्भ्यां पुरुषर्षभौ । युध्येतामनुरूपेण विक्रमेण सुविक्रमौ ॥
data.md: If, O foremost of men, I do not deserve to be forsaken by you, then do you fight according to the measure of your prowess, O you that are possessed of great prowess.

data.v: वाक्प्रतोदेन तौ वीरौ प्रणुन्नौ तनयेन ते । प्रावर्तयेतां तौ युद्धं घट्टिताविव पन्नगौ ॥
data.md: Thus pierced with the goad of speech by your son, those two heroes once more engaged in battle like two snakes poked with sticks.

data.v: ततस्तौ रथिनां श्रेष्ठौ सर्वलोकधनुर्धरौ । शैनेयप्रमुखान्पार्थानभिदुद्रुवतू रणे ॥
data.md: Then those two foremost of car-warriors, the best of all human bowmen, rushed against the Parthas headed by the grandson of Shini and others.

data.v: तथैव सहिताः पार्थाः स्वेन सैन्येन संवृताः । अभ्यवर्तन्त तौ वीरौ नर्दमानौ मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
data.md: Similarly the Parthas supported by their own troops, rushed upon those two heroes, who were roaring repeatedly.

data.md: The resplendent Sakti, resembling a mighty meteor, obtained by him from Vasava is still in his possession, o mighty armed one, kept carefully to be used against yourself by this son Suta.

data.v: घटोत्कचस्तु राधेयं प्रत्युद्यातु महाबलः । स हि भीमेन बलिना जातः सुरपराक्रमः ॥
तस्मिन्नस्त्राणि दिव्यानि राक्षसान्यासुराणि च । सततं चानुरक्तो वो हितैषी च घटोत्कचः । विजेष्यति रणे कर्णमिति मे नात्र संशयः ॥
data.md: Therefore let the mighty Ghatotkacha charge the son of Radha. That one of prowess resembling that of an immortal, was begotten by Bhima and he is conversant with numerous celestial, Asuri and Rakshasa-weapons. I am sure, he will conquer Karna in battle.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुः पार्थं पुष्करलोचनः । आजुहावाथ तद्रक्षः तच्चासीत्प्रादुरग्रतः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to the mighty-armed Partha possessed of eyes resembling lotus petals, summoned the Rakshasa. Thereupon the Rakshasa appeared before him.

data.v: कवची स शरी खड्गी सधन्वा च विशां पते । अभिवाद्य ततः कृष्णं पाण्डवं च धनंजयम् । अब्रवीत्तं तदा हृष्टस्त्वयमस्म्यनुशाधि माम् ॥
data.md: Cased in armour and armed with bows arrows and a sword, O ruler of men. Then doing obeisance to Krishna and Pandu's son Dhananjaya.

data.v: ततस्तं मेघसंकाशं दीप्तास्यं दीप्तकुण्डलम् । अभ्यभाषत हैडिम्बं दाशार्हः प्रहसन्निव ॥
data.md: He proudly said-"Here am I order me.” Thereupon the descendant of the Dasarha race Krishna, addressing Hidimva's son of the complexion of clouds, of effulgent countenance and fiery eyes smilingly said these words.

data.v: घटोत्कच विजानीहि यत्त्वां वक्ष्यामि पुत्रक । प्राप्तो विक्रमकालोऽयं तव नान्यस्य कस्यचित् ॥
data.md: Vasudeva said Take my blessings, O Ghatotkacha, hear attentively what I now say to you. The hour for the display of your prowess and of no one else has now arrived.

data.v: स भवान्मज्जमानानां बन्धूनां त्वं प्लवो यथा । विविधानि तवास्त्राणि सन्ति माया च राक्षसी ॥
data.md: Do you become the raft in this battle to the sinking Pandavas. You possess weapons of various kinds and the potent Rakshasi illusion.

data.v: पश्य कर्णेन हैडिम्ब पाण्डवानामनीकिनी । काल्यमाना यथा गावः पालेन रणमूर्धनि ॥
data.md: Behold, O son of Hidimba, the hosts of the Pandavas afflicted by Karna in battle like a herd of kine belaboured by the keeper.

data.v: एष कर्णो महेष्वासो मतिमान्दृढविक्रमः । पाण्डवानामनीकेषु निहन्ति क्षत्रियर्षभान् ॥
data.md: Yonder does the mighty bowman Karna of great intelligence and resolute prowess, burn the foremost of the Kshatriyas of the Pandava host.

data.v: किरन्तः शरवर्षाणि महान्ति दृढधन्विनः । न शक्नुवन्त्यवस्थातुं पीड्यमानाः शरार्चिषा ॥
data.md: Scorched with his fiery arrows the Pandava warrior cannot stand before that resolute bowman who is shooting numerous arrows.

data.v: निशीथे सूतपुत्रेण शरवर्षेण पीडिताः । एते द्रवन्ति पाञ्चालाः सिंहस्येव भयान्मृगाः ॥
data.md: Afflicted at the dead of night with showers of arrows shot by the son of Suta, yonder are the Panchalas flying away like a flock of deer attacked by the lion.

data.v: एतस्यैवं प्रवृद्धस्य सूतपुत्रस्य संयुगे । निषेद्धा विद्यते नान्यस्त्वदृते भीमविक्रम ॥
data.md: Save yourself, O you of dreadful prowess, no one else is none who can confront Suta's son in battle thus engaged.

data.v: स त्वं कुरु महाबाहो कर्म युक्तमिहात्मनः । मातुलानां पितॄणां च तेजसोऽस्त्रबलस्य च ॥
data.md: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, do you now perform what will be worthy of yourself, your maternal uncles, your sires and the measure of your energy and might.

data.v: एतदर्थं हि हैडिम्ब पुत्रानिच्छन्ति मानवाः । कथं नस्तारयेद्दुःखात्स त्वं तारय बान्धवान् ॥
data.md: It is for saving them from difficulties, that men desire to have sons; O son of Hidimba, do you therefore, rescue your fathers and friends.

data.v: तव ह्यस्त्रबलं भीमं मायाश्च तव दुस्तराः । संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य सततं भीमनन्दन ॥
data.md: You are generous and your strength in battle is indeed terrible and matchless. While engaged in battle, there is none else equal to you.

data.v: पाण्डवानां प्रभग्नानां कर्णेन शितसायकैः । मज्जतां धार्तराष्ट्रेषु भव पारं परंतप ॥
data.md: O afflicter of your foes, do you become the raft for the Pandavas when they are being routed in this hour of night by the shafts of Karna and when they are sinking in the ocean identified with the Dhartarashtra troops.

data.v: रात्रौ हि राक्षसा भूयो भवन्त्यमितविक्रमाः । बलवन्तः सुदुर्धर्षाः शूरा विक्रान्तचारिणः ॥
data.md: Moreover, at night the Rakshasas become possessed of immeasurable prowess; the Rakshasas are by nature powerful, indomitable, heroic and energetic in battle.
