data.v: जहि कर्णं महेष्वासं निशीथे मायया रणे । पार्था द्रोणं वधिष्यन्ति धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः ॥
data.md: With the help of your illusions do you kill the fierce bowman Karna in this nocturnal fight. The of Pritha headed by Dhristadyumna will slay Drona in battle.

data.v: केशवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा बीभत्सुरपि राक्षसम् । अभ्यभाषत कौरव्य घटोत्कचमरिंदमम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Hearing the words of Kesava, Vibhatsu also addressing that Rakshasa, that slayer of foes viz., Ghatotkacha said, O foremost of the Kurus, these words.

data.v: घटोत्कच भवांश्चैव दीर्घबाहुश्च सात्यकिः । मतौ मे सर्वसैन्येषु भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः ॥
data.md: 0 Ghatotkacha, yourself, the long-armed Satyaki and the Pandava Bhimasena, these, according to my opinion, are the foremost among all our troops.

data.v: स भवान्यातु कर्णेन द्वैरथं युध्यतां निशि । सात्यकिः पृष्ठगोपस्ते भविष्यति महारथः ॥
data.md: In this nocturnal fight do you therefore sons warrior Satyaki will become your protect or from behind.

data.v: जहि कर्णं रणे शूरं सात्वतेन सहायवान् । यथेन्द्रस्तारकं पूर्वं स्कन्देन सह जघ्निवान् ॥
data.md: Supported by the Satvata hero, do you slay the heroic Karna in battle, even as Indra supported by Skanda slew Taraka in days gone by.”

data.v: अलमेवास्मि कर्णाय द्रोणायालं च सत्तम । अन्येषां क्षत्रियाणां च कृतास्त्राणां महात्मनाम् ॥
data.md: Ghatotkacha said I am capable of encountering Karna and Drona, O Bharata and I am a match for all the other high-souled Kshatriyas accomplished in the use of weapons.

data.v: अद्य दास्यामि संग्रामं सूतपुत्राय तं निशि । यं जनाः संप्रवक्ष्यन्ति यावद्भूमिर्धरिष्यति ॥
data.md: This night, I shall fight such a fierce battle with the son of Suta, of which men will talk as long as the earth will exit.

data.v: न चात्र शूरान्मोक्ष्यामि न भीतान्न कृताञ्जलीन् । सर्वानेव वधिष्यामि राक्षसं धर्ममास्थितः ॥
data.md: Following the Rakshasa mode, I shall not spare this time any body, either the brave or the coward or those that will with folded palms, solicit mercy. I shall slay all folded palms, solicit mercy. I shall slay all.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्हैडिम्बः परवीरहा । अभ्ययात्तुमुले कर्णं तव सैन्यं विभीषयन् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, that slayer of hostile heroes namely the mighty-armed son of Hidimba, dashed against Karna, in that fierce fight, frightening your troops.

data.v: तमापतन्तं संक्रुद्धं दीप्तास्यमिव पन्नगम् । अभ्यस्यन्परमेष्वासः प्रतिजग्राह सूतजः ॥
data.md: Then that foremost of men that son of Suta smilingly received Ghatotkacha of blazing countenance and burning locks, as the latter was furiously falling upon him.

data.v: तयोः समभवद्युद्धं कर्णराक्षसयोर्निशि । गर्जतो राजशार्दूल शक्रप्रह्रादयोरिव ॥
data.md: Then the battle between those two roaring heroes, viz., Karna and that Rakshasa, commenced resembling O foremost of kings that between Shakra and Pralhada in days gone by.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा घटोत्कचं राजन्सूतपुत्ररथं प्रति । प्रयान्तं त्वरया युक्तं जिघांसुं कर्णमाहवे ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then, O monarch, beholding the mightyarmed Ghatotkacha, rush against the car of Suta's son Karna, with a view to slaughter him,

data.v: अब्रवीत्तव पुत्रस्तु दुःशासनमिदं वचः । एतद्रक्षो रणे तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य विक्रमम् ॥
data.md: Your Duryodhana addressing Dushasana said these works "Beholding Karna's prowess in battle, yonder does the Rakshasa

data.v: अभियाति द्रुतं कर्णं तद्वारय महारथम् । वृतः सैन्येन महता याहि यत्र महाबलः ॥
data.md: Rush against that mighty car-warrior, Do you check the Rakshasa's progress; supported by mighty divisions do you go to the spot where the highly powerful.

data.v: कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे राक्षसेन युयुत्सति । रक्ष कर्णं रणे यत्तो वृतः सैन्येन मानद ॥
data.md: Karna the son of Vikartana is fighting with the Rakshasa. O bestower of honor, putting forth your best energies in battle and supported by the troops do you protect Karna in battle.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजञ्जटासुरसुतो बली । दुर्योधनमुपागम्य प्राह प्रहरतां वरः ॥
दुर्योधन तवामित्रान्प्रख्यातान्युद्धदुर्मदान् । पाण्डवान्हन्तुमिच्छामि त्वयाज्ञप्तः सहानुगान् ॥
data.md: That best of smiters, approaching Duryodhana said these words-"O Duryodhana, with your permission, do I intend to slay the Pandava brothers and their followers who are your inveterate enemies and who are regarded as indomitable in battle. My father was Jatasura that foremost of the Rakshasas, endued with great prowess.

data.v: जटासुरो मम पिता रक्षसामग्रणीः पुरा । प्रयुज्य कर्म रक्षोघ्नं क्षुद्रैः पार्थैर्निपातितः । तस्यापचितिमिच्छामि त्वद्दिष्टो गन्तुमीश्वर ॥
तमब्रवीत्ततो राजा प्रीयमाणः पुनः पुनः । द्रोणकर्णादिभिः सार्धं पर्याप्तोऽहं द्विषद्वधे । त्वं तु गच्छ मयाज्ञप्तो जहि युद्धं घटोत्कचम् ॥
data.md: As also with their flesh. O foremost of kings, it behoves you to accord me your permission.” Thereupon king Duryodhana, highly gratified, repeatedly told these words to

data.v: तथेत्युक्त्वा महाकायः समाहूय घटोत्कचम् । जटासुरिर्भैमसेनिं नानाशस्त्रैरवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Staying himself all the while in the firmament, go dispatch him to Yama's (dreary) place.” Then that huge-bodied son of Jatasura saying “yea' to his words, challenged Ghatotkacha.

data.v: अलंबलं च कर्णं च कुरुसैन्यं च दुस्तरम् । हैडिम्बः प्रममाथैको महावातोऽम्बुदानिव ॥
ततो मायामयं दृष्ट्वा रथं तूर्णमलंबलः । घटोत्कचं शरव्रातैर्नानालिङ्गैः समार्दयत् ॥
विद्ध्वा च बहुभिर्बाणैर्भैमसेनिमलंबलः । व्यद्रावयच्छरव्रातैः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् ॥
data.md: Quickly covered him with myriads of shafts. Piercing the son of Bhimasena with numerous arrows, Alambusha.

data.v: तेन विद्राव्यमाणानि पाण्डुसैन्यानि मारिष । निशीथे विप्रकीर्यन्त वातनुन्ना घना इव ॥
data.md: With his arrows, caused the Pandava armies to be routed. Routed by him the Pandavas troops, O Bharata.

data.v: घटोत्कचशरैर्नुन्ना तथैव कुरुवाहिनी । निशीथे प्राद्रवद्राजन्नुत्सृज्योल्काः सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: Began to disperse in that night, like masses of clouds torn away by a furious gale. Similarly your troops mangled with the arrows of Ghatotkacha.

data.v: अलंबलस्ततः क्रुद्धो भैमसेनिं महामृधे । आजघ्ने निशितैर्बाणैस्तोत्त्रैरिव महाद्विपम् ॥
तिलशस्तस्य तद्यानं सूतं सर्वायुधानि च । घटोत्कचः प्रचिच्छेद प्राणदच्चातिदारुणम् ॥
ततः कर्णं शरव्रातैः कुरूनन्यान्सहस्रशः । अलंबलं चाभ्यवर्षन्मेघो मेरुमिवाचलम् ॥
ततः संचुक्षुभे सैन्यं कुरूणां राक्षसार्दितम् । उपर्युपरि चान्योन्यं चतुरङ्गं ममर्द ह ॥
जटासुरिर्महाराज विरथो हतसारथिः । घटोत्कचं रणे क्रुद्धो मुष्टिनाभ्यहनद्दृढम् ॥
data.md: The four kinds of forces of which your army consisted, began to press and crush one another. Then the son of Jatasura deprived of his car and driver.

data.v: मुष्टिनाभिहतस्तेन प्रचचाल घटोत्कचः । क्षितिकम्पे यथा शैलः सवृक्षगणगुल्मवान् ॥
data.md: Wrathfully struck Ghatotkacha in that battle with his bare fists. Thus struck Ghatotkacha trembled.

data.v: ततः स परिघाभेन द्विट्संघघ्नेन बाहुना । जटासुरिं भैमसेनिरवधीन्मुष्टिना भृशम् ॥
तं प्रमथ्य ततः क्रुद्धस्तूर्णं हैडिम्बिराक्षिपत् । दोर्भ्यामिन्द्रध्वजाभाभ्यां निष्पिपेष महीतले ॥
data.md: Like a mountain with its trees, creepers and grass at the time of an earth-quake. Then the son of Bhimasena furious with rage, raising his own foe-slaying arm that resembled bludgeon, dealt a severe blow to Jatasura's son; thus furiously crushing him, the son of Hidimba quickly threw him down.

data.v: अलंबलोऽपि विक्षिप्य समुत्क्षिप्य च राक्षसम् । घटोत्कचं रणे रोषान्निष्पिपेष महीतले ॥
data.md: Once more rose up quickly and rushed furiously upon the latter. Alambusha also, throwing down and dragging the Rakshasa.

data.v: तयोः समभवद्युद्धं गर्जतोरतिकाययोः । घटोत्कचालंबलयोस्तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् ॥
data.md: Ghatotkacha, out of rage began to press him against the earth. Then between those two roaring heroes of huge proportion, namely Ghatotkacha and Alambusha, a battle raged that was extremely terrible and horripilating. Then those highly proud heroes, each desirous of getting advantage over the other by means of their illusive powers.

data.v: विशेषयन्तावन्योन्यं मायाभिरतिमायिनौ । युयुधाते महावीर्याविन्द्रवैरोचनाविव ॥
data.md: Ghatotkacha, out of rage began to press him against the earth. Then between those two roaring heroes of huge proportion, namely Ghatotkacha and Alambusha, a battle raged that was extremely terrible and horripilating. Then those highly proud heroes, each desirous of getting advantage over the other by means of their illusive powers.

data.v: पावकाम्बुनिधी भूत्वा पुनर्गरुडतक्षकौ । पुनर्मेघमहावातौ पुनर्वज्रमहाचलौ । पुनः कुञ्जरशार्दूलौ पुनः स्वर्भानुभास्करौ ॥
data.md: Fought on with great fury like the puissant Indra and the son of Virochana. Becoming fire and the ocean, again Garuda and Takshaka.

data.v: एवं मायाशतसृजावन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणौ । भृशं चित्रमयुध्येतामलंबलघटोत्कचौ ॥
परिघैश्च गदाभिश्च प्रासमुद्गरपट्टिशैः । मुसलैः पर्वताग्रैश्च तावन्योन्यं निजघ्नतुः ॥
data.md: They thus exhibited a hundred different kinds of illusions, desirous of compassing each other's destruction. Indeed Alambusha and Ghatotkacha fought most wonderfully, with bludgeons and maces and lances and mallets and battle axes and clubs and crests of mountains, they then struck each other.

data.v: हयाभ्यां च गजाभ्यां च पदातिरथिनौ पुनः । युयुधाते महामायौ राक्षसप्रवरौ युधि ॥
data.md: Riding on the back of elephants or horses or on their chariots, those foremost of Rakshasas both possessed of potent illusive powers, fought with each other in that battle.

data.v: ततो घटोत्कचो राजन्नलंबलवधेप्सया । उत्पपात भृशं क्रुद्धः श्येनवन्निपपात ह ॥
data.md: Thereafter, king Ghatotkacha, impelled by a desire for killing Alambusha and excited to the highest pitch of fury soared aloft and then came down even like a hawk.

data.v: गृहीत्वा च महाकायं राक्षसेन्द्रमलंबलम् । उद्यम्य न्यवधीद्भूमौ मयं विष्णुरिवाहवे ॥
data.md: Then seizing that foremost of the Rakshasas, namely, the huge-bodied Alambusha, he raised him high and then dashed him against the earth, like Vishnu dashing Maya against the ground.

data.v: ततो घटोत्कचः खड्गमुद्गृह्याद्भुतदर्शनम् । चकर्त कायाद्धि शिरो भीमं विकृतदर्शनम् ॥
तच्छिरो रुधिराभ्यक्तं गृह्य केशेषु राक्षसः । घटोत्कचो ययावाशु दुर्योधनरथं प्रति ॥
अभ्येत्य च महाबाहुः स्मयमानः स राक्षसः । रथेऽस्य निक्षिप्य शिरो विकृताननमूर्धजम् । प्राणदद्भैरवं नादं प्रावृषीव बलाहकः ॥
data.md: Then the mighty-armed Rakshasa, approaching the car, smilingly threw that head with contorted aspect and dishevelied hair in that car of the king.

data.v: अब्रवीच्च ततो राजन्दुर्योधनमिदं वचः । एष ते निहतो बन्धुस्त्वया दृष्टोऽस्य विक्रमः । पुनर्द्रष्टासि कर्णस्य निष्ठामेतां तथात्मनः ॥
data.md: Here is your friend slain whose prowess you have witnessed yourself. You are destined to see the death of Karna and that of your ownself.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा ततः प्रायात्कर्णं प्रति जनेश्वर । किरञ्शरशतांस्तीक्ष्णान्विमुञ्चन्कर्णमूर्धनि ॥
ततः समभवद्युद्धं घोररूपं भयानकम् । विस्मापनं महाराज नरराक्षसयोर्मृधे ॥
data.md: Scattering hundreds of sharp arrows and directing them at the head of Karna. Then, O mighty monarch, a battle of terrible aspect and great fierceness commenced between the human hero and the Rakshasa-battle that filled every heart with great admiration.

data.v: यत्र वैकर्तनः कर्णो राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः । निशीथे समसज्जेतां तद्युद्धमभवत्कथम् ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said How did that battle between Vikartarna's son Kama and the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha rage at that dead of night when they encountered each other?

data.v: कीदृशं चाभवद्युद्धं तस्य घोरस्य रक्षसः । रथश्च कीदृशस्तस्य मायाः सर्वायुधानि च ॥
data.md: What appearance did that terrible Rakshasa then assume? How looked his car and his steeds and what was the nature of his weapons?

data.v: किंप्रमाणा हयास्तस्य रथकेतुर्धनुस्तथा । कीदृशं वर्म चैवास्य कण्ठत्राणं च कीदृशम् । पृष्टस्त्वमेतदाचक्ष्व कुशलो ह्यसि संजय ॥
data.md: What was the measure of his horses, his standard and his bow? What kind of armour and head-gear did he then wear? O Sanjaya, expert as you are in the art of narration, tell me all this as I am asking you about them.

data.v: लोहिताक्षो महाकायस्ताम्रास्यो निम्नितोदरः । ऊर्ध्वरोमा हरिश्मश्रुः शङ्कुकर्णो महाहनुः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Ghatotkacha was of gigantic proportion; his eyes were crimson; the hue of his countenance was coppery; his belly was low and sunk. The hair on his body were erect, his head was green; his ears were straight like shafts; and his check bones were high.

data.v: आकर्णाद्दारितास्यश्च तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रः करालवान् । सुदीर्घताम्रजिह्वोष्ठो लम्बभ्रूः स्थूलनासिकः ॥
नीलाङ्गो लोहितग्रीवो गिरिवर्ष्मा भयंकरः । महाकायो महाबाहुर्महाशीर्षो महाबलः ॥
विकचः परुषस्पर्शो विकटोद्बद्धपिण्डिकः । स्थूलस्फिग्गूढनाभिश्च शिथिलोपचयो महान् ॥
तथैव हस्ताभरणी महामायोऽङ्गदी तथा । उरसा धारयन्निष्कमग्निमालां यथाचलः ॥
तस्य हेममयं चित्रं बहुरूपाङ्गशोभितम् । तोरणप्रतिमं शुभ्रं किरीटं मूर्ध्न्यशोभत ॥
कुण्डले बालसूर्याभे मालां हेममयीं शुभाम् । धारयन्विपुलं कांस्यं कवचं च महाप्रभम् ॥
data.md: His ear-rings were effulgent like the morning sun and his garlands were of gold and exceedingly bright. His body was cased in a massive brazen armour of great effulgence.

data.v: किङ्किणीशतनिर्घोषं रक्तध्वजपताकिनम् । ऋक्षचर्मावनद्धाङ्गं नल्वमात्रं महारथम् ॥
data.md: His chariot of gigantic size and of the measure of a Nalva and covered with bear-skin was adorned with a hundred tinkling bells and from its standard fluttered numerous crimson banners.

data.v: सर्वायुधवरोपेतमास्थितो ध्वजमालिनम् । अष्टचक्रसमायुक्तं मेघगम्भीरनिस्वनम् ॥
data.md: It was well furnished with all sorts of weapons, offensive and defensive and was decked with a festoon of bannerets. It possessed eight wheels and its clatter resembled the deep rumble of rain-clouds.

data.v: तत्र मातङ्गसंकाशा लोहिताक्षा विभीषणाः । कामवर्णजवा युक्ता बलवन्तोऽवहन्हयाः ॥
data.md: The horses yoked thereto were stout mettled, of chequered complexion, fleet, of red eyed and like infuriate elephants.

data.v: राक्षसोऽस्य विरूपाक्षः सूतो दीप्तास्यकुण्डलः । रश्मिभिः सूर्यरश्म्याभैः संजग्राह हयान्रणे । स तेन सहितस्तस्थावरुणेन यथा रविः ॥
data.md: A Rakshasa of frightful eyes and decked with bright ear-rings and possessing a fierce mouth acted as his charioteer, checking the horses by the rains that were as bright as the rays of the sun.

data.v: संसक्त इव चाभ्रेण यथाद्रिर्महता महान् । दिवस्पृक्सुमहान्केतुः स्यन्दनेऽस्य समुच्छ्रितः । रक्तोत्तमाङ्गः क्रव्यादो गृध्रः परमभीषणः ॥
data.md: A huge standard, touching the very clouds was set upon his chariot. A dreadful vulture of crimson body and flash-eating was the device on his standards.

data.v: वासवाशनिनिर्घोषं दृढज्यमभिविक्षिपन् । व्यक्तं किष्कुपरीणाहं द्वादशारत्नि कार्मुकम् ॥
data.md: The Rakshasa then advanced, forcibly stretching his bow of which the twang resembled the rattle of Indra's thunder and the string was very though and which measured twelve Aranis in length and one in breadth

data.v: रथाक्षमात्रैरिषुभिः सर्वाः प्रच्छादयन्दिशः । तस्यां वीरापहारिण्यां निशायां कर्णमभ्ययात् ॥
data.md: Filling all the quarters of the heaven with arrows of the measures of the Aksha of a car, the Rakshasa assailed Karna in that night that witnessed the destruction of so many heroes.

data.v: तस्य विक्षिपतश्चापं रथे विष्टभ्य तिष्ठतः । अश्रूयत धनुर्घोषो विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः ॥
data.md: Proudly seated on his car, as he stretched his bow, the twang that was heard resembled the rumble of the roaring thunder.

data.v: तेन वित्रास्यमानानि तव सैन्यानि भारत । समकम्पन्त सर्वाणि सिन्धोरिव महोर्मयः ॥
data.md: Frightened at that sound, your troops O Bharata, trembled like the surging billows of the sea.

data.v: तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य विरूपाक्षं विभीषणम् । उत्स्मयन्निव राधेयस्त्वरमाणोऽभ्यवारयत् ॥
data.md: Beholding that one of frightful eyes and dreadful aspect rush towards himself, the son of Radha quickly withstood him in all cheerfulness.

data.v: ततः कर्णोऽभ्ययादेनमस्यन्नस्यन्तमन्तिकात् । मातङ्ग इव मातङ्गं यूथर्षभ इवर्षभम् ॥
data.md: Karna then advanced against the smiting Rakshasa smiting him in return from a near point, like an elephant rushing against another or a bull charging another.

data.v: स संनिपातस्तुमुलस्तयोरासीद्विशां पते । कर्णराक्षसयो राजन्निन्द्रशम्बरयोरिव ॥
data.md: Then the dreadful collision, o mighty monarch, that took place between Karna and the Rakshasa, resembled ( ruler of men that between Shakra and Samvara (in days gone by).

data.v: तौ प्रगृह्य महावेगे धनुषी भीमनिस्वने । प्राच्छादयेतामन्योन्यं तक्षमाणौ महेषुभिः ॥
data.md: Each then grasping a fearful bow of loud twang began to wound and cover the other with mighty shafts.

data.v: ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः । न्यवारयेतामन्योन्यं कांस्ये निर्भिद्य वर्मणी ॥
data.md: Then penetrating each other's brazen armours, they pierced each other with shafts of depressed knots, shot from bows drawn to the fullest stretch.

data.v: तौ नखैरिव शार्दूलौ दन्तैरिव महाद्विपौ । रथशक्तिभिरन्योन्यं विशिखैश्च ततक्षतुः ॥
data.md: Then like two tigers mangling each other with claws or two elephants with their tusks, they mangled each other with their lances and arrows and javelins.

data.v: संछिन्दन्तौ हि गात्राणि संदधानौ च सायकान् । धक्ष्यमाणौ शरव्रातैर्नोदीक्षितुमशक्नुताम् ॥
तौ तु विक्षतसर्वाङ्गौ रुधिरौघपरिप्लुतौ । व्यभ्राजेतां यथा वारिप्रस्रुतौ गैरिकाचलौ ॥
data.md: Covered with arrow-wounds all over the body and steeped in torrents of blood, they both looked beautiful like two hills of red chalk with rivulets flowing down their sides.

data.v: तौ शराग्रविभिन्नाङ्गौ निर्भिन्दन्तौ परस्परम् । नाकम्पयेतामन्योन्यं यतमानौ महाद्युती ॥
data.md: Those two mighty car-warriors, though they were striving hard and each had his limbs torn open with points of shafts, could not make each other flinch or tremble.

data.v: तत्प्रवृत्तं निशायुद्धं चिरं सममिवाभवत् । प्राणयोर्दीव्यतो राजन्कर्णराक्षसयोर्मृधे ॥
data.md: That nocturnal combat between Karna and the Rakshasa, with both regarded as a game having their lives for the stake, seemed for a long time to be a equal one.

data.v: तस्य संदधतस्तीक्ष्णाञ्शरांश्चासक्तमस्यतः । धनुर्घोषेण वित्रस्ताः स्वे परे च तदाभवन् । घटोत्कचं यदा कर्णो विशेषयति नो नृप ॥
data.md: As Ghatotkacha placed keen shafts on his string and as he let them off, his foes and friends alike became terrified with the twang of his bow.

data.v: ततः प्रादुष्करोद्दिव्यमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः । कर्णेन विहितं दृष्ट्वा दिव्यमस्त्रं घटोत्कचः । प्रादुश्चक्रे महामायां राक्षसः पाण्डुनन्दनः ॥
शूलमुद्गरधारिण्या शैलपादपहस्तया । रक्षसां घोररूपाणां महत्या सेनया वृतः ॥
data.md: Instantly he was encircled by a numerous force of dreadful looking Rakshasas armed with lances and large rocks and stones and clubs.

data.v: तमुद्यतमहाचापं दृष्ट्वा ते व्यथिता नृपाः । भूतान्तकमिवायान्तं कालदण्डोग्रधारिणम् ॥
data.md: Beholding the Rakshasa come with an uplifted weapon like the Destroyer of beings armed with his fatal bludgeon, all the kings of your host were filled with terror.

data.v: घटोत्कचप्रमुक्तेन सिंहनादेन भीषिताः । प्रसुस्रुवुर्गजा मूत्रं विव्यथुश्च नरा भृशम् ॥
data.md: Frightened at the war-cries uttered by Ghatotkacha the elephants discharged urine and men were sorely afflicted.

data.v: ततोऽश्मवृष्टिरत्युग्रा महत्यासीत्समन्ततः । अर्धरात्रेऽधिकबलैर्विमुक्ता रक्षसां बलैः ॥
data.md: Then a mighty shower of rocks and stones fell on all sides, being poured incessantly by the Rakshasas, who had acquired greater strength, in consequence of the hour being mid-night.

data.v: आयसानि च चक्राणि भुशुण्ड्यः शक्तितोमराः । पतन्त्यविरलाः शूलाः शतघ्न्यः पट्टिशास्तथा ॥
data.md: Iron wheels, Bhusundis, javelins, lances and spears and Shataghnis and battle axes, then began to fall in torrents.

data.v: तदुग्रमतिरौद्रं च दृष्ट्वा युद्धं नराधिपाः । पुत्राश्च तव योधाश्च व्यथिता विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥
data.md: Then beholding that battle fierce to the extreme, your son and your warriors sorely afflicted (with terror) took to their heels.

data.v: तत्रैकोऽस्त्रबलश्लाघी कर्णो मानी न विव्यथे । व्यधमच्च शरैर्मायां घटोत्कचविनिर्मिताम् ॥
data.md: The proud Karna alone, ever boastful of strength of his weapons, was not terrified and he continued to stay on the field, baffling with his arrows the illusions displayed by Ghatotkacha. Ghatotkacha then discharged dreadful arrows for compassing the death of Suta's son.

data.v: मायायां तु प्रहीणायाममर्षात्स घटोत्कचः । विससर्ज शरान्घोरान्सूतपुत्रं त आविशन् ॥
ततस्ते रुधिराभ्यक्ता भित्त्वा कर्णं महाहवे । विविशुर्धरणीं बाणाः संक्रुद्धा इव पन्नगाः ॥
data.md: Then those arrows piercing through Karna and steeped in blood entered the earth like so many infuriate snakes.

data.v: सूतपुत्रस्तु संक्रुद्धो लघुहस्तः प्रतापवान् । घटोत्कचमतिक्रम्य बिभेद दशभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: Thereupon the light-handed and puissant son of Suta excited to the highest pitch of fury, prevailing over Ghatotkacha, pierced him with ten shafts.

data.v: घटोत्कचो विनिर्भिन्नः सूतपुत्रेण मर्मसु । चक्रं दिव्यं सहस्रारमगृह्णाद्व्यथितो भृशम् ॥
data.md: Pierced in his vital parts and extremely pained by the son of Suta, Ghatotkacha took up a discus of celestial make having a thousands pokes.

data.v: क्षुरान्तं बालसूर्याभं मणिरत्नविभूषितम् । चिक्षेपाधिरथेः क्रुद्धो भैमसेनिर्जिघांसया ॥
data.md: Then the son of Bhima, desirous of slaying the son of Adhiratha, hurled at the latter that discus furnished with a razor-sharp edge, of the effulgence of the morning sun and decked with gems and jewels.

data.v: प्रविद्धमतिवेगेन विक्षिप्तं कर्णसायकैः । अभाग्यस्येव संकल्पस्तन्मोघमपतद्भुवि ॥
data.md: That discus of great impetus and hurled with great force, was cut-off into fragments with the shafts of Karna and it fell down on the earth baffled in its object, like the hopes and purposes of an unfortunate man.

data.v: घटोत्कचस्तु संक्रुद्धो दृष्ट्वा चक्रं निपातितम् । कर्णं प्राच्छादयद्बाणैः स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम् ॥
data.md: Beholding his discus thus baffled, Ghatotkacha was highly enraged and he then covered Karna with his arrows like Rahu covering the sun.

data.v: सूतपुत्रस्त्वसंभ्रान्तो रुद्रोपेन्द्रेन्द्रविक्रमः । घटोत्कचरथं तूर्णं छादयामास पत्रिभिः ॥
data.md: But the son of Suta Karna possessed prowess equal to that of Rudra or Upendra or Indra himself dauntlessly covered Ghatotkacha's chariot with his winged arrows.

data.v: घटोत्कचेन क्रुद्धेन गदा हेमाङ्गदा तदा । क्षिप्ता भ्राम्य शरैः सापि कर्णेनाभ्याहतापतत् ॥
data.md: Thereafter a gold-decked mace was whirled and hurled at Karna by Ghatotkacha. But the former cutting it off with his arrows felled it on the ground.

data.v: ततोऽन्तरिक्षमुत्पत्य कालमेघ इवोन्नदन् । प्रववर्ष महाकायो द्रुमवर्षं नभस्तलात् ॥
data.md: Then soaring into the sky and roaring like destructive clouds, the huge-bodied Rakshasa poured a veritable shower of trees from the skies.

data.v: ततो मायाविनं कर्णो भीमसेनसुतं दिवि । मार्गणैरभिविव्याध घनं सूर्य इवांशुभिः ॥
data.md: Then Karna pierced with his shafts the son of Bhimasena versed in illusion when he was ranging through the skies, like the sun piercing the clouds with his rays.

data.v: तस्य सर्वान्हयान्हत्वा संछिद्य शतधा रथम् । अभ्यवर्षच्छरैः कर्णः पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान् ॥
data.md: Next cutting his car into fragments and slaying all his horses, Karna covered him with arrows, like a cloud charged with rain.

data.v: न चास्यासीदनिर्भिन्नं गात्रे द्व्यङ्गुलमन्तरम् । सोऽदृश्यत मुहूर्तेन श्वाविच्छललितो यथा ॥
data.md: There was not even space of two finger's breadth in the body of Ghatotkacha that was not pierced with Karna's shafts. Soon the Rakshasa appeared to be like a porcupine with its quills erect.

data.v: न हयान्न रथं तस्य न ध्वजं न घटोत्कचम् । दृष्टवन्तः स्म समरे शरौघैरभिसंवृतम् ॥
data.md: So completely was he covered with shafts that we could not in that battle, any longer see either Ghatotkacha's person or his horses or his car or standard.

data.v: स तु कर्णस्य तद्दिव्यमस्त्रमस्त्रेण शातयन् । मायायुद्धेन मायावी सूतपुत्रमयोधयत् ॥
data.md: Then the Rakshasa versed in illusion destroying by his own weapon the celestial weapon of Karna, began to fight with Suta's son, aided by his own illusive powers.

data.v: सोऽयोधयत्तदा कर्णं मायया लाघवेन च । अलक्ष्यमाणोऽथ दिवि शरजालेषु संपतन् ॥
data.md: Indeed he fought on with Karna, aided by his illusive powers and exhibiting his great agility. Then showers of shafts began to fall from invisible quarters in the skies.

data.v: भैमसेनिर्महामायो मायया कुरुसत्तम । प्रचकार महामायां मोहयन्निव भारत ॥
data.md: Then Bhimasena's son possessed of potent powers of illusion, O best of the Kurus, assumed, by the help of those powers, a dreadful appearance and began to confound the Kouravas, O Bharata.

data.v: स स्म कृत्वा विरूपाणि वदनान्यशुभाननः । अग्रसत्सूतपुत्रस्य दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि मायया ॥
data.md: The puissant Rakshasa then assuming many terrible heads, began to swallow up the celestial weapons of Karna.

data.v: पुनश्चापि महाकायः संछिन्नः शतधा रणे । गतसत्त्वो निरुत्साहः पतितः खाद्व्यदृश्यत । हतं तं मन्यमानाः स्म प्राणदन्कुरुपुंगवाः ॥
data.md: Soon again, the huge Rakshasas with hundred of wounds on his body seemed to lie cheerlessly and like one dead, on the field.

data.v: अथ देहैर्नवैरन्यैर्दिक्षु सर्वास्वदृश्यत । पुनश्चापि महाकायः शतशीर्षः शतोदरः ॥
व्यदृश्यत महाबाहुर्मैनाक इव पर्वतः । अङ्गुष्ठमात्रो भूत्वा च पुनरेव स राक्षसः । सागरोर्मिरिवोद्धूतस्तिर्यगूर्ध्वमवर्तत ॥
data.md: Once again he became small about the transversely or soared high like the surging billows of the ocean.

data.v: वसुधां दारयित्वा च पुनरप्सु न्यमज्जत । अदृश्यत तदा तत्र पुनरुन्मज्जितोऽन्यतः ॥
data.md: Tearing through the earth, he dived again into the waters. Once seen here he was next seen rising on the surface at a different place.

data.v: सोऽवतीर्य पुनस्तस्थौ रथे हेमपरिष्कृते । क्षितिं द्यां च दिशश्चैव माययावृत्य दंशितः ॥
data.md: Then coming down from the welkin, he was seen standing, covered in mail, on a chariot adorned with gold, having wandered through earth and sky and all the points of the compass aided by his powers of illusion.

data.v: गत्वा कर्णरथाभ्याशं विचलत्कुण्डलाननः । प्राह वाक्यमसंभ्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं विशां पते ॥
data.md: Then going near the vicinity of Karna's chariot, Ghatotkacha with his his ear-rings moving, dauntlessly addressed the son of Suta, O king, in these words.

data.v: तिष्ठेदानीं न मे जीवन्सूतपुत्र गमिष्यसि । युद्धश्रद्धामहं तेऽद्य विनेष्यामि रणाजिरे ॥
data.md: Wait a little, O son of Suta, whither shall you go with your life, avoiding me? Today I shall remove your itching for fight on the field of battle.

data.v: इत्युक्त्वा रोषताम्राक्षं रक्षः क्रूरपराक्रमम् । उत्पपातान्तरिक्षं च जहास च सुविस्वरम् । कर्णमभ्याहनच्चैव गजेन्द्रमिव केसरी ॥
data.md: Having thus spoken, the Rakshasa of fierce prowess, with his eyes red in rage, soared into the sky and laughed a tremendous laugh.

data.v: रथाक्षमात्रैरिषुभिरभ्यवर्षद्घटोत्कचः । रथिनामृषभं कर्णं धाराभिरिव तोयदः । शरवृष्टिं च तां कर्णो दूरप्राप्तामशातयत् ॥
data.md: That foremost car-warrior viz., Karna, like a could with showers of rain. But Karna repulsed that arrowy shower before it could reach him.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा च विहतां मायां कर्णेन भरतर्षभ । घटोत्कचस्ततो मायां ससर्जान्तर्हितः पुनः ॥
data.md: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, seeing his illusions nullified by Karna, Ghatotkacha once more put forth another illusion and rendered himself invisible.

data.v: सोऽभवद्गिरिरित्युच्चः शिखरैस्तरुसंकटैः । शूलप्रासासिमुसलजलप्रस्रवणो महान् ॥
data.md: He then became a huge mountain with numerous peaks, covered with tall trees. From that mountain streams of lances, spears, swords and maces began to issue out incessantly.

data.v: तमञ्जनचयप्रख्यं कर्णो दृष्ट्वा महीधरम् । प्रपातैरायुधान्युग्राण्युद्वहन्तं न चुक्षुभे ॥
data.md: Beholding that mountain resembling a heap of antimony from which fierce weapons continuously flowed out, Karna was not at all daunted.

data.v: स्मयन्निव ततः कर्णो दिव्यमस्त्रमुदीरयत् । ततः सोऽस्त्रेण शैलेन्द्रो विक्षिप्तो वै व्यनश्यत ॥
data.md: Then smiling, Karna invoked into existence a celestial weapon. Then that foremost of mountains, cut and thrown off by that weapons of Karna, was completely destroyed.

data.v: ततः स तोयदो भूत्वा नीलः सेन्द्रायुधो दिवि । अश्मवृष्टिभिरत्युग्रः सूतपुत्रमवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Thereafter the Rakshasa becoming a blue cloud decked with the rain-bow began to cover the son of Suta with a fierce shower of stones.

data.v: अथ संधाय वायव्यमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः । व्यधमत्कालमेघं तं कर्णो वैकर्तनो वृषा ॥
data.md: Then that foremost of all persons versed in the use of weapons, viz., Karna, the son of Vikartana, discharging the Vayavya weapon destroyed that blue cloud.

data.v: स मार्गणगणैः कर्णो दिशः प्रच्छाद्य सर्वशः । जघानास्त्रं महाराज घटोत्कचसमीरितम् ॥
data.md: Then, O king, covered the quarters of the compass with his arrows, Karna baffled the weapons shot by Ghatotkacha.

data.v: ततः प्रहस्य समरे भैमसेनिर्महाबलः । प्रादुश्चक्रे महामायां कर्णं प्रति महारथम् ॥
data.md: Then the highly puissant son of Bhimasena smiling the while invoked into existence an allpowerful illusion against that mighty carwarrior viz., Karna.

data.v: स दृष्ट्वा पुनरायान्तं रथेन रथिनां वरम् । घटोत्कचमसंभ्रान्तं राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतम् ॥
data.md: Beholding then that foremost of carwarriors viz., Ghatotkacha, dauntlessly approach him surrounded by a large number of Rakshasa.

data.v: सिंहशार्दूलसदृशैर्मत्तद्विरदविक्रमैः । गजस्थैश्च रथस्थैश्च वाजिपृष्ठगतैस्तथा ॥
data.md: That resembled lion and tigers and infuriate powerful elephants, mounted on elephants, some on chariots and some on horses.

data.v: नानाशस्त्रधरैर्घोरैर्नानाकवचभूषणैः । वृतं घटोत्कचं क्रूरैर्मरुद्भिरिव वासवम् । दृष्ट्वा कर्णो महेष्वासो योधयामास राक्षसम् ॥
data.md: All bearing various kinds of weapons and wearing diverse kinds of armour and ornaments indeed beholding Ghatotkacha surrounded by these fearful Rakshasas like Vasava by the Marutas.

data.v: घटोत्कचस्ततः कर्णं विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः । ननाद भैरवं नादं भीषयन्सर्वपार्थिवान् ॥
भूयश्चाञ्जलिकेनाथ समार्गणगणं महत् । कर्णहस्तस्थितं चापं चिच्छेदाशु घटोत्कचः ॥
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय दृढं भारसहं महत् । व्यकर्षत बलात्कर्ण इन्द्रायुधमिवोच्छ्रितम् ॥
ततः कर्णो महाराज प्रेषयामास सायकान् । सुवर्णपुङ्खाञ्शत्रुघ्नान्खचरान्राक्षसान्प्रति ॥
तद्बाणैरर्दितं यूथं रक्षसां पीनवक्षसाम् । सिंहेनेवार्दितं वन्यं गजानामाकुलं कुलम् ॥
विधम्य राक्षसान्बाणैः साश्वसूतगजान्विभुः । ददाह भगवान्वह्निर्भूतानीव युगक्षये ॥
स हत्वा राक्षसीं सेनां शुशुभे सूतनन्दनः । पुरेव त्रिपुरं दग्ध्वा दिवि देवो महेश्वरः ॥
तेषु राजसहस्रेषु पाण्डवेयेषु मारिष । नैनं निरीक्षितुमपि कश्चिच्छक्नोति पार्थिव ॥
ऋते घटोत्कचाद्राजन्राक्षसेन्द्रान्महाबलात् । भीमवीर्यबलोपेतात्क्रुद्धाद्वैवस्वतादिव ॥
तस्य क्रुद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां पावकः समजायत । महोल्काभ्यां यथा राजन्सार्चिषः स्नेहबिन्दवः ॥
तलं तलेन संहत्य संदश्य दशनच्छदम् । रथमास्थाय च पुनर्मायया निर्मितं पुनः ॥
युक्तं गजनिभैर्वाहैः पिशाचवदनैः खरैः । स सूतमब्रवीत्क्रुद्धः सूतपुत्राय मा वह ॥
स ययौ घोररूपेण रथेन रथिनां वरः । द्वैरथं सूतपुत्रेण पुनरेव विशां पते ॥
data.md: Then excited with rages he addressed his charioteer saying, “Take me near the son of Suta.” Then that foremost of car-warriors riding on that chariot of fearful aspect.

data.v: स चिक्षेप पुनः क्रुद्धः सूतपुत्राय राक्षसः । अष्टचक्रां महाघोरामशनिं रुद्रनिर्मिताम् ॥
data.md: An Asani of dreadful appearance furnished with eight wheels and manufactured by Rudra himself. Placing his bow on his car and jumping down on the earth.

data.v: तामवप्लुत्य जग्राह कर्णो न्यस्य रथे धनुः । चिक्षेप चैनां तस्यैव स्यन्दनात्सोऽवपुप्लुवे ॥
data.md: And hurled it back at Ghatotkacha. The latter however had jumped down from his car. Meanwhile that highly resplendent weapon burning down the Rakshasa's car with its charioteer, horses and standard.

data.v: साश्वसूतध्वजं यानं भस्म कृत्वा महाप्रभा । विवेश वसुधां भित्त्वा सुरास्तत्र विसिस्मियुः ॥
कर्णं तु सर्वभूतानि पूजयामासुरञ्जसा । यदवप्लुत्य जग्राह देवसृष्टां महाशनिम् ॥
एवं कृत्वा रणे कर्ण आरुरोह रथं पुनः । ततो मुमोच नाराचान्सूतपुत्रः परंतपः ॥
अशक्यं कर्तुमन्येन सर्वभूतेषु मानद । यदकार्षीत्तदा कर्णः संग्रामे भीमदर्शने ॥
data.md: Thereafter that afflicter of foes, namely the son of Suta began to shoot his arrows. O giver of honour what Karna then achieved in that battle of fierce aspect was incapable of being achieved by any other creatures. Then struck with his Narachas like a mountain by showers of rain.

data.v: स हन्यमानो नाराचैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतः । गन्धर्वनगराकारः पुनरन्तरधीयत ॥
एवं स वै महामायो मायया लाघवेन च । अस्त्राणि तानि दिव्यानि जघान रिपुसूदनः ॥
निहन्यमानेष्वस्त्रेषु मायया तेन रक्षसा । असंभ्रान्तस्ततः कर्णस्तद्रक्षः प्रत्ययुध्यत ॥
ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज भैमसेनिर्महाबलः । चकार बहुधात्मानं भीषयाणो नराधिपान् ॥
ततो दिग्भ्यः समापेतुः सिंहव्याघ्रतरक्षवः । अग्निजिह्वाश्च भुजगा विहगाश्चाप्ययोमुखाः ॥
data.md: Multiplied himself many times thereby inspiring terror in to the hearts of mighty carwarriors. Thereafter from all the points of the compass lions, tigers, hyenas, fire-tongued snakes and iron-beaked rangers of the sky, began to issue out. Covered with the swiftlyflying arrows shot from Karna's bow.

data.v: स कीर्यमाणो निशितैः कर्णचापच्युतैः शरैः । नगराद्रिवनप्रख्यस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
राक्षसाश्च पिशाचाश्च यातुधानाः शलावृकाः । ते कर्णं भक्षयिष्यन्तः सर्वतः समुपाद्रवन् । अथैनं वाग्भिरुग्राभिस्त्रासयां चक्रिरे तदा ॥
उद्यतैर्बहुभिर्घोरैरायुधैः शोणितोक्षितैः । तेषामनेकैरेकैकं कर्णो विव्याध चाशुगैः ॥
प्रतिहत्य तु तां मायां दिव्येनास्त्रेण राक्षसीम् । आजघान हयानस्य शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥
ते भग्ना विकृताङ्गाश्च छिन्नपृष्ठाश्च सायकैः । वसुधामन्वपद्यन्त पश्यतस्तस्य रक्षसः ॥
स भग्नमायो हैडिम्बः कर्णं वैकर्तनं ततः । एष ते विदधे मृत्युमित्युक्त्वान्तरधीयत ॥
data.md: Fell down on the earth, even before the eyes of that Rakshasa. The son of Hidimba seeing his illusions baffled once more made himself invincible, speaking thus to Vikartana's son-"I will presently compass your slaughter."

data.v: तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने कर्णराक्षसयोर्मृधे । अलायुधो राक्षसेन्द्रो वीर्यवानभ्यवर्तत ॥
data.md: Sanjaya sajd When the battle between Karna and that Rakshasa had been thus progressing, Alayudha the prince of the Rakshasa, endued with great strength made his appearance of the field of battle.

data.v: महत्या सेनया युक्तः सुयोधनमुपागमत् । राक्षसानां विरूपाणां सहस्रैः परिवारितः । नानारूपधरैर्वीरैः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् ॥
data.md: Supported by a large division of troops and surrounded by thousands of Rakshasas of dreadful aspect, he approached Duryodhana.

data.v: तस्य ज्ञातिर्हि विक्रान्तो ब्राह्मणादो बको हतः । किर्मीरश्च महातेजा हिडिम्बश्च सखा तथा ॥
स दीर्घकालाध्युषितं पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् । विज्ञायैतन्निशायुद्धं जिघांसुर्भीममाहवे ॥
स मत्त इव मातङ्गः संक्रुद्ध इव चोरगः । दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीद्युद्धलालसः ॥
विदितं ते महाराज यथा भीमेन राक्षसाः । हिडिम्बबककिर्मीरा निहता मम बान्धवाः ॥
data.md: That one longing to engage in the fight spoke these words addressing Duryodhana "O mighty monarch, you have heard how Bhima slew my relatives the Rakshasas Vaka, Krimira and Hidimba in battle. In days gone by, he ravished our daughter Hidimba.

data.v: परामर्शश्च कन्याया हिडिम्बायाः कृतः पुरा । किमन्यद्राक्षसानन्यानस्मांश्च परिभूय ह ॥
तमहं सगणं राजन्सवाजिरथकुञ्जरम् । हैडिम्बं च सहामात्यं हन्तुमभ्यागतः स्वयम् ॥
अद्य कुन्तीसुतान्सर्वान्वासुदेवपुरोगमान् । हत्वा संभक्षयिष्यामि सर्वैरनुचरैः सह । निवारय बलं सर्वं वयं योत्स्याम पाण्डवान् ॥
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हृष्टो दुर्योधनस्तदा । प्रतिपूज्याब्रवीद्वाक्यं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः ॥
data.md: Having heard those words of his, king Duryodhana was filled with delight; and surrounded as he was with his brothers welcoming the Rakshasa, he addressed these words to him.

data.v: त्वां पुरस्कृत्य सगणं वयं योत्स्यामहे परान् । न हि वैरान्तमनसः स्थास्यन्ति मम सैनिकाः ॥
data.md: Placing you and your followers in our front, we shall fight with our enemies. My troops, impelled by the enmity they bear against the Pandavas cannot be restrained.

data.v: एवमस्त्विति राजानमुक्त्वा राक्षसपुंगवः । अभ्ययात्त्वरितो भीमं सहितः पुरुषाशनैः ॥
data.md: "Then let it be so," replying thus to the king, that foremost of the Rakshasas, accompanied by his man-eating followers, dashed in fury against Bhimasena.

data.v: दीप्यमानेन वपुषा रथेनादित्यवर्चसा । तादृशेनैव राजेन्द्र यादृशेन घटोत्कचः ॥
data.md: His person was effulgent and his chariot burnt with the splendour of the solar disc. Indeed, O foremost of kings, he looked as beautiful as Ghatotkacha himself.

data.v: तस्याप्यतुलनिर्घोषो बहुतोरणचित्रितः । ऋक्षचर्मावनद्धाङ्गो नल्वमात्रो महारथः ॥
data.md: His spacious chariot also emitted unequalled clatter and was adorned with numerous arches and covered with bear-skins and measured a Nalva.

data.v: तस्यापि तुरगाः शीघ्रा हस्तिकायाः खरस्वनाः । शतं युक्ता महाकाया मांसशोणितभोजनाः ॥
data.md: His steeds were also fleet and prodigious like elephants and they brayed like asses. Living upon flesh and blood and of huge bodies, a full hundred of them were yoked to his car.

data.v: तस्यापि रथनिर्घोषो महामेघरवोपमः । तस्यापि सुमहच्चापं दृढज्यं बलवत्तरम् ॥
data.md: The clatter of his car also resembled the rumble of mighty clouds. His bow was also tough and strong with a hard string,

data.v: तस्याप्यक्षसमा बाणा रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः । सोऽपि वीरो महाबाहुर्यथैव स घटोत्कचः ॥
data.md: His arrows also were furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone and they resembled Akshas of cars. That hero also possessed might of arms like that of Ghatotkacha himself.

data.v: तस्यापि गोमायुबडाभिगुप्तो; बभूव केतुर्ज्वलनार्कतुल्यः । स चापि रूपेण घटोत्कचस्य; श्रीमत्तमो व्याकुलदीपितास्यः ॥
data.md: His standard also perched upon by hosts of vultures and ravens looked like the sun or the fire; in beauty of person he excelled Ghatotkacha and his countenance was flushed with rage.

data.v: दीप्ताङ्गदो दीप्तकिरीटमाली; बद्धस्रगुष्णीषनिबद्धखड्गः । गदी भुशुण्डी मुसली हली च; शरासनी वारणतुल्यवर्ष्मा ॥
data.md: He wore resplendent Angadas and effulgent diadem and garlands. His headgear and sword and floral garlands were duly tied. He was armed with maces, Bhusundis, bludgeons, ploughs and bows and he was covered with a coat of mail tough and impenetrable like the skin of elephant.

data.v: रथेन तेनानलवर्चसा च; विद्रावयन्पाण्डववाहिनीं ताम् । रराज संख्ये परिवर्तमानो; विद्युन्माली मेघ इवान्तरिक्षे ॥
data.md: Then crushing the Pandava divisions with that car of his of the effulgence of the fire and roving thither and thither he looked beautiful, like a mass of clouds in the welkin fringed with streaks of lighting.

data.v: ते चापि सर्वे प्रवरा नरेन्द्रा; महाबला वर्मिणश्चर्मिणश्च । हर्षान्विता युयुधुस्तत्र राज;न्समन्ततः पाण्डवयोधवीराः ॥
data.md: The foremost royal fighters of the Pandava host also, endued with great shields fought on delightfully, o king, on all sides (in that battle with Alayudha).

data.v: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य भीमकर्माणमाहवे । हर्षमाहारयां चक्रुः कुरवः सर्व एव ते ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then beholding Alayudha of fierce deeds come to fight on their behalf, all the Kouravas, were exceedingly delighted.

data.v: तथैव तव पुत्रास्ते दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः । अप्लवाः प्लवमासाद्य तर्तुकामा इवार्णवम् ॥
data.md: So also your sons, headed by Duryodhana himself, were filled with joy like persons, desirous of crossing a sea, setting rafts, when there was no chance of getting it.

data.v: पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्वानाः पार्थिवास्तदा । अलायुधं राक्षसेन्द्रं स्वागतेनाभ्यपूजयन् ॥
data.md: Having received Alayudha, that foremost prince of the Rakshasas, with a respectful welcome, the kings of your army considered themselves as born anew.

data.v: तस्मिंस्त्वमानुषे युद्धे वर्तमाने भयावहे । कर्णराक्षसयोर्नक्तं दारुणप्रतिदर्शने ॥
data.md: Meanwhile as that nocturnal battle raged between Karna and the Rakshasa-battle that, though terrible and superhuman and fierce, was yet delightful to the eye.

data.v: उपप्रैक्षन्त पाञ्चालाः स्मयमानाः सराजकाः । तथैव तावका राजन्घूर्णमानास्ततस्ततः ॥
data.md: The Panchalas and other kings became passive spectators of it. At the same time, O king, your troops, though protected all over the field by their commanders.

data.v: चुक्रुशुर्नेदमस्तीति द्रोणद्रौणिकृपादयः । तत्कर्म दृष्ट्वा संभ्रान्ता हैडिम्बस्य रणाजिरे ॥
data.md: As also Drona and Drona's son and Kripa and others uttered loud wails, saying All is lost. Indeed beholding on the field those terrible feats of Hidimva's son.

data.v: सर्वमाविग्नमभवद्धाहाभूतमचेतनम् । तव सैन्यं महाराज निराशं कर्णजीविते ॥
data.md: All your fighters were filled with anxiety; and uttering shrieks of distress they almost lost their senses. All your troops then, O king, became hopeless of Karna's life.

data.v: दुर्योधनस्तु संप्रेक्ष्य कर्णमार्तिं परां गतम् । अलायुधं राक्षसेन्द्रमाहूयेदमथाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Then Duryodhana, beholding Karna hard pressed, summoned that foremost of the Rakshasas Alayudha and addressed him in

data.v: एष वैकर्तनः कर्णो हैडिम्बेन समागतः । कुरुते कर्म सुमहद्यदस्यौपयिकं मृधे ॥
data.md: "Yonder is Vikartana's son Karna engaged in battle with the son of Hidimba. Behold he is achieving feats worthy of his valour and strength.

data.v: पश्यैतान्पार्थिवाञ्शूरान्निहतान्भैमसेनिना । नानाशस्त्रैरभिहतान्पादपानिव दन्तिना ॥
data.md: Behold there lie the royal heroic warriors slain and wounded with various weapons by the son of Bhimasena, like so many trees crushed by a huge tusked elephant.

data.v: तवैष भागः समरे राजमध्ये मया कृतः । तवैवानुमते वीर तं विक्रम्य निबर्हय ॥
data.md: Amongst all my kindly allies, I have allotted this (Rakshasa Ghatotkacha), with your permission as your share in battle. O hero, do you bring him down displaying your prowess.

data.v: पुरा वैकर्तनं कर्णमेष पापो घटोत्कचः । मायाबलमुपाश्रित्य कर्शयत्यरिकर्शनः ॥
data.md: O slayer of foes, allow not this sinful Ghatotkacha), to crush Vikartana's son through his illusive powers before you despatch him."

data.v: एवमुक्तः स राज्ञा तु राक्षसस्तीव्रविक्रमः । तथेत्युक्त्वा महाबाहुर्घटोत्कचमुपाद्रवत् ॥
data.md: Thus spoken to by the king, that Rakshasa, of fierce prowess, replied to former saying "let it be so"; and then that mighty-armed one rushed against Ghatotkacha.

data.v: ततः कर्णं समुत्सृज्य भैमसेनिरपि प्रभो । प्रत्यमित्रमुपायान्तं मर्दयामास मार्गणैः ॥
data.md: Thereupon, O lord, the son of Bhimasena also, bearing alone Karna for a while, began to afflict his advancing adversary with this shafts.

data.v: तयोः समभवद्युद्धं क्रुद्धयो राक्षसेन्द्रयोः । मत्तयोर्वाशिताहेतोर्द्विपयोरिव कानने ॥
data.md: Then the battle, that commenced between those two enraged Rakshasa chiefs, resembled that between two infuriate elephants both desirous of consorting with the same sheelephant in her season in the woods.

data.v: रक्षसा विप्रमुक्तस्तु कर्णोऽपि रथिनां वरः । अभ्यद्रवद्भीमसेनं रथेनादित्यवर्चसा ॥
data.md: Meanwhile, left alone by the Rakshasa that foremost of car-warriors viz., Karna, rushed against Bhimasena, on his car of solar effulgence.

data.v: तमायान्तमनादृत्य दृष्ट्वा ग्रस्तं घटोत्कचम् । अलायुधेन समरे सिंहेनेव गवां पतिम् ॥
data.md: Then disregarding the rushing Karna and beholding Ghatotkacha hard pressed by Alayudha, like a bull engaged with a lion.

data.v: रथेनादित्यवपुषा भीमः प्रहरतां वरः । किरञ्शरौघान्प्रययावलायुधरथं प्रति ॥
data.md: That foremost of all smiters, viz., Bhimasena, rushed against the chariot of Alayudha, riding on his own car of solar effulgence and shooting showers of sharp arrows.

data.v: तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य स तदालायुधः प्रभो । घटोत्कचं समुत्सृज्य भीमसेनं समाह्वयत् ॥
data.md: Then, O lord, beholding Bhimasena approach, Alayudha, leaving Ghatotkacha alone rushed against the former.

data.v: तं भीमः सहसाभ्येत्य राक्षसान्तकरः प्रभो । सगणं राक्षसेन्द्रं तं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Then, O master, that slayer of Rakshasa Bhima, furiously encountering that foremost of Rakshasas, covered him and his followers with showers of arrows.

data.v: तथैवालायुधो राजञ्शिलाधौतैरजिह्मगैः । अभ्यवर्षत कौन्तेयं पुनः पुनररिंदमः ॥
data.md: Similarly, O king, that subduer of foes namely, Alayudha, cutting off Bhima's arrows with straight going shafts of his, repeatedly covered the latter with his arrows.

data.v: तथा ते राक्षसाः सर्वे भीमसेनमुपाद्रवन् । नानाप्रहरणा भीमास्त्वत्सुतानां जयैषिणः ॥
data.md: On the other hand all these Rakshasas, armed with various weapons and dreadfullooking, assailed Bhimasena from all sides desirous of securing victory to your sons.

data.v: स ताड्यमानो बलिभिर्भीमसेनो महाबलः । पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः सर्वांस्तानविध्यच्छितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Then the highly puissant Bhimasena, wounded by those numerous Rakshasas, pierced each of them in return with five sharp arrows.

data.v: ते वध्यमाना भीमेन राक्षसाः खरयोनयः । विनेदुस्तुमुलान्नादान्दुद्रुवुश्च दिशो दश ॥
data.md: Those Rakshasas, of cruel minds, when thus engaged with Bhima, began to utter loud roared and to run in all the ten directions of the compass.

data.v: तांस्त्रास्यमानान्भीमेन दृष्ट्वा रक्षो महाबलम् । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन शरैश्चैनमवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: The mighty Rakshasa, then beholding the troops belonging to him fly away from fear of Bhima, rushed furiously upon the latter and covered him with arrows.

data.v: तं भीमसेनः समरे तीक्ष्णाग्रैरक्षिणोच्छरैः । अलायुधस्तु तानस्तान्भीमेन विशिखान्रणे । चिच्छेद कांश्चित्समरे त्वरया कांश्चिदग्रहीत् ॥
data.md: In that battle Bhimasena then shot at Alayudha many shafts of keen points. Thereupon Alayudha, in that battle, quickly put off or caught hold of several arrows shot by Bhimasena. Then Bhima of dreadful prowess, beholding that feat of the foremost of the Rakshasas.

data.v: स तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसेन्द्रं भीमो भीमपराक्रमः । गदां चिक्षेप वेगेन वज्रपातोपमां तदा ॥
तामापतन्तीं वेगेन गदां ज्वालाकुलां ततः । गदया ताडयामास सा गदा भीममाव्रजत् ॥
data.md: Hurled at him with great force a mace whose fall resembled the fall of thunder. With his own mace then Alayudha struck the burning mace of Bhima, where-upon the latter flew towards Bhima. Then the son of Kunti covered that foremost of the Rakshasas with a perfect shower of arrows.

data.v: स राक्षसेन्द्रं कौन्तेयः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् । तानप्यस्याकरोन्मोघान्राक्षसो निशितैः शरैः ॥
ते चापि राक्षसाः सर्वे सैनिका भीमरूपिणः । शासनाद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य निजघ्नू रथकुञ्जरान् ॥
पाञ्चालाः सृञ्जयाश्चैव वाजिनः परमद्विपाः । न शान्तिं लेभिरे तत्र रक्षसैर्भृशपीडिताः ॥
तं तु दृष्ट्वा महाघोरं वर्तमानं महाहवे । अब्रवीत्पुरुषश्रेष्ठो धनंजयमिदं वचः ॥
पश्य भीमं महाबाहो राक्षसेन्द्रवशं गतम् । पदवीमस्य गच्छ त्वं मा विचारय पाण्डव ॥
धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ । सहिता द्रौपदेयाश्च कर्णं यान्तु महारथाः ॥
नकुलः सहदेवश्च युयुधानश्च वीर्यवान् । इतरान्राक्षसान्घ्नन्तु शासनात्तव पाण्डव ॥
त्वमपीमां महाबाहो चमूं द्रोणपुरस्कृताम् । वारयस्व नरव्याघ्र महद्धि भयमागतम् ॥
data.md: Exert themselves in slaughtering the other Rakshasas at your command o son of Pandu. O mighty-armed one, do you hold in check this division headed by Drona, in as much as a great panic has seized our troops now.” When Krishna had thus spoken, those foremost of car-warriors, as appointed.

data.v: एवमुक्ते तु कृष्णेन यथोद्दिष्टा महारथाः । जग्मुर्वैकर्तनं कर्णं राक्षसांश्चेतरान्रणे ॥
अथ पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः शरैराशीविषोपमैः । धनुश्चिच्छेद भीमस्य राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ॥
हयांश्चास्य शितैर्बाणैः सारथिं च महाबलः । जघान मिषतः संख्ये भीमसेनस्य भारत ॥
सोऽवतीर्य रथोपस्थाद्धताश्वो हतसारथिः । तस्मै गुर्वीं गदां घोरां स विनद्योत्ससर्ज ह ॥
ततस्तां भीमनिर्घोषामापतन्तीं महागदाम् । गदया राक्षसो घोरो निजघान ननाद च ॥
तद्दृष्ट्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य घोरं कर्म भयावहम् । भीमसेनः प्रहृष्टात्मा गदामाशु परामृशत् ॥
तयोः समभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं नररक्षसोः । गदानिपातसंह्रादैर्भुवं कम्पयतोर्भृशम् ॥
गदाविमुक्तौ तौ भूयः समासाद्येतरेतरम् । मुष्टिभिर्वज्रसंह्रादैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥
रथचक्रैर्युगैरक्षैरधिष्ठानैरुपस्करैः । यथासन्नमुपादाय निजघ्नतुरमर्षणौ ॥
तौ विक्षरन्तौ रुधिरं समासाद्येतरेतरम् । मत्ताविव महानागावकृष्येतां पुनः पुनः ॥
तमपश्यद्धृषीकेशः पाण्डवानां हिते रतः । स भीमसेनरक्षार्थं हैडिम्बं प्रत्यचोदयत् ॥
data.md: They began to drag each other like two infuriate elephants. Then Hrishikesha, ever devoted to the welfare of the Pandavas, beholding the combat (between Bhima and Alayudha) urged Hidimva's son to the rescue of his father.

data.v: संप्रेक्ष्य समरे भीमं रक्षसा ग्रस्तमन्तिकात् । वासुदेवोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं घटोत्कचमिदं तदा ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then beholding Bhima hard pressed in battle by the Rakshasa Vasudeva's approaching Ghatotkacha said these words to him.

data.v: पश्य भीमं महाबाहो रक्षसा ग्रस्तमन्तिकात् । पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तव चैव महाद्युते ॥
data.md: O mighty armed one, behold Bhima as if devoured by the Rakshasa in battle, before the eyes of all troops and before those of yours, O highly effulgent one.

data.v: स कर्णं त्वं समुत्सृज्य राक्षसेन्द्रमलायुधम् । जहि क्षिप्रं महाबाहो पश्चात्कर्णं वधिष्यसि ॥
data.md: Therefore for a time leaving alone Karna, do you quickly slay Alayudha that foremost of the Rakshasas, O mighty armed one, after which you shall slay Karna.”

data.v: स वार्ष्णेयवचः श्रुत्वा कर्णमुत्सृज्य वीर्यवान् । युयुधे राक्षसेन्द्रेण बकभ्रात्रा घटोत्कचः । तयोः सुतुमुलं युद्धं बभूव निशि रक्षसोः ॥
data.md: Then hearing the words of that one of Vrishni race and leaving Karna alone for a while, the highly puissant Ghatotkacha, that brother of Vaka, fought with that prince of the Rakshasas.

data.v: अलायुधस्य योधांस्तु राक्षसान्भीमदर्शनान् । वेगेनापततः शूरान्प्रगृहीतशरासनान् ॥
data.md: Meanwhile the mighty car-warriors Yuyudhana, Nakula and Sahadeva began to pierce with keen shafts the warriors of Alayudha, viz., those grim looking heroic Rakshasas, who, wielding there bows, were rushing impetuously against them.

data.v: आत्तायुधः सुसंक्रुद्धो युयुधानो महारथः । नकुलः सहदेवश्च चिच्छिदुर्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Meanwhile the mighty car-warriors Yuyudhana, Nakula and Sahadeva began to pierce with keen shafts the warriors of Alayudha, viz., those grim looking heroic Rakshasas, who, wielding there bows, were rushing impetuously against them.

data.v: सर्वांश्च समरे राजन्किरीटी क्षत्रियर्षभान् । परिचिक्षेप बीभत्सुः सर्वतः प्रक्षिपञ्शरान् ॥
data.md: The diadem-decked Vibhatsu, O monarch, in that battle, discharging arrows on all sides, began to overthrow many foremost of Kshatriyas.

data.v: कर्णश्च समरे राजन्व्यद्रावयत पार्थिवान् । धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्ड्यादीन्पाञ्चालानां महारथान् ॥
data.md: Similarly, O king, Karna caused many kings of fly away-including Dhristadyumna, Shikhandin and other mighty car-warriors of the Panchalas.

data.v: तान्वध्यमानान्दृष्ट्वा तु भीमो भीमपराक्रमः । अभ्ययात्त्वरितः कर्णं विशिखान्विकिरन्रणे ॥
data.md: Beholding them thus slaughtered and wounded Bhimasena, of terrible prowess, quickly rushed against Karna shooting sharp arrows.

data.v: ततस्तेऽप्याययुर्हत्वा राक्षसान्यत्र सूतजः । नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः । ते कर्णं योधयामासुः पाञ्चाला द्रोणमेव च ॥
data.md: Then those warriors, viz., Nakula, Sahadeva and the mighty car-warrior, Satyaki, also came to the spot where Suta's son was, having slain many Rakshasas.

data.v: अलायुधस्तु संक्रुद्धो घटोत्कचमरिंदमम् । परिघेणातिकायेन ताडयामास मूर्धनि ॥
data.md: These then fought with Karna and the Panchalas fought with Drona. Meanwhile. Alayudha, excited with rage, began to strike that subduer of enemies, viz., Ghatotkacha on the head with a huge bludgeon. In consequence of that stroke the highly puissant son of Bhima.

data.v: स तु तेन प्रहारेण भैमसेनिर्महाबलः । ईषन्मूर्छान्वितोऽऽत्मानं संस्तम्भयत वीर्यवान् ॥
ततो दीप्ताग्निसंकाशां शतघण्टामलंकृताम् । चिक्षेप समरे तस्मै गदां काञ्चनभूषणाम् ॥
सा हयान्सारथिं चैव रथं चास्य महास्वना । चूर्णयामास वेगेन विसृष्टा भीमकर्मणा ॥
स भग्नहयचक्राक्षो विशीर्णध्वजकूबरः । उत्पपात रथात्तूर्णं मायामास्थाय राक्षसीम् ॥
स समास्थाय मायां तु ववर्ष रुधिरं बहु । विद्युद्विभ्राजितं चासीत्तिमिराभ्राकुलं नभः ॥
ततो वज्रनिपाताश्च साशनिस्तनयित्नवः । महांश्चटचटाशब्दस्तत्रासीद्धि महाहवे ॥
तां प्रेक्ष्य विहितां मायां राक्षसो राक्षसेन तु । ऊर्ध्वमुत्पत्य हैडिम्बस्तां मायां माययावधीत् ॥
सोऽभिवीक्ष्य हतां मायां मायावी माययैव हि । अश्मवर्षं सुतुमुलं विससर्ज घटोत्कचे ॥
अश्मवर्षं स तद्घोरं शरवर्षेण वीर्यवान् । दिशो विध्वंसयामास तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
data.md: Began to pour a heavy downpour of stones on Ghatotkacha. That terrible shower of stones, the brave Ghatotkacha baffled by means of a shower of arrows. They then poured on each other diverse weapons.

data.v: ततो नानाप्रहरणैरन्योन्यमभिवर्षताम् । आयसैः परिघैः शूलैर्गदामुसलमुद्गरैः ॥
पिनाकैः करवालैश्च तोमरप्रासकम्पनैः । नाराचैर्निशितैर्भल्लैः शरैश्चक्रैः परश्वधैः ॥
data.md: Such as iron bludgeons, lances, maces sharp clubs, mallets, tridents, sabres, spears, long and small, kampanas, keen shafts, both long and broad-headed and arrows and discuses and battle axes and Ayagudas and sharp arrows and weapons with heads like those of kine, Ulukhalas.

data.v: अयोगुडैर्भिण्डिपालैर्गोशीर्षोलूखलैरपि । उत्पाट्य च महाशाखैर्विविधैर्जगतीरुहैः ॥
शमीपीलुकरीरैश्च शम्याकैश्चैव भारत । इङ्गुदैर्बदरीभिश्च कोविदारैश्च पुष्पितैः ॥
पलाशैररिमेदैश्च प्लक्षन्यग्रोधपिप्पलैः । महद्भिः समरे तस्मिन्नन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥
विविधैः पर्वताग्रैश्च नानाधातुभिराचितैः । तेषां शब्दो महानासीद्वज्राणां भिद्यतामिव ॥
युद्धं तदभवद्घोरं भैम्यलायुधयोर्नृप । हरीन्द्रयोर्यथा राजन्वालिसुग्रीवयोः पुरा ॥
तौ युद्ध्वा विविधैर्घोरैरायुधैर्विशिखैस्तथा । प्रगृह्य निशितौ खड्गावन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥
तावन्योन्यमभिद्रुत्य केशेषु सुमहाबलौ । भुजाभ्यां पर्यगृह्णीतां महाकायौ महाबलौ ॥
तौ भिन्नगात्रौ प्रस्वेदं सुस्रुवाते जनाधिप । रुधिरं च महाकायावभिवृष्टाविवाचलौ ॥
data.md: And those two huge warriors, covered with numerous wounds on their bodies and blood and perspiration trickling down, appeared beautiful like two mighty masses of clouds pouring rain.

data.v: अथाभिपत्य वेगेन समुद्भ्राम्य च राक्षसम् । बलेनाक्षिप्य हैडिम्बश्चकर्तास्य शिरो महत् ॥
data.md: Then rushing with great violence and whirling the Rakshasa on high and dashing him down again, Hidimba's son cut-off the large head of his adversary.

data.v: सोऽपहृत्य शिरस्तस्य कुण्डलाभ्यां विभूषितम् । तदा सुतुमुलं नादं ननाद सुमहाबलः ॥
data.md: Then holding that had graced with a pair of ear-rings, the puissant Ghatotkacha uttered a terrific roar.

data.v: हतं दृष्ट्वा महाकायं बकज्ञातिमरिंदमम् । पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवाश्चैव सिंहनादान्विनेदिरे ॥
data.md: Beholding the huge-bodied brother of Vaka, that subduer of foes, slain, the Panchalas and the Pandavas uttered tremendous warcries.

data.v: ततो भेरीसहस्राणि शङ्खानामयुतानि च । अवादयन्पाण्डवेयास्तस्मिन्रक्षसि पातिते ॥
data.md: Thereupon on the fall of that Rakshasa the Pandava troops struck up thousands of drums and ten thousand conches.

data.v: अतीव सा निशा तेषां बभूव विजयावहा । विद्योतमाना विबभौ समन्ताद्दीपमालिनी ॥
data.md: That night then exclusively brought victory to the Pandavas; echoing with the sound of musical instruments and illumined with torches it then appeared highly beautiful.

data.v: अलायुधस्य तु शिरो भैमसेनिर्महाबलः । दुर्योधनस्य प्रमुखे चिक्षेप गतचेतनम् ॥
data.md: Then the highly puissant son of Bhima threw that head of Alayudha at he face of Duryodhana who was then rendered insensible.

data.v: अथ दुर्योधनो राजा दृष्ट्वा हतमलायुधम् । बभूव परमोद्विग्नः सह सैन्येन भारत ॥
data.md: Thereupon Duryodhana, beholding the heroic Alayudha slain, became filled with great anxiety together with all his troops.

data.v: तेन ह्यस्य प्रतिज्ञातं भीमसेनमहं युधि । हन्तेति स्वयमागम्य स्मरता वैरमुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: Alayudha, having come to Duryodhana out of his own accord, recollecting his old enmity, has said to the latter, that he would slay Bhima.

data.v: ध्रुवं स तेन हन्तव्य इत्यमन्यत पार्थिवः । जीवितं चिरकालाय भ्रातॄणां चाप्यमन्यत ॥
data.md: The Kuru king had considered the slaughter of Bhima to be certain and had considered the length of the days of his brother also to be measured.

data.v: स तं दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं भीमसेनात्मजेन वै । प्रतिज्ञां भीमसेनस्य पूर्णामेवाभ्यमन्यत ॥
data.md: Then beholding that Alayudha (on whom all his hopes rested) slain by the son of Bhimasena, Duryodhana considered Bhima's vow (about the slaughter of himself and his brothers) to be already fulfilled.

data.v: निहत्यालायुधं रक्षः प्रहृष्टात्मा घटोत्कचः । ननाद विविधान्नादान्वाहिन्याः प्रमुखे स्थितः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Having slain the Rakshasa Alayudha Ghatotkacha was greatly delighted; and then standing at the very van of the troops he began to utter diverse kinds of roars.

data.v: तस्य तं तुमुलं शब्दं श्रुत्वा कुञ्जरकम्पनम् । तावकानां महाराज भयमासीत्सुदारुणम् ॥
data.md: Those loud roars of his, capable of his making an elephant tremble, entering into the car of troops, struck a great panic to their hearts, O mighty monarch.

data.v: अलायुधविषक्तं तु भैमसेनिं महाबलम् । दृष्ट्वा कर्णो महाबाहुः पाञ्चालान्समुपाद्रवत् ॥
data.md: Meanwhile the mighty-armed Karna, beholding the highly puissant son of Bhima engaged with Alayudha, rushed against the Panchalas.

data.v: दशभिर्दशभिर्बाणैर्धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डिनौ । दृढैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैर्बिभेद नतपर्वभिः ॥
data.md: He proceeded against Dhristadyumna and Sikhandin, each with ten strong and straight shafts, shot from his bow drawn to its fullest stretch.

data.v: ततः परमनाराचैर्युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ । सात्यकिं च रथोदारं कम्पयामास मार्गणैः ॥
data.md: Thereafter with a group of other arrows, consisting of Narachas, & c., the son of Suta caused Yudhamanyu, Uttamanjas and the mighty car-warrior Satyaki to tremble.

data.v: तेषामभ्यस्यतां तत्र सर्वेषां सव्यदक्षिणम् । मण्डलान्येव चापानि व्यदृश्यन्त जनाधिप ॥
data.md: The bows of all those warriors also, O king, engaged in shooting shafts right and left, were also seen incessantly to be deawn in a circle.

data.v: तेषां ज्यातलनिर्घोषो रथनेमिस्वनश्च ह । मेघानामिव घर्मान्ते बभूव तुमुलो निशि ॥
data.md: In that night the sound of their palms and the twang of their bow-strings and the clatter of their car-wheels were so loud as to resemble and rumble of cloud at the end of summer.

data.v: ज्यानेमिघोषस्तनयित्नुमान्वै; धनुस्तडिन्मण्डलकेतुशृङ्गः । शरौघवर्षाकुलवृष्टिमांश्च; संग्राममेघः स बभूव राजन् ॥
data.md: Then, O monarch, that battle appeared to be a cloud of which the sound of car-clatter and bow-twang consisted the roar of thunder; the bows of warriors its flashes and showers of arrows it torrents of rain.

data.v: तदुद्धतं शैल इवाप्रकम्प्यो; वर्षं महच्छैलसमानसारः । विध्वंसयामास रणे नरेन्द्र; वैकर्तनः शत्रुगणावमर्दी ॥
data.md: O foremost of kings, then Vikartana's son Karna, that crusher of his foes, immovable like a hill and equal to a hill in personal proportions, destroyed that wonderful shower of arrows.

data.v: ततोऽतुलैर्वज्रनिपातकल्पैः; शितैः शरैः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खैः । शत्रून्व्यपोहत्समरे महात्मा; वैकर्तनः पुत्रहिते रतस्ते ॥
data.md: Then Vikartana's son, high-souled, ever devoted to the interests of your sons, began to slay his adversaries in that battle, with Tomaras, which, in their fall, resembled the thunder-bolt and also with sharp arrows furnished with variegated wings of gold.

data.v: संछिन्नभिन्नध्वजिनश्च केचि;त्केचिच्छरैरर्दितभिन्नदेहाः । केचिद्विसूता विहयाश्च केचि;द्वैकर्तनेनाशु कृता बभूवुः ॥
data.md: Some (of the enemy's host) then had their standards broken and torn; some had their bodies torn and mangled with sharp arrows. Some were deprived of their charioteers, some of their horses and some were soon maimed by Vikartana's son.

data.v: अविन्दमानास्त्वथ शर्म संख्ये; यौधिष्ठिरं ते बलमन्वपद्यन् । तान्प्रेक्ष्य भग्नान्विमुखीकृतांश्च; घटोत्कचो रोषमतीव चक्रे ॥
data.md: Getting no refuge, the Panchala host then fell back upon the division of Yudhishthira. Beholding these troops broken and compelled to turn away, Ghatotkacha then became excited to the highest pitch of fury.

data.v: आस्थाय तं काञ्चनरत्नचित्रं; रथोत्तमं सिंह इवोन्ननाद । वैकर्तनं कर्णमुपेत्य चापि; विव्याध वज्रप्रतिमैः पृषत्कैः ॥
data.md: Then mounting on his excellent car adorned with gold and gems, he began to roar like a lion. Thereafter approaching Vikartana's son Karna he pierced him with arrows resembling the bolt of Heaven itself,

data.v: तौ कर्णिनाराचशिलीमुखैश्च; नालीकदण्डैश्च सवत्सदन्तैः । वराहकर्णैः सविषाणशृङ्गैः; क्षुरप्रवर्षैश्च विनेदतुः खम् ॥
data.md: They both then covered the welkin with showers of barbed arrows, Narachas, Silimukhas, Nalikas, Dandas, Asanis. Vatsyadantas, Varahakarnas and broad-headed and razor-faced arrows and shafts pointed like horns.

data.v: तद्बाणधारावृतमन्तरिक्षं; तिर्यग्गताभिः समरे रराज । सुवर्णपुङ्खज्वलितप्रभाभि;र्विचित्रपुष्पाभिरिव स्रजाभिः ॥
data.md: The welkin then, shrouded with that arrowy shower, appeared in consequence of these gold-winged shafts of burning effulgence flying straight through it, as if hung with festoons of beautiful flowers.

data.v: समं हि तावप्रतिमप्रभावा;वन्योन्यमाजघ्नतुरुत्तमास्त्रैः । तयोर्हि वीरोत्तमयोर्न कश्चि;द्ददर्श तस्मिन्समरे विशेषम् ॥
data.md: Of unequaled splendour, they both were each other's match and they then wounded each other with excellent weapons. None could then find any superiority of either of those two excellent heroes.

data.v: अतीव तच्चित्रमतीव रूपं; बभूव युद्धं रविभीमसून्वोः । समाकुलं शस्त्रनिपातघोरं; दिवीव राह्वंशुमतोः प्रतप्तम् ॥
data.md: The battle, that was thus fought between the sons of Surya and Bhima and in which showers of arrows were discharged, looked highly charming and presented almost of unequaled aspect like what is seen in the fierce encounter between Rahu and the sun in the heavens.

data.v: घटोत्कचो यदा कर्णं न विशेषयते नृप । तदा प्रादुश्चकारोग्रमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः ॥
data.md: Then, O king, Karna was unable to gain any advantage over Ghatotkacha. Thereafter that foremost of all persons versed in the use of weapons, invoked into existence a celestial weapon.

data.v: तेनास्त्रेण हयान्पूर्वं हत्वा कर्णस्य राक्षसः । सारथिं चैव हैडिम्बः क्षिप्रमन्तरधीयत ॥
data.md: Then with that weapon having at first slain Karna's steed, the Rakshasa next destroyed his driver. And then the son of Hidimba quickly rendered himself invisible even then and there,

data.v: तथा ह्यन्तर्हिते तस्मिन्कूटयोधिनि राक्षसे । मामकैः प्रतिपन्नं यत्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said When that Rakshasa, after fighting by underhand measures, had thus disappeared, O Sanjaya, describe to me what befell my troops then.

data.v: अन्तर्हितं राक्षसं तं विदित्वा; संप्राक्रोशन्कुरवः सर्व एव । कथं नायं राक्षसः कूटयोधी; हन्यात्कर्णं समरेऽदृश्यमानः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then beholding the Rakshasa disappear, all the Kurus then exclaimed aloud Saying-"Appearing next to view, the Rakshasa, fighting by underhand means, will certainly slay Karna.”

data.v: ततः कर्णो लघुचित्रास्त्रयोधी; सर्वा दिशो व्यावृणोद्बाणजालैः । न वै किंचिद्व्यापतत्तत्र भूतं; तमोभूते सायकैरन्तरिक्षे ॥
data.md: Thereupon Karna, who was endued with extreme lightness in the use of diverse weapons, covered all the points of the compass with bis arrowy net-work. Then in consequence of the welkin being darkened by those showers of arrows, no creature could be seen distinguished.

data.v: न चाददानो न च संदधानो; न चेषुधी स्पृशमानः कराग्रैः । अदृश्यद्वै लाघवात्सूतपुत्रः; सर्वं बाणैश्छादयानोऽन्तरिक्षम् ॥
data.md: So great was the lightness of hand displayed by the son of Suta that nobody could then mark when the touched his quiver with his fingers, when he placed his arrows on the bowstring and when he aimed and let them off. The whole welkin was then darkened with his shafts.

data.v: ततो मायां विहितामन्तरिक्षे; घोरां भीमां दारुणां राक्षसेन । संपश्यामो लोहिताभ्रप्रकाशां; देदीप्यन्तीमग्निशिखामिवोग्राम् ॥
data.md: Then a fierce and dreadful illusion was invoked into existence in the welkin by the Rakshasa. We then beheld in the sky what appeared to be amass of red cloud resembling the terrible flames of a raging fire.

data.v: ततस्तस्या विद्युतः प्रादुरास;न्नुल्काश्चापि ज्वलिताः कौरवेन्द्र । घोषश्चान्यः प्रादुरासीत्सुघोरः; सहस्रशो नदतां दुन्दुभीनाम् ॥
data.md: O ruler of the Kurus, then from that cloud were seen to issue out flashes of lightning and burning flame-beams. Tremendous roars also issued therefrom, resembling the din of thousands of drums beaten simultaneously.

data.v: ततः शराः प्रापतन्रुक्मपुङ्खाः; शक्त्यः प्रासा मुसलान्यायुधानि । परश्वधास्तैलधौताश्च खड्गाः; प्रदीप्ताग्राः पट्टिशास्तोमराश्च ॥
data.md: From it also fell many gold-winged shafts, spears, javelins, heavy clubs and such other weapons, as also battle-axes, swords cleansed with oil and axes of blazing edges and darts.

data.v: मयूखिनः परिघा लोहबद्धा; गदाश्चित्राः शितधाराश्च शूलाः । गुर्व्यो गदा हेमपट्टावनद्धाः; शतघ्न्यश्च प्रादुरासन्समन्तात् ॥
data.md: And spiked bludgeons pouring shinning rays, charming maces made of iron, long lances of keen points, heavy maces adorned with gold and entwined with strings and Shataghnis all around.

data.v: महाशिलाश्चापतंस्तत्र तत्र; सहस्रशः साशनयः सवज्राः । चक्राणि चानेकशतक्षुराणि; प्रादुर्बभूवुर्ज्वलनप्रभाणि ॥
data.md: Large stones drooped from it and thousands of thunderbolts with loud clap and hundreds of wheels and razors of the effulgence of fire.

data.v: तां शक्तिपाषाणपरश्वधानां; प्रासासिवज्राशनिमुद्गराणाम् । वृष्टिं विशालां ज्वलितां पतन्तीं; कर्णः शरौघैर्न शशाक हन्तुम् ॥
data.md: Shooting countless arrows Karna then failed to destroy that thick and blazing shower of lances, swords, clubs, mallets, thunderbolts Asains and axes.

data.v: शराहतानां पततां हयानां; वज्राहतानां पततां गजानाम् । शिलाहतानां च महारथानां; महान्निनादः पततां बभूव ॥
data.md: Then a tremendous uproar was caused there as horse fell struck with arrows, elephants came down being crushed with thunderbolts and car-warriors fell deprived of life by other weapons.

data.v: सुभीमनानाविधशस्त्रपातै;र्घटोत्कचेनाभिहतं समन्तात् । दौर्योधनं तद्बलमार्तरूप;मावर्तमानं ददृशे भ्रमन्तम् ॥
data.md: Afflicted all around with the fall of dreadful weapons of various kinds discharged by Ghatotkacha and army of Duryodhana, in great distress, were seen to move helplessly on the field of battle.

data.v: हाहाकृतं संपरिवर्तमानं; संलीयमानं च विषण्णरूपम् । ते त्वार्यभावात्पुरुषप्रवीराः; पराङ्मुखा न बभूवुस्तदानीम् ॥
data.md: Cries of Alas and Oh then arose there; and the warriors with their cheerless expression indicted as if they were on the verge of ruin. But those foremost of men, inspired as they were with honorable sentiments, did not then leave the field with faces turned round.

data.v: तां राक्षसीं घोरतरां सुभीमां; वृष्टिं महाशस्त्रमयीं पतन्तीम् । दृष्ट्वा बलौघांश्च निपात्यमाना;न्महद्भयं तव पुत्रान्विवेश ॥
data.md: Then beholding that immensely terrible and awful shower of weapons invoked into existence by the illusive energy of the Rakshasa and seeing their own troops felled incessantly by it, your sons were seized with a great panic.

data.v: शिवाश्च वैश्वानरदीप्तजिह्वाः; सुभीमनादाः शतशो नदन्त्यः । रक्षोगणान्नर्दतश्चाभिवीक्ष्य; नरेन्द्रयोधा व्यथिता बभूवुः ॥
data.md: Jackals having tongues like the leaping flames of fire began to utter fierce howls by hundreds; the Rakshasa also uttered fierce yells. Hearing these disagreeable sounds, O king, your troops were greatly afflicted.

data.v: ते दीप्तजिह्वाननतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा; विभीषणाः शैलनिकाशकायाः । नभोगताः शक्तिविषक्तहस्ता; मेघा व्यमुञ्चन्निव वृष्टिमार्गम् ॥
data.md: Those fierce Rakshasas having fiery tongues, blazing countenances and sharp teeth and forms huge as mountains, car-reering through the sky with lances in grasp, appeared like clouds pouring torrents of rain.

data.v: तैराहतास्ते शरशक्तिशूलै;र्गदाभिरुग्रैः परिघैश्च दीप्तैः । वज्रैः पिनाकैरशनिप्रहारै;श्चक्रैः शतघ्न्युन्मथिताश्च पेतुः ॥
data.md: Wounded and crushed with those dreadful arrows, spears, darts, maces, spiked bludgeons of great lustre, thunder-bolts, trident, Asanis, wheels and Shataghnis, the Kaurava troops began to fall down.

data.v: हुडा भुशुण्ड्योऽश्मगुडाः शतघ्न्यः; स्थूणाश्च कार्ष्णायसपट्टनद्धाः । अवाकिरंस्तव पुत्रस्य सैन्यं; तथा रौद्रं कश्मलं प्रादुरासीत् ॥
data.md: The Rakshasas then went on pouring upon the warriors of your sons long spears and treacle and Shataghnis and Sthunas made of steel and covered with strings of jute and all the combatants became confounded.

data.v: निष्कीर्णान्त्रा विहतैरुत्तमाङ्गैः; संभग्नाङ्गाः शेरते तत्र शूराः । भिन्ना हयाः कुञ्जराश्चावभग्नाः; संचूर्णिताश्चैव रथाः शिलाभिः ॥
data.md: heroic warriors with weapons broken or falling off from their gasp or deprived of heads or with maimed limbs, began to fall down on the field. Then steeds and elephants and chariots were also crushed to pieces by the shower of stones.

data.v: एवं महच्छस्त्रवर्षं सृजन्त;स्ते यातुधाना भुवि घोररूपाः । मायाः सृष्टास्तत्र घटोत्कचेन; नामुञ्चन्वै याचमानं न भीतम् ॥
data.md: Those Yatudhanas of terrible forms created by Ghatotkacha by the help of his illusive powers, pouring that thick shower of mighty weapons, spread neither those that were frightened nor those that begged for mercy.

data.v: तस्मिन्घोरे कुरुवीरावमर्दे; कालोत्सृष्टे क्षत्रियाणामभावे । ते वै भग्नाः सहसा व्यद्रवन्त; प्राक्रोशन्तः कौरवाः सर्व एव ॥
data.md: In the ruthless slaughter of Kuru heroes, brought on by Death himself, in that extermination ou Kshatriyas the Kaurava warriors suddenly broke and fled with speed,

data.v: पलायध्वं कुरवो नैतदस्ति; सेन्द्रा देवा घ्नन्ति नः पाण्डवार्थे । तथा तेषां मज्जतां भारतानां; न स्म द्वीपस्तत्र कश्चिद्बभूव ॥
data.md: "Fly, O Kouravas, all is lost. The gods with Indra at their head are slaying us for the sake of the Pandavas.” At that time there was nobody that could save the sinking Bharata troops."

data.v: तस्मिन्संक्रन्दे तुमुले वर्तमाने; सैन्ये भग्ने लीयमाने कुरूणाम् । अनीकानां प्रविभागेऽप्रकाशे; न ज्ञायन्ते कुरवो नेतरे वा ॥
data.md: During that terrible uproar and shout and carnage of the Kurus, the divisions loosing their distinguishing marks the parties could not be differentiated from one another.

data.v: निर्मर्यादे विद्रवे घोररूपे; सर्वा दिशः प्रेक्षमाणाः स्म शून्याः । तां शस्त्रवृष्टिमुरसा गाहमानं; कर्णं चैकं तत्र राजन्नपश्यम् ॥
data.md: In that dreadful fight in which nobody paid any regard for any one else, every side of the field, when looked at, appeared to be said, O monarch. Karna alone was then to be seen drowned in that downpour of arrows.

data.v: ततो बाणैरावृणोदन्तरिक्षं; दिव्यां मायां योधयन्राक्षसस्य । ह्रीमान्कुर्वन्दुष्करमार्यकर्म; नैवामुह्यत्संयुगे सूतपुत्रः ॥
data.md: Then Karna covered the welkin with his shafts, striking agair..t that celestial illusion of the Rakshasas. The son of Suta, endowed with modesty and achieving the most difficult and praiseworthy feats, was not at all confounded in that battle.

data.v: ततो भीताः समुदैक्षन्त कर्णं; राजन्सर्वे सैन्धवा बाह्लिकाश्च । असंमोहं पूजयन्तोऽस्य संख्ये; संपश्यन्तो विजयं राक्षसस्य ॥
data.md: was O king, then all the Saindhavas and Valhikas looked in fear at Karna whose senses were not confounded in that fight. And they all applauded him whether they looked at the triumphs of the Rakshasa.

data.v: तेनोत्सृष्टा चक्रयुक्ता शतघ्नी; समं सर्वांश्चतुरोऽश्वाञ्जघान । ते जानुभिर्जगतीमन्वपद्य;न्गतासवो निर्दशनाक्षिजिह्वाः ॥
data.md: Thereafter a Sataghni, furnished with wheels, discharged at Karna by Ghatotkacha and it detached at once the four steeds of Karna. These horses then fell down on their knees, deprived of life, teeth, eyes and tongues.

data.v: ततो हताश्वादवरुह्य वाहा;दन्तर्मनाः कुरुषु प्राद्रवत्सु । दिव्ये चास्त्रे मायया वध्यमाने; नैवामुह्यच्चिन्तयन्प्राप्तकालम् ॥
data.md: Then descending from his horseless chariot and seeing the Kouravas fly away and beholding his own celestial weapons repulsed by the illusion of the Rakshasa, Karna, not at all confounded, turned his mind inwards and then began to reflect as to what he should do next.

data.v: ततोऽब्रुवन्कुरवः सर्व एव; कर्णं दृष्ट्वा घोररूपां च मायाम् । शक्त्या रक्षो जहि कर्णाद्य तूर्णं; नश्यन्त्येते कुरवो धार्तराष्ट्राः ॥
data.md: At that time all the Kouravas, beholding Karna and the terrible the terrible illusion of the Rakshasas, cried out saying-O Karna, slay the Rakshasa with your dart. The Kouravas and the Dhritarashtras are on the point of being exterminated.

data.v: करिष्यतः किं च नो भीमपार्थौ; तपन्तमेनं जहि रक्षो निशीथे । यो नः संग्रामाद्घोररूपाद्विमुच्ये;त्स नः पार्थान्समरे योधयेत ॥
data.md: What can Bhima or Arjuna do to us? Slay this wicked Rakshasa, who is consuming us all, at this dead of night. They, that will escape alive form this encounter, will fight with the Parthas tomorrow.

data.v: तस्मादेनं राक्षसं घोररूपं; जहि शक्त्या दत्तया वासवेन । मा कौरवाः सर्व एवेन्द्रकल्पा; रात्रीमुखे कर्ण नेशुः सयोधाः ॥
data.md: Therefore slay this dreadful Rakshasa now with that dart given to you by Vasava. O Karna, let not these great warriors, the Kouravas these royal combatants that resemble Indra himself be all exterminated in this nightfight.

data.v: स वध्यमानो रक्षसा वै निशीथे; दृष्ट्वा राजन्नश्यमानं बलं च । महच्च श्रुत्वा निनदं कौरवाणां; मतिं दध्रे शक्तिमोक्षाय कर्णः ॥
data.md: Then Karna, seeing the Rakshasa alive at the middle of night and the Kuru army filled with fear and hearing also the loud wails of the latter, set his heart upon hurling his dart.

data.v: स वै क्रुद्धः सिंह इवात्यमर्षी; नामर्षयत्प्रतिघातं रणे तम् । शक्तिं श्रेष्ठां वैजयन्तीमसह्यां; समाददे तस्य वधं चिकीर्षन् ॥
data.md: Burning with wrath like an infuriate lion and unable to brook the assaults of the Rakshasa Karna took up that foremost of victory-giving and indomitable darts, desirous of achieving the destruction of Ghatotkacha.

data.v: यासौ राजन्निहिता वर्षपूगा;न्वधायाजौ सत्कृता फल्गुनस्य । यां वै प्रादात्सूतपुत्राय शक्रः; शक्तिं श्रेष्ठां कुण्डलाभ्यां निमाय ॥
data.md: That dart. O monarch, which he had kent and worshipped through years for encompassing the slaughter of Pandu's son in battle, that excellent dart that Indra himself had given to Suta's son in exchange for the latter's ear-rings.

data.v: तां वै शक्तिं लेलिहानां प्रदीप्तां; पाशैर्युक्तामन्तकस्येव रात्रिम् । मृत्योः स्वसारं ज्वलितामिवोल्कां; वैकर्तनः प्राहिणोद्राक्षसाय ॥
data.md: That burning and dreadful dart entwined with strings and which seemed to long for blood, that terrible missile that looked like very tongue of death or his sister, that resplendent and fearful dart Vikartana's son now hurled at the Rakshasa.

data.v: तामुत्तमां परकायापहन्त्रीं; दृष्ट्वा सौतेर्बाहुसंस्थां ज्वलन्तीम् । भीतं रक्षो विप्रदुद्राव राज;न्कृत्वात्मानं विन्ध्यपादप्रमाणम् ॥
data.md: Thereupon seeing that excellent and glittering weapon, capable of penetrating of Suta's son, the Rakshasa fled away in fear making his body prodigious like the foot of the Vindhya hills.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा शक्तिं कर्णबाह्वन्तरस्थां; नेदुर्भूतान्यन्तरिक्षे नरेन्द्र । ववुर्वातास्तुमुलाश्चापि राज;न्सनिर्घाता चाशनिर्गां जगाम ॥
data.md: Then seeing that dart in the grasp of Karna all creatures, in the heavens, began to utter loud wails. Fearful winds began to blow and thunder with tremendous clap began to fall on the earth.

data.v: सा तां मायां भस्म कृत्वा ज्वलन्ती; भित्त्वा गाढं हृदयं राक्षसस्य । ऊर्ध्वं ययौ दीप्यमाना निशायां; नक्षत्राणामन्तराण्याविशन्ती ॥
data.md: Then that dart, destroying the blazing illusion and going through the breast of the Rakshasa, soared aloft and penetrated in the night into a stony constellation in the heavens.

data.v: युद्ध्वा चित्रैर्विविधैः शस्त्रपूगै;र्दिव्यैर्वीरो मानुषै राक्षसैश्च । नदन्नादान्विविधान्भैरवांश्च; प्राणानिष्टांस्त्याजितः शक्रशक्त्या ॥
data.md: Thus having fought with various kinds of weapons with numerous heroic warriors and Rakshasa, Ghatotkacha, then uttering various dreadful roars, fell deprived of life with that dart of Indra.

data.v: इदं चान्यच्चित्रमाश्चर्यरूपं; चकारासौ कर्म शत्रुक्षयाय । तस्मिन्काले शक्तिनिर्भिन्नमर्मा; बभौ राजन्मेघशैलप्रकाशः ॥
data.md: This is the most exceedingly wonderful feat that the Rakshasa achieved for the destruction of his foes viz., that at the time when his heart was penetrated by that dart he shone resplendent, O monarch, like a mightymountain or a mass of clouds.

data.v: ततोऽन्तरिक्षादपतद्गतासुः; स राक्षसेन्द्रो भुवि भिन्नदेहः । अवाक्शिराः स्तब्धगात्रो विजिह्वो; घटोत्कचो महदास्थाय रूपम् ॥
data.md: Deprived of life, that foremost of the Rakshasas, fell down on the ground from welkin. His body was torn, deprived of speech, head and tongue Gatotkacha extended his body in a very large form.

data.v: स तद्रूपं भैरवं भीमकर्मा; भीमं कृत्वा भैमसेनिः पपात । हतोऽप्येवं तव सैन्येकदेश;मपोथयत्कौरवान्भीषयाणः ॥
data.md: Having assumed that terrible and dreadful figure, Bhimasena's son of frightful deeds fell down. When dying, O monarch, he fell upon a portion of your army and pressed those troops down by the weight of his own body.

data.v: ततो मिश्राः प्राणदन्सिंहनादै;र्भेर्यः शङ्खा मुरजाश्चानकाश्च । दग्धां मायां निहतं राक्षसं च; दृष्ट्वा हृष्टाः प्राणदन्कौरवेयाः ॥
data.md: Then a tremendous uproar composed of the war-cries of combatants, beasts, of conchs and sound of drums and cymbals arose there. The Kouravas, then beholding the Rakshasa slain and his illusion destroyed, uttered loud shouts of joy.

data.v: ततः कर्णः कुरुभिः पूज्यमानो; यथा शक्रो वृत्रवधे मरुद्भिः । अन्वारूढस्तव पुत्रं रथस्थं; हृष्टश्चापि प्राविशत्स्वं स सैन्यम् ॥
data.md: Then Karna, applauded by the Kurus, as Shakra had been by the Marutas upon the death of Vritra, ascended behind the car of your son and becoming, the object of every body's sight entered the Kuru host.

data.v: हैडिम्बं निहतं दृष्ट्वा विकीर्णमिव पर्वतम् । पाण्डवा दीनमनसः सर्वे बाष्पाकुलेक्षणाः ॥
वासुदेवस्तु हर्षेण महताभिपरिप्लुतः । ननाद सिंहवन्नादं व्यथयन्निव भारत । विनद्य च महानादं पर्यष्वजत फल्गुनम् ॥
data.md: But the son of Vasudeva, overwhelmed with delight, began to utter there loud war-cries thereby causing pain to the Pandavas.

data.v: स विनद्य महानादमभीशून्संनियम्य च । ननर्त हर्षसंवीतो वातोद्धूत इव द्रुमः ॥
data.md: Indeed uttering loud shouts he then embraced the son of Pandu. Thus uttering loud roars and drawing the reins of the steeds.

data.v: ततो विनिर्भ्राम्य पुनः पार्थमास्फोट्य चासकृत् । रथोपस्थगतो भीमं प्राणदत्पुनरच्युतः ॥
data.md: He began to dance in joy, like a tree shaken by the tempest. Then embracing Partha once more and clapping his armp-its.

data.v: प्रहृष्टमनसं ज्ञात्वा वासुदेवं महाबलम् । अब्रवीदर्जुनो राजन्नातिहृष्टमना इव ॥
data.md: That undeteriorating god, endowed with great intelligence, once more uttered roud roars standing on the terrace of his car. Then beholding those sings of joy manifested by Kesava, Dhananjaya.

data.v: अतिहर्षोऽयमस्थाने तवाद्य मधुसूदन । शोकस्थाने परे प्राप्ते हैडिम्बस्य वधेन वै ॥
data.md: O monarch, with a beast overwhelmed with grief, addressed the former saying-"O slayer of Madhu, you are showing delight at a time scarcely fit for it.

data.v: विमुखानि च सैन्यानि हतं दृष्ट्वा घटोत्कचम् । वयं च भृशमाविग्ना हैडिम्बस्य निपातनात् ॥
data.md: Indeed on an occasion for sorrow generated by the death of Hidimva's son our troops, beholding Ghatotkacha slain, are flying away.

data.v: नैतत्कारणमल्पं हि भविष्यति जनार्दन । तदद्य शंस मे पृष्टः सत्यं सत्यवतां वर ॥
data.md: We also are filled with great grief, at the death of Hidimva's son, O Janardana. The cause of your delight on such occasion must indeed by very serious.

data.v: यद्येतन्न रहस्यं ते वक्तुमर्हस्यरिंदम । धैर्यस्य वैकृतं ब्रूहि त्वमद्य मधुसूदन ॥
data.md: O foremost of all truth-speaking men, therefore tell me today truly the cause of your joy. O subduer of foes, if it is not a secret, it behoves you to say it to me.

data.v: समुद्रस्येव संक्षोभो मेरोरिव विसर्पणम् । तथैतल्लाघवं मन्ये तव कर्म जनार्दन ॥
data.md: O Slayer of Madhu, tell me what has disturbed your patience today? O Jannaradana, I consider this fickleness of yours to be like the drying up of the ocean or the walking of the Meru mountain.

data.v: अतिहर्षमिमं प्राप्तं शृणु मे त्वं धनंजय । अतीव मनसः सद्यः प्रसादकरमुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: Vasudeva's son said Overwhelming is the delight that has filled me now. Hear it, O Dhananjaya. What I shall tell you will immediately dispel your sorrow impart joy on your beast.

data.v: शक्तिं घटोत्कचेनेमां व्यंसयित्वा महाद्युते । कर्णं निहतमेवाजौ विद्धि सद्यो धनंजय ॥
data.md: O you of great splendour, his sakti having been used against Ghatotkacha, regard Karna as already slain in battle.

data.v: शक्तिहस्तं पुनः कर्णं को लोकेऽस्ति पुमानिह । य एनमभितस्तिष्ठेत्कार्त्तिकेयमिवाहवे ॥
data.md: No person could have confronted Karna, if like Kartikeya he would have stood in battle armed with that dart.

data.v: दिष्ट्यापनीतकवचो दिष्ट्यापहृतकुण्डलः । दिष्ट्या च व्यंसिता शक्तिरमोघास्य घटोत्कचे ॥
data.md: It is through good fortune that his armour had been taken away, that his ear-rings, had been taken away from him; by good luck it is that his infallible dart also had been baffled by Ghatotkacha.

data.v: यदि हि स्यात्सकवचस्तथैव च सकुण्डलः । सामरानपि लोकांस्त्रीनेकः कर्णो जयेद्बली ॥
data.md: Covered in his natural coat of mail and decked with his natural ear-rings, Karna, having his senses under thorough control, could, single-handed, defeat the three worlds with the gods therein.

data.v: वासवो वा कुबेरो वा वरुणो वा जलेश्वरः । यमो वा नोत्सहेत्कर्णं रणे प्रतिसमासितुम् ॥
