data.md: And agitated at heart and remembering all his former woes, O lord, Vibhatsu was possessed by an anger engendered of brief, the like of which had never possessed him before.

data.v: तस्मादनर्हमश्लीलमप्रियं द्रौणिमुक्तवान् । मान्यमाचार्यतनयं रूक्षं कापुरुषो यथा ॥
data.md: For this reason it was that like a mean fellow, he then addressed Ashvatthaman, the son of his preceptor and worthy of his respect in such a vale, cruel, disagreeable and undeserving language.

data.v: एवमुक्तः श्वसन्क्रोधान्महेष्वासतमो नृप । पार्थेन परुषं वाक्यं सर्वमर्मघ्नया गिरा । द्रौणिश्चुकोप पार्थाय कृष्णाय च विशेषतः ॥
data.md: Thus wrathfully addressed, o king, by Partha in that indecent and harsh language, that foremost of all best bowmen.

data.v: स तु यत्तो रथे स्थित्वा वार्युपस्पृश्य वीर्यवान् । देवैरपि सुदुर्धर्षमस्त्रमाग्नेयमाददे ॥
दृश्यादृश्यानरिगणानुद्दिश्याचार्यनन्दनः । सोऽभिमन्त्र्य शरं दीप्तं विधूममिव पावकम् । सर्वतः क्रोधमाविश्य चिक्षेप परवीरहा ॥
data.md: That slayer of hostile heroes, filled with extreme raged, let go with due Mantras that shaft that looked resplendent like fire without a curl of smoke.

data.v: ततस्तुमुलमाकाशे शरवर्षमजायत । ववुश्च शिशिरा वाताः सूर्यो नैव तताप च ॥
data.md: The Rakshasa and the Pisachas, joining together to utter fierced yells; inauspicious winds began to blow and the Sun ceased to shine and give heat.

data.v: चुक्रुशुर्दानवाश्चापि दिक्षु सर्वासु भैरवम् । रुधिरं चापि वर्षन्तो विनेदुस्तोयदाम्बरे ॥
data.md: Ravens fiercely croaked on all sides; on the sky clouds emitted roars of thunder and showered torrents of blood.

data.v: पक्षिणः पशवो गावो मुनयश्चापि सुव्रताः । परमं प्रयतात्मानो न शान्तिमुपलेभिरे ॥
data.md: Birds, breasts, kine, sages of illustrious vows and tranquil soul, could not then find any peace.

data.v: भ्रान्तसर्वमहाभूतमावर्जितदिवाकरम् । त्रैलोक्यमभिसंतप्तं ज्वराविष्टमिवातुरम् ॥
data.md: The very elements became perturbed and the Sun appeared to evolve in an opposite course. The triune world seemed as if afflicted in consequence of being under the influence of a corroding fever.

data.v: शरतेजोऽभिसंतप्ता नागा भूमिशयास्तथा । निःश्वसन्तः समुत्पेतुस्तेजो घोरं मुमुक्षवः ॥
data.md: Afflicted with the energy of that weapon elephants and other creatures of the land fled with precipitation, breathing heavily and desirous of saving themselves from that fierce energy.

data.v: जलजानि च सत्त्वानि दह्यमानानि भारत । न शान्तिमुपजग्मुर्हि तप्यमानैर्जलाशयैः ॥
data.md: The watery expouses being heated, the acquatic creatures, scorched with the heat, O Bharata, could not find any ease.

data.v: दिशः खं प्रदिशश्चैव भुवं च शरवृष्टयः । उच्चावचा निपेतुर्वै गरुडानिलरंहसः ॥
data.md: Showers of shafts, swift-flying as Garuda or the wind itself, fell from all points of the compass, cardinal and subsidiary from the welkin and out of earth.

data.v: तैः शरैर्द्रोणपुत्रस्य वज्रवेगसमाहितैः । प्रदग्धाः शत्रवः पेतुरग्निदग्धा इव द्रुमाः ॥
data.md: Wounded with those arrows of Drona's son, arrows endued with the energy of the thunder, his foes, scorched and consumed began to fall down like trees consumed by fire.

data.v: दह्यमाना महानागाः पेतुरुर्व्यां समन्ततः । नदन्तो भैरवान्नादाञ्जलदोपमनिस्वनान् ॥
data.md: Dreadfully scorched mighty elephants fell on the ground uttering terrible roars resembling the rumble of clouds.

data.v: अपरे प्रद्रुतास्तत्र दह्यमाना महागजाः । त्रेसुस्तथापरे घोरे वने दावाग्निसंवृताः ॥
द्रुमाणां शिखराणीव दावदग्धानि मारिष । अश्ववृन्दान्यदृश्यन्त रथवृन्दानि चाभिभो । अपतन्त रथौघाश्च तत्र तत्र सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: O Sire, divisions of steeds and hosts of cars were seen there burnt like the tops of trees during a forest conflagration.

data.v: तत्सैन्यं भगवानग्निर्ददाह युधि भारत । युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि संवर्तक इवानलः ॥
दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवीं सेनां दह्यमानां महाहवे । प्रहृष्टास्तावका राजन्सिंहनादान्विनेदिरे ॥
ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणि नानालिङ्गानि भारत । तूर्णमाजघ्निरे हृष्टास्तावका जितकाशिनः ॥
कृत्स्ना ह्यक्षौहिणी राजन्सव्यसाची च पाण्डवः । तमसा संवृते लोके नादृश्यत महाहवे ॥
नैव नस्तादृशं राजन्दृष्टपूर्वं न च श्रुतम् । यादृशं द्रोणपुत्रेण सृष्टमस्त्रममर्षिणा ॥
data.md: Could not be seen in that dreadful battle in consequence of the darkness that then enveloped the world; O king, we neither heard of, nor beheld the like of the that weapon that a a the revengeful son of Drona then invoked into existence. Thereupon, O mighty monarch, Arjuna invoked into existence the Brahma weapon.

data.v: अर्जुनस्तु महाराज ब्राह्ममस्त्रमुदैरयत् । सर्वास्त्रप्रतिघाताय विहितं पद्मयोनिना ॥
ततो मुहूर्तादिव तत्तमो व्युपशशाम ह । प्रववौ चानिलः शीतो दिशश्च विमलाभवन् ॥
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम कृत्स्नामक्षौहिणीं हताम् । अनभिज्ञेयरूपां च प्रदग्धामस्त्रमायया ॥
ततो वीरौ महेष्वासौ विमुक्तौ केशवार्जुनौ । सहितौ संप्रदृश्येतां नभसीव तमोनुदौ ॥
सपताकध्वजहयः सानुकर्षवरायुधः । प्रबभौ स रथो मुक्तस्तावकानां भयंकरः ॥
data.md: Freed from that fie with their car, their banners and flags and steeds and excellent weapons, they the shone resplendent inspiring terrors at the heart of your troops.

data.v: ततः किलकिलाशब्दः शङ्खभेरीरवैः सह । पाण्डवानां प्रहृष्टानां क्षणेन समजायत ॥
data.md: Then from among the Pandava troops filled with delight, various confused sounds of life mingled with the sounds of drums and the blast of conchs.

data.v: हताविति तयोरासीत्सेनयोरुभयोर्मतिः । तरसाभ्यागतौ दृष्ट्वा विमुक्तौ केशवार्जुनौ ॥
data.md: Both the armies had thought Kesava and Arjuna to be destroyed. Beholding Kesava and Arjuna (freed from that fire of the weapon and that darkness) and seeing them quickly reappear.

data.v: तावक्षतौ प्रमुदितौ दध्मतुर्वारिजोत्तमौ । दृष्ट्वा प्रमुदितान्पार्थांस्त्वदीया व्यथिताभवन् ॥
data.md: Both uninjured and cheerful and blowing their excellent conches, the Pandava troops were filled with delight whilst those of yours were greatly pained.

data.v: विमुक्तौ च महात्मानौ दृष्ट्वा द्रौणिः सुदुःखितः । मुहूर्तं चिन्तयामास किं त्वेतदिति मारिष ॥
data.md: Then Drona's son also beholding those illustrious warriors free and un-injured, became cheerless and O sire, for a moment only be thought. 'What is this?'

data.md: Thus reflecting, O king and over-whelmed with grief and anxious contemplation and sighing hot and heavily, he became cheerless in mind.

data.v: ततो द्रौणिर्धनुर्न्यस्य रथात्प्रस्कन्द्य वेगितः । धिग्धिक्सर्वमिदं मिथ्येत्युक्त्वा संप्राद्रवद्रणात् ॥
data.md: Then Drona's son throwing aside his bow and leaping down with agility from his car, fled from the field of battle-saying-"O Fie, 0 fie, everything is un-true.

data.v: ततः स्निग्धाम्बुदाभासं वेदव्यासमकल्मषम् । आवासं च सरस्वत्याः स वै व्यासं ददर्श ह ॥
data.md: Then as he was flying, he came across the sinless Vyasa, that compiler of the Vedas, that receptacle of Sarasvati, that habitation of the Vadas, who possess the hue of rain clouds.

data.v: तं द्रौणिरग्रतो दृष्ट्वा स्थितं कुरुकुलोद्वह । सन्नकण्ठोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यमभिवाद्य सुदीनवत् ॥

data.v: भो भो माया यदृच्छा वा न विद्मः किमिदं भवेत् । अस्त्रं त्विदं कथं मिथ्या मम कश्च व्यतिक्रमः ॥
data.md: O sire, O sire, is this an illusion or a caprice (on the part of the weapon)? I do not know what this may be? Why has this weapon been repulsed? What has been my fault in the method of its invocation?

data.v: अधरोत्तरमेतद्वा लोकानां वा पराभवः । यदिमौ जीवतः कृष्णौ कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ॥
data.md: Or is it something beyond the natural order of things or is it the defeat of the three worlds, inasmuch as the two Krishnas are still alive. Time indeed, is irresistible.

data.v: नासुरामरगन्धर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः । न सर्पयक्षपतगा न मनुष्याः कथंचन ॥
data.md: Neither Asuras, nor Gandharvas, Pisachas, nor Rakshasa, nor Snakes, nor Jakshas, nor insects, nor men.

data.v: उत्सहन्तेऽन्यथा कर्तुमेतदस्त्रं मयेरितम् । तदिदं केवलं हत्वा युक्तामक्षौहिणीं ज्वलत् ॥
data.md: Dare baffle this weapon invoked by me. This weapon however has become pacified having slain only one Akshauhini of troops.

data.v: केनेमौ मर्त्यधर्माणौ नावधीत्केशवार्जुनौ । एतत्प्रब्रूहि भगवन्मया पृष्टो यथातथम् ॥
महान्तमेतमर्थं मां यं त्वं पृच्छसि विस्मयात् । तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि ते सर्वं समाधाय मनः शृणु ॥
data.md: Vyasa said What you have asked me from curiosity is a matter of great significance. I shall speak to you everything. Hear me attentively.

data.v: योऽसौ नारायणो नाम पूर्वेषामपि पूर्वजः । अजायत च कार्यार्थं पुत्रो धर्मस्य विश्वकृत् ॥
data.md: He that is called Narayana is the most ancient of the ancient; that creator of the worlds took his birth as the son of Dharma for accomplishing a certain mission.

data.v: स तपस्तीव्रमातस्थे मैनाकं गिरिमास्थितः । ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्महातेजा ज्वलनादित्यसंनिभः ॥
data.md: On the Himalaya hills, he performed severe austerities; possessed of great energy and resembling the Sun or the fire, he stood there with his arms upraised.

data.v: षष्टिं वर्षसहस्राणि तावन्त्येव शतानि च । अशोषयत्तदात्मानं वायुभक्षोऽम्बुजेक्षणः ॥
data.md: Endowed with eyes like lotus petals he reduced his bodily strength, by the observance of austerities for six and sixty thousand years living all the while upon air only.

data.v: अथापरं तपस्तप्त्वा द्विस्ततोऽन्यत्पुनर्महत् । द्यावापृथिव्योर्विवरं तेजसा समपूरयत् ॥
data.md: Again undergoing severe austerities of another kind for twice that period, he filled the space intervening between heaven and earth with his energy.

data.v: स तेन तपसा तात ब्रह्मभूतो यदाभवत् । ततो विश्वेश्वरं योनिं विश्वस्य जगतः पतिम् ॥
data.md: When in virtue of those austerities, O son, he became equal to Brahma: he then obtained a sight of that master, origin and Protector, of the universe, the Lord of all the gods, the paramount Deity, who is highly difficult of being looked at; who is smaller then the smallest and larger than the largest;

data.v: ददर्श भृशदुर्दर्शं सर्वदेवैरपीश्वरम् । अणीयसामणीयांसं बृहद्भ्यश्च बृहत्तरम् ॥
रुद्रमीशानमृषभं चेकितानमजं परम् । गच्छतस्तिष्ठतो वापि सर्वभूतहृदि स्थितम् ॥
दुर्वारणं दुर्दृशं तिग्ममन्युं; महात्मानं सर्वहरं प्रचेतसम् । दिव्यं चापमिषुधी चाददानं; हिरण्यवर्माणमनन्तवीर्यम् ॥
data.md: Who is incapable of being resisted and of dreadful aspect, who possesses fierce anger and magnanimous soul, who is the all-destroyer and of generous heart, who bears the celestial bow and a pair of quivers, who is covered in a golden coat of mail and whose energy.

data.v: पिनाकिनं वज्रिणं दीप्तशूलं; परश्वधिं गदिनं स्वायतासिम् । सुभ्रुं जटामण्डलचन्द्रमौलिं; व्याघ्राजिनं परिघं दण्डपाणिम् ॥
data.md: Who wields the Pinaka, who is armed with the thunderbolt, the blazing trident, the battle axe, mace and a large sword. Whose eye-brows are fair, whose locks are matted, who wields the heavy bludgeon, who bears the moon on his forehead, who is clad in tiger-skin and who is armed with the heavy short club.

data.v: शुभाङ्गदं नागयज्ञोपवीतिं; विश्वैर्गणैः शोभितं भूतसंघैः । एकीभूतं तपसां संनिधानं; वयोतिगैः सुष्टुतमिष्टवाग्भिः ॥
data.md: Who is furnished with beautiful Angadas, who has got snakes round his neck in the shape of the sacred thread, who is surrounded by various creatures and numerous ghosts of the universe, who is the One, who is the receptacle of ascetic rites and who is greatly admired by persons of venerable age.

data.v: जलं दिवं खं क्षितिं चन्द्रसूर्यौ; तथा वाय्वग्नी प्रतिमानं जगच्च । नालं द्रष्टुं यमजं भिन्नवृत्ता; ब्रह्मद्विषघ्नममृतस्य योनिम् ॥
data.md: Who is water, heaven, sky, earth, sun, moon, wind and fire and who is the measure of the duration of the universe. Beings of evil mode of life can never obtain a sight of that unborn one, that slayer of ali contemners of Brahmanas, that origin of immorality.

data.v: यं पश्यन्ति ब्राह्मणाः साधुवृत्ताः; क्षीणे पापे मनसा ये विशोकाः । स तन्निष्ठस्तपसा धर्ममीड्यं; तद्भक्त्या वै विश्वरूपं ददर्श । दृष्ट्वा चैनं वाङ्मनोबुद्धिदेहैः; संहृष्टात्मा मुमुदे देवदेवम् ॥
अक्षमालापरिक्षिप्तं ज्योतिषां परमं निधिम् । ततो नारायणो दृष्ट्वा ववन्दे विश्वसंभवम् ॥
वरदं पृथुचार्वङ्ग्या पार्वत्या सहितं प्रभुम् । अजमीशानमव्यग्रं कारणात्मानमच्युतम् ॥
data.md: That giver of boons, that lord of illustrious soul engaged in sporting with the beautifullimbed Parvati and surrounded by hosts of ghost.

data.v: अभिवाद्याथ रुद्राय सद्योऽन्धकनिपातिने । पद्माक्षस्तं विरूपाक्षमभितुष्टाव भक्तिमान् ॥
data.md: That unborn one and paramount. lord, that unmanifest one, that essence of all causes and that undeteriorating one ; then Narayana of eyes like lotus petals, having saluted Rudra, that 'slayer of Andhaka, reverentially began to praise that god of three-eyes. from you.

data.v: त्वत्संभूता भूतकृतो वरेण्य; गोप्तारोऽद्य भुवनं पूर्वदेवाः । आविश्येमां धरणीं येऽभ्यरक्ष;न्पुरा पुराणां तव देव सृष्टिम् ॥
data.md: Narayana said O most adorable one, O first of all the gods, the creators (the Prajapatis) who are protectors of the world and who having entered the earth, your first creation-had, O lord, protected it before, having all sprung

data.v: सुरासुरान्नागरक्षःपिशाचा;न्नरान्सुपर्णानथ गन्धर्वयक्षान् । पृथग्विधान्भूतसंघांश्च विश्वां;स्त्वत्संभूतान्विद्म सर्वांस्तथैव । ऐन्द्रं याम्यं वारुणं वैत्तपाल्यं; मैत्रं त्वाष्ट्रं कर्म सौम्यं च तुभ्यम् ॥
data.md: The celestials, the Asuras, the Nagas, the Rakshasas, the Pisachas, human beings, birds, the Gandharvas, Yakshas and all other creatures, with the whole of this universe, we know have all originated from you.

data.v: रूपं ज्योतिः शब्द आकाशवायुः; स्पर्शः स्वाद्यं सलिलं गन्ध उर्वी । कामो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्म च ब्राह्मणाश्च; त्वत्संभूतं स्थास्नु चरिष्णु चेदम् ॥
data.md: All acts done for gratifying Indra, Yama, Varuna, Kubera, the Pitris and Tashtri and the Moon, all are done to propitiate you. Form and light, sound and the etherial space, wind and touch, taste and water, scent and earth.

data.v: अद्भ्यः स्तोका यान्ति यथा पृथक्त्वं; ताभिश्चैक्यं संक्षये यान्ति भूयः । एवं विद्वान्प्रभवं चाप्ययं च; हित्वा भूतानां तत्र सायुज्यमेति ॥
data.md: Time, Brahma and the Vedas and the Brahmanas and all the mobile and immobile creatures have all sprung from you. Vapours rising up from expanses of water are turned into rain drops and which falling upon the earth, are separated from one another. When the hour of the universal dissolution comes, those separated individual drops once more : unite together and make the earth one vast sheet of water.

data.v: दिव्यावृतौ मानसौ द्वौ सुपर्णा;ववाक्शाखः पिप्पलः सप्त गोपाः । दशाप्यन्ये ये पुरं धारयन्ति; त्वया सृष्टास्ते हि तेभ्यः परस्त्वम् । भूतं भव्यं भविता चाप्यधृष्यं; त्वत्संभूता भुवनानीह विश्वा ॥
data.md: He who is conversant with the nature of things, thus observing the origin and destruction of all things from you, comprehends your unity and oneness. Two birds (Isvara and Jiva), four Ashvathas with their branches (the Vedas and the auxiliaries), the seven guardians (the five elements and the heart and the understanding).

data.v: भक्तं च मां भजमानं भजस्व; मा रीरिषो मामहिताहितेन । आत्मानं त्वामात्मनोऽनन्यभावो; विद्वानेवं गच्छति ब्रह्म शुक्रम् ॥
अस्तौषं त्वां तव संमानमिच्छ;न्विचिन्वन्वै सवृषं देववर्य । सुदुर्लभान्देहि वरान्ममेष्टा;नभिष्टुतः प्रतिकार्षीश्च मा माम् ॥
तस्मै वरानचिन्त्यात्मा नीलकण्ठः पिनाकधृक् । अर्हते देवमुख्याय प्रायच्छदृषिसंस्तुतः ॥
data.md: Vyasa said Then that god of inconceivable soul, possessed of blue throat and the wielder of the Pinaka bow, that divinity always eulogised by the sages, accorded boons to Vasudeya, who deserved then all.

data.v: मत्प्रसादान्मनुष्येषु देवगन्धर्वयोनिषु । अप्रमेयबलात्मा त्वं नारायण भविष्यसि ॥
data.md: The auspicious Lord said O Narayana, through my grace, among human beings, among the celestials and the Gandharavas, you shall be one whose soul and strength will be immeasurable.

data.v: न च त्वा प्रसहिष्यन्ति देवासुरमहोरगाः । न पिशाचा न गन्धर्वा न नरा न च राक्षसाः ॥
data.md: The celestials, the Asuras and the mighty serpents the Pisachas, the Gandharvas, men and Rakshasas, none among these will be able to withstand you (in battle).

data.v: न सुपर्णास्तथा नागा न च विश्वे वियोनिजाः । न कश्चित्त्वां च देवोऽपि समरेषु विजेष्यति ॥
data.md: Neither Suparna, nor any Naga, nor any other creature born in the universe, nor even any of the gods shall be able to vanquish you in battle.

data.v: न शस्त्रेण न वज्रेण नाग्निना न च वायुना । नार्द्रेण न च शुष्केण त्रसेन स्थावरेण वा ॥
data.md: By weapons or thunder-bolt or fire or wind or with any object that is wet or dry or with any mobile and or immobile things.

data.v: कश्चित्तव रुजं कर्ता मत्प्रसादात्कथंचन । अपि चेत्समरं गत्वा भविष्यसि ममाधिकः ॥
एवमेते वरा लब्धाः पुरस्ताद्विद्धि शौरिणा । स एष देवश्चरति मायया मोहयञ्जगत् ॥
data.md: None will be able to cause you pain, in consequence of my grace. You will be superior in battle even to me, if perchance you ever fight with me.

data.v: तस्यैव तपसा जातं नरं नाम महामुनिम् । तुल्यमेतेन देवेन तं जानीह्यर्जुनं सदा ॥
data.md: From the ascetic observances of the great Narayana, a mighty sage, called by the name of Nara was born. This latter is equal to the god Narayana himself. Know that Nara to be Arjuna.

data.v: तावेतौ पूर्वदेवानां परमोपचितावृषी । लोकयात्राविधानार्थं संजायेते युगे युगे ॥
data.md: These two sages, said to be older than the older gods, take their births in every Yuga for carrying on the easy rule of the universe.

data.v: तथैव कर्मणः कृत्स्नं महतस्तपसोऽपि च । तेजोमन्युश्च विद्वंस्त्वं जातो रौद्रो महामते ॥
data.md: You endued in energy and wrath also, O you of generous heart, have sprung from a portion of Rudra, through the merits of all your pious deeds and as a consequence of high ascetic austerities.

data.v: स भवान्देववत्प्राज्ञो ज्ञात्वा भवमयं जगत् । अवाकर्षस्त्वमात्मानं नियमैस्तत्प्रियेप्सया ॥
data.md: Being embodied, your intelligent self considered the world to be pervaded by Mahadeva; and then for propitiating that god you emaciated your body by the observance of hard vows.

data.v: शुभमौर्वं नवं कृत्वा महापुरुषविग्रहम् । ईजिवांस्त्वं जपैर्होमैरुपहारैश्च मानद ॥
data.md: Creating a white image of that foremost of male beings, O Bestower of honor, you adored him with homage, offerings and reiterating prayers.

data.v: स तथा पूज्यमानस्ते पूर्वदेवोऽप्यतूतुषत् । पुष्कलांश्च वरान्प्रादात्तव विद्वन्हृदि स्थितान् ॥
जन्मकर्मतपोयोगास्तयोस्तव च पुष्कलाः । ताभ्यां लिङ्गेऽर्चितो देवस्त्वयार्चायां युगे युगे ॥
data.md: Thus adored by you, the god became gratified on you in your previous life; and he then accorded to you, O learned one, excellent boons that you cherished in your heart.

data.v: सर्वरूपं भवं ज्ञात्वा लिङ्गे योऽर्चयति प्रभुम् । आत्मयोगाश्च तस्मिन्वै शास्त्रयोगाश्च शाश्वताः ॥
एवं देवा यजन्तो हि सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः । प्रार्थयन्ति परं लोके स्थानमेव च शाश्वतम् ॥
स एष रुद्रभक्तश्च केशवो रुद्रसंभवः । कृष्ण एव हि यष्टव्यो यज्ञैश्चैष सनातनः ॥
data.md: With a view to obtain that highest object in the world viz., Sthanu or Mahadeva; He is the creator of all. The eternal Krishna ought to be adored in all sacrifices.

data.v: सर्वभूतभवं ज्ञात्वा लिङ्गेऽर्चयति यः प्रभुम् । तस्मिन्नभ्यधिकां प्रीतिं करोति वृषभध्वजः ॥
data.md: Knowing the Phallic from of Siva to be the origin of all forms, the lord Kesava adores him. The god having the bull for him emblem entertains great respect for Kesava.

data.v: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः । नमश्चकार रुद्राय बहु मेने च केशवम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Hearing those words of his, that mighty carwarrior viz., the son of Drona, saluted Rudra and conceived a great regard for Kesava.

data.v: हृष्टलोमा च वश्यात्मा नमस्कृत्य महर्षये । वरूथिनीमभिप्रेत्य अवहारमकारयत् ॥
data.md: That one of controlled soul bowed also to that mighty sage (Krishna) and had the downs of his body erect. Then looking at his own divisions he withdrew them from the field of battle.

data.v: ततः प्रत्यवहारोऽभूत्पाण्डवानां विशां पते । कौरवाणां च दीनानां द्रोणे युधि निपातिते ॥
data.md: Thereupon, O ruler of men, the Pandava and the Kaurava troops were both withdrawn, the latter highly defeated in consequence of the overthrow of Drona.

data.v: युद्धं कृत्वा दिनान्पञ्च द्रोणो हत्वा वरूथिनीम् । ब्रह्मलोकं गतो राजन्ब्राह्मणो वेदपारगः ॥
data.md: Fighting only for the days and spreading carnage among the Pandava troops, o king, that Brahmana Drona, conversant with the contents of all the Vedas, attained to the posthumous region of the Brahmanas.

data.v: तस्मिन्नतिरथे द्रोणे निहते तत्र संजय । मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वन्नतः परम् ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said When that Atiratha, viz., Drona had been slain by the son of Prisata, O Sanjaya, did my troops and those of the Pandavas do afterwards?

data.v: तस्मिन्नतिरथे द्रोणे निहते पार्षतेन वै । कौरवेषु च भग्नेषु कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said When that Atiratha Drona had been slain by the son of Prisata and when the Kaurava ranks broken and routed, Kunti's Dhananjaya.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा सुमहदाश्चर्यमात्मनो विजयावहम् । यदृच्छयागतं व्यासं पप्रच्छ भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Beholding a wonderful sight indicative of his victory, questioned, O foremost of the Bharatas, the mighty sage Vyasa who had gone there at his own pleasure.

data.v: संग्रामे निघ्नतः शत्रूञ्शरौघैर्विमलैरहम् । अग्रतो लक्षये यान्तं पुरुषं पावकप्रभम् ॥
data.md: Arjuna said When slaying my foes in battle with myriads of resplendent darts, I saw a male being of the effulgence of fire proceeding before me.

data.v: ज्वलन्तं शूलमुद्यम्य यां दिशं प्रतिपद्यते । तस्यां दिशि विशीर्यन्ते शत्रवो मे महामुने ॥
data.md: Raising his blazing trident wherever he turned, my foes in that direction, O mighty sage, he routed and scorched.

data.v: न पद्भ्यां स्पृशते भूमिं न च शूलं विमुञ्चति । शूलाच्छूलसहस्राणि निष्पेतुस्तस्य तेजसा ॥
data.md: He never touches the earth with his feet nor does he hurled his trident; but in consequence of his energy, thousands of arrows issue out of that trident of his.

data.v: तेन भग्नानरीन्सर्वान्मद्भग्नान्मन्यते जनः । तेन दग्धानि सैन्यानि पृष्ठतोऽनुदहाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: People think that I rout my foes whereas they are really routed by him. I only pursue from behind the troops already broken and routed by him.

data.v: भगवंस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व को वै स पुरुषोत्तमः । शूलपाणिर्महान्कृष्ण तेजसा सूर्यसंनिभः ॥
data.md: O illustrious possessor of the six qualities the Bhagas, tell me who is that excellent of all male beings, whom I see armed with the trident and who resembles the Sun himself in effulgence.

data.v: प्रजापतीनां प्रथमं तैजसं पुरुषं विभुम् । भुवनं भूर्भुवं देवं सर्वलोकेश्वरं प्रभुम् ॥
data.md: Vyasa said O son of Pritha, you have seen Sankara, that first of all the creators of the world, that lord of all energies, primary male being, he that is the embodiment of heaven, earth and sky, the divine Lord, the saviour of the universe, the paramount master, the bestower of boons, also called Ishana. O, do you seek the refuge of that boon-giving deity, that lord of the universe.

data.v: ईशानं वरदं पार्थ दृष्टवानसि शंकरम् । तं गच्छ शरणं देवं सर्वादिं भुवनेश्वरम् ॥
महादेवं महात्मानमीशानं जटिलं शिवम् । त्र्यक्षं महाभुजं रुद्रं शिखिनं चीरवाससम् । दातारं चैव भक्तानां प्रसादविहितान्वरान् ॥
data.md: He was the Paramount Divinity, of illustrious soul, also called Ishana, the wearer of matted locks and the origin of all auspiciousness. He possesses three eyes and mighty arms and fierce energy; and his locks are tied as a crown of his head and he clad in deer skin.

data.v: तस्य ते पार्षदा दिव्या रूपैर्नानाविधैः विभोः । वामना जटिला मुण्डा ह्रस्वग्रीवा महोदराः ॥
data.md: That great one has for his companions, celestial beings of various forms, some of whom are dwarfs, some with matted locks, some with bald heads, some with short necks, some with large stomachs.

data.v: महाकाया महोत्साहा महाकर्णास्तथापरे । आननैर्विकृतैः पादैः पार्थ वेषैश्च वैकृतैः ॥
data.md: Some with huge bodies, some endued with great mighty and some with long ears. All of them have, O son of Pritha, distorted faces, mouths and legs and strange dresses.

data.v: ईदृशैः स महादेवः पूज्यमानो महेश्वरः । स शिवस्तात तेजस्वी प्रसादाद्याति तेऽग्रतः । तस्मिन्घोरे तदा पार्थ संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे ॥
data.md: That great lord Mahadeva, O Partha, is adored by even these kinds of followers. That Siva, O son, possessed of energy, goes in advance of you through kindness only.

data.v: द्रोणकर्णकृपैर्गुप्तां महेष्वासैः प्रहारिभिः । कस्तां सेनां तदा पार्थ मनसापि प्रधर्षयेत् । ऋते देवान्महेष्वासाद्बहुरूपान्महेश्वरात् ॥
data.md: In that dreadful battle, O son of Pritha, capable of causing the hair to stand erect, who else, O Arjuna, except the divine Maheshvara, that foremost of all bowmen, could even in his mind, dare defeat that host that was protected by those great smiters and bowmen, viz., Ashvatthaman, Karna and Kripa.

data.v: स्थातुमुत्सहते कश्चिन्न तस्मिन्नग्रतः स्थिते । न हि भूतं समं तेन त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते ॥
data.md: Nobody can venture to withstand the fighter, in whose front walks Mahadeva himself. There is no creature in the triune worlds who is a match for him.

data.v: गन्धेनापि हि संग्रामे तस्य क्रुद्धस्य शत्रवः । विसंज्ञा हतभूयिष्ठा वेपन्ति च पतन्ति च ॥
data.md: At the very smell of the enraged Mahadeva, the enemy trembles and drops down senseless in large numbers in battle.

data.v: तस्मै नमस्तु कुर्वन्तो देवास्तिष्ठन्ति वै दिवि । ये चान्ये मानवा लोके ये च स्वर्गजितो नराः ॥
data.md: For this reason the gods in heaven ever adore and bow down to him. The men of this world as also others that have attained to heaven.

data.v: ये भक्ता वरदं देवं शिवं रुद्रमुमापतिम् । इह लोके सुखं प्राप्य ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् ॥
data.md: If they devoutly worship the boon-giving, auspicious and divine Rudra, the lord of Uma, obtain happiness here and the highest felicity hereafter.

data.v: नमस्कुरुष्व कौन्तेय तस्मै शान्ताय वै सदा । रुद्राय शितिकण्ठाय कनिष्ठाय सुवर्चसे ॥
data.md: O son of Kunti, bow down to him who is peace incarnate, to him called Rudra (of the fierce), who is of blue throat, exceedingly subtle and of great effulgence.

data.v: कपर्दिने करालाय हर्यक्ष्णे वरदाय च । याम्यायाव्यक्तकेशाय सद्वृत्ते शंकराय च ॥
काम्याय हरिनेत्राय स्थाणवे पुरुषाय च । हरिकेशाय मुण्डाय कृशायोत्तरणाय च ॥
भास्कराय सुतीर्थाय देवदेवाय रंहसे । बहुरूपाय शर्वाय प्रियाय प्रियवाससे ॥
उष्णीषिणे सुवक्त्राय सहस्राक्षाय मीढुषे । गिरिशाय प्रशान्ताय पतये चीरवाससे ॥
data.md: To him that possesses an excellent turban, a handsome face and a thousand eyes; him that is the giver of rain, him that has the mountains for his habitation; him that is peace, him that is the protector, him that has the barks of trees for his cloth.

data.v: हिरण्यबाहवे चैव उग्राय पतये दिशाम् । पर्जन्यपतये चैव भूतानां पतये नमः ॥
data.md: To him whose arms are adorned with ornaments of gold, him who is furious; him who is the lord of all the different quarters; him who is the master of clouds and of all created beings.

data.v: वृक्षाणां पतये चैव अपां च पतये तथा । वृक्षैरावृतकायाय सेनान्ये मध्यमाय च ॥
data.md: To hiin who is the lord of all trees and of kine; him that has his body covered with trees; him who is the general of the celestial armies; him who is the inspirer of all thoughts.

data.v: स्रुवहस्ताय देवाय धन्विने भार्गवाय च । बहुरूपाय विश्वस्य पतये चीरवाससे ॥
data.md: To him who has the sacrificial ladle in his hands; him who is effulgent, him who wields the bow; him who is Rama himself, him who has numerous semblance's; him who is the lord of the universe; him who has the Munja grass for his attire;

data.v: सहस्रशिरसे चैव सहस्रनयनाय च । सहस्रबाहवे चैव सहस्रचरणाय च ॥
data.md: To him who has a thousand heads; him who has a thousand eyes; and him who has a thousand arms and a thousand legs.

data.v: शरणं प्राप्य कौन्तेय वरदं भुवनेश्वरम् । उमापतिं विरूपाक्षं दक्षयज्ञनिबर्हणम् । प्रजानां पतिमव्यग्रं भूतानां पतिमव्ययम् ॥
data.md: O son of Kunti, seek the refuge of at lord of the universe, who bestows boons, who is the lord of Uma, who possesses three-eyes and who is the destroyer of Daksha's sacrifice;

data.v: कपर्दिनं वृषावर्तं वृषनाभं वृषध्वजम् । वृषदर्पं वृषपतिं वृषशृङ्गं वृषर्षभम् ॥
वृषाङ्कं वृषभोदारं वृषभं वृषभेक्षणम् । वृषायुधं वृषशरं वृषभूतं महेश्वरम् ॥
महोदरं महाकायं द्वीपिचर्मनिवासिनम् । लोकेशं वरदं मुण्डं ब्रह्मण्यं ब्राह्मणप्रियम् ॥
त्रिशूलपाणिं वरदं खड्गचर्मधरं प्रभुम् । पिनाकिनं खण्डपरशुं लोकानां पतिमीश्वरम् । प्रपद्ये शरणं देवं शरण्यं चीरवाससम् ॥
नमस्तस्मै सुरेशाय यस्य वैश्रवणः सखा । सुवाससे नमो नित्यं सुव्रताय सुधन्विने ॥
data.md: Who use the bow Pinaka, who is shorn of his battle-axe and who is the sovereign and the saviour of the universe. I totally consign myself to the care of that divine lord, that giver of protection, that god versed in deer's skin; salutation to that lord of the gods who has Vaisravana for his friend, salutation to him of illustrious vows, to him whose companions are all best bow-men.

data.v: स्रुवहस्ताय देवाय सुखधन्वाय धन्विने । धन्वन्तराय धनुषे धन्वाचार्याय धन्विने ॥
data.md: To him who himself wields the bow, to that great Divinity with whom the bow is a favourite weapon; who is himself the arrow hurled by the bow; who is the bow-string and the bow and the preceptor instructing others in the use of the bow.

data.v: उग्रायुधाय देवाय नमः सुरवराय च । नमोऽस्तु बहुरूपाय नमश्च बहुधन्विने ॥
data.md: Salutations to that deity whose weapons are terrible and who himself is the foremost of all gods, salutations to him whose semblances are various and who has got diverse bowmen as his attendants.

data.v: नमोऽस्तु स्थाणवे नित्यं सुव्रताय सुधन्विने । नमोऽस्तु त्रिपुरघ्नाय भगघ्नाय च वै नमः ॥
data.md: Salutations to Sthanu, to that best of all wielders of bow, salutations even to the destroyer of 'Tripura,' and the slayer of Bhaga.

data.v: वनस्पतीनां पतये नराणां पतये नमः । अपां च पतये नित्यं यज्ञानां पतये नमः ॥
data.md: Salutations to the lord of the Vanaspatis (Trees & c) and to the lord of men; salutations to the lord of the celestial mothers and to the lord of the Ganas.

data.v: पूष्णो दन्तविनाशाय त्र्यक्षाय वरदाय च । नीलकण्ठाय पिङ्गाय स्वर्णकेशाय वै नमः ॥
data.md: Salutations to him who is the destroyer of Surya's teeth, who is of three eyes, who is the giver of boons, who is called Hara, who is blue-throated and who is of golden locks.

data.v: कर्माणि चैव दिव्यानि महादेवस्य धीमतः । तानि ते कीर्तयिष्यामि यथाप्रज्ञं यथाश्रुतम् ॥
data.md: I shall now relate to you, according to my knowledge and as I have heard them related, all the divine deeds of the supremely wise Mahadeva.

data.v: न सुरा नासुरा लोके न गन्धर्वा न राक्षसाः । सुखमेधन्ति कुपिते तस्मिन्नपि गुहागताः ॥
data.md: If Mahadeva is worked up with rage, neither the gods, nor the Asuras, neither the Gandharvas, nor the Rakshasas, even if they conceal themselves in deep caves, can enjoy any peace.

data.v: विव्याध कुपितो यज्ञं निर्भयस्तु भवस्तदा । धनुषा बाणमुत्सृज्य सघोषं विननाद च ॥
ते न शर्म कुतः शान्तिं लेभिरे स्म सुरास्तदा । विद्रुते सहसा यज्ञे कुपिते च महेश्वरे ॥
तेन ज्यातलघोषेण सर्वे लोकाः समाकुलाः । बभूवुर्वशगाः पार्थ निपेतुश्च सुरासुराः ॥
आपश्चुक्षुभिरे सर्वाश्चकम्पे च वसुंधरा । पर्वताश्च व्यशीर्यन्त दिशो नागाश्च मोहिताः ॥
अन्धाश्च तमसा लोका न प्रकाशन्त संवृताः । जघ्निवान्सह सूर्येण सर्वेषां ज्योतिषां प्रभाः ॥
चुक्रुशुर्भयभीताश्च शान्तिं चक्रुस्तथैव च । ऋषयः सर्वभूतानामात्मनश्च सुखैषिणः ॥
data.md: The splendour of the luminaries as also of the Sun was destroyed. The Rishis filled with fear became agitated and desirous of their own good and that of all other creatures, performed propitiatory rites. Then Sankara, smilingly rushed upon Pushana.

data.v: पूषाणमभ्यद्रवत शंकरः प्रहसन्निव । पुरोडाशं भक्षयतो दशनान्वै व्यशातयत् ॥
ततो निश्चक्रमुर्देवा वेपमाना नताः स्म तम् । पुनश्च संदधे दीप्तं देवानां निशितं शरम् ॥
रुद्रस्य यज्ञभागं च विशिष्टं ते न्वकल्पयन् । भयेन त्रिदशा राजञ्शरणं च प्रपेदिरे ॥
तेन चैवातिकोपेन स यज्ञः संधितस्तदा । यत्ताश्चापि सुरा आसन्यत्ताश्चाद्यापि तं प्रति ॥
असुराणां पुराण्यासंस्त्रीणि वीर्यवतां दिवि । आयसं राजतं चैव सौवर्णमपरं महत् ॥
आयसं तारकाक्षस्य कमलाक्षस्य राजतम् । सौवर्णं परमं ह्यासीद्विद्युन्मालिन एव च ॥
न शक्तस्तानि मघवान्भेत्तुं सर्वायुधैरपि । अथ सर्वेऽमरा रुद्रं जग्मुः शरणमर्दिताः ॥
ते तमूचुर्महात्मानं सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः । रुद्र रौद्रा भविष्यन्ति पशवः सर्वकर्मसु । निपातयिष्यसे चैनानसुरान्भुवनेश्वर ॥
data.md: O Rudra, then creatures immolated in every sacrifice will be yours. Do you therefore, O lord of the universe, over-throw those Asuras.

data.v: स तथोक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा देवानां हितकाम्यया । अतिष्ठत्स्थाणुभूतः स सहस्रं परिवत्सरान् ॥
data.md: Created an excellent and unequaled array called after his own name and then stood firm for a thousand years.

data.v: यदा त्रीणि समेतानि अन्तरिक्षे पुराणि वै । त्रिपर्वणा त्रिशल्येन तेन तानि बिभेद सः ॥
data.md: Then when the three cities came together on the firmameni, he pierced them with that shaft of his having three knots.

data.v: पुराणि न च तं शेकुर्दानवाः प्रतिवीक्षितुम् । शरं कालाग्निसंयुक्तं विष्णुसोमसमायुतम् ॥
data.md: The denizens of those cities, the Danavas, then could not look at that arrow composed of the Fire of Dissolution and of Vishnu and Soma.

data.v: बालमङ्कगतं कृत्वा स्वयं पञ्चशिखं पुनः । उमा जिज्ञासमाना वै कोऽयमित्यब्रवीत्सुरान् ॥
बाहुं सवज्रं शक्रस्य क्रुद्धस्यास्तम्भयत्प्रभुः । स एष भगवान्देवः सर्वलोकेश्वरः प्रभुः ॥
data.md: Thereupon the all-powerful Lord of all the worlds, possessed of the six excellent qualities the Bhagas, smilingly paralysed the arm of the enraged Indra wielding the thunder bolt.

data.v: न संबुबुधिरे चैनं देवास्तं भुवनेश्वरम् । सप्रजापतयः सर्वे बालार्कसदृशप्रभम् ॥
अथाभ्येत्य ततो ब्रह्मा दृष्ट्वा च स महेश्वरम् । अयं श्रेष्ठ इति ज्ञात्वा ववन्दे तं पितामहः ॥
data.md: O gods, you could not recognise that lord of the worlds. Thereafter the celestials with the Prajapati approached that boy of the radiance of the rising Sun. Then Brahma behclding the mighty lord and the grandsire knowing him to be the paramount master, began to adore him

data.v: ततः प्रसादयामासुरुमां रुद्रं च ते सुराः । अभवच्च पुनर्बाहुर्यथाप्रकृति वज्रिणः ॥
data.md: Then the celestials gratified both Uma and Maheswara with eulogies. Then the arm of the wielder of the thunderbolt once more regained its natural state.

data.v: तेषां प्रसन्नो भगवान्सपत्नीको वृषध्वजः । देवानां त्रिदशश्रेष्ठो दक्षयज्ञविनाशनः ॥
data.md: Then that illustrious Divinity whose emblem is the bull and who had destroyed the sacrifice of Daksha, together with his batter half, became gracious on the gods.

data.v: स वै रुद्रः स च शिवः सोऽग्निः शर्वः स सर्ववित् । स चेन्द्रश्चैव वायुश्च सोऽश्विनौ स च विद्युतः ॥
data.md: He is Rudra, he is Siva, he is Agni, he is all and the knower of all. He is Indra, he is Vayu, he is the twin Asvins and he is lightning.

data.v: स भवः स च पर्जन्यो महादेवः स चानघः । स चन्द्रमाः स चेशानः स सूर्यो वरुणश्च सः ॥
data.md: He is Bhava, he is Parjanya, he is Mahadeva and he is sinless. He is the Moon, he is Ishana, he is the Sun and he is Varuna.

data.v: स कालः सोऽन्तको मृत्युः स यमो रात्र्यहानि च । मासार्धमासा ऋतवः संध्ये संवत्सरश्च सः ॥
data.md: He is Time, he is Destroyer, he is death, he is Yama and day and night; He is a month, a fortnight, as well as the seasons, the twilight's and the complete year.

data.v: स च धाता विधाता च विश्वात्मा विश्वकर्मकृत् । सर्वासां देवतानां च धारयत्यवपुर्वपुः ॥
data.md: He is Dhata and Vidhata, the soul of the universe and the doer of all acts of the universe. Himself formless, he is thousand and he is hundreds of thousands.

data.v: सर्वैर्देवैः स्तुतो देवः सैकधा बहुधा च सः । शतधा सहस्रधा चैव तथा शतसहस्रधा ॥
data.md: He is eulogised by all the gods. He is one and many. He is hundred, he is thousand and he is hundreds of thousands.

data.v: ईदृशः स महादेवो भूयश्च भगवानजः । न हि सर्वे मया शक्या वक्तुं भगवतो गुणाः ॥
data.md: Such is the Lord Mahadeva, that Divinity without birth and that possessor of the six illustrious qualities the Bhagas. It is beyond my power to enumerate all the qualities of that lord.

data.v: सर्वैर्ग्रहैर्गृहीतान्वै सर्वपापसमन्वितान् । स मोचयति सुप्रीतः शरण्यः शरणागतान् ॥
आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यं वित्तं कामांश्च पुष्कलान् । स ददाति मनुष्येभ्यः स चैवाक्षिपते पुनः ॥
data.md: That great protector is pleased and grants them salvation, if indeed they seek refuge in him. He grants and takes away, life, health, prosperity, wealth and all other kinds of desirable objects. The prosperity seen in Indra and other gods is really his.

data.v: सेन्द्रादिषु च देवेषु तस्य चैश्वर्यमुच्यते । स चैव व्याहृते लोके मनुष्याणां शुभाशुभे ॥
ऐश्वर्याच्चैव कामानामीश्वरः पुनरुच्यते । महेश्वरश्च भूतानां महतामीश्वरश्च सः ॥
बहुभिर्बहुधा रूपैर्विश्वं व्याप्नोति वै जगत् । अस्य देवस्य यद्वक्त्रं समुद्रे तदतिष्ठत ॥
एष चैव श्मशानेषु देवो वसति नित्यशः । यजन्त्येनं जनास्तत्र वीरस्थान इतीश्वरम् ॥
data.md: This Divinity ever dwells in the places of cremation. Men worship this god there where only the braves can go.

data.v: अस्य दीप्तानि रूपाणि घोराणि च बहूनि च । लोके यान्यस्य कुर्वन्ति मनुष्याः प्रवदन्ति च ॥
data.md: The effulgent forms of this lord are many and marvellous; those forms are worshipped in the worlds and are praised and spoken of by men.

data.v: नामधेयानि लोकेषु बहून्यत्र यथार्थवत् । निरुच्यन्ते महत्त्वाच्च विभुत्वात्कर्मभिस्तथा ॥
data.md: Many also are the names of truthful import of the this Divinity. Known in the worlds. Those. names are all founded upon his supremacy, omnipotence and his acts.

data.v: वेदे चास्य समाम्नातं शतरुद्रीयमुत्तमम् । नाम्ना चानन्तरुद्रेति उपस्थानं महात्मनः ॥
data.md: In the Vedas, the excellent hymn called Shatarudriya has been sung in his praise, he who is the great Lord called the infinite Rudra.

data.v: स कामानां प्रभुर्देवो ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः । स विभुः स प्रभुर्देवो विश्वं व्याप्नुवते महत् ॥
data.md: That divinity is the Lord of all wishes both human and heavenly. He is the Lord Paramount and the supreme ruler and pervades this extensive universe.

data.v: ज्येष्ठं भूतं वदन्त्येनं ब्राह्मणा मुनयस्तथा । प्रथमो ह्येष देवानां मुखादस्यानलोऽभवत् ॥
data.md: The Brahmanas and the sages call him the most ancient of beings. He is the first-born of all the gods and fire came out from his mouth.

data.v: सर्वथा यत्पशून्पाति तैश्च यद्रमते पुनः । तेषामधिपतिर्यच्च तस्मात्पशुपतिः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: As he always and by every means protects the creature of the universe and always find pleasure in their company and as he is the lord of them all, he is truly called Pasupati.

data.v: नित्येन ब्रह्मचर्येण लिङ्गमस्य यदा स्थितम् । महयन्ति च लोकाश्च महेश्वर इति स्मृतः ॥
data.md: As his Phallic form is ever present in the observance of the Brahmacharya vow and as it adds to the glory of the world, he is called Maheshvara.

data.v: ऋषयश्चैव देवाश्च गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा । लिङ्गमस्यार्चयन्ति स्म तच्चाप्यूर्ध्वं समास्थितम् ॥
data.md: The Rishis, the celestials, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras, worship the Phallic emblem of this god, that ever remains erect.

data.v: पूज्यमाने ततस्तस्मिन्मोदते स महेश्वरः । सुखी प्रीतश्च भवति प्रहृष्टश्चैव शंकरः ॥
data.md: When his Phallic unblem is worshipped Maheshvara becomes glad and is pleased and delighted and transported with joy.

data.v: यदस्य बहुधा रूपं भूतभव्यभवत्स्थितम् । स्थावरं जङ्गमं चैव बहुरूपस्ततः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: As in the past, the present and the future, the god has many forms, both mobile and immobile, he is truly called Vahurupa.

data.v: एकाक्षो जाज्वलन्नास्ते सर्वतोक्षिमयोऽपि वा । क्रोधाद्यश्चाविशल्लोकांस्तस्माच्छर्व इति स्मृतः ॥
data.md: With one of his eyes blazing forth, he appears to have eyes on all sides of his body; and as in his wrath, he possesses the worlds, he is called Sarva.

data.v: धूम्रं रूपं च यत्तस्य धूर्जटिस्तेन उच्यते । विश्वे देवाश्च यत्तस्मिन्विश्वरूपस्ततः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: As his form is like that of smoke he is called Dhurjati; and as the Devas in the world are present in him he is called Vishvarupa.

data.v: तिस्रो देवीर्यदा चैव भजते भुवनेश्वरः । द्यामपः पृथिवीं चैव त्र्यम्बकश्च ततः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: As three goddesses viz., the sky, the firmament and the water, ever worship that lord of the worlds, therefore he is truly calied Tryambaka.

data.v: समेधयति यन्नित्यं सर्वार्थान्सर्वकर्मसु । शिवमिच्छन्मनुष्याणां तस्मादेश शिवः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: As he ever helps in the accomplishment of all acts and increased the wealth of men and is engaged in doing good to them, therefore he is called Siva.

data.v: सहस्राक्षोऽयुताक्षो वा सर्वतोक्षिमयोऽपि वा । यच्च विश्वं महत्पाति महादेवस्ततः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: Possessed of thousand or ten thousand eyes or eyes on all sides of his body, as he ever protects the universe, he is called Mahadeva.

data.v: दहत्यूर्ध्वं स्थितो यच्च प्राणोत्पत्तिस्थितश्च यत् । स्थितलिङ्गश्च यन्नित्यं तस्मात्स्थाणुरिति स्मृतः ॥
data.md: As he is Great and Ancient and is the fountain of life and the cause of its continuance and as his Phallic from is eternal, he is called Sthanu.

data.v: विषमस्थः शरीरेषु समश्च प्राणिनामिह । स वायुर्विषमस्थेषु प्राणापानशरीरिषु ॥
data.md: Whatever of soundness or unsoundness there is in the bodies of men, is said to be his manifestation. He is the Pana and Apana breaths in embodied creatures.

data.v: पूजयेद्विग्रहं यस्तु लिङ्गं वापि समर्चयेत् । लिङ्गं पूजयिता नित्यं महतीं श्रियमश्नुते ॥
data.md: He that ever worships the Phallic emblem of that illustrious god, attains great prosperity even by such worship of his.

data.v: ऊरुभ्यामर्धमाग्नेयं सोमार्धं च शिवा तनुः । आत्मनोऽर्धं च तस्याग्निः सोमोऽर्धं पुनरुच्यते ॥
data.md: Below his two thighs the forms are fiery, the other half of his soul is fire and half the moon.

data.v: तैजसी महती दीप्ता देवेभ्यश्च शिवा तनुः । भास्वती मानुषेष्वस्य तनुर्घोराग्निरुच्यते ॥
data.md: His auspicious form surcharged with energy is more blazing than all the forms of the other gods. Amongst men his blazing and dreadful form is called Fire.

data.v: ब्रह्मचर्यं चरत्येष शिवा यास्य तनुस्तया । यास्य घोरतरा मूर्तिः सर्वानत्ति तयेश्वरः ॥
data.md: With his auspicious form he practices the vow Brahmacharya, whereas with the dreadful form he has, he devours everything.

data.v: यन्निर्दहति यत्तीक्ष्णो यदुग्रो यत्प्रतापवान् । मांसशोणितमज्जादो यत्ततो रुद्र उच्यते ॥
data.md: As he burns, as he is keen and fierce and endued with the great prowess and as he devours flesh, blood and marrow, he is called Rudra.

data.v: एष देवो महादेवो योऽसौ पार्थ तवाग्रतः । संग्रामे शात्रवान्निघ्नंस्त्वया दृष्टः पिनाकधृक् ॥
data.md: It is this god of gods, the paramount lord, the wielder of the Pinaka bow, O Partha, whom you have seen go before you slaying your enemies.

data.v: एष वै भगवान्देवः संग्रामे याति तेऽग्रतः । येन दत्तानि तेऽस्त्राणि यैस्त्वया दानवा हताः ॥
data.md: He is that illustrious god, who comes first in the battle field, who provided all weapons by which the Danavas were slain by you.

data.v: धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं वेदैश्च संज्ञितम् । देवदेवस्य ते पार्थ व्याख्यातं शतरुद्रियम् ॥
data.md: O Partha, thus the hymn approved of Vedas and called Sata-rudriya in honour of that god of gods has been explained to thee which is excellent glorious, life-enhancing and sacred.

data.v: सर्वार्थसाधकं पुण्यं सर्वकिल्बिषनाशनम् । सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वदुःखभयापहम् ॥
चतुर्विधमिदं स्तोत्रं यः शृणोति नरः सदा । विजित्य सर्वाञ्शत्रून्स रुद्रलोके महीयते ॥
data.md: The hymn of four divisions capable of accomplishing all desired object, destructive of all sins, sacred and able to drive away all stains and to undo all sorrow and all fears. He who listen to this hymn always is succeeds in defeating all his enemies and is highly respected in the region of Rudra.

data.v: चरितं महात्मनो दिव्यं सांग्रामिकमिदं शुभम् । पठन्वै शतरुद्रीयं शृण्वंश्च सततोत्थितः ॥
भक्तो विश्वेश्वरं देवं मानुषेषु तु यः सदा । वरान्स कामाँल्लभते प्रसन्ने त्र्यम्बके नरः ॥
data.md: A man who always attentively reads or heard the recitation of this account (Satarudriya) belonging to war of this great deity and who worships devotionally that illustrious lord of universe (Vishveshvara) obtaineth all excellency objects of desire, in consequence of the three-eyed God being gratified with him.

data.v: गच्छ युध्यस्व कौन्तेय न तवास्ति पराजयः । यस्य मन्त्री च गोप्ता च पार्श्वतस्ते जनार्दनः ॥
data.md: O son of Kunti, Go and fight, defeat is not for thee that hast Janardana on your side for thy adviser and protector.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वार्जुनं संख्ये पराशरसुतस्तदा । जगाम भरतश्रेष्ठ यथागतमरिंदम ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said 0 best of Bharata! 0 chastiser of foes! Having addressed Arjuna in these words, the son of Parasara (Vyasa) went away to the place he had come from.

data.v: ततो द्रोणे हते राजन्दुर्योधनमुखा नृपाः । भृशमुद्विग्नमनसो द्रोणपुत्रमुपागमन् ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said O king, after Drona had been killed, the monarchs headed by Duryodhana, with greatly anxious hearts, all went to the son of Drona.

data.v: ते द्रोणमुपशोचन्तः कश्मलाभिहतौजसः । पर्युपासन्त शोकार्तास्ततः शारद्वतीसुतम् ॥
data.md: Thereupon mourning for the death of Drona, they (the kings) being highly oppressed with grief and deprived of energy on account of their gloominess of mind sat around the son of Sharadvata.

data.v: मुहूर्तं ते समाश्वास्य हेतुभिः शास्त्रसंमितैः । रात्र्यागमे महीपालाः स्वानि वेश्मानि भेजिरे ॥
data.md: Then having comforted him for a short while by citing reasons arrived at in the Shastras, the rulers of the earth departed to their respective abodes on the advent of the night.

data.v: विशेषतः सूतपुत्रो राजा चैव सुयोधनः । दुःशासनोऽथ शकुनिर्न निद्रामुपलेभिरे ॥
data.md: Especially the son of Suta, king Suyodhana, Dushasana and Shakuni could not at all sleep.

data.v: ते वेश्मस्वपि कौरव्य पृथ्वीशा नाप्नुवन्सुखम् । चिन्तयन्तः क्षयं तीव्रं निद्रां नैवोपलेभिरे ॥
data.md: O descendant of the Kuru race, the lords of the earth could not enjoy pleasure while resting in their own abodes; and they could not obtain sleep, thinking of that immense massacre.

data.v: सहितास्ते निशायां तु दुर्योधननिवेशने । अतिप्रचण्डाद्विद्वेषात्पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ॥
data.md: And they passed together that night in the abode of Duryodhana, whilst they were seriously thinking of the grief's with which the lofty-minded Pandavas were afflicted.

data.v: यत्तद्द्यूतपरिक्लिष्टां कृष्णामानिन्यिरे सभाम् । तत्स्मरन्तोऽन्वतप्यन्त भृशमुद्विग्नचेतसः ॥
data.md: Recollecting these, viz. that they (the Pandavas) were greatly oppressed during the game at dice and also that Krishna (Draupadi) was (forcibly) brought to the assembly (of kings), they greatly regretted, with hearts filled with anxiety.

data.v: चिन्तयन्तश्च पार्थानां तान्क्लेशान्द्यूतकारितान् । कृच्छ्रेण क्षणदां राजन्निन्युरब्दशतोपमाम् ॥
data.md: Thus reflecting upon those miseries resulting from the gambling match, (which the Pandavas had become subject to), their night had passed away with great uneasiness, which (night), O king, seemed to be (so long as) a hundred years.

data.v: ततः प्रभाते विमले स्थिता दिष्टस्य शासने । चक्रुरावश्यकं सर्वे विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥
data.md: Thereupon at the break of day they, being obedient to the injunctions of ordinance, all performed the necessary ceremonies, prescribed by the established usage.

data.v: ते कृत्वावश्यकार्याणि समाश्वस्य च भारत । योगमाज्ञापयामासुर्युद्धाय च विनिर्ययुः ॥
data.md: Having finished all the necessary ceremonies and consoled themselves, they, O Bharata, ordered for the array of soldiers and then started for battle.

data.v: कर्णं सेनापतिं कृत्वा कृतकौतुकमङ्गलाः । वाचयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठान्दधिपात्रघृताक्षतैः ॥
data.md: After having made Karna their generalissimo with the due performance of the most auspicious rites (by tying a thread round his wrist) and having adored the foremost of the regenerate persons by offerings of vessels of curds, clarified butter and vessels, filled with corn and other auspicious articles, as well as by presents of gold-coins, kine and gems, valuable cloths and immense wealth and also having been praised by the charioteers and panegyrists, born in the country of Magadha, (the Magadha-panegyrists are the mixed tribes born of a Kshatriya mother and a Brahmana father), with hymns about victory.

data.v: निष्कैर्गोभिर्हिरण्येन वासोभिश्च महाधनैः । वर्ध्यमाना जयाशीर्भिः सूतमागधबन्दिभिः ॥
तथैव पाण्डवा राजन्कृतसर्वाह्णिकक्रियाः । शिबिरान्निर्ययू राजन्युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयाः ॥
data.md: O monarch, the Pandavas on the other hand, having similarly performed the morning ceremonies, came out of their tents; and O king, they were resolved upon the battle.

data.v: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् । कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च परस्परवधैषिणाम् ॥
data.md: Thereupon the formidable battle began, which caused the hair of the body stand erect, between the Kurus and the Pandavas, each party being desirous of vanquishing the other.

data.v: तयोर्द्वे दिवसे युद्धं कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः । कर्णे सेनापतौ राजन्नभूदद्भुतदर्शनम् ॥
data.md: O monarch, the most formidable battle, betwcen the troops of the Kurus and those of the Pandavas, lasted only for two days during the leadership of Karna.

data.v: ततः शत्रुक्षयं कृत्वा सुमहान्तं रणे वृषः । पश्यतां धार्तराष्ट्राणां फल्गुनेन निपातितः ॥
data.md: Thereupon Vrisha (Karna), having brought about an immense slaughter of the opponents in battle, was himself slain by Falguna (Arjuna), whilst the sons of Dhartarashtra were observing it.

data.v: ततस्तत्संजयः सर्वं गत्वा नागाह्वयं पुरम् । आचख्यौ धृतराष्ट्राय यद्वृत्तं कुरुजाङ्गले ॥
data.md: Thereafter Sanjaya departed towards the city of Hastinapur and told all to Dhritarashtra, that had taken place at Kurujangala.

data.v: आपगेयं हतं श्रुत्वा द्रोणं च समरे परैः । यो जगाम परामार्तिं वृद्धो राजाम्बिकासुतः ॥
data.md: Janamejaya said Having heard that both Bhishma and the car-warrior Drona of indomitable courage were slain (in the battle), the old king (Dhritarashtra) the son of Ambika, was highly oppressed with sorrow.

data.v: स श्रुत्वा निहतं कर्णं दुर्योधनहितैषिणम् । कथं द्विजवर प्राणानधारयत दुःखितः ॥
data.md: Having heard of the death of Karna the benefactor of Duryodhana, how could he, O best of the regenerate persons, hold his life, much aggrieved as he was?

data.v: यस्मिञ्जयाशां पुत्राणाममन्यत स पार्थिवः । तस्मिन्हते स कौरव्यः कथं प्राणानधारयत् ॥
data.md: How could that royal descendant of Kuru hold his life, after having heard of the fall of that hero, on whom he supposed the hope of his sons' victory to rest?

data.v: दुर्मरं बत मन्येऽहं नृणां कृच्छ्रेऽपि वर्तताम् । यत्र कर्णं हतं श्रुत्वा नात्यजज्जीवितं नृपः ॥
data.md: I suppose that men, falling in the most distressful circumstances, find greatest difficulty in yielding up their lives; for, the king, even after hearing of the death of Karna, could not (possibly) forsake his life.

data.v: तथा शांतनवं वृद्धं ब्रह्मन्बाह्लिकमेव च । द्रोणं च सोमदत्तं च भूरिश्रवसमेव च ॥
तथैव चान्यान्सुहृदः पुत्रपौत्रांश्च पातितान् । श्रुत्वा यन्नाजहात्प्राणांस्तन्मन्ये दुष्करं द्विज ॥
data.md: As, O twice-born one, having heard of the fall of the old son of Shantanu, of Balhika, of Drona, of Somadatta, of Bhurisravas, as well as of other friends, of his sons and grandsons, the king did not give up his life; so, I suppose, that to yield up one's life is, O regenerate person, highly difficult.

data.v: एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण तपोधन । न हि तृप्यामि पूर्वेषां शृण्वानश्चरितं महत् ॥
data.md: Relate to me all these in their entirety, as they had really taken place. I am not (at all) satisfied with (simply) hearing the mighty achievements of my forefathers.

data.v: हते कर्णे महाराज निशि गावल्गणिस्तदा । दीनो ययौ नागपुरमश्वैर्वातसमैर्जवे ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said O great king, when Karna was slain, the son of Gavalgana, greatly mortified in heart, repaired that very night to the city of Nagpur, in the back of horses resembling the wind in swiftness.

data.v: स हास्तिनपुरं गत्वा भृशमुद्विग्नमानसः । जगाम धृतराष्ट्रस्य क्षयं प्रक्षीणबान्धवम् ॥
data.md: He then arrived at the city of Hastinapur; and with a greatly anxious heart, repaired to the house of Dhritarashtra which had now been vacated by all its friends.

data.v: स समुद्वीक्ष्य राजानं कश्मलाभिहतौजसम् । ववन्दे प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा मूर्ध्ना पादौ नृपस्य ह ॥
data.md: He then beholding the king deprived of energy in consequence of his gloominess of mind, folded his hands; and indeed, worshipped the monarch's feet by bowing down his head.

data.v: संपूज्य च यथान्यायं धृतराष्ट्रं महीपतिम् । हा कष्टमिति चोक्त्वा स ततो वचनमाददे ॥
data.md: Having worshipped the ruler of the earth, Dhritarashtra, according to the just rites and having uttered-Alas! and woe!-he then

data.v: संजयोऽहं क्षितिपते कच्चिदास्ते सुखं भवान् । स्वदोषेणापदं प्राप्य कच्चिन्नाद्य विमुह्यसि ॥
data.md: O ruler of earth, I am Sanjaya! Are you not at ease? After having obtained distress by your own faults, are you not now deprived of all your senses?

data.v: हितान्युक्तानि विदुरद्रोणगाङ्गेयकेशवैः । अगृहीतान्यनुस्मृत्य कच्चिन्न कुरुषे व्यथाम् ॥
data.md: The good advises, uttered (given) by Vidura, Drona, son of Ganga and Keshava, were not received by you. Do you not feel pain to remember them now?

data.v: आख्याता मामकास्तात निहता युधि पाण्डवैः । निहतान्पाण्डवेयानां मामकैर्ब्रूहि संजय ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said O son, you have related which of my followers were slain in battle by the Pandavas. But now do you tell me, O Sanjaya, which of the Pandavas were slain by the warriors of my side.

data.v: कुन्तयो युधि विक्रान्ता महासत्त्वा महाबलाः । सानुबन्धाः सहामात्या भीष्मेण युधि पातिताः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said All the descendants of Kunti, exerting themselves with prowess in battle and possessed of great spirit and strength, was slain by Bhishma in battle with all their kinsmen and counselors.

data.v: समः किरीटिना संख्ये वीर्येण च बलेन च । सत्यजित्सत्यसंधेन द्रोणेन निहतो रणे ॥
data.md: Satyajit, who was like Kiritin (Arjuna, decked in diadem) fighting in the field, both in prowess and strength, was slain in battle by Drona, who was of sure aim.

data.v: तथा विराटद्रुपदौ वृद्धौ सहसुतौ नृपौ । पराक्रमन्तौ मित्रार्थे द्रोणेन निहतौ रणे ॥
data.md: So also, the old king Virata and Drupada, displaying their prowess in battle, were slain by Drona for sake of their ally, with all their sons.

data.v: यो बाल एव समरे संमितः सव्यसाचिना । केशवेन च दुर्धर्षो बलदेवेन चाभिभूः ॥
स एष कदनं कृत्वा महद्रणविशारदः । परिवार्य महामात्रैः षड्भिः परमकै रथैः । अशक्नुवद्भिर्बीभत्सुमभिमन्युर्निपातितः ॥
data.md: O Lord that invincible hero, Abhimanyu, who, as a boy, was like Savyasachin, Keshava and Baladeva and who also was greatly skilled in battle, was surrounded by six of the most exalted of the car-warriors and slain by them, after having made an utter extermination of the enemies, when they (warriors) became incapable of withstanding Arjuna.

data.v: तं कृतं विरथं वीरं क्षत्रधर्मे व्यवस्थितम् । दौःशासनिर्महाराज सौभद्रं हतवान्रणे ॥
data.md: O powerful monarch, the son of Dushasana, after having dispossessed the son of Subhadra of his car, who was still observing the duties of a Kshatriya slew him in battle.

data.v: बृहन्तस्तु महेष्वासः कृतास्त्रो युद्धदुर्मदः । दुःशासनेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम् ॥
data.md: Brihanta, that great bowman, who was well acquainted with the use of weapons and most invincible in battle, was sent to the region of Yama by Dushasana showing forth his prowess in the field.

data.v: मणिमान्दण्डधारश्च राजानौ युद्धदुर्मदौ । पराक्रमन्तौ मित्रार्थे द्रोणेन विनिपातितौ ॥
data.md: So also, the old king Virata and Drupada, displaying their prowess in battle, were slain by Drona for sake of their ally, with all their sons.

data.v: अंशुमान्भोजराजस्तु सहसैन्यो महारथः । भारद्वाजेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम् ॥
data.md: So also, the mighty car-warrior Ansuman, the king of the Bhojas, was dispatched to the abode of Death with his soldiers by the son of Bharadvaja, displaying his prowess in battle.

data.v: चित्रायुधश्चित्रयोधी कृत्वा तौ कदनं महत् । चित्रमार्गेण विक्रम्य कर्णेन निहतौ युधि ॥
data.md: After having wrought an immense carnage, the two heroes, Chitrayudha and Chitrayodhi, were slain in battle by Vikarna, who was well acquainted with the diverse of stratagems and displayed immense prowess (in the field),

data.v: वृकोदरसमो युद्धे दृढः केकयजो युधि । केकयेनैव विक्रम्य भ्रात्रा भ्राता निपातितः ॥
data.md: Having been encompassed by the Kaikeya warriors, the king of the Kaikeyas, who was the peer of Vrikodara in battle, was slain by (his brother) Kaikeya showing forth his prowess in this encounter of brother against brother.

data.v: जनमेजयो गदायोधी पार्वतीयः प्रतापवान् । दुर्मुखेन महाराज तव पुत्रेण पातितः ॥
data.md: O great monarch, that great wielder of mace, Janamejaya, the dweller of the hilly country, who was possessed of great energy, was slain by your son Durmukha.

data.v: रोचमानौ नरव्याघ्रौ रोचमानौ ग्रहाविव । द्रोणेन युगपद्राजन्दिवं संप्रेषितौ शरैः ॥
data.md: O monarch, the two most exalted of persons, the two brothers known by the name of Rochamana (the bright), like two bright planets, were caused by Drona with his shafts, to repair at the same time to heaven.

data.v: नृपाश्च प्रतियुध्यन्तः पराक्रान्ता विशां पते । कृत्वा नसुकरं कर्म गता वैवस्वतक्षयम् ॥
data.md: O ruler of earth, several other monarchs, possessed of immense prowess, who were engaged in battle (on the side of the Pandavas), all repaired to the abode of Death, after having achieved the most terrible and difficult deeds.

data.v: पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च मातुलः सव्यसाचिनः । संग्रामनिर्जिताँल्लोकान्गमितो द्रोणसायकैः ॥
data.md: Purujit and Kuntibhoja, the two maternal uncles of Savyasachin, were sent by the shafts of Drona to those regions that are attainable in battle.

data.v: अभिभूः काशिराजश्च काशिकैर्बहुभिर्वृतः । वसुदानस्य पुत्रेण न्यासितो देहमाहवे ॥
data.md: Having been encompassed by a large number of the Kashis, Abhivus, the king of the Kashis, was caused to lay dawn his body (i.e. life) in battle by the son of Vasudana.

data.v: अमितौजा युधामन्युरुत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् । निहत्य शतशः शूरान्परैर्विनिहतौ रणे ॥
data.md: Having slaughtered hundreds of heroes, Amitaujah, Yudhamanyu and Uttamanjah endued with prowess, were all slain by our followers.

data.v: क्षत्रधर्मा च पाञ्चाल्यः क्षत्रवर्मा च मारिष । द्रोणेन परमेष्वासौ गमितौ यमसादनम् ॥
शिखण्डितनयो युद्धे क्षत्रदेवो युधां पतिः । लक्ष्मणेन हतो राजंस्तव पौत्रेण भारत ॥
data.md: O King! In that battle, O Bharata! the foremost of warriors, son of Shikhandi Khatradeva was slain by your grandson Lakshmana.

data.v: सुचित्रश्चित्रधर्मा च पितापुत्रौ महारथौ । प्रचरन्तौ महावीर्यौ द्रोणेन निहतौ रणे ॥
data.md: The two heroes, possessed of mighty strength, Suchitra and Chitravarman, who are related to each others as father and son, roving about in the field of battle, were slain by Drona.

data.v: वार्धक्षेमिर्महाराज कृत्वा कदनमाहवे । बाह्लिकेन महाराज कौरवेण निपातितः ॥
धृष्टकेतुर्महाराज चेदीनां प्रवरो रथः । कृत्वा नसुकरं कर्म गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम् ॥
data.md: O powerful king, having achieved the most difficult feats, Dhristaketu that greatest carwarrior among the Chedis, departed to the abode of Death.

data.v: तथा सत्यधृतिस्तात कृत्वा कदनमाहवे । पाण्डवार्थे पराक्रान्तो गमितो यमसादनम् ॥
data.md: So also, having wrought a carnage of the foes in battle for the sake of his ally, the Pandava army, heroic Satyadhriti, who was possessed of great energy, was sent to the region of Yama.

data.v: पुत्रस्तु शिशुपालस्य सुकेतुः पृथिवीपते । निहत्य शात्रवान्संख्ये द्रोणेन निहतो युधि ॥
data.md: Having slaughtered the enemies in battle, the lord of the earth Suketu, the son of Sishupala, was slain by Drona in the field.

data.v: तथा सत्यधृतिर्वीरो मदिराश्वश्च वीर्यवान् । सूर्यदत्तश्च विक्रान्तो निहतो द्रोणसायकैः ॥
data.md: So also, Satyadhriti the chief of the Matshyas and powerful Madirashva and Suryadatta of mighty prowess, slaughtered by the shafts of Drona.

data.v: श्रेणिमांश्च महाराज युध्यमानः पराक्रमी । कृत्वा नसुकरं कर्म गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम् ॥
data.md: Having achieved the extraordinary exploits in battle. Durmarsana, Durvisaha and the great car-warrior Durjaya departed to the region of Death.

data.v: तथैव युधि विक्रान्तो मागधः परवीरहा । भीष्मेण निहतो राजन्युध्यमानः पराक्रमी ॥
वसुदानश्च कदनं कुर्वाणोऽतीव संयुगे । भारद्वाजेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम् ॥
data.md: Having made a great slaughter in battle, Vasudana was sent to the abode of Yama, by the son of Bharadvaja careering in battle with great prowess.

data.v: एते चान्ये च बहवः पाण्डवानां महारथाः । हता द्रोणेन विक्रम्य यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥
data.md: These and several other mighty car-warriors among the Pandavas were slain by Drona displaying their prowess in battle. These are all that you had asked me.

data.v: हतप्रवीरे सैन्येऽस्मिन्मामके वदतां वर । अहताञ्शंस मे सूत येऽत्र जीवन्ति केचन ॥
data.md: After the most heroic warriors on my side were slain in-battle, O Suta, the best of speakers, do you relate to me which of my army are still alive unhurt.

data.v: एतेषु निहतेष्वद्य ये त्वया परिकीर्तिताः । अहतान्मन्यसे यांस्त्वं तेऽपि स्वर्गजितो मताः ॥
यस्मिन्महास्त्राणि समर्पितानि; चित्राणि शुभ्राणि चतुर्विधानि । दिव्यानि राजन्निहितानि चैव; द्रोणेन वीरद्विजसत्तमेन ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said O monarch, the hero-to whom were given the four kinds of brilliant and mighty weapons of innumerable shapes, as well as various other celestial weapons by Drona the best of the regenerate persons.

data.v: महारथः कृतिमान्क्षिप्रहस्तो; दृढायुधो दृढमुष्टिर्दृढेषुः । स वीर्यवान्द्रोणपुत्रस्तरस्वी; व्यवस्थितो योद्धुकामस्त्वदर्थे ॥
data.md: That great car-warrior, the high-souled son of Drona's-who is most expert in military performances, light-handed, having steng weapons and the strongest fist among the boxers and capable of shooting surely from a distance, is still staying in the field most desirous of fighting for your sake.

data.v: आनर्तवासी हृदिकात्मजोऽसौ; महारथः सात्वतानां वरिष्ठः । स्वयं भोजः कृतवर्मा कृतास्त्रो; व्यवस्थितो योद्धुकामस्त्वदर्थे ॥
data.md: That mighty car-warrior Kritavarman, that son of Hridika, the dweller of the country of Anarta, the most exalted of the Satvatas, that chief of the Bhojas himself is still staying in the field of battle, desirous of fighting for your sake, as he is well acquainted with the use of weapons.

data.v: शारद्वतो गौतमश्चापि राज;न्महाबलो बहुचित्रास्त्रयोधी । धनुश्चित्रं सुमहद्भारसाहं; व्यवस्थितो योत्स्यमानः प्रगृह्य ॥
data.md: O monarch, Gautama, the son of Sharadvata, of great strength and variously skilled in the use of innumerable weapons, is staying in the field desirous of fighting, upholding an extraordinary bow capable of bearing a pretty great strain.

data.v: आर्तायनिः समरे दुष्प्रकम्प्यः; सेनाग्रणीः प्रथमस्तावकानाम् । स्वस्रेयांस्तान्पाण्डवेयान्विसृज्य; सत्यां वाचं तां चिकीर्षुस्तरस्वी ॥
तेजोवधं सूतपुत्रस्य संख्ये; प्रतिश्रुत्वाजातशत्रोः पुरस्तात् । दुराधर्षः शक्रसमानवीर्यः; शल्यः स्थितो योद्धुकामस्त्वदर्थे ॥
आजानेयैः सैन्धवैः पार्वतीयै;र्नदीजकाम्बोजवनायुबाह्लिकैः । गान्धारराजः स्वबलेन युक्तो; व्यवस्थितो योद्धुकामस्त्वदर्थे ॥
data.md: Attended by an excellent force consisting of the Ajaneyas, the Saindhavas, the Highlanders, the dwellers of the river-basins, the Kambojas, the Vanayus and the Balhikas, the king of the Gandharas, is still staying in the field desirous of fighting for your sake.

data.v: तथा सुतस्ते ज्वलनार्कवर्णं; रथं समास्थाय कुरुप्रवीर । व्यवस्थितः कुरुमित्रो नरेन्द्र; व्यभ्रे सूर्यो भ्राजमानो यथा वै ॥
data.md: O lord of men, riding on a car resembling the Sun or the fire in splendour, similarly your son, Purumitra, that best hero amongst the Kurus, is careering on the field, even as the Sun, shining brightly wanders on the cloudless firmament.

data.v: दुर्योधनो नागकुलस्य मध्ये; महावीर्यः सह सैन्यप्रवीरैः । रथेन जाम्बूनदभूषणेन; व्यवस्थितः समरे योद्धुकामः ॥
data.md: Riding on a car adorned with gold, Duryodhana of mighty prowess, in the midst of a force consisting on the elephants, is staying on the field with all his heroic soldiers, ready for battling.

data.v: स राजमध्ये पुरुषप्रवीरो; रराज जाम्बूनदचित्रवर्मा । पद्मप्रभो वह्निरिवाल्पधूमो; मेघान्तरे सूर्य इव प्रकाशः ॥
data.md: Putting on an armour decked in gold, that foremost of persons, possessing the splendour of a lotus, shone in the midst of kings, like the fire sending out little smoke, or like the Sun rising after he has emerged from the clouds.

data.v: तथा सुषेणोऽप्यसिचर्मपाणि;स्तवात्मजः सत्यसेनश्च वीरः । व्यवस्थितौ चित्रसेनेन सार्धं; हृष्टात्मानौ समरे योद्धुकामौ ॥
data.md: Similarly, your sons, Sushena furnished with the sword and shield and the war-like Satyasena are still waiting on the field of battle with joy and desirous of battling for your sake.

data.v: ह्रीनिषेधा भरता राजपुत्रा;श्चित्रायुधः श्रुतकर्मा जयश्च । शलश्च सत्यव्रतदुःशलौ च; व्यवस्थिता बलिनो योद्धुकामाः ॥
data.md: The modest princes of the Bharata race, namely Chitrayudha, Shrutavarman, Jaya, Shala, Satyavrata and Dusshala, who are all endued with mighty strength, are still staying in the field with the desire of battling.

data.v: कैतव्यानामधिपः शूरमानी; रणे रणे शत्रुहा राजपुत्रः । पत्री हयी नागरथप्रयायी; व्यवस्थितो योद्धुकामस्त्वदर्थे ॥
data.md: The lord of the Kitavyas, that prince, that smiter of foes, who considers himself most heroic and who is careering in the field accompanied by both infantry and cavalry, as well as by the elephant force and cars, is still in the field with the desire of fighting for your sake.

data.v: वीरः श्रुतायुश्च श्रुतायुधश्च; चित्राङ्गदश्चित्रवर्मा स वीरः । व्यवस्थिता ये तु सैन्ये नराग्र्याः; प्रहारिणो मानिनः सत्यसंधाः ॥
data.md: Those foremost of persons, those mighty smiters of enemies, considering themselves highly proud, the heroic Shrutayus, Shrutayudha, Chitrangada and Chitravarman, all of whom are of sure aim, are similarly staying in the field with the desire of battling.

data.v: कर्णात्मजः सत्यसेनो महात्मा; व्यवस्थितः समरे योद्धुकामः । अथापरौ कर्णसुतौ वरार्हौ; व्यवस्थितौ लघुहस्तौ नरेन्द्र । बलं महद्दुर्भिदमल्पधैर्यैः; समाश्रितौ योत्स्यमानौ त्वदर्थे ॥
data.md: Satyasandha, the lofty-minded son of Karna, is still on the field, desirous of battling. So also, O lord of men, two other sons of Karna, who are acquainted with the use of excellent weapons and are light-handed, are both staying on the field with the desire of battling for your sake, being accompanied by a large army incapable of being vanquished by a force of little prowess.

data.v: एतैश्च मुख्यैरपरैश्च राज;न्योधप्रवीरैरमितप्रभावैः । व्यवस्थितो नागकुलस्य मध्ये; यथा महेन्द्रः कुरुराजो जयाय ॥
data.md: O monarch, being surrounded by these and several other chiefs, who are all best of warriors and are endued with immeasurable prowess, the Kuru king is staying in the field, in the midst of an elephant force, with the object of winning victory; even as Indra (stands in the midst of the celestials).

data.v: आख्याता जीवमाना ये परेभ्योऽन्ये यथातथम् । इतीदमभिगच्छामि व्यक्तमर्थाभिपत्तितः ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said All have been related to me in detail viz. who having escaped from the enemies are alive. From this I clearly understand which side will win the victory; this may really be arrived at from facts.

data.v: एवं ब्रुवन्नेव तदा धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः । हतप्रवीरं विध्वस्तं किंचिच्छेषं स्वकं बलम् । श्रुत्वा व्यामोहमगमच्छोकव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said While Dhritarashtra, the son of Ambika, was thus addressing and also having heard that the most exalted of the heroic warriors on his side were slain and only a small portion of the whole army was alive, he was plunged deep in sorrow and his heart, too, was greatly agitated by grief.

data.v: मुह्यमानोऽब्रवीच्चापि मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ संजय । व्याकुलं मे मनस्तात श्रुत्वा सुमहदप्रियम् । नष्टचित्तस्ततः सोऽथ बभूव जगतीपतिः ॥
data.md: Dnritarashtra said Thereafter, he (the king) became almost senseless and addressed (after having recovered his senses a little) Sanjaya, saying.-'Do you stop for a moment.' O son, having heard of this exceedingly evil intelligence, my mind becomes becomes greatly perplexed. My mind (brain) as well as the different limbs are growing paralyzed, which I am not able to uphold.

data.md: When that mighty bowman Karna was slain in battle by the holder of Kiriti (Arjuna), what other heroes were still waiting in the field. Tell me this, O Sanjaya.

data.md: When his car was not broken, nor his bow was cut-off, nor his weapons were exhausted, how could he (Karna), therefore, be slain by the enemies?

data.v: को हि शक्तो रणे कर्णं विधुन्वानं महद्धनुः । विमुञ्चन्तं शरान्घोरान्दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि चाहवे । जेतुं पुरुषशार्दूलं शार्दूलमिव वेगितम् ॥
data.md: Who, indeed, was able to subdue Karna in battle, that foremost of persons, possessed of the speed of a tiger, while that mighty bowman was shaking his bow and shooting forth his terrible arrows and exhausting his celestial weapons in battle.

data.md: Indeed, I do not find any other cause of his slaughter. 'I will not have my feet washed, so long as I do not slay Falguna.' This was highly the terrible vow of the high-souled one.

data.md: Having been assisted by that hero as well as by his brother Dushasana, that my evil-souled and wicked-minded son had resolved upon to reject the proposals of Vasudeva himself.
