data.md: Sanjaya said Beholding the great bowmen bowmen Karna stationed for battle all the Kurus began to utter loud cries of joy from all sides.

data.v: ततो दुन्दुभिघोषेण भेरीणां निनदेन च । बाणशब्दैश्च विविधैर्गर्जितैश्च तरस्विनाम् । निर्ययुस्तावका युद्धे मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् ॥
data.md: Thereupon with the beatings of cymbals and drums, the sound of all sorts of weapons and the war-cries of the greatly active heroes all your soldiers proceeded to the battle-field, making death the final point of stoppage.

data.v: प्रयाते तु ततः कर्णे योधेषु मुदितेषु च । चचाल पृथिवी राजन्ररास च सुविस्वरम् ॥
data.md: When Karna went all the soldiers, were filled with joy. The earth, O king, trembled and created a loud noise.

data.v: निश्चरन्तो व्यदृश्यन्त सूर्यात्सप्त महाग्रहाः । उल्कापातश्च संजज्ञे दिशां दाहस्तथैव च । तथाशन्यश्च संपेतुर्ववुर्वाताश्च दारुणाः ॥
data.md: All the great planets including the sun seemed moving about. And the meteors were seen blazing up all the quarters. Cloudless thunders fell and fierce winds blew.

data.v: मृगपक्षिगणाश्चैव बहुशः पृतनां तव । अपसव्यं तदा चक्रुर्वेदयन्तो महद्भयम् ॥
data.md: A large number of animals and birds, kept to the right of your army and emitted noise foreboding a dreadful calamity.

data.v: प्रस्थितस्य च कर्णस्य निपेतुस्तुरगा भुवि । अस्थिवर्षं च पतितमन्तरिक्षाद्भयानकम् ॥
data.md: After the departure of Karna his horses trembled down on earth. And a dreadful shower of bones fell from the sky.

data.v: जज्वलुश्चैव शस्त्राणि ध्वजाश्चैव चकम्पिरे । अश्रूणि च व्यमुञ्चन्त वाहनानि विशां पते ॥
data.md: O king, their weapons were as if burning and the flags were trembling. And the horses shed tears.

data.v: एते चान्ये च बहव उत्पातास्तत्र मारिष । समुत्पेतुर्विनाशाय कौरवाणां सुदारुणाः ॥
data.md: Those and other dreadful portends appeared there presaging the destruction of the Kauravas. Stupefied by Destiny they paid no attention of them.

data.v: न च तान्गणयामासुः सर्वे ते दैवमोहिताः । प्रस्थितं सूतपुत्रं च जयेत्यूचुर्नरा भुवि । निर्जितान्पाण्डवांश्चैव मेनिरे तव कौरवाः ॥
data.md: Seeing the departure of the charioteer's son all the king cried out victory. The Kauravas then thought that the Pandavas had been defeated.

data.v: ततो रथस्थः परवीरहन्ता; भीष्मद्रोणावात्तवीर्यौ निरीक्ष्य । समज्वलद्भारत पावकाभो; वैकर्तनोऽसौ रथकुञ्जरो वृषः ॥
data.md: The king Vikartana, the subduer of hostile heroes and the foremost of car-warriors, stood on the car, thinking of the death of Bhishma and Drona. He shone there like the sun of fire.

data.v: स शल्यमाभाष्य जगाद वाक्यं; पार्थस्य कर्माप्रतिमं च दृष्ट्वा । मानेन दर्पेण च दह्यमानः; क्रोधेन दीप्यन्निव निःश्वसित्वा ॥
data.md: Thinking of the powerful feats of Arjuna, elated with self conceit and pride, worked up with anger and breathing hot and hard, said to Shalya-

data.v: नाहं महेन्द्रादपि वज्रपाणेः; क्रुद्धाद्बिभेम्यात्तधनू रथस्थः । दृष्ट्वा तु भीष्मप्रमुखाञ्शयाना;न्न त्वेव मां स्थिरता संजहाति ॥
data.md: When I am with my bow I do not fear even the angry Mahendra with thunder-bolt in his hand. Beholding Bhishma and other leading heroes lying on the battle field I do not feel the least anxiety.

data.v: महेन्द्रविष्णुप्रतिमावनिन्दितौ; रथाश्वनागप्रवरप्रमाथिनौ । अवध्यकल्पौ निहतौ यदा परै;स्ततो ममाद्यापि रणेऽस्ति साध्वसम् ॥
data.md: Seeing the immaculate Bhishma and Drona equal to Indra and Vishnu, the grinders of the best of cars, elephants and horses and who are not to be killed by any, slain by the enemy I do not feel any fear in battle today.

data.v: समीक्ष्य संख्येऽतिबलान्नराधिपै;र्नराश्वमातङ्गरथाञ्शरैर्हतान् । कथं न सर्वानहितान्रणेऽवधी;न्महास्त्रविद्ब्राह्मणपुंगवो गुरुः ॥
data.md: Well-versed in the use of powerful weapons and himself the foremost of Brahmanas why did not the preceptor kill in battle all the enemies who killed the most powerful of our hero with their drivers, elephants and chariots?

data.v: स संस्मरन्द्रोणहवं महाहवे; ब्रवीमि सत्यं कुरवो निबोधत । न वो मदन्यः प्रसहेद्रणेऽर्जुनं; क्रमागतं मृत्युमिवोग्ररूपिणम् ॥
data.md: Listen to me, O Karna, I tell you the truth, thinking of this Drona in battle that there is none amongst you excepting myself who can withstand the advancing Arjuna the heroes who resembled the most dreadful Regent of Death.

data.v: शिक्षा प्रसादश्च बलं धृतिश्च; द्रोणे महास्त्राणि च संनतिश्च । स चेदगान्मृत्युवशं महात्मा; सर्वानन्यानातुरानद्य मन्ये ॥
data.md: In Drona were skill, practice, strength, patience, the greatest of weapons and policy. While that high-souled one has come by death I think all others, shorn of strength, on the point of death.

data.v: नेह ध्रुवं किंचिदपि प्रचिन्त्यं; विदुर्लोके कर्मणोऽनित्ययोगात् । सूर्योदये को हि विमुक्तसंशयो; गर्वं कुर्वीताद्य गुरौ निपातिते ॥
data.md: Even on reflection I do not find any thing perinanent in this world on account of the eternal connection of acts. When the preceptor himself is no more who can expect that he will surely live till even today's sun-rise.

data.v: न नूनमस्त्राणि बलं पराक्रमः; क्रिया सुनीतं परमायुधानि वा । अलं मनुष्यस्य सुखाय वर्तितुं; तथा हि युद्धे निहतः परैर्गुरुः ॥
data.md: While preceptor has been slain in battle by the enemies, weapons, strength, prowess, actions and wise policy cannot forsooth conduce to the happiness of a man.

data.v: हुताशनादित्यसमानतेजसं; पराक्रमे विष्णुपुरंदरोपमम् । नये बृहस्पत्युशनःसमं सदा; न चैनमस्त्रं तदपात्सुदुःसहम् ॥
data.md: In energy Drona equaled the sun or firc; in prowess he was like Vishnu or Indra, in policy he was like Vrihaspati or Ushanas; invincible though he was even weapons could not protect him.

data.v: संप्रक्रुष्टे रुदितस्त्रीकुमारे; पराभूते पौरुषे धार्तराष्ट्रे । मया कृत्यमिति जानामि शल्य; प्रयाहि तस्माद्द्विषतामनीकम् ॥
data.md: Our women and children are weeping and bewailing, the manliness of the sons of Dhritarashtra has been defeated. I know therefore, O Shalya, that it is I who am to fight; proceed therefore against the array of our enemies.

data.v: यत्र राजा पाण्डवः सत्यसंधो; व्यवस्थितो भीमसेनार्जुनौ च । वासुदेवः सृञ्जयाः सात्यकिश्च; यमौ च कस्तौ विषहेन्मदन्यः ॥
data.md: Save me who can withstand the army in the midst of which in the truthful Pandavas king Bhimasena, Arjuna, Vasudeva, Satyaki, Srinjaya and the twins.

data.v: तस्मात्क्षिप्रं मद्रपते प्रयाहि; रणे पाञ्चालान्पाण्डवान्सृञ्जयांश्च । तान्वा हनिष्यामि समेत्य संख्ये; यास्यामि वा द्रोणमुखाय मन्ये ॥
data.md: Therefore, O king of Madra, move on quickly in this battle towards the Panchalas, Pandavas and Srinjayas. Encountering them either I will kill them or will myself go to the abode of death by the road followed by Drona.

data.v: न त्वेवाहं न गमिष्यामि मध्यं; तेषां शूराणामिति मा शल्य विद्धि । मित्रद्रोहो मर्षणीयो न मेऽयं; त्यक्त्वा प्राणाननुयास्यामि द्रोणम् ॥
data.md: Do not think, O Shalya, that I will not enter into the heart of their army. I cannot tolerate such dissension's amongst the kith and kin. I will even follow Drona, renouncing my life.

data.v: प्राज्ञस्य मूढस्य च जीवितान्ते; प्राणप्रमोक्षोऽन्तकवक्त्रगस्य । अतो विद्वन्नभियास्यामि पार्थं; दिष्टं न शक्यं व्यतिवर्तितुं वै ॥
data.md: A wise man or an ignorant person, none can escape death, when the lease of his life expires. Therefore, O learned one. I shall proceed against Partha. I cannot transgress my destiny.

data.v: कल्याणवृत्तः सततं हि राज;न्वैचित्रवीर्यस्य सुतो ममासीत् । तस्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमहं त्यजामि; प्रियान्भोगान्दुस्त्यजं जीवितं च ॥
data.md: O king, the son of Chitravirya's son always does me good. For the accomplishment of his object I will give up this dear life which it is very difficult to renounce.

data.v: वैयाघ्रचर्माणमकूजनाक्षं; हैमत्रिकोशं रजतत्रिवेणुम् । रथप्रबर्हं तुरगप्रबर्है;र्युक्तं प्रादान्मह्यमिदं हि रामः ॥
data.md: Rama conferred upon me this best of cars covered with tiger-skins, with axle producing no sound, equipped with a golden seat, having trivenu made of silver and drawn by best of horses.

data.v: धनूंषि चित्राणि निरीक्ष्य शल्य; ध्वजं गदां सायकांश्चोग्ररूपान् । असिं च दीप्तं परमायुधं च; शङ्खं च शुभ्रं स्वनवन्तमुग्रम् ॥
data.md: Behold, O Shalya, these beautiful bows, these, flags, these maces, these dreadful arrows, this shinning sword, this powerful weapon this white conch of dreadful and loud blare.

data.v: पताकिनं वज्रनिपातनिस्वनं; सिताश्वयुक्तं शुभतूणशोभितम् । इमं समास्थाय रथं रथर्षभं; रणे हनिष्याम्यहमर्जुनं बलात् ॥
data.md: Mounted upon this chariot with banners, its wheels producing a sound like that of a thunderbolt drawn by white horses and adorned with beautiful quivers I shall, with all my mighty, destroy that best of car-warriors, Arjuna.

data.v: तं चेन्मृत्युः सर्वहरोऽभिरक्षते; सदाप्रमत्तः समरे पाण्डुपुत्रम् । तं वा हनिष्यामि समेत्य युद्धे; यास्यामि वा भीष्ममुखो यमाय ॥
data.md: Even if death himself the destroyer of all, protects vigilantly the son of Pandu, in battle I will either kill him or go myself to the abode of death following Bhishma.

data.v: यमवरुणकुबेरवासवा वा; यदि युगपत्सगणा महाहवे । जुगुपिषव इहैत्य पाण्डवं; किमु बहुना सह तैर्जयामि तम् ॥
data.md: If Yama, Varuna, Kubera and Vasava with all their followers come here and unitedly protect the son of Pandu in battle, I will even then defeat himn with them all. What is the use of speaking more?

data.v: इति रणरभसस्य कत्थत;स्तदुपनिशम्य वचः स मद्रराट् । अवहसदवमन्य वीर्यवा;न्प्रतिषिषिधे च जगाद चोत्तरम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Hearing those words of Karna who was delighted at the prospect of the battle, the powerful king of Madras laughed him and said the following to check him.

data.v: विरम विरम कर्ण कत्थना;दतिरभसोऽस्यति चाप्ययुक्तवाक् । क्व च हि नरवरो धनंजयः; क्व पुनरिह त्वमुपारमाबुध ॥
यदुसदनमुपेन्द्रपालितं; त्रिदिवमिवामरराजरक्षितम् । प्रसभमिह विलोक्य को हरे;त्पुरुषवरावरजामृतेऽर्जुनात् ॥
data.md: Who else save him the foremost of men (Arjuna) could carry away by force the younger sister of Keshava, having made a confusion in the capital of Yadus that was protected by the younger brother of Indra and that resembled the celestial region protected by the king of gods.

data.v: त्रिभुवनसृजमीश्वरेश्वरं; क इह पुमान्भवमाह्वयेद्युधि । मृगवधकलहे ऋतेऽर्जुना;त्सुरपतिवीर्यसमप्रभावतः ॥
data.md: Who else save, Arjuna, powerful like the king of gods, could on the occasion of a quarrel brought about by the slaughter of an animal summon Bhaba, the lord of lords, the creator of the worlds, to battle?

data.v: असुरसुरमहोरगान्नरा;न्गरुडपिशाचसयक्षराक्षसान् । इषुभिरजयदग्निगौरवा;त्स्वभिलषितं च हविर्ददौ जयः ॥
data.md: To honor the god of fire Jaya, (Arjuna) vanquished the Asuras, gods, great snakes, men, birds, Pishacas, Yakshas and Rakshasas with his arrow and gave him the food he wanted.

data.v: स्मरसि ननु यदा परैर्हृतः; स च धृतराष्ट्रसुतो विमोक्षितः । दिनकरज नरोत्तमैर्यदा; मरुषु बहून्विनिहत्य तानरीन् ॥
data.md: Do you remember, O Karna, the occasion when killing the large nuinber of enemies with this arrows effulgent like the sun Arjuna liberated the son of Dhritarashtra himself among the Kurus?

data.v: प्रथममपि पलायिते त्वयि; प्रियकलहा धृतराष्ट्रसूनवः । स्मरसि ननु यदा प्रमोचिताः; खचरगणानवजित्य पाण्डवैः ॥
data.md: Do you remember the occasion when you yourself were the first to take to your heels and the Pandavas, having defeated the Gandharvas headed by Chitraratha, liberated the quarrelsome sons of Dhritarashtra?

data.v: समुदितबलवाहनाः पुनः; पुरुषवरेण जिताः स्थ गोग्रहे । सगुरुगुरुसुताः सभीष्मकाः; किमु न जितः स तदा त्वयार्जुनः ॥
data.md: When Virata's kine were seized by them, the Kauravas, overwhelining in number both as regards men and animals and having the preceptor, the preceptor's son and Bhishma amongst them, were defeated by that foremost of men. Why did you not defeat Arjuna then?

data.v: इदमपरमुपस्थितं पुन;स्तव निधनाय सुयुद्धमद्य वै । यदि न रिपुभयात्पलायसे; समरगतोऽद्य हतोऽसि सूतज ॥
data.md: Another battle has presented itself today for your destruction. If you do not fly from the battle in fear of your enemies you will be killed, O charioteer's son, as soon as you will go to the battle.

data.v: इति बहुपरुषं प्रभाषति; प्रमनसि मद्रपतौ रिपुस्तवम् । भृशमतिरुषितः परं वृषः; कुरुपृतनापतिराह मद्रपम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said When the king of Madra was thus, in all sincerity, addressing these harsh words to him and singing the glories of his enemy, that slayer of foes, the commander of the Kuru army, excited with anger, said.

data.v: भवतु भवतु किं विकत्थसे; ननु मम तस्य च युद्धमुद्यतम् । यदि स जयति मां महाहवे; तत इदमस्तु सुकत्थितं तव ॥
data.md: Karna said Let it be so. Why do you praise Arjuna so much. A battle will soon take place between him and me. If he defeats me in battle then your praises will be considered as well said.

data.v: एवमस्त्विति मद्रेश उक्त्वा नोत्तरमुक्तवान् । याहि मद्रेश चाप्येनं कर्णः प्राह युयुत्सया ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said The king of Madra said-'let it be so,' and gave no reply, when Karna desirous of fighting, said to Shalya 'go'. Then that carwarrior, having white horses and Shalya as his driver, dashed against his enemies killing a number of enemies in battle like the sun destroying darkness.

data.v: स रथः प्रययौ शत्रूञ्श्वेताश्वः शल्यसारथिः । निघ्नन्नमित्रान्समरे तमो घ्नन्सविता यथा ॥
ततः प्रायात्प्रीतिमान्वै रथेन; वैयाघ्रेण श्वेतयुजाथ कर्णः । स चालोक्य ध्वजिनीं पाण्डवानां; धनंजयं त्वरया पर्यपृच्छत् ॥
data.md: Then in that car covered with tiger-skins and white horses yoked to it, Karna went on cheerfully. And seeing the armies of the Pandavas he immediately inquired after Arjuna.

data.v: प्रयानेव तदा कर्णो हर्षयन्वाहिनीं तव । एकैकं समरे दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवं पर्यपृच्छत ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said After Karna, gladdening your army, had started for battle he addressed to every Pandava soldier he met with these harsh words.

data.v: यो ममाद्य महात्मानं दर्शयेच्छ्वेतवाहनम् । तस्मै दद्यामभिप्रेतं वरं यं मनसेच्छति ॥
data.md: I shall give him whatever riches he will want who will point out to me today the highsouled (Arjuna) of white horses.

data.v: स चेत्तदभिमन्येत तस्मै दद्यामहं पुनः । शकटं रत्नसंपूर्णं यो मे ब्रूयाद्धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: I shall further more confer upon him, if he is not satisfied, a cart-load of jewels who will tell me where Dhananjaya is.

data.v: स चेत्तदभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान् । अन्यं तस्मै पुनर्दद्यां सौवर्णं हस्तिषड्गवम् ॥
data.md: If the person who will point out Arjuna be not contented with it, I shall give him a hundred kine with an equal number of brass vessels for milching them.

data.v: तथा तस्मै पुनर्दद्यां स्त्रीणां शतमलंकृतम् । श्यामानां निष्ककण्ठीनां गीतवाद्यविपश्चिताम् ॥
data.md: If the person, who will point out Arjuna, be not contented with it I shall give him another best of cars made of gold and drawn by six bulls as large as elephants. I shall furthermore confer upon him one hundred well-adorned females wearing golden necklaces, fair and accomplished in singing and dancing.

data.v: स चेत्तदभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान् । अन्यं तस्मै वरं दद्यां श्वेतान्पञ्चशतान्हयान् ॥
data.md: If the person, who will find out Arjuna for me, be not satisfied with it i shall give him a more valuable present, namely five hundred horses-with gold trappings and jewelled ornaments.

data.v: हेमभाण्डपरिच्छन्नान्सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डलान् । सुदान्तानपि चैवाहं दद्यामष्टशतान्परान् ॥
रथं च शुभ्रं सौवर्णं दद्यां तस्मै स्वलंकृतम् । युक्तं परमकाम्बोजैर्यो मे ब्रूयाद्धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: I shall also give him eighteen other tame horses. I shall give him, who will point out Arjuna to me, a golden car adorned with various ornaments and drawn by best Kamboja horses.

data.v: अन्यं तस्मै वरं दद्यां कुञ्जराणां शतानि षट् । काञ्चनैर्विविधैर्भाण्डैराच्छन्नान्हेममालिनः । उत्पन्नानपरान्तेषु विनीतान्हस्तिशिक्षकैः ॥
data.md: If the person showing Arjuna to me considers it again inchoate reward, I will give him some more precious wealth. I will offer him six hundred elephants decorated with different gold ornaments and garlands who have born in the western border of India and suffice training given by the expert Mahavatas.

data.v: स चेत्तदभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान् । अन्यं तस्मै वरं दद्यां यमसौ कामयेत्स्वयम् ॥
data.md: If the person who will point out Arjuna be not contented with it, I shall give him a hundred kine with an equal number of brass vessels for milching them.

data.v: पुत्रदारान्विहारांश्च यदन्यद्वित्तमस्ति मे । तच्च तस्मै पुनर्दद्यां यद्यत्स मनसेच्छति ॥
data.md: I will give him all that wished by him and had in my possession whether wife, son, the garden and parks including clubs and whatever is with me in term of wealth and prosperity.

data.v: हत्वा च सहितौ कृष्णौ तयोर्वित्तानि सर्वशः । तस्मै दद्यामहं यो मे प्रब्रूयात्केशवार्जुनौ ॥
data.md: I shall give him who will find out Keshava and Arjuna all the riches that will be left by them after slaying these two.

data.v: एता वाचः सुबहुशः कर्ण उच्चारयन्युधि । दध्मौ सागरसंभूतं सुस्वनं शङ्खमुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: Having expressed himself thus in the battle Karna blew his excellent conch sea-born and making sweet blare.

data.v: ता वाचः सूतपुत्रस्य तथा युक्ता निशम्य तु । दुर्योधनो महाराज प्रहृष्टः सानुगोऽभवत् ॥
data.md: Hearing the words of the charioteer's son, which seemed proper to him, the great king Duryodhana, with all his followers, became filled with delight.

data.v: ततो दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषो मृदङ्गानां च सर्वशः । सिंहनादः सवादित्रः कुञ्जराणां च निस्वनः ॥
data.md: Then there arose in the midst of the army, O king, O foremost, of men, the beat of cymbals and druirs, leonine roars of the elephants and the sounds of the various musical instruments as well as war-cries of the heroes filled with joy.

data.v: प्रादुरासीत्तदा राजंस्त्वत्सैन्ये भरतर्षभ । योधानां संप्रहृष्टानां तथा समभवत्स्वनः ॥
तथा प्रहृष्टे सैन्ये तु प्लवमानं महारथम् । विकत्थमानं समरे राधेयमरिकर्शनम् । मद्रराजः प्रहस्येदं वचनं प्रत्यभाषत ॥
data.md: When the Kuru ariny was thus filled with joy the king of Madra said in derision the following words to the subduer of foes, the son of Radha, the powerful car-warrior who was thus bragging and about to plunge himself into that ocean of battle.

data.v: मा सूतपुत्र मानेन सौवर्णं हस्तिषड्गवम् । प्रयच्छ पुरुषायाद्य द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: Shalya said O son of a charioteer, give away to any man a golden car with six bulls as large as the elephants you will see Dhananjaya today.

data.v: बाल्यादिव त्वं त्यजसि वसु वैश्रवणो यथा । अयत्नेनैव राधेय द्रष्टास्यद्य धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: Foolishly you are giving away your wealth as if you are Vaisravana, the king of riches. Without any trouble, O son of Radha, you will see Dhananjaya today.

data.v: परासृजसि मिथ्या किं किं च त्वं बहु मूढवत् । अपात्रदाने ये दोषास्तान्मोहान्नावबुध्यसे ॥
data.md: You are giving away your riches as if they are nothing like a highly ignorant man. You do not out of ignorance perceive the demerit attached to gifts made to unworthy persons.

data.v: यत्प्रवेदयसे वित्तं बहुत्वेन खलु त्वया । शक्यं बहुविधैर्यज्ञैर्यष्टुं सूत यजस्व तैः ॥
data.md: You may perform many Yajnas with the immense wealth that you are thus distributing. Therefore, O charioteer's son, do you perform Yajnas.

data.v: यच्च प्रार्थयसे हन्तुं कृष्णौ मोहान्मृषैव तत् । न हि शुश्रुम संमर्दे क्रोष्ट्रा सिंहौ निपातितौ ॥
data.md: But vain is the desire that you cherish out of folly, for destroying Krishna and Arjuna. We have never heard of a couple of lions overthrown by a fox.

data.v: अप्रार्थितं प्रार्थयसे सुहृदो न हि सन्ति ते । ये त्वां न वारयन्त्याशु प्रपतन्तं हुताशने ॥
data.md: You seek what you should never do. You have no such friends as will prevent you form immediately falling into fire.

data.v: कालकार्यं न जानीषे कालपक्वोऽस्यसंशयम् । बह्वबद्धमकर्णीयं को हि ब्रूयाज्जिजीविषुः ॥
data.md: You are unable to distinguish between what you should do and should not. Forsooth, the lease of your life has run out. What man, desirous of living, would give vent to such incoherent words unworthy of being listened to.

data.v: समुद्रतरणं दोर्भ्यां कण्ठे बद्ध्वा यथा शिलाम् । गिर्यग्राद्वा निपतनं तादृक्तव चिकीर्षितम् ॥
data.md: This your attempt is like that of a person, who, having tied round his neck a heavy stone, wishes to cross the ocean with his two arms or like that of a man who wishes to leap down from the summit of a mountain.

data.v: सहितः सर्वयोधैस्त्वं व्यूढानीकैः सुरक्षितः । धनंजयेन युध्यस्व श्रेयश्चेत्प्राप्तुमिच्छसि ॥
data.md: If you wish to secure your well-being, fight with Dhananjaya from the division of your own army well protected and aided by your warriors.

data.v: हितार्थं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य ब्रवीमि त्वा न हिंसया । श्रद्धत्स्वैतन्मया प्रोक्तं यदि तेऽस्ति जिजीविषा ॥
data.md: I tell you this for the well-being of Duryodhana and not out of any ill will for you. If you wish to preserve your life obey my words.

data.v: स्ववीर्येऽहं पराश्वस्य प्रार्थयाम्यर्जुनं रणे । त्वं तु मित्रमुखः शत्रुर्मां भीषयितुमिच्छसि ॥
data.md: Karna said Depending on the strength of my own arms I wish to meet Arjuna in battle. You are an enemy with the look of a friend and wish to frighten me.

data.v: न मामस्मादभिप्रायात्कश्चिदद्य निवर्तयेत् । अपीन्द्रो वज्रमुद्यम्य किं नु मर्त्यः करिष्यति ॥
data.md: No one will be able to make me change this resolution, not even Indra taking up his thunderbolt, what to speak of an insignificant mortal?

data.v: इति कर्णस्य वाक्यान्ते शल्यः प्राहोत्तरं वचः । चुकोपयिषुरत्यर्थं कर्णं मद्रेश्वरः पुनः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said After Karna had his say, Shalya the king of Madra, with a view to provoke him greatly, said in reply.

data.v: यदा वै त्वां फल्गुनवेगनुन्ना; ज्याचोदिता हस्तवता विसृष्टाः । अन्वेतारः कङ्कपत्राः शिताग्रा;स्तदा तप्स्यस्यर्जुनस्याभियोगात् ॥
data.md: When keen edged and Kanka feathered arrows, shot off his bow. by the powerful Phalguna with all his energy, will come upon you, you will repent for your encounter with that hero.

data.v: यदा दिव्यं धनुरादाय पार्थः; प्रभासयन्पृतनां सव्यसाची । त्वामर्दयेत निशितैः पृषत्कै;स्तदा पश्चात्तप्स्यसे सूतपुत्र ॥
data.md: When Partha, otherwise called Savyasachin, taking up his celestial bow, will scorch the Kuru army and assail you greatly with his keen edged arrows then O charioteer's son, you will repent for your folly.

data.v: बालश्चन्द्रं मातुरङ्के शयानो; यथा कश्चित्प्रार्थयतेऽपहर्तुम् । तद्वन्मोहाद्यतमानो रथस्थ;स्त्वं प्रार्थयस्यर्जुनमद्य जेतुम् ॥
data.md: Like a child, on mother's lap seeking to catch hold of the sun, you, out of your folly, wish to defect the effulgent Arjuna stationed on his car.

data.v: त्रिशूलमाश्लिष्य सुतीक्ष्णधारं; सर्वाणि गात्राणि निघर्षसि त्वम् । सुतीक्ष्णधारोपमकर्मणा त्वं; युयुत्ससे योऽर्जुनेनाद्य कर्ण ॥
data.md: By desiring to fight, O Karna, today with Arjuna of illustrious feats, you have addressed yourself to rule your body against the keen edges of a trident.

data.v: सिद्धं सिंहं केसरिणं बृहन्तं; बालो मूढः क्षुद्रमृगस्तरस्वी । समाह्वयेत्तद्वदेतत्तवाद्य; समाह्वानं सूतपुत्रार्जुनस्य ॥
data.md: O charioteer's son, your challenge of Arjuna is like that of an over active little deer against a huge angry lion.

data.v: मा सूतपुत्राह्वय राजपुत्रं; महावीर्यं केसरिणं यथैव । वने सृगालः पिशितस्य तृप्तो; मा पार्थमासाद्य विनङ्क्ष्यसि त्वम् ॥
data.md: O charioteer's son, do not challenge that highly energetic prince like a fox, gratified with meat, challenging a lion. Do not be slain by encountering Arjuna.

data.v: ईषादन्तं महानागं प्रभिन्नकरटामुखम् । शशकाह्वयसे युद्धे कर्ण पार्थं धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: O Karna, your challenge of Dhananjaya, the son of Pritha, is like that of a hare challenging a powerful elephant with tusks large as ploughshares and with temporal juice trickling out of its mouth and temples.

data.v: बिलस्थं कृष्णसर्पं त्वं बाल्यात्काष्ठेन विध्यसि । महाविषं पूर्णकोशं यत्पार्थं योद्धुमिच्छसि ॥
data.md: By wishing to fight with Partha you are, out of folly, striking with a piece of wood the black cobra of deadly venom furiously excited within its hole.

data.v: सिंहं केसरिणं क्रुद्धमतिक्रम्याभिनर्दसि । सृगाल इव मूढत्वान्नृसिंहं कर्ण पाण्डवम् ॥
data.md: You are a fool to yell at Arjuna, the best of men, disregarding him like a jackal yelling at an excited lion.

data.v: सुपर्णं पतगश्रेष्ठं वैनतेयं तरस्विनम् । लट्वेवाह्वयसे पाते कर्ण पार्थं धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: As a snake, for its own destruction, encounters the best of birds Garuda, highly active and of beautiful feathers, so do you O Karna, challenge Dhananjaya the son of Pritha.

data.v: सर्वाम्भोनिलयं भीममूर्मिमन्तं झषायुतम् । चन्द्रोदये विवर्तन्तमप्लवः संतितीर्षसि ॥
data.md: You wish to cross, without a raft at the rise of the moon, the ocean, the receptacle of all waters with dreadful huge waves and teeming with aquatic animals.

data.v: ऋषभं दुन्दुभिग्रीवं तीक्ष्णशृङ्गं प्रहारिणम् । वत्स आह्वयसे युद्धे कर्ण पार्थं धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: O Karna, your challenge of Dhananjaya is like that of a calf against a fearful bull of sharpened horns and with a neck thick as a drum.

data.v: महाघोषं महामेघं दर्दुरः प्रतिनर्दसि । कामतोयप्रदं लोके नरपर्जन्यमर्जुनम् ॥
data.md: Your roaring at Arjuna, the deity of clouds among men, like that of frog at a dreadful huge cloud discharging copious showers of rain.

data.v: यथा च स्वगृहस्थः श्वा व्याघ्रं वनगतं भषेत् । तथा त्वं भषसे कर्ण नरव्याघ्रं धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: Like a dog barking from within his master's house at a forest-ranging tiger you bark at Dhananjaya, the foremost of men.

data.v: सृगालोऽपि वने कर्ण शशैः परिवृतो वसन् । मन्यते सिंहमात्मानं यावत्सिंहं न पश्यति ॥
data.md: While living in the forest in the midst of hares a jackal, O Karna, considers himself a lion till he actually sees the latter.

data.v: तथा त्वमपि राधेय सिंहमात्मानमिच्छसि । अपश्यञ्शत्रुदमनं नरव्याघ्रं धनंजयम् ॥
data.md: So do you, O son of Radha, consider yourself a lion for you do not see that subduer of foes, that foremost of men, Dhananjaya.

data.v: व्याघ्रं त्वं मन्यसेऽऽत्मानं यावत्कृष्णौ न पश्यसि । समास्थितावेकरथे सूर्याचन्द्रमसाविव ॥
data.md: You consider yourself a lion for you have not seen Krishna and Arjuna stationed on the same car like the sun and moon.

data.v: यावद्गाण्डीवनिर्घोषं न शृणोषि महाहवे । तावदेव त्वया कर्ण शक्यं वक्तुं यथेच्छसि ॥
data.md: As long as you do not hear the twang of Gandiva in battle, so long you are able to do what you please.

data.v: रथशब्दधनुःशब्दैर्नादयन्तं दिशो दश । नर्दन्तमिव शार्दूलं दृष्ट्वा क्रोष्टा भविष्यसि ॥
data.md: Beholding the ten quarters filled with the sound of his car and the twang of his bow and him roaring like a tiger you will become a jackal.

data.v: नित्यमेव सृगालस्त्वं नित्यं सिंहो धनंजयः । वीरप्रद्वेषणान्मूढ नित्यं क्रोष्टेव लक्ष्यसे ॥
data.md: You are always a jackal and Dhananjaya always a lion. On account of your envy and hatred for heroes, you appear a jackal.

data.v: यथाखुः स्याद्बिडालश्च श्वा व्याघ्रश्च बलाबले । यथा सृगालः सिंहश्च यथा च शशकुञ्जरौ ॥
यथानृतं च सत्यं च यथा चापि विषामृते । तथा त्वमपि पार्थश्च प्रख्यातावात्मकर्मभिः ॥
data.md: As a mouse and a cat are to each other in strength, or a fox and a lion or a hare and an elephant, as falsehood and truth, ambrosia and poison so you and Partha are known to all by your respective deeds.

data.v: अधिक्षिप्तस्तु राधेयः शल्येनामिततेजसा । शल्यमाह सुसंक्रुद्धो वाक्शल्यमवधारयन् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Thus reviled by Shalya of incomparable energy the son of Radha understanding the meaning of the word Shalya by his words said to him in areat anger.

data.v: गुणान्गुणवतः शल्य गुणवान्वेत्ति नागुणः । त्वं तु नित्यं गुणैर्हीनः किं ज्ञास्यस्यगुणो गुणान् ॥
data.md: Karna said O Shalya, the meritorious only appreciate the merits of those who possess them and not one who has none. You are destitute of all merits. How can you understand what is merit and what is demerit.

data.v: अर्जुनस्य महास्त्राणि क्रोधं वीर्यं धनुः शरान् । अहं शल्याभिजानामि न त्वं जानासि तत्तथा ॥
data.md: O Shalya, I know that powerful weapons of Arjuna, his anger, energy, bow, arrows and as well as the prowess of that high-souled one.

data.v: एवमेवात्मनो वीर्यमहं वीर्यं च पाण्डवे । जानन्नेवाह्वये युद्धे शल्य नाग्निं पतंगवत् ॥
data.md: Knowing my own strength as well as that of Pandava I have challenged him in battle, O Shalya, I shall not fall into fire like an insect.

data.v: अस्ति चायमिषुः शल्य सुपुङ्खो रक्तभोजनः । एकतूणीशयः पत्री सुधौतः समलंकृतः ॥
data.md: I have this arrow, O Shalya, keen edged, blood-drinking, occupying alone one quiver, furnished with wings, well-steeped in oil and well-adorned.

data.v: शेते चन्दनपूर्णेन पूजितो बहुलाः समाः । आहेयो विषवानुग्रो नराश्वद्विपसंघहा ॥
data.md: It lies in sandal dust and is being adored by me from a long time. Having the shape and nature of a serpent it is poisonous and dreadful and capable of killing a great many men, horses and elephants.

data.v: एकवीरो महारौद्रस्तनुत्रास्थिविदारणः । निर्भिन्द्यां येन रुष्टोऽहमपि मेरुं महागिरिम् ॥
data.md: Highly dreadful in form it can go through coats of mail and bones. When worked up with anger I can perforate with it even the huge Meru mountain.

data.v: तमहं जातु नास्येयमन्यस्मिन्फल्गुनादृते । कृष्णाद्वा देवकीपुत्रात्सत्यं चात्र शृणुष्व मे ॥
data.md: I will not discharge this arrow at any other person excepting Arjuna or Krishna, the son of Devaki. Listen, I tell you the truth.

data.v: तेनाहमिषुणा शल्य वासुदेवधनंजयौ । योत्स्ये परमसंक्रुद्धस्तत्कर्म सदृशं मम ॥
data.md: Worked up with anger, I shall with that arrow, O Shalya, fight Vasudeva and Dhananjaya. That will be a deed becoming me.

data.v: सर्वेषां वासुदेवानां कृष्णे लक्ष्मीः प्रतिष्ठिता । सर्वेषां पाण्डुपुत्राणां जयः पार्थे प्रतिष्ठितः । उभयं तत्समासाद्य कोऽतिवर्तितुमर्हति ॥
data.md: Of all the heroes of the Vrishni race in Krishna only prosperity exists eternally. Of all the sons of Pandu, Partha is the one who comes off invariable victorious.

data.v: तावेतौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ समेतौ स्यन्दने स्थितौ । मामेकमभिसंयातौ सुजातं शल्य पश्य मे ॥
data.md: Those two foremost of men, seated on the same car, will encounter me single in battle, you will, O Shalya, witness today the nobility of my birth.

data.v: पितृष्वसामातुलजौ भ्रातरावपराजितौ । मणी सूत्र इव प्रोतौ द्रष्टासि निहतौ मया ॥
data.md: You will seen that (With one shaft) I will kill those two cousins, one of whom is the son of the aunt and the other the son of the maternal uncle-those two invincible warriors. They will took like two pearls strung together in the same string

data.v: अर्जुने गाण्डिवं कृष्णे चक्रं तार्क्ष्यकपिध्वजौ । भीरूणां त्रासजननौ शल्य हर्षकरौ मम ॥
data.md: The Gandiva of Arjuna, the discus of Krishna and their two banners having the emblems of a monkey and Garuda strike terror into the timid. But they are sources of delight to me.

data.v: त्वं तु दुष्प्रकृतिर्मूढो महायुद्धेष्वकोविदः । भयावतीर्णः संत्रासादबद्धं बहु भाषसे ॥
data.md: You are a fool, a bad character and do not know the mode of a true war-fare. Possessed by fear you are giving vent to these ravings.

data.v: संस्तौषि त्वं तु केनापि हेतुना तौ कुदेशज । तौ हत्वा समरे हन्ता त्वामद्धा सहबान्धवम् ॥
data.md: Born in a sinful country you are wicked, mean and a wrath of a Kshatriya or you are praising them for something which is not known to me. Having killed those two first I shall kill you today with all your relatives.

data.v: पापदेशज दुर्बुद्धे क्षुद्र क्षत्रियपांसन । सुहृद्भूत्वा रिपुः किं मां कृष्णाभ्यां भीषयन्नसि ॥
तौ वा ममाद्य हन्तारौ हन्तास्मि समरे स्थितौ । नाहं बिभेमि कृष्णाभ्यां विजानन्नात्मनो बलम् ॥
वासुदेवसहस्रं वा फल्गुनानां शतानि च । अहमेको हनिष्यामि जोषमास्स्व कुदेशज ॥
data.md: I know my strength well and I do not fear the two Krishnas. I will kill single handed a thousand Vasudevas and hundreds of Phalgunas. Hold your tongue. O you born in a sinful country.

data.v: स्त्रियो बालाश्च वृद्धाश्च प्रायः क्रीडागता जनाः । या गाथाः संप्रगायन्ति कुर्वन्तोऽध्ययनं यथा । ता गाथाः शृणु मे शल्य मद्रकेषु दुरात्मसु ॥
data.md: Hear from me, O Shalya, the sayings that have already passed into proverbs, that men young and old and women, persons while sporting utter as if they are their studies about the wicked Madrakas. the Brahmanas also recounted them formerly in the courts of kings. Hearing them, O fool, you may forgive or give a reply.

data.v: ब्राह्मणैः कथिताः पूर्वं यथावद्राजसंनिधौ । श्रुत्वा चैकमना मूढ क्षम वा ब्रूहि वोत्तरम् ॥
मित्रध्रुङ्मद्रको नित्यं यो नो द्वेष्टि स मद्रकः । मद्रके संगतं नास्ति क्षुद्रवाक्ये नराधमे ॥
data.md: Madraka is always a hater of friends. He who hates us is a Madraka. There is no good feeling in a Madraka who is the vilest of men and gives vent to mean words.

data.v: दुरात्मा मद्रको नित्यं नित्यं चानृतिकोऽनृजुः । यावदन्तं हि दौरात्म्यं मद्रकेष्विति नः श्रुतम् ॥
data.md: The Madraka is always wicked, untruthful and crooked. We have heard that the Madrakas are wicked till the hour of their death.

data.v: पिता माता च पुत्रश्च श्वश्रूश्वशुरमातुलाः । जामाता दुहिता भ्राता नप्ता ते ते च बान्धवाः ॥
