data.v: अपरे प्राद्रवन्नागाः शल्यार्ता व्रणपीडिताः । प्रतिमानैश्च कुम्भैश्च पेतुरुर्व्यां महाहवे ॥
data.md: Others, afflicted with arrows and much pained by the wound, fell down on the earth in that dreadful encounter with their frontal globes or the parts between their tusks.

data.v: निषेदुः सिंहवच्चान्ये नदन्तो भैरवान्रवान् । मम्लुश्च बहवो राजंश्चुकूजुश्चापरे तथा ॥
data.md: Others roared like lions. And many emitting terrible sounds ran hither and thither and many, O king, uttered cries of pain.

data.v: हयाश्च निहता बाणैः स्वर्णभाण्डपरिच्छदाः । निषेदुश्चैव मम्लुश्च बभ्रमुश्च दिशो दश ॥
data.md: Horses, adorned with golden trappings, kills by arrows, fell down or became weak or ran in all directions.

data.v: अपरे कृष्यमाणाश्च विवेष्टन्तो महीतले । भावान्बहुविधांश्चक्रुस्ताडिताः शरतोमरैः ॥
data.md: Others, wounded with arrows or dragged, fell down on the earth making diverse kinds of motion in agony.

data.v: नरास्तु निहता भूमौ कूजन्तस्तत्र मारिष । दृष्ट्वा च बान्धवानन्ये पितॄनन्ये पितामहान् ॥
data.md: Men also slain fell down on the earth uttering many cries. Many beholding their relatives, fathers, grand-fathers, while others, seeing their retreating enemies called one another by their own and their family names.

data.v: धावमानान्परांश्चैव दृष्ट्वान्ये तत्र भारत । गोत्रनामानि ख्यातानि शशंसुरितरेतरम् ॥
तेषां छिन्ना महाराज भुजाः कनकभूषणाः । उद्वेष्टन्ते विवेष्टन्ते पतन्ते चोत्पतन्ति च ॥
data.md: Cut-off by enemies, the arms of many warriors adorned with golden ornaments fell down on the earth and writhed in agony.

data.v: निपतन्ति तथा भूमौ स्फुरन्ति च सहस्रशः । वेगांश्चान्ये रणे चक्रुः स्फुरन्त इव पन्नगाः ॥
data.md: Thousands of such arms fell down on the earth and sprang up and many seemed to dart forward like five-headed snakes.

data.v: ते भुजा भोगिभोगाभाश्चन्दनाक्ता विशां पते । लोहितार्द्रा भृशं रेजुस्तपनीयध्वजा इव ॥
data.md: O king, those arms, resembling the bodies of serpents, pasted with gold and besmeared with blood, appeared like little mountains.

data.v: वर्तमाने तथा घोरे संकुले सर्वतोदिशम् । अविज्ञाताः स्म युध्यन्ते विनिघ्नन्तः परस्परम् ॥
data.md: When such a dreadful battle raged on all sides, people not know themselves killed one another.

data.v: भौमेन रजसा कीर्णे शस्त्रसंपातसंकुले । नैव स्वे न परे राजन्व्यज्ञायन्त तमोवृते ॥
data.md: When everything was covered with dust raised by the weapons, they, O king, could not recognise who were their own and who were their enemies.

data.v: तथा तदभवद्युद्धं घोररूपं भयानकम् । शोणितोदा महानद्यः प्रसस्रुस्तत्र चासकृत् ॥
data.md: Then there took place a dreadful encounter and there flew a river of blood striking terror unto all.

data.v: शीर्षपाषाणसंछन्नाः केशशैवलशाद्वलाः । अस्थिसंघातसंकीर्णा धनुःशरवरोत्तमाः ॥
data.md: It was filled with heads forming the rocks. The hairs of the warriors formed the floating weeds and mosses. Bones formed the fishes; and bows, arrows and maces formed the rafts by which to cross them.

data.v: मांसकर्दमपङ्काश्च शोणितौघाः सुदारुणाः । नदीः प्रवर्तयामासुर्यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनीः ॥
data.md: Flesh and blood formed their mire. Thus dreadful and terrible rivers, with currents swelled by blood, were formed there.

data.v: ता नद्यो घोररूपाश्च नयन्त्यो यमसादनम् । अवगाढा मज्जयन्त्यः क्षत्रस्याजनयन्भयम् ॥
क्रव्यादानां नरव्याघ्र नर्दतां तत्र तत्र ह । घोरमायोधनं जज्ञे प्रेतराजपुरोपमम् ॥
data.md: And many plunged into those rivers striking terror unto the Kshatriyas and dies. O best of men, on account of many carnivorous animals emitting yells on all sides the battle-field became terrible, like the territory of the Regent of the Dead.

data.v: उत्थितान्यगणेयानि कबन्धानि समन्ततः । नृत्यन्ति वै भूतगणाः संतृप्ता मांसशोणितैः ॥
data.md: And innumerable, headless trunks rose on all sides. And many terrible creatures eating flesh and drinking blood and fat began to dance around.

data.v: पीत्वा च शोणितं तत्र वसां पीत्वा च भारत । मेदोमज्जावसातृप्तास्तृप्ता मांसस्य चैव हि । धावमानाश्च दृश्यन्ते काकगृध्रबलास्तथा ॥
data.md: And gratified with fat, marrow and flesh crows, vultures and cranes were seen to move about in delight.

data.v: शूरास्तु समरे राजन्भयं त्यक्त्वा सुदुस्त्यजम् । योधव्रतसमाख्याताश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत् ॥
data.md: The heroes, however, O king, shaking off fear and observing the warrior's warrior's vow, fearlessly did their duty.

data.v: शरशक्तिसमाकीर्णे क्रव्यादगणसंकुले । व्यचरन्त गणैः शूराः ख्यापयन्तः स्वपौरुषम् ॥
data.md: On that field where innumerable arrows and darts passed through the air and where various carnivorous animals in large number and the brave warriors armed moved about displaying their powers.

data.v: अन्योन्यं श्रावयन्ति स्म नामगोत्राणि भारत । पितृनामानि च रणे गोत्रनामानि चाभितः ॥
data.md: They called out one another by their own and family names. And many taking the names of their fathers and families began to assail one another with darts, lances and battle axes.

data.v: श्रावयन्तो हि बहवस्तत्र योधा विशां पते । अन्योन्यमवमृद्नन्तः शक्तितोमरपट्टिशैः ॥
data.md: They called out one another by their own and family names. And many taking the names of their fathers and families began to assail one another with darts, lances and battle axes.

data.v: वर्तमाने तदा युद्धे घोररूपे सुदारुणे । व्यषीदत्कौरवी सेना भिन्ना नौरिव सागरे ॥
data.md: In that-onset the Kuru army became divested of its strength and unable to stand any longer like a ship foundered on the bosom of the ocean.

data.v: वर्तमाने तदा युद्धे क्षत्रियाणां निमज्जने । गाण्डीवस्य महान्घोषः शुश्रुवे युधि मारिष ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said While that war, destructive of the Kshatriyas, raged on, the dreadful twang of the Gandiva bow was heard, O Sire.

data.v: संशप्तकानां कदनमकरोद्यत्र पाण्डवः । कोसलानां तथा राजन्नारायणबलस्य च ॥
data.md: O king, there the son of Pandu brought about the destruction of the Samsaptakas, the Kosalas and the army of Narayana.

data.v: संशप्तकास्तु समरे शरवृष्टिं समन्ततः । अपातयन्पार्थमूर्ध्नि जयगृद्धाः प्रमन्यवः ॥
data.md: The Samsaptakas too, desirous of acquiring victory and worked up with rage, made a downpour of their arrows from all sides on the head of Partha.

data.v: तां वृष्टिं सहसा राजंस्तरसा धारयन्प्रभुः । व्यगाहत रणे पार्थो विनिघ्नन्रथिनां वरः ॥
data.md: That shower of arrows, O king, the powerful Arjuna soon checked and plunging into battle destroyed many leading carwarriors.

data.v: निगृह्य तु रथानीकं कङ्कपत्रैः शिलाशितैः । आससाद रणे पार्थः सुशर्माणं महारथम् ॥
data.md: Having assailed the car-warriors with Kanka-feathered and sharp arrows, Partha approached the mighty car-warrior, Susharma.

data.v: स तस्य शरवर्षाणि ववर्ष रथिनां वरः । तथा संशप्तकाश्चैव पार्थस्य समरे स्थिताः ॥
data.md: That foremost of car-Warriors made a downpour of arrows and the Samsaptakas too covered Partha with their shafts.

data.v: सुशर्मा तु ततः पार्थं विद्ध्वा नवभिराशुगैः । जनार्दनं त्रिभिर्बाणैरभ्यहन्दक्षिणे भुजे । ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन केतुं विव्याध मारिष ॥
data.md: Thereupon, Susharma having pierced Partha with ten quick-coursing arrows struck Janardana on his right arm with three arrows.

data.v: स वानरवरो राजन्विश्वकर्मकृतो महान् । ननाद सुमहन्नादं भीषयन्वै ननर्द च ॥
data.md: Then with another Bhalla he struck down his standard. That huge monkey, created by Vishvakarma, O king, being terrified emitted a tremendous roar.

data.v: कपेस्तु निनदं श्रुत्वा संत्रस्ता तव वाहिनी । भयं विपुलमादाय निश्चेष्टा समपद्यत ॥
data.md: Hearing the roar of the monkey, your army was agitated. And possessed by terrible fear they became inactive.

data.v: ततः सा शुशुभे सेना निश्चेष्टावस्थिता नृप । नानापुष्पसमाकीर्णं यथा चैत्ररथं वनम् ॥
data.md: Becoming inactive, O king, that army looked like the garden of Chitraratha filled with various flowers.

data.v: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां योधास्ते कुरुसत्तम । अर्जुनं सिषिचुर्बाणैः पर्वतं जलदा इव । परिवव्रुस्तदा सर्वे पाण्डवस्य महारथम् ॥
data.md: Then regaining their consciousness, O foremost of Kurus, your soldiers made a downpour of arrows on Arjuna like clouds on a mountain.

data.v: ते हयान्रथचक्रे च रथेषाश्चापि भारत । निगृह्य बलवत्तूर्णं सिंहनादमथानदन् ॥
अपरे जगृहुश्चैव केशवस्य महाभुजौ । पार्थमन्ये महाराज रथस्थं जगृहुर्मुदा ॥
data.md: O sire, Some among them seized the long arins of Kesava and others seized Arjuna who was on his car.

data.v: केशवस्तु तदा बाहू विधुन्वन्रणमूर्धनि । पातयामास तान्सर्वान्दुष्टहस्तीव हस्तिनः ॥
data.md: Then shaking his arms on the field of battle Keshava struck down all of them like an elephant assailing other leading elephants.

data.v: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे पार्थः संवृतस्तैर्महारथैः । निगृहीतं रथं दृष्ट्वा केशवं चाप्यभिद्रुतम् । रथारूढांश्च सुबहून्पदातींश्चाप्यपातयत् ॥
data.md: Surrounded by those mighty car-warriors and beholding his car assailed and thus Keshava attacked, Partha, boiling with rage, overthrew a large number of car-warriors and foot-soldiers.

data.v: आसन्नांश्च ततो योधाञ्शरैरासन्नयोधिभिः । च्यावयामास समरे केशवं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: He pushed down a number of infantry soldiers rode on his chariot while fighting, covered all Samsaptaka warriors stood nearby through volley of arrows useful for proxy war and said with vigour to lord Krishna in the battle-field.

data.v: पश्य कृष्ण महाबाहो संशप्तकगणान्मया । कुर्वाणान्दारुणं कर्म वध्यमानान्सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: “Behold, O Krishna, O you of long arms, those numberless Samsaptakas, bent upon a dreadful feat, are killed by thousands.

data.v: रथबन्धमिमं घोरं पृथिव्यां नास्ति कश्चन । यः सहेत पुमाँल्लोके मदन्यो यदुपुंगव ॥
data.md: O foremost of Yadus, there is none on earth, save myself who is capable of bearing such a close attack on his car."

data.v: इत्येवमुक्त्वा बीभत्सुर्देवदत्तमथाधमत् । पाञ्चजन्यं च कृष्णोऽपि पूरयन्निव रोदसी ॥
data.md: Having said this Vibhatsu blew his Devadatta conch and Krishna his Panchajanya filling the earth and sky with the blare.

data.v: तं तु शङ्खस्वनं श्रुत्वा संशप्तकवरूथिनी । संचचाल महाराज वित्रस्ता चाभवद्भृशम् ॥
data.md: Hearing that sound the army of the Samsaptakas began to tremble and were filled with fear.

data.v: पदबन्धं ततश्चक्रे पाण्डवः परवीरहा । नागमस्त्रं महाराज संप्रोदीर्य मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
data.md: O monarch, then repeatedly invoking the Naga weapon, Paridava, the slayers of hostile horses, tied down their legs.

data.v: यानुद्दिश्य रणे पार्थः पदबन्धं चकार ह । ते बद्धाः पदबन्धेन पाण्डवेन महात्मना । निश्चेष्टा अभवन्राजन्नश्मसारमया इव ॥
data.md: When they were thus bound down by the high-souled son of Pandu, O king, they became inactive like horses and dogs.

data.v: निश्चेष्टांस्तु ततो योधानवधीत्पाण्डुनन्दनः । यथेन्द्रः समरे दैत्यांस्तारकस्य वधे पुरा ॥
data.md: Then the son of Pandu began to slay all those inactive warriors as Indra killed the Asuras in the days of yore in his encounter with Taraka.

data.v: ते वध्यमानाः समरे मुमुचुस्तं रथोत्तमम् । आयुधानि च सर्वाणि विस्रष्टुमुपचक्रमुः ॥
data.md: They, thus being slaughtered in battle, began to leave the best of cars and throw off all their weapons.

data.v: ततः सुशर्मा राजेन्द्र गृहीतां वीक्ष्य वाहिनीम् । सौपर्णमस्त्रं त्वरितः प्रादुश्चक्रे महारथः ॥
data.md: Then beholding his army thus bound down, O king, the might car-warrior Susharma speedily invoked his Sauparna weapon.

data.v: ततः सुपर्णाः संपेतुर्भक्षयन्तो भुजंगमान् । ते वै विदुद्रुवुर्नागा दृष्ट्वा तान्खचरान्नृप ॥
data.md: Then numerous vultures began to come down and devour snakes. Then, O king, beholding those birds the serpents began to fly away.

data.v: बभौ बलं तद्विमुक्तं पदबन्धाद्विशां पते । मेघवृन्दाद्यथा मुक्तो भास्करस्तापयन्प्रजाः ॥
data.md: Freed from that foot-trapping weapon the Samsaptakas, O monarch, looked like the sun giving rays unto all creatures when freed from clouds.

data.v: विप्रमुक्तास्तु ते योधाः फल्गुनस्य रथं प्रति । ससृजुर्बाणसंघांश्च शस्त्रसंघांश्च मारिष ॥
data.md: Thus freed, the warriors once more discharged their arrows and weapons at Arjuna's car. And all of them pierced Partha with numerous weapons

data.v: तां महास्त्रमयीं वृष्टिं संछिद्य शरवृष्टिभिः । व्यवातिष्ठत्ततो योधान्वासविः परवीरहा ॥
data.md: Cutting off with his own arrows the brightly weapons showered on him, Vasava's son, the slayer of hostile heroes, began to kill those warriors.

data.v: सुशर्मा तु ततो राजन्बाणेनानतपर्वणा । अर्जुनं हृदये विद्ध्वा विव्याधान्यैस्त्रिभिः शरैः । स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ॥
data.md: Thereupon Susharma, O king, struck Arjuna to his very vitals with arrows and three weapons.

data.v: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः । ऐन्द्रमस्त्रममेयात्मा प्रादुश्चक्रे त्वरान्वितः । ततो बाणसहस्राणि समुत्पन्नानि मारिष ॥
data.md: Then regaining his consciousness the highly energetic Arjuna of white steeds and with Krishna for his charioteer, quickly discharged the Aindra weapon.

data.v: सर्वदिक्षु व्यदृश्यन्त सूदयन्तो नृप द्विपान् । हयान्रथांश्च समरे शस्त्रैः शतसहस्रशः ॥
वध्यमाने ततः सैन्ये विपुला भीः समाविशत् । संशप्तकगणानां च गोपालानां च भारत । न हि कश्चित्पुमांस्तत्र योऽर्जुनं प्रत्ययुध्यत ॥
पश्यतां तत्र वीराणामहन्यत महद्बलम् । हन्यमानमपश्यंश्च निश्चेष्टाः स्म पराक्रमे ॥
अयुतं तत्र योधानां हत्वा पाण्डुसुतो रणे । व्यभ्राजत रणे राजन्विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन् ॥
data.md: Beholding that slaughter all of them were petrified and could not display their prowess. Having killed ten thousand warriors in that battle the son of Pandu shone like the blazing fire without smoke.

data.v: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि यानि शिष्टानि भारत । रथानामयुतं चैव त्रिसाहस्राश्च दन्तिनः ॥
data.md: O Bharata! there remained living as much as fourteen thousand infantry soldiers, ten thousand chariot riders and three thousand elephants with Samsaptakas (Kauravas) till then.

data.v: ततः संशप्तका भूयः परिवव्रुर्धनंजयम् । मर्तव्यमिति निश्चित्य जयं वापि निवर्तनम् ॥
data.md: Then the Samsaptakas surrounded Dhananjaya determined upon either gaining victory or meeting with death.

data.v: तत्र युद्धं महद्ध्यासीत्तावकानां विशां पते । शूरेण बलिना सार्धं पाण्डवेन किरीटिना ॥
data.md: Then there took place a dreadful encounter between your army, O king and the heroic, diadem-decked son of Pandu.

data.v: कृतवर्मा कृपो द्रौणिः सूतपुत्रश्च मारिष । उलूकः सौबलश्चैव राजा च सह सोदरैः ॥
सीदमानां चमूं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुपुत्रभयार्दिताम् । समुज्जिहीर्षुर्वेगेन भिन्नां नावमिवार्णवे ॥
ततो युद्धमतीवासीन्मुहूर्तमिव भारत । भीरूणां त्रासजननं शूराणां हर्षवर्धनम् ॥
data.md: Then there took place an encounter for the time being capable of striking terror unto the timid and increasing the delight of the heroes.

data.v: कृपेण शरवर्षाणि विप्रमुक्तानि संयुगे । सृञ्जयाः शातयामासुः शलभानां व्रजा इव ॥
data.md: The downpour of arrows made by Kripa in the battle covered the Srinjayas like a swarm of locusts.

data.v: शिखण्डी तु ततः क्रुद्धो गौतमं त्वरितो ययौ । ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि समन्तादेव ब्राह्मणे ॥
data.md: Thereupon Shikhandin, worked up with anger, speedily approached the son of Gautaina and discharged a shower of arrows upon that best of men.

data.v: कृपस्तु शरवर्षं तद्विनिहत्य महास्त्रवित् । शिखण्डिनं रणे क्रुद्धो विव्याध दशभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: And checking that downpour of arrows Kripa, conversant with the use of mighty weapons and filled with anger, struck in that encounter Shikhandin with ten arrows.

data.v: ततः शिखण्डी कुपीतः शरैः सप्तभिराहवे । कृपं विव्याध सुभृशं कङ्कपत्रैरजिह्मगैः ॥
data.md: Then Shikhandin, worked up with anger, pierced Kripa and seven straight Kankafeathered arrows.

data.v: ततः कृपः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सोऽतिविद्धो महारथः । व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे पार्षतं तु द्विजोत्तमः ॥
data.md: Then the Brahmana Kripa, a mighty carwarrior, piercing heavily with sharp arrows, deprived Shikhandin of his horses, charioteer and car.

data.v: हताश्वात्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य महारथः । चर्मखड्गे च संगृह्य सत्वरं ब्राह्मणं ययौ ॥
data.md: Then jumping down from the car, the heroes of which were slain, the mighty carwarrior speedily took up his sword and armour and approached the Brahmana.

data.v: तमापतन्तं सहसा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः । छादयामास समरे तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम शिलानां प्लवनं यथा । निश्चेष्टो यद्रणे राजञ्शिखण्डी समतिष्ठत ॥
data.md: Then he covered him suddenly who was approaching with straight arrows. This was indeed wonderful. We then, O king, beheld a wonderful spectacle like the flying of rocks. And Shikhandin remained inactive in that battle.

data.v: कृपेण छादितं दृष्ट्वा नृपोत्तम शिखण्डिनम् । प्रत्युद्ययौ कृपं तूर्णं धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः ॥
data.md: Beholding Shikhandin covered with arrows by Kripa, O foremost of kings, the mighty carwarrior Dhristadyumna speedily approached him.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नं ततो यान्तं शारद्वतरथं प्रति । प्रतिजग्राह वेगेन कृतवर्मा महारथः ॥
data.md: Thereupon the mighty car-warrior Kritavarma vehemently resisted Dhristadyumna who was advancing towards the son of Sharadvata.

data.v: युधिष्ठिरमथायान्तं शारद्वतरथं प्रति । सपुत्रं सहसेनं च द्रोणपुत्रो न्यवारयत् ॥
data.md: Drona's son then resisted Yudhishthira who was advancing with his own son and arms against the son of Sharadvata.

data.v: नकुलं सहदेवं च त्वरमाणौ महारथौ । प्रतिजग्राह ते पुत्रः शरवर्षेण वारयन् ॥
data.md: Your son then impeded with a downpour of arrows the approach of the two car-warriors Nakula and Sahadeva.

data.v: भीमसेनं करूषांश्च केकयान्सहसृञ्जयान् । कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे वारयामास भारत ॥
data.md: Karna, the son of Vikartana, O descendant of Bharata, then resisted in battle Bhimasena, Karushas, Kaikeyas and Srinjayas.

data.v: शिखण्डिनस्ततो बाणान्कृपः शारद्वतो युधि । प्राहिणोत्त्वरया युक्तो दिधक्षुरिव मारिष ॥
data.md: Then in the battle, O Sire, Kripa quickly hurled arrows at Shikhandin as to burn him down.

data.v: ताञ्शरान्प्रेषितांस्तेन समन्ताद्धेमभूषणान् । चिच्छेद खड्गमाविध्य भ्रामयंश्च पुनः पुनः ॥
data.md: Whirling his sword repeatedly (Shikhandin) then with his sword cut-off all those golddecked arrows that were discharged at him.

data.v: शतचन्द्रं ततश्चर्म गौतमः पार्षतस्य ह । व्यधमत्सायकैस्तूर्णं तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः ॥
data.md: The son of Gautama then quickly cut-off with his arrows the shield of Prishata's son that was adorned with a hundred moons. At this his people made a loud uproar.

data.v: स विचर्मा महाराज खड्गपाणिरुपाद्रवत् । कृपस्य वशमापन्नो मृत्योरास्यमिवातुरः ॥
data.md: Deprived of his shield, O monarch and brought under the influence of Kripa, he, with his sword, advanced like a sick man advancing towards death.

data.v: शारद्वतशरैर्ग्रस्तं क्लिश्यमानं महाबलम् । चित्रकेतुसुतो राजन्सुकेतुस्त्वरितो ययौ ॥
data.md: O king, Chitraketu's son Suketu quickly proceeded towards the highly powerful (Shikhandin) who was thus distressed and assailed by the son of Sharadvata.

data.v: विकिरन्ब्राह्मणं युद्धे बहुभिर्निशितैः शरैः । अभ्यापतदमेयात्मा गौतमस्य रथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Having covered in battle the Brahmana with sharp arrows, that one of immeasurable energy, advanced towards the car of Gautama's son.

data.v: दृष्ट्वाविषह्यं तं युद्धे ब्राह्मणं चरितव्रतम् । अपयातस्ततस्तूर्णं शिखण्डी राजसत्तम ॥
data.md: Beholding that Brahmana, observant of vows thus engaged in battle, Shikhandin, O king, quickly proceeded there.

data.v: सुकेतुस्तु ततो राजन्गौतमं नवभिः शरैः । विद्ध्वा विव्याध सप्तत्या पुनश्चैनं त्रिभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: O king, having pierced the son of Gautama with nine arrows Suketu once more pierced him with seventy and again with three.

data.v: अथास्य सशरं चापं पुनश्चिच्छेद मारिष । सारथिं च शरेणास्य भृशं मर्मण्यताडयत् ॥
data.md: He then cut-off his bow and arrows; then with another he pierced greatly his driver to the very vitals.

data.v: गौतमस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो धनुर्गृह्य नवं दृढम् । सुकेतुं त्रिंशता बाणैः सर्वमर्मस्वताडयत् ॥
data.md: Thereupon worked up with anger Gautama took up a fresh and strong bow and cut-off Suketu to the very vital part with thirty arrows.

data.v: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गः प्रचचाल रथोत्तमे । भूमिचाले यथा वृक्षश्चलत्याकम्पितो भृशम् ॥
data.md: All his limbs were weakened and he shook on that best of cars as a tree trembles greatly during an earth quake.

data.v: चलतस्तस्य कायात्तु शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम् । सोष्णीषं सशिरस्त्राणं क्षुरप्रेणान्वपातयत् ॥
data.md: Then with a razor-sharpened arrow he sundered from body his head still trembling with shining ear-rings, crown and headprotector.

data.v: तच्छिरः प्रापतद्भूमौ श्येनाहृतमिवामिषम् । ततोऽस्य कायो वसुधां पश्चात्प्राप तदा च्युतः ॥
data.md: His head fell down on the earth like a piece of meant stolen away by a hawk, afterwards his body, O Eternal one, fell down on the earth.

data.v: तस्मिन्हते महाराज त्रस्तास्तस्य पदानुगाः । गौतमं समरे त्यक्त्वा दुद्रुवुस्ते दिशो दश ॥
data.md: O Emperor, when he was slain, all his followers, leaving behind the son of Gautama in the battle-field fled, away in ten directions.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नं तु समरे संनिवार्य महाबलः । कृतवर्माब्रवीद्धृष्टस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति पार्षतम् ॥
data.md: Encircling the highly powerful Dhristadyumna in the battle-field Kritavarma said to him-"Wait! wait!"

data.v: तदभूत्तुमुलं युद्धं वृष्णिपार्षतयो रणे । आमिषार्थे यथा युद्धं श्येनयोर्गृद्धयोर्नृप ॥
data.md: Then there took place a terrible and wonderful encounter between the Vrishnis and Parsatas like that of two angry hawks, O king, for a piece of meat.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु समरे हार्दिक्यं नवभिः शरैः । आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः पीडयन्हृदिकात्मजम् ॥
data.md: Worked up with anger, Dhristadyumna, in that battle, assailed Hridika's son violently and struck him on the chest with nine arrows.

data.v: कृतवर्मा तु समरे पार्षतेन दृढाहतः । पार्षतं सरथं साश्वं छादयामास सायकैः ॥
data.md: Thus Assailed by a Parohata in battle Kritavarma covered him, his chariot and horses with arrows.

data.v: सरथश्छादितो राजन्धृष्टद्युम्नो न दृश्यते । मेघैरिव परिच्छन्नो भास्करो जलदागमे ॥
data.md: O king, thus covered along with his car Dhristadyumna became invisible like the sun enshrouded by clouds surcharged with water.

data.v: विधूय तं बाणगणं शरैः कनकभूषणैः । व्यरोचत रणे राजन्धृष्टद्युम्नः कृतव्रणः ॥
data.md: Withstanding him with gold feathered arrows, O king, Dhristadyumna appeared in battle with wounds.

data.v: ततस्तु पार्षतः क्रुद्धः शस्त्रवृष्टिं सुदारुणाम् । कृतवर्माणमासाद्य व्यसृजत्पृतनापतिः ॥
data.md: Obtaining Kritavarma, Parsata, the commander of the forces, worked up with anger, made a terrible downpour of arrows.

data.v: तामापतन्तीं सहसा शस्त्रवृष्टिं निरन्तराम् । शरैरनेकसाहस्रैर्हार्दिक्यो व्यधमद्युधि ॥
data.md: In that battle Hridika's son with many thousand arrows, all on a sudden, dispelled that highly dreadful shower of arrows that was about to fall on him.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा तु दारितां युद्धे शस्त्रवृष्टिं दुरुत्तराम् । कृतवर्माणमभ्येत्य वारयामास पार्षतः ॥
data.md: Beholding in that battle that fearful downpour of arrows thus dispelled by him Prishata's son, approaching Kritavarma, withstood him.

data.v: सारथिं चास्य तरसा प्राहिणोद्यमसादनम् । भल्लेन शितधारेण स हतः प्रापतद्रथात् ॥
data.md: With a sharpened spike he dispatched his charioteer to the abode of Death. Slain he fell down from the chariot.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु बलवाञ्जित्वा शत्रुं महारथम् । कौरवान्समरे तूर्णं वारयामास सायकैः ॥
data.md: Having vanquished his highly powerful enemy, the mighty Dhristadyumna speedily withstood the Kauravas in battle with arrows.

data.v: ततस्ते तावका योधा धृष्टद्युम्नमुपाद्रवन् । सिंहनादरवं कृत्वा ततो युद्धमवर्तत ॥
data.md: Thereupon emitting leonine roars your warriors ran towards Dhristadyumna and again an encounter took place.

data.v: द्रौणिर्युधिष्ठिरं दृष्ट्वा शैनेयेनाभिरक्षितम् । द्रौपदेयैस्तथा शूरैरभ्यवर्तत हृष्टवत् ॥
किरन्निषुगणान्घोरान्स्वर्णपुङ्खाञ्शिलाशितान् । दर्शयन्विविधान्मार्गाञ्शिक्षार्थं लघुहस्तवत् ॥
ततः खं पूरयामास शरैर्दिव्यास्त्रमन्त्रितैः । युधिष्ठिरं च समरे पर्यवारयदस्त्रवित् ॥
data.md: Thereupon he filled the sky with arrows of the vigour of celestial weapons. That one, conversant with the use of weapons, withstood Yudhishthira in battle.

data.v: द्रौणायनिशरच्छन्नं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन । बाणभूतमभूत्सर्वमायोधनशिरो हि तत् ॥
data.md: When the sky was covered with the arrows of Drona's son nothing could be perceived. The space before the warriors was filled with arrows.

data.v: बाणजालं दिविष्ठं तत्स्वर्णजालविभूषितम् । शुशुभे भरतश्रेष्ठ वितानमिव विष्ठितम् ॥
data.md: The sky being covered with a net-work of golden arrows it appeared as if a canopy had been spread there.

data.v: तेन छन्ने रणे राजन्बाणजालेन भास्वता । अभ्रच्छायेव संजज्ञे बाणरुद्धे नभस्तले ॥
data.md: O king, the sky being covered with a network of shining arrows a shadow appeared there like that of clouds.

data.v: तत्राश्चर्यमपश्याम बाणभूते तथाविधे । न स्म संपतते भूमौ दृष्ट्वा द्रौणेः पराक्रमम् ॥
data.md: When the sky was thus converted into one sheet of arrows it was a wonderful sight to look at. No creature could range in the sky at that time.

data.v: लाघवं द्रोणपुत्रस्य दृष्ट्वा तत्र महारथाः । व्यस्मयन्त महाराज न चैनं प्रतिवीक्षितुम् । शेकुस्ते सर्वराजानस्तपन्तमिव भास्करम् ॥
data.md: Beholding the light-handness of Drona's son, all the mighty car-warriors there, O king, were filled with wonder. All the kings could not look at him, as if shedding lustre of the sun.

data.v: सात्यकिर्यतमानस्तु धर्मराजश्च पाण्डवः । तथेतराणि सैन्यानि न स्म चक्रुः पराक्रमम् ॥
data.md: Satyaki, although trying his very best, the pious son of Pandu and other warriors, could not display their prowess.

data.v: वध्यमाने ततः सैन्ये द्रौपदेया महारथाः । सात्यकिर्धर्मराजश्च पाञ्चालाश्चापि संगताः । त्यक्त्वा मृत्युभयं घोरं द्रौणायनिमुपाद्रवन् ॥
data.md: Thereupon, when their soldiers were being thus slaughtered, the mighty car-warriors, the son of Draupadi, Satyaki, the pious king Yudhishthira and the Panchalas, all united, giving up the dreadful fear of death, rushed towards the son of Drona.

data.v: सात्यकिः पञ्चविंशत्या द्रौणिं विद्ध्वा शिलामुखैः । पुनर्विव्याध नाराचैः सप्तभिः स्वर्णभूषितैः ॥
data.md: Piercing the son of Drona with twenty seven arrows he again pierced him with seven gold-plated winged arrows.

data.v: युधिष्ठिरस्त्रिसप्तत्या प्रतिविन्ध्यश्च सप्तभिः । श्रुतकर्मा त्रिभिर्बाणैः श्रुतकीर्तिस्तु सप्तभिः ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira struck him with seventy three arrows and Prativinda with seven, Shrutakarma cut him with three arrows and Shrutakirti with seven. Sutasoma struck him with nine arrows and Satanika with seven. And many other warrior struck him from all sides with a number of shafts.

data.v: सुतसोमश्च नवभिः शतानीकश्च सप्तभिः । अन्ये च बहवः शूरा विव्यधुस्तं समन्ततः ॥
सोऽतिक्रुद्धस्ततो राजन्नाशीविष इव श्वसन् । सात्यकिं पञ्चविंशत्या प्राविध्यत शिलाशितैः ॥
data.md: Thereupon worked up with rage, O king, he, sighing like a deadly serpent, struck Satyaki with twenty five sharpened arrows.

data.v: श्रुतकीर्तिं च नवभिः सुतसोमं च पञ्चभिः । अष्टभिः श्रुतकर्माणं प्रतिविन्ध्यं त्रिभिः शरैः । शतानीकं च नवभिर्धर्मपुत्रं च सप्तभिः ॥
data.md: And he struck Srutakirti with nine arrows and Sutasoma with five; and Prativindhya with three arrows and Srutakarma with eight. And he. struck Raja Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, with five arrows and Satanika with nine. And then he struck other warriors with two shafts each and cut into pieces the bow of Srutakirti with very sharp pointed arrows.

data.v: ततो दुर्योधनस्याश्वान्हत्वा सूतं च पञ्चभिः । धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन जातरूपपरिष्कृतम् ॥
data.md: Then with five of these arrows he slew Duryodhana's four horses and his Suta charioteer and with another he cut-off his gilded bow.

data.v: रथं सोपस्करं छत्रं शक्तिं खड्गं गदां ध्वजम् । भल्लैश्चिच्छेद नवभिः पुत्रस्य तव पार्षतः ॥
data.md: And with remaining ten shafts the son of Prishata cut-off the royal umbrella, the spear, the sword, the mace, the car with Upaskara and the flag of your son.

data.v: तपनीयाङ्गदं चित्रं नागं मणिमयं शुभम् । ध्वजं कुरुपतेश्छिन्नं ददृशुः सर्वपार्थिवाः ॥
data.md: Alas, all the chiefs saw the beautiful standard of the Kuru king, adorned with golden Angada and bearing the likeness of an elephant set with jewels, cut-off by Dhristadyumna.

data.v: दुर्योधनं तु विरथं छिन्नसर्वायुधं रणे । भ्रातरः पर्यरक्षन्त सोदर्या भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Then, O foremost of the Bharata's race, Duryodhana, thus deprived of all his weapons in the battle, was protected by his brothers.

data.v: तमारोप्य रथे राजन्दण्डधारो जनाधिपम् । अपोवाह च संभ्रान्तो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.md: In the very sight of Dhristadyumna. Dandadhara, taking the king upon his own car, quickly carried him away from the field.

data.v: कर्णस्तु सात्यकिं जित्वा राजगृद्धी महाबलः । द्रोणहन्तारमुग्रेषुं ससाराभिमुखं रणे ॥
data.md: In the meantime, the greatly powerful Karna, having killed Satyaki, proceeded straight on towards the slayer of Drona for the rescue of the Kuru king.

data.v: तं पृष्ठतोऽभ्ययात्तूर्णं शैनेयो वितुदञ्शरैः । वारणं जघनोपान्ते विषाणाभ्यामिव द्विपः ॥
data.md: And the son of Sini speedily pursued him striking him with arrows as an elephant pursues his rival piercing him with his tusks on the rear.

data.v: स भारत महानासीद्योधानां सुमहात्मनाम् । कर्णपार्षतयोर्मध्ये त्वदीयानां महारणः ॥
data.md: Thus, O king, the battle raged furiously amongst these sturdy heroes of both the armies and the spot, lying between Karna and the son of Prishata, grew simply terrifying.

data.v: न पाण्डवानां नास्माकं योधः कश्चित्पराङ्मुखः । प्रत्यदृश्यत यत्कर्णः पाञ्चालांस्त्वरितो ययौ ॥
data.md: Not a single combatant, of either party, turned his face from the field. Karna then rushed towards the Panchala with great speed.

data.v: तस्मिन्क्षणे नरश्रेष्ठ गजवाजिनरक्षयः । प्रादुरासीदुभयतो राजन्मध्यंगतेऽहनि ॥
data.md: Then, O best of men, countless men, horses and elephant of both parties fell just when the sun ascended the meridian.

data.v: पाञ्चालास्तु महाराज त्वरिता विजिगीषवः । सर्वतोऽभ्यद्रवन्कर्णं पतत्रिण इव द्रुमम् ॥
data.md: The Panchalas, O king, desirous of victory, rushed towards Karna as birds flock towards their nest.

data.v: तेषामाधिरथिः क्रुद्धो यतमानान्मनस्विनः । विचिन्वन्नेव बाणाग्रैः समासादयदग्रतः ॥
व्याघ्रकेतुं सुशर्माणं शङ्कुं चोग्रं धनंजयम् । शुक्लं च रोचमानं च सिंहसेनं च दुर्जयम् ॥
ते वीरा रथवेगेन परिवव्रुर्नरोत्तमम् । सृजन्तं सायकान्क्रुद्धं कर्णमाहवशोभिनम् ॥
data.md: All those heroes, quickly driving their cars towards Karna-the glory of the battle field, encompassed him and began to shower their sharp shafts upon that infuriated hero, the foremost of men.

data.v: युध्यमानांस्तु ताञ्शूरान्मनुजेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् । अष्टाभिरष्टौ राधेयो न्यहनन्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: But all those eight heroes who had proceeded to combat that brave hero, the son of Radha, were sorely afflicted by him each with eight piercing arrows.

data.v: अथापरान्महाराज सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । जघान बहुसाहस्रान्योधान्युद्धविशारदः ॥
data.md: Thereupon, O king, the powerful son of charioteer killed thousands of other heroes-all skillful in the manoeuvre of war.

data.v: विष्णुं च विष्णुकर्माणं देवापिं भद्रमेव च । दण्डं च समरे राजंश्चित्रं चित्रायुधं हरिम् ॥
data.md: Worked up with anger Karna stuck in battle, Jishnu, Jishnukarman, Devapi, Bhadra, Danda, Chitra, Chitrayudha, Hari, Singhaketu, Rochamana, the great car-warriors Shalabha and many other Chedi heroes.

data.v: सिंहकेतुं रोचमानं शलभं च महारथम् । निजघान सुसंक्रुद्धश्चेदीनां च महारथान् ॥
तेषामाददतः प्राणानासीदाधिरथेर्वपुः । शोणिताभ्युक्षिताङ्गस्य रुद्रस्येवोर्जितं महत् ॥
data.md: When the son of Adhiratha was engaged in striking those heroes his body, besmeared with blood and swelled with pride and animation, looked like the gigantic form of Rudra himself.

data.v: तत्र भारत कर्णेन मातङ्गास्ताडिताः शरैः । सर्वतोऽभ्यद्रवन्भीताः कुर्वन्तो महदाकुलम् ॥
data.md: Then, O Bharata, the elephants afflicted by Karna's arrows, bolted with fear and caused great commotion in the battle-field.

data.v: निपेतुरुर्व्यां समरे कर्णसायकपीडिताः । कुर्वन्तो विविधान्नादान्वज्रनुन्ना इवाचलाः ॥
data.md: Others, oppressed by Karna's arrows, cried aloud in diverse voice and fell down as do the mountain peaks when struck down with thunder.

data.v: गजवाजिमनुष्यैश्च निपतद्भिः समन्ततः । रथैश्चावगतैर्मार्गे पर्यस्तीर्यत मेदिनी ॥
data.md: The earth, along the trace of Karna's car, was fully strewn with broken cars and carcasses of elephants, horses and men.

data.v: नैव भीष्मो न च द्रोणो नाप्यन्ये युधि तावकाः । चक्रुः स्म तादृशं कर्म यादृशं वै कृतं रणे ॥
data.md: Verily one of the warriors of your army may not even Bhishma or Drona, did ever achieve such an exploit, as was achieved by Karna in the battle.

data.v: सूतपुत्रेण नागेषु रथेषु च हयेषु च । नरेषु च नरव्याघ्र कृतं स्म कदनं महत् ॥
data.md: Suta's son, O most valiant of men, indeed made a havoc amongst the elephants and horses and destroyed the cars and men in countless numbers.

data.v: मृगमध्ये यथा सिंहो दृश्यते निर्भयश्चरन् । पाञ्चालानां तथा मध्ये कर्णोऽचरदभीतवत् ॥
data.md: Like a lion roaming fearlessly among a herd of deer Karna too moved about fcarlessly amongst the Panchalas.

data.v: यथा मृगगणांस्त्रस्तान्सिंहो द्रावयते दिशः । पाञ्चालानां रथव्रातान्कर्णो द्रावयते तथा ॥
data.md: As a lion drives away a herd of timid deer in all directions, so Karna dispelled the crowd of Panchala's cars to all directions.

data.v: सिंहास्यं च यथा प्राप्य न जीवन्ति मृगाः क्वचित् । तथा कर्णमनुप्राप्य न जीवन्ति महारथाः ॥
data.md: And as a stag cam never escape from the black jaws of a lion so even those heroes, who happened to approach Karna, could not return with their lives.

data.v: वैश्वानरं यथा दीप्तं दह्यन्ते प्राप्य वै जनाः । कर्णाग्निना रणे तद्वद्दग्धा भारत सृञ्जयाः ॥
data.md: As men are sure to be burnt down if they approach a blazing fire so even the Srinjayas, O Bharata, were burnt by the flame of Karna when they approached it.

data.v: कर्णेन चेदिष्वेकेन पाञ्चालेषु च भारत । विश्राव्य नाम निहता बहवः शूरसंमताः ॥
data.md: Many proud and well-approved heroes of the Chedis and Panchalas were killed by Karna.

data.v: मम चासीन्मनुष्येन्द्र दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य विक्रमम् । नैकोऽप्याधिरथेर्जीवन्पाञ्चाल्यो मोक्ष्यते युधि ॥
data.md: Beholding the valour of Karna, O king, I was under the impression that not even a single soul of the Panchalas would escape from the son of Adhiratha in that battle. Indeed the Suta's son repeatedly routed the Panchalas in the battle.

data.v: पाञ्चालान्विधमन्संख्ये सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धो धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥
धृष्टद्युम्नश्च राजानं द्रौपदेयाश्च मारिष । परिवव्रुरमित्रघ्नं शतशश्चापरे जनाः ॥
data.md: Dhristadyumna, the sons of Droupadi and hundreds of other heroes, O Sire, speedily encompassed the son of Radha, the slayer of foes.

data.v: शिखण्डी सहदेवश्च नकुलो नाकुलिस्तथा । जनमेजयः शिनेर्नप्ता बहवश्च प्रभद्रकाः ॥
data.md: And many other warriors of immeasurable strength as Sikhandin, Sahadeva, Nakula, his sons, the descendant of Sini and a good many of the Prabhadrakas advancing along with Dhristadyumna in their respective cars looked very grand when they all began to strike Karna with their shafts and many other weapons of different descriptions.

data.v: एते पुरोगमा भूत्वा धृष्टद्युम्नस्य संयुगे । कर्णमस्यन्तमिष्वस्त्रैर्विचेरुरमितौजसः ॥
data.md: And many other warriors of immeasurable strength as Sikhandin, Sahadeva, Nakula, his sons, the descendant of Sini and a good many of the Prabhadrakas advancing along with Dhristadyumna in their respective cars looked very grand when they all began to strike Karna with their shafts and many other weapons of different descriptions.

data.v: तांस्तत्राधिरथिः संख्ये चेदिपाञ्चालपाण्डवान् । एको बहूनभ्यपतद्गरुत्मन्पन्नगानिव ॥
data.md: But the son of Adhiratha, though singlehanded, fell ferociously upon all those Panchalas, Chedis and Pandavas in the encounter just as Garuda falls upon a number of snakes.

data.v: भीमसेनस्तु संक्रुद्धः कुरून्मद्रान्सकेकयान् । एकः संख्ये महेष्वासो योधयन्बह्वशोभत ॥
तत्र मर्मसु भीमेन नाराचैस्ताडिता गजाः । प्रपतन्तो हतारोहाः कम्पयन्ति स्म मेदिनीम् ॥
data.md: The earth itself began to tremble with the violence of the fall of the huge elephants struck fatally with the awful arrows of Bhimasena in the vital parts of their riders shot dead.

data.v: वाजिनश्च हतारोहाः पत्तयश्च गतासवः । शेरते युधि निर्भिन्ना वमन्तो रुधिरं बहु ॥
data.md: Many horses also, with their riders slain and many of the infantries lay down dead pierced with arrows and vomiting blood and bleeding profusely.

data.v: सहस्रशश्च रथिनः पतिताः पतितायुधाः । अक्षताः समदृश्यन्त भीमाद्भीता गतासवः ॥
data.md: Thousands of car-warriors, deprived of their arms, lay senseless through the fear of Bhima and inany lay dead, their bodies mangled with wounds.

data.v: रथिभिर्वाजिभिः सूतैः पत्तिभिश्च तथा गजैः । भीमसेनशरच्छिन्नैरास्तीर्णा वसुधाभवत् ॥
तत्स्तम्भितमिवातिष्ठद्भीमसेनबलार्दितम् । दुर्योधनबलं राजन्निरुत्साहं कृतव्रणम् ॥
data.md: The army of Duryodhana, of Duryodhana, O king, melancholy, mainted and grieved through fear of Bhimasena, stood in utter confusion. That poor confounded host stood motionless in the field.

data.v: निश्चेष्टं तुमुले दीनं बभौ तस्मिन्महारणे । प्रसन्नसलिलः काले यथा स्यात्सागरो नृप ॥
मन्युवीर्यबलोपेतं बलात्पर्यवरोपितम् । अभवत्तव पुत्रस्य तत्सैन्यमिषुभिस्तदा । रुधिरौघपरिक्लिन्नं रुधिरार्द्रं बभूव ह ॥
data.md: The army of your son, however powerful and energetic it might have been, lost all its glory and pride at that time.

data.v: सूतपुत्रो रणे क्रुद्धः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् । भीमसेनः कुरूंश्चापि द्रावयन्बह्वशोभत ॥
data.md: Suta's son, filled with anger, routed the Pandava army while the enraged Bhimasena routed the Kurus. And both the heroes thus engaged looked exceedingly beautiful.

data.v: वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे संग्रामेऽद्भुतदर्शने । निहत्य पृतनामध्ये संशप्तकगणान्बहून् ॥
data.md: In that extremely fierce and awe-inspiring battle, Arjuna, that foremost of victorious heroes, having killed a large number of Samasaptakas in the very heart of their array,

data.v: अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठो वासुदेवमथाब्रवीत् । प्रभग्नं बलमेतद्धि योत्स्यमानं जनार्दन ॥
एते धावन्ति सगणाः संशप्तकमहारथाः । अपारयन्तो मद्बाणान्सिंहशब्दान्मृगा इव ॥
data.md: This array of these fighting warriors, O Janaradana, has been broken through. These great warriors of the Samasaptakas, unable to withstand my arrows, are running away with their men as a herd of deer at the roar of a lion.

data.v: दीर्यते च महत्सैन्यं सृञ्जयानां महारणे । हस्तिकक्ष्यो ह्यसौ कृष्ण केतुः कर्णस्य धीमतः । दृश्यते राजसैन्यस्य मध्ये विचरतो मुहुः ॥
data.md: And even the vast force of the Srinjayas appears to give way in this great battle. There in the midst of Yudhishthira's division, the banner, of the highly intelligent Karna, bearing the device of an elephant is seen to move about with great activity.

data.v: न च कर्णं रणे शक्ता जेतुमन्ये महारथाः । जानीते हि भवान्कर्णं वीर्यवन्तं पराक्रमे ॥
data.md: O Janardana, You are well aware of Karna's energy and prowess. No other warrior of our army is capable of conquering Karna.

data.v: तत्र याहि यतः कर्णो द्रावयत्येष नो बलम् ॥
वर्जयित्वा रणे याहि सूतपुत्रं महारथम् । श्रमो मा बाधते कृष्ण यथा वा तव रोचते ॥
data.md: Pray, proceed there where Karna is crushing down our force. Leaving all others proceed against that mighty car-warrior, the son of Suta, O Krishna, this is my suggestion; but please do what you think proper,

data.v: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महाराज गोविन्दः प्रहसन्निव । अब्रवीदर्जुनं तूर्णं कौरवाञ्जहि पाण्डव ॥
data.md: Hearing these words of his, Govind smiled and addressing Arjuna said-"O son of Pandu, go on killing the Kauravas indiscriminately."

data.v: ततस्तव महत्सैन्यं गोविन्दप्रेरिता हयाः । हंसवर्णाः प्रविविशुर्वहन्तः कृष्णपाण्डवौ ॥
data.md: Then those swan white horses, driven by Krishna, penetrated into your strong array bearing both Krishna and himself and the son of Pandu.

data.v: केशवप्रहितैरश्वैः श्वेतैः काञ्चनभूषणैः । प्रविशद्भिस्तव बलं चतुर्दिशमभिद्यत ॥
data.md: And your host gave way on all sides as those two white animals bedecked with golden trappings entered into its midst led by Keshava.

data.v: तौ विदार्य महासेनां प्रविष्टौ केशवार्जुनौ । क्रुद्धौ संरम्भरक्ताक्षौ व्यभ्राजेतां महाद्युती ॥
data.md: When cutting through the vast army, Keshava and Arjuna entered the arena with their eyes blooded with anger they looked exceedingly splendid and resplendent.

data.v: युद्धशौण्डौ समाहूतावरिभिस्तौ रणाध्वरम् । यज्वभिर्विधिनाहूतौ मखे देवाविवाश्विनौ ॥
data.md: Taking great delight in battle and accepting the challenge of the Kurus when those two heroes came to the field they looked like the w twin gods Ashvinis invoked with proper rites in a sacrifice by the priests.

data.v: क्रुद्धौ तौ तु नरव्याघ्रौ वेगवन्तौ बभूवतुः । तलशब्देन रुषितौ यथा नागौ महाहवे ॥
data.md: Those two enraged heroes of tigerish fierceness grew extremely violent in their moments like two elephants excited at the claps of hunters in a deep forest.

data.v: विगाहन्स रथानीकमश्वसंघांश्च फल्गुनः । व्यचरत्पृतनामध्ये पाशहस्त इवान्तकः ॥
data.md: Penetrating into the midst of those cars and horses drawn in array Phalguna move about like the destroyer himself armed with his fatal noose.

data.v: तं दृष्ट्वा युधि विक्रान्तं सेनायां तव भारत । संशप्तकगणान्भूयः पुत्रस्ते समचोदयत् ॥
data.md: Beholding him displaying such courage within his own army, O Bharata, your son tried once more to stir up the Samasaptakas against him.

data.md: Then throwing off his broken bow the great car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna took up a fresh one and shafts resembling venomous snakes and struck Karna with seventy arrows.

data.v: तथैव राजन्कर्णोऽपि पार्षतं शत्रुतापनम् । द्रोणशत्रुं महेष्वासो विव्याध निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Likewise Karna too covered Prishata's son, the scorcher of his enemies with arrows resembling deadly deadly serpents. The great bowman, the enemy of Drona, struck (Karna) with sharpened arrows.

data.v: तस्य कर्णो महाराज शरं कनकभूषणम् । प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धो मृत्युदण्डमिवापरम् ॥
data.md: Karna discharged at him in anger a golden arrow like the very rod of Death.

data.v: तमापतन्तं सहसा घोररूपं विशां पते । चिच्छेद सप्तधा राजञ्शैनेयः कृतहस्तवत् ॥
data.md: O king, the descendant of Sini, like an expert, sundered into seven pieces that dreadful arrow which was about to fall on him.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा विनिहितं बाणं शरैः कर्णो विशां पते । सात्यकिं शरवर्षेण समन्तात्पर्यवारयत् ॥
data.md: Seeing that arrow broken with his shafts, Karna, O king, covered Satyaki completely with a downpour of arrows.

data.v: विव्याध चैनं समरे नाराचैस्तत्र सप्तभिः । तं प्रत्यविध्यच्छैनेयः शरैर्हेमविभूषितैः ॥
data.md: He pierced him with seven arrows. The grandson of Sini, in return, struck him with golden-feathered arrows.

data.v: ततो युद्धमतीवासीच्चक्षुःश्रोत्रभयावहम् । राजन्घोरं च चित्रं च प्रेक्षणीयं समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Then there took place an encounter wonderful and terrible striking terror to ears and eyes.

data.v: सर्वेषां तत्र भूतानां लोमहर्षो व्यजायत । तद्दृष्ट्वा समरे कर्म कर्णशैनेययोर्नृप ॥
data.md: Hairs on the body of all creatures present there stood erect on beholding in that battle the wonderful feats of Karna and of the grandson of Sini.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे द्रौणिरभ्ययात्सुमहाबलम् । पार्षतं शत्रुदमनं शत्रुवीर्यासुनाशनम् ॥
data.md: In the meantime the highly powerful son of Drona approached Parshata, the subduer of his enemies and the destroyer of their prowess.

data.v: अभ्यभाषत संक्रुद्धो द्रौणिर्दूरे धनंजये । तिष्ठ तिष्ठाद्य ब्रह्मघ्न न मे जीवन्विमोक्ष्यसे ॥
data.md: Drouni, the victor of hostile cities, said to him, in anger, "Wait, wait! O slayer of Brahmanas, you will not escape me today with your life.

data.v: इत्युक्त्वा सुभृशं वीरः शीघ्रकृन्निशितैः शरैः । पार्षतं छादयामास घोररूपैः सुतेजनैः । यतमानं परं शक्त्या यतमानो महारथः ॥
data.md: Saying this he covered the great hero, Parshata, with dreadful, dreadful, sharpened and powerful arrows although that car-warrior tried his level best to thwart them.

data.v: यथा हि समरे द्रौणिः पार्षतं वीक्ष्य मारिष । तथा द्रौणिं रणे दृष्ट्वा पार्षतः परवीरहा । नातिहृष्टमना भूत्वा मन्यते मृत्युमात्मनः ॥
data.md: As Drona, while he was alive, became dispirited on seeing the son of Prishata and took him for his death, so the son of Prishata, on seeing Drona's son in battle, regarded him as his death.

data.v: द्रौणिस्तु दृष्ट्वा राजेन्द्र धृष्टद्युम्नं रणे स्थितम् । क्रोधेन निःश्वसन्वीरः पार्षतं समुपाद्रवत् । तावन्योन्यं तु दृष्ट्वैव संरम्भं जग्मतुः परम् ॥
data.md: Seeing Dhristadyumna stand firm before him the heroic son of Drona, sighing in anger, rushed towards Parshata.

data.v: अथाब्रवीन्महाराज द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । धृष्टद्युम्नं समीपस्थं त्वरमाणो विशां पते । पाञ्चालापसदाद्य त्वां प्रेषयिष्यामि मृत्यवे ॥
data.md: O king, both are very angry to see each other. Then, O king, the powerful son of Drona quickly said to Dhristadyumna who stood before him.

data.v: पापं हि यत्त्वया कर्म घ्नता द्रोणं पुरा कृतम् । अद्य त्वा पत्स्यते तद्वै यथा ह्यकुशलं तथा ॥
अरक्ष्यमाणः पार्थेन यदि तिष्ठसि संयुगे । नापक्रमसि वा मूढ सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ॥
एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान् । प्रतिवाक्यं स एवासिर्मामको दास्यते तव । येनैव ते पितुर्दत्तं यतमानस्य संयुगे ॥
data.md: Thus addressed the powerful Dhristadyumna replied-What, I said to your father, while trying his best in battle, will serve as a reply to your words.

data.v: यदि तावन्मया द्रोणो निहतो ब्राह्मणब्रुवः । त्वामिदानीं कथं युद्धे न हनिष्यामि विक्रमात् ॥
data.md: If Drona, who was a Brahmana in name, could have been killed by me, why should I not, by my power, kill you today in battle.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज सेनापतिरमर्षणः । निशितेनाथ बाणेन द्रौणिं विव्याध पार्षतः ॥
data.md: Having said this, O king, the revengeful commander (of Pandava's army) Parshata struck Drona's son with sharpened arrows.

data.v: ततो द्रौणिः सुसंक्रुद्धः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः । प्राच्छादयद्दिशो राजन्धृष्टद्युम्नस्य संयुगे ॥
data.md: Thereupon, worked up with anger Drona's son, O king, covered all sides of Dhristadyumna with arrows.

data.v: नैवान्तरिक्षं न दिशो नैव योधाः समन्ततः । दृश्यन्ते वै महाराज शरैश्छन्नाः सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: Covered with thousands of shafts neither the sky, nor the quarters, nor the warriors around could be seen.

data.v: तथैव पार्षतो राजन्द्रौणिमाहवशोभिनम् । शरैः संछादयामास सूतपुत्रस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.md: Before the very eyes of the charioteer's son, O king, Parshata covered Drona's son, the ornament of the battle field, with arrows.

data.v: राधेयोऽपि महाराज पाञ्चालान्सह पाण्डवैः । द्रौपदेयान्युधामन्युं सात्यकिं च महारथम् । एकः स वारयामास प्रेक्षणीयः समन्ततः ॥
data.md: But the son of Radha alone, O king, visible on every side, withstood the Panchalas, Pandavas, the sons of Draupadi, Yudhamanyu and the great car-warrior Satyaki.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽपि समरे द्रौणेश्चिच्छेद कार्मुकम् । तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नमन्यदादत्त कार्मुकम् । वेगवत्समरे घोरं शरांश्चाशीविषोपमान् ॥
स पार्षतस्य राजेन्द्र धनुः शक्तिं गदां ध्वजम् । हयान्सूतं रथं चैव निमेषाद्व्यधमच्छरैः ॥
स छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः । खड्गमादत्त विपुलं शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत् ॥
data.md: Having his bow and car broken and horses and charioteer slain, he took up a huge sword shining like a hundred moon.

data.v: द्रौणिस्तदपि राजेन्द्र भल्लैः क्षिप्रं महारथः । चिच्छेद समरे वीरः क्षिप्रहस्तो दृढायुधः । रथादनवरूढस्य तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
data.md: O king, the great car-warrior, the heroic son of Drona, displaying light handedness and holding firm his weapon, quickly cut-off in battle with Bhallas, that weapon of his, before he could come down from the car. It was indeed wonderful.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नं तु विरथं हताश्वं छिन्नकार्मुकम् । शरैश्च बहुधा विद्धमस्त्रैश्च शकलीकृतम् । नातरद्भरतश्रेष्ठ यतमानो महारथः ॥
data.md: O foremost of Bharatas, that great carwarrior, although striving hard, could not kill Dhristadyumna, who had his bow and car broken and horses slain and was wounded with various arrows.

data.v: तस्यान्तमिषुभी राजन्यदा द्रौणिर्न जग्मिवान् । अथ त्यक्त्वा धनुर्वीरः पार्षतं त्वरितोऽन्वगात् ॥
data.md: O king, when the son of Drona could not kill him with arrows, that hero, laying aside his bow, quickly followed Parshata.

data.v: आसीदाद्रवतो राजन्वेगस्तस्य महात्मनः । गरुडस्येव पततो जिघृक्षोः पन्नगोत्तमम् ॥
data.md: The motion of that high-souled one as he rushed on resembled that of Garuda, swooping down for catching a snake.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु माधवोऽर्जुनमब्रवीत् । पश्य पार्थ यथा द्रौणिः पार्षतस्य वधं प्रति । यत्नं करोति विपुलं हन्याच्चैनमसंशयम् ॥
data.md: In the interval Madhava said to Arjuna-"See, O Partha, how Drona's son is proceeding quickly towards Parshata's car. Forsooth, he will kill the prince. There is no doubt.

data.v: तं मोचय महाबाहो पार्षतं शत्रुतापनम् । द्रौणेरास्यमनुप्राप्तं मृत्योरास्यगतं यथा ॥
data.md: O you of large arms, O subduer of enemies, rescue Prishata's son who is near the mouth of Drona's son as if he is within the jaws of Death."

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज वासुदेवः प्रतापवान् । प्रैषयत्तत्र तुरगान्यत्र द्रौणिर्व्यवस्थितः ॥
data.md: Having said this, O king, the powerful son of Vasudeva drove the horses where Drona's son was staying

data.v: ते हयाश्चन्द्रसंकाशाः केशवेन प्रचोदिताः । पिबन्त इव तद्व्योम जग्मुर्द्रौणिरथं प्रति ॥
data.md: Urged on by the Keshava those horses, effulgent like the moon, ran towards the car of Drona's son as if devouring the very sky.

data.v: दृष्ट्वायान्तौ महावीर्यावुभौ कृष्णधनंजयौ । धृष्टद्युम्नवधे राजंश्चक्रे यत्नं महाबलः ॥
data.md: Seeing those two mighty heroes approach him, Ashvatthama set forth his exertions for killing Dhristadyumna soon.

data.v: विकृष्यमाणं दृष्ट्वैव धृष्टद्युम्नं जनेश्वर । शरांश्चिक्षेप वै पार्थो द्रौणिं प्रति महाबलः ॥
data.md: O king, seeing Dhristadyumna dragged by his enemy, the powerful son of Pritha discharged many arrows at the son of Drona.

data.v: ते शरा हेमविकृता गाण्डीवप्रेषिता भृशम् । द्रौणिमासाद्य विविशुर्वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः ॥
data.md: Those golden shafts, shot off his Gandiva, approached the son of Drona and wounded him deep like serpents entering into an ant hill.

data.v: स विध्वस्तैः शरैर्घोरैर्द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । रथमारुरुहे वीरो धनंजयशरार्दितः । प्रगृह्य च धनुः श्रेष्ठं पार्थं विव्याध सायकैः ॥
data.md: Thus wounded by Dhananjaya with arrows the hero got on his chariot. And taking up his bow he began to strike Partha with innumerabie arrows.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरः सहदेवो जनाधिप । अपोवाह रथेनाजौ पार्षतं शत्रुतापनम् ॥
data.md: In the interval O king, the heroic Sahadeva carried away on his chariot Parshata the scorcher of his enemies.

data.v: अर्जुनोऽपि महाराज द्रौणिं विव्याध पत्रिभिः । तं द्रोणपुत्रः संक्रुद्धो बाह्वोरुरसि चार्दयत् ॥
data.md: Arjuna in return struck Drona's son with Winged arrows. Worked up Drona's son struck him on the arms and the chest.

data.v: क्रोधितस्तु रणे पार्थो नाराचं कालसंमितम् । द्रोणपुत्राय चिक्षेप कालदण्डमिवापरम् । स ब्राह्मणस्यांसदेशे निपपात महाद्युतिः ॥
data.md: with anger Filled with anger Partha discharged in that battle at Drona's son a Naracha like unto the very rod of Death.

data.v: स विह्वलो महाराज शरवेगेन संयुगे । निषसाद रथोपस्थे वैक्लव्यं च परं ययौ ॥
data.md: O king, That highly effulgent arrow fell on Brahmana's shoulder, he was stupefied in the battle with the force of that arrow. He sat down exhausted on the car.

data.v: ततः कर्णो महाराज व्याक्षिपद्विजयं धनुः । अर्जुनं समरे क्रुद्धः प्रेक्षमाणो मुहुर्मुहुः । द्वैरथं चापि पार्थेन कामयानो महारणे ॥
data.md: Then, O king, Karna took up his bow, Vijaya and filled with anger he again and again cast his looks on Arjuna desiring for a duel with him.

data.v: तं तु हित्वा हतं वीरं सारथिः शत्रुकर्शनम् । अपोवाह रथेनाजौ त्वरमाणो रणाजिरात् ॥
data.md: Seeing Drona's son senseless his charioteer quickly took him away on his car from the battle-field.

data.v: अथोत्क्रुष्टं महाराज पाञ्चालैर्जितकाशिभिः । मोक्षितं पार्षतं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणपुत्रं च पीडितम् ॥
data.md: Seeing Prishata's son released and Drona's son wounded, the Panchalas, O king, jubilant over the victory, sent up loud war-cries.

data.v: वादित्राणि च दिव्यानि प्रावाद्यन्त सहस्रशः । सिंहनादश्च संजज्ञे दृष्ट्वा घोरं महाद्भुतम् ॥
data.md: Thousands of musical instruments of swell tune were struck. Seeing those wonderful feats the heroes sent up leonine shouts.

data.v: एवं कृत्वाब्रवीत्पार्थो वासुदेवं धनंजयः । याहि संशप्तकान्कृष्ण कार्यमेतत्परं मम ॥
data.md: Subsequent to exhibit such valour, Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti said to Sri Krishna-"Sri Krishna! Move now towards Samsaptakas as it is my prime target this time.

data.v: ततः प्रयातो दाशार्हः श्रुत्वा पाण्डवभाषितम् । रथेनातिपताकेन मनोमारुतरंहसा ॥
data.md: Hearing those words of Arjuna Krishna drove his car adorned with many banners and fleet like the wind or the mind. Hearing those words of Arjuna Krishna drove his car adorned with many banners and fleet like the wind or the mind.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णः पार्थं वचनमब्रवीत् । दर्शयन्निव कौन्तेयं धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said In the meantime pointing out the righteous king Yudhishthira to Parthia, the son of Kunti, Krishna said-

data.v: एष पाण्डव ते भ्राता धार्तराष्ट्रैर्महाबलैः । जिघांसुभिर्महेष्वासैर्द्रुतं पार्थानुसर्यते ॥
data.md: Behold, O son of Pandu, your brother Yudhishthira pursued by the highly powerful sons of Dhritarashtra, all great bowmen desirous of killing him.

data.v: तथानुयान्ति संरब्धाः पाञ्चाला युद्धदुर्मदाः । युधिष्ठिरं महात्मानं परीप्सन्तो महाजवाः ॥
data.md: The powerful Panchalas, whom it is difficult to vanquish, are running after the great Yudhishthira for rescuing him.

data.v: एष दुर्योधनः पार्थ रथानीकेन दंशितः । राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य राजानमनुधावति ॥
data.md: Accoutred in coat of mail and accompanied by a large army Duryodhana, the king of the whole world, is pursuing the Pandava king, with a view to kill him, O foremost of men, assisted by his brothers, all expert in fighting whose very touch is like the deadly venom of serpents.

data.v: जिघांसुः पुरुषव्याघ्रं भ्रातृभिः सहितो बली । आशीविषसमस्पर्शैः सर्वयुद्धविशारदैः ॥
data.md: Accoutred in coat of mail and accompanied by a large army Duryodhana, the king of the whole world, is pursuing the Pandava king, with a view to kill him, O foremost of men, assisted by his brothers, all expert in fighting whose very touch is like the deadly venom of serpents.

data.v: एते जिघृक्षवो यान्ति द्विपाश्वरथपत्तयः । युधिष्ठिरं धार्तराष्ट्रा रत्नोत्तममिवार्थिनः ॥
data.md: Your army, riding on elephants, horses and cars and proceeding on foot are going to kill a Yudhishthira like poor men for possessing a costly gem.

data.v: पश्य सात्वतभीमाभ्यां निरुद्धाधिष्ठितः प्रभुः । जिहीर्षवोऽमृतं दैत्याः शक्राग्निभ्यामिवावशाः ॥
data.md: See, obstructed by Satvata and Bhima, they have become motionless like unto the Dailyas desirous of pilfering ambrosia stupefied by Sakra and Agni.

data.v: एते बहुत्वात्त्वरिताः पुनर्गच्छन्ति पाण्डवम् । समुद्रमिव वार्योघाः प्रावृट्काले महारथाः ॥
data.md: On account of their numerical vastness (the Kuru) car-warriors are proceeding quickly towards Yudhishthira like unto a collection of water running towards the ocean during the rainy season.

data.v: नदन्तः सिंहनादांश्च धमन्तश्चापि वारिजान् । बलवन्तो महेष्वासा विधुन्वन्तो धनूंषि च ॥
data.md: Blowing their conch-shell and shaking their bows those powerful bow-men are sending up leonine shouts.

data.v: मृत्योर्मुखगतं मन्ये कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् । हुतमग्नौ च भद्रं ते दुर्योधनवशं गतम् ॥
data.md: I regard Kunti's son Yudhishthira who has been brought under the influence of Duryodhana as within the mouth of Death or like an oblation of ghee in fire.

data.v: यथायुक्तमनीकं हि धार्तराष्ट्रस्य पाण्डव । नास्य शक्रोऽपि मुच्येत संप्राप्तो बाणगोचरम् ॥
data.md: Duryodhana's army is properly armed. Coming within the range of their arrows even Sakra cannot escape.

data.v: दुर्योधनस्य शूरस्य द्रौणेः शारद्वतस्य च । कर्णस्य चेषुवेगो वै पर्वतानपि दारयेत् ॥
data.md: The force of Duryodhana's arrows, or of Drona's son's, or Kripa's, or Karna's, can shatter even the very mountains. was

data.v: दुर्योधनस्य शूरस्य शरौघाञ्शीघ्रमस्यतः । संक्रुद्धस्यान्तकस्येव को वेगं संसहेद्रणे ॥
data.md: Who in battle can bear the force of arrows shot by Duryodhana, who, when worked ups with anger, resembles Death himself.

data.v: कर्णेन च कृतो राजा विमुखः शत्रुतापनः । बलवाँल्लघुहस्तश्च कृती युद्धविशारदः ॥
data.md: The powerful light-handed and successful king Yudhishthira, expert in fighting and the scorcher of his enemies, was compelled by Karna to retreat from the battle-field.

data.v: राधेयः पाण्डवश्रेष्ठं शक्तः पीडयितुं रणे । सहितो धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रैः शूरो महात्मभिः ॥
data.md: Accompanied by the highly powerful and heroic sons of Dhritarashtra the son of Radha is capable of afflicting the Pandava chief in battle.

data.v: तस्यैवं युध्यमानस्य संग्रामे संयतात्मनः । अन्यैरपि च पार्थस्य हृतं वर्म महारथैः ॥
data.md: While the self-controlled Partha fighting with them, other great car-warriors brought about his discomfiture.

data.v: उपवासकृशो राजा भृशं भरतसत्तम । ब्राह्मे बले स्थितो ह्येष न क्षत्रेऽतिबले विभो ॥
data.md: O foremost of Bharatas, the king is great emaciated with fasts. He is gifted with the force of a Brahmana, but he is not endued with Kshatriya prowess.

data.v: न जीवति महाराजो मन्ये पार्थ युधिष्ठिरः । यद्भीमसेनः सहते सिंहनादममर्षणः ॥
data.md: I think, O Partha, the king, Yudhishthira has fallen, since the wrathful Bhimasena, the slayer of his enemies, is calmy bearing the leonine shouts repeatedly sent up by Dhritarashtra's sons desirous of achieving victory and blowing their conch-shells.

data.v: नर्दतां धार्तराष्ट्राणां पुनः पुनररिंदम । धमतां च महाशङ्खान्संग्रामे जितकाशिनाम् ॥
युधिष्ठिरं पाण्डवेयं हतेति भरतर्षभ । संचोदयत्यसौ कर्णो धार्तराष्ट्रान्महाबलान् ॥
data.md: Indeed, O foremost of men, Pandu's son Yudhishthira is slain. See Karna is exciting the great car-warrior of Dhritarashtra's army. The powerful car-warriors are covering the son of Pritha with a down-pour of various weapons such as Indrajala, Sthunakarna and Pasupata.

data.v: स्थूणाकर्णेन्द्रजालेन पार्थ पाशुपतेन च । प्रच्छादयन्तो राजानमनुयान्ति महारथाः । आतुरो मे मतो राजा संनिषेव्यश्च भारत ॥
यथैनमनुवर्तन्ते पाञ्चालाः सह पाण्डवैः । त्वरमाणास्त्वराकाले सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वराः । मज्जन्तमिव पाताले बलिनोऽप्युज्जिहीर्षवः ॥
data.md: Forsooth, O Arjuna, the king is greatly wounded and weakened, since the Panchalas, the wielders of all sorts of weapons, accompanied with Pandavas, are following him hurriedly at a time when it is necessary to display speed like unto men rushing to rescue a man sinking under earth.

data.v: न केतुर्दृश्यते राज्ञः कर्णेन निहतः शरैः । पश्यतोर्यमयोः पार्थ सात्यकेश्च शिखण्डिनः ॥
धृष्टद्युम्नस्य भीमस्य शतानीकस्य वा विभो । पाञ्चालानां च सर्वेषां चेदीनां चैव भारत ॥
एष कर्णो रणे पार्थ पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् । शरैर्विध्वंसयति वै नलिनीमिव कुञ्जरः ॥
एते द्रवन्ति रथिनस्त्वदीयाः पाण्डुनन्दन । पश्य पश्य यथा पार्थ गच्छन्त्येते महारथाः ॥
data.md: The car-warriors of your army, O son of Pandu, are flying away. See, O Partha, how they are taking to their heels.

data.v: एते भारत मातङ्गाः कर्णेनाभिहता रणे । आर्तनादान्विकुर्वाणा विद्रवन्ति दिशो दश ॥
data.md: Struck by Karna in battle, O Arjuna the elephants are flying away in ten directions yelling cries of pain.

data.v: रथानां द्रवतां वृन्दं पश्य पार्थ समन्ततः । द्राव्यमाणं रणे चैव कर्णेनामित्रकर्शिना ॥
data.md: Pursued in battle by Karna, the grinder of his enemies the collection of cars is dispersed on all sides.

data.v: हस्तिकक्ष्यां रणे पश्य चरन्तीं तत्र तत्र ह । रथस्थं सूतपुत्रस्य केतुं केतुमतां वर ॥
data.md: O foremost of those leading standards, see the standard the bearing the emblem of an elephant of charioteer's son is moving about all over (the field).

data.v: असौ धावति राधेयो भीमसेनरथं प्रति । किरञ्शरशतानीव विनिघ्नंस्तव वाहिनीम् ॥
data.md: There the son of Radha runs after Bhimasena scattering hundreds of arrows and killing your soldiers.

data.v: एतान्पश्य च पाञ्चालान्द्राव्यमाणान्महात्मना । शक्रेणेव यथा दैत्यान्हन्यमानान्महाहवे ॥
data.md: There the powerful Panchala car-warriors are being dispersed (by him) like the Daityas slain by Sakra in the great battle.

data.v: एष कर्णो रणे जित्वा पाञ्चालान्पाण्डुसृञ्जयान् । दिशो विप्रेक्षते सर्वास्त्वदर्थमिति मे मतिः ॥
data.md: Having defeated the Panchalas, Pandavas and Srinjayas, Karna is casting his eyes on all sides, methinks, for finding you out.

data.v: पश्य पार्थ धनुः श्रेष्ठं विकर्षन्साधु शोभते । शत्रूञ्जित्वा यथा शक्रो देवसंघैः समावृतः ॥
data.md: See Partha, how beautiful he looks while drawing his best of bows as did shine Shakra in the midst of the celestials after having defeated his enemies.

data.v: एते नदन्ति कौरव्या दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य विक्रमम् । त्रासयन्तो रणे पार्थान्सृञ्जयांश्च सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: Witnessing Karna's power there the Kauravas are shouting and striking terror to the Pandavas and Srinjayas.

data.v: एष सर्वात्मना पाण्डूंस्त्रासयित्वा महारणे । अभिभाषति राधेयः सर्वसैन्यानि मानदः ॥
data.md: Having thus terrified the Pandavas in the great battle with all his force, the son of Radha, O giver of honor, addressing his army said-

data.v: अभिद्रवत गच्छध्वं द्रुतं द्रवत कौरवाः । यथा जीवन्न वः कश्चिन्मुच्यते युधि सृञ्जयः ॥
data.md: “May you fare well, O Kauravas. Do you move on with such a force that no Srinjaya can escape from the battle-field with his life.

data.v: तथा कुरुत संयत्ता वयं यास्याम पृष्ठतः । एवमुक्त्वा ययावेष पृष्ठतो विकिरञ्शरैः ॥
data.md: Do so in a body. We will follow you." Saying this he followed them shooting his arrow.

data.v: पश्य कर्णं रणे पार्थ श्वेतच्छविविराजितम् । उदयं पर्वतं यद्वच्छोभयन्वै दिवाकरः ॥
data.md: See Partha, Karna is shining in the battlefield with a white umbrella like the Udaya (rising mountain) beautified with the moon.

data.v: पूर्णचन्द्रनिकाशेन मूर्ध्नि छत्रेण भारत । ध्रियमाणेन समरे तथा शतशलाकिना ॥
एष त्वां प्रेक्षते कर्णः सकटाक्षो विशां पते । उत्तमं यत्नमास्थाय ध्रुवमेष्यति संयुगे ॥
data.md: With this umbrella of a hundred ribs resembling the full-moon held over his head he is casting his looks around for you. Forsooth, he will come here quickly.

data.v: पश्य ह्येनं महाबाहो विधुन्वानं महद्धनुः । शरांश्चाशीविषाकारान्विसृजन्तं महाबलम् ॥
data.md: See, O you of large arms, he is drawing a huge bow shooting, in the great battle, arrows resembling deadly serpents.

data.v: असौ निवृत्तो राधेयो दृश्यते वानरध्वज । वधाय चात्मनोऽभ्येति दीपस्य शलभो यथा ॥
कर्णमेकाकिनं दृष्ट्वा रथानीकेन भारत । रिरक्षिषुः सुसंयत्तो धार्तराष्ट्रोऽभिवर्तते ॥
data.md: O Partha and bringing on his destruction like an insect approaching a burning flame. This wrathful hero is engaged in the well-being of Dhritarashtra's son; that own W one of wicked understanding always seeks to injure you. Seeing Karna alone Dhritarashtra's son is turning with his car force to protect him.

data.v: सार्वैः सहैभिर्दुष्टात्मा वध्य एष प्रयत्नतः । त्वया यशश्च राज्यं च सुखं चोत्तममिच्छता ॥
data.md: That wicked man with all his followers should be killed by you with all care if you wish to secure fame, kingdom and happiness.

data.v: आत्मानं च कृतात्मानं समीक्ष्य भरतर्षभ । कृतागसं च राधेयं धर्मात्मनि युधिष्ठिरे ॥
data.md: O foremost of Bharatas, knowing yourself self-controlled and Karna cherishing animosity against the pious Yudhishthira, O son of Kunti, make use of this good opportunity.

data.v: प्रतिपद्यस्व राधेयं प्राप्तकालमनन्तरम् । आर्यां युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा प्रत्येहि रथयूथपम् ॥
पञ्च ह्येतानि मुख्यानां रथानां रथसत्तम । शतान्यायान्ति वेगेन बलिनां भीमतेजसाम् ॥
पञ्च नागसहस्राणि द्विगुणा वाजिनस्तथा । अभिसंहत्य कौन्तेय पदातिप्रयुतानि च । अन्योन्यरक्षितं वीर बलं त्वामभिवर्तते ॥
सूतपुत्रे महेष्वासे दर्शयात्मानमात्मना । उत्तमं यत्नमास्थाय प्रत्येहि भरतर्षभ ॥
असौ कर्णः सुसंरब्धः पाञ्चालानभिधावति । केतुमस्य हि पश्यामि धृष्टद्युम्नरथं प्रति । समुच्छेत्स्यति पाञ्चालानिति मन्ये परंतप ॥
data.md: Worked up up with anger there Karna advances against the Panchalas. I see his standard approaching the car of Dhristadyumna, forsooth.

data.v: आचक्षे ते प्रियं पार्थ तदेवं भरतर्षभ । राजा जीवति कौरव्यो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥
असौ भीमो महाबाहुः संनिवृत्तश्चमूमुखे । वृतः सृञ्जयसैन्येन सात्यकेन च भारत ॥
वध्यन्त एते समरे कौरवा निशितैः शरैः । भीमसेनेन कौन्तेय पाञ्चालैश्च महात्मभिः ॥
data.md: He is surrounded by the Srinjayas and Satyaki. There in battle the Kuru soldiers are being killed in battle with sharp arrows by Bhimasena and the high-souled Panchalas.

data.v: सेना हि धार्तराष्ट्रस्य विमुखा चाभवद्रणात् । विप्रधावति वेगेन भीमस्य निहता शरैः ॥
data.md: Wounded with Bhima's arrows, Duryodhana's army, retreating and bathed in blood, are quickly flying away.

data.v: विपन्नसस्येव मही रुधिरेण समुक्षिता । भारती भरतश्रेष्ठ सेना कृपणदर्शना ॥
data.md: Covered with blood the Bharata is looking poorly like the earth divested of crops.

data.v: निवृत्तं पश्य कौन्तेय भीमसेनं युधां पतिम् । आशीविषमिव क्रुद्धं तस्माद्द्रवति वाहिनी ॥
data.md: Behold, O son of Kunti, Bhimasena, the commander of your army, worked up with anger like a serpent, is assailing the (Kuru) troops.

data.v: पीतरक्तासितसितास्ताराचन्द्रार्कमण्डिताः । पताका विप्रकीर्यन्ते छत्राण्येतानि चार्जुन ॥
data.md: Look, O Arjuna, at the yellow, crimson, black and white banners painted with stars, moons and suns and innumerable umbrellas scattered all over the field.

data.v: सौवर्णा राजताश्चैव तैजसाश्च पृथग्विधाः । केतवो विनिपात्यन्ते हस्त्यश्वं विप्रकीर्यते ॥
data.md: Standards, made of gold, silver and other metals, are lying about and there lie scattered slain horses.

data.v: रथेभ्यः प्रपतन्त्येते रथिनो विगतासवः । नानावर्णैर्हता बाणैः पाञ्चालैरपलायिभिः ॥
data.md: Car-warriors, deprived of their life, are dropping down from cars, killed by the unretreating Panchalas with variegated arrows.

data.v: निर्मनुष्यान्गजानश्वान्रथांश्चैव धनंजय । समाद्रवन्ति पाञ्चाला धार्तराष्ट्रांस्तरस्विनः ॥
data.md: There the quick-coursing Panchalas, O Dhananjaya, are rushing against the elephants, horses and cars belonging the Dhritarashtra's party, divested of their riders. O foremost of men, O slayer of enemies, your warriors, giving up the love of their lives and invincible in battle, are, aided by Bhimasena's power, grinding the enemy's army.

data.v: मृद्नन्ति च नरव्याघ्रा भीमसेनव्यपाश्रयात् । बलं परेषां दुर्धर्षं त्यक्त्वा प्राणानरिंदम ॥
एते नदन्ति पाञ्चाला धमन्त्यपि च वारिजान् । अभिद्रवन्ति च रणे निघ्नन्तः सायकैः परान् ॥
पश्य स्वर्गस्य माहात्म्यं पाञ्चाला हि परंतप । धार्तराष्ट्रान्विनिघ्नन्ति क्रुद्धाः सिंहा इव द्विपान् ॥
data.md: Look at their greatness. through their power the Panchalas are killing Dhritarashtra's soldiers as the angry lions kill the tigers.

data.v: सर्वतश्चाभिपन्नैषा धार्तराष्ट्री महाचमूः । पाञ्चालैर्मानसादेत्य हंसैर्गङ्गेव वेगितैः ॥
data.md: Like quick-coursing swans leaving Manasa lake and running into the Ganges the Panchalas are rushing against the Kuru army and are assailing every part of the huge force of Duryodhana.

data.v: सुभृशं च पराक्रान्ताः पाञ्चालानां निवारणे । कृपकर्णादयो वीरा ऋषभाणामिवर्षभाः ॥
data.md: Like bulls withstanding bulls, Kripa, Karna and other warriors with all their energy are resisting the Panchalas.

data.v: सुनिमग्नांश्च भीमास्त्रैर्धार्तराष्ट्रान्महारथान् । धृष्टद्युम्नमुखा वीरा घ्नन्ति शत्रून्सहस्रशः । विषण्णभूयिष्ठरथा धार्तराष्ट्री महाचमूः ॥
data.md: The heroes, headed by Dhristadyumna, are killing thousands of their enemies, the great car-warriors of Duryodhana's force, already sunk in the ocean of Bhima's weapons.

data.v: पश्य भीमेन नाराचैश्छिन्ना नागाः पतन्त्यमी । वज्रिवज्राहतानीव शिखराणि महीभृताम् ॥
data.md: See, these elephants, struck by Bhima with his Narachas, are dropping down like the summits of mountains clapped by Indra's thunder-bolt.

data.v: भीमसेनस्य निर्विद्धा बाणैः संनतपर्वभिः । स्वान्यनीकानि मृद्नन्तो द्रवन्त्येते महागजाः ॥
data.md: There the huge elephants, wounded by Bhima with his arrows, are flying away crushing their own army.

data.v: नाभिजानासि भीमस्य सिंहनादं दुरुत्सहम् । नदतोऽर्जुन संग्रामे वीरस्य जितकाशिनः ॥
data.md: Do you not recognise the leonine shouts of Bhima, O Arjuna, who, worked up with the desire of achieving victory, is roaring.

data.v: एष नैषादिरभ्येति द्विपमुख्येन पाण्डवम् । जिघांसुस्तोमरैः क्रुद्धो दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः ॥
data.md: There worked up with anger the Prince of Nishadas is advancing on his best of cars, like Death himself armed with his rod against the son of Pandu for killing him with his Tomara.

data.v: सतोमरावस्य भुजौ छिन्नौ भीमेन गर्जतः । तीक्ष्णैरग्निशिखाप्रख्यैर्नाराचैर्दशभिर्हतः ॥
data.md: His two arms with Tomaras are cut-off by Bhima with ten sharpened Narachas effulgent like fire of the sun.

data.v: हत्वैनं पुनरायाति नागानन्यान्प्रहारिणः । पश्य नीलाम्बुदनिभान्महामात्रैरधिष्ठितान् । शक्तितोमरसंकाशैर्विनिघ्नन्तं वृकोदरम् ॥
data.md: Killing him he is proceeding against other elephants resembling a mass of dark blue clouds and driven by riders. They are striking Vrikodara with Saktis and Tomaras.

data.v: सप्त सप्त च नागांस्तान्वैजयन्तीश्च सध्वजाः । निहत्य निशितैर्बाणैश्छिन्नाः पार्थाग्रजेन ते । दशभिर्दशभिश्चैको नाराचैर्निहतो गजः ॥
data.md: Slaying those forty-nine elephants with sharp arrows Parthas' elder brother is striking down their victorious standards.

data.v: न चासौ धार्तराष्ट्राणां श्रूयते निनदस्तथा । पुरंदरसमे क्रुद्धे निवृत्ते भरतर्षभे ॥
data.md: The other elephants were killed each with ten Narachas. The war-cries of Dhritarashtra's soldiers are no longer audible since (Bhima), like Purandara himself, is engaged in battle.

data.v: अक्षौहिण्यस्तथा तिस्रो धार्तराष्ट्रस्य संहताः । क्रुद्धेन नरसिंहेन भीमसेनेन वारिताः ॥
data.md: Three Akshauhini of Dhritarashtra's soldiers have been arranged and they all have been thwarted by angry Bhima, the foremost of men.

data.v: भीमसेनेन तत्कर्म कृतं दृष्ट्वा सुदुष्करम् । अर्जुनो व्यधमच्छिष्टानहितान्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Beholding that arduous task accomplished by Bhima Arjuna, with his sharp arrows, killed the remaining enemies.

data.v: ते वध्यमानाः समरे संशप्तकगणाः प्रभो । शक्रस्यातिथितां गत्वा विशोका ह्यभवन्मुदा ॥
data.md: O sovereign! The mighty samsaptakas have run away to ten directions on account of their severe slaughter in battle-field and the departing as also loss of courage. A number of other warriors got immediate relief by joining Indra as his guest.

data.v: पार्थश्च पुरुषव्याघ्रः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः । जघान धार्तराष्ट्रस्य चतुर्विधबलां चमूम् ॥
data.md: Lion heart Partha killed the Caturangini army (infantry, chariot-rider, horse-riders and elephant-riders) led by Duryodhana by shooting arrows with bent nodes.

data.v: निवृत्ते भीमसेने च पाण्डवे च युधिष्ठिरे । वध्यमाने बले चापि मामके पाण्डुसृञ्जयैः ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said When Bhimasena and Pandu's Yudhishthira were fighting, when my soldiers were being killed by the Pandavas and Srinjayas, when my army was routed and dispirited tell me, O Sanjaya, what did the Kauravas do. son

data.v: द्रवमाणे बलौघे च निराक्रन्दे मुहुर्मुहुः । किमकुर्वन्त कुरवस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥
दृष्ट्वा भीमं महाबाहुं सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । क्रोधरक्तेक्षणो राजन्भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Seeing the mighty-armed Bhima the valiant Karna, with eyes, reddened in anger, rushed towards him.

data.v: तावकं च बलं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनात्पराङ्मुखम् । यत्नेन महता राजन्पर्यवस्थापयद्बली ॥
data.md: Beholding your soldiers routed by Bhima the powerful Karna rallied them again with great exertion.

data.v: व्यवस्थाप्य महाबाहुस्तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम् । प्रत्युद्ययौ तदा कर्णः पाण्डवान्युद्धदुर्मदान् ॥
data.md: Having collected your son's force the largearmed Karna advanced against the heroic Pandavas invincible in battle. Drawing their bows and discharging arrows the great carwarriors of the Pandavas advanced against the son of Radha.

data.v: प्रत्युद्ययुस्तु राधेयं पाण्डवानां महारथाः । धुन्वानाः कार्मुकाण्याजौ विक्षिपन्तश्च सायकान् ॥
data.md: Having collected your son's force the largearmed Karna advanced against the heroic Pandavas invincible in battle. Drawing their bows and discharging arrows the great carwarriors of the Pandavas advanced against the son of Radha.

data.v: भीमसेनः शिनेर्नप्ता शिखण्डी जनमेजयः । धृष्टद्युम्नश्च बलवान्सर्वे चापि प्रभद्रकाः ॥
data.md: Worked up with anger and desiring for victory Bhimasena, the grandson of Sini, Shikhandi Janamejaya, the powerful Dhristadyumna, all the Prabhadrakas and the Panchalas advanced furiously from all directions against your army.

data.v: पाञ्चालाश्च नरव्याघ्राः समन्तात्तव वाहिनीम् । अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धाः समरे जितकाशिनः ॥
data.md: Worked up with anger and desiring for victory Bhimasena, the grandson of Sini, Shikhandi Janamejaya, the powerful Dhristadyumna, all the Prabhadrakas and the Panchalas advanced furiously from all directions against your army.

data.v: तथैव तावका राजन्पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् । अभ्यद्रवन्त त्वरिता जिघांसन्तो महारथाः ॥
data.md: In the same way the powerful car-warriors of your host speedily advanced against the Pandava army desirous of killing them.

data.v: रथनागाश्वकलिलं पत्तिध्वजसमाकुलम् । बभूव पुरुषव्याघ्र सैन्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् ॥
data.md: The hosts, abounding in cars, elephants, the cavalry and infantry, looked exceedingly wonderful.

data.v: शिखण्डी च ययौ कर्णं धृष्टद्युम्नः सुतं तव । दुःशासनं महाराज महत्या सेनया वृतम् ॥
data.md: Shikhandi rushed against Karna and Dhristadyumna, accompanied by a great force, proceeded against your son Dushasana.

data.v: नकुलो वृषसेनं च चित्रसेनं युधिष्ठिरः । उलूकं समरे राजन्सहदेवः समभ्ययात् ॥
data.md: Nakula against Vrishasena and Yudhishthira advanced against Chitrasena; Sahadeva proceeded against Uluka in that battle. two ran

data.v: सात्यकिः शकुनिं चापि भीमसेनश्च कौरवान् । अर्जुनं च रणे यत्तं द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः ॥
data.md: Satyaki proceeded against Shakuni and the sons of Draupadi against other Kauravas. And the great car-warrior Drona's son proceeded against Arjuna in that battle.

data.v: युधामन्युं महेष्वासं गौतमोऽभ्यपतद्रणे । कृतवर्मा च बलवानुत्तमौजसमाद्रवत् ॥
data.md: Gautama encountered in battle the great bowman Yudhamanyu. And the powerful Kritavarma rushed against Uttamoujasa.

data.v: भीमसेनः कुरून्सर्वान्पुत्रांश्च तव मारिष । सहानीकान्महाबाहुरेक एवाभ्यवारयत् ॥
data.md: The large-armed Bhimasena alone withstood all your sons with their armies.

data.v: शिखण्डी च ततः कर्णं विचरन्तमभीतवत् । भीष्महन्ता महाराज वारयामास पत्रिभिः ॥
data.md: Thereupon Shikhandi, the slayer of Bhishma, with winged arrows, obstructed Karna ranging fearlessly in the battle-field).

data.v: प्रतिरब्धस्ततः कर्णो रोषात्प्रस्फुरिताधरः । शिखण्डिनं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्भ्रुवोर्मध्ये व्यताडयत् ॥
data.md: Thus obstructed and with his lips trembling in anger Karna struck Shikhandi on the forehead with three arrows.

data.v: धारयंस्तु स तान्बाणाञ्शिखण्डी बह्वशोभत । राजतः पर्वतो यद्वत्त्रिभिः शृङ्गैः समन्वितः ॥
data.md: Carrying three arrows Shikhandi shone there like a silver mountain with three elevated summits.

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः सूतपुत्रेण संयुगे । कर्णं विव्याध समरे नवत्या निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Sorely wounded by Karna in that battle that great bowman struck him in return with ninety sharp arrows.

data.v: तस्य कर्णो हयान्हत्वा सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः । उन्ममाथ ध्वजं चास्य क्षुरप्रेण महारथः ॥
data.md: Having slain his horses and driver with three arrows the great car-warrior Karna struck down his standard with a razor-shaped arrow.

data.v: हताश्वात्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य महारथः । शक्तिं चिक्षेप कर्णाय संक्रुद्धः शत्रुतापनः ॥
data.md: Then jumping down from his horseless car that great car-warrior, the aggrandiser of his enemies, discharged a dart in anger at Karna.

data.v: तां छित्त्वा समरे कर्णस्त्रिभिर्भारत सायकैः । शिखण्डिनमथाविध्यन्नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Cutting it off in battle with three arrows Karna struck Shikhandi with nine sharp arrows.

data.v: कर्णचापच्युतान्बाणान्वर्जयंस्तु नरोत्तमः । अपयातस्ततस्तूर्णं शिखण्डी जयतां वरः ॥
data.md: Avoiding arrows shot off Karna's bow Shikhandi, greatly wounded, quickly retreated from the field.

data.v: ततः कर्णो महाराज पाण्डुसैन्यान्यशातयत् । तूलराशिं समासाद्य यथा वायुर्महाजवः ॥
data.md: O king, then Karna fell on the Pandava army as the violent wind disperses a pack of cotton.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज तव पुत्रेण पीडितः । दुःशासनं त्रिभिर्बाणैरभ्यविध्यत्स्तनान्तरे ॥
data.md: Wounded by your son Dhristadyumna struck, in return, Dushasana on the breast with three arrows.

data.v: तस्य दुःशासनो बाहुं सव्यं विव्याध मारिष । शितेन रुक्मपुङ्खेन भल्लेन नतपर्वणा ॥
data.md: Then Dushasana struck the left arm of his enemy with a sharp gold feathered, winged arrows.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु निर्विद्धः शरं घोरममर्षणः । दुःशासनाय संक्रुद्धः प्रेषयामास भारत ॥
data.md: Thus wounded and filled with terrible rage Dhristadyumna shot arrows at Dushasana.

data.v: आपतन्तं महावेगं धृष्टद्युम्नसमीरितम् । शरैश्चिच्छेद पुत्रस्ते त्रिभिरेव विशां पते ॥
data.md: O king, with three arrows your son cut-off the shaft discharged by Dhristadyumna which was about to fall with great force.

data.v: अथापरैः सप्तदशैर्भल्लैः कनकभूषणैः । धृष्टद्युम्नं समासाद्य बाह्वोरुरसि चार्दयत् ॥
data.md: Then approaching Dhristadyumna he struck him on the breast and two arms with seventeen other gold winged arrows.

data.v: ततः स पार्षतः क्रुद्धो धनुश्चिच्छेद मारिष । क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः ॥
data.md: Then worked up with anger Prisata's son cut-off his bow with a sharp razor shaped arrow at which all his people shouted out.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय पुत्रस्ते भरतर्षभ । धृष्टद्युम्नं शरव्रातैः समन्तात्पर्यवारयत् ॥
data.md: Your son, however, taking up another bow, smilingly covered Dhristadyumna with wounds of arrows.

data.v: तव पुत्रस्य ते दृष्ट्वा विक्रमं तं महात्मनः । व्यहसन्त रणे योधाः सिद्धाश्चाप्सरसां गणाः ॥
data.md: Beholding the prowess of your high-souled son all the warriors in the field, Siddhas and Apsaras were filled surprise.

data.v: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तावकानां परैः सह । घोरं प्राणभृतां काले घोररूपं परंतप ॥
data.md: O slayer of enemies, then ensued a dreadful and destructive encounter between your people and your enemy's host.

data.v: नकुलं वृषसेनस्तु विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिरायसैः । पितुः समीपे तिष्ठन्तं त्रिभिरन्यैरविध्यत ॥
data.md: Standing by his father's side Vrishasena struck Nakula with five iron arrows and again wounded with three others.

data.v: नकुलस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो वृषसेनं स्मयन्निव । नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन विव्याध हृदये दृढम् ॥
data.md: The heroic Nakula however smiling struck Vrishasena on the breast with a sharp Naracha.

data.v: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुकर्शनः । शत्रुं विव्याध विंशत्या स च तं पञ्चभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: Thus wounded greatly by his powerful enemy that grinder of his enemies struck his adversary with twenty five arrows.

data.v: ततः शरसहस्रेण तावुभौ पुरुषर्षभौ । अन्योन्यमाच्छादयतामथाभज्यत वाहिनी ॥
data.md: Those two foremost of men covered each other with thousands of arrows at which their respective battalions broke.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा तु प्रद्रुतां सेनां धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सूतजः । निवारयामास बलादनुपत्य विशां पते । निवृत्ते तु ततः कर्णे नकुलः कौरवान्ययौ ॥
data.md: Seeing Duryodhana's soldiers quickly flying away Karna, O king, prevented them with force.

data.v: कर्णपुत्रस्तु समरे हित्वा नकुलमेव तु । जुगोप चक्रं त्वरितं राधेयस्यैव मारिष ॥
data.md: After Karna's departure Nakula proceeded against the Kauravas. Avoiding Nakula in battle Karna's son quickly went to Karna, who was guarding the passage of his chariot.

data.v: उलूकस्तु रणे क्रुद्धः सहदेवेन वारितः । तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा सहदेवः प्रतापवान् । सारथिं प्रेषयामास यमस्य सदनं प्रति ॥
data.md: Angry Uluka was restrained by Sahadeva in battle. Having killed his four horse the powerful Sahadeva dispatched his charioteer to the abode of Yama.

data.v: उलूकस्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य विशां पते । त्रिगर्तानां बलं पूर्णं जगाम पितृनन्दनः ॥
data.md: Then leaping down from his car O king, Uluka, the joy of his sire, soon advanced against the host of Trigarttas.

data.v: सात्यकिः शकुनिं विद्ध्वा विंशत्या निशितैः शरैः । ध्वजं चिच्छेद भल्लेन सौबलस्य हसन्निव ॥
data.md: Having pierced Shakuni with twenty sharp arrows Satyaki, as if smiling, struck down the standard of Subala's son with his dart.

data.v: सौबलस्तस्य समरे क्रुद्धो राजन्प्रतापवान् । विदार्य कवचं भूयो ध्वजं चिच्छेद काञ्चनम् ॥
data.md: O king, the powerful son of Subala too, worked up with anger, cutting off his coat of mail, again sundered his golden standard.

data.v: अथैनं निशितैर्बाणैः सात्यकिः प्रत्यविध्यत । सारथिं च महाराज त्रिभिरेव समार्दयत् । अथास्य वाहांस्त्वरितः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥
data.md: Then Satyaki pierced him in return with sharpened arrows and also pierced his charioteer with three arrows.

data.v: ततोऽवप्लुत्य सहसा शकुनिर्भरतर्षभ । आरुरोह रथं तूर्णमुलूकस्य महारथः । अपोवाहाथ शीघ्रं स शैनेयाद्युद्धशालिनः ॥
सात्यकिस्तु रणे राजंस्तावकानामनीकिनीम् । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन ततोऽनीकमभिद्यत ॥
data.md: Then that hero, expert in fighting, soon took away Sini's grandson. Then O king, Satyaki, with great force, advanced against your army at which they were all routed.

data.v: शैनेयशरनुन्नं तु ततः सैन्यं विशां पते । भेजे दश दिशस्तूर्णं न्यपतच्च गतासुवत् ॥
data.md: Covered with arrows shot by Sini's grandson your soldiers, O king, fled away in all directions and dropped down dead.
