data.md: When after Karna's fall Partha sent up leonine war-cries your sons were possessed by a mighty fear.

data.v: तान्समाश्वास्य तु तदा मद्रराजः प्रतापवान् । व्यूह्य व्यूहं महाराज सर्वतोभद्रमृद्धिमत् ॥
प्रत्युद्यातो रणे पार्थान्मद्रराजः प्रतापवान् । विधुन्वन्कार्मुकं चित्रं भारघ्नं वेगवत्तरम् ॥
data.md: Assuring him the valiant king of the Madras, having formed, O king, a grand array, proceeded against the Parthas in battle. And the brave king of the Madras possessed, shaking his beautiful and strong bow capable of shooting arrows with great force.

data.v: रथप्रवरमास्थाय सैन्धवाश्वं महारथः । तस्य सीता महाराज रथस्थाशोभयद्रथम् ॥
data.md: And that mighty car-warrior drove an excellent car having horses of the Sindhu breed yoked to it. Riding upon his car, his driver made the car resplendent.

data.v: स तेन संवृतो वीरो रथेनामित्रकर्शनः । तस्थौ शूरो महाराज पुत्राणां ते भयप्रणुत् ॥
data.md: Protected by that car, that hero, that brave destroyer of foes, stood, O king dissipating the fears of your sons.

data.v: प्रयाणे मद्रराजोऽभून्मुखं व्यूहस्य दंशितः । मद्रकैः सहितो वीरैः कर्णपुत्रैश्च दुर्जयैः ॥
data.md: The king of the Madras, clad in mail, proceeded at the head of the army accompanied by the brave Madrakas and the invincible sons of Karna.

data.v: सव्येऽभूत्कृतवर्मा च त्रिगर्तैः परिवारितः । गौतमो दक्षिणे पार्श्वे शकैश्च यवनैः सह ॥
data.md: On the left stood Kritavarman, surrounded by the Trigartas. On the right was (Kripa) with the Sakas and the Yavanas.

data.v: अश्वत्थामा पृष्ठतोऽभूत्काम्बोजैः परिवारितः । दुर्योधनोऽभवन्मध्ये रक्षितः कुरुपुंगवैः ॥
data.md: In the rear was Ashvathaman surrounded by the Kambojas. In the centre was Duryodhana, protected by the best of Kuru warriors.

data.v: हयानीकेन महता सौबलश्चापि संवृतः । प्रययौ सर्वसैन्येन कैतव्यश्च महारथः ॥
data.md: Surrounded by a large army of cavalry and other troops, Subala's son, Sakuni, as also the great car-warrior, Uluka, proceeded with others.

data.v: पाण्डवाश्च महेष्वासा व्यूह्य सैन्यमरिंदमाः । त्रिधा भूत्वा महाराज तव सैन्यमुपाद्रवन् ॥
data.md: The great bowmen amongst the Pandavas, those chastisers of foes, dividing themselves, O king, into three divisions, rushed against your troops.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च सात्यकिश्च महारथः । शल्यस्य वाहिनीं तूर्णमभिदुद्रुवुराहवे ॥
data.md: Dhrishtadyumna and Shikhandin and the great car-warrior Satyaki proceeded quickly against the army of Shalya.

data.v: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा स्वेनानीकेन संवृतः । शल्यमेवाभिदुद्राव जिघांसुर्भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Then king Yudhishthira, accompanied by his soldiers, rushed against Shalya alone, with a view to kill him, O best of Bharata's race.

data.v: हार्दिक्यं तु महेष्वासमर्जुनः शत्रुपूगहा । संशप्तकगणांश्चैव वेगतोऽभिविदुद्रुवे ॥
data.md: Arjuna, the slayer of foes, rushed against that great bowman, Kritavarman and the Samsaptakas.

data.v: गौतमं भीमसेनो वै सोमकाश्च महारथाः । अभ्यद्रवन्त राजेन्द्र जिघांसन्तः परान्युधि ॥
data.md: Bhimasena and the great car-warriors among the Somakas rushed, O monarch, against Kripa, desirous of killing their enemies in battle.

data.v: माद्रीपुत्रौ तु शकुनिमुलूकं च महारथौ । ससैन्यौ सहसेनौ तावुपतस्थतुराहवे ॥
data.md: The two sons of Madri, accompanied by their soldiers, proceeded against Sakuni and the great car-warrior Uluka at the head of their forces.

data.v: तथैवायुतशो योधास्तावकाः पाण्डवान्रणे । अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धा विविधायुधपाणयः ॥
data.md: Similarly, thousands of warriors, of your army, armed with various weapons and filled with anger, proceeded against the Pandavas in that battle.

data.v: हते भीष्मे महेष्वासे द्रोणे कर्णे महारथे । कुरुष्वल्पावशिष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु च संयुगे ॥
data.md: Dhritarashtra said After the fall of the great bowmen Bhishma and Drona and the great car-warrior Karna and after both the Kurus and the Pandavas had been lessened in numbers and when the powerful Parthas became once more angry in battle, what, O Sanjaya, was the strength of each of the armies.

data.v: सुसंरब्धेषु पार्थेषु पराक्रान्तेषु संजय । मामकानां परेषां च किं शिष्टमभवद्बलम् ॥
यथा वयं परे राजन्युद्धाय समवस्थिताः । यावच्चासीद्बलं शिष्टं संग्रामे तन्निबोध मे ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Hear, O king, how we and the enemy both stood for battle on that occasion and what was then the relative strength of the two armies.

data.v: एकादश सहस्राणि रथानां भरतर्षभ । दश दन्तिसहस्राणि सप्त चैव शतानि च ॥
पूर्णे शतसहस्रे द्वे हयानां भरतर्षभ । नरकोट्यस्तथा तिस्रो बलमेतत्तवाभवत् ॥
रथानां षट्सहस्राणि षट्सहस्राश्च कुञ्जराः । दश चाश्वसहस्राणि पत्तिकोटी च भारत ॥
data.md: Six thousand cars, six thousand elephants, ten thousand horse and one million of foot, O Bharata, war the remnant of the Pandava force in that battle. These, O best of Bharata's race, met each other for battle.

data.v: एतद्बलं पाण्डवानामभवच्छेषमाहवे । एत एव समाजग्मुर्युद्धाय भरतर्षभ ॥
एवं विभज्य राजेन्द्र मद्रराजमते स्थिताः । पाण्डवान्प्रत्युदीयाम जयगृद्धाः प्रमन्यवः ॥
data.md: Having divided our armies in this way, O) king, we, worked up with wrath and filled with the desire of victory, rushed against the Pandavas, under the command of the king of the Madras.

data.v: तथैव पाण्डवाः शूराः समरे जितकाशिनः । उपयाता नरव्याघ्राः पाञ्चालाश्च यशस्विनः ॥
data.md: Similarly, the brave Pandavas, those foremost of men, desirous of killing their enemies, encountered one another early in the morning, O king.

data.v: एवमेते बलौघेन परस्परवधैषिणः । उपयाता नरव्याघ्राः पूर्वां संध्यां प्रति प्रभो ॥
data.md: Similarly, the brave Pandavas, those foremost of men, desirous of killing their enemies, encountered one another early in the morning, O king.

data.v: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं घोररूपं भयानकम् । तावकानां परेषां च निघ्नतामितरेतरम् ॥
data.md: Then began a battle once more that was highly terrific, between your troops and the enemy, that resembled the one between the gods and demons.

data.v: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरूणां भयवर्धनम् । सृञ्जयैः सह राजेन्द्र घोरं देवासुरोपमम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then took place the battle between the Kurus and the Srinjayas, O king, that was as fierce and awful as that between the celestials and the Asuras.

data.v: नरा रथा गजौघाश्च सादिनश्च सहस्रशः । वाजिनश्च पराक्रान्ताः समाजग्मुः परस्परम् ॥
data.md: Men and cars and elephants and elephantwarriors and horsemen by thousands and horses, all very powerful, encountered one another.

data.v: नागानां भीमरूपाणां द्रवतां निस्वनो महान् । अश्रूयत यथा काले जलदानां नभस्तले ॥
data.md: The loud noise of the rushing of dreadful elephants was then heard there, resembling the roars of the clouds in the sky in the rains.

data.v: नागैरभ्याहताः केचित्सरथा रथिनोऽपतन् । व्यद्रवन्त रणे वीरा द्राव्यमाणा मदोत्कटैः ॥
data.md: Some car-warriors, struck by elephants, were deprived of their cars. Dispersed by those infuriate animals, other brave heroes ran away.

data.v: हयौघान्पादरक्षांश्च रथिनस्तत्र शिक्षिताः । शरैः संप्रेषयामासुः परलोकाय भारत ॥
data.md: Well-trained car-warriors, O Bharata, with their arrows, killed a number of cavalry and infantry that urged and protected the elephants.

data.v: सादिनः शिक्षिता राजन्परिवार्य महारथान् । विचरन्तो रणेऽभ्यघ्नन्प्रासशक्त्यृष्टिभिस्तथा ॥
data.md: Well-trained horsemen, king, surrounding great car-warriors, moved about in the field, striking and slaying the latter with spears and draft and swords.

data.v: धन्विनः पुरुषाः केचित्संनिवार्य महारथान् । एकं बहव आसाद्य प्रेषयेयुर्यमक्षयम् ॥
नागं रथवरांश्चान्ये परिवार्य महारथाः । सोत्तरायुधिनं जघ्नुर्द्रवमाणा महारवम् ॥
तथा च रथिनं क्रुद्धं विकिरन्तं शरान्बहून् । नागा जघ्नुर्महाराज परिवार्य समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Similarly, O king, elephants, encircling individual car-warriors worked up with rage and shooting arrows, killed them.

data.v: नागो नागमभिद्रुत्य रथी च रथिनं रणे । शक्तितोमरनाराचैर्निजघ्नुस्तत्र तत्र ह ॥
data.md: Elephant-warrior rushing against elephantwarrior and car-warrior against car-warrior, in that battle, killed each other with darts and lances and Narachas, O Bharata.

data.v: पादातानवमृद्नन्तो रथवारणवाजिनः । रणमध्ये व्यदृश्यन्त कुर्वन्तो महदाकुलम् ॥
data.md: Cars and elephants and horses, crushing foot-soldiers in the midst of battle, mad a confusion all over.

data.v: हयाश्च पर्यधावन्त चामरैरुपशोभिताः । हंसा हिमवतः प्रस्थे पिबन्त इव मेदिनीम् ॥
data.md: Adorned with yak-tails, horses rushed on all sides, looking like the swans found on the plains at the foot of Himavat. In their speed they seemed as if ready to devour the very earth.

data.v: तेषां तु वाजिनां भूमिः खुरैश्चित्रा विशां पते । अशोभत यथा नारी करजक्षतविक्षता ॥
data.md: The field, O king, marked with the hoofs of horses, looked beautiful like a beautiful woman bearing the marks of (her lover's) nails on her person.

data.v: वाजिनां खुरशब्देन रथनेमिस्वनेन च । पत्तीनां चापि शब्देन नागानां बृंहितेन च ॥
data.md: With the sound caused by the trampling of horses, the wheels of cars, the shouts of footsoldiers, the grunts of clephants, the beating of drums and other musical instruments and the blare of conchs, the earth began to resound as if with deafening peals of thunder.

data.v: वादित्राणां च घोषेण शङ्खानां निस्वनेन च । अभवन्नादिता भूमिर्निर्घातैरिव भारत ॥
data.md: With the sound caused by the trampling of horses, the wheels of cars, the shouts of footsoldiers, the grunts of clephants, the beating of drums and other musical instruments and the blare of conchs, the earth began to resound as if with deafening peals of thunder.

data.v: धनुषां कूजमानानां निस्त्रिंशानां च दीप्यताम् । कवचानां प्रभाभिश्च न प्राज्ञायत किंचन ॥
data.md: On account of twanging bows and flashing swords and the glittering armour of the worriors everything was so confused there that nothing could be distinctly seen.

data.v: बहवो बाहवश्छिन्ना नागराजकरोपमाः । उद्वेष्टन्ते विवेष्टन्ते वेगं कुर्वन्ति दारुणम् ॥
data.md: Numerous arms, chooped off from human bodies and looking like the tusks of elephants, jumped up and moved furiously about.

data.v: शिरसां च महाराज पततां वसुधातले । च्युतानामिव तालेभ्यः फलानां श्रूयते स्वनः ॥
data.md: The sound, made, O monarch, by heads falling on the field of battle, resembled that made by the falling fruits of palmyra trees.

data.v: शिरोभिः पतितैर्भाति रुधिरार्द्रैर्वसुंधरा । तपनीयनिभैः काले नलिनैरिव भारत ॥
उद्वृत्तनयनैस्तैस्तु गतसत्त्वैः सुविक्षतैः । व्यभ्राजत महाराज पुण्डरीकैरिवावृता ॥
data.md: Covered with those lifeless heads with upturned eyes, that were exceedingly mangled the field of battle, O king, looked resplendent as if covered with full-blown lotuses.

data.v: बाहुभिश्चन्दनादिग्धैः सकेयूरैर्महाधनैः । पतितैर्भाति राजेन्द्र मही शक्रध्वजैरिव ॥
data.md: With the fallen arms of the warriors smeared with sandal and adorned with rich Keyuras, the Earth looked resplendent as if strewn with the rich poles set up in Indra's honours.

data.v: ऊरुभिश्च नरेन्द्राणां विनिकृत्तैर्महाहवे । हस्तिहस्तोपमैरन्यैः संवृतं तद्रणाङ्गणम् ॥
data.md: The battle-field-was covered with the things of kings, cut off in that battle and looking like the trunk of elephants.

data.v: कबन्धशतसंकीर्णं छत्रचामरशोभितम् । सेनावनं तच्छुशुभे वनं पुष्पाचितं यथा ॥
data.md: Covered with hundreds of headless trunks and strewn with umbrellas and yakyails, that vast army looked beautiful like a blossoming forest.

data.v: तत्र योधा महाराज विचरन्तो ह्यभीतवत् । दृश्यन्ते रुधिराक्ताङ्गाः पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः ॥
data.md: Then, on the field of battle, O monarch, warriors moved about fearlessly, their limbs bathed in blood and, therefore, looking like flowering Kinshukas.

data.v: मातङ्गाश्चाप्यदृश्यन्त शरतोमरपीडिताः । पतन्तस्तत्र तत्रैव छिन्नाभ्रसदृशा रणे ॥
data.md: Elephants also, wounded with arrows and lances, dropped down here and there like broken clouds dropped from the sky.

data.v: गजानीकं महाराज वध्यमानं महात्मभिः । व्यदीर्यत दिशः सर्वा वातनुन्ना घना इव ॥
data.md: O king, killed by great warriors, elephant divisions were dispersed in all directions like clouds scattered by the wind.

data.v: ते गजा घनसंकाशाः पेतुरुर्व्यां समन्ततः । वज्ररुग्णा इव बभुः पर्वता युगसंक्षये ॥
data.md: Those elephants, resembling clouds dropped on the earth like mountai is clapped by a thunder, O lord, at the time of the universal dissolution.

data.v: हयानां सादिभिः सार्धं पतितानां महीतले । राशयः संप्रदृश्यन्ते गिरिमात्रास्ततस्ततः ॥
data.md: Horses with their drivers lay in masses on the ground like so many mountains.

data.v: संजज्ञे रणभूमौ तु परलोकवहा नदी । शोणितोदा रथावर्ता ध्वजवृक्षास्थिशर्करा ॥
data.md: A river was formed on the field o, battle, flowing towards the other world. Blood formed its waters and cars its eddies, Standards were its trees, the bones its pebbles.

data.v: भुजनक्रा धनुःस्रोता हस्तिशैला हयोपला । मेदोमज्जाकर्दमिनी छत्रहंसा गदोडुपा ॥
data.md: The arms were its alligators, bows its current, elephants its large rocks and its smaller ones. Fat and marrow constituted its mire, umbrellas its swans and maces its rafts.

data.v: कवचोष्णीषसंछन्ना पताकारुचिरद्रुमा । चक्रचक्रावलीजुष्टा त्रिवेणूदण्डकावृता ॥
data.md: Abounding with armour and head-gears, banners formed its beautiful trees. Wheels formed its swarms of Chakravakas and it was covered with Trivenus and Dandas.

data.v: शूराणां हर्षजननी भीरूणां भयवर्धिनी । प्रावर्तत नदी रौद्रा कुरुसृञ्जयसंकुला ॥
data.md: Filling the brave with joy and increasing the fears of the timid, that fierce river flowed the shores of which were filled with Kurus and Srinjayas.

data.v: तां नदीं पितृलोकाय वहन्तीमतिभैरवाम् । तेरुर्वाहननौभिस्ते शूराः परिघबाहवः ॥
data.md: Those brave warriors, with arms resembling bludgeons, by the aid of their cars and animals, acting as rafts and boats crossed that dreadful river which flowed towards the region of the deed.

data.v: वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे निर्मर्यादे विशां पते । चतुरङ्गक्षये घोरे पूर्वं देवासुरोपमे ॥
data.md: During the course of that battle, O king, in which no consideration was showed by any body for any one and which with awful destruction of the four fold forces, resembled the battle between the celestials and the Asuras in the days of yore.

data.v: अक्रोशन्बान्धवानन्ये तत्र तत्र परंतप । क्रोशद्भिर्बान्धवैश्चान्ये भयार्ता न निवर्तिरे ॥
data.md: Some warriors, O scorcher of foes, loudly called upon their kinsmen and friends. Some, called upon by crying kinsmen, returned stricken with fear,

data.md: During the course of that fierce and dreadful battle, Arjuna and Bhimasena stupefied their foes.

data.md: Then taking up a sharp and powerful arrow having a semi-circular head, Nakula shot it with great force at Karna's son in that battle.

data.v: तस्य तेन शिरः कायाज्जहार नृपसत्तम । पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
data.md: With that arrow, O best of kings, the son of Pandu cut off from Sushena's trunk his head before all the troops. That feat was highly wonderful.

data.v: स हतः प्रापतद्राजन्नकुलेन महात्मना । नदीवेगादिवारुग्णस्तीरजः पादपो महान् ॥
data.md: Thus killed by the illustrious Nakula Karna's son drooped down like a tall tree on the bank of a river thrown down by the current of the river.

data.v: कर्णपुत्रवधं दृष्ट्वा नकुलस्य च विक्रमम् । प्रदुद्राव भयात्सेना तावकी भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Seeing the destruction of Karna's son and the power of Nakula, your army, O best of Bharatas, fled away in fear.

data.v: तां तु सेनां महाराज मद्रराजः प्रतापवान् । अपालयद्रणे शूरः सेनापतिररिंदमः ॥
data.md: Their General however, the brave and valiant king of the Madras, that repressor of foes, then protected, O king, those troops in battle.

data.v: विभीस्तस्थौ महाराज व्यवस्थाप्य च वाहिनीम् । सिंहनादं भृशं कृत्वा धनुःशब्दं च दारुणम् ॥
data.md: Rallying his army, O king, Shalya stood fearlessly in battle sending forth leonine shouts and twanging his bow fiercely.

data.v: तावकाः समरे राजन्रक्षिता दृढधन्वना । प्रत्युद्ययुररातींस्ते समन्ताद्विगतव्यथाः ॥
data.md: Then your soldiers O king, protected in battle by that firm bowman, cheerfully rushed against the enemy once more from all sides.

data.v: मद्रराजं महेष्वासं परिवार्य समन्ततः । स्थिता राजन्महासेना योद्धुकामाः समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Those great warriors, encircling that great bowmen, the king of the Madras, stood, O king, desirous of fighting on every side.

data.v: सात्यकिर्भीमसेनश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ । युधिष्ठिरं पुरस्कृत्य ह्रीनिषेधमरिंदमम् ॥
data.md: Then Satyaki and Bhimasena and those two Pandavas, the twin sons of Madri, placing that modest chastiser of foes, Yudhishthira, at their head and surrounding him on all sides in that battle, sent up leonine roars. And those heroes also caused a loud sound of the arrows and frequently sent up war-cries.

data.v: परिवार्य रणे वीराः सिंहनादं प्रचक्रिरे । बाणशब्दरवांश्चोग्रान्क्ष्वेडांश्च विविधान्दधुः ॥
तथैव तावकाः सर्वे मद्राधिपतिमञ्जसा । परिवार्य सुसंरब्धाः पुनर्युद्धमरोचयन् ॥
data.md: Smingly, all your warriors, enraged, quickly encompassed the king of the Madras and stood there for battle.

data.v: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं भीरूणां भयवर्धनम् । तावकानां परेषां च मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् ॥
data.md: Then began a battle once more that was highly terrific, between your troops and the enemy, that resembled the one between the gods and demons.

data.v: यथा देवासुरं युद्धं पूर्वमासीद्विशां पते । अभीतानां तथा राजन्यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम् ॥
data.md: The battle between fearless combatants resembled, O king that between the gods and the Asuras in days of yore and increased the population of Yama's kingdom.

data.v: ततः कपिध्वजो राजन्हत्वा संशप्तकान्रणे । अभ्यद्रवत तां सेनां कौरवीं पाण्डुनन्दनः ॥
data.md: Then the ape-emblemed son of Pandu, O king, having killed the Samsaptakas in battle, rushed against the Kauravas.

data.v: तथैव पाण्डवाः शेषा धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः । अभ्यधावन्त तां सेनां विसृजन्तः शिताञ्शरान् ॥
data.md: Smiling, all the Pandavas, headed by Dhrishtadyumna, proceeded against the same detachment discharging keen arrows.

data.v: पाण्डवैरवकीर्णानां संमोहः समजायत । न च जज्ञुरनीकानि दिशो वा प्रदिशस्तथा ॥
data.md: Overpowered by the Pandavas, the Kaurava army were stupefied. Indeed, those divisions then could not distinguish the cardinal and the minor points of the compass.

data.v: आपूर्यमाणा निशितैः शरैः पाण्डवचोदितैः । हतप्रवीरा विध्वस्ता कीर्यमाणा समन्ततः । कौरव्यवध्यत चमूः पाण्डुपुत्रैर्महारथैः ॥
data.md: Covered with keen arrows shot by the Pandavas, the Kaurava ariny, deprived of its foremost warriors, were routed on all sides. Indeed, O Kauravya, your army were killed by the mighty car-warriors of the Pandavas.

data.v: तथैव पाण्डवी सेना शरै राजन्समन्ततः । रणेऽहन्यत पुत्रैस्ते शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: Similarly, the Pandava army, O king, were killed in hundreds and thousands in that battle by your sons on every side with their arrows.

data.v: ते सेने भृशसंतप्ते वध्यमाने परस्परम् । व्याकुले समपद्येतां वर्षासु सरिताविव ॥
data.md: While the two armies, in their excitement, were thus killing each other, they became much agitated like two streams in the rains.

data.v: आविवेश ततस्तीव्रं तावकानां महद्भयम् । पाण्डवानां च राजेन्द्र तथाभूते महाहवे ॥
data.md: During the onset of that dreadful fight, O king, a great fear possessed your warriors as also those of the Pandavas.

data.v: तस्मिन्विलुलिते सैन्ये वध्यमाने परस्परम् । द्रवमाणेषु योधेषु निनदत्सु च दन्तिषु ॥
कूजतां स्तनतां चैव पदातीनां महाहवे । विद्रुतेषु महाराज हयेषु बहुधा तदा ॥
प्रक्षये दारुणे जाते संहारे सर्वदेहिनाम् । नानाशस्त्रसमावापे व्यतिषक्तरथद्विपे ॥
हर्षणे युद्धशौण्डानां भीरूणां भयवर्धने । गाहमानेषु योधेषु परस्परवधैषिषु ॥
प्राणादाने महाघोरे वर्तमाने दुरोदरे । संग्रामे घोररूपे तु यमराष्ट्रविवर्धने ॥
पाण्डवास्तावकं सैन्यं व्यधमन्निशितैः शरैः । तथैव तावका योधा जघ्नुः पाण्डवसैनिकान् ॥
तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने युद्धे भीरुभयावहे । पूर्वाह्णे चैव संप्राप्ते भास्करोदयनं प्रति ॥
data.md: During that awe-inspiring battle, during the progress of the battle faught about the hour of sin-rise, the Pandava heroes, of good aim, protected by the high-souled Yudhishthira, fought with your forces, making death itself their goal.

data.v: लब्धलक्षाः परे राजन्रक्षिताश्च महात्मना । अयोधयंस्तव बलं मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् ॥
data.md: During that awe-inspiring battle, during the progress of the battle faught about the hour of sin-rise, the Pandava heroes, of good aim, protected by the high-souled Yudhishthira, fought with your forces, making death itself their goal.

data.v: बलिभिः पाण्डवैर्दृप्तैर्लब्धलक्षैः प्रहारिभिः । कौरव्यसीदत्पृतना मृगीवाग्निसमाकुला ॥
data.md: The Kuru army, Kuru chief, encountering the proud and powerful Pandavas skilled in striking and of sure aim, became weakened and agitated like a herd of she-deer frightened at a forest fire.

data.v: तां दृष्ट्वा सीदतीं सेनां पङ्के गामिव दुर्बलाम् । उज्जिहीर्षुस्तदा शल्यः प्रायात्पाण्डुचमूं प्रति ॥
data.md: Seeing that army weakened and helpless like a cow sunk in mire, Shalya, desirous of rescuing it, proceeded against the Pandavas army.

data.v: मद्रराजस्तु संक्रुद्धो गृहीत्वा धनुरुत्तमम् । अभ्यद्रवत संग्रामे पाण्डवानाततायिनः ॥
data.md: Enraged the king of the Madras, taking up an excellent bow, rushed for battle against the Pandavas.

data.v: पाण्डवाश्च महाराज समरे जितकाशिनः । मद्रराजं समासाद्य विव्यधुर्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: The Pandavas also, O king, in that battle, filled with the desire of victory, proceeded against the king of the Madras and struck him with keen arrows.

data.v: ततः शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मद्रराजो महाबलः । अर्दयामास तां सेनां धर्मराजस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.md: The powerful king of the Madras struck that army with showers of keen arrows before the very eyes of the righteous king.

data.v: प्रादुरासंस्ततो राजन्नानारूपाण्यनेकशः । चचाल शब्दं कुर्वाणा मही चापि सपर्वता ॥
data.md: The Earth, with her mountains, shook, making a loud noise.

data.v: सदण्डशूला दीप्ताग्राः शीर्यमाणाः समन्ततः । उल्का भूमिं दिवः पेतुराहत्य रविमण्डलम् ॥
data.md: Meteors, keen pointed and bright like lances, dropped on Earth from the sky piercing the air.

data.v: मृगाश्च माहिषाश्चापि पक्षिणश्च विशां पते । अपसव्यं तदा चक्रुः सेनां ते बहुशो नृप ॥
data.md: Large numbers of deer and buffaloes and birds, O king, passed by the left of your army.

data.v: ततस्तद्युद्धमत्युग्रमभवत्संघचारिणाम् । तथा सर्वाण्यनीकानि संनिपत्य जनाधिप । अभ्ययुः कौरवा राजन्पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् ॥
data.md: Then a fierce encounter took place between the Kauravas and the Pandavas assembled together in large bodies.

data.v: शल्यस्तु शरवर्षेण वर्षन्निव सहस्रदृक् । अभ्यवर्षददीनात्मा कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥
भीमसेनं शरैश्चापि रुक्मपुङ्खैः शिलाशितः । द्रौपदेयांस्तथा सर्वान्माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ ॥
धृष्टद्युम्नं च शैनेयं शिखण्डिनमथापि च । एकैकं दशभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध च महाबलः । ततोऽसृजद्बाणवर्षं घर्मान्ते मघवानिव ॥
data.md: He struck Bhimasena, the five sons of Draupadi, the two sons of Madri by Pandu, Dhrishtadyumna, the grand-son of Shini, Shikhandin each with ten gold-winged arrows whetted on stone. Then he, the great powerful wounded every one by ten arrows. Indeed, he began to discharge his arrows like Indra pouring rain at the close of the summer season.

data.v: ततः प्रभद्रका राजन्सोमकाश्च सहस्रशः । पतिताः पात्यमानाश्च दृश्यन्ते शल्यसायकैः ॥
data.md: Then the Prabhadrakas, O king and the Somakas, where killed by thousands by Shalya's arrows.

data.v: भ्रमराणामिव व्राताः शलभानामिव व्रजाः । ह्रादिन्य इव मेघेभ्यः शल्यस्य न्यपतञ्शराः ॥
data.md: The arrows of Shalya, as swarms of becs or fights of locusts, were seen to fall, like thunder bolts from the clouds.

data.v: द्विरदास्तुरगाश्चार्ताः पत्तयो रथिनस्तथा । शल्यस्य बाणैर्न्यपतन्बभ्रमुर्व्यनदंस्तथा ॥
data.md: Elephants and horses and foot-soldiers and car-warriors, assailed with Shalya's arrows, fell down or strayed away bewailing loudly.

data.v: आविष्ट इव मद्रेशो मन्युना पौरुषेण च । प्राच्छादयदरीन्संख्ये कालसृष्ट इवान्तकः । विनर्दमानो मद्रेशो मेघह्रादो महाबलः ॥
data.md: Beside himself with rage the ruler of the Madras covered his foes in that battle like the Destroyer at the end of the cycle.

data.v: सा वध्यमाना शल्येन पाण्डवानामनीकिनी । अजातशत्रुं कौन्तेयमभ्यधावद्युधिष्ठिरम् ॥
data.md: The Pandava army, thus killed by Shalya, ran towards Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti.

data.v: तां समर्प्य ततः संख्ये लघुहस्तः शितैः शरैः । शरवर्षेण महता युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत् ॥
data.md: Light-handed Shalya, having in that battle struck them with whetted arrows, began to assail Yudhishthira with a down-pour of arrows.

data.v: तमापतन्तं पत्त्यश्वैः क्रुद्धो राजा युधिष्ठिरः । अवारयच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मत्तं द्विपमिवाङ्कुशैः ॥
data.md: Beholding Shalya rushing towards him with horse and foot, king Yudhishthira, worked up with wrath, checked him with sharp arrows, even as an infuriate elephant is checked with iron-hooks.

data.v: तस्य शल्यः शरं घोरं मुमोचाशीविषोपमम् । सोऽभ्यविध्यन्महात्मानं वेगेनाभ्यपतच्च गाम् ॥
data.md: Then Shalya shot a dreadful arrow at Yudhishthira that resembled a a snake of dreadful venom. Piercing through the highsouled son of Kunti, that arrow quickly dropped down the Earth.

data.v: ततो वृकोदरः क्रुद्धः शल्यं विव्याध सप्तभिः । पञ्चभिः सहदेवस्तु नकुलो दशभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: Then Vrikodara, enraged, pierced Shalya with seven arrows and Sahadeva pierced him with five and Nakula with ten.

data.v: द्रौपदेयाश्च शत्रुघ्नं शूरमार्तायनिं शरैः । अभ्यवर्षन्महाभागं मेघा इव महीधरम् ॥
data.md: The five sons of Draupadi poured upon that heroic and impetuous Artayani, showers of arrows like clouds pouring rain upon a mountain.

data.v: ततो दृष्ट्वा तुद्यमानं शल्यं पार्थैः समन्ततः । कृतवर्मा कृपश्चैव संक्रुद्धावभ्यधावताम् ॥
data.md: Beholding Shalya struck by the Parthas on every side, both Kritavarman and Kripa proceeded in anger there.

data.v: उलूकश्च पतत्री च शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः । स्मयमानश्च शनकैरश्वत्थामा महारथः । तव पुत्राश्च कार्त्स्न्येन जुगुपुः शल्यमाहवे ॥
data.md: The generally energetic Uluka, Shakuni, the son of Subala and the great car-warrior Ashvatthaman smiling and all your sons protected Shalya every way in that battle.

data.v: भीमसेनं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा कृतवर्मा शिलीमुखैः । बाणवर्षेण महता क्रुद्धरूपमवारयत् ॥
data.md: Piercing Bhimasena with three arrows Kritavarman, discharging a mass of arrows, checked that warrior who was as if the personification of wrath.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नं कृपः क्रुद्धो बाणवर्षैरपीडयत् । द्रौपदेयांश्च शकुनिर्यमौ च द्रौणिरभ्ययात् ॥
data.md: Excited with anger, Kripa struck Dhrishtadyumna with numberless arrows. Shakuni rushed against the sons of Draupadi and Ashvathaman against the twins.

data.v: दुर्योधनो युधां श्रेष्ठावाहवे केशवार्जुनौ । समभ्ययादुग्रतेजाः शरैश्चाभ्यहनद्बली ॥
data.md: That foremost of warriors, the energetic Duryodhana, rushed in that battle, against Keshava and Arjuna and struck them both with many arrows.

data.v: एवं द्वंद्वशतान्यासंस्त्वदीयानां परैः सह । घोररूपाणि चित्राणि तत्र तत्र विशां पते ॥
data.md: Thus hundreds of dreadful encounters, O king, took place between your ariny and the enemy, on the various parts of the field.

data.v: ऋश्यवर्णाञ्जघानाश्वान्भोजो भीमस्य संयुगे । सोऽवतीर्य रथोपस्थाद्धताश्वः पाण्डुनन्दनः । कालो दण्डमिवोद्यम्य गदापाणिरयुध्यत ॥
data.md: The chief of the Bhojas then killed he brown horses of Bhimasena's car in that encounter. The son of Pandu, deprived of his horses, alighting from his car, began to fight with his mace, like the Destroyer himself with his uplifted bludgeon.

data.v: प्रमुखे सहदेवस्य जघानाश्वांश्च मद्रराट् । ततः शल्यस्य तनयं सहदेवोऽसिनावधीत् ॥
data.md: The king of the Madras then killed the horses of Sahadeva before his eyes and then Sahadeva killed Shalya's son with his sword.

data.v: गौतमः पुनराचार्यो धृष्टद्युम्नमयोधयत् । असंभ्रान्तमसंभ्रान्तो यत्नवान्यत्नवत्तरम् ॥
data.md: The preceptor Gautama again fought with Dhristadyumna, both trying their level best.

data.v: द्रौपदेयांस्तथा वीरानेकैकं दशभिः शरैः । अविध्यदाचार्यसुतो नातिक्रुद्धः स्मयन्निव ॥
