data.md: Desirous of going to the regions of Brahman and longing for victory by fair fight, the warriors displayed their prowess worked up with the hope of heaven.

data.v: भर्तृपिण्डविमोक्षार्थं भर्तृकार्यविनिश्चिताः । स्वर्गसंसक्तमनसो योधा युयुधिरे तदा ॥
data.md: For paying off the debt they owed to their masters on account of the maintenance received or bent upon achieving the objects of their friends and allies, the warriors, desirous of going to heaven, fought with one another.

data.v: नानारूपाणि शस्त्राणि विसृजन्तो महारथाः । अन्योन्यमभिगर्जन्तः प्रहरन्तः परस्परम् ॥
data.md: Discharging various weapons, great carwarriors roared at the struck one another.

data.v: हत विध्यत गृह्णीत प्रहरध्वं निकृन्तत । इति स्म वाचः श्रूयन्ते तव तेषां च वै बले ॥
data.md: Slay, seize, strike, cut off-these were the words that were heard in that battle, ultered by your people and those of the enemy.

data.v: ततः शल्यो महाराज धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम् । विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैर्हन्तुकामो महारथम् ॥
data.md: Then Shalya, O king, desirous of killing him, struck king Yudhishthira, a mighty carwarrior, with many sharp arrows.

data.v: तस्य पार्थो महाराज नाराचान्वै चतुर्दश । मर्माण्युद्दिश्य मर्मज्ञो निचखान हसन्निव ॥
data.md: Acquainted with the vital parts of the body, the son of Pritha, however, O king, struck the king of the Madras with fourteen cloth-yard shafts, aiming at the latter's vital parts.

data.v: तं वार्य पाण्डवं बाणैर्हन्तुकामो महायशाः । विव्याध समरे क्रुद्धो बहुभिः कङ्कपत्रिभिः ॥
data.md: Resisting the son of Pandu with his arrows the illustrious Shalya, filled with ire and desirous of killing his antagonist, struck hiin in that battle with innumerable Kanka-feathered arrows.

data.v: अथ भूयो महाराज शरेण नतपर्वणा । युधिष्ठिरं समाजघ्ने सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.md: Again, O king, he struck Yudhishthura with a straight shaft in the very presences of all the troops.

data.v: धर्मराजोऽपि संक्रुद्धो मद्रराजं महायशाः । विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैः कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः ॥
चन्द्रसेनं च सप्तत्या सूतं च नवभिः शरैः । द्रुमसेनं चतुःषष्ट्या निजघान महारथः ॥
data.md: That nighty car-warrior then pierced Chandrasena with seventy arrows and Shalya's driver with nine and Drumasena with sixty four.

data.v: चक्ररक्षे हते शल्यः पाण्डवेन महात्मना । निजघान ततो राजंश्चेदीन्वै पञ्चविंशतिम् ॥
data.md: When the two protectors of his car-wheels were (thus) killed by the great son of Pandu, Shalya, O king, slew twenty five warriors among the Chedis.

data.v: सात्यकिं पञ्चविंशत्या भीमसेनं च पञ्चभिः । माद्रीपुत्रौ शतेनाजौ विव्याध निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: And he struck Satyaki with twenty five keen arrows and Bhimasena with seven and the two sons of Madri with a hundred, in the battle.

data.v: एवं विचरतस्तस्य संग्रामे राजसत्तम । संप्रेषयच्छितान्पार्थः शरानाशीविषोपमान् ॥
data.md: While Shalya was thus fighting in that battle, that best of kings, the son of Pritha, shot at him many arrows that resembled snakes of virulent poison.

data.v: ध्वजाग्रं चास्य समरे कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः । प्रमुखे वर्तमानस्य भल्लेनापहरद्रथात् ॥
data.md: With a broad-headed arrow, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, then cut off from his car the standard of his antagonist as the latter stood before him.

data.v: पाण्डुपुत्रेण वै तस्य केतुं छिन्नं महात्मना । निपतन्तमपश्याम गिरिशृङ्गमिवाहतम् ॥
data.md: We saw the standard of Shalya, which was thus cut off by the son of Pandu in that great battle, drop down like a mountain summit.

data.v: ध्वजं निपतितं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवं च व्यवस्थितम् । संक्रुद्धो मद्रराजोऽभूच्छरवर्षं मुमोच ह ॥
data.md: Seeing his standard fallen and observing the son of Pandu standing before him, the king of the Madras, worked up with range, shot a number of shafts.

data.v: शल्यः सायकवर्षेण पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान् । अभ्यवर्षदमेयात्मा क्षत्रियं क्षत्रियर्षभः ॥
data.md: That foremost of Kshatriyas, viz., Shalya of great energy poured over the Kshatriyas in that battle dense. showers of arrows like Indra pouring torrents of rain.

data.v: सात्यकिं भीमसेनं च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ । एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत् ॥
data.md: Piercing Satyaki and Bhimasena and the twin sons of Madri by Pandu, each with five arrows, he assailed Yudhishthira greatly.

data.v: ततो बाणमयं जालं विततं पाण्डवोरसि । अपश्याम महाराज मेघजालमिवोद्गतम् ॥
data.md: We then, O king, beheld a net of arrows spread before the chest of Pandu's son like a mass of risen clouds.

data.v: तस्य शल्यो रणे क्रुद्धो बाणैः संनतपर्वभिः । दिशः प्रच्छादयामास प्रदिशश्च महारथः ॥
data.md: The great car-warrior Shalya, in that battle, filled with rage, covered Yudhishthira with straight shafts.

data.v: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा बाणजालेन पीडितः । बभूव हृतविक्रान्तो जम्भो वृत्रहणा यथा ॥
data.md: At this, king Yudhishthira, afflicted with those arrows, felt himself deprived of his prowess, even as the Asura Jambha had become before the killer of Vritra.

data.v: पीडिते धर्मराजे तु मद्रराजेन मारिष । सात्यकिर्भीमसेनश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ । परिवार्य रथैः शल्यं पीडयामासुराहवे ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said When king Yudhishthira was thus assailed by the king of the Madras, Satyaki and Bhimasena and the two sons of Madri by Pandu, encircling Shalya with their cars, began to assail him in that battle.

data.v: तमेकं बहुभिर्दृष्ट्वा पीड्यमानं महारथैः । साधुवादो महाञ्जज्ञे सिद्धाश्चासन्प्रहर्षिताः । आश्चर्यमित्यभाषन्त मुनयश्चापि संगताः ॥
data.md: Beholding the helpless Shalya thus assailed by those great car-warriors loud sounds of applause were hcard and the Siddhas became filled with delight. The ascetics, assembled together, declared it wonderful.

data.v: भीमसेनो रणे शल्यं शल्यभूतं पराक्रमे । एकेन विद्ध्वा बाणेन पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥
data.md: Then Bhimasena in that battle, having cut Shalya who had become irresistible with one arrow, next struck him with seven.

data.v: सात्यकिश्च शतेनैनं धर्मपुत्रपरीप्सया । मद्रेश्वरमवाकीर्य सिंहनादमथानदत् ॥
data.md: Satyaki, desirous of rescuing the son of Dharma, strucks Shalya with a hundred arrows and uttered a loud leonine roar.

data.v: नकुलः पञ्चभिश्चैनं सहदेवश्च सप्तभिः । विद्ध्वा तं तु ततस्तूर्णं पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥
data.md: Nakula struck him with five arrows and Sahadeva with seven; the latter then once more struck him with as many.

data.v: स तु शूरो रणे यत्तः पीडितस्तैर्महारथैः । विकृष्य कार्मुकं घोरं वेगघ्नं भारसाधनम् ॥
data.md: The heroic king of the Madras, struggling carefully in that battle, thus afflicted by those grcat car-warriors, drew a formidable and strong bow capable of imparting great force to the shafts shot from it and pierced Satyaki, with twenty-five arrows and Bhima with seventy-three and Nakula with seven.

data.v: सात्यकिं पञ्चविंशत्या शल्यो विव्याध मारिष । भीमसेनं त्रिसप्तत्या नकुलं सप्तभिस्तथा ॥
data.md: The heroic king of the Madras, struggling carefully in that battle, thus afflicted by those grcat car-warriors, drew a formidable and strong bow capable of imparting great force to the shafts shot from it and pierced Satyaki, with twenty-five arrows and Bhima with seventy-three and Nakula with seven.

data.v: ततः सविशिखं चापं सहदेवस्य धन्विनः । छित्त्वा भल्लेन समरे विव्याधैनं त्रिसप्तभिः ॥
data.md: Then cutting off with a broad-headed arrow the bow, with shaft fixed on the string, of Sahadeva, he struck Sahadeva himself in that battle, with seventy-arrows.

data.v: सहदेवस्तु समरे मातुलं भूरिवर्चसम् । सज्यमन्यद्धनुः कृत्वा पञ्चभिः समताडयत् । शरैराशीविषाकारैर्ज्वलज्ज्वलनसंनिभैः ॥
data.md: Sahadeva then, stringing another bow, pierced his maternal uncle with five arrows that resembled snakes of virulent poison or burning fire.

data.v: सारथिं चास्य समरे शरेणानतपर्वणा । विव्याध भृशसंक्रुद्धस्तं च भूयस्त्रिभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: Worked up with great ire, he then struck his antagonist's driver with a straight shaft in that battle and then Shałya himself once more with three.

data.v: भीमसेनस्त्रिसप्तत्या सात्यकिर्नवभिः शरैः । धर्मराजस्तथा षष्ट्या गात्रे शल्यं समर्पयत् ॥
data.md: Then Bhimasena pierced the king of the Madras with seventy arrows and Satyaki pierced him with nine and king Yudhishthira with sixty.

data.v: ततः शल्यो महाराज निर्विद्धस्तैर्महारथैः । सुस्राव रुधिरं गात्रैर्गैरिकं पर्वतो यथा ॥
data.md: Thus pierced, O king, by those mighty carwarriors, blood began to flow from Shalya's body, like red streams running down the breast of a mountain of red chalk.

data.v: तांश्च सर्वान्महेष्वासान्पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः । विव्याध तरसा राजंस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥
data.md: Shalya, however, quickly struck in return each of those great bowmen with five arrows, O king. Exceedingly wonderful was this feat.

data.v: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन धर्मपुत्रस्य मारिष । धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे सज्यं स सुमहारथः ॥
data.md: With another broad-headed arrow, that great car-warrio; then, O sire, cut off the stringed bow, of Dharma's son in that battle.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय धर्मपुत्रो महारथः । साश्वसूतध्वजरथं शल्यं प्राच्छादयच्छरैः ॥
data.md: Taking up another bow, that great carwarrior, viz., the son of Dharma, covered Shalya, his horses and driver and standard and car, with many arrows.

data.v: स च्छाद्यमानः समरे धर्मपुत्रस्य सायकैः । युधिष्ठिरमथाविध्यद्दशभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Thus covered in that battle by the son of Dharma with his arrows Shalya struck the former with ten keen arrows.

data.v: सात्यकिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो धर्मपुत्रे शरार्दिते । मद्राणामधिपं शूरं शरौघैः समवारयत् ॥
data.md: Then Satyaki, enraged upon beholding the son of Dharma thus assailed with arrows, obstructed the heroic king of the Madras with clouds of arrows.

data.v: स सात्यकेः प्रचिच्छेद क्षुरप्रेण महद्धनुः । भीमसेनमुखांस्तांश्च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरताडयत् ॥
data.md: At this, Shalya cut off with a razor-faced arrow the terrible bow of Satyaki and cut each of the other Pandava warriors with three arrows.

data.v: तस्य क्रुद्धो महाराज सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः । तोमरं प्रेषयामास स्वर्णदण्डं महाधनम् ॥
data.md: Enraged, O king, the highly powerful Salyaki then discharge at Shalya a golden lance set with many jewels and gems.

data.v: भीमसेनोऽथ नाराचं ज्वलन्तमिव पन्नगम् । नकुलः समरे शक्तिं सहदेवो गदां शुभाम् । धर्मराजः शतघ्नीं तु जिघांसुः शल्यमाहवे ॥
data.md: Bhimasena shot at him a cloth-yard shaft that looked like a blazing snake; Nakula discharged at him a dart, Sahadeva an excellent mace and the son of Dharina a Sataghni, all actuated by the desire of killing him.

data.v: तानापतत एवाशु पञ्चानां वै भुजच्युतान् । सात्यकिप्रहितं शल्यो भल्लैश्चिच्छेद तोमरम् ॥
भीमेन प्रहितं चापि शरं कनकभूषणम् । द्विधा चिच्छेद समरे कृतहस्तः प्रतापवान् ॥
नकुलप्रेषितां शक्तिं हेमदण्डां भयावहाम् । गदां च सहदेवेन शरौघैः समवारयत् ॥
शराभ्यां च शतघ्नीं तां राज्ञश्चिच्छेद भारत । पश्यतां पाण्डुपुत्राणां सिंहनादं ननाद च । नामृष्यत्तं तु शैनेयः शत्रोर्विजयमाहवे ॥
data.md: With a couple of other arrows, O Bharata, he cut off the Shataghni shot at him by the king, in the very presence of the sons of Pandu and uttered a loud leonine roar. The grandson of Shini, however, could not bear the defeat of his weapon in that battle.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय सात्यकिः क्रोधमूर्छितः । द्वाभ्यां मद्रेश्वरं विद्ध्वा सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: Beside himself with age Satyaki took up another bow and cut the king of the Madras with two arrows and his driver with three.

data.v: ततः शल्यो महाराज सर्वांस्तान्दशभिः शरैः । विव्याध सुभृशं क्रुद्धस्तोत्त्रैरिव महाद्विपान् ॥
data.md: At this, Shalya, O king, worked up with rage, deeply struck all of them with ten arrows, like persons piercing mighty elephants with sharp pointed lances.

data.v: ते वार्यमाणाः समरे मद्रराज्ञा महारथाः । न शेकुः प्रमुखे स्थातुं तस्य शत्रुनिषूदनाः ॥
data.md: Thus thwarted in that battle by the king of the Madras, O Bharata, those slayers of foes could not stand in front of Shalya.

data.v: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा दृष्ट्वा शल्यस्य विक्रमम् । निहतान्पाण्डवान्मेने पाञ्चालानथ सृञ्जयान् ॥
data.md: Witnessing the prowess of Shalya, king Duryodhana considered the Pandavas, the Panchalas and the Srinjayas as already killed.

data.v: ततो राजन्महाबाहुर्भीमसेनः प्रतापवान् । संत्यज्य मनसा प्राणान्मद्राधिपमयोधयत् ॥
data.md: Then, O king, the mighty-armed Bhimasena, determined to kill him, encountered the king of the Madras.

data.v: नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः । परिवार्य तदा शल्यं समन्ताद्व्यकिरञ्शरैः ॥
data.md: Nakula and Sahadeva and the powerful Satyaki, encompassing Shalya, shot their arrows at him from all sides.

data.v: स चतुर्भिर्महेष्वासैः पाण्डवानां महारथैः । वृतस्तान्योधयामास मद्रराजः प्रतापवान् ॥
data.md: Though surrounded by those four great bowmen and powerful car-warriors of the Pandavas, the valiant king of the Madras still fought with them.

data.v: तस्य धर्मसुतो राजन्क्षुरप्रेण महाहवे । चक्ररक्षं जघानाशु मद्रराजस्य पार्थिव ॥
data.md: Then, O king, the son of Dharma, in that dreadful encounter, quickly cut off with a razor-headed arrow one of the guards of Shalya's car-wheels.

data.v: तस्मिंस्तु निहते शूरे चक्ररक्षे महारथे । मद्रराजोऽतिबलवान्सैनिकानास्तृणोच्छरैः ॥
data.md: When that brave and mighty car-warrior, the protector of Shalya's car-wheel, was thus killed, Shalya enshrouded the Pandava warriors with showers of arrows.

data.v: समाच्छन्नांस्ततस्तांस्तु राजन्वीक्ष्य स सैनिकान् । चिन्तयामास समरे धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ॥
data.md: Beholding his troops covered with arrows, O king, king Yudhishthira began to think Verily, how shall those weighty words of Madhava become true. I hope, the king the Madras, worked up with ire, will not destroy my army in battle.

data.v: कथं नु न भवेत्सत्यं तन्माधववचो महत् । न हि क्रुद्धो रणे राजा क्षपयेत बलं मम ॥
ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वज । मद्रेश्वरं समासेदुः पीडयन्तः समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Then the Pandavas, elder brother of Pandu, with cars and elephants and horses approached the king of the Madras and began to assail him from all sides.

data.v: नानाशस्त्रौघबहुलां शस्त्रवृष्टिं समुत्थिताम् । व्यधमत्समरे राजन्महाभ्राणीव मारुतः ॥
data.md: Like the wind scattering masses of clouds, the king of the Madras, in that battle, dispersed the shower of arrows and various other weapons.

data.v: ततः कनकपुङ्खां तां शल्यक्षिप्तां वियद्गताम् । शरवृष्टिमपश्याम शलभानामिवाततिम् ॥
data.md: We then saw the downpour of gold-winged arrows shot by Shalya, passing through welkin like as warm of locusts.

data.v: ते शरा मद्रराजेन प्रेषिता रणमूर्धनि । संपतन्तः स्म दृश्यन्ते शलभानां व्रजा इव ॥
data.md: Indeed, those arrows, discharged by the king of the Madras from the rear of the battle, were seen to fall like a flight of birds.

data.v: मद्रराजधनुर्मुक्तैः शरैः कनकभूषणैः । निरन्तरमिवाकाशं संबभूव जनाधिप ॥
data.md: With the golden shafts shot off the bow of the Madra king, the sky, O king, was so covered that there was not an inch of empty space.

data.v: न पाण्डवानां नास्माकं तत्र कश्चिद्व्यदृश्यत । बाणान्धकारे महति कृते तत्र महाभये ॥
data.md: Then a thick darkness was caused by the arrows shot by the powerful king of the Madras in that dreadful battle.

data.v: मद्रराजेन बलिना लाघवाच्छरवृष्टिभिः । लोड्यमानं तथा दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवानां बलार्णवम् । विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ॥
data.md: And when they saw the vest host of the Pandavas agitated by that hero, the gods and the Gandharvas were stricken with great wonder.

data.v: स तु तान्सर्वतो यत्ताञ्शरैः संपीड्य मारिष । धर्मराजमवच्छाद्य सिंहवद्व्यनदन्मुहुः ॥
data.md: Assailing vigorously all the Pandava heroes with his with his arrows from every side, O sire, Shalya covered king Yudhishthira and roared repeatedly like a lion.

data.v: ते छन्नाः समरे तेन पाण्डवानां महारथाः । न शेकुस्तं तदा युद्धे प्रत्युद्यातुं महारथम् ॥
data.md: Thus covered by Shalya in that battle the great car-warriors of the Pandavas could not proceed against that great hero for fighting with him.

data.v: धर्मराजपुरोगास्तु भीमसेनमुखा रथाः । न जहुः समरे शूरं शल्यमाहवशोभिनम् ॥
data.md: Those amongst thein that were led by Bhimasena and king Yudhishthira did not fly away from the brave Shalya the ornament of battle.

data.v: अर्जुनो द्रौणिना विद्धो युद्धे बहुभिरायसैः । तस्य चानुचरैः शूरैस्त्रिगर्तानां महारथैः । द्रौणिं विव्याध समरे त्रिभिरेव शिलीमुखैः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said In the meantime Arjuna, in that battle, struck with many arrows by the son of Drona as also by the latter's followers the heroic and mighty car-warriors among the Trigartas, pierced Drona's son in return with three arrows and each of the others with two. Again, the mighty armed Dhananjaya covered his enemies with shower of arrows.

data.v: तथेतरान्महेष्वासान्द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां धनंजयः । भूयश्चैव महाबाहुः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥
शरकण्टकितास्ते तु तावका भरतर्षभ । न जहुः समरे पार्थं वध्यमानाः शितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Though struck with keen shafts and thought they looked like porcupines on account of those arrows sticking to their body still your soldiers, O foremost of Bharatas did not fly from Partha in that battle.

data.v: तेऽर्जुनं रथवंशेन द्रोणपुत्रपुरोगमाः । अयोधयन्त समरे परिवार्य महारथाः ॥
data.md: Led by Drona's son they surrounded that great car-warrior and fought with him discharging many arrows.

data.v: तैस्तु क्षिप्ताः शरा राजन्कार्तस्वरविभूषिताः । अर्जुनस्य रथोपस्थं पूरयामासुरञ्जसा ॥
data.md: The gold-decked arrows, O king, shot by them, quickly filled Arjuna's car.

data.v: तथा कृष्णौ महेष्वासौ वृषभौ सर्वधन्विनाम् । शरैर्वीक्ष्य वितुन्नाङ्गौ प्रहृष्टौ युद्धदुर्मदौ ॥
data.md: Beholding those two great bowmen, those two foremost of all warriors, viz., the two Krishnas, covered with arrows, those invincible (Kaurava) warriors filled with joy.

data.v: कूबरं रथचक्राणि ईषा योक्त्राणि चाभिभो । युगं चैवानुकर्षं च शरभूतमभूत्तदा ॥
data.md: The Kubera, the wheels, the shaft, the terraces, the yoke and the Anukarsha of Arjuna's car, were covered with arrows.

data.v: नैतादृशं दृष्टपूर्वं राजन्नैव च नः श्रुतम् । यादृशं तत्र पार्थस्य तावकाः संप्रचक्रिरे ॥
data.md: Never before, O king, had been either seen or heard the like of what your warriors then did unto Partha.

data.v: स रथः सर्वतो भाति चित्रपुङ्खैः शितैः शरैः । उल्काशतैः संप्रदीप्तं विमानमिव भूतले ॥
data.md: That car shone with those keen arrows of beautiful wings like a celestial car, blazing with hundreds of torches dropped on the carth.

data.v: ततोऽर्जुनो महाराज शरैः संनतपर्वभिः । अवाकिरत्तां पृतनां मेघो वृष्ट्या यथाचलम् ॥
data.md: Then Arjuna, O king, covered his enemies with showers of straight arrows like a cloud pouring torrents of rain on a mountain.

data.v: ते वध्यमानाः समरे पार्थनामाङ्कितैः शरैः । पार्थभूतममन्यन्त प्रेक्षमाणास्तथाविधम् ॥
data.md: Struck in that battle with arrows with Partha's name engraven on them those heroes regarded the battle field as full of Parthas.

data.v: ततोऽद्भुतशरज्वालो धनुःशब्दानिलो महान् । सेनेन्धनं ददाहाशु तावकं पार्थपावकः ॥
data.md: Then the Partha-fire, having arrows for its wonderful flames and the loud twang of Gandiva for the wind that increased it, began to consume the fuel of your soldiers.

data.v: चक्राणां पततां चैव युगानां च धरातले । तूणीराणां पताकानां ध्वजानां च रथैः सह ॥
ईषाणामनुकर्षाणां त्रिवेणूनां च भारत । अक्षाणामथ योक्त्राणां प्रतोदानां च सर्वशः ॥
शिरसां पततां चैव कुण्डलोष्णीषधारिणाम् । भुजानां च महाराज स्कन्धानां च समन्ततः ॥
छत्राणां व्यजनैः सार्धं मुकुटानां च राशयः । समदृश्यन्त पार्थस्य रथमार्गेषु भारत ॥
अगम्यरूपा पृथिवी मांसशोणितकर्दमा । बभूव भरतश्रेष्ठ रुद्रस्याक्रीडनं यथा । भीरूणां त्रासजननी शूराणां हर्षवर्धनी ॥
हत्वा तु समरे पार्थः सहस्रे द्वे परंतप । रथानां सवरूथानां विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन् ॥
data.md: Having destroyed two thousand cars with their fences, that scorcher of foes, Partha, appeared like a smokeless fire with blazing flames.

data.v: यथा हि भगवानग्निर्जगद्दग्ध्वा चराचरम् । विधूमो दृश्यते राजंस्तथा पार्थो महारथः ॥
data.md: As the illustrious Agni blazes forth for destroying the immobile and the immobile creation so. O king, mighty car-warrior Partha looked.

data.v: द्रौणिस्तु समरे दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवस्य पराक्रमम् । रथेनातिपताकेन पाण्डवं प्रत्यवारयत् ॥
data.md: Beholding the prowess of Pandu's son in that battle, the son of Drona, on his car adorned with many banners, tried to check him.

data.v: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ श्वेताश्वौ धन्विनां वरौ । समीयतुस्तदा तूर्णं परस्परवधैषिणौ ॥
data.md: Those two foremost of men both having white horses yoked to their cars quickly encountered each other, each desirous of killing the other.

data.v: तयोरासीन्महाराज बाणवर्षं सुदारुणम् । जीमूतानां यथा वृष्टिस्तपान्ते भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: The arrows discharged by both became exceedingly terrible and were as thick, O best of Bharatas, as the torrents of rain poured by two masses of clouds at the close of summer.

data.v: अन्योन्यस्पर्धिनौ तौ तु शरैः संनतपर्वभिः । ततक्षतुर्मृधेऽन्योन्यं शृङ्गाभ्यां वृषभाविव ॥
data.md: Each challenging the other, those two warriors struck each other with straight arrows in that battle, like a couple of bulls tearing cach other with their horns.

data.v: तयोर्युद्धं महाराज चिरं सममिवाभवत् । अस्त्राणां संगमश्चैव घोरस्तत्राभवन्महान् ॥
data.md: The battle between them, O king, was equally fought for a long while. The din of weapons was horrible.

data.v: ततोऽर्जुनं द्वादशभी रुक्मपुङ्खैः सुतेजनैः । वासुदेवं च दशभिर्द्रौणिर्विव्याध भारत ॥
data.md: The son of Drona then, O Bharata, struck Arjuna with a dozen of powerful gold winged arrows and Vasudeva with ten.

data.v: ततः प्रहस्य बीभत्सुर्व्याक्षिपद्गाण्डिवं धनुः । मानयित्वा मुहूर्तं च गुरुपुत्रं महाहवे ॥
data.md: Having shown for a short while some respect for the preceptor's son in that great battle, Vibhatsu then, smiling, drew his bow Gandiva with force.

data.v: व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे सव्यसाची महारथः । मृदुपूर्वं ततश्चैनं त्रिभिर्विव्याध सायकैः ॥
data.md: Immediately the great car-warrior Savyasachin deprived his antagonist of his horses, driver and car and without the least exertion struck him with three arrows.

data.v: हताश्वे तु रथे तिष्ठन्द्रोणपुत्रस्त्वयस्मयम् । मुसलं पाण्डुपुत्राय चिक्षेप परिघोपमम् ॥
data.md: Staying on that horseless car Drona's son, smiling, discharged, at the son of Pandu a heavy mallet that looked like a dreadful mace with iron spikes.

data.v: तमापतन्तं सहसा हेमपट्टविभूषितम् । चिच्छेद सप्तधा वीरः पार्थः शत्रुनिबर्हणः ॥
data.md: Seeing that weapon, which was covered with cloth of gold, come towards him, the heroic Partha, that killer of foes, cut it off into seven pieces.

data.v: स च्छिन्नं मुसलं दृष्ट्वा द्रौणिः परमकोपनः । आददे परिघं घोरं नगेन्द्रशिखरोपमम् । चिक्षेप चैव पार्थाय द्रौणिर्युद्धविशारदः ॥
data.md: Seeing his mallet cut off, Drona's son, in great anger, took up a terrible mace adorned with iron spikes and looking like a mountain crest. Accomplished in warfare, the son of Drona discharged it at Partha.

data.v: तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धं परिघं प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवः । अर्जुनस्त्वरितो जघ्ने पञ्चभिः सायकोत्तमैः ॥
data.md: Seeing that mace come towards him like the Destroyer himself in anger Pandu's son Arjuna quickly cut it off with five excellent arrows.

data.v: स च्छिन्नः पतितो भूमौ पार्थबाणैर्महाहवे । दारयन्पृथिवीन्द्राणां मनः शब्देन भारत ॥
data.md: Cut off with Partha's shaft in that great battle, that weapon dropped down on earth, riving the hearts, as it were, O Bharata, of the inimical kings.

data.v: ततोऽपरैस्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्द्रौणिं विव्याध पाण्डवः । सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता पार्थेन सुमहाबलः । न संभ्रान्तस्तदा द्रौणिः पौरुषे स्वे व्यवस्थितः ॥
data.md: The son of Pandu then struck Drona's son with three other arrows. Through deeply cut by the mighty Partha, the highly powerful Drona's son, depending upon his own manliness, displayed on sign of fear or agitation.

data.v: सुधर्मा तु ततो राजन्भारद्वाजं महारथम् । अवाकिरच्छरव्रातैः सर्वक्षत्रस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.md: That great car-warrior, the son of Drona then, O king, covered Suratha with showers of arrows before the eyes of all the Kshatriyas.

data.v: ततस्तु सुरथोऽप्याजौ पाञ्चालानां महारथः । रथेन मेघघोषेण द्रौणिमेवाभ्यधावत ॥
data.md: At this, Suratha, the great car-warrior among the Panchalas, in that battle, riding upon his car whose rattle was as deep as the muttering of the clouds, proceeded against the son of Drona.

data.v: विकर्षन्वै धनुः श्रेष्ठं सर्वभारसहं दृढम् । ज्वलनाशीविषनिभैः शरैश्चैनमवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Drawing his best of bows capable of standing a great strain, the Panchala hero covered Ashvatthaman with arrows resembling flames of fire or snakes of virulent position.

data.v: सुरथं तु ततः क्रुद्धमापतन्तं महारथम् । चुकोप समरे द्रौणिर्दण्डाहत इवोरगः ॥
data.md: Seeing the great car-warrior Suratha proceed towards him in anger the son of Drona was filled with range like a scorched snake.

data.v: त्रिशिखां भ्रुकुटीं कृत्वा सृक्किणी परिलेलिहन् । उद्वीक्ष्य सुरथं रोषाद्धनुर्ज्यामवमृज्य च । मुमोच तीक्ष्णं नाराचं यमदण्डसमद्युतिम् ॥
data.md: Contracting his eye brow into three lines and licking the corners of his inouth with his tongue, he looked at Suratha in anger and then touched his bowstring and shot a keen clothyard shaft resembling the dreadful rod of Death.

data.v: स तस्य हृदयं भित्त्वा प्रविवेशातिवेगतः । शक्राशनिरिवोत्सृष्टा विदार्य धरणीतलम् ॥
data.md: Endued with great force, that shaft struck the heart of Suratha and coming out entered the Earth riving her through like the thunder-bolt of Indra hurled from the sky.

data.v: ततस्तं पतितं भूमौ नाराचेन समाहतम् । वज्रेणेव यथा शृङ्गं पर्वतस्य महाधनम् ॥
data.md: Struck with that arrow Suratha fell down on the Earth like mountain crest given with thunder.

data.v: तस्मिंस्तु निहते वीरे द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं तमेव रथिनां वरः ॥
data.md: After the fall of that hero, the valiant son of Drona, that foremost of car-warriors, speedily got upon the car of his slain enemy.

data.v: ततः सज्जो महाराज द्रौणिराहवदुर्मदः । अर्जुनं योधयामास संशप्तकवृतो रणे ॥
data.md: Then, O king, that warrior, invincible in batile, the son of Drona, well equipt with armour and weapons and helped by the Samsaptakas, fought with Arjuna.

data.v: तत्र युद्धं महच्चासीदर्जुनस्य परैः सह । मध्यंदिनगते सूर्ये यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम् ॥
data.md: At noon, that battle between one and the many, increasing the denizens of Yama's abode, became exceedingly fierce.

data.v: तत्राश्चर्यमपश्याम दृष्ट्वा तेषां पराक्रमम् । यदेको युगपद्वीरान्समयोधयदर्जुनः ॥
data.md: The sight was wonderful. Arjuna, alone and unsupported, fought with all his foes simultaneously.

data.v: विमर्दस्तु महानासीदर्जुनस्य परैः सह । शतक्रतोर्यथा पूर्वं महत्या दैत्यसेनया ॥
data.md: The encounter was highly terrific that took place between Arjuna and his enemies, resembling that between Indra, in days of yore and the vast army of the Asuras. The encounter was highly terrific that took place between Arjuna and his enemies, resembling that between Indra, in days of yore and the vast army of the Asuras.

data.v: दुर्योधनो महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः । चक्रतुः सुमहद्युद्धं शरशक्तिसमाकुलम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Duryodhana, O king and Dhrishtadyumna, the son of Prishata, fought a dreadful fight with enough arrows and darts.

data.v: तयोरासन्महाराज शरधाराः सहस्रशः । अम्बुदानां यथा काले जलधाराः समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Both of them, O king shot arrows like showers of rain poured by the clouds in the rainy season.

data.v: राजा तु पार्षतं विद्ध्वा शरैः पञ्चभिरायसैः । द्रोणहन्तारमुग्रेषुः पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥
data.md: Having struck with five arrows the slayer of Drona, viz., Prishata's son the Kuru king again struck him with seven arrows.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु समरे बलवान्दृढविक्रमः । सप्तत्या विशिखानां वै दुर्योधनमपीडयत् ॥
data.md: The powerful and steady Dhrishtadyumna, in that battle, assailed Duryodhana with seventy arrows.

data.v: पीडितं प्रेक्ष्य राजानं सोदर्या भरतर्षभ । महत्या सेनया सार्धं परिवव्रुः स्म पार्षतम् ॥
data.md: Seeing the king thus assailed, O foremost of Bharatas, his brothers, accompanied by a large force, surrounded the son of Prishata.

data.v: स तैः परिवृतः शूरैः सर्वतोऽतिरथैर्भृशम् । व्यचरत्समरे राजन्दर्शयन्हस्तलाघवम् ॥
data.md: Surrounded by those great warriors on every side, the Panchala hero, O king, moved in the battle-field, displaying his quickness in the use of weapons.

data.v: शिखण्डी कृतवर्माणं गौतमं च महारथम् । प्रभद्रकैः समायुक्तो योधयामास धन्विनौ ॥
data.md: Helped by the Prabhadrakas, Shikhandin fought with the two Kuru bowmen, Kritavarman and the great car-warrior Kripa.

data.v: तत्रापि सुमहद्युद्धं घोररूपं विशां पते । प्राणान्संत्यजतां युद्धे प्राणद्यूताभिदेवने ॥
data.md: Then, O king, that battle became fierce and awful because the warriors were all bent upon sacrificing their lives.

data.v: शल्यस्तु शरवर्षाणि विमुञ्चन्सर्वतोदिशम् । पाण्डवान्पीडयामास ससात्यकिवृकोदरान् ॥
data.md: Discharging arrows on all sides Shalya assailed the Pandavas with Satyaki and Vrikodara amongst them.

data.v: तथोभौ च यमौ युद्धे यमतुल्यपराक्रमौ । योधयामास राजेन्द्र वीर्येण च बलेन च ॥
data.md: O king, with patience and great strength, the king of the Madras at the same time fought with the twins Nakula and Sahadeva, each of whom was powerful like the Destroyer himself.

data.v: शल्यसायकनुन्नानां पाण्डवानां महामृधे । त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छन्त केचित्तत्र महारथाः ॥
data.md: The great car-warriors among the Pandavas who were wounded in that great battle with the arrows of Shalya, could not find a protector.

data.v: ततस्तु नकुलः शूरो धर्मराजे प्रपीडिते । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन मातुलं माद्रिनन्दनः ॥
data.md: Seeing the just king Yudhishthira greatly assailed the heroic Nakula, the son of Madri, rushed with force against his maternal uncle.

data.v: संछाद्य समरे शल्यं नकुलः परवीरहा । विव्याध चैनं दशभिः स्मयमानः स्तनान्तरे ॥
data.md: Covering Shalya in that batile Nakula, that slayer of hostile heroes, smiling struck him in the breast with ten other arrows, made entirely of iron, polished by the smith, equipt with wings of gold whetted on stone and discharged from his bow with great force.

data.v: सर्वपारशवैर्बाणैः कर्मारपरिमार्जितैः । स्वर्णपुङ्खैः शिलाधौतैर्धनुर्यन्त्रप्रचोदितैः ॥
data.md: Covering Shalya in that batile Nakula, that slayer of hostile heroes, smiling struck him in the breast with ten other arrows, made entirely of iron, polished by the smith, equipt with wings of gold whetted on stone and discharged from his bow with great force.

data.v: शल्यस्तु पीडितस्तेन स्वस्रीयेण महात्मना । नकुलं पीडयामास पत्रिभिर्नतपर्वभिः ॥
data.md: Assailed by his illustrious nephew, Shalya struck him in return with many straight arrows.

data.v: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमसेनोऽथ सात्यकिः । सहदेवश्च माद्रेयो मद्रराजमुपाद्रवन् ॥
data.md: Then king Yudhishthira, Bhimasena, Satyaki and Sahadeva the son of Madri, all rushed against the king of the Madras.

data.v: तानापतत एवाशु पूरयानान्रथस्वनैः । दिशश्च प्रदिशश्चैव कम्पयानांश्च मेदिनीम् । प्रतिजग्राह समरे सेनापतिरमित्रजित् ॥
data.md: That vanquisher of foes, the commander of the Kuru army, received in that battle all those heroes that rushed towards him vehemently filling the cardinal and the subsidiary points of the compass with the rattle of their cars and causing the Earth to tremble.

data.v: युधिष्ठिरं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा भीमसेनं च सप्तभिः । सात्यकिं च शतेनाजौ सहदेवं त्रिभिः शरैः ॥
ततस्तु सशरं चापं नकुलस्य महात्मनः । मद्रेश्वरः क्षुरप्रेण तदा चिच्छेद मारिष । तदशीर्यत विच्छिन्नं धनुः शल्यस्य सायकैः ॥
data.md: Then the king of the Madras, O sire, cut off, with a razor-headed arrow, the bow with arrow fixed on it of the great Nakula.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय माद्रीपुत्रो महारथः । मद्रराजरथं तूर्णं पूरयामास पत्रिभिः ॥
data.md: Taking up another bow, Madri's son quickly covered the king of the Madras with winged arrows.

data.v: युधिष्ठिरस्तु मद्रेशं सहदेवश्च मारिष । दशभिर्दशभिर्बाणैरुरस्येनमविध्यताम् ॥
data.md: Then Yudhishthira and Sahadeva, each struck the king of the Madras with ten arrows on the breast.

data.v: भीमसेनस्ततः षष्ट्या सात्यकिर्नवभिः शरैः । मद्रराजमभिद्रुत्य जघ्नतुः कङ्कपत्रिभिः ॥
data.md: Rushing at the ruler of the Madras Bhimasena and Satyaki both struck him with Kanka-feathered arrows, the former with sixty and the latter with ten.

data.v: मद्रराजस्ततः क्रुद्धः सात्यकिं नवभिः शरैः । विव्याध भूयः सप्तत्या शराणां नतपर्वणाम् ॥
data.md: Enraged at this, the ruler of the Madras struck Satyaki with nine arrows and again with seventy straight arrows.

data.v: अथास्य सशरं चापं मुष्टौ चिच्छेद मारिष । हयांश्च चतुरः संख्ये प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे ॥
data.md: Then O king, he cut off at the handle the bow, with arrow fixed on it, of Satyaki and then killed the four horses of the latter.

data.v: विरथं सात्यकिं कृत्वा मद्रराजो महाबलः । विशिखानां शतेनैनमाजघान समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Having made Satyaki carless, that great carwarrior, the king of the Madras, struck him with a hundred arrows from all sides.

data.v: माद्रीपुत्रौ तु संरब्धौ भीमसेनं च पाण्डवम् । युधिष्ठिरं च कौरव्य विव्याध दशभिः शरैः ॥
data.md: He next struck the two angry sons of Madri and Bhimasena the son of Pandu and Yudhishthira, O Kuru chief, with ten arrows each.

data.v: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम मद्रराजस्य पौरुषम् । यदेनं सहिताः पार्था नाभ्यवर्तन्त संयुगे ॥
data.md: The prowess of the king of the Madras was highly wonderful, since the Parthas, even in a body, could not approach him in that battle.

data.v: अथान्यं रथमास्थाय सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः । पीडितान्पाण्डवान्दृष्ट्वा मद्रराजवशं गतान् । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन मद्राणामधिपं बली ॥
data.md: Riding then upon another car, the mighty and powerful Satyaki, seeing the Pandavas assailed and yielding to the king of the Madras, rushed quickly against him.

data.v: आपतन्तं रथं तस्य शल्यः समितिशोभनः । प्रत्युद्ययौ रथेनैव मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम् ॥
data.md: Shalya rushed, on his car, against the car of Satyaki, like one infuriate elephant against another.

data.v: स संनिपातस्तुमुलो बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः । सात्यकेश्चैव शूरस्य मद्राणामधिपस्य च । यादृशो वै पुरा वृत्तः शम्बरामरराजयोः ॥
data.md: The encounter between Satyaki and the heroic king of the Madras, became fierce and wonderful to look at like that which had taken place in the days of yore between the Asura Shambara and Indra.

data.v: सात्यकिः प्रेक्ष्य समरे मद्रराजं व्यवस्थितम् । विव्याध दशभिर्बाणैस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Seeing the king of the Madras stay before him in that battle, Satyaki struck him with ten arrows.

data.v: मद्रराजस्तु सुभृशं विद्धस्तेन महात्मना । सात्यकिं प्रतिविव्याध चित्रपुङ्खैः शितैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Deeply struck by that great warrior, the king of the Madras struck Satyaki in return with sharp arrows adorned with beautiful feathers.

data.v: ततः पार्था महेष्वासाः सात्वताभिसृतं नृपम् । अभ्यद्रवन्रथैस्तूर्णं मातुलं वधकाम्यया ॥
data.md: Beholding the king of the Madras struck by Satyaki those great bowmen the Parthas, quickly rushed towards him with a view to kill him.

data.v: तत आसीत्परामर्दस्तुमुलः शोणितोदकः । शूराणां युध्यमानानां सिंहानामिव नर्दताम् ॥
data.md: The encounter, between those struggling heroes marked by a great flow of blood, was highly dreadful like that which takes place between a number of roaring lions fighting for a piece of meat.

data.v: तेषामासीन्महाराज व्यतिक्षेपः परस्परम् । सिंहानामामिषेप्सूनां कूजतामिव संयुगे ॥
data.md: The encounter, between those struggling heroes marked by a great flow of blood, was highly dreadful like that which takes place between a number of roaring lions fighting for a piece of meat.

data.v: तेषां बाणसहस्रौघैराकीर्णा वसुधाभवत् । अन्तरिक्षं च सहसा बाणभूतमभूत्तदा ॥
data.md: With the thick downpour of arrows shot by them, the Earth was entirely covered and the sky was converted into one mass of arrows.

data.v: शरान्धकारं बहुधा कृतं तत्र समन्ततः । अभ्रच्छायेव संजज्ञे शरैर्मुक्तैर्महात्मभिः ॥
data.md: Indeed, with the arrows shot by those illustrious warriors a shadow, like that of the clouds was caused there.

data.v: तत्र राजञ्शरैर्मुक्तैर्निर्मुक्तैरिव पन्नगैः । स्वर्णपुङ्खैः प्रकाशद्भिर्व्यरोचन्त दिशस्तथा ॥
data.md: Then, O king, with those shining and gold winged arrows shot by warriors, that resembled snakes that had just cast off their sloughs, the points of the horizon were as if ablaze.

data.v: तत्राद्भुतं परं चक्रे शल्यः शत्रुनिबर्हणः । यदेकः समरे शूरो योधयामास वै बहून् ॥
data.md: Shalya, that slayer of foes, performed a wonderful deed because that hero, Alone, unaided, fought with many arrows in that battle.

data.v: मद्रराजभुजोत्सृष्टैः कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः । संपतद्भिः शरैर्घोरैरवाकीर्यत मेदिनी ॥
data.md: The Earth was covered with the dreadful Kanka and peacock feathered arrows that fell from the hands of the king of the Madras.

data.v: तत्र शल्यरथं राजन्विचरन्तं महाहवे । अपश्याम यथा पूर्वं शक्रस्यासुरसंक्षये ॥
data.md: Then, O king, we behalf the car of Shalya moving about in that dreadful battle like the car of Shakra in days of yore on the occasion of the destruction of the Asuras.

data.v: ततः सैन्यास्तव विभो मद्रराजपुरस्कृताः । पुनरभ्यद्रवन्पार्थान्वेगेन महता रणे ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Then, O king, your soldiers, led by Shalya, once more rushed against the Parthas in that battle with great impetuosity.

data.v: पीडितास्तावकाः सर्वे प्रधावन्तो रणोत्कटाः । क्षणेनैव च पार्थांस्ते बहुत्वात्समलोडयन् ॥
data.md: Although assailed still those troops, who were fierce in battle, rushing against the Parthas, very soon agitated them on account of the superiority in numbers.

data.v: ते वध्यमानाः कुरुभिः पाण्डवा नावतस्थिरे । निवार्यमाणा भीमेन पश्यतोः कृष्णपार्थयोः ॥
data.md: Struck by the Kurus, the Pandava troops, in the very presence of the two Krishnas, could not stand in the field though checked by Bhimasena. Worked up with anger Dhananjaya covered Kripa and his followers, as also Kritavarman, with showers of arrows.

data.v: ततो धनंजयः क्रुद्धः कृपं सह पदानुगैः । अवाकिरच्छरौघेण कृतवर्माणमेव च ॥
data.md: Struck by the Kurus, the Pandava troops, in the very presence of the two Krishnas, could not stand in the field though checked by Bhimasena. Worked up with anger Dhananjaya covered Kripa and his followers, as also Kritavarman, with showers of arrows.

data.v: शकुनिं सहदेवस्तु सहसैन्यमवारयत् । नकुलः पार्श्वतः स्थित्वा मद्रराजमवैक्षत ॥
data.md: Sahadeva checked Shakuni and his detachment. Nakula looked at the king of the Madras from his flanks.

data.v: द्रौपदेया नरेन्द्रांश्च भूयिष्ठं समवारयन् । द्रोणपुत्रं च पाञ्चाल्यः शिखण्डी समवारयत् ॥
data.md: The (five) sons of Draupadi opposed numerous kings (of the Kuru army). The Panchala prince Shikhandin checked the son of Drona.

data.v: भीमसेनस्तु राजानं गदापाणिरवारयत् । शल्यं तु सह सैन्येन कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥
data.md: Arined with his mace, Bhimasena opposed the king. Kunti's son Yudhishthira resisted Shalya at the head of his army.

data.v: ततः समभवद्युद्धं संसक्तं तत्र तत्र ह । तावकानां परेषां च संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनाम् ॥
data.md: Again an encounter took place between those pairs as they stood, among your warriors and those of the enemy, none of whom had ever retreated from fight.

data.v: तत्र पश्यामहे कर्म शल्यस्यातिमहद्रणे । यदेकः सर्वसैन्यानि पाण्डवानामयुध्यत ॥
data.md: Shalya performed a wonderful feat because alone he fought with the whole Pandava ariny.

data.v: व्यदृश्यत तदा शल्यो युधिष्ठिरसमीपतः । रणे चन्द्रमसोऽभ्याशे शनैश्चर इव ग्रहः ॥
data.md: Shalya, then, as he stood near Yudhishthira in that battle, looked like the planet Saturn near the Moon.

data.v: पीडयित्वा तु राजानं शरैराशीविषोपमैः । अभ्यधावत्पुनर्भीमं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Afflicting the king with arrows that resembled Venomous serpents Shalya proceeded against Bhima, covering him with showers of arrows.

data.v: तस्य तल्लाघवं दृष्ट्वा तथैव च कृतास्त्रताम् । अपूजयन्ननीकानि परेषां तावकानि च ॥
data.md: Beholding the lightness of hand and mastery over weapons displayed by Shalya, both the armies spoke highly of him.

data.v: पीड्यमानास्तु शल्येन पाण्डवा भृशविक्षताः । प्राद्रवन्त रणं हित्वा क्रोशमाने युधिष्ठिरे ॥
data.md: Assailed by Shalya, the Pandavas, exceedingly wounded, fled away, from the battle, disregarding orders of Yudhishthira to stop them.

data.v: वध्यमानेष्वनीकेषु मद्रराजेन पाण्डवः । अमर्षवशमापन्नो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः । ततः पौरुषमास्थाय मद्रराजमपीडयत् ॥
data.md: While soldiers were thus being killed by the king of the Madras, Pandu's son king Yudhishthira was worked up with rage.

data.v: जयो वास्तु वधो वेति कृतबुद्धिर्महारथः । समाहूयाब्रवीत्सर्वान्भ्रातॄन्कृष्णं च माधवम् ॥
भीष्मो द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च ये चान्ये पृथिवीक्षितः । कौरवार्थे पराक्रान्ताः संग्रामे निधनं गताः ॥
data.md: Summoning all his others and also Krishna he said to them— Bhishma and Drona and Karna and other kings who fought for the Kauravas, have all died in battle. You all have shown valour and courage in the tasks allotted। to you.

data.v: यथाभागं यथोत्साहं भवन्तः कृतपौरुषाः । भागोऽवशिष्ट एकोऽयं मम शल्यो महारथः ॥
सोऽहमद्य युधा जेतुमाशंसे मद्रकेश्वरम् । तत्र यन्मानसं मह्यं तत्सर्वं निगदामि वः ॥
चक्ररक्षाविमौ शूरौ मम माद्रवतीसुतौ । अजेयौ वासवेनापि समरे वीरसंमतौ ॥
साध्विमौ मातुलं युद्धे क्षत्रधर्मपुरस्कृतौ । मदर्थं प्रतियुध्येतां मानार्हौ सत्यसंगरौ ॥
मां वा शल्यो रणे हन्ता तं वाहं भद्रमस्तु वः । इति सत्यामिमां वाणीं लोकवीरा निबोधत ॥
data.md: Either Shalya will kill me in battle or I will kill him. Blessed be you. Listen to these true words, O foremost of heroes in the world.

data.v: योत्स्येऽहं मातुलेनाद्य क्षत्रधर्मेण पार्थिवाः । स्वयं समभिसंधाय विजयायेतराय वा ॥
data.md: Observing Kshatriya duties I will fight with my maternal uncle, determined to either win victory or be slain.

data.v: तस्य मेऽभ्यधिकं शस्त्रं सर्वोपकरणानि च । संयुञ्जन्तु रणे क्षिप्रं शास्त्रवद्रथयोजकाः ॥
data.md: Let them that furnish car quickly supply my car according to the rules of science, with all kinds of weapons and implements more than what Shalya possesses.

data.v: शैनेयो दक्षिणं चक्रं धृष्टद्युम्नस्तथोत्तरम् । पृष्ठगोपो भवत्वद्य मम पार्थो धनंजयः ॥
data.md: The grandson of Shini will protect my right wheel and Dhristadyumna my left. Let Pritha's son Dhananjaya guard my rear to-day.

data.v: पुरःसरो ममाद्यास्तु भीमः शस्त्रभृतां वरः । एवमभ्यधिकः शल्याद्भविष्यामि महामृधे ॥
data.md: And let Bhima, the foremost of warriors, fight in my front. I shall thus be superior to Shalya in the great battle that will soon take place.”

data.v: एवमुक्तास्तथा चक्रुः सर्वे राज्ञः प्रियैषिणः । ततः प्रहर्षः सैन्यानां पुनरासीत्तदा नृप ॥
data.md: Thus accosted by the king, all his wellwishers did what they were asked to do.

data.v: पाञ्चालानां सोमकानां मत्स्यानां च विशेषतः । प्रतिज्ञां तां च संग्रामे धर्मराजस्य पूरयन् ॥
data.md: Then the Pandava troops were again filled up with joy, especially the Panchalas, the Somakas and the Matsyas.

data.v: ततः शङ्खांश्च भेरीश्च शतशश्चैव पुष्करान् । अवादयन्त पाञ्चालाः सिंहनादांश्च नेदिरे ॥
data.md: Having made that vow, the king proceeded against the king of the Madras. The Panchalas then blew and beat numberless conchs and drums and sent up leonine roars.

data.v: तेऽभ्यधावन्त संरब्धा मद्रराजं तरस्विनः । महता हर्षजेनाथ नादेन कुरुपुंगवाः ॥
ह्रादेन गजघण्टानां शङ्खानां निनदेन च । तूर्यशब्देन महता नादयन्तश्च मेदिनीम् ॥
data.md: Endued with great activity and worked up with ire they rushed, with loud shouts of joy, against the king of the Madras, that foremost of the Kurus. And they made the earth resound with the noise of the elephant's bells and the loud sound of conchs and trumpets.

data.v: तान्प्रत्यगृह्णात्पुत्रस्ते मद्रराजश्च वीर्यवान् । महामेघानिव बहूञ्शैलावस्तोदयावुभौ ॥
data.md: Then your son and the brave king of the Madras, like the rising the setting hills, received those assailants.

data.v: शल्यस्तु समरश्लाघी धर्मराजमरिंदमम् । ववर्ष शरवर्षेण वर्षेण मघवानिव ॥
data.md: Bragging Shalya poured a shower of arrows of that chastiser of foes, king Yudhishthira like Indra pouring rain.

data.v: तथैव कुरुराजोऽपि प्रगृह्य रुचिरं धनुः । द्रोणोपदेशान्विविधान्दर्शयानो महामनाः ॥
data.md: Also, having taken up his beautiful bow, the great king of the Kurus displayed various lessons received by him from Drona.

data.v: ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि चित्रं लघु च सुष्ठु च । न चास्य विवरं कश्चिद्ददर्श चरतो रणे ॥
data.md: And beautifully, quickly and with great skill, he made successive downpours of arrows. As he moved about in battle, none could mark anything in him.

data.v: तावुभौ विविधैर्बाणैस्ततक्षाते परस्परम् । शार्दूलावामिषप्रेप्सू पराक्रान्ताविवाहवे ॥
data.md: The powerful Shalya and Yudhishthira wounded each other, like a couple of igers fighting for a piece of meat.

data.v: भीमस्तु तव पुत्रेण रणशौण्डेन संगतः । पाञ्चाल्यः सात्यकिश्चैव माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ । शकुनिप्रमुखान्वीरान्प्रत्यगृह्णन्समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Bhima fought with your son, the delighter in batlle. Dhristadyumna, Satyaki and the two sons of Madri by Pandu received Shakuni and the other Kuru heroes around.

data.v: तदासीत्तुमुलं युद्धं पुनरेव जयैषिणाम् । तावकानां परेषां च राजन्दुर्मन्त्रिते तव ॥
data.md: On account of your vile policy, O king, there again occurred a dreadful battle between your people and those of the foe, all of whom were actuated with the desire of victory.

data.v: दुर्योधनस्तु भीमस्य शरेणानतपर्वणा । चिच्छेदादिश्य संग्रामे ध्वजं हेमविभूषितम् ॥
data.md: Aiming at the gold-decked standard of Bhima, Duryodhana then, with a straight arrow, cut it off in that battle.

data.v: सकिङ्किणीकजालेन महता चारुदर्शनः । पपात रुचिरः सिंहो भीमसेनस्य नानदन् ॥
data.md: The beautiful standard of Bhimasena, adorned with many bells, dropped down, O giver of honours.

data.v: पुनश्चास्य धनुश्चित्रं गजराजकरोपमम् । क्षुरेण शितधारेण प्रचकर्त नराधिपः ॥
data.md: Again the king, with a sharp razor-faced arrow, cut off the beautiful bow of Bhima resembling the trunk of an elephant.

data.v: स च्छिन्नधन्वा तेजस्वी रथशक्त्या सुतं तव । बिभेदोरसि विक्रम्य स रथोपस्थ आविशत् ॥
data.md: Gifted with great energy Bhima, who had been deprived of his bow, then displaying his prowess, struck on the chest of your son with a dart. Thereat your son sat down on the terrace of his car.

data.v: तस्मिन्मोहमनुप्राप्ते पुनरेव वृकोदरः । यन्तुरेव शिरः कायात्क्षुरप्रेणाहरत्तदा ॥
data.md: When Duryodhana fainted Vrikodara, with a razor-faced arrow, cut off the head of his driver from his trunk.

data.v: हतसूता हयास्तस्य रथमादाय भारत । व्यद्रवन्त दिशो राजन्हाहाकारस्तदाभवत् ॥
data.md: Deprived of their driver the horses, of Duryodhana's car, ran wildly on all sides, O Bharata, dragging the car after them at which the Kurus bewailed loudly.

data.v: तमभ्यधावत्त्राणार्थं द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः । कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च पुत्रं तेऽभिपरीप्सवः ॥
data.md: Then the great car-warrior Ashvatthaman and Kripa and Kritavarman, followed the car, with a view to save your son.

data.v: तस्मिन्विलुलिते सैन्ये त्रस्तास्तस्य पदानुगाः । गाण्डीवधन्वा विस्फार्य धनुस्तानहनच्छरैः ॥
data.md: Thereat the troops troops were were exceedingly agitated. The followers of Duryodhana were terrified. At that time the wilder or Gandiva, drawing his bow, began to kill them with his arrows.

data.v: युधिष्ठिरस्तु मद्रेशमभ्यधावदमर्षितः । स्वयं संचोदयन्नश्वान्दन्तवर्णान्मनोजवान् ॥
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम कुन्तीपुत्रे युधिष्ठिरे । पुरा भूत्वा मृदुर्दान्तो यत्तदा दारुणोऽभवत् ॥
data.md: Then filled with rage, Yudhishthira rushed against the king of the Madras, himself driving his horses white as ivory and fleet as mind. We then saw some thing wonderful in Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, for though very mild by nature he then 'ecame highly terrific.

data.v: विवृताक्षश्च कौन्तेयो वेपमानश्च मन्युना । चिच्छेद योधान्निशितैः शरैः शतसहस्रशः ॥
data.md: With eyes opened wide and body trembling in anger the son of Kunti killed hostile warriors in hundreds and thousands with sharp arrows.

data.v: यां यां प्रत्युद्ययौ सेनां तां तां ज्येष्ठः स पाण्डवः । शरैरपातयद्राजन्गिरीन्वज्रैरिवोत्तमैः ॥
data.md: Many soldiers were overthrown by him, O king, like mountain summits broken with thunder.

data.v: साश्वसूतध्वजरथान्रथिनः पातयन्बहून् । आक्रीडदेको बलवान्पवनस्तोयदानिव ॥
data.md: Striking down cars with steeds and drivers and standards and throwing down many carwarriors, Yudhishthira, without any help, began to sport there like a powerful wind dissipating masses of clouds.

data.v: साश्वारोहांश्च तुरगान्पत्तींश्चैव सहस्रशः । व्यपोथयत संग्रामे क्रुद्धो रुद्रः पशूनिव ॥
data.md: Filled with anger, he killed horses with riders and horses without riders and the infantry by thousands in that battle, like Rudra destroying living creatures at the time of the universal dissolution.

data.v: शून्यमायोधनं कृत्वा शरवर्षैः समन्ततः । अभ्यद्रवत मद्रेशं तिष्ठ शल्येति चाब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Having made the field empty by discharging his arrows on all sides, Yudhishthira proceeded against the king of the Madras and said-Wait, Wait.

data.v: तस्य तच्चरितं दृष्ट्वा संग्रामे भीमकर्मणः । वित्रेसुस्तावकाः सर्वे शल्यस्त्वेनं समभ्ययात् ॥
data.md: Beholding the feats of that hero of terrible deeds, all your warriors were filled with fear. Shalya, however, rushed again him.

data.v: ततस्तौ तु सुसंरब्धौ प्रध्माप्य सलिलोद्भवौ । समाहूय तदान्योन्यं भर्त्सयन्तौ समीयतुः ॥
data.md: Both of them, in anger, blew their respective conchs. Returning and challenging each other, each then met the other.

data.v: शल्यस्तु शरवर्षेण युधिष्ठिरमवाकिरत् । मद्रराजं च कौन्तेयः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Then Shalya enshrouded Yudhishthira with showers of arrows. Likewise the son of Kunti covered the king of the Madras with showers of arrows.

data.v: व्यदृश्येतां तदा राजन्कङ्कपत्रिभिराहवे । उद्भिन्नरुधिरौ शूरौ मद्रराजयुधिष्ठिरौ ॥
पुष्पिताविव रेजाते वने शल्मलिकिंशुकौ । दीप्यमानौ महात्मानौ प्राणयोर्युद्धदुर्मदौ ॥
दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि सैन्यानि नाध्यवस्यंस्तयोर्जयम् । हत्वा मद्राधिपं पार्थो भोक्ष्यतेऽद्य वसुंधराम् ॥
data.md: Beholding them both, the soldiers could not decide which of them would win. Whether the son of Pritha would enjoy the Earth, having killed the king of the Madras or, Shalya, having slain the son of Pandu, would bestow the Earth on Duryodhana, could not be decided, O Bharata, by the warriors present there.

data.v: शल्यो वा पाण्डवं हत्वा दद्याद्दुर्योधनाय गाम् । इतीव निश्चयो नाभूद्योधानां तत्र भारत ॥
data.md: Beholding them both, the soldiers could not decide which of them would win. Whether the son of Pritha would enjoy the Earth, having killed the king of the Madras or, Shalya, having slain the son of Pandu, would bestow the Earth on Duryodhana, could not be decided, O Bharata, by the warriors present there.

data.v: प्रदक्षिणमभूत्सर्वं धर्मराजस्य युध्यतः ॥
ततः शरशतं शल्यो मुमोचाशु युधिष्ठिरे । धनुश्चास्य शिताग्रेण बाणेन निरकृन्तत ॥
data.md: King Yudhishthira, in the course of that battle, placed his enemy to his right. Then Shalya shot a century of best arrows, at Yudhisthira. With another sharp arrow, he cut off the latter's bow.

data.v: सोऽन्यत्कार्मुकमादाय शल्यं शरशतैस्त्रिभिः । अविध्यत्कार्मुकं चास्य क्षुरेण निरकृन्तत ॥
data.md: Taking up another bow, Yudhishthira struck Shalya with three hundred arrows and cut off the latter's bow with a razor-faced arrow.

data.v: अथास्य निजघानाश्वांश्चतुरो नतपर्वभिः । द्वाभ्यामथ शिताग्राभ्यामुभौ च पार्ष्णिसारथी ॥
data.md: The son of Pandu then killed the four horses of his antagonist with some straight arrows. With two other very sharp arrows he then cut off the two Parshni drivers of Shalya.

data.v: ततोऽस्य दीप्यमानेन पीतेन निशितेन च । प्रमुखे वर्तमानस्य भल्लेनापाहरद्ध्वजम् । ततः प्रभग्नं तत्सैन्यं दौर्योधनमरिंदम ॥
data.md: Then with another shining, well-tempered and sharp arrow, he cut off the standard of Shalya who stood before him. Then, O chastiser of foes, the army of Duryodhana were scattered.

data.v: ततो मद्राधिपं द्रौणिरभ्यधावत्तथाकृतम् । आरोप्य चैनं स्वरथं त्वरमाणः प्रदुद्रुवे ॥
data.md: The son of Drona, at this time, speedily proceeded towards the king of the Madras who had been reduced to that strait and quickly taking him up on his own car, fled away.

data.v: मुहूर्तमिव तौ गत्वा नर्दमाने युधिष्ठिरे । स्थित्वा ततो मद्रपतिरन्यं स्यन्दनमास्थितः ॥
data.md: After the two had gone for a moment, they heard Yudhishthira cry aloud. Stopping, the ruler of the Madras he then got upon another well equipi car.

data.v: विधिवत्कल्पितं शुभ्रं महाम्बुदनिनादिनम् । सज्जयन्त्रोपकरणं द्विषतां रोमहर्षणम् ॥
data.md: That best of cars had a rattle deep as the muttering of the clouds. Well furnished with weapons and instruments and all kinds of utensils, that vehicle made the hairs of foes stand erect.

data.v: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय बलवद्वेगवत्तरम् । युधिष्ठिरं मद्रपतिर्विद्ध्वा सिंह इवानदत् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said Taking up another very strong bow the king of the Madras struck Yudhishthira and roared like a lion.

data.v: ततः स शरवर्षेण पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान् । अभ्यवर्षदमेयात्मा क्षत्रियान्क्षत्रियर्षभः ॥
data.md: That foremost of Kshatriyas, viz., Shalya of great energy poured over the Kshatriyas in that battle dense. showers of arrows like Indra pouring torrents of rain.

data.v: सात्यकिं दशभिर्विद्ध्वा भीमसेनं त्रिभिः शरैः । सहदेवं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत् ॥
data.md: Piercing Satyaki with ten arrows and Bhima with three and Sahadeva with as many, he assailed Yudhishthira greatly.

data.v: तांस्तानन्यान्महेष्वासान्साश्वान्सरथकुञ्जरान् । कुञ्जरान्कुञ्जरारोहानश्वानश्वप्रयायिनः । रथांश्च रथिभिः सार्धं जघान रथिनां वरः ॥
data.md: That foremost of car-warriors destroyed elephants and elephant-riders, horses and horse-men and cars and car-warriors,

data.v: बाहूंश्चिच्छेद च तथा सायुधान्केतनानि च । चकार च महीं योधैस्तीर्णां वेदीं कुशैरिव ॥
data.md: And he cut off the arms of combatants holding weapons and the standards of cars and filled the earth with (slain) warriors like the sacrificial altar with blades of Kusha grass.

data.v: तथा तमरिसैन्यानि घ्नन्तं मृत्युमिवान्तकम् । परिवव्रुर्भृशं क्रुद्धाः पाण्डुपाञ्चालसोमकाः ॥
data.md: Then the Pandus, the Panchalas and the Somakas, encompassed angrily that hero who was thus killing their soldiers like alldestroying Death.

data.v: तं भीमसेनश्च शिनेश्च नप्ता; माद्र्याश्च पुत्रौ पुरुषप्रवीरौ । समागतं भीमबलेन राज्ञा; पर्यापुरन्योन्यमथाह्वयन्तः ॥
data.md: Bhimasena and the grandson of Shini and those two foremost of men, the two sons of Madri surrounded that hero while he was fighting with the highly powerful (Pandava) king. Ana all of them challenged him to battle.

data.v: ततस्तु शूराः समरे नरेन्द्रं; मद्रेश्वरं प्राप्य युधां वरिष्ठम् । आवार्य चैनं समरे नृवीरा; जघ्नुः शरैः पत्रिभिरुग्रवेगैः ॥
data.md: Then those heroes, O king, having obtained the king of the Madras, that best of warriors in battle, opposed that first of men in that encounter and began to strike him with powerful winged arrows.

data.v: संरक्षितो भीमसेनेन राजा; माद्रीसुताभ्यामथ माधवेन । मद्राधिपं पत्रिभिरुग्रवेगैः; स्तनान्तरे धर्मसुतो निजघ्ने ॥
data.md: Protected by Bhimasena and the two sons of Madri and Krishna the royal son of Dharma struck the king of the Madras on the chest with powerful winged arrows.

data.v: ततो रणे तावकानां रथौघाः; समीक्ष्य मद्राधिपतिं शरार्तम् । पर्यावव्रुः प्रवराः सर्वशश्च; दुर्योधनस्यानुमते समन्तात् ॥
data.md: Then beholding the king of the Madras greatly wounded with arrows in that battle, the car-warriors and other combatants of your army, clad in mail and armed with weapons, surrounded him on all sides at Duryodhana's behest.

data.v: ततो द्रुतं मद्रजनाधिपो रणे; युधिष्ठिरं सप्तभिरभ्यविध्यत् । तं चापि पार्थो नवभिः पृषत्कै;र्विव्याध राजंस्तुमुले महात्मा ॥
data.md: They king of the Madras at this time quickly struck Yudhishthira with seven arrows in that battle. The great son of Pritha. O king, in return, struck his foe with nine arrows in that dreadful battle.

data.v: आकर्णपूर्णायतसंप्रयुक्तैः; शरैस्तदा संयति तैलधौतैः । अन्योन्यमाच्छादयतां महारथौ; मद्राधिपश्चापि युधिष्ठिरश्च ॥
data.md: Those two great car-warriors, viz., Shalya and Yudhishthira, began to cover each other with arrows bathed in oil and shot off bows drawn to their ears.

data.v: ततस्तु तूर्णं समरे महारथौ; परस्परस्यान्तरमीक्षमाणौ । शरैर्भृशं विव्यधतुर्नृपोत्तमौ; महाबलौ शत्रुभिरप्रधृष्यौ ॥
data.md: Those two best of kings, both gifted with great strength, both incapable of being defeated by foes and both foremost of car-warriors looking at each other's loop-holes, quickly and deeply struck each other's shafts.

data.v: तयोर्धनुर्ज्यातलनिस्वनो महा;न्महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यनिस्वनः । परस्परं बाणगणैर्महात्मनोः; प्रवर्षतोर्मद्रपपाण्डुवीरयोः ॥
data.md: The loud noise of their bows, bowstrings and palms, resembled that of Indra's thunder as those great car-warriors showered upon each other innumerable arrows.

data.v: तौ चेरतुर्व्याघ्रशिशुप्रकाशौ; महावनेष्वामिषगृद्धिनाविव । विषाणिनौ नागवराविवोभौ; ततक्षतुः संयुगजातदर्पौ ॥
data.md: They moved about in the field of battle like two young tigers in the deep forest fighting for a piece of meat. Elated with the pride of prowess, they wounded each other like a couple of infuriate elephants of powerful tusks.

data.v: ततस्तु मद्राधिपतिर्महात्मा; युधिष्ठिरं भीमबलं प्रसह्य । विव्याध वीरं हृदयेऽतिवेगं; शरेण सूर्याग्निसमप्रभेण ॥
data.md: Displaying his vigor, then the illustrious king of the Madras struck the heroic Yudhishthira of terrible might in the chest with an arrow effulgent like the fire or the sun.

data.v: ततोऽतिविद्धोऽथ युधिष्ठिरोऽपि; सुसंप्रयुक्तेन शरेण राजन् । जघान मद्राधिपतिं महात्मा; मुदं च लेभे ऋषभः कुरूणाम् ॥
data.md: Deeply struck, O king, that best of Kurus, the illustrious Yudhishthira, then struck the king of the Madras with a well aimed arrow and was filled with joy.

data.v: ततो मुहूर्तादिव पार्थिवेन्द्रो; लब्ध्वा संज्ञां क्रोधसंरक्तनेत्रः । शतेन पार्थं त्वरितो जघान; सहस्रनेत्रप्रतिमप्रभावः ॥
data.md: Regaining his consciousness within a moment that foremost of kings viz., Shalya, powerful like Indra with eyes reddened in wrath, quickly struck the son of Pritha with a hundred arrows.

data.v: त्वरंस्ततो धर्मसुतो महात्मा; शल्यस्य क्रुद्धो नवभिः पृषत्कैः । भित्त्वा ह्युरस्तपनीयं च वर्म; जघान षड्भिस्त्वपरैः पृषत्कैः ॥

data.md: Filled with joy, the 1. ing of the Madras then, drawing his bow and having discharged many arrows, at last cut off, with a pair of razorfaced shafts, the bow of his royal foe.

data.v: नवं ततोऽन्यत्समरे प्रगृह्य; राजा धनुर्घोरतरं महात्मा । शल्यं तु विद्ध्वा निशितैः समन्ता;द्यथा महेन्द्रो नमुचिं शिताग्रैः ॥
data.md: The illustrious Yudhishthira then, taking a new and more powerful bow in that battle, struck Shalya with many keen pointed arrows from all sides like Indra striking the Asura Namuchi.

data.v: ततोऽपरेण ज्वलितार्कतेजसा; क्षुरेण राज्ञो धनुरुन्ममाथ । कृपश्च तस्यैव जघान सूतं; षड्भिः शरैः सोऽभिमुखं पपात ॥
data.md: With another razor-faced arrow effulgent like the fire of the sun, he then cut off the bow of Yudhishthira. At this time Kripa, with six arrows, killed the king's driver who fell down in front of the car.

data.md: The king of the Madras then killed with four arrows the four horses of Yudhishthira. Having slain the horses of the king, the great Shalya then began to kill the soldiers of the royal son of Dharma.

data.v: तथा कृते राजनि भीमसेनो; मद्राधिपस्याशु ततो महात्मा । छित्त्वा धनुर्वेगवता शरेण; द्वाभ्यामविध्यत्सुभृशं नरेन्द्रम् ॥

data.md: With another arrow he cut off the head of Shalya's driver from his trunk the middle of which was encased in mail. Beside himself with anger, Bhimasena next killed without a moment's delay, the four horses of his enemy.

data.md: That foremost of all bowmen, viz., Bhima, then covered with a hundred arrows that hero who, gifted with great energy, was moving about alone in the field. Sahadeva, the son of Madri, did the same. Beholding Shalya stupefied with those arrows, Bhima cut off his armour with other arrows.

data.v: तैः सायकैर्मोहितं वीक्ष्य शल्यं; भीमः शरैरस्य चकर्त वर्म । स भीमसेनेन निकृत्तवर्मा; मद्राधिपश्चर्म सहस्रतारम् ॥

data.md: His armour having been cut off by Bhimasena, the great king of Madras, taking up a sword and a shield adorned with a thousand stars, leaped down from his car and rushed towards the son of Kunti. Cutting off the shaft of Nakula's car, the powerful Shalya rushed towards Yudhishthira.

data.v: तं चापि राजानमथोत्पतन्तं; क्रुद्धं यथैवान्तकमापतन्तम् । धृष्टद्युम्नो द्रौपदेयाः शिखण्डी; शिनेश्च नप्ता सहसा परीयुः ॥

data.md: Then the illustrious Bhima cut off the ten arrows the matchless shield of that hero. With another broad-headed arrow he cut off the sword also of that warrior. Filled with joy at this, he cried aloud in the midst of the army.

data.md: At that terrible noise the army, protected by your warriors, were depressed, covered with sweat, bathed in blood, exceedingly melancholy and dispirited.

data.md: Assailed by those foremost of Pandava warriors headed by Bhimasena, the king of the Madras proceeded towards Yudhishthira, like a lion going to catch a deer.

data.md: Deprived of his car and horses, king Yudhishthira, looked like a blazing fire for the anger with which he was then excited. Beholding the king of the Madras before him, he rushed towards that foe with great force.

data.md: Recollecting the words of Govinda, he quickly set his heart on the destruction of Shalya. Indeed, king Yudhishthira, staying on his steedless and driverless car, waited to take up a dart.

data.md: Beholding that feat of Shalya and thinking that the person who had been allotted to him as his share was not yet killed the son of Pandu firmly made up his mind to do what Indra's younger brother had advised him to do.

data.md: King Yudhishthira took up a dart whose handle was made of gold and set with gems and which was bright like gold. Rolling his wide open eyes, he looked at the king of Madras, his heart filled with anger.

data.v: निरीक्षितो वै नरदेव राज्ञा; पूतात्मना निर्हृतकल्मषेण । अभून्न यद्भस्मसान्मद्रराज;स्तदद्भुतं मे प्रतिभाति राजन् ॥
data.md: Thus looked at, O god among men, by that king of pure and sinless soul the king of the Madras was not reduced to ashes. This was indeed wonderful, O monarch.

data.v: ततस्तु शक्तिं रुचिरोग्रदण्डां; मणिप्रवालोज्ज्वलितां प्रदीप्ताम् । चिक्षेप वेगात्सुभृशं महात्मा; मद्राधिपाय प्रवरः कुरूणाम् ॥
data.md: The chief of the Kurus then hurled with great force at the king of the Madras that blazing dart of beautiful and fierce handle set with gems and corals.

data.md: All the Kauravas beheld that blazing dart sending forth scintillations of fire as it passed through the sky after having been discharged with great force, like a large meteor dropping from the sky at the end of the cycle.

data.v: तां कालरात्रीमिव पाशहस्तां; यमस्य धात्रीमिव चोग्ररूपाम् । सब्रह्मदण्डप्रतिमाममोघां; ससर्ज यत्तो युधि धर्मराजः ॥
data.md: King Yudhishthira, in that battle, carefully discharged that dart which resembled the Death-night armed with the dreadful noose or the dreadful mother of Yama himself and which like the Brahmana's curse, was of sure effect.

data.md: Carefully the sons of Pandu had always worshipped that weapon with scents, garland, seats and the best food and drinks. That weapon seemed to born like the Samvartaka fire and was as dreadful as a rite performed according to the Atharvan of Angirasa.

data.v: ईशानहेतोः प्रतिनिर्मितां तां; त्वष्ट्रा रिपूणामसुदेहभक्षाम् । भूम्यन्तरिक्षादिजलाशयानि; प्रसह्य भूतानि निहन्तुमीशाम् ॥
data.md: Made by Tashtri the celestial architect for the use of Shiva it destroyed the vital airs and the bodies of all foes. It could destroy by its force the earth, the sky and all the reservoirs of water and animals of every description.

data.v: घण्टापताकामणिवज्रभाजं; वैडूर्यचित्रां तपनीयदण्डाम् । त्वष्ट्रा प्रयत्नान्नियमेन कॢप्तां; ब्रह्मद्विषामन्तकरीममोघाम् ॥
data.md: Adorned with bells, flags, gems, diamonds, lapis lazuli and equipt with a golden handle, the celestial Architect himself had made it with great care after having practised many vows. This fatal weapon was destructive of all haters of Brahma.

data.v: बलप्रयत्नादधिरूढवेगां; मन्त्रैश्च घोरैरभिमन्त्रयित्वा । ससर्ज मार्गेण च तां परेण; वधाय मद्राधिपतेस्तदानीम् ॥
data.md: Having inspired it with many mantras and impregnated it with terrible velocity by the exercise of great power and care, king Yudhishthira hurled it by the best path for the destruction of the king of the Madras.

data.md: Saying in a loud voice the words-"you are killed, O wretch”-the king hurled it, even as Rudra had, in days of yore, shot his arrow for the destruction of the Asura Andhaka, extending his strong arm adorned with a beautiful hand and dancing in anger.

data.v: तां सर्वशक्त्या प्रहितां स शक्तिं; युधिष्ठिरेणाप्रतिवार्यवीर्याम् । प्रतिग्रहायाभिननर्द शल्यः; सम्यग्घुतामग्निरिवाज्यधाराम् ॥
data.md: Shalya cried aloud and tried to catch that excellent dart of great energy hurled by Yudhishthira with all his strength even as a fire laps forth for catching the clarified butter poured over it.

data.v: सा तस्य मर्माणि विदार्य शुभ्र;मुरो विशालं च तथैव वर्म । विवेश गां तोयमिवाप्रसक्ता; यशो विशालं नृपतेर्दहन्ती ॥
data.md: Cutting through his very vitals and his fair and broad chest, that dart entered the Earth as easily as it would water without the slightest obstruction and carrying away the world-wide reputation of Shalya.

data.md: Covered with the blood that came out of his nostrils, cyes, ears and mouth and that which flowed from his wound, he looked like the huge Krauncha mountain when it was pierced by Skanda.

data.md: His armour having been cut off by Yudhishthira the illustrious Shalya, strong as Indra's elephant, stretching his arms, dropped down on the Earth, like a mountain summit clapped by a thunder-bolt.

data.md: Stretching his arms, the king of the Madras fell down on the Earth, with his face directed towards king Yudhishthira like Indra's pole dropped down on the ground.

data.md: Having enjoyed long the Earth like a dear wife, the powerful Shalya, now to sleep on the Earth's breast, embraced her.

data.md: Slain by Dharma's son in a fair fight, Shalya shone like fire lying extinguished on the sacrificial altar.

data.v: शक्त्या विभिन्नहृदयं विप्रविद्धायुधध्वजम् । संशान्तमपि मद्रेशं लक्ष्मीर्नैव व्यमुञ्चत ॥
data.md: Though deprived of his weapons and standard and though his heart had been cut and slain still his body was not shorn of beauty.

data.v: ततो युधिष्ठिरश्चापमादायेन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम् । व्यधमद्द्विषतः संख्ये खगराडिव पन्नगान् । देहासून्निशितैर्भल्लै रिपूणां नाशयन्क्षणात् ॥
data.md: Taking up his bow resplendent like Indra's bow then Yudhishthira began to destroy his foes in that battle like Garuda killing snakes. With the greatest speed he began to cut off the bodies of his enemies with the keen arrows.

data.v: ततः पार्थस्य बाणौघैरावृताः सैनिकास्तव । निमीलिताक्षाः क्षिण्वन्तो भृशमन्योन्यमर्दिताः । संन्यस्तकवचा देहैर्विपत्रायुधजीविताः ॥
data.md: Your troops were entirely covered with the showers of arrows that the son of Pritha then shot. Possessed with fear and with eyes shut, they began to strike one another. With their bodies bathed in blood they were deprived of their offensive and defensive arins and divested of their vital-breaths.

data.v: ततः शल्ये निपतिते मद्रराजानुजो युवा । भ्रातुः सर्वैर्गुणैस्तुल्यो रथी पाण्डवमभ्ययात् ॥
data.md: Upon the fall of Shalya, the youthful younger brother of the king of the Madras who equal his brother in every accomplishment and who was a great carwarrior, proceeded against Yudhishthira.

data.v: विव्याध च नरश्रेष्ठो नाराचैर्बहुभिस्त्वरन् । हतस्यापचितिं भ्रातुश्चिकीर्षुर्युद्धदुर्मदः ॥
data.md: Invincible in battle and desirous of satisfying the last dues of his brother, that foremost of men struck speedily the Pandava with many arrows.

data.v: तं विव्याधाशुगैः षड्भिर्धर्मराजस्त्वरन्निव । कार्मुकं चास्य चिच्छेद क्षुराभ्यां ध्वजमेव च ॥
data.md: King Yudhishthira immediately struck him with six arrows. He then cut off the bow and the standard of his antagonist with two razorfaced arrows.

data.v: ततोऽस्य दीप्यमानेन सुदृढेन शितेन च । प्रमुखे वर्तमानस्य भल्लेनापाहरच्छिरः ॥
data.md: Then with another shining, well-tempered and sharp arrow, he cut off the standard of Shalya who stood before him. Then, O chastiser of foes, the army of Duryodhana were scattered.

data.v: सकुण्डलं तद्ददृशे पतमानं शिरो रथात् । पुण्यक्षयमिव प्राप्य पतन्तं स्वर्गवासिनम् ॥
data.md: That head adorned with ear-rings was seen to fall down from the car like a denizen of heaven falling down on the exhaustion of his virtues.

data.v: तस्यापकृष्टशीर्षं तच्छरीरं पतितं रथात् । रुधिरेणावसिक्ताङ्गं दृष्ट्वा सैन्यमभज्यत ॥
data.md: Beholding his headless trunk, bathed in blood, fallen down from his car, the Kaurava troops were dispersed.

data.v: विचित्रकवचे तस्मिन्हते मद्रनृपानुजे । हाहाकारं विकुर्वाणाः कुरवो विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥
data.md: Indeed, upon the destruction of the younger brother of the Madras clad in beautiful armour, the Kurus bewailed and fled away quickly.

data.v: शल्यानुजं हतं दृष्ट्वा तावकास्त्यक्तजीविताः । वित्रेसुः पाण्डवभयाद्रजोध्वस्तास्तथा भृशम् ॥
data.md: Beholding Shalya's younger brother killed your troops, hopeless of their lives; were pursued by the fear of the Pandavas and fled, coated with dust.

data.v: तांस्तथा भज्यतस्त्रस्तान्कौरवान्भरतर्षभ । शिनेर्नप्ता किरन्बाणैरभ्यवर्तत सात्यकिः ॥
data.md: Then Shini's grandson Satyaki, O foremost of Bharatas, shooting his arrows, proceeded against the frightened Kauravas in the course of their fight.

data.v: तमायान्तं महेष्वासमप्रसह्यं दुरासदम् । हार्दिक्यस्त्वरितो राजन्प्रत्यगृह्णादभीतवत् ॥
data.md: The Hridika's son, O king, quickly and fearlessly opposed that invincible warrior, that irresistible and powerful bowman, as he proceeded against them.

data.v: तौ समेतौ महात्मानौ वार्ष्णेयावपराजितौ । हार्दिक्यः सात्यकिश्चैव सिंहाविव मदोत्कटौ ॥
data.md: Those two illustrious and invincible Vrishni heroes, Hridika's son and Satyaki, encountered each other like two enraged lions.

data.v: इषुभिर्विमलाभासैश्छादयन्तौ परस्परम् । अर्चिर्भिरिव सूर्यस्य दिवाकरसमप्रभौ ॥
data.md: Both effulgent like the sun, they covered each other with burning arrows resplendent like the rays of the sun.

data.v: चापमार्गबलोद्धूतान्मार्गणान्वृष्णिसिंहयोः । आकाशे समपश्याम पतंगानिव शीघ्रगान् ॥
data.md: The arrows of those two Vrishni chiefs, shot off their bows, appeared like swiftlycoursing insects in the sky.

data.v: सात्यकिं दशभिर्विद्ध्वा हयांश्चास्य त्रिभिः शरैः । चापमेकेन चिच्छेद हार्दिक्यो नतपर्वणा ॥
data.md: Piercing Satyaki with ten arrows and his horses with three, the son of Hridika cut off his bow with a straight arrow.

data.v: तन्निकृत्तं धनुः श्रेष्ठमपास्य शिनिपुंगवः । अन्यदादत्त वेगेन वेगवत्तरमायुधम् ॥
data.md: Casting off his bow which was thus cut off, that heroe, quickly took up another that was stronger than the first.

data.v: तदादाय धनुः श्रेष्ठं वरिष्ठः सर्वधन्विनाम् । हार्दिक्यं दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यत्स्तनान्तरे ॥
data.md: Having taken up that best of bows, that first of bowmen struck the son of Hridika with ten arrows on the chest.

data.v: ततो रथं युगेषां च छित्त्वा भल्लैः सुसंयतैः । अश्वांस्तस्यावधीत्तूर्णमुभौ च पार्ष्णिसारथी ॥
data.md: Then cutting off his car and the shaft of that car with many well-aimed arrows, Satyaki quickly killed the horses of his antagonist and his two Parshni drivers.

data.v: मद्रराजे हते राजन्विरथे कृतवर्मणि । दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं पुनरासीत्पराङ्मुखम् ॥
data.md: The king of the Madras being slain and upon Kritavarma having been made carless, the entire arıny of Duryodhana fled away from the battle field.

data.v: तत्परे नावबुध्यन्त सैन्येन रजसा वृते । बलं तु हतभूयिष्ठं तत्तदासीत्पराङ्मुखम् ॥
data.md: At this time the army was covered with a cloud of dust. We could not perceive anything. The major portion, however, of your army were killed. They, who remained alive, took to their heels from the battle-field.

data.v: ततो मुहूर्तात्तेऽपश्यन्रजो भौमं समुत्थितम् । विविधैः शोणितस्रावैः प्रशान्तं पुरुषर्षभ ॥
data.md: Soon it was seen that the cloud of dust was suppressed, O foremost of men, on account of the streams of blood that flowed on all sides.

data.v: ततो दुर्योधनो दृष्ट्वा भग्नं स्वबलमन्तिकात् । जवेनापततः पार्थानेकः सर्वानवारयत् ॥
data.md: Then seeing his army routed Duryodhana, alone, resisted all the Parthas advancing furiously.

data.v: पाण्डवान्सरथान्दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम् । आनर्तं च दुराधर्षं शितैर्बाणैरवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Beholding the Pandavas on their cars as also Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata and the invincible Satyaki, the Kuru king struck them with sharp arrows.

data.v: तं परे नाभ्यवर्तन्त मर्त्या मृत्युमिवागतम् । अथान्यं रथमास्थाय हार्दिक्योऽपि न्यवर्तत ॥
data.md: His enemies could not approach him then, like creatures unable to approach the Death. Then the son of Hridika came there, on another car.

data.v: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा त्वरमाणो महारथः । चतुर्भिर्निजघानाश्वान्पत्रिभिः कृतवर्मणः । विव्याध गौतमं चापि षड्भिर्भल्लैः सुतेजनैः ॥
data.md: The great car-warrior Yudhishthira then quickly killed the four horses of Kritavarman with four arrows and struck the son of Gotama with six broad-headed powerful arrows.

data.v: अश्वत्थामा ततो राज्ञा हताश्वं विरथीकृतम् । समपोवाह हार्दिक्यं स्वरथेन युधिष्ठिरात् ॥
data.md: Then Ashvatthaman, taking upon his car, the son of Hridika who had been deprived of his horses by the (Pandava) king, took him away from Yudhishthira's presence.

data.v: ततः शारद्वतोऽष्टाभिः प्रत्यविध्यद्युधिष्ठिरम् । विव्याध चाश्वान्निशितैस्तस्याष्टाभिः शिलीमुखैः ॥
data.md: The son of Sharadvata struck Yudhishthira in return with eight arrows and his horses also with cight keen arrows.

data.v: एवमेतन्महाराज युद्धशेषमवर्तत । तव दुर्मन्त्रिते राजन्सहपुत्रस्य भारत ॥
data.md: Thus, O king, the battle raged on all sides on account of the evil policy of yourself and your soni, O Bharata.

data.v: तस्मिन्महेष्वासवरे विशस्ते; संग्राममध्ये कुरुपुंगवेन । पार्थाः समेताः परमप्रहृष्टाः; शङ्खान्प्रदध्मुर्हतमीक्ष्य शल्यम् ॥
data.md: After the destruction of that foremost of bow men on the field of battle by that foremost of Kuru's race, the Parthas, beholding Shalya slain, in a body filled with great joy, blew their conchs.

data.v: युधिष्ठिरं च प्रशशंसुराजौ; पुरा सुरा वृत्रवधे यथेन्द्रम् । चक्रुश्च नानाविधवाद्यशब्दा;न्निनादयन्तो वसुधां समन्तात् ॥
data.md: And all of them praised Yudhishthira in that battle, even as the celestials, in days of yore, had praised Indra after the destruction of Vritra. And they beat and blew various kinds of musical instruments, making the Earth resound on all sides.

data.v: शल्ये तु निहते राजन्मद्रराजपदानुगाः । रथाः सप्तशता वीरा निर्ययुर्महतो बलात् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said After the destruction of Shalya, O king, the followers of the Madra king, numbering seventeen hundred brave car-warriors, proceeded for battle with great force.

data.v: दुर्योधनस्तु द्विरदमारुह्याचलसंनिभम् । छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन वीज्यमानश्च चामरैः । न गन्तव्यं न गन्तव्यमिति मद्रानवारयत् ॥
data.md: Duryodhana, riding upon a huge mountainlike elephant with an umbrella held over his head and fanned with white chowries, forbade the Madraka warriors, saying "Do not proceed, Do not proceed!”

data.v: दुर्योधनेन ते वीरा वार्यमाणाः पुनः पुनः । युधिष्ठिरं जिघांसन्तः पाण्डूनां प्राविशन्बलम् ॥
data.md: Though repeatedly forbidden by Duryodhana, those heroes, desirous of killing Yudhishthira, entered into the Pandava army.

data.v: ते तु शूरा महाराज कृतचित्ताः स्म योधने । धनुःशब्दं महत्कृत्वा सहायुध्यन्त पाण्डवैः ॥
data.md: Those brave warriors, O king, loyal to Duryodhana, twanging their bows loudly fought with the Pandavas.

data.v: श्रुत्वा तु निहतं शल्यं धर्मपुत्रं च पीडितम् । मद्रराजप्रिये युक्तैर्मद्रकाणां महारथैः ॥
data.md: In the meantime hearing that Shalya had been killed and that Yudhishthira had been assailed by the mighty car-warriors of the Madrakas devoted to the well-being of the Madraka king, the great car-warrior Partha came there, stretching his bow Gandiva and filling the Earth with the rattle of his car.

data.v: आजगाम ततः पार्थो गाण्डीवं विक्षिपन्धनुः । पूरयन्रथघोषेण दिशः सर्वा महारथः ॥
ततोऽर्जुनश्च भीमश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ । सात्यकिश्च नरव्याघ्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः ॥
data.md: Then Arjuna, Bhima and the two sons of Madri by Pandu and that foremost of men, Satyaki and the (five) sons of Draupadi and Dhrishtadyumna and Sikhandin and the Panchalas and the Somakas, desirous of rescuing Yudhishthira, encircled him on all sides.

data.v: धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च पाञ्चालाः सह सोमकैः । युधिष्ठिरं परीप्सन्तः समन्तात्पर्यवारयन् ॥
data.md: Then Arjuna, Bhima and the two sons of Madri by Pandu and that foremost of men, Satyaki and the (five) sons of Draupadi and Dhrishtadyumna and Sikhandin and the Panchalas and the Somakas, desirous of rescuing Yudhishthira, encircled him on all sides.

data.v: ते समन्तात्परिवृताः पाण्डवैः पुरुषर्षभाः । क्षोभयन्ति स्म तां सेनां मकराः सागरं यथा ॥
data.md: Having taken their positions round the king, the Pandavas, those foremost of men, began te) agitate the enemy's army like Makaras agitating the ocean. Indecd, they made your army tremble like a mighty tempest shaking the trees.

data.v: पुरोवातेन गङ्गेव क्षोभ्यमाना महानदी । अक्षोभ्यत तदा राजन्पाण्डूनां ध्वजिनी पुनः ॥
data.md: Like the great river Ganges agitated by a hostile wind, the Pandava army, O king, once more were exceedingly agitated,

data.v: प्रस्कन्द्य सेनां महतीं त्यक्तात्मानो महारथाः । वृक्षानिव महावाताः कम्पयन्ति स्म तावकाः ॥
बहवश्चुक्रुशुस्तत्र क्व स राजा युधिष्ठिरः । भ्रातरो वास्य ते शूरा दृश्यन्ते नेह केचन ॥
पाञ्चालानां महावीर्याः शिखण्डी च महारथः । धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ शैनेयो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः ॥
एवं तान्वादिनः शूरान्द्रौपदेया महारथाः । अभ्यघ्नन्युयुधानश्च मद्रराजपदानुगान् ॥
data.md: Thereat those great car-warriors, viz., the sons of Draupadi, began to kill the followers of the Madra king who were uttering those words i and fighting vigorously. In that battle, some, amongst your troops, where crushed by carwheels and some slain by huge standards.

data.v: चक्रैर्विमथितैः केचित्केचिच्छिन्नैर्महाध्वजैः । प्रत्यदृश्यन्त समरे तावका निहताः परैः ॥
data.md: Thereat those great car-warriors, viz., the sons of Draupadi, began to kill the followers of the Madra king who were uttering those words i and fighting vigorously. In that battle, some, amongst your troops, where crushed by carwheels and some slain by huge standards.

data.v: आलोक्य पाण्डवान्युद्धे योधा राजन्समन्ततः । वार्यमाणा ययुर्वेगात्तव पुत्रेण भारत ॥
data.md: Beholding, however, the heroic Pandavas, the brave warriors of your army, O Bharata, though forbidden by your son, still proceeded against them.

data.v: दुर्योधनस्तु तान्वीरान्वारयामास सान्त्वयन् । न चास्य शासनं कश्चित्तत्र चक्रे महारथः ॥
data.md: Speaking mildly Duryodhana tried to prevent those warriors from fighting with the foe. No great car-warrior, however, amongst them carried out his order.

data.v: ततो गान्धारराजस्य पुत्रः शकुनिरब्रवीत् । दुर्योधनं महाराज वचनं वचनक्षमः ॥
data.md: Then Sakuni, the eloquent son of the Gandhara king, O king, said to Duryodhana these words:-How is this that we are standing here, while the Madraka army is being killed before our eyes? O Bharata,when you are here, it does not look well!

data.v: किं नः संप्रेक्षमाणानां मद्राणां हन्यते बलम् । न युक्तमेतत्समरे त्वयि तिष्ठति भारत ॥
data.md: Then Sakuni, the eloquent son of the Gandhara king, O king, said to Duryodhana these words:-How is this that we are standing here, while the Madraka army is being killed before our eyes? O Bharata,when you are here, it does not look well!

data.v: सहितैर्नाम योद्धव्यमित्येष समयः कृतः । अथ कस्मात्परानेव घ्नतो मर्षयसे नृप ॥
data.md: The contract was that all of us should fight in a body. Why then, O king, do you suffer our foes to kill thus our soldiers?

data.v: वार्यमाणा मया पूर्वं नैते चक्रुर्वचो मम । एते हि निहताः सर्वे प्रस्कन्नाः पाण्डुवाहिनीम् ॥
data.md: Duryodhana said Though prevented by me before, they did not carry our my order. These men, in a body, have entered into the Pandava army.

data.v: न भर्तुः शासनं वीरा रणे कुर्वन्त्यमर्षिताः । अलं क्रोद्धुं तथैतेषां नायं काल उपेक्षितुम् ॥
data.md: Sakuni said When worked up with rage in battle, brave warriors do not obcy the bchests of their leaders. You should not be angry with those men. This is not the time to act indifferently.

data.v: यामः सर्वेऽत्र संभूय सवाजिरथकुञ्जराः । परित्रातुं महेष्वासान्मद्रराजपदानुगान् ॥
data.md: We shall, therefore, all of us, in a body with our cars and horses and elephants, proceed, for rescuing those great bowmen, viz., the followers of the Madra king.
