data.v: तेषामापततां तत्र संहृष्टानां परस्परम् । संमर्दः सुमहाञ्जज्ञे घोररूपो भयानकः ॥
data.md: The clash of those rushing warriors elated with joy was loud and exceedingly terrible.

data.v: भीमसेनं तदा राजन्धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम् । बलेन चतुरङ्गेण नानादेश्या न्यवारयन् ॥
data.md: Then Bhimasena, O king and Dhrishtadyumna, the son of Prishata, opposed them with four-fold forces.

data.v: भीममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त रणेऽन्ये तु पदातयः । प्रक्ष्वेड्यास्फोट्य संहृष्टा वीरलोकं यियासवः ॥
data.md: Other foot-soldiers, all actuated with the desire of victory, proceeded against Bhima, uttering loud cries and slapping their armpits, by the desire of going to heaven.

data.v: आसाद्य भीमसेनं तु संरब्धा युद्धदुर्मदाः । धार्तराष्ट्रा विनेदुर्हि नान्यां चाकथयन्कथाम् । परिवार्य रणे भीमं निजघ्नुस्ते समन्ततः ॥
data.md: Filled with rage and invincible in battle those heroes, belonging to your party, approached Bhimasena and cried aloud. They then spoke not to one another. Encircling Bhima in that battle, they began to strike him from all sides.

data.v: स वध्यमानः समरे पदातिगणसंवृतः । न चचाल रथोपस्थे मैनाक इव पर्वतः ॥
data.md: Encircled by that huge body of infantry and struck by them in that battle Bhima did not stir from where he stood are remained motionless like the Mainaka mountain.

data.v: ते तु क्रुद्धा महाराज पाण्डवस्य महारथम् । निग्रहीतुं प्रचक्रुर्हि योधांश्चान्यानवारयन् ॥
data.md: His antagonists meanwhile, filled with rage, O monarch, tried to assail that great car-warrior of the Pandavas and opposed other combatants (that tried to rescue him).

data.v: अक्रुध्यत रणे भीमस्तैस्तदा पर्यवस्थितैः । सोऽवतीर्य रथात्तूर्णं पदातिः समवस्थितः ॥
data.md: Encountered by those warriors, Bhima became furious. And quickly getting down from his car, he proceeded on foot against them.

data.v: जातरूपपरिच्छन्नां प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम् । अवधीत्तावकान्योधान्दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः ॥
data.md: Taking up his massive mace adorned with gold, he began to kill your soldiers like the destroyer himself armed with his club.

data.v: रथाश्वद्विपहीनांस्तु तान्भीमो गदया बली । एकविंशतिसाहस्रान्पदातीनवपोथयत् ॥
data.md: The mighty Bhiina, with his mace, crushed those twenty one thousand foot-soldiers who deprived of cars and horses and elephants.

data.v: हत्वा तत्पुरुषानीकं भीमः सत्यपराक्रमः । धृष्टद्युम्नं पुरस्कृत्य नचिरात्प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥
data.md: Having killed that strong army 3hima, of great prowess, showed himself with Dhrishtadyumna in his front.

data.v: पादाता निहता भूमौ शिश्यिरे रुधिरोक्षिताः । संभग्ना इव वातेन कर्णिकाराः सुपुष्पिताः ॥
data.md: The foot-soldiers, of your party thus slain, lay down on the ground, bathed in blood, like Karnikaras with their flowers struck down by a storm.

data.v: नानापुष्पस्रजोपेता नानाकुण्डलधारिणः । नानाजात्या हतास्तत्र नानादेशसमागताः ॥
data.md: Adorned with garlands made of various kinds of flowers and with diverse kinds of earrings, those combatants of various races, who were had come from various kingdoms, lay down on the field, lifeless.

data.v: पताकाध्वजसंछन्नं पदातीनां महद्बलम् । निकृत्तं विबभौ तत्र घोररूपं भयानकम् ॥
data.md: Covered with banners and standards, that large army of foot-soldiers looked fierce and terrible and lay prostrate on the field.

data.v: युधिष्ठिरपुरोगास्तु सर्वसैन्यमहारथाः । अभ्यधावन्महात्मानं पुत्रं दुर्योधनं तव ॥
data.md: The great car-warriors, with their followers, that fought under Yudhishthira, all pursued you illustrious son Duryodhana.

data.v: ते सर्वे तावकान्दृष्ट्वा महेष्वासान्पराङ्मुखान् । नाभ्यवर्तन्त ते पुत्रं वेलेव मकरालयम् ॥
data.md: Beholding your troops turn away from the battle, those great bowmen proceeded against Duryodhana, but they could not overcome him even as the ocean cannot go beyond its continents.

data.v: तदद्भुतमपश्याम तव पुत्रस्य पौरुषम् । यदेकं सहिताः पार्था न शेकुरतिवर्तितुम् ॥
data.md: The prowess of the king of the Madras was highly wonderful, since the Parthas, even in a body, could not approach him in that battle.

data.v: नातिदूरापयातं तु कृतबुद्धिं पलायने । दुर्योधनः स्वकं सैन्यमब्रवीद्भृशविक्षतम् ॥
data.md: Addressing his own army which had not fled far but which, wounded with arrows, were bent upon flying, Then Duryodhana said these words: "I do not see a place on plain or mountain, where if you fly, the Pandavas will not pursue and kill you. What is the use of flight?

data.v: न तं देशं प्रपश्यामि पृथिव्यां पर्वतेषु वा । यत्र यातान्न वो हन्युः पाण्डवाः किं सृतेन वः ॥
data.md: Addressing his own army which had not fled far but which, wounded with arrows, were bent upon flying, Then Duryodhana said these words: "I do not see a place on plain or mountain, where if you fly, the Pandavas will not pursue and kill you. What is the use of flight?

data.v: अल्पं च बलमेतेषां कृष्णौ च भृशविक्षतौ । यदि सर्वेऽत्र तिष्ठामो ध्रुवो नो विजयो भवेत् ॥
data.md: The army of the Pandavas had been reduced in nuinbers. The two Krishnas are greatly wounded. If all of us make a stand, we will surely acquire victory.

data.v: विप्रयातांस्तु वो भिन्नान्पाण्डवाः कृतकिल्बिषान् । अनुसृत्य हनिष्यन्ति श्रेयो नः समरे स्थितम् ॥
data.md: If you fly away, in confusion, the sinful Pandavas will pursue you and kill you. If on the other hand we made a bold stand, it will do us good.

data.v: शृणुध्वं क्षत्रियाः सर्वे यावन्तः स्थ समागताः । यदा शूरं च भीरुं च मारयत्यन्तकः सदा । को नु मूढो न युध्येत पुरुषः क्षत्रियब्रुवः ॥
data.md: Listen, all you Kshatriyas that are here. When Dcath always kills heroes and cowards alike what man is there so foolish that, calling himself a Kshatriya, will not fight.

data.v: श्रेयो नो भीमसेनस्य क्रुद्धस्य प्रमुखे स्थितम् । सुखः सांग्रामिको मृत्युः क्षत्रधर्मेण युध्यताम् । जित्वेह सुखमाप्नोति हतः प्रेत्य महत्फलम् ॥
data.md: It will be to our interest if we stay before the angry Bhimasena. Death in battle, while fighting in pursuance of the Kshatriya practices, leads to happiness.

data.v: न युद्धधर्माच्छ्रेयान्वै पन्थाः स्वर्गस्य कौरवाः । अचिरेण जिताँल्लोकान्हतो युद्धे समश्नुते ॥
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य पूजयित्वा च पार्थिवाः । पुनरेवान्ववर्तन्त पाण्डवानाततायिनः ॥
तानापतत एवाशु व्यूढानीकाः प्रहारिणः । प्रत्युद्ययुस्तदा पार्था जयगृध्राः प्रहारिणः ॥
data.md: Seeing them advancing quickly the Parthas, arrayed in order of battle, skilled in smiting, worked up with rage and filled with the desire of victory, proceeded against them.

data.v: धनंजयो रथेनाजावभ्यवर्तत वीर्यवान् । विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु गाण्डीवं विक्षिपन्धनुः ॥
data.md: Stretching his bow Gandiva celebrated over the three worlds, the brave Dhananjaya proceeded on his car against the foe.

data.v: माद्रीपुत्रौ च शकुनिं सात्यकिश्च महाबलः । जवेनाभ्यपतन्हृष्टा यतो वै तावकं बलम् ॥
data.md: The two sons of Madri and Satyaki rushed against Shakuni and the other Pandava heroes smilingly proceeded against your army.

data.v: संनिवृत्ते बलौघे तु शाल्वो म्लेच्छगणाधिपः । अभ्यवर्तत संक्रुद्धः पाण्डूनां सुमहद्बलम् ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said After the (Kuru) army had been gathered Shalya, the king of the Mlechchhas, filled with rage, rushed against the large army of the Pandavas, riding on a gigantic clephant, with temporal juice trickling, looking like a hill, elated with pride, resembling Airavata himself and capable of crushing large numbers of foes.

data.v: आस्थाय सुमहानागं प्रभिन्नं पर्वतोपमम् । दृप्तमैरावतप्रख्यममित्रगणमर्दनम् ॥
योऽसौ महाभद्रकुलप्रसूतः; सुपूजितो धार्तराष्ट्रेण नित्यम् । सुकल्पितः शास्त्रविनिश्चयज्ञैः; सदोपवाह्यः समरेषु राजन् ॥
data.md: Shalya's animal was of a good breed, was always adored by Dhritarashtra's sons and was properly equipped and properly trained for battle, O king, by persons well conversant with the science of elephant training. Riding on that elephant, that foremost of kings looked like the morning sun at the close of summer.

data.v: तमास्थितो राजवरो बभूव; यथोदयस्थः सविता क्षपान्ते । स तेन नागप्रवरेण राज;न्नभ्युद्ययौ पाण्डुसुतान्समन्तात् । शितैः पृषत्कैर्विददार चापि; महेन्द्रवज्रप्रतिमैः सुघोरैः ॥
ततः शरान्वै सृजतो महारणे; योधांश्च राजन्नयतो यमाय । नास्यान्तरं ददृशुः स्वे परे वा; यथा पुरा वज्रधरस्य दैत्याः ॥
ते पाण्डवाः सोमकाः सृञ्जयाश्च; तमेव नागं ददृशुः समन्तात् । सहस्रशो वै विचरन्तमेकं; यथा महेन्द्रस्य गजं समीपे ॥
data.md: The Pandavas, the Somakes and the Srinjayas, saw one elephant look like a thousand elephants moving around them as the enemies of the gods had in days of yore seen the elephant of Indra in battle.

data.v: संद्राव्यमाणं तु बलं परेषां; परीतकल्पं विबभौ समन्तात् । नैवावतस्थे समरे भृशं भया;द्विमर्दमानं तु परस्परं तदा ॥
data.md: The army so driven by thai elephant seemed as if trapped from all sides. It could not stay for moments in the battle-field on account of sheer fright. All soldiers started crushing in hue and cry over mutual pull and push.

data.v: ततः प्रभग्ना सहसा महाचमूः; सा पाण्डवी तेन नराधिपेन । दिशश्चतस्रः सहसा प्रधाविता; गजेन्द्रवेगं तमपारयन्ती ॥
data.md: Agitated by that animal, the hostile army looked life-less. Unable to stand in battle, they then fled away in great fear, crushing one another. Then the huge army of the Pandavas, routed by king Shalya, suddenly fled on all sides unable to stand the vigor of that elephant.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा च तां वेगवता प्रभग्नां; सर्वे त्वदीया युधि योधमुख्याः । अपूजयंस्तत्र नराधिपं तं; दध्मुश्च शङ्खाञ्शशिसंनिकाशान् ॥
data.md: Seeing the Pandava army routed and flying away quickly all your leading warriors worshipped king Shalya and blew their moonwhite conchs.

data.v: श्रुत्वा निनादं त्वथ कौरवाणां; हर्षाद्विमुक्तं सह शङ्खशब्दैः । सेनापतिः पाण्डवसृञ्जयानां; पाञ्चालपुत्रो न ममर्ष रोषात् ॥
data.md: Hearing the war-cries of the Kauravas uttered in joy and the blare of their conchs, the commander of the Pandava and the Srinjaya forces, viz., the Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna could not, from wrath, bear it.

data.v: ततस्तु तं वै द्विरदं महात्मा; प्रत्युद्ययौ त्वरमाणो जयाय । जम्भो यथा शक्रसमागमे वै; नागेन्द्रमैरावणमिन्द्रवाह्यम् ॥
data.md: The illustrious Dhrishtadyumna then quickly proceeded for defeating that elephant, as the Asura Jainbha had proceed against Airavata, the carrier of Indra, while he fought with Indra.

data.v: तमापतन्तं सहसा तु दृष्ट्वा; पाञ्चालराजं युधि राजसिंहः । तं वै द्विपं प्रेषयामास तूर्णं; वधाय राजन्द्रुपदात्मजस्य ॥
data.md: Beholding the king of the Pandavas proceed against him, Shalya, the foremost of kings, quickly urged his elephant, O king, for the destruction of Drupada's son.

data.v: स तं द्विपं सहसाभ्यापतन्त;मविध्यदर्कप्रतिमैः पृषत्कैः । कर्मारधौतैर्निशितैर्ज्वलद्भि;र्नाराचमुख्यैस्त्रिभिरुग्रवेगैः ॥
data.md: Seeing the animal approaching the latter struck it with three best arrows, polished, keen, blazing, powerful and resembling fire itself in effulgence and force.

data.v: ततोऽपरान्पञ्च शितान्महात्मा; नाराचमुख्यान्विससर्ज कुम्भे । स तैस्तु विद्धः परमद्विपो रणे; तदा परावृत्य भृशं प्रदुद्रुवे ॥
data.md: Then that illustrious hero struck the animal on the trunk with five other whetted and best arrows. Struck therewith, that prince of elephants, turning away from the battle, ran quickly away.

data.v: तं नागराजं सहसा प्रणुन्नं; विद्राव्यमाणं च निगृह्य शाल्वः । तोत्त्राङ्कुशैः प्रेषयामास तूर्णं; पाञ्चालराजस्य रथं प्रदिश्य ॥
data.md: Suddenly checking that foremost of elephants which had been greatly wounded and compelled to retreat Shalya, however, caused it to turn back and with hooks and keen lances urged it forward against the car of the Panchala king, pointing it out to the infuriate animal.

data.v: दृष्ट्वापतन्तं सहसा तु नागं; धृष्टद्युम्नः स्वरथाच्छीघ्रमेव । गदां प्रगृह्याशु जवेन वीरो; भूमिं प्रपन्नो भयविह्वलाङ्गः ॥
data.md: Beholding the animal rushing forcibly at him, the heroic Dhrishtadyumna, taking up a mace, quickly leaped down on the Earth from his car, his limbs benumbed with fear.

data.v: स तं रथं हेमविभूषिताङ्गं; साश्वं ससूतं सहसा विमृद्य । उत्क्षिप्य हस्तेन तदा महाद्विपो; विपोथयामास वसुंधरातले ॥
data.md: That huge elephant, meanwhile, suddenly crushing that gold-decked car with its horses and driver, raised it up in the air with his trunk and then dashed it down on the Earth.

data.v: पाञ्चालराजस्य सुतं स दृष्ट्वा; तदार्दितं नागवरेण तेन । तमभ्यधावत्सहसा जवेन; भीमः शिखण्डी च शिनेश्च नप्ता ॥
data.md: Beholding the driver of Panchala king thus crushed by that best of elephants. Bhima and Shikhandin and the grandson of Shini rushed with great force against that animal.

data.v: शरैश्च वेगं सहसा निगृह्य; तस्याभितोऽभ्यापततो गजस्य । स संगृहीतो रथिभिर्गजो वै; चचाल तैर्वार्यमाणश्च संख्ये ॥
data.md: With their arrows they quickly restrained that animal. Thus restrained by them in battle, the elephant began to tremble.

data.v: ततः पृषत्कान्प्रववर्ष राजा; सूर्यो यथा रश्मिजालं समन्तात् । तेनाशुगैर्वध्यमाना रथौघाः; प्रदुद्रुवुस्तत्र ततस्तु सर्वे ॥
data.md: Meanwhile king Shalya began to discharge arrows like the Sun shedding his rays on all sides. Struck with those arrows, the (Pandava) car-warriors began to fly away.

data.v: तत्कर्म शाल्वस्य समीक्ष्य सर्वे; पाञ्चालमत्स्या नृप सृञ्जयाश्च । हाहाकारैर्नादयन्तः स्म युद्धे; द्विपं समन्ताद्रुरुधुर्नराग्र्याः ॥
data.md: Beholding that feat of Shalya, the Panchalas, the Srinjayas and the Matsyas. O king, bewailed aloud in that battle. All those foremost of men however, surrounded the animal entirely.

data.v: पाञ्चालराजस्त्वरितस्तु शूरो; गदां प्रगृह्याचलशृङ्गकल्पाम् । असंभ्रमं भारत शत्रुघाती; जवेन वीरोऽनुससार नागम् ॥
data.md: Then, taking up his mace resembling the crest of a mountain, the brave Panchalas appeared there. Fearlessly, O king, that hero, that striker of foes, rushed quickly against the clephant.

data.v: ततोऽथ नागं धरणीधराभं; मदं स्रवन्तं जलदप्रकाशम् । गदां समाविध्य भृशं जघान; पाञ्चालराजस्य सुतस्तरस्वी ॥
data.md: The active prince of the Panchala, approaching, began to strike with his mace that animal which was huge as a hill and which shed temporal juice like a mass of pouring clouds.

data.v: स भिन्नकुम्भः सहसा विनद्य; मुखात्प्रभूतं क्षतजं विमुञ्चन् । पपात नागो धरणीधराभः; क्षितिप्रकम्पाच्चलितो यथाद्रिः ॥
data.md: Its trunk cut open, the animal cried aloud; and vomiting enough blood, the animal, huge as a hill, suddenly dropped down as a mountain falling down during an earthquake.

data.v: निपात्यमाने तु तदा गजेन्द्रे; हाहाकृते तव पुत्रस्य सैन्ये । स शाल्वराजस्य शिनिप्रवीरो; जहार भल्लेन शिरः शितेन ॥
data.md: While that best of elephants was falling down and while your son's ariny were bewailing at the spectacle, that best of warriors among the Shinis cut off the head of king Shalya with a sharp and broad-headed arrow.

data.v: हृतोत्तमाङ्गो युधि सात्वतेन; पपात भूमौ सह नागराज्ञा । यथाद्रिशृङ्गं सुमहत्प्रणुन्नं; वज्रेण देवाधिपचोदितेन ॥
data.md: His head having been sundered by the Satwata hero, Shalya dropped down on the Earth along with his best of elephants, like a mountain summit suddenly clapped by the thunder-bolt discharged by the best of the celestials.

data.v: तस्मिंस्तु निहते शूरे शाल्वे समितिशोभने । तवाभज्यद्बलं वेगाद्वातेनेव महाद्रुमः ॥
data.md: Sanjaya said After the heroic Shalya, that flower of the court, had been killed your ariny were dispersed like a huge tree broken by the force of the storm.

data.v: तत्प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा कृतवर्मा महारथः । दधार समरे शूरः शत्रुसैन्यं महाबलः ॥
data.md: Seeing the army routed, the great carwarrior, Kritavarına, opposed the hostile force in that battle.

data.v: संनिवृत्तास्तु ते शूरा दृष्ट्वा सात्वतमाहवे । शैलोपमं स्थितं राजन्कीर्यमाणं शरैर्युधि ॥
data.md: Seeing the Satwata hero, O king, standing in battle like a hill though struck with arrows (by the foe), the Kuru heroes, who had fled away, rallied and came back.

data.v: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरूणां पाण्डवैः सह । निवृत्तानां महाराज मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् ॥
data.md: Then, O king, an encounter which took place between the Pandavas and the Kurus who were determined upon meeting with death.

data.v: तत्राश्चर्यमभूद्युद्धं सात्वतस्य परैः सह । यदेको वारयामास पाण्डुसेनां दुरासदाम् ॥
data.md: Wonderful was that fierce encounter which took place between the Satwata hero and his foes, since alone hc opposed the invincible ariny of the Pandavas.

data.v: तेषामन्योन्यसुहृदां कृते कर्मणि दुष्करे । सिंहनादः प्रहृष्टानां दिवःस्पृक्सुमहानभूत् ॥
data.md: Seeing this most difficult feat friends, filled with delight, set up leonine shouts that sceined to reach the very heavens.

data.v: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तान्पाञ्चालान्भरतर्षभ । शिनेर्नप्ता महाबाहुरन्वपद्यत सात्यकिः ॥
data.md: At those sounds and Panchalas, O foremost of Bharata's race, were filled with fear. Then Satyaki, the grandson of Shini, came there.

data.v: स समासाद्य राजानं क्षेमधूर्तिं महाबलम् । सप्तभिर्निशितैर्बाणैरनयद्यमसादनम् ॥
data.md: Approaching the powerful king Kshemakirti, Satyaki killed him with seven keen arrows.

data.v: तमायान्तं महाबाहुं प्रवपन्तं शिताञ्शरान् । जवेनाभ्यपतद्धीमान्हार्दिक्यः शिनिपुंगवम् ॥
data.md: Then the intelligent son of Hridika, rushed quickly against the best of Shinis, that mightyarmed warrior, as the latter came discharging his whetted shafts.

data.v: तौ सिंहाविव नर्दन्तौ धन्विनौ रथिनां वरौ । अन्योन्यमभ्यधावेतां शस्त्रप्रवरधारिणौ ॥
data.md: Those two bowmen, those two foremost of car-warriors roared like lions and met each other, both being armed with best of weapons.

data.v: पाण्डवाः सह पाञ्चालैर्योधाश्चान्ये नृपोत्तमाः । प्रेक्षकाः समपद्यन्त तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः ॥
data.md: The Pandavas, the Panchalas and the other warriors, witnessed that terrible encounter between the two heroes.

data.v: नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथौ । अभिजघ्नतुरन्योन्यं प्रहृष्टाविव कुञ्जरौ ॥
data.md: Those two Vrishni and Andhaka heroes, like two elephants filled with delight, struck each other with long arrows and arrows with calf-toothed heads.

data.v: चरन्तौ विविधान्मार्गान्हार्दिक्यशिनिपुंगवौ । मुहुरन्तर्दधाते तौ बाणवृष्ट्या परस्परम् ॥
data.md: Moving about in various ways the son of Hridika and that foremost of Shini's race soon covered each other with showers of arrows.

data.v: चापवेगबलोद्धूतान्मार्गणान्वृष्णिसिंहयोः । आकाशे समपश्याम पतंगानिव शीघ्रगान् ॥
data.md: The arrows of those two Vrishni chiefs, shot off their bows, appeared like swiftlycoursing insects in the sky.

data.v: तमेकं सत्यकर्माणमासाद्य हृदिकात्मजः । अविध्यन्निशितैर्बाणैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् ॥
data.md: Approaching the powerful Satyaki of true prowess, the son of Hridika struck the four horses of the former with four keen arrows.

data.v: स दीर्घबाहुः संक्रुद्धस्तोत्त्रार्दित इव द्विपः । अष्टाभिः कृतवर्माणमविध्यत्परमेषुभिः ॥
data.md: Enraged at this like an elephant struck with a lance, the long-armed Satyaki struck Kritavarman with eight best arrows.

data.v: ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः कृतवर्मा शिलाशितैः । सात्यकिं त्रिभिराहत्य धनुरेकेन चिच्छिदे ॥
data.md: Then Kritavarman struck Satyaki with three arrows whetted on stone and shot off his bow drawn to its fullest stretch and then cut of his bow with another arrow.

data.v: निकृत्तं तद्धनुःश्रेष्ठमपास्य शिनिपुंगवः । अन्यदादत्त वेगेन शैनेयः सशरं धनुः ॥
data.md: Casting off his bow which was thus cut off, that heroe, quickly took up another that was stronger than the first.

data.v: तदादाय धनुःश्रेष्ठं वरिष्ठः सर्वधन्विनाम् । आरोप्य च महावीर्यो महाबुद्धिर्महाबलः ॥
अमृष्यमाणो धनुषश्छेदनं कृतवर्मणा । कुपितोऽतिरथः शीघ्रं कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात् ॥
data.md: Having taken up that best of bows and stringed it, that foremost of all bowmen, that warrior of great energy, intelligence and strength, unable to bear the cutting of his bow by Kritavarman, quickly and furiously rushed against the latter.

data.v: ततः सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्दशभिः शिनिपुंगवः । जघान सूतमश्वांश्च ध्वजं च कृतवर्मणः ॥
data.md: With ten keen arrows that Shini chief then struck the driver, the horses and the standard of Kritavarman.

data.v: ततो राजन्महेष्वासः कृतवर्मा महारथः । हताश्वसूतं संप्रेक्ष्य रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम् ॥
data.md: At this, O king, the great bowinan and carwarrior Kritavarman, beholding his golddecked car made driverless and horseless, was filled with rage. Taking up a pointed lance, he discharged it with all might at that best of Shini's race, desirous of killing him.

data.v: रोषेण महताविष्टः शूलमुद्यम्य मारिष । चिक्षेप भुजवेगेन जिघांसुः शिनिपुंगवम् ॥
data.md: At this, O king, the great bowinan and carwarrior Kritavarman, beholding his golddecked car made driverless and horseless, was filled with rage. Taking up a pointed lance, he discharged it with all might at that best of Shini's race, desirous of killing him.

data.v: तच्छूलं सात्वतो ह्याजौ निर्भिद्य निशितैः शरैः । चूर्णितं पातयामास मोहयन्निव माधवम् । ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन हृद्येनं समताडयत् ॥
data.md: Striking that lance with many keen arrows, Satyaki sundered it off into pieces and caused it to fall down. Stupefying Kritavarinan of Madhu's race with another broad-headed arrow he then struck Kritavarman on the chest.

data.v: स युद्धे युयुधानेन हताश्वो हतसारथिः । कृतवर्मा कृतास्त्रेण धरणीमन्वपद्यत ॥
